namespace Infragistics.Documents.Reports

	public interface ISealable
	{
		bool IsSealed { get; }

		void Seal();
	}
	public class SealableBase : ISealable
	{
		private bool isSealed;

		public bool IsSealed => isSealed;

		public virtual void Seal()
		{
			isSealed = true;
		}

		internal virtual bool VerifyMembersSealed()
		{
			return true;
		}

		public static void VerifyNotSealed(ISealable instance)
		{
			if (instance == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("instance");
			}
			if (instance.IsSealed)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperation_Sealed"));
			}
		}
	}

		internal class LOGFONT

			public int lfHeight;

			public byte lfClipPrecision;

			public byte lfQuality;

			public byte lfPitchAndFamily;

			[MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValTStr, SizeConst = 32)]

			public LOGFONT(bool dummy)
			{
				lfHeight = 0;
				lfWidth = 0;
				lfEscapement = 0;
				lfOrientation = 0;
				lfWeight = 0;
				lfItalic = 0;
				lfUnderline = 0;

				lfClipPrecision = 0;
				lfQuality = 0;
				lfPitchAndFamily = 0;
				lfFaceName = string.Empty;
			}
		}

		public static bool CryptAcquireContextApi(ref IntPtr hProv, string pszContainer, string pszProvider, uint dwProvType, uint dwFlags)
		{
			try
			{
				return CryptAcquireContextUnsafe(ref hProv, pszContainer, pszProvider, dwProvType, dwFlags);
			}
			catch
			{
				hProv = IntPtr.Zero;
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static bool CryptAcquireContextUnsafe(ref IntPtr hProv, string pszContainer, string pszProvider, uint dwProvType, uint dwFlags)
		{
			return CryptAcquireContext(ref hProv, pszContainer, pszProvider, dwProvType, dwFlags);
		}

		public static bool CryptEncryptApi(IntPtr hKey, IntPtr hHash, int bFinal, uint dwFlags, byte[] pbData, ref int pdwDataLen, int dwBufLen)
		{
			try
			{
				uint pdwDataLen2 = (uint)pdwDataLen;
				bool result = CryptEncryptUnsafe(hKey, hHash, bFinal, dwFlags, pbData, ref pdwDataLen2, (uint)dwBufLen);
				pdwDataLen = (int)pdwDataLen2;
				return result;
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static bool CryptEncryptUnsafe(IntPtr hKey, IntPtr hHash, int bFinal, uint dwFlags, byte[] pbData, ref uint pdwDataLen, uint dwBufLen)
		{
			return CryptEncrypt(hKey, hHash, bFinal, dwFlags, pbData, ref pdwDataLen, dwBufLen);
		}

		public static bool CryptImportKeyApi(IntPtr hProv, byte[] pbData, uint dwDataLen, IntPtr hPubKey, uint dwFlags, ref IntPtr phKey)
		{
			try
			{
				return CryptImportKeyUnsafe(hProv, pbData, dwDataLen, hPubKey, dwFlags, ref phKey);
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static bool CryptImportKeyUnsafe(IntPtr hProv, byte[] pbData, uint dwDataLen, IntPtr hPubKey, uint dwFlags, ref IntPtr phKey)
		{
			return CryptImportKey(hProv, pbData, dwDataLen, hPubKey, dwFlags, ref phKey);
		}

		public static bool CryptReleaseContextApi(IntPtr hProv, uint dwFlags)
		{
			try

	[ComVisible(false)]
	public sealed class DocumentsResourceCustomizer
	{
		private Dictionary<string, string> customizedStrings;

		private IDictionary CustomizedStrings
		{
			get
			{
				if (customizedStrings == null)
				{
					customizedStrings = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				}
				return customizedStrings;
			}
		}

		public string GetCustomizedString(string name)
		{
			if (CustomizedStrings.Contains(name))
			{
				return CustomizedStrings[name] as string;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void ResetAllCustomizedStrings()
		{
			if (customizedStrings != null)
			{
				customizedStrings.Clear();
			}
		}

		public void ResetCustomizedString(string name)
		{
			SetCustomizedString(name, null);
		}

		public void SetCustomizedString(string name, string customizedText)
		{
			if (CustomizedStrings.Contains(name))
			{
				CustomizedStrings.Remove(name);
			}
			if (customizedText != null)
			{
				CustomizedStrings.Add(name, customizedText);
			}
		}
	}
	[ComVisible(false)]
	public static class Resources
	{
		public static DocumentsResourceCustomizer Customizer => ResourceCustomizerLocator.Customizer;

		public static string GetString(string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return SR.GetString(name, args);
		}

		public static string GetString(string name)
		{
			return SR.GetString(name);
		}

		public static object GetObject(string name)
		{
			return SR.GetObject(name);
		}
	}

		}

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image _image;

	internal class Brush : Object
	{
		private short _style;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color _color;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.HatchStyle _hatch;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image _image;

		public override ObjectType Type => ObjectType.Brush;

		public Brush()
		{
			_style = 0;
			_color = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Colors.Black;
			_hatch = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.HatchStyle.Cross;
		}

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush GetBrush(State state)
		{
			if (_style == 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (_style == 0)
			{
				return new SolidColorBrush(_color);
			}
			if (_style == 2)
			{
				if (state.BackMode == 1)
				{
					return new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.HatchBrush(_hatch, _color, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Colors.White);
				}
				return new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.HatchBrush(_hatch, _color, state.BackColor);
			}
			if (_style == 3 && _image != null)
			{
				return new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.TextureBrush(_image);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void Load(Reader reader)
		{
			_style = reader.ReadShort();
			switch (_style)
			{
			case 0:
			case 1:
			case 2:
				_color = reader.ReadRGBColor();
				switch (reader.ReadShort())
				{
				case 0:
					_hatch = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.HatchStyle.Horizontal;
					break;
				case 1:
					_hatch = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.HatchStyle.Vertical;
					break;
				case 2:
					_hatch = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.HatchStyle.ForwardDiagonal;
					break;
				case 3:
					_hatch = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.HatchStyle.BackwardDiagonal;
					break;
				case 4:
					_hatch = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.HatchStyle.Cross;
					break;
				case 5:
					_hatch = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.HatchStyle.DiagonalCross;
					break;
				}
				break;
			case 3:
			case 5:
			{
				reader.Stream.Position += 2L;
				Image image = new Image();
				image.Load(reader);
				_image = image.GetImage();
				break;
			}
			case 4:
				break;
			}
		}
	}

				{
					float eh = (float)reader.ReadShort() * _state.ScaleY / _state.ExtentY;
					float ew = (float)reader.ReadShort() * _state.ScaleX / _state.ExtentX;
					num4 = _state.TranslateY(reader.ReadShort());
					num3 = _state.TranslateX(reader.ReadShort());
					num2 = _state.TranslateY(reader.ReadShort());
					num = _state.TranslateX(reader.ReadShort());
					x = num;
					y = num2;
					num5 = num3 - num;
					num6 = num4 - num2;
					graphics.Brush = _state.Brush.GetBrush(_state);
					graphics.Pen = _state.Pen.GetPen(_state);
					graphics.DrawRoundedRect(x, y, num5, num6, ew, eh, PaintMode.FillStroke);
					break;
				}
				case 30:
				{
					graphics.SaveState();
					State state = new State();
					state.Assign(_state);
					_states.Push(state);
					break;
				}
				case 301:
					Select(reader.ReadShort());
					break;
				case 513:
					_state.BackColor = reader.ReadRGBColor();
					break;
				case 258:
					_state.BackMode = reader.ReadShort();
					break;
				case 1055:
				{
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color color = reader.ReadRGBColor();
					y = reader.ReadShort();
					x = reader.ReadShort();
					_state.Position = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point(x, y);
					y = _state.TranslateY(y);
					x = _state.TranslateX(x);
					graphics.Brush = new SolidColorBrush(color);
					graphics.DrawRectangle(x, y, 0.5f, 0.5f, PaintMode.Fill);
					break;
				}
				case 262:
				{
					short num29 = reader.ReadShort();
					if (num29 == 1)
					{
						graphics.AlternateFill = true;
					}
					else
					{
						graphics.AlternateFill = false;
					}
					break;
				}
				case 302:
					_state.TextAlignment = reader.ReadShort();
					break;
				case 264:
					_state.CharacterExtra = reader.ReadShort();
					break;
				case 521:
					_state.TextColor = reader.ReadRGBColor();
					break;
				case 527:
					_state.OffsetY += reader.ReadShort();
					_state.OffsetX += reader.ReadShort();
					break;
				case 524:
					_state.ExtentY = reader.ReadShort();
					_state.ExtentX = reader.ReadShort();
					break;
				case 523:
					_state.OffsetY = reader.ReadShort();
					_state.OffsetX = reader.ReadShort();
					break;
				case 2881:
				case 3907:
				{
					_stream.Position += 12L;
					if (num9 == 3907)
					{
						_stream.Position += 2L;
					}
					num6 = reader.ReadShort();
					num5 = reader.ReadShort();
					y = reader.ReadShort();
					x = reader.ReadShort();
					num6 = num6 * _state.ScaleY / _state.ExtentY;
					num5 = num5 * _state.ScaleX / _state.ExtentX;
					y = _state.TranslateY(y);
					x = _state.TranslateX(x);
					Image image = new Image();
					image.Load(reader);
					graphics.DrawImage(image.GetImage(), x, y, num5, num6);
					break;
				}
				case 1313:
				{
					short num10 = reader.ReadShort();
					byte[] array = new byte[num10];
					for (short num11 = 0; num11 < num10; num11++)
					{
						array[num11] = (byte)reader.ReadByte();
					}
					if (num10 != 0 && (num10 != 1 || array[0] > 32))
					{
						int num12 = (num10 + 1) & 0xFFFE;
						_stream.Position += num12 - num10;
						y = reader.ReadShort();
						x = reader.ReadShort();
						if ((_state.TextAlignment & 1) == 1)
						{
							y = _state.Position.Y;
							x = _state.Position.X;
						}
						y = _state.TranslateY(y);
						x = _state.TranslateX(x);
						DrawText(graphics, x, y, array, fontMapper);
					}
					break;
				}
				}
				_stream.Position = position2;
			}
		}

		private static float CalculateAngle(float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2)
		{
			float num = x2 - x1;
			float num2 = y2 - y1;
			if (num == 0f && num2 > 0f)
			{
				return 90f;
			}
			if (num == 0f && num2 < 0f)
			{
				return -90f;
			}
			double num3 = Math.Atan(Math.Abs(num2 / num));
			if (num2 > 0f && num < 0f)
			{
				num3 = Math.PI - num3;
			}
			if (num2 < 0f && num < 0f)
			{
				num3 = Math.PI + num3;
			}
			if (num2 < 0f && num > 0f)
			{
				num3 = Math.PI * 2.0 - num3;
			}
			return (float)(num3 * (Math.PI / 180.0));
		}

		private void Add(Object obj)
		{
			int count = _objects.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (_objects[i] == null)
				{
					_objects[i] = obj;
					return;
				}
			}
			_objects.Add(obj);
		}

		private void DrawText(IGraphics graphics, float x, float y, byte[] buffer, IFontMapper fontMapper)
		{
			graphics.Font = _state.Font.GetFont(_state, fontMapper);
			string text = TextEncoding.GetEncoding(_state.Font.Charset).Encode(buffer);
			graphics.CharSpacing = (float)_state.CharacterExtra * _state.ScaleX / _state.ExtentX;
			short textAlignment = _state.TextAlignment;
			float stringWidth = graphics.GetStringWidth(text);
			FontMetrics fontMetrics = graphics.FontMetrics;
			float height = fontMetrics.Height;
			float ascent = fontMetrics.Ascent;
			float num = 0f;
			if ((textAlignment & 6) == 6)
			{
				num = stringWidth / 2f;
			}
			else if ((textAlignment & 2) == 2)
			{
				num = stringWidth;
			}
			x -= num;
			float num2 = 0f;
			if ((textAlignment & 0x18) == 24)
			{
				num2 = height;
			}
			else if ((textAlignment & 8) == 8)
			{
				num2 = ascent;
			}
			y -= num2;
			float angle = _state.Font.Angle;
			if (_state.BackMode == 2)
			{
				graphics.Brush = new SolidColorBrush(_state.BackColor);
				if (angle == 0f)
				{
					graphics.DrawRectangle(x, y, stringWidth, height, PaintMode.Fill);
				}
				else
				{
					graphics.SaveState();
					graphics.Rotate(x + num, y + num2, angle);
					graphics.DrawRectangle(x, y, stringWidth, height, PaintMode.Fill);
					graphics.RestoreState();
				}
			}
			graphics.Brush = new SolidColorBrush(_state.TextColor);
			if (angle == 0f)
			{
				graphics.DrawString(x, y, text);
				return;
			}
			graphics.SaveState();
			graphics.Rotate(x + num, y + num2, angle);
			graphics.DrawString(x, y, text);
			graphics.RestoreState();
		}

		private void Remove(int index)
		{
			if (index >= 0 && index < _objects.Count)
			{
				_objects[index] = null;
			}
		}

		private void Select(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || index >= _objects.Count)
			{
				return;
			}
			Object obj = _objects[index];
			if (obj != null)
			{
				switch (obj.Type)
				{
				case ObjectType.Font:
					_state.Font = (Font)obj;
					break;
				case ObjectType.Brush:
					_state.Brush = (Brush)obj;
					break;
				case ObjectType.Pen:
					_state.Pen = (Pen)obj;
					break;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class Font : Object
	{
		private CharBuffer _name;

		private short _height;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle _style;

		private byte _charset;

		private float _angle;

		public float Angle => _angle;

		public byte Charset => _charset;

		public override ObjectType Type => ObjectType.Font;

		public Font()
		{
			_name = new CharBuffer(35);
			_style = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Regular;
		}

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font GetFont(State state, IFontMapper fontMapper)
		{
			string text = _name.ToString().Trim();
			if (fontMapper != null)
			{
				text = fontMapper.MapFont(text);
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) || text == "Symbol" || text == "System")
			{
				text = "Arial";
			}
			float num = Math.Abs((float)_height * state.ScaleY / state.ExtentY);
			if (num <= 0f)
			{
				num = 12f;
			}
			return new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font(text, num, _style);
		}

		public override void Load(Reader reader)
		{
			_height = Math.Abs(reader.ReadShort());
			reader.Stream.Position += 2L;
			_angle = (float)reader.ReadShort() / 10f;
			reader.Stream.Position += 2L;
			_style = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Regular;
			if (reader.ReadShort() >= 600)
			{
				_style |= Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Bold;
			}
			if (reader.ReadByte() > 0)
			{
				_style |= Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Italic;
			}
			if (reader.ReadByte() > 0)
			{
				_style |= Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Underline;
			}
			if (reader.ReadByte() > 0)
			{
				_style |= Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Strikeout;
			}
			_charset = (byte)reader.ReadByte();
			reader.Stream.Position += 4L;
			_name.Clear();
			for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++)
			{
				int num = reader.ReadByte();
				if (num > 0)
				{
					_name.Add((char)num);
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class Object
	{
		public virtual ObjectType Type => ObjectType.Default;

		public virtual void Load(Reader reader)
		{
		}
	}
	internal class Pen : Object
	{
		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color _color;

		private float _width;

		private short _style;

		public override ObjectType Type => ObjectType.Pen;

		public Pen()
		{
			_color = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Colors.Black;
			_style = 0;
		}

		public override void Load(Reader reader)
		{
			_style = reader.ReadShort();
			_width = reader.ReadShort();
			reader.Stream.Position += 2L;
			_color = reader.ReadRGBColor();
		}

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen GetPen(State state)
		{
			if (_style == 5)
			{
				return null;
			}
			float num = Math.Abs(_width * state.ScaleX / state.ExtentX);
			if ((double)num < 0.01)
			{
				num = 0.01f;
			}
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.DashStyle style = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.DashStyle.Solid;
			switch (_style)
			{
			case 0:
				style = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.DashStyle.Solid;
				break;
			case 2:
				style = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.DashStyle.Dot;
				break;
			case 1:
				style = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.DashStyle.Dash;
				break;
			case 3:
				style = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.DashStyle.DashDot;
				break;
			case 4:
				style = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.DashStyle.DashDotDot;
				break;
			}
			return new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen(_color, num, style);
		}
	}
	internal class Reader
	{
		private System.IO.Stream _stream;

		public System.IO.Stream Stream => _stream;

		public Reader(System.IO.Stream stream)
		{
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("stream");
			}
			_stream = stream;
		}

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color ReadBGRColor()
		{
			byte b = (byte)_stream.ReadByte();
			byte g = (byte)_stream.ReadByte();
			byte r = (byte)_stream.ReadByte();
			_stream.Position++;
			return new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color(r, g, b);
		}

		public int ReadByte()
		{
			return _stream.ReadByte();
		}

		public int ReadInt()
		{
			int num = _stream.ReadByte();
			int num2 = _stream.ReadByte();
			int num3 = _stream.ReadByte();
			int num4 = _stream.ReadByte();
			num2 <<= 8;
			num3 <<= 16;
			num4 <<= 24;
			return num4 | num3 | num2 | num;
		}

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color ReadRGBColor()
		{
			byte r = (byte)_stream.ReadByte();
			byte g = (byte)_stream.ReadByte();
			byte b = (byte)_stream.ReadByte();
			_stream.Position++;
			return new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color(r, g, b);
		}

		public short ReadShort()
		{
			int num = _stream.ReadByte();
			int num2 = _stream.ReadByte();
			num2 <<= 8;
			return (short)(num2 | num);
		}

		public uint ReadUInt()
		{
			int num = _stream.ReadByte();
			int num2 = _stream.ReadByte();
			int num3 = _stream.ReadByte();
			int num4 = _stream.ReadByte();
			num2 <<= 8;
			num3 <<= 16;
			num4 <<= 24;
			return (uint)(num4 | num3 | num2 | num);
		}
	}

			_backColor = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Colors.White;
			_backMode = 2;
			_extentX = 1f;
			_extentY = 1f;
			_scaleX = 1f;
			_scaleY = 1f;
		}

		public void Assign(State state)
		{
			if (state != null)
			{
				_font = state.Font;
				_brush = state.Brush;
				_pen = state.Pen;
				_position = state.Position;
				_textColor = state.TextColor;
				_backColor = state.BackColor;
				_backMode = state.BackMode;
				_textAlignment = state.TextAlignment;
				_characterExtra = state.CharacterExtra;
				_x = state.X;
				_y = state.Y;
				_offsetX = state.OffsetX;
				_offsetY = state.OffsetY;
				_extentX = state.ExtentX;
				_extentY = state.ExtentY;
				_scaleX = state.ScaleX;
				_scaleY = state.ScaleY;
			}
		}

		public float TranslateX(float value)
		{
			return _x + (value - _offsetX) * _scaleX / _extentX;
		}

		public float TranslateY(float value)
		{
			return _y + (value - _offsetY) * _scaleY / _extentY;
		}
	}

		{
			_operator.Add(ch);
		}

		public void ProcessSubject(char ch)
		{
			_subject.Add(ch);
		}

		public void ProcessTitle(char ch)
		{
			_title.Add(ch);
		}

	public class DestinationKeyword : Keyword
	{
		public DestinationKeyword(byte symbol, Target target)
			: base(symbol, target)
		{
		}
	}
	public class FlagKeyword : Keyword
	{
		public FlagKeyword(byte symbol, Target target)
			: base(symbol, target)
		{
		}
	}
	public class Keyword
	{
		[CLSCompliant(false)]
		protected byte _symbol;

		[CLSCompliant(false)]
		protected Target _target;

		public byte Symbol
		{
			get
			{
				return _symbol;
			}
			set
			{
				_symbol = value;
			}
		}

		public Target Target
		{
			get
			{
				return _target;
			}
			set
			{
				_target = value;
			}
		}

		public Keyword(byte symbol, Target target)
		{
			_symbol = symbol;
			_target = target;
		}
	}
	public class SymbolKeyword : Keyword
	{
		public SymbolKeyword(byte symbol, Target target)
			: base(symbol, target)
		{
		}
	}
	public class ToggleKeyword : Keyword
	{
		private bool _active;

		public bool Active
		{
			get
			{
				return _active;
			}
			set
			{
				_active = value;
			}
		}

		public ToggleKeyword(byte symbol, Target target)
			: this(symbol, target, active: false)
		{
		}

		public ToggleKeyword(byte symbol, Target target, bool active)
			: base(symbol, target)
		{
			_active = active;
		}
	}
	public class ValueKeyword : Keyword
	{
		private int _value;

		public int Value
		{
			get
			{
				return _value;
			}
			set
			{
				_value = value;
			}
		}

		public ValueKeyword(byte symbol, Target target)
			: this(symbol, target, 0)
		{
		}

		public ValueKeyword(byte symbol, Target target, int value)
			: base(symbol, target)
		{
			_value = value;
		}
	}

		public Reader(System.IO.Stream stream, ICallback callback)
		{
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("stream");
			}
			if (callback == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("callback");
			}
			_stream = stream;
			_callback = callback;
			_buffer = new List<byte>(25);
			_capacity = 25;
			_format = Format.Default;
			_mode = Mode.Default;
			_states = new Stack<State>();
			_state = new State();
			_state.Changed = true;
			_charset = 238;
			_fonts = new Dictionary<int, Font>(25);
			_colors = new Dictionary<int, Color>(25);
			_defaultFontIndex = -1;
			_defaultColorIndex = -1;
			_info = new Info();
		}

		private void ChangeDestination(int destination)
		{
			if (destination != 25 && destination != 26)
			{
				_state.Destination = destination;
			}
		}

		private char EncodeChar(int ch)
		{
			if (ch <= 255 && _charset != 238)
			{
				ch = TextEncoding.GetEncoding(_charset).Encode((byte)ch);
			}
			if (_state.Character.Capital)
			{
				ch = char.ToUpper((char)ch);
			}
			return (char)ch;
		}

		private void PopState()
		{
			int destination = _state.Destination;
			if (_states.Count > 0)
			{
				_state = _states.Pop();
				_state.Changed = true;
			}
			_groupCounter--;
			if (_mode == Mode.Skip)
			{
				_skipCounter--;
				if (_skipCounter == 0)
				{
					_mode = Mode.Default;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (destination == _state.Destination)
				{
					return;
				}
				switch (destination)
				{
				case 29:
					if (_fonts.ContainsKey(_defaultFontIndex))
					{
						_charset = _fonts[_defaultFontIndex].Charset;
					}
					break;
				case 45:
					_callback.OnInfo(_info);
					break;
				case 99:
				{
					_imageStream.Position = 0L;
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image(_imageStream);
					_imageStream.Close();
					_callback.OnImage(image, _imageWidth, _imageHeight);
					break;
				}
				}
			}
		}

		private void ProcessChar(int ch)
		{
			if (_format == Format.Bin)
			{
				_binaryCounter--;
				if (_binaryCounter <= 0)
				{
					_format = Format.Default;
				}
			}
			if ((_format == Format.Default || _format == Format.Hex) && _unicodeCounter > 0)
			{
				_unicodeCounter--;
				return;
			}
			if (_format == Format.Unicode)
			{
				_format = Format.Default;
			}
			if (_mode == Mode.Skip)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (_state.Destination)
			{
			case 1:
				_callback.OnChar(EncodeChar(ch));
				break;
			case 97:
				_callback.OnChar(EncodeChar(ch));
				break;
			case 29:
				if (_activeFont != null)
				{
					_activeFont.ProcessName((char)ch);
				}
				break;
			case 41:
				if (ch == 59)
				{
					_activeColor = new Color();
					_colors.Add(_colors.Count, _activeColor);
				}
				break;
			case 46:
				_info.ProcessTitle(EncodeChar(ch));
				break;
			case 47:
				_info.ProcessSubject(EncodeChar(ch));
				break;
			case 48:
				_info.ProcessAuthor(EncodeChar(ch));
				break;
			case 49:
				_info.ProcessManager(EncodeChar(ch));
				break;
			case 50:
				_info.ProcessCompany(EncodeChar(ch));
				break;
			case 51:
				_info.ProcessOperator(EncodeChar(ch));
				break;
			case 52:
				_info.ProcessCategory(EncodeChar(ch));
				break;
			case 53:
				_info.ProcessKeywords(EncodeChar(ch));
				break;
			case 99:
				_imageStream.WriteByte((byte)ch);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void ProcessCharacterProperties(Keyword keyword)
		{
			switch (keyword.Symbol)
			{
			case 84:
				_state.Character.Bold = false;
				_state.Character.Italic = false;
				_state.Character.Underline = false;
				_state.Character.Capital = false;
				_state.Character.Subscript = false;
				_state.Character.Superscript = false;
				_state.Character.FontIndex = -1;
				_state.Character.FontSize = -1;
				_state.Character.ColorIndex = -1;
				_state.Character.BackColorIndex = -1;
				_state.Character.Changed = true;
				break;
			case 85:
				_state.Character.Bold = ((ToggleKeyword)keyword).Active;
				_state.Character.Changed = true;
				break;
			case 86:
				_state.Character.Capital = ((ToggleKeyword)keyword).Active;
				_state.Character.Changed = true;
				break;
			case 87:
				_state.Character.BackColorIndex = ((ValueKeyword)keyword).Value;

		private void ProcessKeyword(string name, int value, bool assigned)
		{
			Keyword keyword = null;
			if (_keywords.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				keyword = _keywords[name];
			}
			if (keyword == null)
			{
				if (_marked)
				{
					_mode = Mode.Skip;
					_skipCounter = 1;
					_marked = false;
				}
				return;
			}
			_marked = false;
			if (_mode == Mode.Skip)
			{
				if (keyword.Target != Target.Format)
				{
					return;
				}
				ProcessFormat(keyword);
			}
			if (assigned)
			{
				if (keyword is ValueKeyword)
				{
					((ValueKeyword)keyword).Value = value;
				}
				if (keyword is ToggleKeyword)
				{
					if (value != 0)
					{
						((ToggleKeyword)keyword).Active = true;
					}
					else
					{
						((ToggleKeyword)keyword).Active = false;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (keyword is ToggleKeyword)
			{
				((ToggleKeyword)keyword).Active = true;
			}
			if (keyword is DestinationKeyword)
			{
				ChangeDestination(keyword.Symbol);
			}
			switch (keyword.Target)
			{
			case Target.Default:
				ProcessDefault(keyword);
				break;
			case Target.Format:
				ProcessFormat(keyword);
				break;
			case Target.Symbol:
				ProcessSymbol(keyword);
				break;
			case Target.Unicode:
				ProcessUnicode(keyword);
				break;
			case Target.FontTable:
				ProcessFontTable(keyword);
				break;
			case Target.ColorTable:
				ProcessColorTable(keyword);
				break;
			case Target.InfoGroup:
				ProcessInfoGroup(keyword);
				break;
			case Target.DocumentProperties:
				ProcessDocumentProperties(keyword);
				break;
			case Target.SectionProperties:
				ProcessSectionProperties(keyword);
				break;
			case Target.ParagraphProperties:
				ProcessParagraphProperties(keyword);
				break;
			case Target.TableProperties:
				ProcessTableProperties(keyword);
				break;
			case Target.CharacterProperties:
				ProcessCharacterProperties(keyword);
				break;
			case Target.Field:
				ProcessField(keyword);
				break;
			case Target.Image:
				ProcessImage(keyword);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void PushState()
		{
			State item = new State(_state);
			_states.Push(item);
			_format = Format.Default;
			_groupCounter++;
			if (_mode == Mode.Skip)
			{
				_skipCounter++;
			}
		}

		private int ReadChar()
		{
			int num = -1;
			if (_position < _buffer.Count)
			{
				num = _buffer[_position];
				_position++;
			}
			else
			{
				num = _stream.ReadByte();
				if (num != -1)
				{
					if (_position < _capacity)
					{
						_buffer.Add((byte)num);
						_position++;
					}
					else
					{
						_buffer.RemoveAt(0);
						_buffer.Add((byte)num);
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private bool ReadKeyword()
		{
			int num = ReadChar();
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!char.IsLetter((char)num))
			{
				ProcessKeyword(char.ToString((char)num), 0, assigned: false);
				return true;
			}
			CharBuffer charBuffer = new CharBuffer(30);
			while (char.IsLetter((char)num))
			{
				charBuffer.Add((char)num);
				num = ReadChar();
				if (num == -1)
				{
					ProcessKeyword(charBuffer.ToString(), 0, assigned: false);
					return true;
				}
			}
			string name = charBuffer.ToString();
			charBuffer.Clear();
			bool flag = false;
			if (num == 45)
			{
				flag = true;
				num = ReadChar();
				if (num == -1)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (char.IsDigit((char)num))
			{
				while (num != -1 && char.IsDigit((char)num))
				{
					charBuffer.Add((char)num);
					num = ReadChar();
				}
				int num2 = Convert.ToInt32(charBuffer.ToString());
				if (flag)
				{
					num2 = -num2;
				}
				ProcessKeyword(name, num2, assigned: true);
			}
			else
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					return false;
				}
				ProcessKeyword(name, 0, assigned: false);
			}
			if (num != 32)
			{
				UnreadChar();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void UnreadChar()
		{
			_position--;
			if (_position < 0)
			{
				_position = 0;
			}
		}

		public void Read()
		{
			_callback.OnStart();
			byte b = 0;
			int num = 0;
			while (true)
			{
				if (_groupCounter < 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				int num2 = ReadChar();
				if (num2 == -1)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (_format == Format.Bin)
				{
					ProcessChar(num2);
					continue;
				}
				switch (num2)
				{
				case 10:
				case 13:
					continue;
				case 123:
					PushState();
					continue;
				case 125:
					PopState();
					continue;
				case 92:
					if (!ReadKeyword())
					{
						return;
					}
					continue;
				}
				if (_format == Format.Default && _state.Destination != 99)
				{
					ProcessChar(num2);
					continue;
				}
				num++;
				b <<= 4;
				if (num2 >= 48 && num2 <= 57)
				{
					b += (byte)(num2 - 48);
				}
				if (num2 >= 97 && num2 <= 102)
				{
					b += (byte)(num2 - 97 + 10);
				}
				if (num2 >= 65 && num2 <= 70)
				{
					b += (byte)(num2 - 65 + 10);
				}
				if (num == 2)
				{
					ProcessChar(b);
					_format = Format.Default;
					b = 0;
					num = 0;
				}
			}
			_callback.OnEnd();
		}
	}

				return _strikeout;
			}
			set
			{
				_strikeout = value;
			}
		}

		public Character()
		{
			Reset();
		}

		public Character(Character value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				_bold = value.Bold;
				_italic = value.Italic;
				_underline = value.Underline;
				_capital = value.Capital;
				_subscript = value.Subscript;
				_superscript = value.Superscript;
				_fontIndex = value.FontIndex;
				_fontSize = value.FontSize;
				_colorIndex = value.ColorIndex;
				_backColorIndex = value.BackColorIndex;
				_changed = value.Changed;
				_strikeout = value.Strikeout;
			}
			else
			{
				Reset();
			}
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			_bold = false;
			_italic = false;
			_underline = false;
			_capital = false;
			_subscript = false;
			_superscript = false;
			_fontIndex = -1;
			_fontSize = -1;
			_colorIndex = -1;
			_backColorIndex = -1;
			_changed = false;
			_strikeout = false;
		}
	}

	public class State
	{
		private int _unicodeCounter;

		private int _destination;

		private Document _d;

		private Section _s;

		private Paragraph _p;

		private Character _c;

		private bool _changed;

		public bool Changed
		{
			get
			{
				return _changed;
			}
			set
			{
				_changed = value;
			}
		}

		public Character Character => _c;

		public int Destination
		{
			get
			{
				return _destination;
			}
			set
			{
				_destination = value;
			}
		}

		public Document Document => _d;

		public Paragraph Paragraph => _p;

		public Section Section => _s;

		public int UnicodeCounter
		{
			get
			{
				return _unicodeCounter;
			}
			set
			{
				_unicodeCounter = value;
			}
		}

		public State()
		{
			Reset();
		}

		public State(State value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				_unicodeCounter = value.UnicodeCounter;
				_destination = value.Destination;
				_d = new Document(value.Document);
				_s = new Section(value.Section);
				_p = new Paragraph(value.Paragraph);
				_c = new Character(value.Character);
				_changed = value.Changed;
			}
			else
			{
				Reset();
			}
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			_unicodeCounter = 0;
			_destination = 0;
			_d = new Document();
			_s = new Section();
			_p = new Paragraph();
			_c = new Character();
			_changed = false;
		}
	}
}

	[Serializable]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(PageMarginsTypeConverter))]
	public class PageMargins
	{
		private class PageMarginsTypeConverter : TypeConverter
		{
			public override bool GetStandardValuesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return context != null;
			}

			public override StandardValuesCollection GetStandardValues(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				List<PageMargins> list = new List<PageMargins>();
				list.Add(Normal);
				list.Add(Narrow);
				list.Add(Moderate);
				list.Add(Wide);
				return new StandardValuesCollection(list);
			}

			public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
			{
				if (sourceType == typeof(string))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
			}

			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(string))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			[SecuritySafeCritical]
			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				PageMargins pageMargins = value as PageMargins;
				if (typeof(string) == destinationType && pageMargins != null)
				{
					if (pageMargins.Name != null && pageMargins.Name.Length > 0)
					{
						return pageMargins.Name;
					}
					if (culture == null)
					{
						culture = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
					}
					string listSeparator = culture.TextInfo.ListSeparator;
					return string.Format("{0}{4} {1}{4} {2}{4} {3}", pageMargins.Left, pageMargins.Top, pageMargins.Right, pageMargins.Bottom, listSeparator);
				}
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor) && pageMargins != null)
				{
					ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(PageMargins).GetConstructor(new Type[4]
					{
						typeof(float),
						typeof(float),
						typeof(float),
						typeof(float)
					});
					if (constructor != null)
					{
						return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[4] { pageMargins.Left, pageMargins.Top, pageMargins.Right, pageMargins.Bottom }, isComplete: true);
					}
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
			{
				if (value is string)
				{
					if (culture == null)
					{
						culture = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
					}
					string listSeparator = culture.TextInfo.ListSeparator;
					string text = ((string)value).Trim();
					if (text.Length == 0)
					{
						return Normal;
					}
					PageMargins pageMargins = GetPageMargins(text);
					if (pageMargins != null)
					{
						return pageMargins;
					}
					string[] array = text.Split(listSeparator[0]);
					if (array.Length != 4)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException($"Unable to parse text '{text}' into a PageMargins. Expected format is 'Width, Height'");
					}
					TypeConverter converter = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(typeof(int));
					int[] array2 = new int[4];
					for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
					{
						array2[i] = (int)converter.ConvertFromString(array[i]);
					}
					return new PageMargins(array2[0], array2[1], array2[2], array2[3]);
				}
				return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
			}
		}

		private static Dictionary<string, PageMargins> _pageMargins;

		private static Dictionary<string, string> _names;

		private static PageMargins _pageMarginsNormal;

		private static PageMargins _pageMarginsNarrow;

		private static PageMargins _pageMarginsModerate;

		private static PageMargins _pageMarginsWide;

		private float _left;

		private float _top;

		private float _right;

		private float _bottom;

		public float Left => _left;

		public float Top => _top;

		public float Right => _right;

		public float Bottom => _bottom;

		public string Name => GetName(this);

		public static PageMargins Normal => _pageMarginsNormal;

		public static PageMargins Narrow => _pageMarginsNarrow;

		public static PageMargins Moderate => _pageMarginsModerate;

		public static PageMargins Wide => _pageMarginsWide;

		static PageMargins()
		{
			_pageMargins = new Dictionary<string, PageMargins>(4);
			_names = new Dictionary<string, string>(4);
			_pageMarginsNormal = new PageMargins(72f, 72f, 72f, 72f);
			_pageMarginsNarrow = new PageMargins(36f, 36f, 36f, 36f);
			_pageMarginsModerate = new PageMargins(54f, 72f, 54f, 72f);
			_pageMarginsWide = new PageMargins(144f, 72f, 144f, 72f);
			_pageMargins.Add("Normal", _pageMarginsNormal);
			_pageMargins.Add("Narrow", _pageMarginsNarrow);
			_pageMargins.Add("Moderate", _pageMarginsModerate);
			_pageMargins.Add("Wide", _pageMarginsWide);
			_names.Add(_pageMarginsNormal.ToString(), "Normal");
			_names.Add(_pageMarginsNarrow.ToString(), "Narrow");
			_names.Add(_pageMarginsModerate.ToString(), "Moderate");
			_names.Add(_pageMarginsWide.ToString(), "Wide");
		}

		public PageMargins(float left, float top, float right, float bottom)
		{
			if (left < 0f)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("width", "[0.0, ...]");
			}
			if (top < 0f)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("height", "[0.0, ...]");
			}
			if (right < 0f)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("height", "[0.0, ...]");
			}
			if (bottom < 0f)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("height", "[0.0, ...]");
			}
			_left = left;
			_top = top;
			_right = right;
			_bottom = bottom;
		}

		public static string GetName(PageMargins pageMargins)
		{
			if (pageMargins == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string key = pageMargins.ToString();
			if (_names.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				return _names[key];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static PageMargins GetPageMargins(string name)
		{
			if (name == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (_pageMargins.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				return _pageMargins[name];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return _left.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + ", " + _top.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + ", " + _right.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + ", " + _bottom.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo);
		}
	}

	public class Borders : SealableBase
	{
		private Border _left;

		private Border _right;

		private Border _top;

		private Border _bottom;

		private Corners _corners;

		public Border All
		{
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_left = value;
				_right = value;
				_top = value;
				_bottom = value;
			}
		}

		public Border Bottom
		{
			get
			{
				if (_bottom == null)
				{
					_bottom = new Border();
				}
				return _bottom;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_bottom = value;
			}
		}

		public Corners Corners
		{
			get
			{
				if (_corners == null)
				{
					_corners = new Corners();
				}
				return _corners;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_corners = value;
			}
		}

		public bool HasAll
		{
			get
			{
				if (HasBottom && HasLeft && HasRight)
				{
					return HasTop;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool HasBottom => _bottom != null;

		public bool HasLeft => _left != null;

		public bool HasRight => _right != null;

		public bool HasTop => _top != null;

		public Border Horizontal
		{
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_left = value;
				_right = value;
			}
		}

		public Border Left
		{
			get
			{
				if (_left == null)
				{
					_left = new Border();
				}
				return _left;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_left = value;
			}
		}

		public Border Right
		{
			get
			{
				if (_right == null)
				{
					_right = new Border();
				}
				return _right;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_right = value;
			}
		}

		public Border Top
		{
			get
			{
				if (_top == null)
				{
					_top = new Border();
				}
				return _top;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_top = value;
			}
		}

		public Border Vertical
		{
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_top = value;
				_bottom = value;
			}
		}

		public Borders()
		{
		}

		public Borders(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen pen)
		{
			All = new Border(pen);
		}

		public Borders(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen pen, float radius)
			: this(pen)
		{
			_corners = new Corners(pen, radius);
		}

		public Borders(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen h, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen v)
		{
			if (h != null)
			{
				Horizontal = new Border(h);
			}
			if (v != null)
			{
				Vertical = new Border(v);
			}
		}

		public Borders(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen left, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen right, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen top, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen bottom)
		{
			_left = new Border(left);
			_right = new Border(right);
			_top = new Border(top);
			_bottom = new Border(bottom);
		}

		public override void Seal()
		{
			base.Seal();
			Corners.Seal();
		}

		internal override bool VerifyMembersSealed()
		{
			if (_corners != null && !_corners.IsSealed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

		public class Reader
		{
			private System.IO.Stream _stream;

			public System.IO.Stream Stream => _stream;

			public Reader(System.IO.Stream stream)
			{
				_stream = stream;
			}

			public bool ReadBoolean()
			{
				if (_stream.ReadByte() != 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public int ReadByte()
			{
				return _stream.ReadByte();
			}

			public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color ReadColor()
			{
				byte a = (byte)_stream.ReadByte();
				byte r = (byte)_stream.ReadByte();
				byte g = (byte)_stream.ReadByte();
				byte b = (byte)_stream.ReadByte();
				return new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color(a, r, g, b);
			}

			public float ReadFloat()
			{
				return BitConverter.ToSingle(new byte[4]
				{
					(byte)_stream.ReadByte(),
					(byte)_stream.ReadByte(),
					(byte)_stream.ReadByte(),
					(byte)_stream.ReadByte()
				}, 0);
			}

			public int ReadInt()
			{
				int num = _stream.ReadByte();
				int num2 = _stream.ReadByte();
				int num3 = _stream.ReadByte();
				int num4 = _stream.ReadByte();
				num <<= 24;
				num2 <<= 16;
				num3 <<= 8;
				return num | num2 | num3 | num4;
			}

			public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point[] ReadPoints()
			{
				int i = 0;
				int num = ReadInt();
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point[] array = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point[num];
				for (; i < num; i++)
				{
					float x = ReadFloat();
					float y = ReadFloat();
					array[i] = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point(x, y);
				}
				return array;
			}

			public string ReadString()
			{
				int i = 0;
				int num = ReadInt();
				CharBuffer charBuffer = new CharBuffer();
				for (; i < num; i++)
				{
					int num2 = _stream.ReadByte();
					int num3 = _stream.ReadByte();
					charBuffer.Add((char)((num2 << 8) | num3));
				}
				return charBuffer.ToString();
			}
		}

		public class Writer
		{
			private System.IO.Stream _stream;

			public Writer(System.IO.Stream stream)
			{
				_stream = stream;
			}

			public void Write(byte b)
			{
				_stream.WriteByte(b);
			}

			public void Write(int value)
			{
				byte value2 = (byte)(value >> 24);
				byte value3 = (byte)(value >> 16);
				byte value4 = (byte)(value >> 8);
				byte value5 = (byte)value;
				_stream.WriteByte(value2);
				_stream.WriteByte(value3);
				_stream.WriteByte(value4);
				_stream.WriteByte(value5);
			}

			public void Write(float value)
			{
				byte[] bytes = BitConverter.GetBytes(value);
				_stream.WriteByte(bytes[0]);
				_stream.WriteByte(bytes[1]);
				_stream.WriteByte(bytes[2]);
				_stream.WriteByte(bytes[3]);
			}

			public void Write(bool value)
			{
				if (value)
				{
					_stream.WriteByte(1);
				}
				else
				{
					_stream.WriteByte(0);
				}
			}

			public void Write(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color color)
			{
				_stream.WriteByte(color.A);
				_stream.WriteByte(color.R);
				_stream.WriteByte(color.G);
				_stream.WriteByte(color.B);
			}

			public void Write(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix matrix)
			{
				Write(matrix.M11);
				Write(matrix.M12);
				Write(matrix.M21);
				Write(matrix.M22);
				Write(matrix.OffsetX);
				Write(matrix.OffsetY);
			}

			public void Write(string text)
			{
				Write(text.Length);
				foreach (char c in text)
				{
					byte b = (byte)((int)c >> 8);
					byte b2 = (byte)c;
					Write(b);
					Write(b2);
				}
			}

			public void Write(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point[] points)
			{
				Write(points.Length);
				foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point point in points)
				{
					Write(point.X);
					Write(point.Y);
				}
			}
		}

		private MemoryStream _stream;

		private Writer _writer;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix _matrix;

		private Stack<State> _states;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.TTF.Font _ttFont;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font _font;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush _brush;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen _pen;

		private float _fontSize;

		private float _fontAscent;

		private float _fontDescent;

		private float _fontHeight;

		private float _boldFactor;

		private bool _hyperlinkStarted;

		private bool _hyperlinkPaused;

		private float _posX;

		private float _posY;

		private float _charSpacing;

		private bool _alternateFill;

		private object parent;

		public bool AlternateFill
		{
			get
			{
				return _alternateFill;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_alternateFill != value)
				{
					_alternateFill = value;
					_writer.Write((byte)9);
					_writer.Write(_alternateFill);
				}
			}
		}

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush Brush
		{
			get
			{
				return _brush;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_brush == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				_brush = value;
				if (_brush != null)
				{
					if (_report.BrushIndexes.ContainsKey(_brush))
					{
						_writer.Write((byte)3);
						_writer.Write(_report.BrushIndexes[_brush]);
						return;
					}
					int count = _report.BrushIndexes.Count;
					_report.BrushIndexes.Add(_brush, count);
					_report.Brushes.Add(_brush);
					_writer.Write((byte)3);
					_writer.Write(count);
				}
				else
				{
					_writer.Write((byte)4);
				}
			}
		}

		public float CharSpacing
		{
			get
			{
				return _charSpacing;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_charSpacing != value)
				{
					_charSpacing = value;
					_writer.Write((byte)8);
					_writer.Write(_charSpacing);
				}
			}
		}

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font Font
		{
			get
			{
				return _font;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_font == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				_font = value;
				if (_font != null)
				{
					if (_report.FontIndexes.ContainsKey(_font))
					{
						_writer.Write((byte)1);
						_writer.Write(_report.FontIndexes[_font]);
					}
					else
					{
						int count = _report.FontIndexes.Count;
						_report.FontIndexes.Add(_font, count);
						_report.Fonts.Add(_font);
						_writer.Write((byte)1);
						_writer.Write(count);
					}
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.TTF.FontHashKey key = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.TTF.FontHashKey(_font.Name, _font.Style);
					if (_report.TTFonts.ContainsKey(key))
					{
						_ttFont = _report.TTFonts[key];
					}
					else
					{
						_ttFont = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.TTF.FontFactory.CreateFont(_font);
						_report.TTFonts.Add(key, _ttFont);
					}
					_fontSize = _font.Size;
					_fontAscent = _fontSize * _ttFont.Ascent;
					_fontDescent = _fontSize * _ttFont.Descent;
					_fontHeight = _fontSize * _ttFont.Height;
					bool flag = (_font.Style & Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Bold) == Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Bold;
					bool flag2 = (_ttFont.Style & Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Bold) == Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Bold;
					if (flag && !flag2)
					{
						_boldFactor = 1.15f;
					}
					else
					{
						_boldFactor = 1f;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_writer.Write((byte)2);
					_ttFont = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public FontMetrics FontMetrics => new FontMetrics(_fontAscent, _fontDescent, _fontHeight);

		public bool HyperlinkStarted => _hyperlinkStarted;

		public bool HyperlinkPaused => _hyperlinkPaused;

		public object Parent => parent;

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen Pen
		{
			get
			{
				return _pen;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_pen == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				_pen = value;
				if (_pen != null)
				{
					if (_report.PenIndexes.ContainsKey(_pen))
					{
						_writer.Write((byte)5);
						_writer.Write(_report.PenIndexes[_pen]);
						return;
					}
					int count = _report.PenIndexes.Count;
					_report.PenIndexes.Add(_pen, count);
					_report.Pens.Add(_pen);
					_writer.Write((byte)5);
					_writer.Write(count);
				}
				else
				{
					_writer.Write((byte)6);
				}
			}
		}

		public MemoryStream Stream => _stream;

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point TextPosition
		{
			get
			{
				return new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point(_posX, _posY);
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_writer.Write((byte)7);
				_writer.Write(value.X);
				_writer.Write(value.Y);
				SetTextPosition(value.X, value.Y);
			}
		}

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix Transformation => _matrix.Clone();

		public override ElementType Type => ElementType.Canvas;

		public Canvas(Report report)
			: base(report)
		{
			_stream = new MemoryStream();
			_writer = new Writer(_stream);
			_matrix = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix();
			_states = new Stack<State>();
			_alternateFill = true;
		}

		private void PopState()
		{
			State state = _states.Pop();
			Font = state.Font;
			Brush = state.Brush;
			Pen = state.Pen;
			_matrix = state.Matrix;
			_charSpacing = state.CharSpacing;
			_alternateFill = state.AlternateFill;
		}

		private void PushState()
		{
			State state = new State();
			state.Font = _font;
			state.Brush = _brush;
			state.Pen = _pen;
			state.Matrix = _matrix.Clone();
			state.CharSpacing = _charSpacing;
			state.AlternateFill = _alternateFill;
			_states.Push(state);
		}

		private void SetTextPosition(float x, float y)
		{
			int num = (int)(_posX * 100f);
			int num2 = (int)(x * 100f);
			int num3 = (int)(_posY * 100f);
			int num4 = (int)(y * 100f);
			if (Math.Abs(num - num2) > 1 || Math.Abs(num3 - num4) > 1)
			{
				_posX = x;
				_posY = y;
			}
		}

		public void DrawImage(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image, float x, float y, float width, float height, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color transparentColor, float alpha)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("image");
			}
			if (!(alpha <= 0f))
			{
				_writer.Write((byte)42);
				if (_report.ImageIndexes.ContainsKey(image))
				{
					_writer.Write(_report.ImageIndexes[image]);
				}
				else
				{
					int count = _report.ImageIndexes.Count;
					_report.ImageIndexes.Add(image, count);
					_report.Images.Add(image);
					_writer.Write(count);
				}
				_writer.Write(x);
				_writer.Write(y);
				_writer.Write(width);
				_writer.Write(height);
				if (transparentColor != null)
				{
					_writer.Write(value: true);
					_writer.Write(transparentColor);
				}
				else
				{
					_writer.Write(value: false);
				}
				_writer.Write(alpha);
			}
		}

		{

			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("text");
			}
			_writer.Write((byte)21);
			_writer.Write(x);
			_writer.Write(y);
			_writer.Write(text);
			SetTextPosition(x, y);
			if (_ttFont != null)
			{
				float stringWidth = GetStringWidth(text);
				_posX = x + stringWidth;
				_posY = y;
			}
		}

		public float GetCharWidth(char ch)
		{
			if (_ttFont != null)
			{
				return _fontSize * _boldFactor * (float)_ttFont.GlyphWidth(ch) / 1000f + _charSpacing;
			}
			return 0f;
		}

		public float GetStringWidth(string text)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			int length = text.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				char c = text[i];
				if (c < ' ')
				{
					c = ' ';
				}
				num += GetCharWidth(c);
			}
			return num;
		}

		public void Rotate(float centerX, float centerY, float angle)
		{
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix matrix = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix();
			matrix.RotateAt(angle, new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point(centerX, centerY), Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.MatrixOrder.Prepend);
			Transform(matrix);
		}

		public void SaveClip(float x, float y, float width, float height)
		{

		public override Bounds GetBounds(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			float num3 = 0f;
			if (_margins != null)
			{
				num3 += _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
			}
			switch (_width.Type)
			{
			case WidthType.Fixed:
				num = ((FixedWidth)_width).Value;
				num2 = num;
				break;
			case WidthType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeWidth relativeWidth = (RelativeWidth)_width;
				num2 = composition.Scene.Width - num3;
				num2 *= relativeWidth.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeWidth.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num);
					num2 = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num2);
				}
				break;
			}
			case WidthType.Max:
			case WidthType.Auto:
				num2 = composition.Scene.Width - num3;
				break;
			}
			return new Bounds(num + num3, num2 + num3);
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			CanvasArea canvasArea = null;
			float num = 0f;
			switch (_width.Type)
			{
			case WidthType.Fixed:
				num = ((FixedWidth)_width).Value;
				break;
			case WidthType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeWidth relativeWidth = (RelativeWidth)_width;
				num = composition.Scene.Width;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
				num *= relativeWidth.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeWidth.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num);
				}
				break;
			}
			case WidthType.Max:
			case WidthType.Auto:
				num = composition.Scene.Width;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (num < 0f)
			{
				num = 0f;
			}
			float num2 = 65535f;
			switch (_height.Type)
			{
			case HeightType.Fixed:
				num2 = ((FixedHeight)_height).Value;
				break;
			case HeightType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeHeight relativeHeight = (RelativeHeight)_height;
				num2 = composition.ResidualHeight;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num2 -= _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
				}
				num2 *= relativeHeight.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeHeight.Constraint != null)
				{
					num2 = relativeHeight.Constraint.Apply(num2);
				}
				break;
			}
			case HeightType.Max:
				num2 = composition.ResidualHeight;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num2 -= _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
				}
				break;
			case HeightType.Auto:
				if (mode != MeasureMode.MasterFlush)
				{
					num2 = composition.ResidualHeight;
					if (_margins != null)
					{
						num2 -= _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			if (num2 < 0f)
			{
				num2 = 0f;
			}
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
				{
					float num3 = num2;
					if (_margins != null)
					{
						num2 += _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
					}
					if (composition.ResidualHeight < num3)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Create:
					canvasArea = new CanvasArea(this);
					canvasArea.Parent = composition;
					canvasArea.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
					canvasArea.Top = composition.Scene.Top;
					canvasArea.Width = num;
					canvasArea.Height = num2;
					canvasArea.Borders = base.BordersResolved;
					canvasArea.Margins = _margins;
					canvasArea.Paddings = _paddings;
					canvasArea.Background = _background;
					if (_panel == null)
					{
						if (_margins != null)
						{
							canvasArea.Left += _margins.Left;
							canvasArea.Top += composition.ActiveHeight + _margins.Top;
						}
						else
						{
							canvasArea.Top += composition.ActiveHeight;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						PropertyCollection propertyCollection = _panel.AttachedProperties[this];
						canvasArea.Left += propertyCollection.GetValue("Left", 0f);
						canvasArea.Top += propertyCollection.GetValue("Top", 0f);
						canvasArea.RotationAngle = propertyCollection.GetValue("Angle", 0f);
					}
					canvasArea.ResetScene();
					_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
					composition.Content.Add(canvasArea);
					if (_panel == null)
					{
						composition.ActiveHeight += num2;
						if (_margins != null)
						{
							composition.ActiveHeight += _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
						}
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}
	}

		}

		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.Layout;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Flush;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Flush;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.Layout;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Flush;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Flush;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
				{
					bool flag = false;
					bool flag2 = _freshBreak;
					int num = -1;
					int num2 = _marker;
					int count2 = _content.Count;
					while (!flag && num2 < count2)
					{
						Element element2 = _content[num2];
						if (!flag2 && num == -1)
						{
							num = num2;
							composition.Mark();
						}
						MeasureResult measureResult = element2.Measure(composition, graphics, MeasureMode.Normal);
						if (measureResult != MeasureResult.Ok)
						{
							if (flag2 && measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
							{
								element2.Measure(composition, graphics, MeasureMode.Flush);
								num = -1;
								num2++;
								if (num2 < count2)
								{
									flag = true;
								}
								continue;
							}
							if (_marker == num2 && measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
							{
								_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
								return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
							}
							if (measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore || measureResult == MeasureResult.ContentBreak)
							{
								if (num >= 0)
								{
									composition.Rollback();
									for (int j = num; j <= num2; j++)
									{
										element2 = _content[j];
										element2.Reset();
									}
									num2 = num;
									num = -1;
								}
							}
							else
							{
								num = -1;
							}
							if (measureResult == MeasureResult.PageBreak)
							{
								num2++;
							}
							flag = true;
						}
						else
						{
							num2++;
							flag2 = false;
						}
					}
					_marker = num2;
					if (flag)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.ContentBreak;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Flush:
				{
					int i = _marker;
					for (int count = _content.Count; i < count; i++)
					{
						Element element = _content[i];
						element.Measure(composition, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
					}
					_marker = i;
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Process(visitor);
			}
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Reset();
			}
			_marker = 0;
			base.Reset();
		}
	}

		public override Bounds GetBounds(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			float num3 = ((_margins != null) ? (_margins.Left + _margins.Right) : 0f);
			switch (_width.Type)
			{
			case WidthType.Fixed:
				num = ((FixedWidth)_width).Value;
				num2 = num;
				break;
			case WidthType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeWidth relativeWidth = (RelativeWidth)_width;
				num2 = composition.Scene.Width - num3;
				num2 *= relativeWidth.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeWidth.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num);
					num2 = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num2);
				}
				break;
			}
			case WidthType.Max:
				num2 = composition.Scene.Width - num3;
				break;
			case WidthType.Auto:
				foreach (Element item in _content)
				{
					Bounds bounds = item.GetBounds(composition, graphics);
					if (num < bounds.Min)
					{
						num = bounds.Min;
					}
					if (num2 < bounds.Max)
					{
						num2 = bounds.Max;
					}
				}
				if (_paddings != null)
				{
					num3 += _paddings.Left + _paddings.Right;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasLeft && base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen != null)
				{
					num3 += base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasRight && base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen != null)
				{
					num3 += base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				break;
			}
			return new Bounds(num + num3, num2 + num3);
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			Composition composition2 = null;
			float num = 0f;
			switch (_width.Type)
			{
			case WidthType.Fixed:
				num = ((FixedWidth)_width).Value;
				break;
			case WidthType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeWidth relativeWidth = (RelativeWidth)_width;
				num = composition.Scene.Width;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
				num *= relativeWidth.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeWidth.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num);
				}
				break;
			}
			case WidthType.Max:
				num = composition.Scene.Width;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
				break;
			case WidthType.Auto:
				num = GetBounds(composition, graphics).Fit(composition.Scene.Width);
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (num < 0f)
			{
				num = 0f;
			}
			float num2 = 65535f;
			switch (_height.Type)
			{
			case HeightType.Fixed:
				num2 = ((FixedHeight)_height).Value;
				break;
			case HeightType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeHeight relativeHeight = (RelativeHeight)_height;
				num2 = composition.ResidualHeight;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num2 -= _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
				}
				num2 *= relativeHeight.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeHeight.Constraint != null)
				{
					num2 = relativeHeight.Constraint.Apply(num2);
				}
				break;
			}
			case HeightType.Max:
				num2 = composition.ResidualHeight;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num2 -= _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
				}
				break;
			case HeightType.Auto:
				if (mode != MeasureMode.MasterFlush)
				{
					num2 = composition.ResidualHeight;
					if (_margins != null)
					{
						num2 -= _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			if (num2 < 0f)
			{
				num2 = 0f;
			}
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
				{
					float num3 = ((_margins != null) ? (_margins.Top + _margins.Bottom) : 0f);
					if (_height.Type != HeightType.Auto)
					{
						num3 += num2;
					}
					if (composition.ResidualHeight < num3)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Create:
					composition2 = new Composition();
					composition2.Parent = composition;
					if (_margins != null)
					{
						composition2.Left = composition.Scene.Left + _margins.Left;
						composition2.Top = composition.Scene.Top + composition.ActiveHeight + _margins.Top;
					}
					else
					{
						composition2.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
						composition2.Top = composition.Scene.Top + composition.ActiveHeight;
					}
					composition2.Width = num;
					composition2.Height = num2;
					composition2.Borders = base.BordersResolved;
					composition2.Margins = _margins;
					composition2.Paddings = _paddings;
					composition2.Background = _background;
					composition2.ResetScene();
					if (mode == MeasureMode.Normal && _height.Type == HeightType.Auto)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					}
					else
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Flush;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
				{
					bool flag = false;
					bool flag2 = _freshBreak;
					int num4 = _marker;
					int count2 = _content.Count;
					while (!flag && num4 < count2)
					{
						Element element2 = _content[num4];
						MeasureResult measureResult = element2.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.Normal);
						if (measureResult != MeasureResult.Ok)
						{
							if (flag2 && measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
							{
								element2.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.Flush);
								num4++;
								if (num4 < count2)
								{
									flag = true;
								}
								continue;
							}
							if (_marker == num4 && measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
							{
								_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
								return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
							}
							if (measureResult == MeasureResult.PageBreak)
							{
								num4++;
							}
							flag = true;
						}
						else
						{
							num4++;
							flag2 = false;
						}
					}
					if (_conditions.Count == 0)
					{
						if (composition2.Content.Count != 0)
						{
							composition.Content.Add(composition2);
							if (composition2.ResidualHeight > 0f)
							{
								composition2.Height -= composition2.ResidualHeight;
								composition2.ResetScene();
							}
							composition.ActiveHeight += composition2.Height;
							if (_margins != null)
							{
								composition.ActiveHeight += _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
							}
							Composition.AlignHorizontal(composition2, AlignmentResolved, Layout.Vertical);
							Composition.AlignVertical(composition2, AlignmentResolved, Layout.Vertical);
						}
						_marker = num4;
						if (flag)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
							return MeasureResult.ContentBreak;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (!flag)
						{
							if (composition2.Content.Count != 0)
							{
								composition.Content.Add(composition2);
								if (composition2.ResidualHeight > 0f)
								{
									composition2.Height -= composition2.ResidualHeight;
									composition2.ResetScene();
								}
								composition.ActiveHeight += composition2.Height;
								if (_margins != null)
								{
									composition.ActiveHeight += _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
								}
								Composition.AlignHorizontal(composition2, AlignmentResolved, Layout.Vertical);
								Composition.AlignVertical(composition2, AlignmentResolved, Layout.Vertical);
							}
							_marker = num4;
						}
						foreach (Condition condition in _conditions)
						{
							if (condition.Fit != flag)
							{
								condition.Active = true;
							}
						}
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Flush:
				{
					int i = _marker;
					for (int count = _content.Count; i < count; i++)
					{
						Element element = _content[i];
						element.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
					}
					composition.Content.Add(composition2);
					if (_height.Type == HeightType.Auto && composition2.ResidualHeight > 0f)
					{
						composition2.Height -= composition2.ResidualHeight;
						composition2.ResetScene();
					}
					composition.ActiveHeight += composition2.Height;
					if (_margins != null)
					{
						composition.ActiveHeight += _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
					}
					Composition.AlignHorizontal(composition2, AlignmentResolved, Layout.Vertical);
					Composition.AlignVertical(composition2, AlignmentResolved, Layout.Vertical);
					_marker = i;
					foreach (Condition condition2 in _conditions)
					{
						if (condition2.Fit)
						{
							condition2.Active = true;
						}
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Process(visitor);
			}
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			foreach (Condition condition in _conditions)
			{
				condition.Active = false;
			}
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Reset();
			}
			_marker = 0;
			base.Reset();
		}
	}
	public class ContentAlignment : SealableBase
	{
		private Alignment _h;

		private Alignment _v;

		private static ContentAlignment _alignmentLeft = new ContentAlignment(Alignment.Left);

		private static ContentAlignment _alignmentCenter = new ContentAlignment(Alignment.Center);

		private static ContentAlignment _alignmentRight = new ContentAlignment(Alignment.Right);

		private static ContentAlignment _alignmentJustify = new ContentAlignment(Alignment.Justify);

		public static ContentAlignment Center => _alignmentCenter;

		public static ContentAlignment Justify => _alignmentJustify;

		public static ContentAlignment Left => _alignmentLeft;

		public static ContentAlignment Right => _alignmentRight;

		public Alignment Horizontal
		{
			get
			{
				return _h;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				switch (value)
				{
				case Alignment.Left:
				case Alignment.Center:
				case Alignment.Right:
				case Alignment.Justify:
					_h = value;
					break;
				default:
					throw new ArgumentException("Left, Center, Right, Justify");
				}
			}
		}

		public Alignment Vertical
		{
			get
			{
				return _v;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				switch (value)
				{
				case Alignment.Justify:
				case Alignment.Top:
				case Alignment.Middle:
				case Alignment.Bottom:
					_v = value;
					break;
				default:
					throw new ArgumentException("Top, Middle, Bottom, Justify");
				}
			}
		}

		public ContentAlignment()
			: this(Alignment.Left, Alignment.Top)
		{
		}

		public ContentAlignment(Alignment alignment)
		{
			switch (alignment)
			{
			case Alignment.Left:
			case Alignment.Center:
			case Alignment.Right:
			case Alignment.Justify:
				_h = alignment;
				_v = Alignment.Top;
				break;
			case Alignment.Top:
			case Alignment.Middle:
			case Alignment.Bottom:
				_h = Alignment.Left;
				_v = alignment;
				break;
			}
		}

		public ContentAlignment(Alignment h, Alignment v)
		{
			switch (h)
			{
			case Alignment.Left:
			case Alignment.Center:
			case Alignment.Right:
			case Alignment.Justify:
				_h = h;
				switch (v)
				{
				case Alignment.Justify:
				case Alignment.Top:
				case Alignment.Middle:
				case Alignment.Bottom:
					_v = v;
					break;
				default:
					throw new ArgumentException("Top, Middle, Bottom, Justify", "v");
				}
				break;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException("Left, Center, Right, Justify", "h");
			}
		}
	}

		public IQuickImage AddQuickImage(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image)

				throw new ArgumentNullException("image");
