		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			Composition composition2 = null;
			if (!_active)
			{
				_state = MeasureState.End;
			}
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
					if (composition.ResidualHeight < 0f)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				case MeasureState.Create:
					composition2 = new Composition();
					composition2.Fake = true;
					composition2.Parent = composition;
					composition2.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
					composition2.Top = composition.Scene.Top + composition.ActiveHeight;
					composition2.Width = composition.Scene.Width;
					composition2.Height = composition.ResidualHeight;
					composition2.ResetScene();
					if (mode == MeasureMode.Normal)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					}
					else
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Flush;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
				{
					bool flag = false;
					bool flag2 = _freshBreak;
					int num = _marker;
					int count2 = _content.Count;
					while (!flag && num < count2)
					{
						Element element2 = _content[num];
						MeasureResult measureResult = element2.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.Normal);
						if (measureResult != MeasureResult.Ok)
						{
							if (flag2 && measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
							{
								element2.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.Flush);
								num++;
								if (num < count2)
								{
									flag = true;
								}
								continue;
							}
							if (_marker == num && measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
							{
								_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
								return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
							}
							if (measureResult == MeasureResult.PageBreak)
							{
								num++;
							}
							flag = true;
						}
						else
						{
							num++;
							flag2 = false;
						}
					}
					if (composition2.Content.Count != 0)
					{
						composition.Content.Add(composition2);
						if (composition2.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							composition2.Height -= composition2.ResidualHeight;
						}
						composition.ActiveHeight += composition2.Height;
					}
					_marker = num;
					if (flag)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.ContentBreak;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Flush:
				{
					int i = _marker;
					for (int count = _content.Count; i < count; i++)
					{
						Element element = _content[i];
						element.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
					}
					composition.Content.Add(composition2);
					if (composition2.ResidualHeight > 0f)
					{
						composition2.Height -= composition2.ResidualHeight;
					}
					composition.ActiveHeight += composition2.Height;
					_marker = i;
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Process(visitor);
			}
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Reset();
			}
			_active = false;
			_marker = 0;
			base.Reset();
		}
	}

	internal class Bounds
	{
		private float _min;

		private float _max;

		public float Max
		{
			get
			{
				return _max;
			}
			set
			{
				_max = value;
			}
		}

		public float Min
		{
			get
			{
				return _min;
			}
			set
			{
				_min = value;
			}
		}

		public Bounds()
		{
		}

		public Bounds(float min, float max)
		{
			_min = min;
			_max = max;
		}

		public float Fit(float value)
		{
			if (value > _max)
			{
				value = _max;
			}
			if (value < _min)
			{
				value = _min;
			}
			return value;
		}
	}

	internal class QuickImage : Block, IQuickImage
	{
		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image _value;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color _transparentColor;

		private float _alpha;

		private bool _stretch;

		private object parent;

		public float Alpha
		{
			get
			{
				return _alpha;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0f || value > 1f)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(null, "[0.0, 1.0]");
				}
				_alpha = value;
			}
		}

		public object Parent => parent;

		public bool Stretch
		{
			get
			{
				return _stretch;
			}
			set
			{
				_stretch = value;
			}
		}

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color TransparentColor
		{
			get
			{
				return _transparentColor;
			}
			set
			{
				_transparentColor = value;
			}
		}

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image Value => _value;

		public override ElementType Type => ElementType.QuickImage;

		public QuickImage(Report report, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image value)
			: base(report)
		{
			_value = value;
			_alpha = 1f;
		}

		public void InitializeParent(object parent)
		{
			if (parent == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("parent");
			}
			this.parent = parent;
		}

		public void SetTransparentColor(string value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("value");
			}
			if (value == "Auto")
			{
				_transparentColor = _value.GetPixel(0, 0);
			}
			else
			{
				_transparentColor = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color.Parse(value);
			}
		}

		public override Bounds GetBounds(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = ((_margins != null) ? (_margins.Left + _margins.Right) : 0f);
			num = ((!_stretch) ? Converter.PixelsToPoints(_value.Width) : (composition.Scene.Width - num2));
			return new Bounds(num + num2, num + num2);
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			ImageArea imageArea = null;
			float num = 0f;
			if (_stretch)
			{
				num = composition.Scene.Width;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num = Converter.PixelsToPoints(_value.Width);
			}
			if (num < 0f)
			{
				num = 0f;
			}
			float num2 = 0f;
			num2 = ((_value.Width == 0) ? Converter.PixelsToPoints(_value.Height) : ((float)_value.Height / (float)_value.Width * num));
			if (num2 < 0f)
			{
				num2 = 0f;
			}
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
				{
					float num3 = num2;
					if (_margins != null)
					{
						num3 += _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
					}
					if (composition.ResidualHeight < num3)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Create:
					imageArea = new ImageArea(_value, _transparentColor, _alpha, keepRatio: false);
					imageArea.Fake = true;
					imageArea.Parent = composition;
					imageArea.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
					imageArea.Top = composition.Scene.Top + composition.ActiveHeight;
					if (_margins != null)
					{
						imageArea.Left += _margins.Left;
						imageArea.Top += _margins.Top;
					}
					imageArea.Width = num;
					imageArea.Height = num2;
					imageArea.Margins = _margins;
					imageArea.ResetScene();
					_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
					composition.Content.Add(imageArea);
					composition.ActiveHeight += num2;
					if (_margins != null)
					{
						composition.ActiveHeight += _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}
	}

		void SetTransparentColor(string value);
	}

			return quickList;

		public override Bounds GetBounds(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			float num3 = ((_margins != null) ? (_margins.Left + _margins.Right) : 0f);
			switch (_width.Type)
			{
			case WidthType.Fixed:
				num = ((FixedWidth)_width).Value;
				num2 = num;
				break;
			case WidthType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeWidth relativeWidth = (RelativeWidth)_width;
				num2 = composition.Scene.Width - num3;
				num2 *= relativeWidth.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeWidth.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num);
					num2 = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num2);
				}
				break;
			}
			case WidthType.Max:
			case WidthType.Auto:
				num2 = composition.Scene.Width - num3;
				break;
			}
			return new Bounds(num + num3, num2 + num3);
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			Composition composition2 = null;
			Composition composition3 = null;
			float num = 0f;
			switch (_width.Type)
			{
			case WidthType.Fixed:
				num = ((FixedWidth)_width).Value;
				break;
			case WidthType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeWidth relativeWidth = (RelativeWidth)_width;
				num = composition.Scene.Width;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
				num *= relativeWidth.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeWidth.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num);
				}
				break;
			}
			case WidthType.Max:
			case WidthType.Auto:
				num = composition.Scene.Width;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (num < 0f)
			{
				num = 0f;
			}
			float num2 = 0f;
			switch (_height.Type)
			{
			case HeightType.Fixed:
				num2 = ((FixedHeight)_height).Value;
				break;
			case HeightType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeHeight relativeHeight = (RelativeHeight)_height;
				num2 = composition.ResidualHeight;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num2 -= _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
				}
				num2 *= relativeHeight.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeHeight.Constraint != null)
				{
					num2 = relativeHeight.Constraint.Apply(num2);
				}
				break;
			}
			case HeightType.Max:
				num2 = composition.ResidualHeight;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num2 -= _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
				}
				break;
			case HeightType.Auto:
			{
				float num3 = 0f;
				if (_paddings != null)
				{
					num3 += _paddings.Top + _paddings.Bottom;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasTop && base.BordersResolved.Top.Pen != null)
				{
					num3 += base.BordersResolved.Top.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasBottom && base.BordersResolved.Bottom.Pen != null)
				{
					num3 += base.BordersResolved.Bottom.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				foreach (Element item in _content)
				{
					Bounds bounds = item.GetBounds(composition, graphics);
					if (num2 < bounds.Max + num3)
					{
						num2 = bounds.Max + num3;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			if (num2 < 0f)
			{
				num2 = 0f;
			}
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
				{
					float num4 = num2;
					if (_margins != null)
					{
						num4 += _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
					}
					if (composition.ResidualHeight < num4)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Create:
					composition2 = new Composition();
					composition2.Parent = composition;
					composition2.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
					composition2.Top = composition.Scene.Top + composition.ActiveHeight;
					if (_margins != null)
					{
						composition2.Left += _margins.Left;
						composition2.Top += _margins.Top;
					}
					composition2.Width = num;
					composition2.Height = num2;
					composition2.Borders = base.BordersResolved;
					composition2.Margins = _margins;
					composition2.Paddings = _paddings;
					composition2.Background = _background;
					composition2.ResetScene();
					composition3 = new Composition();
					composition3.Fake = true;
					composition3.Parent = composition2;
					composition3.Width = composition2.Scene.Height;
					composition3.Height = composition2.Scene.Width;
					composition3.ResetScene();
					_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
				{
					foreach (Element item2 in _content)
					{
						item2.Measure(composition3, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
					}
					if (_width.Type == WidthType.Auto)
					{
						if (composition3.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							composition3.Height -= composition3.ResidualHeight;
							composition3.ResetScene();
						}
						composition2.Width = composition3.Height;
						if (_paddings != null)
						{
							composition2.Width += _paddings.Left + _paddings.Right;
						}
						if (base.BordersResolved.HasLeft && base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen != null)
						{
							composition2.Width += base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen.Width / 2f;
						}
						if (base.BordersResolved.HasRight && base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen != null)
						{
							composition2.Width += base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen.Width / 2f;
						}
						composition2.ResetScene();
					}
					composition2.Content.Add(composition3);
					composition.Content.Add(composition2);
					composition.ActiveHeight += composition2.Height;
					if (_margins != null)
					{
						composition.ActiveHeight += _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
					}
					if (_backward)
					{
						composition3.Left = composition2.Scene.Left + composition2.Scene.Width;
						composition3.Top = composition2.Scene.Top;
						composition3.RotationAngle = 90f;
					}
					else
					{
						composition3.Left = composition2.Scene.Left;
						composition3.Top = composition2.Scene.Top + composition2.Scene.Height;
						composition3.RotationAngle = -90f;
					}
					ContentAlignment contentAlignment = new ContentAlignment();
					switch (AlignmentResolved.Vertical)
					{
					case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Top:
						if (_backward)
						{
							contentAlignment.Horizontal = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Left;
						}
						else
						{
							contentAlignment.Horizontal = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Right;
						}
						break;
					case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Middle:
						contentAlignment.Horizontal = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Center;
						break;
					case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Bottom:
						if (_backward)
						{
							contentAlignment.Horizontal = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Right;
						}
						else
						{
							contentAlignment.Horizontal = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Left;
						}
						break;
					case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Justify:
						contentAlignment.Horizontal = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Justify;
						break;
					}
					switch (AlignmentResolved.Horizontal)
					{
					case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Left:
						if (_backward)
						{
							contentAlignment.Vertical = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Bottom;
						}
						else
						{
							contentAlignment.Vertical = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Top;
						}
						break;
					case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Center:
						contentAlignment.Vertical = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Middle;
						break;
					case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Right:
						if (_backward)
						{
							contentAlignment.Vertical = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Top;
						}
						else
						{
							contentAlignment.Vertical = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Bottom;
						}
						break;
					case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Justify:
						contentAlignment.Vertical = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Justify;
						break;
					}
					Composition.AlignHorizontal(composition3, contentAlignment, Layout.Vertical);
					Composition.AlignVertical(composition3, contentAlignment, Layout.Vertical);
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Process(visitor);
			}
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Reset();
			}
			base.Reset();
		}
	}

	internal class Dummy : Element
	{
		public override ElementType Type => ElementType.Dummy;

		public Dummy(Report report)
			: base(report)
		{
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			Area area = null;
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.Create:
					area = new Area();
					area.Parent = composition;
					area.Fake = true;
					area.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
					area.Top = composition.Scene.Top + composition.ActiveHeight;
					area.ResetScene();
					_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
					composition.Content.Add(area);
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}
	}

	public class PageNumberAlignment
	{
		private Alignment _h;

		private Alignment _v;

		private static PageNumberAlignment _alignmentLeft = new PageNumberAlignment(Alignment.Left);

		private static PageNumberAlignment _alignmentCenter = new PageNumberAlignment(Alignment.Center);

		private static PageNumberAlignment _alignmentRight = new PageNumberAlignment(Alignment.Right);

		public static PageNumberAlignment Center => _alignmentCenter;

		public static PageNumberAlignment Left => _alignmentLeft;

		public static PageNumberAlignment Right => _alignmentRight;

		public Alignment Horizontal
		{
			get
			{
				return _h;
			}
			set
			{
				switch (value)
				{
				case Alignment.Left:
				case Alignment.Center:
				case Alignment.Right:
					_h = value;
					break;
				default:
					throw new ArgumentException("Left, Center, Right");
				}
			}
		}

		public Alignment Vertical
		{
			get
			{
				return _v;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == Alignment.Top || value == Alignment.Bottom)
				{
					_v = value;
					return;
				}
				throw new ArgumentException("Top, Bottom");
			}
		}

		public PageNumberAlignment()
			: this(Alignment.Right, Alignment.Bottom)
		{
		}

		public PageNumberAlignment(Alignment alignment)
		{
			switch (alignment)
			{
			case Alignment.Left:
			case Alignment.Center:
			case Alignment.Right:
				_h = alignment;
				_v = Alignment.Bottom;
				break;
			case Alignment.Top:
			case Alignment.Bottom:
				_h = Alignment.Right;
				_v = alignment;
				break;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException("Left, Center, Right, Top, Bottom", "alignment");
			}
		}

		public PageNumberAlignment(Alignment h, Alignment v)
		{
			switch (h)
			{
			case Alignment.Left:
			case Alignment.Center:
			case Alignment.Right:
				_h = h;
				if (v == Alignment.Top || v == Alignment.Bottom)
				{
					_v = v;
					break;
				}
				throw new ArgumentException("Top, Bottom", "v");
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException("Left, Center, Right", "h");
			}
		}
	}
	public class TextAlignment : SealableBase
	{
		private Alignment _h;

		private Alignment _v;

		private static TextAlignment _alignmentLeft = new TextAlignment(Alignment.Left);

		private static TextAlignment _alignmentCenter = new TextAlignment(Alignment.Center);

		private static TextAlignment _alignmentRight = new TextAlignment(Alignment.Right);

		private static TextAlignment _alignmentJustify = new TextAlignment(Alignment.Justify);

		public static TextAlignment Center => _alignmentCenter;

		public static TextAlignment Justify => _alignmentJustify;

		public static TextAlignment Left => _alignmentLeft;

		public static TextAlignment Right => _alignmentRight;

		public Alignment Horizontal
		{
			get
			{
				return _h;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				switch (value)
				{
				case Alignment.Left:
				case Alignment.Center:
				case Alignment.Right:
				case Alignment.Justify:
					_h = value;
					break;
				default:
					throw new ArgumentException("Left, Center, Right, Justify");
				}
			}
		}

		public Alignment Vertical
		{
			get
			{
				return _v;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				switch (value)
				{
				case Alignment.Top:
				case Alignment.Middle:
				case Alignment.Bottom:
					_v = value;
					break;
				default:
					throw new ArgumentException("Top, Middle, Bottom");
				}
			}
		}

		public TextAlignment()
			: this(Alignment.Left, Alignment.Top)
		{
		}

		public TextAlignment(Alignment alignment)
		{
			switch (alignment)
			{
			case Alignment.Left:
			case Alignment.Center:
			case Alignment.Right:
			case Alignment.Justify:
				_h = alignment;
				_v = Alignment.Top;
				break;
			case Alignment.Top:
			case Alignment.Middle:
			case Alignment.Bottom:
				_h = Alignment.Left;
				_v = alignment;
				break;
			}
		}

		public TextAlignment(Alignment h, Alignment v)
		{
			switch (h)
			{
			case Alignment.Left:
			case Alignment.Center:
			case Alignment.Right:
			case Alignment.Justify:
				_h = h;
				switch (v)
				{
				case Alignment.Top:
				case Alignment.Middle:
				case Alignment.Bottom:
					_v = v;
					break;
				default:
					throw new ArgumentException("Top, Middle, Bottom", "v");
				}
				break;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException("Left, Center, Right, Justify", "h");
			}
		}
	}
	internal class Metafile : DecoratedBlock, IMetafile
	{
		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Metafile _value;

		private float _activeScale;

		public float ActiveScale => _activeScale;

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Metafile Value => _value;

		public override ElementType Type => ElementType.Metafile;

		public Metafile(Report report, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Metafile value)
			: base(report)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("metafile");
			}
			_width = AutoWidth.Instance;
			_value = value;
			_activeScale = 100f;
		}

		public override Bounds GetBounds(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			float num3 = ((_margins != null) ? (_margins.Left + _margins.Right) : 0f);
			switch (_width.Type)
			{
			case WidthType.Fixed:
				num = ((FixedWidth)_width).Value;
				num2 = num;
				break;
			case WidthType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeWidth relativeWidth = (RelativeWidth)_width;
				num2 = composition.Scene.Width - num3;
				num2 *= relativeWidth.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeWidth.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num);
					num2 = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num2);
				}
				break;
			}
			case WidthType.Max:
				num2 = composition.Scene.Width - num3;
				break;
			case WidthType.Auto:
				num = _value.GetSize().Width;
				num2 = num;
				break;
			}
			if (_width.Type == WidthType.Fixed || _width.Type == WidthType.Auto)
			{
				if (_paddings != null)
				{
					num3 += _paddings.Left + _paddings.Right;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasLeft && base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen != null)
				{
					num3 += base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasRight && base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen != null)
				{
					num3 += base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
			}
			return new Bounds(num + num3, num2 + num3);
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			MetafileArea metafileArea = null;
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Size size = _value.GetSize();
			float num = size.Width;
			switch (_width.Type)
			{
			case WidthType.Fixed:
				num = ((FixedWidth)_width).Value;
				break;
			case WidthType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeWidth relativeWidth = (RelativeWidth)_width;
				num = composition.Scene.Width;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
				num *= relativeWidth.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeWidth.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num);
				}
				break;
			}
			case WidthType.Max:
				num = composition.Scene.Width;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (_width.Type == WidthType.Fixed || _width.Type == WidthType.Auto)
			{
				if (_paddings != null)
				{
					num += _paddings.Left + _paddings.Right;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasLeft && base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen != null)
				{
					num += base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasRight && base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen != null)
				{
					num += base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
			}
			if (num < 0f)
			{
				num = 0f;
			}
			float height = size.Height;
			if (size.Width != 0f)
			{
				float num2 = num;
				if (_paddings != null)
				{
					num2 -= _paddings.Left + _paddings.Right;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasLeft && base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen != null)
				{
					num2 -= base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasRight && base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen != null)
				{
					num2 -= base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				_activeScale = num2 / size.Width * 100f;
			}
			height *= _activeScale / 100f;
			if (_paddings != null)
			{
				height += _paddings.Top + _paddings.Bottom;
			}
			if (base.BordersResolved.HasTop && base.BordersResolved.Top.Pen != null)
			{
				height += base.BordersResolved.Top.Pen.Width / 2f;
			}
			if (base.BordersResolved.HasBottom && base.BordersResolved.Bottom.Pen != null)
			{
				height += base.BordersResolved.Bottom.Pen.Width / 2f;
			}
			if (height < 0f)
			{
				height = 0f;
			}
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
				{
					float num3 = height;
					if (_margins != null)
					{
						num3 += _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
					}
					if (composition.ResidualHeight < num3)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Create:
					metafileArea = new MetafileArea(this);
					metafileArea.Parent = composition;
					metafileArea.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
					metafileArea.Top = composition.Scene.Top;
					metafileArea.Width = num;
					metafileArea.Height = height;
					metafileArea.Borders = base.BordersResolved;
					metafileArea.Margins = _margins;
					metafileArea.Paddings = _paddings;
					metafileArea.Background = _background;
					if (_panel == null)
					{
						if (_margins != null)
						{
							metafileArea.Left += _margins.Left;
							metafileArea.Top += composition.ActiveHeight + _margins.Top;
						}
						else
						{
							metafileArea.Top += composition.ActiveHeight;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						PropertyCollection propertyCollection = _panel.AttachedProperties[this];
						metafileArea.Left += propertyCollection.GetValue("Left", 0f);
						metafileArea.Top += propertyCollection.GetValue("Top", 0f);
						metafileArea.RotationAngle = propertyCollection.GetValue("Angle", 0f);
					}
					metafileArea.ResetScene();
					_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
					composition.Content.Add(metafileArea);
					if (_panel == null)
					{
						composition.ActiveHeight += height;
						if (_margins != null)
						{
							composition.ActiveHeight += _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
						}
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			_activeScale = 100f;
			base.Reset();
		}
	}

		private void AddElement(Element element, float left, float top)
		{
			element.Panel = this;

		}

		{
			element.Panel = this;
			PropertyCollection propertyCollection = new PropertyCollection();
			propertyCollection.SetValue("Left", left);
			propertyCollection.SetValue("Top", top);
			propertyCollection.SetValue("Angle", angle);
			_properties.Add(element, propertyCollection);
			_content.Add(element);
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Measure(composition, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
			}
			_state = MeasureState.End;
			return MeasureResult.Ok;
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Reset();
			}
			_state = MeasureState.Start;
		}

	public interface IGap
	{
		Height Height { get; set; }
	}
	internal class Gap : Element, IGap
	{
		private Height _height;

		public Height Height
		{
			get
			{
				return _height;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_height = value;
			}
		}

		public override ElementType Type => ElementType.Gap;

		public Gap(Report report)
			: base(report)
		{
			_height = MaxHeight.Instance;
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			Area area = null;
			float num = 65535f;
			switch (_height.Type)
			{
			case HeightType.Fixed:
				num = ((FixedHeight)_height).Value;
				break;
			case HeightType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeHeight relativeHeight = (RelativeHeight)_height;
				num = composition.ResidualHeight * relativeHeight.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeHeight.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeHeight.Constraint.Apply(num);
				}
				break;
			}
			case HeightType.Max:
				num = composition.ResidualHeight;
				break;
			case HeightType.Auto:
				if (mode != MeasureMode.MasterFlush)
				{
					num = composition.ResidualHeight;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (num < 0f)
			{
				num = 0f;
			}
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.Create:
					area = new Area();
					area.Parent = composition;
					area.Fake = true;
					area.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
					area.Top = composition.Scene.Top + composition.ActiveHeight;
					area.Width = composition.Scene.Width;
					area.Height = num;
					area.ResetScene();
					_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
					composition.Content.Add(area);
					composition.ActiveHeight += num;
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}
	}

	internal class PrintManager
	{
		private Report _report;

		private PrintDocument _pd;

		private PrinterSettings.PaperSizeCollection _paperSizes;

		private ProjectionPageCollection _pages;

		private int _index;

		public PrintManager(Report report, string printerName)
		{
			_report = report;
			_pd = new PrintDocument();
			_pd.QueryPageSettings += QueryPageSettings;
			_pd.PrintPage += PrintPage;
			if (printerName != null)
			{
				_pd.PrinterSettings.PrinterName = printerName;
			}
			_paperSizes = _pd.PrinterSettings.PaperSizes;
		}

		public void Print(ProjectionPageCollection pages)
		{
			Print(pages, showPrintStatusDialog: true);
		}

		public void Print(ProjectionPageCollection pages, bool showPrintStatusDialog)
		{
			_pages = pages;
			_index = 0;
			if (!showPrintStatusDialog)
			{
				_pd.PrintController = new StandardPrintController();
			}
			_pd.Print();
		}

		private System.Drawing.Printing.PaperSize GetPaperSize()
		{
			PaperKind paperKind;
			switch (_report.Preferences.Printing.PaperSize)
			{
			case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Preferences.Printing.PaperSize.Letter:
				paperKind = PaperKind.Letter;
				break;
			case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Preferences.Printing.PaperSize.Legal:
				paperKind = PaperKind.Legal;
				break;
			case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Preferences.Printing.PaperSize.Tabloid:
				paperKind = PaperKind.Tabloid;
				break;
			case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Preferences.Printing.PaperSize.Ledger:
				paperKind = PaperKind.Ledger;
				break;
			case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Preferences.Printing.PaperSize.Statement:
				paperKind = PaperKind.Statement;
				break;
			case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Preferences.Printing.PaperSize.Executive:
				paperKind = PaperKind.Executive;
				break;
			case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Preferences.Printing.PaperSize.Folio:
				paperKind = PaperKind.Folio;
				break;
			case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Preferences.Printing.PaperSize.Quarto:
				paperKind = PaperKind.Quarto;
				break;
			case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Preferences.Printing.PaperSize.A5:
				paperKind = PaperKind.A5;
				break;
			case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Preferences.Printing.PaperSize.A4:
				paperKind = PaperKind.A4;
				break;
			case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Preferences.Printing.PaperSize.A3:
				paperKind = PaperKind.A3;
				break;
			default:
				return null;
			}
			foreach (System.Drawing.Printing.PaperSize paperSize in _paperSizes)
			{
				if (paperKind == paperSize.Kind)
				{
					return paperSize;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private System.Drawing.Printing.PaperSize GetPaperSize(float width, float height)
		{
			System.Drawing.Printing.PaperSize result = null;
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			foreach (System.Drawing.Printing.PaperSize paperSize in _paperSizes)
			{
				float num2 = (float)paperSize.Width - width;
				float num3 = (float)paperSize.Height - height;
				if (num2 == 0f && num3 == 0f)
				{
					return paperSize;
				}
				if (num2 >= 0f && num3 >= 0f)
				{
					double num4 = Math.Sqrt(num2 * num2 + num3 * num3);
					if (num > num4)
					{
						num = num4;
						result = paperSize;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void PrintPage(object sender, PrintPageEventArgs ev)
		{
			ProjectionPage projectionPage = _pages[_index];
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Graphics graphics = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Graphics(ev.Graphics);
			if (_report.Preferences.Printing.FitToMargins)
			{
				if (ev.PageSettings.Landscape)
				{
					float scaleX = ev.PageSettings.PrintableArea.Height * 72f / 100f / projectionPage.Width;
					float scaleY = ev.PageSettings.PrintableArea.Width * 72f / 100f / projectionPage.Height;
					graphics.Scale(scaleX, scaleY);
				}
				else
				{
					float scaleX2 = ev.PageSettings.PrintableArea.Width * 72f / 100f / projectionPage.Width;
					float scaleY2 = ev.PageSettings.PrintableArea.Height * 72f / 100f / projectionPage.Height;
					graphics.Scale(scaleX2, scaleY2);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				float offsetX = (0f - ev.PageSettings.HardMarginX) * 72f / 100f;
				float offsetY = (0f - ev.PageSettings.HardMarginY) * 72f / 100f;
				graphics.Translate(offsetX, offsetY);
			}
			projectionPage.Draw(graphics);
			_index++;
			if (_index < _pages.Count)
			{
				ev.HasMorePages = true;
			}
			else
			{
				ev.HasMorePages = false;
			}
		}

		private void QueryPageSettings(object sender, QueryPageSettingsEventArgs ev)
		{
			System.Drawing.Printing.PaperSize paperSize = null;
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			switch (_report.Preferences.Printing.PaperSize)
			{
			case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Preferences.Printing.PaperSize.Auto:
			{
				ProjectionPage projectionPage = _pages[_index];
				num = projectionPage.Width * 100f / 72f;
				num2 = projectionPage.Height * 100f / 72f;
				paperSize = ((!(num < num2)) ? GetPaperSize(num2, num) : GetPaperSize(num, num2));
				break;
			}
			default:
				paperSize = GetPaperSize();
				if (paperSize != null)
				{
					num = paperSize.Width;
					num2 = paperSize.Height;
				}
				break;
			case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Preferences.Printing.PaperSize.Default:
				break;
			}
			ev.PageSettings.PaperSize = paperSize;
			switch (_report.Preferences.Printing.PaperOrientation)
			{
			case PaperOrientation.Auto:
				if (num > num2)
				{
					ev.PageSettings.Landscape = true;
				}
				else
				{
					ev.PageSettings.Landscape = false;
				}
				break;
			case PaperOrientation.Portrait:
				ev.PageSettings.Landscape = false;
				break;
			case PaperOrientation.Landscape:
				ev.PageSettings.Landscape = true;
				break;
			}
			ev.PageSettings.Margins.Left = 0;
			ev.PageSettings.Margins.Right = 0;
			ev.PageSettings.Margins.Top = 0;
			ev.PageSettings.Margins.Bottom = 0;
		}
	}
	public class VerticalMargins
	{
		private float _top;

		private float _bottom;

		public float All
		{
			set
			{
				if (value < 0f)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(null, "[0.0, ...]");
				}
				_top = value;
				_bottom = value;
			}
		}

		public float Bottom
		{
			get
			{
				return _bottom;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0f)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(null, "[0.0, ...]");
				}
				_bottom = value;
			}
		}

		public float Top
		{
			get
			{
				return _top;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0f)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(null, "[0.0, ...]");
				}
				_top = value;
			}
		}

		public VerticalMargins()
		{
		}

		public VerticalMargins(float value)
		{
			if (value < 0f)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", "[0.0, ...]");
			}
			_top = value;
			_bottom = value;
		}

		public VerticalMargins(float top, float bottom)
		{
			if (top < 0f)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("top", "[0.0, ...]");
			}
			if (bottom < 0f)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("bottom", "[0.0, ...]");
			}
			_top = top;
			_bottom = bottom;
		}
	}

	internal class PropertyCollection : Dictionary<string, object>
	{
		public object GetValue(string key, object defaultValue)
		{
			if (key == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("key");
			}
			if (ContainsKey(key))
			{
				return base[key];
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}

		public string GetValue(string key, string defaultValue)
		{
			return (string)GetValue(key, (object)defaultValue);
		}

		public int GetValue(string key, int defaultValue)
		{
			return (int)GetValue(key, (object)defaultValue);
		}

		public float GetValue(string key, float defaultValue)
		{
			return (float)GetValue(key, (object)defaultValue);
		}

		public bool GetValue(string key, bool defaultValue)
		{
			return Convert.ToBoolean(GetValue(key, (object)defaultValue));
		}

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color GetValue(string key, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color defaultValue)
		{
			return (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color)GetValue(key, (object)defaultValue);
		}

		public void SetValue(string key, object value)
		{
			if (key == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("key");
			}
			if (ContainsKey(key))
			{
				base[key] = value;
			}
			else
			{
				Add(key, value);
			}
		}

		public void SetValue(string key, string value)
		{
			SetValue(key, (object)value);
		}

		public void SetValue(string key, int value)
		{
			SetValue(key, (object)value);
		}

		public void SetValue(string key, float value)
		{
			SetValue(key, (object)value);
		}

		public void SetValue(string key, bool value)
		{
			SetValue(key, (object)value);
		}

		public void SetValue(string key, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color value)
		{
			SetValue(key, (object)value);
		}
	}

		private static PageSize _pageSizeLetter;

		private static PageSize _pageSizeLegal;

		private static PageSize _pageSizeTabloid;

		private static PageSize _pageSizeLedger;

		private static PageSize _pageSizeStatement;

		private static PageSize _pageSizeExecutive;

		private static PageSize _pageSizeFolio;

		private static PageSize _pageSizeQuarto;

		private static PageSize _pageSizeA5;

		private static PageSize _pageSizeA4;

		private static PageSize _pageSizeA3;

		public static PageSize A3 => _pageSizeA3;

		public static PageSize A4 => _pageSizeA4;

		public static PageSize A5 => _pageSizeA5;

		public static PageSize Executive => _pageSizeExecutive;

		public static PageSize Folio => _pageSizeFolio;

		public static PageSize Ledger => _pageSizeLedger;

		public static PageSize Legal => _pageSizeLegal;

		public static PageSize Statement => _pageSizeStatement;

		static PageSizes()

			_pageSizeLetter = new PageSize(612f, 792f);
			_pageSizeLegal = new PageSize(612f, 1008f);
			_pageSizeTabloid = new PageSize(792f, 1224f);
			_pageSizeLedger = new PageSize(1224f, 792f);
			_pageSizeStatement = new PageSize(396f, 612f);
			_pageSizeExecutive = new PageSize(540f, 720f);
			_pageSizeFolio = new PageSize(612f, 936f);
			_pageSizeQuarto = new PageSize(610f, 780f);
			_pageSizeA5 = new PageSize(420f, 595f);
			_pageSizeA4 = new PageSize(595f, 842f);
			_pageSizeA3 = new PageSize(842f, 1190f);
			_pageSizes.Add("Letter", _pageSizeLetter);
			_pageSizes.Add("Legal", _pageSizeLegal);
			_pageSizes.Add("Tabloid", _pageSizeTabloid);
			_pageSizes.Add("Ledger", _pageSizeLedger);
			_pageSizes.Add("Statement", _pageSizeStatement);
			_pageSizes.Add("Executive", _pageSizeExecutive);
			_pageSizes.Add("Folio", _pageSizeFolio);
			_pageSizes.Add("Quarto", _pageSizeQuarto);
			_pageSizes.Add("A5", _pageSizeA5);
			_pageSizes.Add("A4", _pageSizeA4);
			_pageSizes.Add("A3", _pageSizeA3);
			_names.Add(_pageSizeLetter.ToString(), "Letter");
			_names.Add(_pageSizeLegal.ToString(), "Legal");
			_names.Add(_pageSizeTabloid.ToString(), "Tabloid");
			_names.Add(_pageSizeLedger.ToString(), "Ledger");

			_names.Add(_pageSizeFolio.ToString(), "Folio");
			_names.Add(_pageSizeQuarto.ToString(), "Quarto");
			_names.Add(_pageSizeA5.ToString(), "A5");
			_names.Add(_pageSizeA4.ToString(), "A4");
			_names.Add(_pageSizeA3.ToString(), "A3");
		}

		public static string GetName(PageSize pageSize)
		{
			if (pageSize == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string key = pageSize.ToString();
			if (_names.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				return _names[key];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static PageSize GetPageSize(string name)
		{
			if (name == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (_pageSizes.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				return _pageSizes[name];
			}
			return null;
		}

	[Serializable]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(PageSizeTypeConverter))]
	public class PageSize
	{
		private class PageSizeTypeConverter : TypeConverter
		{
			public override bool GetStandardValuesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return context != null;
			}

			public override StandardValuesCollection GetStandardValues(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				List<PageSize> list = new List<PageSize>();
				list.Add(PageSizes.A3);
				list.Add(PageSizes.A4);
				list.Add(PageSizes.A5);
				list.Add(PageSizes.Executive);
				list.Add(PageSizes.Folio);
				list.Add(PageSizes.Ledger);
				list.Add(PageSizes.Legal);
				list.Add(PageSizes.Letter);
				list.Add(PageSizes.Quarto);
				list.Add(PageSizes.Statement);
				list.Add(PageSizes.Tabloid);
				return new StandardValuesCollection(list);
			}

			public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
			{
				if (sourceType == typeof(string))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
			}

			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(string))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			[SecuritySafeCritical]
			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				PageSize pageSize = value as PageSize;
				if (typeof(string) == destinationType && pageSize != null)
				{
					if (pageSize.Name != null && pageSize.Name.Length > 0)
					{
						return pageSize.Name;
					}
					if (culture == null)
					{
						culture = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
					}
					string listSeparator = culture.TextInfo.ListSeparator;
					return string.Format("{0}{2} {1}", pageSize.Width, pageSize.Height, listSeparator);
				}
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor) && pageSize != null)
				{
					ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(PageSize).GetConstructor(new Type[2]
					{
						typeof(float),
						typeof(float)
					});
					if (constructor != null)
					{
						return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[2] { pageSize.Width, pageSize.Height }, isComplete: true);
					}
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
			{
				if (value is string)
				{
					if (culture == null)
					{
						culture = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
					}
					string listSeparator = culture.TextInfo.ListSeparator;
					string text = ((string)value).Trim();
					if (text.Length == 0)
					{
						return PageSizes.Letter;
					}
					PageSize pageSize = PageSizes.GetPageSize(text);
					if (pageSize != null)
					{
						return pageSize;
					}
					string[] array = text.Split(listSeparator[0]);
					if (array.Length != 2)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException($"Unable to parse text '{text}' into a PageSize. Expected format is 'Width, Height'");
					}
					TypeConverter converter = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(typeof(int));
					int[] array2 = new int[2];
					for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
					{
						array2[i] = (int)converter.ConvertFromString(array[i]);
					}
					return new PageSize(array2[0], array2[1]);
				}
				return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
			}
		}

		private float _width;

		private float _height;

		public float Height => _height;

		public string Name => PageSizes.GetName(this);

		public float Width => _width;

		public PageSize(float width, float height)
		{
			if (width < 0f)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("width", "[0.0, ...]");
			}
			if (height < 0f)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("height", "[0.0, ...]");
			}
			_width = width;
			_height = height;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return _width.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + ", " + _height.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo);
		}
	}

		public void InitializeParent(object parent)
		{

		}

		public override Bounds GetBounds(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			float num3 = ((_margins != null) ? (_margins.Left + _margins.Right) : 0f);
			switch (_width.Type)
			{
			case WidthType.Fixed:
				num = ((FixedWidth)_width).Value;
				num2 = num;
				break;
			case WidthType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeWidth relativeWidth = (RelativeWidth)_width;
				num2 = composition.Scene.Width - num3;
				num2 *= relativeWidth.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeWidth.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num);
					num2 = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num2);
				}
				break;
			}
			case WidthType.Max:
			case WidthType.Auto:
				num2 = composition.Scene.Width - num3;
				break;
			}
			return new Bounds(num + num3, num2 + num3);
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			Composition composition2 = null;
			float num = 0f;
			switch (_width.Type)
			{
			case WidthType.Fixed:
				num = ((FixedWidth)_width).Value;
				break;
			case WidthType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeWidth relativeWidth = (RelativeWidth)_width;
				num = composition.Scene.Width;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
				num *= relativeWidth.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeWidth.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num);
				}
				break;
			}
			case WidthType.Max:
			case WidthType.Auto:
				num = composition.Scene.Width;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (num < 0f)
			{
				num = 0f;
			}
			float num2 = 65535f;
			switch (_height.Type)
			{
			case HeightType.Fixed:
				num2 = ((FixedHeight)_height).Value;
				break;
			case HeightType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeHeight relativeHeight = (RelativeHeight)_height;
				num2 = composition.ResidualHeight;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num2 -= _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
				}
				num2 *= relativeHeight.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeHeight.Constraint != null)
				{
					num2 = relativeHeight.Constraint.Apply(num2);
				}
				break;
			}
			case HeightType.Max:
				num2 = composition.ResidualHeight;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num2 -= _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
				}
				break;
			case HeightType.Auto:
				if (mode != MeasureMode.MasterFlush)
				{
					num2 = composition.ResidualHeight;
					if (_margins != null)
					{
						num2 -= _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			if (num2 < 0f)
			{
				num2 = 0f;
			}
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
				{
					float num3 = num2;
					if (_margins != null)
					{
						num3 += _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
					}
					if (composition.ResidualHeight < num3)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Create:
					composition2 = new Composition();
					composition2.Parent = composition;
					composition2.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
					composition2.Top = composition.Scene.Top;
					composition2.Width = num;
					composition2.Height = num2;
					composition2.Borders = _borders;
					composition2.Margins = _margins;
					composition2.Paddings = _paddings;
					composition2.Background = _background;
					if (_panel == null)
					{
						if (_margins != null)
						{
							composition2.Left += _margins.Left;
							composition2.Top += composition.ActiveHeight + _margins.Top;
						}
						else
						{
							composition2.Top += composition.ActiveHeight;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						PropertyCollection propertyCollection = _panel.AttachedProperties[this];
						composition2.Left += propertyCollection.GetValue("Left", 0f);
						composition2.Top += propertyCollection.GetValue("Top", 0f);
						composition2.RotationAngle = propertyCollection.GetValue("Angle", 0f);
					}
					composition2.ResetScene();
					_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
					foreach (Element item in _content)
					{
						item.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
					}
					composition.Content.Add(composition2);
					if (_panel == null)
					{
						composition.ActiveHeight += num2;
						if (_margins != null)
						{
							composition.ActiveHeight += _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
						}
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Process(visitor);
			}
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}
	}

		public override Bounds GetBounds(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			float num3 = ((_margins != null) ? (_margins.Left + _margins.Right) : 0f);
			switch (_width.Type)
			{
			case WidthType.Fixed:
				num = ((FixedWidth)_width).Value;
				num2 = num;
				break;
			case WidthType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeWidth relativeWidth = (RelativeWidth)_width;
				num2 = composition.Scene.Width - num3;
				num2 *= relativeWidth.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeWidth.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num);
					num2 = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num2);
				}
				break;
			}
			case WidthType.Max:
				num2 = composition.Scene.Width - num3;
				break;
			case WidthType.Auto:
				if (_layout == Layout.Vertical)
				{
					foreach (Element item in _content)
					{
						Bounds bounds = item.GetBounds(composition, graphics);
						if (num < bounds.Min)
						{
							num = bounds.Min;
						}
						if (num2 < bounds.Max)
						{
							num2 = bounds.Max;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					foreach (Element item2 in _content)
					{
						Bounds bounds2 = item2.GetBounds(composition, graphics);
						num += bounds2.Min;
						num2 += bounds2.Max;
					}
				}
				if (_paddings != null)
				{
					num3 += _paddings.Left + _paddings.Right;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasLeft && base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen != null)
				{
					num3 += base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasRight && base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen != null)
				{
					num3 += base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				break;
			}
			return new Bounds(num + num3, num2 + num3);
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{

			{

				num = ((FixedWidth)_width).Value;

			case WidthType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeWidth relativeWidth = (RelativeWidth)_width;
				num = composition.Scene.Width;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
				num *= relativeWidth.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeWidth.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num);
				}

				num = composition.Scene.Width;
				if (_margins != null)

					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;

				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}

			if (num < 0f)
			{
				num = 0f;

				{
					float num12 = ((_margins != null) ? (_margins.Top + _margins.Bottom) : 0f);
					if (_height.Type != HeightType.Auto)

					}
					if (composition.ResidualHeight < num12)
					{

				}
				case MeasureState.Create:
					composition2 = new Composition();
					composition2.Parent = composition;

						{

					}

										return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;

									flag3 = true;
									break;
								case MeasureResult.Ok:

									num7++;

								}

							bool flag4 = _freshBreak;

										{

										}
										continue;
									}

								}
								else

								}
							}

							if (composition2.ResidualHeight > 0f)

							{
								composition.ActiveHeight += composition2.Height;
								if (_margins != null)
								{

								}
							}
							Composition.AlignHorizontal(composition2, AlignmentResolved, Layout.Vertical);
							Composition.AlignVertical(composition2, AlignmentResolved, Layout.Vertical);
						}
						_marker = num7;
						if (flag3)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
							return MeasureResult.ContentBreak;
						}
						_state = MeasureState.End;
						break;
					}
					bool flag5 = false;
					bool flag6 = false;
					float num8 = 0f;
					bool flag7 = true;

					int count6 = _content.Count;

					{
						Element element5 = _content[num9];
						if (element5.Type == ElementType.PageBreak)

						}

						if (element5 is IBlock)
						{
							block2 = (IBlock)element5;
						}

								flag6 = true;

							{

									}

								}

							Area area4 = new Area();
							area4.Left = composition2.Scene.Left;

					}

									num3 += base.BordersResolved.Bottom.Pen.Width / 2f;
								}
							}

								composition.ActiveHeight += composition2.Height;

					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;

				case MeasureState.End:

				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Process(visitor);
			}
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Reset();
			}
			_marker = 0;
			base.Reset();
		}
	}

	public interface IImage
	{
		Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color TransparentColor { get; set; }

		bool KeepRatio { get; set; }

		Width Width { get; set; }

		Height Height { get; set; }

		Borders Borders { get; set; }

		Margins Margins { get; set; }

		Paddings Paddings { get; set; }

		Background Background { get; set; }

		object Parent { get; }

		Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Size Measure();
	}
	internal class Image : DecoratedBlock, IImage
	{
		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image _value;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color _transparentColor;

		private float _alpha;

		private bool _keepRatio;

		private object parent;

		public float Alpha
		{
			get
			{
				return _alpha;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0f || value > 1f)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(null, "[0.0, 1.0]");
				}
				_alpha = value;
			}
		}

		public bool KeepRatio
		{
			get
			{
				return _keepRatio;
			}
			set
			{
				_keepRatio = value;
			}
		}

		public object Parent => parent;

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color TransparentColor
		{
			get
			{
				return _transparentColor;
			}
			set
			{
				_transparentColor = value;
			}
		}

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image Value => _value;

		public override ElementType Type => ElementType.Image;

		public Image(Report report, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image value)
			: base(report)
		{
			_width = AutoWidth.Instance;
			_value = value;
			_alpha = 1f;
			_keepRatio = true;
		}

		public void InitializeParent(object parent)
		{
			if (parent == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("parent");
			}
			this.parent = parent;
		}

		public void SetTransparentColor(string value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("value");
			}
			if (value == "Auto")
			{
				_transparentColor = _value.GetPixel(0, 0);
			}
			else
			{
				_transparentColor = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color.Parse(value);
			}
		}

		public override Bounds GetBounds(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			float num3 = ((_margins != null) ? (_margins.Left + _margins.Right) : 0f);
			switch (_width.Type)
			{
			case WidthType.Fixed:
				num = ((FixedWidth)_width).Value;
				num2 = num;
				break;
			case WidthType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeWidth relativeWidth = (RelativeWidth)_width;
				num2 = composition.Scene.Width - num3;
				num2 *= relativeWidth.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeWidth.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num);
					num2 = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num2);
				}
				break;
			}
			case WidthType.Max:
				num2 = composition.Scene.Width - num3;
				break;
			case WidthType.Auto:
				num = Converter.PixelsToPoints(_value.Width);
				num2 = num;
				break;
			}
			if (_width.Type == WidthType.Fixed || _width.Type == WidthType.Auto)
			{
				if (_paddings != null)
				{
					num3 += _paddings.Left + _paddings.Right;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasLeft && base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen != null)
				{
					num3 += base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasRight && base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen != null)
				{
					num3 += base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
			}
			return new Bounds(num + num3, num2 + num3);
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			ImageArea imageArea = null;
			float num = 0f;
			switch (_width.Type)
			{
			case WidthType.Fixed:
				num = ((FixedWidth)_width).Value;
				break;
			case WidthType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeWidth relativeWidth = (RelativeWidth)_width;
				num = composition.Scene.Width;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
				num *= relativeWidth.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeWidth.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num);
				}
				break;
			}
			case WidthType.Max:
				num = composition.Scene.Width;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
				break;
			case WidthType.Auto:
				num = Converter.PixelsToPoints(_value.Width);
				break;
			}
			if (_width.Type == WidthType.Fixed || _width.Type == WidthType.Auto)
			{
				if (_paddings != null)
				{
					num += _paddings.Left + _paddings.Right;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasLeft && base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen != null)
				{
					num += base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasRight && base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen != null)
				{
					num += base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
			}
			if (num < 0f)
			{
				num = 0f;
			}
			float num2 = 0f;
			switch (_height.Type)
			{
			case HeightType.Fixed:
				num2 = ((FixedHeight)_height).Value;
				break;
			case HeightType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeHeight relativeHeight = (RelativeHeight)_height;
				num2 = composition.ResidualHeight;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num2 -= _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
				}
				num2 *= relativeHeight.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeHeight.Constraint != null)
				{
					num2 = relativeHeight.Constraint.Apply(num2);
				}
				break;
			}
			case HeightType.Max:
				num2 = composition.ResidualHeight;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num2 -= _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
				}
				break;
			case HeightType.Auto:
				if (_keepRatio && _value.Width != 0)
				{
					float num3 = num;
					if (_paddings != null)
					{
						num3 -= _paddings.Left + _paddings.Right;
					}
					if (base.BordersResolved.HasLeft && base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen != null)
					{
						num3 -= base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen.Width / 2f;
					}
					if (base.BordersResolved.HasRight && base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen != null)
					{
						num3 -= base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen.Width / 2f;
					}
					num2 = (float)_value.Height / (float)_value.Width * num3;
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = Converter.PixelsToPoints(_value.Height);
				}
				break;
			}
			if (_height.Type == HeightType.Fixed || _height.Type == HeightType.Auto)
			{
				if (_paddings != null)
				{
					num2 += _paddings.Top + _paddings.Bottom;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasTop && base.BordersResolved.Top.Pen != null)
				{
					num2 += base.BordersResolved.Top.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasBottom && base.BordersResolved.Bottom.Pen != null)
				{
					num2 += base.BordersResolved.Bottom.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
			}
			if (num2 < 0f)
			{
				num2 = 0f;
			}
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
				{
					float num4 = num2;
					if (_margins != null)
					{
						num4 += _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
					}
					if (composition.ResidualHeight < num4)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Create:
					imageArea = new ImageArea(_value, _transparentColor, _alpha, keepRatio: false);
					imageArea.Parent = composition;
					imageArea.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
					imageArea.Top = composition.Scene.Top;
					imageArea.Width = num;
					imageArea.Height = num2;
					imageArea.Borders = base.BordersResolved;
					imageArea.Margins = _margins;
					imageArea.Paddings = _paddings;
					imageArea.Background = _background;
					if (_panel == null)
					{
						if (_margins != null)
						{
							imageArea.Left += _margins.Left;
							imageArea.Top += composition.ActiveHeight + _margins.Top;
						}
						else
						{
							imageArea.Top += composition.ActiveHeight;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						PropertyCollection propertyCollection = _panel.AttachedProperties[this];
						imageArea.Left += propertyCollection.GetValue("Left", 0f);
						imageArea.Top += propertyCollection.GetValue("Top", 0f);
						imageArea.RotationAngle = propertyCollection.GetValue("Angle", 0f);
					}
					imageArea.ResetScene();
					_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
					composition.Content.Add(imageArea);
					if (_panel == null)
					{
						composition.ActiveHeight += num2;
						if (_margins != null)
						{
							composition.ActiveHeight += _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
						}
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}
	}

		public void AddProperty(string name, string value)
		{
			if (name == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("name");
			}
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("value");
			}
			if (!_properties.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				_properties.Add(name, value);
			}
			else
			{
				_properties[name] = value;
			}
		}

	public class RelativeWidth : Width
	{
		private float _value;

		private Constraint _constraint;

		internal override WidthType Type => WidthType.Relative;

		public Constraint Constraint
		{
			get
			{
				return _constraint;
			}
			set
			{
				_constraint = value;
			}
		}

		public float Value
		{

	public class Corners : SealableBase
	{
		private Corner _topLeft;

		private Corner _topRight;

		private Corner _bottomLeft;

		private Corner _bottomRight;

		public Corner All
		{
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_topLeft = value;
				_topRight = value;
				_bottomLeft = value;
				_bottomRight = value;
			}
		}

		public Corner BottomLeft
		{
			get
			{
				if (_bottomLeft == null)
				{
					_bottomLeft = new Corner();
				}
				return _bottomLeft;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_bottomLeft = value;
			}
		}

		public Corner BottomRight
		{
			get
			{
				if (_bottomRight == null)
				{
					_bottomRight = new Corner();
				}
				return _bottomRight;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_bottomRight = value;
			}
		}

		public bool HasAll
		{
			get
			{
				if (HasBottomLeft && HasBottomRight && HasTopLeft)
				{
					return HasTopRight;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool HasBottomLeft => _bottomLeft != null;

		public bool HasBottomRight => _bottomRight != null;

		public bool HasTopLeft => _topLeft != null;

		public bool HasTopRight => _topRight != null;

		public Corner TopLeft
		{
			get
			{
				if (_topLeft == null)
				{
					_topLeft = new Corner();
				}
				return _topLeft;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_topLeft = value;
			}
		}

		public Corner TopRight
		{
			get
			{
				if (_topRight == null)
				{
					_topRight = new Corner();
				}
				return _topRight;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_topRight = value;
			}
		}

		public Corners()
		{
		}

		public Corners(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen pen, float radius)
		{
			All = new Corner(pen, radius);
		}

	internal abstract class Element
	{
		protected Report _report;

		protected IPanel _panel;

		protected bool _freshBreak;

		protected MeasureState _state;

		public bool Measured
		{
			get
			{
				if (_state == MeasureState.End)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public virtual IPanel Panel
		{
			get
			{
				return _panel;
			}
			set
			{
				_panel = value;
			}
		}

		public virtual Report Report => _report;

		public abstract ElementType Type { get; }

		public Element(Report report)
		{
			_report = report;
			_state = MeasureState.Start;
		}

		public virtual Bounds GetBounds(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics)
		{
			return new Bounds(0f, composition.Scene.Width);
		}

		public virtual MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			_state = MeasureState.End;
			return MeasureResult.Ok;
		}

		public virtual void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
		}

		public virtual void Reset()
		{
			_state = MeasureState.Start;
		}

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Size Measure()
		{
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Projection.Projection projection = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Projection.Projection();
			ProjectionPage projectionPage = projection.AddPage(PageSizes.Letter.Width, PageSizes.Letter.Height);
			Composition composition = projectionPage.AddComposition();
			composition.Width = PageSizes.Letter.Width;
			composition.Height = PageSizes.Letter.Height;
			composition.ResetScene();
			VirtualGraphics graphics = new VirtualGraphics(_report.TTFonts);
			Measure(composition, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
			float width = 0f;
			float height = 0f;
			if (composition.Content.Count > 0)
			{
				Area area = composition.Content[0];
				width = area.Width;
				height = area.Height;
			}
			Reset();
			return new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Size(width, height);
		}
	}

	}

	public class Corner : SealableBase
	{
		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen _pen;

		private float _radius;

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen Pen
		{
			get
			{
				return _pen;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_pen = value;
			}
		}

		public float Radius
		{
			get
			{
				return _radius;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				if (value < 0f)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(null, "[0.0, ...]");
				}
				_radius = value;
			}
		}

		public Corner()
		{
		}

		public Corner(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen pen, float radius)
		{
			if (radius < 0f)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("radius", "[0.0, ...]");
			}
			_pen = pen;
			_radius = radius;
		}

		public override void Seal()
		{
			base.Seal();
			if (Pen != null)
			{
				Pen.Seal();
			}
		}

		internal override bool VerifyMembersSealed()
		{
			if (Pen != null && !Pen.IsSealed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
