		public void AttachFile(string fileName, string name, string mimeType, string description)
		{
			if (fileName == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("fileName");
			}
			if (name == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("name");
			}
			FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(fileName, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.Read);
			int num = (int)fileStream.Length;
			byte[] buffer = new byte[num];
			fileStream.Read(buffer, 0, num);
			fileStream.Close();
			_attachments.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Attachments.Attachment(name, mimeType, description, new MemoryStream(buffer)));
		}

		public void AttachFile(System.IO.Stream stream, string name, string mimeType, string description)
		{
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("stream");
			}
			if (name == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("name");
			}
			_attachments.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Attachments.Attachment(name, mimeType, description, stream));
		}

		public void Publish(string fileName, FileFormat format)
		{
			if (fileName == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("fileName");
			}
			FileStream fileStream = null;
			try
			{
				fileStream = new FileStream(fileName, FileMode.Create);
				Publish(fileStream, format);
			}
			finally
			{
				fileStream?.Close();
			}
		}

		public void Publish(System.IO.Stream stream, FileFormat format)
		{
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("stream");
			}
			switch (format)
			{
			case FileFormat.PDF:
			{
				PdfDocument pdfDocument = new PdfDocument();
				if (this.ReportPublishing != null)
				{
					pdfDocument.ReportPublishing += DocumentReportPublishing;
				}
				pdfDocument.Info.Title = _info.Title;
				pdfDocument.Info.Subject = _info.Subject;
				pdfDocument.Info.Keywords = _info.Keywords;
				switch (_preferences.PDF.Info.AuthorType)
				{
				case AuthorType.Author:
					pdfDocument.Info.Author = _info.Author;
					break;
				case AuthorType.Company:
					pdfDocument.Info.Author = _info.Company;
					break;
				case AuthorType.Manager:
					pdfDocument.Info.Author = _info.Manager;
					break;
				}
				if (_preferences.PDF.Info.ShowCreator)
				{
					pdfDocument.Info.Creator = _info.Creator;
				}
				pdfDocument.Info.Created = _info.Created;
				pdfDocument.Info.Modified = _info.Modified;
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, string> property in ((Info)_info).Properties)
				{
					pdfDocument.Info.AddProperty(property.Key, property.Value);
				}
				switch (_preferences.PDF.Encryptor.Cipher)
				{
				case CipherType.Default:
					pdfDocument.Cipher = CipherType.Default;
					break;
				case CipherType.AES:
					pdfDocument.Cipher = CipherType.AES;
					break;
				}
				pdfDocument.Owner = _preferences.PDF.Encryptor.Password.Owner;
				pdfDocument.User = _preferences.PDF.Encryptor.Password.User;
				pdfDocument.Permissions.Add = _preferences.PDF.Encryptor.Permissions.Add;
				pdfDocument.Permissions.Copy = _preferences.PDF.Encryptor.Permissions.Copy;
				pdfDocument.Permissions.Modify = _preferences.PDF.Encryptor.Permissions.Modify;
				pdfDocument.Permissions.Print = _preferences.PDF.Encryptor.Permissions.Print;
				pdfDocument.ViewerPreferences.HideToolbar = _preferences.PDF.Viewer.HideToolbar;
				pdfDocument.ViewerPreferences.HideMenubar = _preferences.PDF.Viewer.HideMenubar;
				pdfDocument.ViewerPreferences.HideWindowUI = _preferences.PDF.Viewer.HideWindowUI;
				pdfDocument.ViewerPreferences.FitWindow = _preferences.PDF.Viewer.FitWindow;
				pdfDocument.ViewerPreferences.CenterWindow = _preferences.PDF.Viewer.CenterWindow;
				if (_attachments.Count > 0)
				{
					pdfDocument.DisplayMode = DisplayMode.Attachments;
				}
				foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Attachments.Attachment attachment in _attachments)
				{
					pdfDocument.AttachFile(attachment.Content, attachment.Name, attachment.MimeType, attachment.Description);
				}
				if (_fb != null)
				{
					pdfDocument.FileBuffer = _fb;
				}
				Measure();
				int num2 = 0;
				foreach (ProjectionPage page in _projection.Pages)
				{
					pdfDocument.AddPage(page.Width, page.Height);
					page.AbsoluteIndex = num2;
					num2++;
				}
				foreach (ProjectionPage page2 in _projection.Pages)
				{
					IPdfPage pdfPage = ((IPdfPageCollection)pdfDocument)[page2.AbsoluteIndex];
					page2.Draw(pdfPage.Graphics);
					pdfPage.Graphics.Flush();
				}
				if (_bookmarks.Root.Content.Count > 0)
				{
					pdfDocument.DisplayMode = DisplayMode.Bookmarks;
					foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Bookmarks.Bookmark item in _bookmarks.Root.Content)
					{
						Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Projection.Destination destination2 = item.Text.GetDestination();
						Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.IBookmark pdfBookmark = pdfDocument.AddBookmark(destination2.Page.AbsoluteIndex, destination2.X, destination2.Y, item.GetTitle(), item.Level.Opened);
						BuildPDFBookmarks(item.Content, pdfBookmark);
					}
				}
				if (_preferences.PDF.Signature.Certificate != null)
				{
					pdfDocument.Sign(_preferences.PDF.Signature.Certificate, _preferences.PDF.Signature.Reason, _preferences.PDF.Signature.Location, _preferences.PDF.Signature.ContactInfo);
				}
				pdfDocument.Generate(stream);
				break;
			}
			case FileFormat.XPS:
			{
				XpsDocument xpsDocument = new XpsDocument();
				if (this.ReportPublishing != null)
				{
					xpsDocument.ReportPublishing += DocumentReportPublishing;
				}
				xpsDocument.Info.Category = _info.Category;
				xpsDocument.Info.Title = _info.Title;
				xpsDocument.Info.Subject = _info.Subject;
				xpsDocument.Info.Keywords = _info.Keywords;
				switch (_preferences.XPS.Info.CreatorType)
				{
				case CreatorType.Creator:
					xpsDocument.Info.Creator = _info.Creator;
					break;
				case CreatorType.Author:
					xpsDocument.Info.Creator = _info.Author;
					break;
				case CreatorType.Company:
					xpsDocument.Info.Creator = _info.Company;
					break;
				case CreatorType.Manager:
					xpsDocument.Info.Creator = _info.Manager;
					break;
				}
				xpsDocument.Info.Created = _info.Created;
				xpsDocument.Info.Modified = _info.Modified;
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, string> property2 in ((Info)_info).Properties)
				{
					xpsDocument.Info.AddProperty(property2.Key, property2.Value);
				}
				foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Attachments.Attachment attachment2 in _attachments)
				{
					xpsDocument.AttachFile(attachment2.Content, attachment2.Name, attachment2.MimeType);
				}
				if (_fb != null)
				{
					xpsDocument.FileBuffer = _fb;
				}
				Measure();
				int num = 0;
				foreach (ProjectionPage page3 in _projection.Pages)
				{
					xpsDocument.AddPage(page3.Width, page3.Height);
					page3.AbsoluteIndex = num;
					num++;
				}
				if (_bookmarks.Root.Content.Count > 0)
				{
					foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Bookmarks.Bookmark item2 in _bookmarks.Root.Content)
					{
						Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Projection.Destination destination = item2.Text.GetDestination();
						Infragistics.Documents.Reports.XPS.IBookmark xpsBookmark = xpsDocument.AddBookmark(destination.Page.AbsoluteIndex, destination.X, destination.Y, item2.GetTitle());
						BuildXPSBookmarks(item2.Content, xpsBookmark);
					}
				}
				foreach (ProjectionPage page4 in _projection.Pages)
				{
					IXpsPage xpsPage = ((IXpsPageCollection)xpsDocument)[page4.AbsoluteIndex];
					page4.Draw(xpsPage.Graphics);
					xpsPage.Graphics.Flush();
				}
				xpsDocument.Generate(stream);
				break;
			}
			case FileFormat.PlainText:
			{
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.IO.PlainText.Writer writer = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.IO.PlainText.Writer(this);
				writer.Write(stream);
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		private void DocumentReportPublishing(object sender, PublishProgressEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.ReportPublishing != null)
			{
				this.ReportPublishing(sender, e);
			}
		}

		internal void AddTarget(string name, ReportTarget target)
		{
			List<ReportTarget> list;
			if (!_targets.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				list = new List<ReportTarget>();
				list.Add(target);
				_targets.Add(name, list);
				return;
			}
			list = _targets[name];
			if (!list.Contains(target))
			{
				_targets[name].Add(target);
			}
		}

		internal List<ReportTarget> GetTarget(string name)
		{
			if (_targets.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				return _targets[name];
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Projection.Projection Measure()
		{
			if (_projection == null)
			{
				HeadingCollector headingCollector = new HeadingCollector();
				Process(headingCollector);
				BuildBookmarks(headingCollector.Headings);
				if (_toc != null)
				{
					BuildTOC(headingCollector.Headings);
				}
				if (_index != null)
				{
					BuildIndex();
				}
				_projection = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Projection.Projection();
				int firstPageNumber = 0;
				int firstLineNumber = 0;
				bool flag = true;
				foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Section.Section section in _sections)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						firstPageNumber = ((section.PageNumbering == null) ? 1 : section.PageNumbering.First);
						section.FirstPageNumber = firstPageNumber;
						firstLineNumber = ((section.LineNumbering == null) ? 1 : section.LineNumbering.First);
						section.FirstLineNumber = firstLineNumber;
						flag = false;
					}
					else
					{
						if (section.PageNumbering != null)
						{
							if (section.PageNumbering.Continue)
							{
								section.FirstPageNumber = firstPageNumber;
							}
							else
							{
								section.FirstPageNumber = section.PageNumbering.First;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							section.FirstPageNumber = firstPageNumber;
						}
						if (section.LineNumbering != null)
						{
							if (section.LineNumbering.Continue)
							{
								section.FirstLineNumber = firstLineNumber;
							}
							else
							{
								section.FirstLineNumber = section.LineNumbering.First;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							section.FirstLineNumber = firstLineNumber;
						}
					}
					section.Measure(_projection, new VirtualGraphics(_ttFonts));
					firstPageNumber = section.LastPageNumber + 1;
					firstLineNumber = section.LastLineNumber + 1;
				}
			}
			if (_index != null)
			{
				_index.RemoveDuplicateTargets();
			}
			return _projection;
		}

		internal void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Section.Section section in _sections)
			{
				section.Process(visitor);
			}
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}

		private void BuildBookmarks(HeadingCollection headings)
		{
			_bookmarks.Root = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Bookmarks.Bookmark();
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Bookmarks.Bookmark bookmark = _bookmarks.Root;
			int num = 0;
			foreach (Heading heading in headings)
			{
				if (heading.Level <= _bookmarks.Levels.Count)
				{
					while (num > heading.Level - 1)
					{
						bookmark = bookmark.Parent;
						num--;
					}
					bookmark = bookmark.AddBookmark(_bookmarks.Levels[heading.Level - 1], heading.Text);
					num++;
				}
			}
		}

		private void BuildIndex()
		{
			Dictionary<string, Entry> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, Entry>(100);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, List<ReportTarget>> target in _targets)
			{
				List<ReportTarget> value = target.Value;
				foreach (ReportTarget item in value)
				{
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.Caption))
					{
						continue;
					}
					CharBuffer charBuffer = new CharBuffer();
					CharBuffer charBuffer2 = new CharBuffer();
					int num = 1;
					string caption = item.Caption;
					foreach (char c in caption)
					{
						if (c == ':')
						{
							if (charBuffer2.Count > 0)
							{
								string text = charBuffer.ToString();
								if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(text))
								{
									dictionary.Add(text, new Entry(text, charBuffer2.ToString(), num));
								}
								charBuffer.Add(c);
								charBuffer2.Clear();
								num++;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							charBuffer.Add(c);
							charBuffer2.Add(c);
						}
					}
					if (charBuffer2.Count > 0)
					{
						string text = charBuffer.ToString();
						if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(text))
						{
							dictionary.Add(text, new Entry(text, charBuffer2.ToString(), num));
						}
						dictionary[text].Targets.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}
			List<Entry> list = new List<Entry>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, Entry> item2 in dictionary)
			{
				list.Add(item2.Value);
			}
			list.Sort(new EntryComparer());
			char c2 = ' ';
			foreach (Entry item3 in list)
			{
				if (item3.Level <= _index.Levels.Count)
				{
					char c3 = char.ToUpper(item3.Path[0]);
					if (c3 < 'A' || c3 > 'Z')
					{
						c3 = '#';
					}
					if (c2 != c3)
					{
						c2 = c3;
						_index.AddMarker(c2);
					}
					_index.AddItem(_index.Levels[item3.Level - 1], item3.Caption, item3.Targets);
				}
			}
		}

		private void BuildPDFBookmarks(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Bookmarks.BookmarkCollection content, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.IBookmark pdfBookmark)
		{
			foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Bookmarks.Bookmark item in content)
			{
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Projection.Destination destination = item.Text.GetDestination();
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.IBookmark pdfBookmark2 = pdfBookmark.AddBookmark(destination.Page.AbsoluteIndex, destination.X, destination.Y, item.GetTitle(), item.Level.Opened);
				BuildPDFBookmarks(item.Content, pdfBookmark2);
			}
		}

		private void BuildTOC(HeadingCollection headings)
		{
			foreach (Heading heading in headings)
			{
				if (heading.Level <= _toc.Levels.Count)
				{
					_toc.AddItem(_toc.Levels[heading.Level - 1], heading.Text);
				}
			}
		}

		private void BuildXPSBookmarks(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Bookmarks.BookmarkCollection content, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.XPS.IBookmark xpsBookmark)
		{
			foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Bookmarks.Bookmark item in content)
			{
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Projection.Destination destination = item.Text.GetDestination();
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.XPS.IBookmark xpsBookmark2 = xpsBookmark.AddBookmark(destination.Page.AbsoluteIndex, destination.X, destination.Y, item.GetTitle());
				BuildXPSBookmarks(item.Content, xpsBookmark2);
			}
		}
	}
	public class PublishProgressEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		private readonly double _current;

		private readonly int _total;

		public int Total => _total;

		public double Current => _current;

		public bool IsFinished => Math.Abs((double)Total - Current) < 0.001;

		public double Percentage => Current / (double)Total;

		public PublishProgressEventArgs(double current, int total)
		{
			_current = current;
			_total = total;
		}
	}
	internal class Rule : Element, IRule
	{
		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen _pen;

		private VerticalMargins _margins;

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen Pen
		{
			get
			{
				return _pen;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_pen = value;
			}
		}

		public VerticalMargins Margins
		{
			get
			{
				return _margins;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_margins = value;
			}
		}

		public override ElementType Type => ElementType.Rule;

		public Rule(Report report)
			: base(report)
		{
			_pen = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pens.Black;
			_margins = new VerticalMargins();
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			RuleArea ruleArea = null;
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
				{
					float num = _pen.Width;
					if (_margins != null)
					{
						num += _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
					}
					if (composition.ResidualHeight < num)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Create:
					ruleArea = new RuleArea(this);
					ruleArea.Parent = composition;
					ruleArea.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
					ruleArea.Top = composition.Scene.Top;
					ruleArea.Width = composition.Scene.Width;
					ruleArea.Height = _pen.Width;
					if (_margins != null && (_margins.Top > 0f || _margins.Bottom > 0f))
					{
						ruleArea.Margins = new Margins(0f, 0f, _margins.Top, _margins.Bottom);
					}
					if (_panel == null)
					{
						ruleArea.Top += composition.ActiveHeight;
						if (_margins != null)
						{
							ruleArea.Top += _margins.Top;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						PropertyCollection propertyCollection = _panel.AttachedProperties[this];
						ruleArea.Left += propertyCollection.GetValue("Left", 0f);
						ruleArea.Top += propertyCollection.GetValue("Top", 0f);
						ruleArea.RotationAngle = propertyCollection.GetValue("Angle", 0f);
					}
					ruleArea.ResetScene();
					_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
					composition.Content.Add(ruleArea);
					if (_panel == null)
					{
						composition.ActiveHeight += _pen.Width + _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}
	}
	public class Margins

			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("bottom", "[0.0, ...]");
			}
			_left = left;
			_right = right;
			_top = top;
			_bottom = bottom;
		}

	internal class Stretcher : Element, IStretcher
	{
		private float _clearance;

		public float Clearance
		{
			get
			{
				return _clearance;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0f)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(null, "[0.0, ...]");
				}
				_clearance = value;
			}
		}

		public override ElementType Type => ElementType.Stretcher;

		public Stretcher(Report report)
			: base(report)
		{
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			Area area = null;
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
					if (composition.ResidualHeight < _clearance)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				case MeasureState.Create:
					area = new Area();
					area.Parent = composition;
					area.Fake = true;
					area.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
					area.Top = composition.Scene.Top + composition.ActiveHeight;
					area.Width = composition.Scene.Width;
					area.Height = composition.ResidualHeight - _clearance;
					area.ResetScene();
					_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
					composition.Content.Add(area);
					composition.ActiveHeight += area.Height;
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}
	}
	public abstract class Width
	{
		internal abstract WidthType Type { get; }
	}
}

	internal class Decoration : Panel, IDecoration
	{
		private bool _rear;

		private MasterRange _masterRange;

		private RangeCollection _ranges;

		public MasterRange MasterRange
		{
			get
			{
				return _masterRange;
			}
			set
			{
				_masterRange = value;
			}
		}

		public RangeCollection Ranges => _ranges;

		public bool Rear
		{
			get
			{
				return _rear;
			}
			set
			{
				_rear = value;
			}
		}

		public override ElementType Type => ElementType.Decoration;

		public Decoration(Report report)
			: base(report)
		{
			_masterRange = MasterRange.All;
			_ranges = new RangeCollection();
		}

		public IRange AddRange()
		{
			Range range = new Range();
			_ranges.Add(range);
			return range;
		}

		public IRange AddRange(int start, int end)
		{
			Range range = new Range(start, end);
			_ranges.Add(range);
			return range;
		}

		public bool InRange(int pageIndex)
		{
			int num = pageIndex + 1;
			switch (_masterRange)
			{
			case MasterRange.Even:
				if (num % 2 != 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				break;
			case MasterRange.Odd:
				if (num % 2 == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (_ranges.Count == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			foreach (Range range in _ranges)
			{
				if (range.Contains(num))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Process(visitor);
			}
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}
	}
	internal class DecorationCollection : List<Decoration>
	{
	}

	public class PageNumbering
	{
		private Style _style;

		private string _template;

		private PageNumberFormat _format;

		private PageNumberAlignment _alignment;

		private int _first;

		private bool _continue;

		private bool _skipFirst;

		private float _offsetX;

		private float _offsetY;

		private static Style DefaultStyle = new Style(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Text.DefaultStyle.Font, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Text.DefaultStyle.Brush);

		private string cachedTemplate;

		public PageNumberAlignment Alignment
		{
			get
			{
				return _alignment;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_alignment = value;
			}
		}

		public bool Continue
		{
			get
			{
				return _continue;
			}
			set
			{
				_continue = value;
			}
		}

		public int First
		{
			get
			{
				return _first;
			}
			set
			{
				_first = value;
			}
		}

		public PageNumberFormat Format
		{
			get
			{
				return _format;
			}
			set
			{
				_format = value;
			}
		}

		public float OffsetX
		{
			get
			{
				return _offsetX;
			}
			set
			{
				_offsetX = value;
			}
		}

		public float OffsetY
		{
			get
			{
				return _offsetY;
			}
			set
			{
				_offsetY = value;
			}
		}

		public bool SkipFirst
		{
			get
			{
				return _skipFirst;
			}
			set
			{
				_skipFirst = value;
			}
		}

		public Style Style
		{
			get
			{
				return _style;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_style = value;
			}
		}

		public string Template
		{
			get
			{
				return _template;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_template != value)
				{
					_template = value;
					cachedTemplate = _template;
					if (cachedTemplate != null)
					{
						cachedTemplate = cachedTemplate.Replace("[Page #]", "{0}");
						cachedTemplate = cachedTemplate.Replace("[LastPageInSection]", "{1}");
						cachedTemplate = cachedTemplate.Replace("[TotalPages]", "{2}");
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal string TemplateResolved => cachedTemplate;

		public PageNumbering()
		{
			_style = DefaultStyle;
			_format = PageNumberFormat.Decimal;
			_alignment = new PageNumberAlignment();
			_first = 1;
			_continue = true;
			_skipFirst = true;
		}
	}
	internal class Range : IRange
	{
		private int _start;

		private int _end;

		public int End
		{
			get
			{
				return _end;
			}
			set
			{
				_end = value;
			}
		}

		public int Start
		{
			get
			{
				return _start;
			}
			set
			{
				_start = value;
			}
		}

		public Range()
			: this(1, -1)
		{
		}

		public Range(int start, int end)
		{
			_start = start;
			_end = end;
		}

		public bool Contains(int number)
		{
			if (number >= _start)
			{
				if (_end == -1)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (number <= _end)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class RangeCollection : List<Range>
	{
	}
	internal class Section : ISection
	{
		private Report _report;

		{
			if (width < 0f)

				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("width", "[0.0, ...]");
			}
			if (height < 0f)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("height", "[0.0, ...]");
			}
			SectionPage sectionPage = new SectionPage(_report);
			sectionPage.Width = width;
			sectionPage.Height = height;
			sectionPage.Borders = _pageBorders;
			sectionPage.Margins = _pageMargins;
			sectionPage.Paddings = _pagePaddings;
			sectionPage.Background = _pageBackground;
			_content.Add(sectionPage);
			return sectionPage;
		}

		public void Measure(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Projection.Projection projection, IGraphics graphics)
		{
			SectionHeaderCollection sectionHeaderCollection = new SectionHeaderCollection();
			foreach (SectionHeader header in _headers)
			{
				sectionHeaderCollection.Add(header);
			}
			SectionFooterCollection sectionFooterCollection = new SectionFooterCollection();
			foreach (SectionFooter footer in _footers)
			{
				sectionFooterCollection.Add(footer);
			}
			StationeryCollection stationeryCollection = new StationeryCollection();
			foreach (Stationery stationery in _stationeries)
			{
				stationeryCollection.Add(stationery);
			}
			Composition composition = null;
			bool flag = false;
			int num = 0;
			bool flag2 = true;
			if (_content.Count > 0)
			{
				Element element = _content[0];
				if (element.Type == ElementType.Page)
				{
					flag2 = false;
				}
			}
			_lastPageNumber = _firstPageNumber;
			_lastLineNumber = _firstLineNumber;
			if (flag2)
			{
				composition = AddPage(this, projection, graphics, sectionHeaderCollection, sectionFooterCollection, stationeryCollection, num, _pageSize.Width, _pageSize.Height, PageBordersResolved, PageMarginsResolved, _pagePaddings, _pageBackground, blank: false);
				flag = true;
				num++;
			}
			else
			{
				_lastPageNumber--;
			}
			MeasureMode mode = MeasureMode.Normal;
			bool flag3 = true;
			bool flag4 = false;
			int num2 = _firstLineNumber;
			int num3 = 0;
			int count = _content.Count;
			while (num3 < count)
			{
				Element element2 = _content[num3];
				if (element2.Type == ElementType.Page)
				{
					SectionPage sectionPage = (SectionPage)element2;
					_lastPageNumber++;
					if (flag)
					{
						Composition.AlignHorizontal(composition, PageAlignmentResolved, Layout.Vertical);
						Composition.AlignVertical(composition, PageAlignmentResolved, Layout.Vertical);
					}
					composition = AddPage(this, projection, graphics, sectionHeaderCollection, sectionFooterCollection, stationeryCollection, num, sectionPage.Width, sectionPage.Height, sectionPage.Borders, sectionPage.Margins, sectionPage.Paddings, sectionPage.Background, sectionPage.Blank);
					flag = false;
					num++;
					element2.Measure(composition, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
					flag4 = true;
					num3++;
					continue;
				}
				if (flag4)
				{
					_lastPageNumber++;
					if (flag)
					{
						Composition.AlignHorizontal(composition, PageAlignmentResolved, Layout.Vertical);
						Composition.AlignVertical(composition, PageAlignmentResolved, Layout.Vertical);
					}
					composition = AddPage(this, projection, graphics, sectionHeaderCollection, sectionFooterCollection, stationeryCollection, num, _pageSize.Width, _pageSize.Height, PageBordersResolved, PageMarginsResolved, _pagePaddings, _pageBackground, blank: false);
					flag = true;
					num++;
					flag4 = false;
					flag3 = true;
				}
				if (_lineNumbering != null && element2.Type == ElementType.Text)
				{
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Text text = (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Text)element2;
					text.LineNumbering = new TextLineNumbering();
					text.LineNumbering.First = num2;
					text.LineNumbering.OffsetX = _lineNumbering.OffsetX;
					text.LineNumbering.OffsetY = _lineNumbering.OffsetY;
					text.LineNumbering.Style = _lineNumbering.Style;
				}
				MeasureResult measureResult = element2.Measure(composition, graphics, mode);
				if (measureResult != MeasureResult.Ok)
				{
					if (measureResult == MeasureResult.PageBreak)
					{
						num3++;
					}
					mode = MeasureMode.Normal;
					if (flag3 && measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
					{
						mode = MeasureMode.Flush;
						continue;
					}
					_lastPageNumber++;
					if (flag)
					{
						Composition.AlignHorizontal(composition, PageAlignmentResolved, Layout.Vertical);
						Composition.AlignVertical(composition, PageAlignmentResolved, Layout.Vertical);
					}
					composition = AddPage(this, projection, graphics, sectionHeaderCollection, sectionFooterCollection, stationeryCollection, num, _pageSize.Width, _pageSize.Height, PageBordersResolved, PageMarginsResolved, _pagePaddings, _pageBackground, blank: false);
					flag = true;
					num++;
					flag3 = true;
				}
				else
				{
					num3++;
					mode = MeasureMode.Normal;
					flag3 = false;
					if (_lineNumbering != null && element2.Type == ElementType.Text)
					{
						Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Text text2 = (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Text)element2;
						num2 = text2.LastLineNumber + 1;
					}
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				Composition.AlignHorizontal(composition, PageAlignmentResolved, Layout.Vertical);
				Composition.AlignVertical(composition, PageAlignmentResolved, Layout.Vertical);
			}
			_lastLineNumber = num2 - 1;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Reset();
			}
		}

		private static Composition AddPage(Section section, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Projection.Projection projection, IGraphics graphics, SectionHeaderCollection headers, SectionFooterCollection footers, StationeryCollection stationeries, int pageIndex, float width, float height, Borders borders, Margins spacings, Paddings paddings, Background background, bool blank)
		{
			if (section.PageOrientation == PageOrientation.Landscape)
			{
				float num = width;
				width = height;
				height = num;
			}
			ProjectionPage projectionPage = projection.AddPage(width, height);
			projectionPage.Section = section;
			projectionPage.RelativeIndex = pageIndex;
			projectionPage.Number = section.LastPageNumber;
			Composition composition = projectionPage.AddComposition();
			if (spacings != null)
			{
				width -= spacings.Left + spacings.Right;
				height -= spacings.Top + spacings.Bottom;
				if (section.Flip && (pageIndex + 1) % 2 == 0)
				{
					composition.Left = spacings.Right;
				}
				else
				{
					composition.Left = spacings.Left;
				}
				composition.Top = spacings.Top;
			}
			else
			{
				composition.Left = 0f;
				composition.Top = 0f;
			}
			composition.Width = width;
			composition.Height = height;
			composition.ResetScene();
			Stationery stationery = null;
			if (!blank && pageIndex < stationeries.Count)
			{
				stationery = stationeries[pageIndex];
				if (stationery.Repeat)
				{
					stationeries.Add(stationery);
				}
				stationery.Reset();
				stationery.Measure(composition, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
			}
			SectionHeader sectionHeader = null;
			if (!blank && pageIndex < headers.Count)
			{
				sectionHeader = headers[pageIndex];
				if (sectionHeader.Repeat)
				{
					headers.Add(sectionHeader);
				}
				composition.Scene.Height = sectionHeader.Height;
				sectionHeader.Reset();
				sectionHeader.Measure(composition, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
			}
			SectionFooter sectionFooter = null;
			if (!blank && pageIndex < footers.Count)
			{
				sectionFooter = footers[pageIndex];
				if (sectionFooter.Repeat)
				{
					footers.Add(sectionFooter);
				}
				composition.ResetScene();
				composition.Scene.Top += composition.Scene.Height - sectionFooter.Height;
				composition.Scene.Height = sectionFooter.Height;
				sectionFooter.Reset();
				sectionFooter.Measure(composition, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
			}
			composition.Borders = borders;
			composition.Background = background;
			composition.ResetScene();
			Composition composition2 = new Composition();
			composition2.Parent = composition;
			composition2.Width = width;
			composition2.Height = height;
			if (!blank && sectionHeader != null)
			{
				composition2.Top += sectionHeader.Height;
				composition2.Height -= sectionHeader.Height;
			}
			if (!blank && sectionFooter != null)
			{
				composition2.Height -= sectionFooter.Height;
			}
			if (paddings != null)
			{
				composition2.Left += paddings.Left;
				composition2.Top += paddings.Top;
				composition2.Width -= paddings.Left + paddings.Right;
				composition2.Height -= paddings.Top + paddings.Bottom;
			}
			composition2.ResetScene();
			composition.Content.Add(composition2);
			if (!blank)
			{
				foreach (Decoration decoration in section.Decorations)
				{
					if (decoration.InRange(pageIndex))
					{
						Composition composition3 = new Composition();
						composition3.Page = projectionPage;
						if (decoration.Rear)
						{
							projectionPage.Compositions.Insert(0, composition3);
						}
						else
						{
							projectionPage.Compositions.Add(composition3);
						}
						composition3.Width = projectionPage.Width;
						composition3.Height = projectionPage.Height;
						composition3.ResetScene();
						decoration.Reset();
						decoration.Measure(composition3, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
					}
				}
			}
			return composition2;
		}

		internal void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			foreach (SectionHeader header in _headers)
			{
				header.Process(visitor);
			}
			foreach (SectionFooter footer in _footers)
			{
				footer.Process(visitor);
			}
			foreach (Stationery stationery in _stationeries)
			{
				stationery.Process(visitor);
			}
			foreach (Decoration decoration in _decorations)
			{
				decoration.Process(visitor);
			}
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Process(visitor);
			}
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}
	}
	internal class SectionCollection : List<Section>
	{
	}
	internal class Stationery : Panel, IStationery
	{
		private bool _repeat;

		public bool Repeat
		{
			get
			{
				return _repeat;
			}
			set
			{
				_repeat = value;
			}
		}

		public override ElementType Type => ElementType.Stationery;

		public Stationery(Report report)
			: base(report)
		{
			_repeat = true;
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Process(visitor);
			}
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}

	internal class Item : Element
	{
		private Level _level;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Text _text;

		public Level Level => _level;

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Text Text => _text;

		public override ElementType Type => ElementType.TOCItem;

		public Item(Report report, Level level, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Text text)
			: base(report)
		{
			_level = level;
			_text = text;
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Projection.TOC.ItemArea itemArea = null;
			graphics.Font = _level.Style.Font;
			float num = graphics.FontMetrics.Height + _level.Indents.Top + _level.Indents.Bottom;
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
					if (composition.ResidualHeight < num)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				case MeasureState.Create:
					itemArea = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Projection.TOC.ItemArea(this);
					itemArea.Parent = composition;
					itemArea.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
					itemArea.Top = composition.Scene.Top + composition.ActiveHeight;
					itemArea.Width = composition.Scene.Width;
					itemArea.Height = num;
					itemArea.Paddings = new Paddings(_level.Indents.Left, _level.Indents.Right, _level.Indents.Top, _level.Indents.Bottom);
					itemArea.ResetScene();
					_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
					composition.Content.Add(itemArea);
					composition.ActiveHeight += num;
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}
	}

	internal class TOC : Element, ITOC
	{
		private LevelCollection _levels;

		private ItemCollection _items;

		private int _marker;

		public LevelCollection Levels => _levels;

		public override ElementType Type => ElementType.TOC;

		public TOC(Report report)
			: base(report)
		{
			_levels = new LevelCollection();
			_items = new ItemCollection();
		}

		public Item AddItem(Level level, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Text text)
		{
			Item item = new Item(_report, level, text);
			_items.Add(item);
			return item;
		}

		public ILevel AddLevel()
		{
			Level level = new Level();
			_levels.Add(level);
			return level;
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			Composition composition2 = null;
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
					if (composition.ResidualHeight < 0f)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				case MeasureState.Create:
					composition2 = new Composition();
					composition2.Fake = true;
					composition2.Parent = composition;
					composition2.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
					composition2.Top = composition.Scene.Top + composition.ActiveHeight;
					composition2.Width = composition.Scene.Width;
					composition2.Height = composition.ResidualHeight;
					composition2.ResetScene();
					if (mode == MeasureMode.Normal)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					}
					else
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Flush;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
				{
					bool flag = false;
					int num = _marker;
					int count2 = _items.Count;
					bool flag2 = _freshBreak;
					while (!flag && num < count2)
					{
						Item item2 = _items[num];
						MeasureResult measureResult = item2.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.Normal);
						if (measureResult != MeasureResult.Ok)
						{
							if (flag2 && measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
							{
								item2.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.Flush);
								num++;
								if (num < count2)
								{
									flag = true;
								}
								continue;
							}
							if (_marker == num && measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
							{
								_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
								return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
							}
							if (measureResult == MeasureResult.PageBreak)
							{
								num++;
							}
							flag = true;
						}
						else
						{
							num++;
							flag2 = false;
						}
					}
					if (composition2.Content.Count != 0)
					{
						composition.Content.Add(composition2);
						if (composition2.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							composition2.Height -= composition2.ResidualHeight;
						}
						composition.ActiveHeight += composition2.Height;
					}
					_marker = num;
					if (flag)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.ContentBreak;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Flush:
				{
					int i = _marker;
					for (int count = _items.Count; i < count; i++)
					{
						Item item = _items[i];
						item.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
					}
					composition.Content.Add(composition2);
					if (composition2.ResidualHeight > 0f)
					{
						composition2.Height -= composition2.ResidualHeight;
					}
					composition.ActiveHeight += composition2.Height;
					_marker = i;
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			foreach (Item item in _items)
			{
				item.Process(visitor);
			}
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			foreach (Item item in _items)
			{
				item.Reset();
			}
			_marker = 0;
			base.Reset();
		}
	}

	internal class Node : Element, INode
	{
		private Tree _tree;

		private Caption _caption;

		private float _indent;

		private float _interval;

		private Lines _lines;

		private bool _keepSolid;

		private NodeCollection _nodes;

		private ElementCollection _content;

		private int _marker;

		private object parent;

		public ICaption Caption => _caption;

		public float Indent
		{
			get
			{
				return _indent;
			}
			set
			{
				_indent = value;
			}
		}

		public float Interval
		{
			get
			{
				return _interval;
			}
			set
			{
				_interval = value;
			}

		public bool KeepSolid
		{
			get
			{
				return _keepSolid;
			}
			set
			{
				_keepSolid = value;
			}
		}

		public Lines Lines
		{
			get
			{
				return _lines;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_lines = value;
			}
		}

		public NodeCollection Nodes => _nodes;

		public object Parent => parent;

		public Tree Tree => _tree;

		public override ElementType Type => ElementType.TreeNode;

		public Node(Report report, Tree tree)
			: base(report)
		{
			_tree = tree;
			_caption = new Caption(_report, this);
			_indent = 10f;
			_interval = 5f;
			_lines = new Lines();
			_nodes = new NodeCollection();
		}

		public INode AddNode()
		{
			Node node = new Node(_report, _tree);
			if (_tree.Pattern != null)
			{
				_tree.Pattern.Node.Apply(node);
			}
			_nodes.Add(node);
			node.InitializeParent(this);
			return node;
		}

		public void InitializeParent(object parent)
		{
			if (parent == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("parent");
			}
			this.parent = parent;
		}

		public override Bounds GetBounds(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			float num3 = 0f;
			Bounds bounds = _caption.GetBounds(composition, graphics);
			num = bounds.Min;
			num2 = bounds.Max;
			foreach (Node node in _nodes)
			{
				bounds = node.GetBounds(composition, graphics);
				bounds.Min += _indent;
				bounds.Max += _indent;
				if (num < bounds.Min)
				{
					num = bounds.Min;
				}
				if (num2 < bounds.Max)
				{
					num2 = bounds.Max;
				}
			}
			return new Bounds(num + num3, num2 + num3);
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			NodeComposition nodeComposition = null;
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
					if (composition.ResidualHeight < 0f)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				case MeasureState.Create:
					nodeComposition = new NodeComposition(this);
					nodeComposition.Parent = composition;
					nodeComposition.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
					nodeComposition.Top = composition.Scene.Top + composition.ActiveHeight;
					nodeComposition.Width = composition.Scene.Width;
					nodeComposition.Height = composition.ResidualHeight;
					nodeComposition.ResetScene();
					if (_content == null)
					{
						_content = new ElementCollection();
						_content.Add(_caption);
						foreach (Node node2 in _nodes)
						{
							_content.Add(node2);
						}
					}
					if (_marker > 0)
					{
						float num3 = nodeComposition.Scene.Left + _caption.MarginsResolved.Left;
						float y = nodeComposition.Scene.Top + nodeComposition.ActiveHeight;
						nodeComposition.PointB = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point(num3, y);
						num3 += _indent / 2f;
						nodeComposition.PointA = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point(num3, y);
						nodeComposition.SaveScene();
						nodeComposition.Scene.Left += _indent + _caption.MarginsResolved.Left;
						nodeComposition.Scene.Width -= _indent + _caption.MarginsResolved.Left;
						nodeComposition.DrawLineB = false;
					}
					if (mode == MeasureMode.Normal)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					}
					else
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Flush;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
				{
					bool flag = false;
					int num2 = _marker;
					int count2 = _content.Count;
					if (_keepSolid)
					{
						while (!flag && num2 < count2)
						{
							Element element2 = _content[num2];
							MeasureResult measureResult = element2.Measure(nodeComposition, graphics, MeasureMode.Normal);
							switch (measureResult)
							{
							case MeasureResult.BreakBefore:
							case MeasureResult.ContentBreak:
								if (!_freshBreak)
								{
									for (int i = _marker; i <= num2; i++)
									{
										element2 = _content[i];
										element2.Reset();
									}
									_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
									return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
								}
								if (_marker == num2 && measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
								{
									_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
									return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
								}
								flag = true;
								break;
							case MeasureResult.Ok:
								num2++;
								if (num2 == 1)
								{
									Update(nodeComposition, _lines, _indent);
								}
								if (num2 < count2)
								{
									nodeComposition.ActiveHeight += _interval;
								}
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						bool flag2 = _freshBreak;
						while (!flag && num2 < count2)
						{
							Element element3 = _content[num2];
							MeasureResult measureResult2 = element3.Measure(nodeComposition, graphics, MeasureMode.Normal);
							if (measureResult2 != MeasureResult.Ok)
							{
								if (flag2 && measureResult2 == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
								{
									element3.Measure(nodeComposition, graphics, MeasureMode.Flush);
									num2++;
									if (num2 == 1)
									{
										Update(nodeComposition, _lines, _indent);
									}
									if (num2 < count2)
									{
										nodeComposition.ActiveHeight += _interval;
										flag = true;
									}
								}
								else
								{
									if (_marker == num2 && measureResult2 == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
									{
										_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
										return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
									}
									flag = true;
								}
							}
							else
							{
								num2++;
								if (num2 == 1)
								{
									Update(nodeComposition, _lines, _indent);
								}
								if (num2 < count2)
								{
									nodeComposition.ActiveHeight += _interval;
								}
								flag2 = false;
							}
						}
					}
					if (nodeComposition.Content.Count != 0)
					{
						if (num2 == 0)
						{
							Update(nodeComposition, _lines, _indent);
							nodeComposition.DrawLineA = false;
							nodeComposition.DrawLineC = false;
						}
						else
						{
							if (flag)
							{
								if (num2 == count2 - 1)
								{
									Node node = _nodes[num2 - 1];
									if (((Element)node.Caption).Measured)
									{
										nodeComposition.DrawLineC = false;
									}
								}
							}
							else if (num2 == count2)
							{
								nodeComposition.DrawLineC = false;
							}
							if (_nodes.Count == 0)
							{
								nodeComposition.DrawLineA = false;
								nodeComposition.DrawLineC = false;
							}
						}
						nodeComposition.RestoreScene();
						composition.Content.Add(nodeComposition);
						if (nodeComposition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							nodeComposition.Height -= nodeComposition.ResidualHeight;
						}
						if (_panel == null)
						{
							composition.ActiveHeight += nodeComposition.Height;
						}
					}
					_marker = num2;
					if (flag)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.ContentBreak;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Flush:
				{
					int num = _marker;
					int count = _content.Count;
					while (num < count)
					{
						Element element = _content[num];
						element.Measure(nodeComposition, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
						num++;
						if (num == 1)
						{
							Update(nodeComposition, _lines, _indent);
						}
						if (num < count)
						{
							nodeComposition.ActiveHeight += _interval;
						}
					}
					nodeComposition.DrawLineC = false;
					if (_nodes.Count == 0)
					{
						nodeComposition.DrawLineA = false;
					}
					nodeComposition.RestoreScene();
					composition.Content.Add(nodeComposition);
					if (nodeComposition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
					{
						nodeComposition.Height -= nodeComposition.ResidualHeight;
					}
					if (_panel == null)
					{
						composition.ActiveHeight += nodeComposition.Height;
					}
					_marker = num;
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			_caption.Process(visitor);
			foreach (Node node in _nodes)
			{
				node.Process(visitor);
			}
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			_caption.Reset();
			foreach (Node node in _nodes)
			{
				node.Reset();
			}
			_content = null;
			_marker = 0;
			base.Reset();
		}

		private static void Update(NodeComposition body, Lines lines, float indent)
		{
			if (body.Content.Count > 0)
			{
				Area area = body.Content[body.Content.Count - 1];
				float left = area.Left;
				float y = area.Top + area.Height / 2f;
				body.PointB = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point(left, y);
				left = area.Left + indent / 2f;
				y = area.Top + area.Height;
				body.PointA = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point(left, y);
				body.SaveScene();
				body.Scene.Left += indent + area.MarginsResolved.Left;
				body.Scene.Width -= indent + area.MarginsResolved.Left;
			}
		}
	}

	internal class Tree : DecoratedBlock, ITree
	{
		private Node _root;

		private bool _keepSolid;

		private TreePattern _pattern;

		private object parent;

		public bool KeepSolid
		{
			get
			{
				return _keepSolid;
			}
			set
			{
				_keepSolid = value;
			}
		}

		public object Parent => parent;

		public TreePattern Pattern => _pattern;

		public INode Root => _root;

		public override ElementType Type => ElementType.Tree;

		public Tree(Report report)
			: base(report)
		{
			_root = new Node(_report, this);
			_root.InitializeParent(this);
		}

		public void ApplyPattern(TreePattern pattern)
		{
			_pattern = pattern;
			if (_pattern != null)
			{
				_pattern.Apply(this);
			}
		}

		public void InitializeParent(object parent)
		{
			if (parent == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("parent");
			}
			this.parent = parent;
		}

		public override Bounds GetBounds(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			float num3 = ((_margins != null) ? (_margins.Left + _margins.Right) : 0f);
			switch (_width.Type)
			{
			case WidthType.Fixed:
				num = ((FixedWidth)_width).Value;
				num2 = num;
				break;
			case WidthType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeWidth relativeWidth = (RelativeWidth)_width;
				num2 = composition.Scene.Width - num3;
				num2 *= relativeWidth.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeWidth.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num);
					num2 = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num2);
				}
				break;
			}
			case WidthType.Max:
				num2 = composition.Scene.Width - num3;
				break;
			case WidthType.Auto:
			{
				Bounds bounds = _root.GetBounds(composition, graphics);
				num = bounds.Min;
				num2 = bounds.Max;
				if (_paddings != null)
				{
					num3 += _paddings.Left + _paddings.Right;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasLeft && base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen != null)
				{
					num3 += base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasRight && base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen != null)
				{
					num3 += base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			return new Bounds(num + num3, num2 + num3);
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			Composition composition2 = null;
			float num = 0f;
			switch (_width.Type)
			{
			case WidthType.Fixed:
				num = ((FixedWidth)_width).Value;
				break;
			case WidthType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeWidth relativeWidth = (RelativeWidth)_width;
				num = composition.Scene.Width;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
				num *= relativeWidth.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeWidth.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num);
				}
				break;
			}
			case WidthType.Max:
				num = composition.Scene.Width;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
				break;
			case WidthType.Auto:
				num = GetBounds(composition, graphics).Fit(composition.Scene.Width);
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (num < 0f)
			{
				num = 0f;
			}
			float num2 = 65535f;
			switch (_height.Type)
			{
			case HeightType.Fixed:
				num2 = ((FixedHeight)_height).Value;
				break;
			case HeightType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeHeight relativeHeight = (RelativeHeight)_height;
				num2 = composition.ResidualHeight;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num2 -= _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
				}
				num2 *= relativeHeight.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeHeight.Constraint != null)
				{
					num2 = relativeHeight.Constraint.Apply(num2);
				}
				break;
			}
			case HeightType.Max:
				num2 = composition.ResidualHeight;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num2 -= _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
				}
				break;
			case HeightType.Auto:
				if (mode != MeasureMode.MasterFlush)
				{
					num2 = composition.ResidualHeight;
					if (_margins != null)
					{
						num2 -= _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			if (num2 < 0f)
			{
				num2 = 0f;
			}
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
				{
					float num3 = ((_margins != null) ? (_margins.Top + _margins.Bottom) : 0f);
					if (_height.Type != HeightType.Auto)
					{
						num3 += num2;
					}
					if (composition.ResidualHeight < num3)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Create:
					composition2 = new Composition();
					composition2.Parent = composition;
					composition2.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
					composition2.Top = composition.Scene.Top;
					composition2.Width = num;
					composition2.Height = num2;
					composition2.Borders = base.BordersResolved;
					composition2.Margins = _margins;
					composition2.Paddings = _paddings;
					composition2.Background = _background;
					if (_panel == null)
					{
						if (_margins != null)
						{
							composition2.Left += _margins.Left;
							composition2.Top += composition.ActiveHeight + _margins.Top;
						}
						else
						{
							composition2.Top += composition.ActiveHeight;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						PropertyCollection propertyCollection = _panel.AttachedProperties[this];
						composition2.Left += propertyCollection.GetValue("Left", 0f);
						composition2.Top += propertyCollection.GetValue("Top", 0f);
						composition2.RotationAngle = propertyCollection.GetValue("Angle", 0f);
					}
					composition2.ResetScene();
					if (mode == MeasureMode.Normal && _height.Type == HeightType.Auto)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					}
					else
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Flush;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
				{
					bool flag = false;
					if (_keepSolid)
					{
						MeasureResult measureResult = _root.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.Normal);
						if (measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore || measureResult == MeasureResult.ContentBreak)
						{
							if (!_freshBreak)
							{
								_root.Reset();
								_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
								return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
							}
							if (measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
							{
								_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
								return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
							}
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						MeasureResult measureResult2 = _root.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.Normal);
						if (measureResult2 != MeasureResult.Ok)
						{
							if (_freshBreak && measureResult2 == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
							{
								_root.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.Flush);
							}
							else
							{
								if (measureResult2 == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
								{
									_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
									return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
								}
								flag = true;
							}
						}
					}
					if (composition2.Content.Count != 0)
					{
						composition.Content.Add(composition2);
						if (composition2.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							composition2.Height -= composition2.ResidualHeight;
						}
						if (_panel == null)
						{
							composition.ActiveHeight += composition2.Height;
							if (_margins != null)
							{
								composition.ActiveHeight += _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
							}
						}
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.ContentBreak;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Flush:
					_root.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
					composition.Content.Add(composition2);
					if (_height.Type == HeightType.Auto && composition2.ResidualHeight > 0f)
					{
						composition2.Height -= composition2.ResidualHeight;
					}
					if (_panel == null)
					{
						composition.ActiveHeight += composition2.Height;
						if (_margins != null)
						{
							composition.ActiveHeight += _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
						}
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			_root.Process(visitor);
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			_root.Reset();
			base.Reset();
		}
	}

		public ICondition AddCondition(IContainer container, bool fit)
		{
			if (container == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("container");
			}
			Container container2 = (Container)container;
			Condition condition = new Condition(_report, container2, fit);
			container2.Conditions.Add(condition);

		public override Bounds GetBounds(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			float num3 = MarginsResolved.Left + MarginsResolved.Right;
			switch (_width.Type)
			{
			case WidthType.Fixed:
				num = ((FixedWidth)_width).Value;
				num2 = num;
				break;
			case WidthType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeWidth relativeWidth = (RelativeWidth)_width;
				num2 = composition.Scene.Width - num3;
				num2 *= relativeWidth.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeWidth.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num);
					num2 = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num2);
				}
				break;
			}
			case WidthType.Max:
				num2 = composition.Scene.Width - num3;
				break;
			case WidthType.Auto:
				foreach (Element item in _content)
				{
					Bounds bounds = item.GetBounds(composition, graphics);
					if (num < bounds.Min)
					{
						num = bounds.Min;
					}
					if (num2 < bounds.Max)
					{
						num2 = bounds.Max;
					}
				}
				if (_paddings != null)
				{
					num3 += _paddings.Left + _paddings.Right;
				}
				if (BordersResolved.HasLeft && BordersResolved.Left.Pen != null)
				{
					num3 += BordersResolved.Left.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				if (BordersResolved.HasRight && BordersResolved.Right.Pen != null)
				{
					num3 += BordersResolved.Right.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				break;
			}
			return new Bounds(num + num3, num2 + num3);
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			Composition composition2 = null;
			float num = 0f;
			switch (_height.Type)
			{
			case HeightType.Fixed:
				num = ((FixedHeight)_height).Value;
				break;
			case HeightType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeHeight relativeHeight = (RelativeHeight)_height;
				num = composition.Scene.Height * relativeHeight.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeHeight.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeHeight.Constraint.Apply(num);
				}
				break;
			}
			case HeightType.Max:
			case HeightType.Auto:
				num = composition.Scene.Height;
				break;
			}
			if (num < 0f)
			{
				num = 0f;
			}
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
				{
					float num2 = 0f;
					if (_height.Type != HeightType.Auto)
					{
						num2 += num;
					}
					if (composition.Scene.Height < num2)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Create:
					composition2 = new Composition();
					composition2.Parent = composition;
					composition2.Left = composition.Scene.Left + MarginsResolved.Left;
					composition2.Top = composition.Scene.Top;
					composition2.Width = _activeWidth;
					composition2.Height = num;
					composition2.Borders = BordersResolved;
					if (MarginsResolved.Left > 0f || MarginsResolved.Right > 0f)
					{
						composition2.Margins = new Margins(MarginsResolved.Left, MarginsResolved.Right, 0f, 0f);
					}
					composition2.Paddings = _paddings;
					composition2.Background = _background;
					composition2.ResetScene();
					if (mode == MeasureMode.Normal && _height.Type == HeightType.Auto)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					}
					else
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Flush;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
				{
					bool flag = false;
					int num3 = _marker;
					int count2 = _content.Count;
					bool flag2 = _freshBreak;
					while (!flag && num3 < count2)
					{
						Element element2 = _content[num3];
						MeasureResult measureResult = element2.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.Normal);
						if (measureResult != MeasureResult.Ok)
						{
							if (flag2 && measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
							{
								element2.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.Flush);
								num3++;
								if (num3 < count2)
								{
									flag = true;
								}
								continue;
							}
							if (_marker == num3 && measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
							{
								_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
								return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
							}
							if (measureResult == MeasureResult.PageBreak)
							{
								num3++;
							}
							flag = true;
						}
						else
						{
							num3++;
							flag2 = false;
						}
					}
					composition.Content.Add(composition2);
					if (composition2.ResidualHeight > 0f)
					{
						composition2.Height -= composition2.ResidualHeight;
					}
					if (composition2.Content.Count == 0)
					{
						composition2.Empty = true;
					}
					_marker = num3;
					if (flag)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.ContentBreak;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Flush:
				{
					int i = _marker;
					for (int count = _content.Count; i < count; i++)
					{
						Element element = _content[i];
						element.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
					}
					composition.Content.Add(composition2);
					if (_height.Type == HeightType.Auto && composition2.ResidualHeight > 0f)
					{
						composition2.Height -= composition2.ResidualHeight;
					}
					if (composition2.Content.Count == 0)
					{
						composition2.Empty = true;
					}
					_marker = i;
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Process(visitor);
			}
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Reset();
			}
			_activeWidth = 0f;
			_marker = 0;
			base.Reset();
		}
	}

	public class TableCellPattern
	{
		private ContentAlignment _alignment;

		private Borders _borders;

		private HorizontalMargins _margins;

		private Paddings _paddings;

		private Background _background;

		public ContentAlignment Alignment
		{
			get
			{
				return _alignment;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_alignment = value;
			}
		}

		public Background Background
		{
			get
			{
				if (_background == null)
				{
					_background = new Background();
				}
				return _background;
			}
			set
			{
				_background = value;
			}
		}

		public Borders Borders
		{
			get
			{
				return _borders;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_borders = value;
			}
		}

		public Paddings Paddings
		{
			get
			{
				if (_paddings == null)
				{
					_paddings = new Paddings();
				}
				return _paddings;
			}
			set
			{
				_paddings = value;
			}
		}

		public HorizontalMargins Margins
		{
			get
			{
				return _margins;
			}
			set
			{
				_margins = value;
			}
		}

		public TableCellPattern()
		{
			_alignment = new ContentAlignment();
			_borders = new Borders();
			_margins = new HorizontalMargins();
		}

		public void Apply(ITableCell cell)
		{
			if (cell == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("cell");
			}
			cell.Alignment = _alignment;
			cell.Borders = _borders;
			cell.Margins = _margins;
			cell.Paddings = _paddings;
			cell.Background = _background;
		}
	}

	public class TableHeaderPattern
	{
		private bool _repeat;

		private VerticalMargins _margins;

		private TableCellPattern _cell;

		public TableCellPattern Cell => _cell;

		public bool Repeat
		{
			get
			{
				return _repeat;
			}
			set
			{
				_repeat = value;
			}
		}

		public VerticalMargins Margins
		{
			get
			{
				return _margins;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_margins = value;
			}
		}

		public TableHeaderPattern()
		{
			_margins = new VerticalMargins();
			_cell = new TableCellPattern();
		}

		public void Apply(ITableHeader header)
		{
			if (header == null)
