		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			switch (_height.Type)
			{
			case HeightType.Fixed:
				num = ((FixedHeight)_height).Value;
				break;
			case HeightType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeHeight relativeHeight = (RelativeHeight)_height;
				num = composition.ResidualHeight - MarginsResolved.Top - MarginsResolved.Bottom;
				num *= relativeHeight.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeHeight.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeHeight.Constraint.Apply(num);
				}
				break;
			}
			case HeightType.Max:
				num = composition.ResidualHeight - MarginsResolved.Top - MarginsResolved.Bottom;
				break;
			}
			if (num < 0f)
			{
				num = 0f;
			}
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
				{
					float num3 = MarginsResolved.Top + MarginsResolved.Bottom;
					if (_height.Type != HeightType.Auto)
					{
						num3 += num;
					}
					if (composition.ResidualHeight < num3)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Create:
					composition.SaveScene();
					composition.Scene.Top += composition.ActiveHeight + MarginsResolved.Top;
					composition.Scene.Height = composition.ResidualHeight - MarginsResolved.Top - MarginsResolved.Bottom;
					_fw = 0f;
					_sw = 0f;
					foreach (TableCell cell in _cells)
					{
						switch (cell.Width.Type)
						{
						case WidthType.Fixed:
							_fw += cell.GetBounds(composition, graphics).Max;
							break;
						case WidthType.Relative:
						case WidthType.Max:
						case WidthType.Auto:
							_sw += cell.GetBounds(composition, graphics).Max;
							break;
						}
					}
					_dw = composition.Scene.Width - _fw;
					if (_dw < 0f)
					{
						_dw = 0f;
					}
					if (mode == MeasureMode.Normal && _height.Type == HeightType.Auto)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					}
					else
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Flush;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
				{
					int count5 = composition.Content.Count;
					bool flag3 = false;
					bool flag4 = false;
					float num4 = 0f;
					bool flag5 = true;
					int num5 = 0;
					int count6 = _cells.Count;
					while (!flag3 && num5 < count6)
					{
						TableCell tableCell3 = _cells[num5];
						if (!tableCell3.Measured)
						{
							switch (tableCell3.Width.Type)
							{
							case WidthType.Fixed:
								tableCell3.ActiveWidth = ((FixedWidth)tableCell3.Width).Value;
								break;
							case WidthType.Relative:
							case WidthType.Max:
							case WidthType.Auto:
								if (_sw > 0f)
								{
									tableCell3.ActiveWidth = tableCell3.GetBounds(composition, graphics).Max * _dw / _sw - tableCell3.MarginsResolved.Left - tableCell3.MarginsResolved.Right;
								}
								break;
							}
							switch (tableCell3.Measure(composition, graphics, MeasureMode.Normal))
							{
							case MeasureResult.BreakBefore:
								flag3 = true;
								break;
							case MeasureResult.ContentBreak:
								flag4 = true;
								break;
							}
							if (!flag3)
							{
								Area area4 = composition.Content[composition.Content.Count - 1];
								if (!area4.Empty)
								{
									float height2 = area4.Height;
									if (num4 < height2)
									{
										num4 = height2;
									}
									flag5 = false;
								}
							}
						}
						else
						{
							Area area5 = new Area();
							area5.Left = composition.Scene.Left + tableCell3.MarginsResolved.Left;
							area5.Top = composition.Scene.Top;
							area5.Width = tableCell3.ActiveWidth;
							area5.Borders = tableCell3.BordersResolved;
							if (tableCell3.MarginsResolved.Left > 0f || tableCell3.MarginsResolved.Right > 0f)
							{
								area5.Margins = new Margins(tableCell3.MarginsResolved.Left, tableCell3.MarginsResolved.Right, 0f, 0f);
							}
							area5.Paddings = tableCell3.Paddings;
							area5.Background = tableCell3.Background;
							composition.Content.Add(area5);
							area5.Parent = composition;
						}
						composition.Scene.Left += tableCell3.ActiveWidth + tableCell3.MarginsResolved.Left + tableCell3.MarginsResolved.Right;
						num5++;
					}
					if (!_freshBreak && _keepSolid && flag4)
					{
						flag3 = true;
					}
					if (flag3)
					{
						Reset();
						composition.Content.RemoveRange(count5, composition.Content.Count - count5);
						composition.RestoreScene();
						if (!_freshBreak)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
							return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
						}
						_state = MeasureState.Flush;
						break;
					}
					if (flag5)
					{
						composition.Content.RemoveRange(count5, composition.Content.Count - count5);
					}
					else
					{
						num5 = count5;
						for (count6 = composition.Content.Count; num5 < count6; num5++)
						{
							TableCell tableCell4 = _cells[num5 - count5];
							Area area6 = composition.Content[num5];
							area6.Height = num4;
							if (area6 is Composition)
							{
								area6.ResetScene();
								Composition composition2 = (Composition)area6;
								Composition.AlignHorizontal(composition2, tableCell4.AlignmentResolved, Layout.Vertical);
								Composition.AlignVertical(composition2, tableCell4.AlignmentResolved, Layout.Vertical);
							}
						}
						composition.ActiveHeight += num4 + MarginsResolved.Top + MarginsResolved.Bottom;
					}
					_activeHeight = num4;
					composition.RestoreScene();
					if (flag4)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.ContentBreak;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Flush:
				{
					int count = composition.Content.Count;
					float num2 = 0f;
					bool flag = true;
					int i = 0;
					for (int count2 = _cells.Count; i < count2; i++)
					{
						TableCell tableCell = _cells[i];
						bool flag2 = true;
						if (!tableCell.Measured)
						{
							switch (tableCell.Width.Type)
							{
							case WidthType.Fixed:
								tableCell.ActiveWidth = ((FixedWidth)tableCell.Width).Value;
								break;
							case WidthType.Relative:
							case WidthType.Max:
							case WidthType.Auto:
								if (_sw > 0f)
								{
									tableCell.ActiveWidth = tableCell.GetBounds(composition, graphics).Max * _dw / _sw - tableCell.MarginsResolved.Left - tableCell.MarginsResolved.Right;
								}
								break;
							}
							int count3 = composition.Content.Count;
							tableCell.Measure(composition, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
							int count4 = composition.Content.Count;
							if (count3 < count4)
							{
								Area area = composition.Content[composition.Content.Count - 1];
								if (!area.Empty)
								{
									float height = area.Height;
									if (num2 < height)
									{
										num2 = height;
									}
									flag = false;
								}
								flag2 = false;
							}
						}
						if (flag2)
						{
							Area area2 = new Area();
							area2.Left = composition.Scene.Left + tableCell.MarginsResolved.Left;
							area2.Top = composition.Scene.Top;
							area2.Width = tableCell.ActiveWidth;
							area2.Borders = tableCell.BordersResolved;
							if (tableCell.MarginsResolved.Left > 0f || tableCell.MarginsResolved.Right > 0f)
							{
								area2.Margins = new Margins(tableCell.MarginsResolved.Left, tableCell.MarginsResolved.Right, 0f, 0f);
							}
							area2.Paddings = tableCell.Paddings;
							area2.Background = tableCell.Background;
							composition.Content.Add(area2);
							area2.Parent = composition;
						}
						composition.Scene.Left += tableCell.ActiveWidth + tableCell.MarginsResolved.Left + tableCell.MarginsResolved.Right;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						composition.Content.RemoveRange(count, composition.Content.Count - count);
					}
					else
					{
						if (_height.Type != HeightType.Auto)
						{
							num2 = num;
						}
						i = count;
						for (int count2 = composition.Content.Count; i < count2; i++)
						{
							TableCell tableCell2 = _cells[i - count];
							Area area3 = composition.Content[i];
							area3.Height = num2;
							if (area3 is Composition)
							{
								area3.ResetScene();
								Composition.AlignHorizontal((Composition)area3, tableCell2.AlignmentResolved, Layout.Vertical);
								Composition.AlignVertical((Composition)area3, tableCell2.AlignmentResolved, Layout.Vertical);
							}
						}
						composition.ActiveHeight += num2 + MarginsResolved.Top + MarginsResolved.Bottom;
					}
					_activeHeight = num2;
					composition.RestoreScene();
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			foreach (TableCell cell in _cells)
			{
				cell.Process(visitor);
			}
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			foreach (TableCell cell in _cells)
			{
				cell.Reset();
			}
			_activeHeight = 0f;
			base.Reset();
		}
	}

		public override Bounds GetBounds(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			float num3 = ((_margins != null) ? (_margins.Left + _margins.Right) : 0f);
			switch (_width.Type)
			{
			case WidthType.Fixed:
				num = ((FixedWidth)_width).Value;
				num2 = num;
				break;
			case WidthType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeWidth relativeWidth = (RelativeWidth)_width;
				num2 = composition.Scene.Width - num3;
				num2 *= relativeWidth.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeWidth.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num);
					num2 = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num2);
				}
				break;
			}
			case WidthType.Max:
				num2 = composition.Scene.Width - num3;
				break;
			case WidthType.Auto:
			{
				Bounds bounds = null;
				if (HasHeader && _header.Cells.Count > 0)
				{
					bounds = _header.GetBounds(composition, graphics);
					num = bounds.Min;
					num2 = bounds.Max;
				}
				if (HasFooter && _footer.Cells.Count > 0)
				{
					bounds = _footer.GetBounds(composition, graphics);
					if (num < bounds.Min)
					{
						num = bounds.Min;
					}
					if (num2 < bounds.Max)
					{
						num2 = bounds.Max;
					}
				}
				if (HasDivider && _divider.Cells.Count > 0)
				{
					bounds = _divider.GetBounds(composition, graphics);
					if (num < bounds.Min)
					{
						num = bounds.Min;
					}
					if (num2 < bounds.Max)
					{
						num2 = bounds.Max;
					}
				}
				foreach (TableRow row in _rows)
				{
					bounds = row.GetBounds(composition, graphics);
					if (num < bounds.Min)
					{
						num = bounds.Min;
					}
					if (num2 < bounds.Max)
					{
						num2 = bounds.Max;
					}
				}
				if (_paddings != null)
				{
					num3 += _paddings.Left + _paddings.Right;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasLeft && base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen != null)
				{
					num3 += base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasRight && base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen != null)
				{
					num3 += base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			return new Bounds(num + num3, num2 + num3);
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			Composition composition2 = null;
			Composition composition3 = null;
			Composition composition4 = null;
			Composition composition5 = null;
			Composition composition6 = null;
			float num = 0f;
			switch (_width.Type)
			{
			case WidthType.Fixed:
				num = ((FixedWidth)_width).Value;
				break;
			case WidthType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeWidth relativeWidth = (RelativeWidth)_width;
				num = composition.Scene.Width;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
				num *= relativeWidth.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeWidth.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num);
				}
				break;
			}
			case WidthType.Max:
				num = composition.Scene.Width;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
				break;
			case WidthType.Auto:
				num = GetBounds(composition, graphics).Fit(composition.Scene.Width);
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (num < 0f)
			{
				num = 0f;
			}
			float num2 = 65535f;
			switch (_height.Type)
			{
			case HeightType.Fixed:
				num2 = ((FixedHeight)_height).Value;
				break;
			case HeightType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeHeight relativeHeight = (RelativeHeight)_height;
				num2 = composition.ResidualHeight;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num2 -= _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
				}
				num2 *= relativeHeight.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeHeight.Constraint != null)
				{
					num2 = relativeHeight.Constraint.Apply(num2);
				}
				break;
			}
			case HeightType.Max:
				num2 = composition.ResidualHeight;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num2 -= _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
				}
				break;
			case HeightType.Auto:
				if (mode != MeasureMode.MasterFlush)
				{
					num2 = composition.ResidualHeight;
					if (_margins != null)
					{
						num2 -= _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			if (num2 < 0f)
			{
				num2 = 0f;
			}
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
				{
					float num3 = ((_margins != null) ? (_margins.Top + _margins.Bottom) : 0f);
					if (_height.Type != HeightType.Auto)
					{
						num3 += num2;
					}
					if (composition.ResidualHeight < num3)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Create:
					composition2 = new Composition();
					composition2.Parent = composition;
					composition2.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
					composition2.Top = composition.Scene.Top;
					composition2.Width = num;
					composition2.Height = num2;
					composition2.Borders = base.BordersResolved;
					composition2.Margins = _margins;
					composition2.Paddings = _paddings;
					composition2.Background = _background;
					if (_panel == null)
					{
						if (_margins != null)
						{
							composition2.Left += _margins.Left;
							composition2.Top += composition.ActiveHeight + _margins.Top;
						}
						else
						{
							composition2.Top += composition.ActiveHeight;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						PropertyCollection propertyCollection = _panel.AttachedProperties[this];
						composition2.Left += propertyCollection.GetValue("Left", 0f);
						composition2.Top += propertyCollection.GetValue("Top", 0f);
						composition2.RotationAngle = propertyCollection.GetValue("Angle", 0f);
					}
					composition2.ResetScene();
					composition3 = new Composition();
					composition3.Parent = composition2;
					composition3.Left = composition2.Scene.Left;
					composition3.Top = composition2.Scene.Top;
					composition3.Width = composition2.Scene.Width;
					composition3.Height = composition2.Scene.Height;
					if (mode == MeasureMode.Normal && _height.Type == HeightType.Auto)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					}
					else
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Flush;
					}
					if (HasHeader && _header.Cells.Count > 0 && (_header.Repeat || _bodyCounter == 0))
					{
						composition4 = new Composition();
						composition4.Parent = composition2;
						composition4.Fake = true;
						composition4.Left = composition2.Scene.Left;
						composition4.Top = composition2.Scene.Top;
						composition4.Width = composition2.Scene.Width;
						composition4.Height = composition2.Scene.Height;
						composition4.ResetScene();
						_header.Reset();
						_header.Measure(composition4, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
						composition4.Height = _header.ActiveHeight + _header.MarginsResolved.Top + _header.MarginsResolved.Bottom;
						composition3.Height -= composition4.Height;
					}
					if (HasFooter && _footer.Cells.Count > 0 && (_footer.Repeat || _state == MeasureState.Flush))
					{
						composition5 = new Composition();
						composition5.Parent = composition2;
						composition5.Fake = true;
						composition5.Left = composition2.Scene.Left;
						composition5.Top = composition2.Scene.Top;
						composition5.Width = composition2.Scene.Width;
						composition5.Height = composition2.Scene.Height;
						composition5.ResetScene();
						_footer.Reset();
						_footer.Measure(composition5, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
						composition5.Height = _footer.ActiveHeight + _footer.MarginsResolved.Top + _footer.MarginsResolved.Bottom;
						composition3.Height -= composition5.Height;
					}
					if (HasDivider && _divider.Cells.Count > 0 && _state == MeasureState.Layout)
					{
						composition6 = new Composition();
						composition6.Parent = composition2;
						composition6.Fake = true;
						composition6.Left = composition2.Scene.Left;
						composition6.Top = composition2.Scene.Top;
						composition6.Width = composition2.Scene.Width;
						composition6.Height = composition2.Scene.Height;
						composition6.ResetScene();
						_divider.Reset();
						_divider.Measure(composition6, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
						composition6.Height = _divider.ActiveHeight + _divider.MarginsResolved.Top + _divider.MarginsResolved.Bottom;
						composition3.Height -= composition6.Height;
					}
					composition3.ResetScene();
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
				{
					bool flag = false;
					TableRow tableRow2 = null;
					int num4 = _marker;
					int count2 = _rows.Count;
					if (_keepSolid)
					{
						while (!flag && num4 < count2)
						{
							TableRow tableRow3 = _rows[num4];
							if (num4 == count2 - 1 && HasFooter && _footer.Cells.Count > 0 && !_footer.Repeat)
							{
								composition5 = new Composition();
								composition5.Parent = composition2;
								composition5.Fake = true;
								composition5.Left = composition2.Scene.Left;
								composition5.Top = composition2.Scene.Top;
								composition5.Width = composition2.Scene.Width;
								composition5.Height = composition2.Scene.Height;
								composition5.ResetScene();
								_footer.Reset();
								_footer.Measure(composition5, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
								composition5.Height = _footer.ActiveHeight + _footer.MarginsResolved.Top + _footer.MarginsResolved.Bottom;
								composition3.Height -= composition5.Height;
								composition3.Scene.Height -= composition5.Height;
								if (composition3.Height < 0f)
								{
									composition3.Height = 0f;
								}
								if (composition3.Scene.Height < 0f)
								{
									composition3.Scene.Height = 0f;
								}
							}
							MeasureResult measureResult = tableRow3.Measure(composition3, graphics, MeasureMode.Normal);
							if (measureResult != MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
							{
								tableRow2 = tableRow3;
							}
							switch (measureResult)
							{
							case MeasureResult.BreakBefore:
							case MeasureResult.ContentBreak:
								if (!_freshBreak)
								{
									for (int j = _marker; j <= num4; j++)
									{
										tableRow3 = _rows[j];
										tableRow3.Reset();
									}
									_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
									return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
								}
								if (_marker == num4 && measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
								{
									_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
									return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
								}
								flag = true;
								break;
							case MeasureResult.Ok:
								num4++;
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						bool flag2 = _freshBreak;
						int num5 = -1;
						while (!flag && num4 < count2)
						{
							TableRow tableRow4 = _rows[num4];
							if (num4 == count2 - 1 && HasFooter && _footer.Cells.Count > 0 && !_footer.Repeat)
							{
								composition5 = new Composition();
								composition5.Parent = composition2;
								composition5.Fake = true;
								composition5.Left = composition2.Scene.Left;
								composition5.Top = composition2.Scene.Top;
								composition5.Width = composition2.Scene.Width;
								composition5.Height = composition2.Scene.Height;
								composition5.ResetScene();
								_footer.Reset();
								_footer.Measure(composition5, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
								composition5.Height = _footer.ActiveHeight + _footer.MarginsResolved.Top + _footer.MarginsResolved.Bottom;
								composition3.Height -= composition5.Height;
								composition3.Scene.Height -= composition5.Height;
								if (composition3.Height < 0f)
								{
									composition3.Height = 0f;
								}
								if (composition3.Scene.Height < 0f)
								{
									composition3.Scene.Height = 0f;
								}
							}
							if (!flag2 && tableRow4.KeepWithNext && num5 == -1)
							{
								num5 = num4;
								composition3.Mark();
							}
							MeasureResult measureResult2 = tableRow4.Measure(composition3, graphics, MeasureMode.Normal);
							if (measureResult2 != MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
							{
								tableRow2 = tableRow4;
							}
							if (measureResult2 != MeasureResult.Ok)
							{
								if (flag2 && measureResult2 == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
								{
									tableRow4.Measure(composition3, graphics, MeasureMode.Flush);
									num5 = -1;
									num4++;
									if (num4 < count2)
									{
										flag = true;
									}
								}
								else
								{
									if (_marker == num4 && measureResult2 == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
									{
										_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
										return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
									}
									if (measureResult2 == MeasureResult.BreakBefore || measureResult2 == MeasureResult.ContentBreak)
									{
										if (num5 >= 0 && (tableRow4.KeepWithNext || measureResult2 == MeasureResult.BreakBefore))
										{
											composition3.Rollback();
											for (int k = num5; k <= num4; k++)
											{
												tableRow4 = _rows[k];
												tableRow4.Reset();
											}
											num4 = num5;
											num5 = -1;
											tableRow2 = ((num4 <= 0) ? null : _rows[num4 - 1]);
										}
									}
									else
									{
										num5 = -1;
									}
									flag = true;
								}
							}
							else
							{
								num4++;
								flag2 = false;
							}
							if (!tableRow4.KeepWithNext)
							{
								num5 = -1;
							}
						}
					}
					if (composition3.Content.Count != 0)
					{
						composition.Content.Add(composition2);
						_bodyCounter++;
						if (composition4 != null)
						{
							composition2.Content.Add(composition4);
							composition4.Parent = composition2;
							composition4.Top = composition2.Scene.Top + composition2.ActiveHeight;
							composition2.ActiveHeight += composition4.Height;
						}
						composition2.Content.Add(composition3);
						composition3.Parent = composition2;
						if (!_stretch)
						{
							if (composition3.ResidualHeight > 0f)
							{
								composition3.Height -= composition3.ResidualHeight;
							}
						}
						else if (tableRow2 != null)
						{
							if (composition6 != null && !flag)
							{
								composition3.Height += composition6.Height;
								composition3.Scene.Height += composition6.Height;
							}
							tableRow2.Stretch(composition3);
						}
						composition3.Top = composition2.Scene.Top + composition2.ActiveHeight;
						composition2.ActiveHeight += composition3.Height;
						composition3.ResetScene();
						if (HasDivider && _divider.Inner && composition6 != null && flag)
						{
							composition2.Content.Add(composition6);
							composition6.Parent = composition2;
							composition6.Top = composition2.Scene.Top + composition2.ActiveHeight;
							composition2.ActiveHeight += composition6.Height;
						}
						if (composition5 != null && ((HasFooter && _footer.Repeat) || !flag))
						{
							composition2.Content.Add(composition5);
							composition5.Parent = composition2;
							composition5.Top = composition2.Scene.Top + composition2.ActiveHeight;
							composition2.ActiveHeight += composition5.Height;
						}
						if ((!HasDivider || !_divider.Inner) && composition6 != null && flag)
						{
							composition2.Content.Add(composition6);
							composition6.Parent = composition2;
							composition6.Top = composition2.Scene.Top + composition2.ActiveHeight;
							composition2.ActiveHeight += composition6.Height;
						}
						if (composition2.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							composition2.Height -= composition2.ResidualHeight;
						}
						if (_panel == null)
						{
							composition.ActiveHeight += composition2.Height;
							if (_margins != null)
							{
								composition.ActiveHeight += _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
							}
						}
					}
					_marker = num4;
					if (flag)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.ContentBreak;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Flush:
				{
					int i = _marker;
					for (int count = _rows.Count; i < count; i++)
					{
						TableRow tableRow = _rows[i];
						tableRow.Measure(composition3, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
					}
					composition.Content.Add(composition2);
					_bodyCounter++;
					if (composition4 != null)
					{
						composition2.Content.Add(composition4);
						composition4.Parent = composition2;
						composition4.Top = composition2.Scene.Top + composition2.ActiveHeight;
						composition2.ActiveHeight += composition4.Height;
					}
					if (_height.Type == HeightType.Auto)
					{
						if (composition3.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							composition3.Height -= composition3.ResidualHeight;
						}
					}
					else if (composition5 != null)
					{
						composition3.Height = composition2.ResidualHeight - composition5.Height;
					}
					else
					{
						composition3.Height = composition2.ResidualHeight;
					}
					if (composition3.Height > 0f)
					{
						composition2.Content.Add(composition3);
						composition3.Parent = composition2;
						composition3.Top = composition2.Scene.Top + composition2.ActiveHeight;
						composition2.ActiveHeight += composition3.Height;
						composition3.ResetScene();
					}
					if (composition5 != null)
					{
						composition2.Content.Add(composition5);
						composition5.Parent = composition2;
						composition5.Top = composition2.Scene.Top + composition2.ActiveHeight;
						composition2.ActiveHeight += composition5.Height;
					}
					if (_height.Type == HeightType.Auto && composition2.ResidualHeight > 0f)
					{
						composition2.Height -= composition2.ResidualHeight;
					}
					if (_panel == null)
					{
						composition.ActiveHeight += composition2.Height;
						if (_margins != null)
						{
							composition.ActiveHeight += _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
						}
					}
					_marker = i;
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			if (HasHeader)
			{
				_header.Process(visitor);
			}
			if (HasFooter)
			{
				_footer.Process(visitor);
			}
			if (HasDivider)
			{
				_divider.Process(visitor);
			}
			foreach (TableRow row in _rows)
			{
				row.Process(visitor);
			}
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			foreach (TableRow row in _rows)
			{
				row.Reset();
			}
			_bodyCounter = 0;
			_marker = 0;
			base.Reset();
		}
	}

		{

			float y = _y + _height / 2f;
			return new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point(x, y);
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			ArcArea arcArea = null;
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				case MeasureState.Create:
					arcArea = new ArcArea(this);
					arcArea.Parent = composition;
					arcArea.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
					arcArea.Top = composition.Scene.Top;
					arcArea.Width = composition.Scene.Width;
					arcArea.Height = composition.Scene.Height;
					arcArea.ResetScene();
					_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
					composition.Content.Add(arcArea);
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			LabelArea labelArea = null;
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{

			_bulletsBlackCircle = new Bullets(BulletType.BlackCircle);
			_bulletsWhiteCircle = new Bullets(BulletType.WhiteCircle);
			_bulletsBlackSquare = new Bullets(BulletType.BlackSquare);
			_bulletsWhiteSquare = new Bullets(BulletType.WhiteSquare);
			_bulletsAsterisk = new Bullets(BulletType.Asterisk);
			_bulletsDecimal = new Bullets(BulletType.Decimal);
			_bulletsSmallLetters = new Bullets(BulletType.SmallLetters);
			_bulletsBigLetters = new Bullets(BulletType.BigLetters);
			_bulletsSmallRoman = new Bullets(BulletType.SmallRoman);
			_bulletsBigRoman = new Bullets(BulletType.BigRoman);
			_bullets.Add("BlackCircle", _bulletsBlackCircle);
			_bullets.Add("WhiteCircle", _bulletsWhiteCircle);
			_bullets.Add("BlackSquare", _bulletsBlackSquare);
			_bullets.Add("WhiteSquare", _bulletsWhiteSquare);
			_bullets.Add("Asterisk", _bulletsAsterisk);
			_bullets.Add("Decimal", _bulletsDecimal);
			_bullets.Add("SmallLetters", _bulletsSmallLetters);
			_bullets.Add("BigLetters", _bulletsBigLetters);
			_bullets.Add("SmallRoman", _bulletsSmallRoman);
			_bullets.Add("BigRoman", _bulletsBigRoman);
		}

		public Bullets(BulletType type, float indent, Style style)
		{
			if (style == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("style");
			}
			_type = type;
			if (_type == BulletType.Decimal)
			{
				_template = "{0}.";
			}
			else
			{
				_template = "{0})";
			}
			_indent = indent;
			_style = style;
		}

		public static Bullets GetBullets(string name)
		{
			if (name == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (_bullets.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				return _bullets[name];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override Bounds GetBounds(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				Bounds bounds = item.GetBounds(composition, graphics);
				if (num < bounds.Min)
				{
					num = bounds.Min;
				}
				if (num2 < bounds.Max)
				{
					num2 = bounds.Max;
				}
			}
			return new Bounds(num, num2);
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			ItemComposition itemComposition = null;
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
					if (composition.ResidualHeight < 0f)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				case MeasureState.Create:
					itemComposition = new ItemComposition(this);
					itemComposition.Parent = composition;
					itemComposition.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
					itemComposition.Top = composition.Scene.Top + composition.ActiveHeight;
					itemComposition.Width = composition.Scene.Width;
					itemComposition.Height = composition.ResidualHeight;
					itemComposition.ResetScene();
					if (mode == MeasureMode.Normal)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					}
					else
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Flush;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
				{
					bool flag = false;
					int num = _marker;
					int count2 = _content.Count;
					if (_keepSolid)
					{
						while (!flag && num < count2)
						{
							Element element2 = _content[num];
							MeasureResult measureResult = element2.Measure(itemComposition, graphics, MeasureMode.Normal);
							switch (measureResult)
							{
							case MeasureResult.BreakBefore:
							case MeasureResult.ContentBreak:
								if (!_freshBreak)
								{
									for (int j = _marker; j <= num; j++)
									{
										element2 = _content[j];
										element2.Reset();
									}
									_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
									return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
								}
								if (_marker == num && measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
								{
									_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
									return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
								}
								flag = true;
								break;
							case MeasureResult.Ok:
							case MeasureResult.PageBreak:
								num++;
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						bool flag2 = _freshBreak;
						while (!flag && num < count2)
						{
							Element element3 = _content[num];
							MeasureResult measureResult2 = element3.Measure(itemComposition, graphics, MeasureMode.Normal);
							if (measureResult2 != MeasureResult.Ok)
							{
								if (flag2 && measureResult2 == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
								{
									element3.Measure(itemComposition, graphics, MeasureMode.Flush);
									num++;
									if (num < count2)
									{
										flag = true;
									}
									continue;
								}
								if (_marker == num && measureResult2 == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
								{
									_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
									return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
								}
								if (measureResult2 == MeasureResult.PageBreak)
								{
									num++;
								}
								flag = true;
							}
							else
							{
								num++;
								flag2 = false;
							}
						}
					}
					if (itemComposition.Content.Count != 0)
					{
						composition.Content.Add(itemComposition);
						if (_showBullet && !itemComposition.Empty)
						{
							itemComposition.ShowBullet = true;
							_showBullet = false;
						}
						if (itemComposition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							itemComposition.Height -= itemComposition.ResidualHeight;
						}
						composition.ActiveHeight += itemComposition.Height;
					}
					_marker = num;
					if (flag)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.ContentBreak;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Flush:
				{
					int i = _marker;
					for (int count = _content.Count; i < count; i++)
					{
						Element element = _content[i];
						element.Measure(itemComposition, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
					}
					composition.Content.Add(itemComposition);
					if (_showBullet && !itemComposition.Empty)
					{
						itemComposition.ShowBullet = true;
						_showBullet = false;
					}
					if (itemComposition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
					{
						itemComposition.Height -= itemComposition.ResidualHeight;
					}
					composition.ActiveHeight += itemComposition.Height;
					_marker = i;
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Process(visitor);
			}
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Reset();
			}
			_showBullet = true;
			_marker = 0;
			base.Reset();
		}
	}

	internal class List : DecoratedBlock, IList
	{
		private Bullets _bullets;

		private int _startNumber;

		private float _interval;

		private ItemCollection _items;

		private bool _keepSolid;

		private ListPattern _pattern;

		private int _marker;

		private object parent;

		public Bullets Bullets
		{
			get
			{
				return _bullets;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_bullets = value;
			}
		}

		public float Interval
		{
			get
			{
				return _interval;
			}
			set
			{
				_interval = value;
			}
		}

		public bool KeepSolid
		{
			get
			{
				return _keepSolid;
			}
			set
			{
				_keepSolid = value;
			}
		}

		public object Parent => parent;

		public ListPattern Pattern => _pattern;

		public int StartNumber
		{
			get
			{
				return _startNumber;
			}
			set
			{
				_startNumber = value;
			}
		}

		public override ElementType Type => ElementType.List;

		public List(Report report)
			: base(report)
		{
			_bullets = new Bullets();
			_startNumber = 1;
			_interval = 5f;
			_items = new ItemCollection();
		}

		public IListItem AddItem()
		{
			ListItem listItem = new ListItem(_report, this);
			_items.Add(listItem);
			return listItem;
		}

		public void ApplyPattern(ListPattern pattern)
		{
			_pattern = pattern;
			if (_pattern != null)
			{
				_pattern.Apply(this);
			}
		}

		public void InitializeParent(object parent)
		{
			if (parent == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("parent");
			}
			this.parent = parent;
		}

		public override Bounds GetBounds(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			float num3 = ((_margins != null) ? (_margins.Left + _margins.Right) : 0f);
			switch (_width.Type)
			{
			case WidthType.Fixed:
				num = ((FixedWidth)_width).Value;
				num2 = num;
				break;
			case WidthType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeWidth relativeWidth = (RelativeWidth)_width;
				num2 = composition.Scene.Width - num3;
				num2 *= relativeWidth.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeWidth.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num);
					num2 = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num2);
				}
				break;
			}
			case WidthType.Max:
				num2 = composition.Scene.Width - num3;
				break;
			case WidthType.Auto:
				foreach (ListItem item in _items)
				{
					Bounds bounds = item.GetBounds(composition, graphics);
					if (num < bounds.Min)
					{
						num = bounds.Min;
					}
					if (num2 < bounds.Max)
					{
						num2 = bounds.Max;
					}
				}
				if (_paddings != null)
				{
					num3 += _paddings.Left + _paddings.Right;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasLeft && base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen != null)
				{
					num3 += base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasRight && base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen != null)
				{
					num3 += base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				if (_items.Count > 0)
				{
					num3 += _bullets.Indent;
				}
				break;
			}
			return new Bounds(num + num3, num2 + num3);
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			Composition composition2 = null;
			float num = 0f;
			switch (_width.Type)
			{
			case WidthType.Fixed:
				num = ((FixedWidth)_width).Value;
				break;
			case WidthType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeWidth relativeWidth = (RelativeWidth)_width;
				num = composition.Scene.Width;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
				num *= relativeWidth.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeWidth.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num);
				}
				break;
			}
			case WidthType.Max:
				num = composition.Scene.Width;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
				break;
			case WidthType.Auto:
				num = GetBounds(composition, graphics).Fit(composition.Scene.Width);
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (num < 0f)
			{
				num = 0f;
			}
			float num2 = 65535f;
			switch (_height.Type)
			{
			case HeightType.Fixed:
				num2 = ((FixedHeight)_height).Value;
				break;
			case HeightType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeHeight relativeHeight = (RelativeHeight)_height;
				num2 = composition.ResidualHeight;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num2 -= _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
				}
				num2 *= relativeHeight.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeHeight.Constraint != null)
				{
					num2 = relativeHeight.Constraint.Apply(num2);
				}
				break;
			}
			case HeightType.Max:
				num2 = composition.ResidualHeight;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num2 -= _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
				}
				break;
			case HeightType.Auto:
				if (mode != MeasureMode.MasterFlush)
				{
					num2 = composition.ResidualHeight;
					if (_margins != null)
					{
						num2 -= _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			if (num2 < 0f)
			{
				num2 = 0f;
			}
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
				{
					float num6 = ((_margins != null) ? (_margins.Top + _margins.Bottom) : 0f);
					if (_height.Type != HeightType.Auto)
					{
						num6 += num2;
					}
					if (composition.ResidualHeight < num6)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Create:
					composition2 = new Composition();
					composition2.Parent = composition;
					composition2.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
					composition2.Top = composition.Scene.Top;
					composition2.Width = num;
					composition2.Height = num2;
					composition2.Borders = base.BordersResolved;
					composition2.Margins = _margins;
					composition2.Paddings = _paddings;
					composition2.Background = _background;
					if (_panel == null)
					{
						if (_margins != null)
						{
							composition2.Left += _margins.Left;
							composition2.Top += composition.ActiveHeight + _margins.Top;
						}
						else
						{
							composition2.Top += composition.ActiveHeight;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						PropertyCollection propertyCollection = _panel.AttachedProperties[this];
						composition2.Left += propertyCollection.GetValue("Left", 0f);
						composition2.Top += propertyCollection.GetValue("Top", 0f);
						composition2.RotationAngle = propertyCollection.GetValue("Angle", 0f);
					}
					composition2.ResetScene();
					if (mode == MeasureMode.Normal && _height.Type == HeightType.Auto)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					}
					else
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Flush;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
				{
					bool flag = false;
					int num4 = _marker;
					int count2 = _items.Count;
					if (_keepSolid)
					{
						while (!flag && num4 < count2)
						{
							ListItem listItem2 = _items[num4];
							listItem2.Index = num4;
							MeasureResult measureResult = listItem2.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.Normal);
							switch (measureResult)
							{
							case MeasureResult.BreakBefore:
							case MeasureResult.ContentBreak:
								if (!_freshBreak)
								{
									for (int i = _marker; i <= num4; i++)
									{
										listItem2 = _items[i];
										listItem2.Reset();
									}
									_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
									return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
								}
								if (_marker == num4 && measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
								{
									_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
									return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
								}
								flag = true;
								break;
							case MeasureResult.Ok:
								num4++;
								if (num4 < count2)
								{
									composition2.ActiveHeight += _interval;
								}
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						bool flag2 = _freshBreak;
						int num5 = -1;
						while (!flag && num4 < count2)
						{
							ListItem listItem3 = _items[num4];
							listItem3.Index = num4;
							if (!flag2 && listItem3.KeepWithNext && num5 == -1)
							{
								num5 = num4;
								composition2.Mark();
							}
							MeasureResult measureResult2 = listItem3.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.Normal);
							if (measureResult2 != MeasureResult.Ok)
							{
								if (flag2 && measureResult2 == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
								{
									listItem3.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.Flush);
									num5 = -1;
									num4++;
									if (num4 < count2)
									{
										composition2.ActiveHeight += _interval;
										flag = true;
									}
								}
								else
								{
									if (_marker == num4 && measureResult2 == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
									{
										_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
										return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
									}
									if (measureResult2 == MeasureResult.BreakBefore || measureResult2 == MeasureResult.ContentBreak)
									{
										if (num5 >= 0 && (listItem3.KeepWithNext || measureResult2 == MeasureResult.BreakBefore))
										{
											composition2.Rollback();
											for (int j = num5; j <= num4; j++)
											{
												listItem3 = _items[j];
												listItem3.Reset();
											}
											num4 = num5;
											num5 = -1;
										}
									}
									else
									{
										num5 = -1;
									}
									flag = true;
								}
							}
							else
							{
								num4++;
								if (num4 < count2)
								{
									composition2.ActiveHeight += _interval;
								}
								flag2 = false;
							}
							if (!listItem3.KeepWithNext)
							{
								num5 = -1;
							}
						}
					}
					if (composition2.Content.Count != 0)
					{
						composition.Content.Add(composition2);
						if (composition2.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							composition2.Height -= composition2.ResidualHeight;
						}
						if (_panel == null)
						{
							composition.ActiveHeight += composition2.Height;
							if (_margins != null)
							{
								composition.ActiveHeight += _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
							}
						}
					}
					_marker = num4;
					if (flag)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.ContentBreak;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Flush:
				{
					int num3 = _marker;
					int count = _items.Count;
					while (num3 < count)
					{
						ListItem listItem = _items[num3];
						listItem.Index = num3;
						listItem.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
						num3++;
						if (num3 < count)
						{
							composition2.ActiveHeight += _interval;
						}
					}
					composition.Content.Add(composition2);
					if (_height.Type == HeightType.Auto && composition2.ResidualHeight > 0f)
					{
						composition2.Height -= composition2.ResidualHeight;
					}
					if (_panel == null)
					{
						composition.ActiveHeight += composition2.Height;
						if (_margins != null)
						{
							composition.ActiveHeight += _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
						}
					}
					_marker = num3;
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			foreach (ListItem item in _items)
			{
				item.Process(visitor);
			}
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			foreach (ListItem item in _items)
			{
				item.Reset();
			}
			_marker = 0;
			base.Reset();
		}
	}
	public class ListPattern
	{
		private Bullets _bullets;

		private int _startNumber;

		private float _interval;

		private Borders _borders;

		private Margins _margins;

		private Paddings _paddings;

		private Background _background;

		public Background Background
		{
			get
			{
				if (_background == null)
				{
					_background = new Background();
				}
				return _background;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_background = value;
			}
		}

		public Borders Borders
		{
			get
			{
				return _borders;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_borders = value;
			}
		}

		public Bullets Bullets
		{
			get
			{
				return _bullets;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_bullets = value;
			}
		}

		public float Interval
		{
			get
			{
				return _interval;
			}
			set
			{
				_interval = value;
			}
		}

		public Paddings Paddings
		{
			get
			{
				if (_paddings == null)
				{
					_paddings = new Paddings();
				}
				return _paddings;
			}
			set
			{
				_paddings = value;
			}
		}

		public Margins Margins
		{
			get
			{
				if (_margins == null)
				{
					_margins = new Margins();
				}
				return _margins;
			}
			set
			{
				_margins = value;
			}
		}

		public int StartNumber
		{
			get
			{
				return _startNumber;
			}
			set
			{
				_startNumber = value;
			}
		}

		public ListPattern()
		{
			_bullets = new Bullets();
			_startNumber = 1;
			_interval = 5f;
			_borders = new Borders();
		}

		public void Apply(IList list)
		{
			if (list == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("list");
			}
			list.Bullets = _bullets;
			list.StartNumber = _startNumber;
			list.Interval = _interval;
			list.Borders = _borders;
			list.Margins = _margins;
			list.Paddings = _paddings;
			list.Background = _background;
		}
	}

		public Reader(Report report)
		{
			_report = report;
		}

		public Reader(Report report, Container container)
			: this(report)
		{
			_container = container;
		}

		public void Read(XmlTextReader reader)
		{
			_reader = reader;
			_resources = new Dictionary<string, byte[]>(25);
			_linkedColors = new Dictionary<string, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color>(25);
			_linkedPens = new Dictionary<string, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen>(25);
			_linkedBrushes = new Dictionary<string, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush>(25);
			_linkedFonts = new Dictionary<string, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font>(25);
			_inlineStyles = new Dictionary<ShortStyleHashKey, Style>(25);
			_fonts = new Dictionary<Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontHashKey, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font>(25);
			_brushes = new Dictionary<Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush>(25);
			_pens = new Dictionary<Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen.HashKey, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen>(25);
			_images = new Dictionary<Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image.HashKey, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image>(25);
			_metafiles = new Dictionary<string, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Metafile>(25);
			_containers = new Dictionary<string, IContainer>(25);
			_styles = new Dictionary<string, Style>(25);
			_textPatterns = new Dictionary<string, TextPattern>(25);
			_tablePatterns = new Dictionary<string, TablePattern>(25);
			_gridPatterns = new Dictionary<string, GridPattern>(25);
			_flowPatterns = new Dictionary<string, FlowPattern>(25);
			_listPatterns = new Dictionary<string, ListPattern>(25);
			_treePatterns = new Dictionary<string, TreePattern>(25);
			while (Next())
			{
				if (_reader.Name == "Report")
				{
					LoadReport();
				}
				if (_reader.Name == "Fragment")
				{
					LoadFragment();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ContainsAttribute(string name)
		{
			string attribute = _reader.GetAttribute(name);
			if (attribute != null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ContainsAttribute(string name, string value)
		{
			if (value == _reader.GetAttribute(name))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private string GetAttribute(string name, string defaultValue)
		{
			string attribute = _reader.GetAttribute(name);
			if (attribute != null)
			{
				return attribute;
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}

		private int GetAttribute(string name, int defaultValue)
		{
			string attribute = _reader.GetAttribute(name);
			if (attribute != null)
			{
				return Convert.ToInt32(attribute);
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}

		private float GetAttribute(string name, float defaultValue)
		{
			string attribute = _reader.GetAttribute(name);
			if (attribute != null)
			{
				return Converter.ToPoints(attribute);
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}

		private bool GetAttribute(string name, bool defaultValue)
		{
			string attribute = _reader.GetAttribute(name);
			if (attribute != null)
			{
				return Convert.ToBoolean(attribute);
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}

		private System.DateTime GetAttribute(string name, System.DateTime defaultValue)
		{
			string attribute = _reader.GetAttribute(name);
			if (attribute != null)
			{
				return Convert.ToDateTime(attribute, Converter.DateTimeFormatInfo);
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color GetAttribute(string name, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color defaultValue)
		{
			string attribute = _reader.GetAttribute(name);
			if (attribute != null)
			{
				if (attribute[0] == '#')
				{
					string key = attribute.Substring(1);
					if (_linkedColors.ContainsKey(key))
					{
						return _linkedColors[key];
					}
				}
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color color = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color.Parse(attribute);
				if (color != null)
				{
					return color;
				}
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}

		private Background GetBackground(string category, PropertyCollection properties)
		{
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush brush = GetBrush(category, properties);
			if (brush != null)
			{
				return new Background(brush);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private Border GetBorder(string category, PropertyCollection properties)
		{
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen pen = GetPen(category, properties);
			if (pen != null)
			{
				return new Border(pen);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private Borders GetBorders(string category, PropertyCollection properties)
		{
			category += ".";
			Border border = GetBorder(category + "Left", properties);
			Border border2 = GetBorder(category + "Right", properties);
			Border border3 = GetBorder(category + "Top", properties);
			Border border4 = GetBorder(category + "Bottom", properties);
			Corners corners = GetCorners(category + "Corners", properties);
			if (border != null || border2 != null || border3 != null || border4 != null || corners != null)
			{
				Borders borders = new Borders();
				if (border != null)
				{
					borders.Left = border;
				}
				if (border2 != null)
				{
					borders.Right = border2;
				}
				if (border3 != null)
				{
					borders.Top = border3;
				}
				if (border4 != null)
				{
					borders.Bottom = border4;
				}
				if (corners != null)
				{
					borders.Corners = corners;
				}
				return borders;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush GetBrush(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color color)
		{
			if (_brushes.ContainsKey(color))
			{
				return _brushes[color];
			}
			SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush = new SolidColorBrush(color);
			_brushes.Add(color, solidColorBrush);
			return solidColorBrush;
		}

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush GetBrush(string category, PropertyCollection properties)
		{
			category += ".";
			if (properties.ContainsKey(category + "Id"))
			{
				string value = properties.GetValue(category + "Id", (string)null);
				return _linkedBrushes[value];
			}
			if (properties.ContainsKey(category + "Type"))
			{
				string value2 = properties.GetValue(category + "Type", "SolidColor");
				bool value3 = properties.GetValue(category + "Sealed", defaultValue: false);
				switch ((BrushType)Enum.Parse(typeof(BrushType), value2, ignoreCase: false))
				{
				case BrushType.SolidColor:
				{
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color value7 = properties.GetValue(category + "Color", Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Colors.Black);
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush brush = null;

		private Corner GetCorner(string category, PropertyCollection properties)
		{
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen pen = GetPen(category, properties);
			category += ".";
			if (pen == null && !properties.ContainsKey(category + "Radius"))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (pen == null)
			{
				pen = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pens.Black;
			}
			float value = properties.GetValue(category + "Radius", 0f);
			return new Corner(pen, value);
		}

		private Corners GetCorners(string category, PropertyCollection properties)
		{
			category += ".";
			Corner corner = GetCorner(category + "TopLeft", properties);
			Corner corner2 = GetCorner(category + "TopRight", properties);
			Corner corner3 = GetCorner(category + "BottomLeft", properties);
			Corner corner4 = GetCorner(category + "BottomRight", properties);
			if (corner != null || corner2 != null || corner3 != null || corner4 != null)
			{
				Corners corners = new Corners();
				if (corner != null)
				{
					corners.TopLeft = corner;
				}
				if (corner2 != null)
				{
					corners.TopRight = corner2;
				}
				if (corner3 != null)
				{
					corners.BottomLeft = corner3;
				}
				if (corner4 != null)
				{
					corners.BottomRight = corner4;
				}
				return corners;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font GetFont(string category, PropertyCollection properties)
		{
			category += ".";
			if (properties.ContainsKey(category + "Id"))
			{
				string value = properties.GetValue(category + "Id", (string)null);
				return _linkedFonts[value];
			}
			string value2 = properties.GetValue(category + "Source", (string)null);
			string value3 = properties.GetValue(category + "Name", "Arial");
			float value4 = properties.GetValue(category + "Size", 12f);
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle fontStyle = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Regular;
			if (properties.GetValue(category + "Bold", defaultValue: false))
			{
				fontStyle |= Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Bold;
			}
			if (properties.GetValue(category + "Italic", defaultValue: false))
			{
				fontStyle |= Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Italic;
			}
			if (properties.GetValue(category + "Strikeout", defaultValue: false))
			{
				fontStyle |= Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Strikeout;
			}
			if (properties.GetValue(category + "DoubleStrikeout", defaultValue: false))
			{
				fontStyle |= Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.DoubleStrikeout;
			}
			if (properties.GetValue(category + "Underline", defaultValue: false))
			{
				fontStyle |= Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Underline;
			}
			if (properties.GetValue(category + "DoubleUnderline", defaultValue: false))
			{
				fontStyle |= Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.DoubleUnderline;
			}
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font font = GetFont(value3, value4, fontStyle, value2);
			if (properties.ContainsKey(category + "Embed"))
			{
				font.Preferences.Embed = properties.GetValue(category + "Embed", defaultValue: false);
			}
			if (properties.ContainsKey(category + "Subset"))
			{
				font.Preferences.Subset = properties.GetValue(category + "Subset", defaultValue: false);
			}
			if (properties.ContainsKey(category + "EnableCIDFontRendering"))
			{
				font.Preferences.EnableCIDFontRendering = properties.GetValue(category + "EnableCIDFontRendering", defaultValue: false);
			}
			if (properties.GetValue(category + "Sealed", defaultValue: false))
			{
				font.Seal();
			}
			return font;
		}

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font GetFont(string name, float size, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle style, string source)
		{
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontHashKey key = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontHashKey(name, size, style);
			if (_fonts.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				return _fonts[key];
			}
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font font = ((source == null) ? new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font(name, size, style) : ((source[0] == '#') ? new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font(name, size, style, _resources[source.Substring(1)]) : ((_report.FontLoader != null && source.StartsWith("Loader:")) ? _report.FontLoader.Load(source.Substring(7)) : ((_report.PathResolver == null) ? new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font(name, size, style, source) : new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font(name, size, style, _report.PathResolver.Resolve(source))))));
			_fonts.Add(key, font);
			return font;
		}

		{
			return (Tabs)properties.GetValue(category, (object)null);
		}

		private Lines GetTreeLines(string category, PropertyCollection properties)
		{
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen pen = GetPen(category, properties);
			if (pen != null)
			{
				return new Lines(pen);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static VerticalMargins GetVerticalMargins(string category, PropertyCollection properties)
		{
			category += ".";
			if (properties.ContainsKey(category + "Top") || properties.ContainsKey(category + "Bottom"))
			{
				float value = properties.GetValue(category + "Top", 0f);
				float value2 = properties.GetValue(category + "Bottom", 0f);
				return new VerticalMargins(value, value2);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static void LoadAlignment(string category, PropertyCollection properties, string[] values)
		{
			if (values == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = values.Length;
			if (num != 0)
			{
				category += ".";
				string text = values[0];
				switch (text)
				{
				case "Top":
				case "Middle":
				case "Bottom":
					properties.SetValue(category + "Vertical", text);
					break;
				default:
					properties.SetValue(category + "Horizontal", text);
					break;
				}
				if (num != 1)
				{
					properties.SetValue(category + "Vertical", values[1]);
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadAlignment(string category, string path, PropertyCollection properties)
		{
			category += ".";
			if (path.Length > 0)
			{
				path += ".";
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Horizontal"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Horizontal", GetAttribute(path + "Horizontal", "Left"));
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Vertical"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Vertical", GetAttribute(path + "Vertical", "Top"));
			}
		}

		private void LoadAllCapsText(IText text, Style style, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Hyperlink hyperlink)
		{
			if (_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (!_reader.EOF)
			{
				_reader.Read();
				switch (_reader.NodeType)
				{
				case XmlNodeType.Text:
				case XmlNodeType.Whitespace:
					text.AddContent(_reader.Value.ToUpper(), style, hyperlink);
					break;
				case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
					if (_reader.Name == "AllCaps")
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadArc(IArc arc)
		{
			arc.X = GetAttribute("X", 0f);
			arc.Y = GetAttribute("Y", 0f);
			arc.Width = GetAttribute("Width", 0f);
			arc.Height = GetAttribute("Height", 0f);
			arc.StartAngle = GetAttribute("StartAngle", 0f);
			arc.EndAngle = GetAttribute("EndAngle", 0f);
			arc.Angle = GetAttribute("Angle", 0f);
			PropertyCollection properties = new PropertyCollection();
			LoadPen("Pen", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Pen", (string)null)));
			LoadPen("Pen", "Pen", properties);
			if (!_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				while (flag)
				{
					if (!Next())
					{
						return;
					}
					if (!_arcSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
					{
						continue;
					}
					short num = _arcSymbols[_reader.Name];
					switch (_reader.NodeType)
					{
					case XmlNodeType.Element:
						if (num == 2)
						{
							LoadPen("Pen", "", properties);
						}
						break;
					case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
						if (num == 1)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			arc.Pen = GetPen("Pen", properties);
		}

		private void LoadAttachment()
		{
			if (_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			string attribute = GetAttribute("Name", (string)null);
			string attribute2 = GetAttribute("MimeType", (string)null);
			string attribute3 = GetAttribute("Description", (string)null);
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			byte[] array = new byte[100000];
			while (!_reader.EOF && _reader.Name == "Attachment")
			{
				int num = _reader.ReadBase64(array, 0, array.Length);
				if (num > 0)
				{
					memoryStream.Write(array, 0, num);
				}
			}
			memoryStream.Position = 0L;
			memoryStream = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Utils.FlateCompressor.Inflate(memoryStream);
			_report.AttachFile(memoryStream, attribute, attribute2, attribute3);
		}

		private void LoadAttachments()
		{
			if (_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (Next())
			{
				if (!_attachmentsSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
				{
					continue;
				}
				short num = _attachmentsSymbols[_reader.Name];
				switch (_reader.NodeType)
				{
				case XmlNodeType.Element:
					if (num == 2)
					{
						LoadAttachment();
					}
					break;
				case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
					if (num == 1)
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadBand(IBand band)
		{
			band.Width = LoadWidth(band.Width);
			band.Height = LoadHeight(band.Height);
			band.KeepSolid = GetAttribute("KeepSolid", band.KeepSolid);
			band.Stretch = GetAttribute("Stretch", band.Stretch);
			PropertyCollection properties = new PropertyCollection();
			LoadAlignment("Alignment", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Alignment", (string)null)));
			LoadAlignment("Alignment", "Alignment", properties);
			LoadBorders("Borders", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Borders", (string)null)));
			LoadBorders("Borders", "Borders", properties);
			LoadMargins("Margins", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Margins", (string)null)));
			LoadMargins("Margins", "Margins", properties);
			LoadPaddings("Paddings", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Paddings", (string)null)));
			LoadPaddings("Paddings", "Paddings", properties);
			LoadBackground("Background", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Background", (string)null)));
			LoadBackground("Background", "Background", properties);
			if (!_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				while (flag)
				{
					if (!Next())
					{
						return;
					}
					if (!_bandSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
					{
						continue;
					}
					short num = _bandSymbols[_reader.Name];
					switch (_reader.NodeType)
					{
					case XmlNodeType.Element:
						switch (num)
						{
						case 1:
							LoadBand(band.AddBand());
							break;
						case 2:
							LoadBandHeader(band.Header);
							break;
						case 3:
							LoadBandFooter(band.Footer);
							break;
						case 4:
							LoadBandDivider(band.Divider);
							break;
						case 5:
							LoadAlignment("Alignment", "", properties);
							break;
						case 6:
							LoadBorders("Borders", "", properties);
							break;
						case 7:
							LoadMargins("Margins", "", properties);
							break;
						case 8:
							LoadPaddings("Paddings", "", properties);
							break;
						case 9:
							LoadBackground("Background", "", properties);
							break;
						case 10:
							LoadQuickText(band.AddQuickText(GetAttribute("Content", (string)null)));
							break;
						case 11:
						{
							string attribute2 = GetAttribute("Source", (string)null);
							Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.ImageConverter converter2 = LoadImageConverter(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Converter", (string)null)));
							ImageCompressor compressor2 = LoadImageCompressor(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Compressor", (string)null)));
							Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image2 = GetImage(attribute2, converter2, compressor2);
							LoadQuickImage(band.AddQuickImage(image2));
							break;
						}
						case 12:
							LoadQuickList(band.AddQuickList());
							break;
						case 13:
							LoadQuickTable(band.AddQuickTable());
							break;
						case 14:
							LoadText(band.AddText());
							break;
						case 15:
						{
							string attribute = GetAttribute("Source", (string)null);
							Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.ImageConverter converter = LoadImageConverter(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Converter", (string)null)));
							ImageCompressor compressor = LoadImageCompressor(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Compressor", (string)null)));
							Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image = GetImage(attribute, converter, compressor);
							LoadImage(band.AddImage(image));
							break;
						}
						case 16:
							LoadMetafile(band.AddMetafile(GetMetafile(GetAttribute("Source", (string)null))));
							break;
						case 17:
							LoadRule(band.AddRule());
							break;
						case 18:
							LoadGap(band.AddGap());
							break;
						case 19:
							LoadGroup(band.AddGroup());
							break;
						case 20:
							LoadChain(band.AddChain());
							break;
						case 21:
							LoadTable(band.AddTable());
							break;
						case 22:
							LoadGrid(band.AddGrid());
							break;
						case 23:
							LoadFlow(band.AddFlow());
							break;
						case 24:
							LoadList(band.AddList());
							break;
						case 25:
							LoadTree(band.AddTree());
							break;
						case 26:
							LoadSite(band.AddSite());
							break;
						case 27:
							LoadCanvas(band.AddCanvas());
							break;
						case 28:
							LoadRotator(band.AddRotator());
							break;
						case 29:
							LoadContainer(band.AddContainer(GetAttribute("Name", (string)null)));
							break;
						case 30:
							LoadCondition(band.AddCondition(_containers[GetAttribute("Container", (string)null)], GetAttribute("Fit", defaultValue: false)));
							break;
						case 31:
							LoadStretcher(band.AddStretcher());
							break;
						case 32:
							band.AddDummy();
							break;
						case 33:
							band.AddPageBreak();
							break;
						case 34:
							LoadTOC(band.AddTOC());
							break;
						case 35:
							LoadIndex(band.AddIndex());
							break;
						}
						break;
					case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
						if (num == 1)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			ContentAlignment contentAlignment = GetContentAlignment("Alignment", properties);
			Borders borders = GetBorders("Borders", properties);
			Margins margins = GetMargins("Margins", properties);
			Paddings paddings = GetPaddings("Paddings", properties);
			Background background = GetBackground("Background", properties);
			if (contentAlignment != null)
			{
				band.Alignment = contentAlignment;
			}
			if (borders != null)
			{
				band.Borders = borders;
			}
			if (margins != null)
			{
				band.Margins = margins;
			}
			if (paddings != null)
			{
				band.Paddings = paddings;
			}
			if (background != null)
			{
				band.Background = background;
			}
		}

						{
