							Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.ImageConverter converter2 = LoadImageConverter(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Converter", (string)null)));
							ImageCompressor compressor2 = LoadImageCompressor(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Compressor", (string)null)));
							Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image2 = GetImage(attribute2, converter2, compressor2);
							LoadQuickImage(header.AddQuickImage(image2));
							break;
						}
						case 9:
							LoadQuickList(header.AddQuickList());
							break;
						case 10:
							LoadQuickTable(header.AddQuickTable());
							break;
						case 11:
							LoadText(header.AddText());
							break;
						case 12:
						{
							string attribute = GetAttribute("Source", (string)null);
							Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.ImageConverter converter = LoadImageConverter(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Converter", (string)null)));
							ImageCompressor compressor = LoadImageCompressor(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Compressor", (string)null)));
							Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image = GetImage(attribute, converter, compressor);
							LoadImage(header.AddImage(image));
							break;
						}
						case 13:
							LoadMetafile(header.AddMetafile(GetMetafile(GetAttribute("Source", (string)null))));
							break;
						case 14:
							LoadRule(header.AddRule());
							break;
						case 15:
							LoadGap(header.AddGap());
							break;
						case 16:
							LoadGroup(header.AddGroup());
							break;
						case 17:
							LoadBand(header.AddBand());
							break;
						case 18:
							LoadTable(header.AddTable());
							break;
						case 19:
							LoadGrid(header.AddGrid());
							break;
						case 20:
							LoadFlow(header.AddFlow());
							break;
						case 21:
							LoadList(header.AddList());
							break;
						case 22:
							LoadTree(header.AddTree());
							break;
						case 23:
							LoadSite(header.AddSite());
							break;
						case 24:
							LoadCanvas(header.AddCanvas());
							break;
						case 25:
							LoadRotator(header.AddRotator());
							break;
						case 26:
							LoadContainer(header.AddContainer(GetAttribute("Name", (string)null)));
							break;
						}
						break;
					case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
						if (num == 1)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			ContentAlignment contentAlignment = GetContentAlignment("Alignment", properties);
			Borders borders = GetBorders("Borders", properties);
			Margins margins = GetMargins("Margins", properties);
			Paddings paddings = GetPaddings("Paddings", properties);
			Background background = GetBackground("Background", properties);
			if (contentAlignment != null)
			{
				header.Alignment = contentAlignment;
			}
			if (borders != null)
			{
				header.Borders = borders;
			}
			if (margins != null)
			{
				header.Margins = margins;
			}
			if (paddings != null)
			{
				header.Paddings = paddings;
			}
			if (background != null)
			{
				header.Background = background;
			}
		}

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.ColorBlend LoadBlend()
		{
			if (_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.ColorBlend colorBlend = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.ColorBlend();
			while (Next())
			{
				if (!_blendSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
				{
					continue;
				}
				short num = _blendSymbols[_reader.Name];
				switch (_reader.NodeType)
				{
				case XmlNodeType.Element:
					if (num == 2)
					{
						LoadBlendEntry(colorBlend);
					}
					break;
				case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
					if (num == 1)
					{
						return colorBlend;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			return colorBlend;
		}

		private void LoadBlendEntry(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.ColorBlend blend)
		{
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color attribute = GetAttribute("Color", Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Colors.Black);
			float attribute2 = GetAttribute("Offset", 0f);
			blend.Add(attribute, attribute2);
		}

		private void LoadBody()
		{
			if (_container == null || _reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (Next())
			{
				if (!_bodySymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
				{
					continue;
				}
				short num = _bodySymbols[_reader.Name];
				switch (_reader.NodeType)
				{
				case XmlNodeType.Element:
					switch (num)
					{
					case 2:
						LoadText(_container.AddText());
						break;
					case 3:
					{
						string attribute = GetAttribute("Source", (string)null);
						Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.ImageConverter converter = LoadImageConverter(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Converter", (string)null)));
						ImageCompressor compressor = LoadImageCompressor(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Compressor", (string)null)));
						Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image = GetImage(attribute, converter, compressor);
						LoadImage(_container.AddImage(image));
						break;
					}
					case 4:
						LoadMetafile(_container.AddMetafile(GetMetafile(GetAttribute("Source", (string)null))));
						break;
					case 5:
						LoadRule(_container.AddRule());
						break;
					case 6:
						LoadGap(_container.AddGap());
						break;
					case 7:
						LoadGroup(_container.AddGroup());
						break;
					case 8:
						LoadChain(_container.AddChain());
						break;
					case 9:
						LoadBand(_container.AddBand());
						break;
					case 10:
						LoadTable(_container.AddTable());
						break;
					case 11:
						LoadGrid(_container.AddGrid());
						break;
					case 12:
						LoadFlow(_container.AddFlow());
						break;
					case 13:
						LoadList(_container.AddList());
						break;
					case 14:
						LoadTree(_container.AddTree());
						break;
					case 15:
						LoadSite(_container.AddSite());
						break;
					case 16:
						LoadCanvas(_container.AddCanvas());
						break;
					case 17:
						LoadRotator(_container.AddRotator());
						break;
					case 18:
						LoadContainer(_container.AddContainer(GetAttribute("Name", (string)null)));
						break;
					case 19:
						LoadCondition(_container.AddCondition(_containers[GetAttribute("Container", (string)null)], GetAttribute("Fit", defaultValue: false)));
						break;
					case 20:
						LoadStretcher(_container.AddStretcher());
						break;
					case 21:
						_container.AddPageBreak();
						break;
					case 22:
						LoadTOC(_container.AddTOC());
						break;
					case 23:
						LoadIndex(_container.AddIndex());
						break;
					}
					break;
				case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
					if (num == 1)
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadBoldText(IText text, Style style, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Hyperlink hyperlink)
		{
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font font = style.Font;
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush brush = style.Brush;
			style = GetStyle(GetFont(font.Name, font.Size, font.Style | Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Bold, null), brush);
			if (_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (!_reader.EOF)
			{
				_reader.Read();
				switch (_reader.NodeType)
				{
				case XmlNodeType.Text:
				case XmlNodeType.Whitespace:
					text.AddContent(_reader.Value, style, hyperlink);
					break;
				case XmlNodeType.Element:
					if (_boldTextSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
					{
						switch (_boldTextSymbols[_reader.Name])
						{
						case 2:
							LoadItalicText(text, style, hyperlink);
							break;
						case 3:
							LoadUnderlinedText(text, style, hyperlink);
							break;
						case 4:
							LoadAllCapsText(text, style, hyperlink);
							break;
						case 5:
							LoadSmallCapsText(text, style, hyperlink);
							break;
						case 6:
							LoadTextInjector(text, style, hyperlink);
							break;
						}
					}
					break;
				case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
					if (_boldTextSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name) && _boldTextSymbols[_reader.Name] == 1)
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadBookmarks()
		{
			if (_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (Next())
			{
				if (!_bookmarksSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
				{
					continue;
				}
				short num = _bookmarksSymbols[_reader.Name];
				switch (_reader.NodeType)
				{
				case XmlNodeType.Element:
					if (num == 2)
					{
						_report.Bookmarks.AddLevel(GetAttribute("Opened", defaultValue: false));
					}
					break;
				case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
					if (num == 1)
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadBorder(string category, PropertyCollection properties, string[] values)
		{
			LoadPen(category, properties, values);
		}

		private void LoadBorder(string category, string path, PropertyCollection properties)
		{
			LoadPen(category, path, properties);
		}

		private void LoadBorders(string category, PropertyCollection properties, string[] values)
		{
			if (values != null && values.Length != 0)
			{
				category += ".";
				LoadBorder(category + "Left", properties, values);
				LoadBorder(category + "Right", properties, values);
				LoadBorder(category + "Top", properties, values);
				LoadBorder(category + "Bottom", properties, values);
				if (values.Length == 4)
				{
					LoadCorners(category + "Corners", properties, values);
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadBorders(string category, string path, PropertyCollection properties)
		{
			category += ".";
			LoadBorder(category + "Left", path, properties);
			LoadBorder(category + "Right", path, properties);
			LoadBorder(category + "Top", path, properties);
			LoadBorder(category + "Bottom", path, properties);
			if (path.Length > 0)
			{
				path += ".";
			}
			LoadHorizontalBorders(category, properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute(path + "Horizontal", (string)null)));
			LoadHorizontalBorders(category, path + "Horizontal", properties);
			LoadVerticalBorders(category, properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute(path + "Vertical", (string)null)));
			LoadVerticalBorders(category, path + "Vertical", properties);
			LoadBorder(category + "Left", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute(path + "Left", (string)null)));
			LoadBorder(category + "Left", path + "Left", properties);
			LoadBorder(category + "Right", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute(path + "Right", (string)null)));
			LoadBorder(category + "Right", path + "Right", properties);
			LoadBorder(category + "Top", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute(path + "Top", (string)null)));
			LoadBorder(category + "Top", path + "Top", properties);
			LoadBorder(category + "Bottom", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute(path + "Bottom", (string)null)));
			LoadBorder(category + "Bottom", path + "Bottom", properties);
			LoadCorners(category + "Corners", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute(path + "Corners", (string)null)));
			LoadCorners(category + "Corners", path + "Corners", properties);
			if (_reader.IsEmptyElement || path.Length != 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (Next())
			{
				if (!_bordersSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
				{
					continue;
				}
				short num = _bordersSymbols[_reader.Name];
				switch (_reader.NodeType)
				{
				case XmlNodeType.Element:
					switch (num)
					{
					case 2:
						LoadHorizontalBorders(category, path, properties);
						break;
					case 3:
						LoadVerticalBorders(category, path, properties);
						break;
					case 4:
						LoadBorder(category + "Left", path, properties);
						break;
					case 5:
						LoadBorder(category + "Right", path, properties);
						break;
					case 6:
						LoadBorder(category + "Top", path, properties);
						break;
					case 7:
						LoadBorder(category + "Bottom", path, properties);
						break;
					case 8:
						LoadCorners(category + "Corners", path, properties);
						break;
					}
					break;
				case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
					if (num == 1)
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadBrush()
		{
			string attribute = GetAttribute("Id", (string)null);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(attribute) || _linkedBrushes.ContainsKey(attribute))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Id");
			}
			PropertyCollection properties = new PropertyCollection();
			LoadBrush("Brush", "", properties);
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush brush = GetBrush("Brush", properties);
			if (brush != null)
			{
				_linkedBrushes.Add(attribute, brush);
			}
		}

		private void LoadBrush(string category, PropertyCollection properties, string[] values)
		{
			if (values == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			category += ".";
			switch (values.Length)
			{
			case 1:
			case 2:
			{
				string text = values[0];
				if (text[0] == '#')
				{
					string text2 = text.Substring(1);
					if (_linkedBrushes.ContainsKey(text2))
					{
						properties.SetValue(category + "Id", text2);
						break;
					}
				}
				properties.SetValue(category + "Type", "SolidColor");
				properties.SetValue(category + "Color", Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color.Parse(text));
				if (values.Length > 1)
				{
					properties.SetValue(category + "Sealed", values[1]);
				}
				break;
			}
			case 3:
				properties.SetValue(category + "Type", "LinearGradient");
				properties.SetValue(category + "StartColor", Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color.Parse(values[0]));
				properties.SetValue(category + "EndColor", Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color.Parse(values[1]));
				properties.SetValue(category + "Sealed", values[2]);
				break;
			case 4:
				if (Enum.IsDefined(typeof(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.HatchStyle), values[0]))
				{
					properties.SetValue(category + "Type", "Hatch");
					properties.SetValue(category + "Style", values[0]);
					properties.SetValue(category + "ForeColor", Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color.Parse(values[1]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "BackColor", Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color.Parse(values[2]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "Sealed", values[3]);
				}
				else
				{
					properties.SetValue(category + "Type", "LinearGradient");
					properties.SetValue(category + "StartColor", Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color.Parse(values[0]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "EndColor", Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color.Parse(values[1]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "Angle", Convert.ToSingle(values[2], Converter.NumberFormatInfo));
					properties.SetValue(category + "Sealed", values[3]);
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private void LoadBrush(string category, string path, PropertyCollection properties)
		{
			category += ".";
			if (path.Length > 0)
			{
				path += ".";
			}
			if (!properties.ContainsKey(category + "Id"))
			{
				string attribute = GetAttribute(path + "Reference", (string)null);
				if (attribute != null)
				{
					string text = attribute.Substring(1);
					if (_linkedBrushes.ContainsKey(text))
					{
						properties.SetValue(category + "Id", text);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					string attribute2 = GetAttribute(path + "Type", properties.GetValue(category + "Type", "SolidColor"));
					if (attribute2 == "SolidColor" && !ContainsAttribute(path + "Color"))
					{
						return;
					}
					properties.SetValue(category + "Type", attribute2);
					switch ((BrushType)Enum.Parse(typeof(BrushType), attribute2, ignoreCase: false))
					{
					case BrushType.SolidColor:
						properties.SetValue(category + "Color", GetAttribute(path + "Color", properties.GetValue(category + "Color", Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Colors.Black)));
						properties.SetValue(category + "Sealed", GetAttribute(path + "Sealed", properties.GetValue(category + "Sealed", defaultValue: false)));
						break;
					case BrushType.Hatch:
						properties.SetValue(category + "Style", GetAttribute(path + "Style", properties.GetValue(category + "Style", "Cross")));
						properties.SetValue(category + "ForeColor", GetAttribute(path + "ForeColor", properties.GetValue(category + "ForeColor", Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Colors.Black)));
						properties.SetValue(category + "BackColor", GetAttribute(path + "BackColor", properties.GetValue(category + "BackColor", Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Colors.Black)));
						properties.SetValue(category + "Sealed", GetAttribute(path + "Sealed", properties.GetValue(category + "Sealed", defaultValue: false)));
						break;
					case BrushType.LinearGradient:
						properties.SetValue(category + "StartColor", GetAttribute(path + "StartColor", properties.GetValue(category + "StartColor", Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Colors.Black)));
						properties.SetValue(category + "EndColor", GetAttribute(path + "EndColor", properties.GetValue(category + "EndColor", Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Colors.Black)));
						properties.SetValue(category + "Angle", GetAttribute(path + "Angle", properties.GetValue(category + "Angle", 0f)));
						properties.SetValue(category + "Sealed", GetAttribute(path + "Sealed", properties.GetValue(category + "Sealed", defaultValue: false)));
						break;
					case BrushType.LinearGradientDirect:
						LoadRectangle(category + "Rectangle", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute(path + "Rectangle", (string)null)));
						LoadRectangle(category + "Rectangle", path + "Rectangle", properties);
						LoadMatrix(category + "Transform", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute(path + "Transform", (string)null)));
						LoadMatrix(category + "Transform", path + "Transform", properties);
						properties.SetValue(category + "Sealed", GetAttribute(path + "Sealed", properties.GetValue(category + "Sealed", defaultValue: false)));
						break;
					case BrushType.RadialGradient:
						properties.SetValue(category + "StartColor", GetAttribute(path + "StartColor", properties.GetValue(category + "StartColor", Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Colors.Black)));
						properties.SetValue(category + "EndColor", GetAttribute(path + "EndColor", properties.GetValue(category + "EndColor", Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Colors.Black)));
						properties.SetValue(category + "Angle", GetAttribute(path + "Angle", properties.GetValue(category + "Angle", 0f)));
						SetPoint(category + "Center", properties, 0.5f, 0.5f);
						LoadPoint(category + "Center", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute(path + "Center", (string)null)));
						LoadPoint(category + "Center", path + "Center", properties);
						properties.SetValue(category + "RadiusX", GetAttribute(path + "RadiusX", properties.GetValue(category + "RadiusX", 0.5f)));
						properties.SetValue(category + "RadiusY", GetAttribute(path + "RadiusY", properties.GetValue(category + "RadiusY", 0.5f)));
						SetPoint(category + "Focus", properties, 0.5f, 0.5f);
						LoadPoint(category + "Focus", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute(path + "Focus", (string)null)));
						LoadPoint(category + "Focus", path + "Focus", properties);
						properties.SetValue(category + "Sealed", GetAttribute(path + "Sealed", properties.GetValue(category + "Sealed", defaultValue: false)));
						properties.SetValue(category + "Circular", GetAttribute(path + "Circular", properties.GetValue(category + "Circular", defaultValue: false)));
						break;
					case BrushType.RadialGradientDirect:
						SetPoint(category + "Center", properties, 0.5f, 0.5f);
						LoadPoint(category + "Center", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute(path + "Center", (string)null)));
						LoadPoint(category + "Center", path + "Center", properties);
						properties.SetValue(category + "RadiusX", GetAttribute(path + "RadiusX", properties.GetValue(category + "RadiusX", 0.5f)));
						properties.SetValue(category + "RadiusY", GetAttribute(path + "RadiusY", properties.GetValue(category + "RadiusY", 0.5f)));
						SetPoint(category + "Focus", properties, 0.5f, 0.5f);
						LoadPoint(category + "Focus", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute(path + "Focus", (string)null)));
						LoadPoint(category + "Focus", path + "Focus", properties);
						LoadMatrix(category + "Transform", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute(path + "Transform", (string)null)));
						LoadMatrix(category + "Transform", path + "Transform", properties);
						properties.SetValue(category + "Sealed", GetAttribute(path + "Sealed", properties.GetValue(category + "Sealed", defaultValue: false)));
						properties.SetValue(category + "Circular", GetAttribute(path + "Circular", properties.GetValue(category + "Circular", defaultValue: false)));
						break;
					case BrushType.Texture:
						properties.SetValue(category + "Source", GetAttribute(path + "Source", properties.GetValue(category + "Source", (string)null)));
						properties.SetValue(category + "Converter", GetAttribute(path + "Converter", properties.GetValue(category + "Converter", (string)null)));
						properties.SetValue(category + "Compressor", GetAttribute(path + "Compressor", properties.GetValue(category + "Compressor", (string)null)));
						properties.SetValue(category + "Angle", GetAttribute(path + "Angle", properties.GetValue(category + "Angle", 0f)));
						properties.SetValue(category + "ScaleX", GetAttribute(path + "ScaleX", properties.GetValue(category + "ScaleX", 1f)));
						properties.SetValue(category + "ScaleY", GetAttribute(path + "ScaleY", properties.GetValue(category + "ScaleY", 1f)));
						properties.SetValue(category + "OffsetX", GetAttribute(path + "OffsetX", properties.GetValue(category + "OffsetX", 0f)));
						properties.SetValue(category + "OffsetY", GetAttribute(path + "OffsetY", properties.GetValue(category + "OffsetY", 0f)));
						properties.SetValue(category + "Sealed", GetAttribute(path + "Sealed", properties.GetValue(category + "Sealed", defaultValue: false)));
						break;
					case BrushType.TextureDirect:
						properties.SetValue(category + "Source", GetAttribute(path + "Source", properties.GetValue(category + "Source", (string)null)));
						properties.SetValue(category + "Converter", GetAttribute(path + "Converter", properties.GetValue(category + "Converter", (string)null)));
						properties.SetValue(category + "Compressor", GetAttribute(path + "Compressor", properties.GetValue(category + "Compressor", (string)null)));
						LoadMatrix(category + "Transform", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute(path + "Transform", (string)null)));
						LoadMatrix(category + "Transform", path + "Transform", properties);
						properties.SetValue(category + "Sealed", GetAttribute(path + "Sealed", properties.GetValue(category + "Sealed", defaultValue: false)));
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (_reader.IsEmptyElement || path.Length > 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (Next())
			{
				if (!_brushSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
				{
					continue;
				}
				short num = _brushSymbols[_reader.Name];
				switch (_reader.NodeType)
				{
				case XmlNodeType.Element:
					switch (num)
					{
					case 2:
						properties.SetValue(category + "Blend", LoadBlend());
						break;
					case 3:
						LoadPoint(category + "Center", "", properties);
						break;
					case 4:
						LoadPoint(category + "Focus", "", properties);
						break;
					case 5:
						LoadRectangle(category + "Rectangle", "", properties);
						break;
					case 6:
						LoadMatrix(category + "Transform", "", properties);
						break;
					}
					break;
				case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
					if (num == 1)
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadBrushes()
		{
			if (_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (Next())
			{
				if (!_brushesSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
				{
					continue;
				}
				short num = _brushesSymbols[_reader.Name];
				switch (_reader.NodeType)
				{

		private void LoadChain(IChain chain)
		{
			if (_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (Next())
			{
				if (!_chainSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
				{
					continue;
				}
				short num = _chainSymbols[_reader.Name];
				switch (_reader.NodeType)
				{
				case XmlNodeType.Element:
					switch (num)
					{
					case 2:
						LoadQuickText(chain.AddQuickText(GetAttribute("Content", (string)null)));
						break;
					case 3:
					{
						string attribute2 = GetAttribute("Source", (string)null);
						Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.ImageConverter converter2 = LoadImageConverter(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Converter", (string)null)));
						ImageCompressor compressor2 = LoadImageCompressor(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Compressor", (string)null)));
						Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image2 = GetImage(attribute2, converter2, compressor2);
						LoadQuickImage(chain.AddQuickImage(image2));
						break;
					}
					case 4:
						LoadQuickList(chain.AddQuickList());
						break;
					case 5:
						LoadQuickTable(chain.AddQuickTable());
						break;
					case 6:
						LoadText(chain.AddText());
						break;
					case 7:
					{
						string attribute = GetAttribute("Source", (string)null);
						Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.ImageConverter converter = LoadImageConverter(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Converter", (string)null)));
						ImageCompressor compressor = LoadImageCompressor(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Compressor", (string)null)));
						Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image = GetImage(attribute, converter, compressor);
						LoadImage(chain.AddImage(image));
						break;
					}
					case 8:
						LoadMetafile(chain.AddMetafile(GetMetafile(GetAttribute("Source", (string)null))));
						break;
					case 9:
						LoadRule(chain.AddRule());
						break;
					case 10:
						LoadGap(chain.AddGap());
						break;
					case 11:
						LoadGroup(chain.AddGroup());
						break;
					case 12:
						LoadBand(chain.AddBand());
						break;
					case 13:
						LoadTable(chain.AddTable());
						break;
					case 14:
						LoadGrid(chain.AddGrid());
						break;
					case 15:
						LoadFlow(chain.AddFlow());
						break;
					case 16:
						LoadList(chain.AddList());
						break;
					case 17:
						LoadTree(chain.AddTree());
						break;
					case 18:
						LoadSite(chain.AddSite());
						break;
					case 19:
						LoadCanvas(chain.AddCanvas());
						break;
					case 20:
						LoadContainer(chain.AddContainer(GetAttribute("Name", (string)null)));
						break;
					case 21:
						LoadCondition(chain.AddCondition(_containers[GetAttribute("Container", (string)null)], GetAttribute("Fit", defaultValue: false)));
						break;
					case 22:
						LoadStretcher(chain.AddStretcher());
						break;
					case 23:
						LoadTOC(chain.AddTOC());
						break;
					case 24:
						LoadIndex(chain.AddIndex());
						break;
					}
					break;
				case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
					if (num == 1)
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadColor()
		{
			string attribute = GetAttribute("Id", (string)null);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(attribute) || _linkedColors.ContainsKey(attribute))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Id");
			}
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color attribute2 = GetAttribute("Value", Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Colors.Black);
			_linkedColors.Add(attribute, attribute2);
		}

		private void LoadColors()
		{
			if (_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (Next())
			{
				if (!_colorsSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
				{
					continue;
				}
				short num = _colorsSymbols[_reader.Name];
				switch (_reader.NodeType)
				{
				case XmlNodeType.Element:
					if (num == 2)
					{
						LoadColor();
					}
					break;
				case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
					if (num == 1)
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadContainer(IContainer container)
		{
			if (!_containers.ContainsKey(container.Name))
			{
				_containers.Add(container.Name, container);
			}
			if (_report.Callback != null)
			{
				_report.Callback.OnContainer(container);
			}
			container.Width = LoadWidth(container.Width);
			container.Height = LoadHeight(container.Height);
			PropertyCollection properties = new PropertyCollection();
			LoadAlignment("Alignment", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Alignment", (string)null)));
			LoadAlignment("Alignment", "Alignment", properties);
			LoadBorders("Borders", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Borders", (string)null)));
			LoadBorders("Borders", "Borders", properties);
			LoadMargins("Margins", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Margins", (string)null)));
			LoadMargins("Margins", "Margins", properties);
			LoadPaddings("Paddings", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Paddings", (string)null)));
			LoadPaddings("Paddings", "Paddings", properties);
			LoadBackground("Background", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Background", (string)null)));
			LoadBackground("Background", "Background", properties);
			if (!_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				while (flag)
				{
					if (!Next())
					{
						return;
					}
					if (!_containerSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
					{
						continue;
					}
					short num = _containerSymbols[_reader.Name];
					switch (_reader.NodeType)
					{
					case XmlNodeType.Element:
						switch (num)
						{
						case 1:
							LoadContainer(container.AddContainer(GetAttribute("Name", (string)null)));
							break;
						case 2:
							LoadAlignment("Alignment", "", properties);
							break;
						case 3:
							LoadBorders("Borders", "", properties);
							break;
						case 4:
							LoadMargins("Margins", "", properties);
							break;
						case 5:
							LoadPaddings("Paddings", "", properties);
							break;
						case 6:
							LoadBackground("Background", "", properties);
							break;
						case 7:
							LoadQuickText(container.AddQuickText(GetAttribute("Content", (string)null)));
							break;
						case 8:
						{
							string attribute2 = GetAttribute("Source", (string)null);
							Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.ImageConverter converter2 = LoadImageConverter(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Converter", (string)null)));

		private void LoadCorner(string category, PropertyCollection properties, string[] values)
		{
			if (values == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = values.Length;
			if (num != 0)
			{
				LoadPen(category, properties, values);
				if (num == 4 && !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.LineCap), values[3]))
				{
					category += ".";
					properties.SetValue(category + "Radius", Converter.ToPoints(values[3]));
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadCorner(string category, string path, PropertyCollection properties)
		{
			LoadPen(category, path, properties);
			category += ".";
			if (path.Length > 0)
			{
				path += ".";
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Radius"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Radius", GetAttribute(path + "Radius", 0f));
			}
		}

		private void LoadCorners(string category, PropertyCollection properties, string[] values)
		{
			if (values != null && values.Length != 0)
			{
				category += ".";
				LoadCorner(category + "TopLeft", properties, values);
				LoadCorner(category + "TopRight", properties, values);
				LoadCorner(category + "BottomLeft", properties, values);
				LoadCorner(category + "BottomRight", properties, values);
			}
		}

		private void LoadCorners(string category, string path, PropertyCollection properties)
		{
			category += ".";
			LoadCorner(category + "TopLeft", path, properties);
			LoadCorner(category + "TopRight", path, properties);
			LoadCorner(category + "BottomLeft", path, properties);
			LoadCorner(category + "BottomRight", path, properties);
			if (path.Length > 0)
			{
				path += ".";
			}
			LoadCorner(category + "TopLeft", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute(path + "TopLeft", (string)null)));
			LoadCorner(category + "TopLeft", path + "TopLeft", properties);
			LoadCorner(category + "TopRight", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute(path + "TopRight", (string)null)));
			LoadCorner(category + "TopRight", path + "TopRight", properties);
			LoadCorner(category + "BottomLeft", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute(path + "BottomLeft", (string)null)));
			LoadCorner(category + "BottomLeft", path + "BottomLeft", properties);
			LoadCorner(category + "BottomRight", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute(path + "BottomRight", (string)null)));
			LoadCorner(category + "BottomRight", path + "BottomRight", properties);
			if (_reader.IsEmptyElement || path.Length != 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (Next())
			{
				if (!_cornersSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
				{
					continue;
				}
				short num = _cornersSymbols[_reader.Name];
				switch (_reader.NodeType)
				{
				case XmlNodeType.Element:
					switch (num)
					{
					case 2:
						LoadCorner(category + "TopLeft", path, properties);
						break;
					case 3:
						LoadCorner(category + "TopRight", path, properties);
						break;
					case 4:
						LoadCorner(category + "BottomLeft", path, properties);
						break;
					case 5:
						LoadCorner(category + "BottomRight", path, properties);
						break;
					}
					break;
				case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
					if (num == 1)
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadFlow(IFlow flow)
		{
			string attribute = GetAttribute("Pattern", (string)null);
			if (attribute != null && _flowPatterns.ContainsKey(attribute))
			{
				flow.ApplyPattern(_flowPatterns[attribute]);
			}
			flow.Width = LoadWidth(flow.Width);
			flow.Height = LoadHeight(flow.Height);
			flow.KeepSolid = GetAttribute("KeepSolid", flow.KeepSolid);
			PropertyCollection properties = new PropertyCollection();
			LoadAlignment("Alignment", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Alignment", (string)null)));
			LoadAlignment("Alignment", "Alignment", properties);
			if (ContainsAttribute("Borders", "Default"))
			{
				flow.Borders = new Borders();
			}
			else
			{
				LoadBorders("Borders", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Borders", (string)null)));
			}
			if (!ContainsAttribute("Margins", "Default"))
			{
				LoadMargins("Margins", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Margins", (string)null)));
			}
			if (!ContainsAttribute("Paddings", "Default"))
			{
				LoadPaddings("Paddings", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Paddings", (string)null)));
			}
			if (!ContainsAttribute("Background", "Default"))
			{
				LoadBackground("Background", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Background", (string)null)));
			}
			LoadBorders("Borders", "Borders", properties);
			LoadMargins("Margins", "Margins", properties);
			LoadPaddings("Paddings", "Paddings", properties);
			LoadBackground("Background", "Background", properties);
			if (!_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				bool flag = true;

					if (!Next())
					{
						return;
					}
					if (!_flowSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
					{
						continue;
					}

					switch (_reader.NodeType)
					{

							break;
						case 9:
							flow.AddRowBreak();
							break;
						case 10:
							LoadQuickText(flow.AddQuickText(GetAttribute("Content", (string)null)));
							break;
						case 11:

							ImageCompressor compressor2 = LoadImageCompressor(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Compressor", (string)null)));
							Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image2 = GetImage(attribute3, converter2, compressor2);
							LoadQuickImage(flow.AddQuickImage(image2));
							break;
						}
						case 12:
							LoadQuickList(flow.AddQuickList());
							break;
						case 13:
							LoadQuickTable(flow.AddQuickTable());
							break;
						case 14:
							LoadText(flow.AddText());
							break;
						case 15:

							string attribute2 = GetAttribute("Source", (string)null);

							ImageCompressor compressor = LoadImageCompressor(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Compressor", (string)null)));
							Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image = GetImage(attribute2, converter, compressor);
							LoadImage(flow.AddImage(image));

						case 16:
							LoadMetafile(flow.AddMetafile(GetMetafile(GetAttribute("Source", (string)null))));
							break;
						case 17:
							LoadRule(flow.AddRule());
							break;
						case 18:

							break;
						case 19:
							LoadGroup(flow.AddGroup());
							break;
						case 20:
							LoadChain(flow.AddChain());
							break;
						case 21:
							LoadBand(flow.AddBand());
							break;

							break;

							break;

							break;

							break;

							LoadMargins("Margins", "", properties);
							break;
						case 5:
							LoadPaddings("Paddings", "", properties);
							break;
						case 6:
							LoadBackground("Background", "", properties);
							break;
						}
						break;
					case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
						if (num == 1)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			ContentAlignment contentAlignment = GetContentAlignment("Alignment", properties);
			Borders borders = GetBorders("Borders", properties);
			Margins margins = GetMargins("Margins", properties);
			Paddings paddings = GetPaddings("Paddings", properties);
			Background background = GetBackground("Background", properties);
			if (contentAlignment != null)
			{
				column.Alignment = contentAlignment;
			}
			if (borders != null)
			{
				column.Borders = borders;
			}
			if (margins != null)
			{
				column.Margins = margins;
			}
			if (paddings != null)
			{
				column.Paddings = paddings;
			}
			if (background != null)
			{
				column.Background = background;
			}
		}

		private void LoadFlowPattern()
		{
			string attribute = GetAttribute("Id", (string)null);
			FlowPattern flowPattern = new FlowPattern();
			PropertyCollection properties = new PropertyCollection();
			LoadAlignment("Alignment", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Alignment", (string)null)));
			LoadAlignment("Alignment", "Alignment", properties);
			LoadBorders("Borders", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Borders", (string)null)));
			LoadBorders("Borders", "Borders", properties);
			LoadMargins("Margins", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Margins", (string)null)));
			LoadMargins("Margins", "Margins", properties);
			LoadPaddings("Paddings", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Paddings", (string)null)));
			LoadPaddings("Paddings", "Paddings", properties);
			LoadBackground("Background", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Background", (string)null)));
			LoadBackground("Background", "Background", properties);
			if (!_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				while (flag)
				{
					if (!Next())
					{
						return;
					}
					if (!_flowPatternSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
					{
						continue;
					}
					short num = _flowPatternSymbols[_reader.Name];
					switch (_reader.NodeType)
					{
					case XmlNodeType.Element:
						switch (num)
						{
						case 2:
							LoadAlignment("Alignment", "", properties);
							break;
						case 3:
							LoadBorders("Borders", "", properties);
							break;
						case 4:
							LoadMargins("Margins", "", properties);
							break;
						case 5:
							LoadPaddings("Paddings", "", properties);
							break;
						case 6:
							LoadBackground("Background", "", properties);
							break;
						case 7:
							LoadFlowColumnPattern(flowPattern.Column);
							break;
						}
						break;
					case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
						if (num == 1)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			ContentAlignment contentAlignment = GetContentAlignment("Alignment", properties);
			Borders borders = GetBorders("Borders", properties);
			Margins margins = GetMargins("Margins", properties);
			Paddings paddings = GetPaddings("Paddings", properties);
			Background background = GetBackground("Background", properties);
			if (contentAlignment != null)
			{

			}
			if (borders != null)
			{
				flowPattern.Borders = borders;
			}
			if (margins != null)
			{
				flowPattern.Margins = margins;
			}
			if (paddings != null)
			{
				flowPattern.Paddings = paddings;
			}
			if (background != null)
			{
				flowPattern.Background = background;
			}
			_flowPatterns.Add(attribute, flowPattern);

		private void LoadFont()
		{
			string attribute = GetAttribute("Id", (string)null);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(attribute) || _linkedFonts.ContainsKey(attribute))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Id");
			}
			PropertyCollection properties = new PropertyCollection();
			LoadFont("Font", "", properties);
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font font = GetFont("Font", properties);
			if (font != null)
			{
				_linkedFonts.Add(attribute, font);
			}
		}

		private void LoadFont(string category, PropertyCollection properties, string[] values)
		{
			if (values == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = values.Length;
			if (num == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			category += ".";
			string text = values[0];
			if (text[0] == '#')
			{
				string text2 = text.Substring(1);
				if (_linkedFonts.ContainsKey(text2))
				{
					properties.SetValue(category + "Id", text2);
					return;
				}
			}
			properties.SetValue(category + "Name", text);
			if (num != 1)
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Size", Converter.ToPoints(values[1]));
				for (int i = 2; i < num; i++)
				{
					properties.SetValue(category + values[i], value: true);
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadFont(string category, string path, PropertyCollection properties)
		{
			category += ".";
			if (properties.ContainsKey(category + "Id"))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (path.Length > 0)
			{
				path += ".";
			}
			string attribute = GetAttribute(path + "Reference", (string)null);
			if (attribute != null)
			{
				string text = attribute.Substring(1);
				if (_linkedFonts.ContainsKey(text))
				{
					properties.SetValue(category + "Id", text);
				}
				return;
			}
			LoadFontStyle(category, properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute(path + "Style", (string)null)));
			properties.SetValue(category + "Source", GetAttribute(path + "Source", properties.GetValue(category + "Source", (string)null)));
			properties.SetValue(category + "Name", GetAttribute(path + "Name", properties.GetValue(category + "Name", "Arial")));
			properties.SetValue(category + "Size", GetAttribute(path + "Size", properties.GetValue(category + "Size", 12f)));
			properties.SetValue(category + "Bold", GetAttribute(path + "Bold", properties.GetValue(category + "Bold", defaultValue: false)));
			properties.SetValue(category + "Italic", GetAttribute(path + "Italic", properties.GetValue(category + "Italic", defaultValue: false)));
			properties.SetValue(category + "Strikeout", GetAttribute(path + "Strikeout", properties.GetValue(category + "Strikeout", defaultValue: false)));
			properties.SetValue(category + "DoubleStrikeout", GetAttribute(path + "DoubleStrikeout", properties.GetValue(category + "DoubleStrikeout", defaultValue: false)));
			properties.SetValue(category + "Underline", GetAttribute(path + "Underline", properties.GetValue(category + "Underline", defaultValue: false)));
			properties.SetValue(category + "DoubleUnderline", GetAttribute(path + "DoubleUnderline", properties.GetValue(category + "DoubleUnderline", defaultValue: false)));
			properties.SetValue(category + "Subscript", GetAttribute(path + "Subscript", properties.GetValue(category + "Subscript", defaultValue: false)));
			properties.SetValue(category + "Superscript", GetAttribute(path + "Superscript", properties.GetValue(category + "Superscript", defaultValue: false)));
			properties.SetValue(category + "AllCaps", GetAttribute(path + "AllCaps", properties.GetValue(category + "AllCaps", defaultValue: false)));
			properties.SetValue(category + "SmallCaps", GetAttribute(path + "SmallCaps", properties.GetValue(category + "SmallCaps", defaultValue: false)));
			properties.SetValue(category + "Sealed", GetAttribute(path + "Sealed", properties.GetValue(category + "Sealed", defaultValue: false)));
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Embed"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Embed", GetAttribute(path + "Embed", properties.GetValue(category + "Embed", defaultValue: false)));
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Subset"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Subset", GetAttribute(path + "Subset", properties.GetValue(category + "Subset", defaultValue: false)));
			}
		}

		private void LoadFonts()
		{
			if (_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (Next())
			{
				if (!_fontsSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
				{
					continue;
				}
				short num = _fontsSymbols[_reader.Name];
				switch (_reader.NodeType)
				{
				case XmlNodeType.Element:
					if (num == 2)
					{
						LoadFont();
					}
					break;
				case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
					if (num == 1)
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void LoadFontStyle(string category, PropertyCollection properties, string[] values)
		{
			if (values != null)
			{
				foreach (string text in values)
				{
					properties.SetValue(category + text, value: true);
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadFooter(ISectionFooter footer)
		{
			footer.Height = GetAttribute("Height", 0f);
			footer.Repeat = GetAttribute("Repeat", footer.Repeat);
			if (_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (Next())
			{
				if (!_footerSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
				{
					continue;
				}
				short num = _footerSymbols[_reader.Name];
				switch (_reader.NodeType)
				{
				case XmlNodeType.Element:
					switch (num)
					{
					case 2:
						LoadText(footer.AddText(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
						break;
					case 3:
					{
						string attribute = GetAttribute("Source", (string)null);
						Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.ImageConverter converter = LoadImageConverter(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Converter", (string)null)));
						ImageCompressor compressor = LoadImageCompressor(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Compressor", (string)null)));
						Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image = GetImage(attribute, converter, compressor);
						LoadImage(footer.AddImage(image, GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
						break;
					}
					case 4:
						LoadMetafile(footer.AddMetafile(GetMetafile(GetAttribute("Source", (string)null)), GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
						break;
					case 5:
						LoadRule(footer.AddRule(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
						break;
					case 6:
						LoadGroup(footer.AddGroup(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
						break;
					case 7:
						LoadBand(footer.AddBand(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
						break;
					case 8:
						LoadTable(footer.AddTable(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
						break;
					case 9:
						LoadGrid(footer.AddGrid(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
						break;
					case 10:
						LoadFlow(footer.AddFlow(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
						break;
					case 11:
						LoadList(footer.AddList(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
						break;
					case 12:
						LoadTree(footer.AddTree(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
						break;
					case 13:
						LoadSite(footer.AddSite(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
						break;
					case 14:
						LoadLabel(footer.Shapes.AddLabel());
						break;
					case 15:
						LoadLine(footer.Shapes.AddLine());
						break;
					case 16:
						LoadPolyline(footer.Shapes.AddPolyline());
						break;
					case 17:
						LoadPolygon(footer.Shapes.AddPolygon());
						break;
					case 18:
						LoadRectangle(footer.Shapes.AddRectangle());
						break;
					case 19:
						LoadEllipse(footer.Shapes.AddEllipse());
						break;
					case 20:
						LoadArc(footer.Shapes.AddArc());
						break;
					case 21:
						LoadPie(footer.Shapes.AddPie());
						break;
					case 22:
						LoadPath(footer.Shapes.AddPath());
						break;
					case 23:
						LoadCanvas(footer.AddCanvas(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
						break;
					}
					break;
				case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
					if (num == 1)
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		}

		private void LoadGrid(IGrid grid)
		{
			string attribute = GetAttribute("Pattern", (string)null);
			if (attribute != null && _gridPatterns.ContainsKey(attribute))
			{
				grid.ApplyPattern(_gridPatterns[attribute]);
			}
			grid.Width = LoadWidth(grid.Width);
			grid.Height = LoadHeight(grid.Height);
			grid.KeepSolid = GetAttribute("KeepSolid", grid.KeepSolid);
			grid.Stretch = GetAttribute("Stretch", grid.Stretch);
			PropertyCollection properties = new PropertyCollection();
			if (ContainsAttribute("Borders", "Default"))
			{
				grid.Borders = new Borders();
			}
			else
			{
				LoadBorders("Borders", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Borders", (string)null)));
			}
			if (!ContainsAttribute("Margins", "Default"))
			{
				LoadMargins("Margins", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Margins", (string)null)));
			}
			if (!ContainsAttribute("Paddings", "Default"))
			{
				LoadPaddings("Paddings", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Paddings", (string)null)));
			}
			if (!ContainsAttribute("Background", "Default"))
			{
				LoadBackground("Background", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Background", (string)null)));
			}
			LoadBorders("Borders", "Borders", properties);
			LoadMargins("Margins", "Margins", properties);
			LoadPaddings("Paddings", "Paddings", properties);
			LoadBackground("Background", "Background", properties);
			if (!_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				while (flag)
				{
					if (!Next())
					{
						return;
					}
					if (!_gridSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
					{
						continue;
					}
					short num = _gridSymbols[_reader.Name];
					switch (_reader.NodeType)
					{
					case XmlNodeType.Element:
						switch (num)
						{
						case 2:
							LoadGridHeader(grid.Header);
							break;
						case 3:
							LoadGridFooter(grid.Footer);
							break;
						case 4:
							LoadGridDivider(grid.Divider);
							break;
						case 5:
							LoadBorders("Borders", "", properties);
							break;
						case 6:
							LoadMargins("Margins", "", properties);
							break;
						case 7:
							LoadPaddings("Paddings", "", properties);
							break;
						case 8:
							LoadBackground("Background", "", properties);
							break;
						case 9:
							LoadGridColumn(grid.AddColumn());
							break;
						case 10:
							LoadGridRow(grid.AddRow());
							break;
						}
						break;
					case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
						if (num == 1)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			Borders borders = GetBorders("Borders", properties);
			Margins margins = GetMargins("Margins", properties);
			Paddings paddings = GetPaddings("Paddings", properties);
			Background background = GetBackground("Background", properties);
			if (borders != null)
			{
				grid.Borders = borders;
			}
			if (margins != null)
			{
				grid.Margins = margins;
			}
			if (paddings != null)
			{
				grid.Paddings = paddings;
			}
			if (background != null)
			{
				grid.Background = background;
			}
		}

		private void LoadGridCellPattern(GridCellPattern cell)
		{
			PropertyCollection properties = new PropertyCollection();
			LoadAlignment("Alignment", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Alignment", (string)null)));
			LoadAlignment("Alignment", "Alignment", properties);
			LoadBorders("Borders", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Borders", (string)null)));
			LoadBorders("Borders", "Borders", properties);
			LoadPaddings("Paddings", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Paddings", (string)null)));
			LoadPaddings("Paddings", "Paddings", properties);
			LoadBackground("Background", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Background", (string)null)));
			LoadBackground("Background", "Background", properties);
			if (!_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				while (flag)
				{
					if (!Next())
					{
						return;
					}
					if (!_gridCellPatternSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
					{
						continue;
					}
					short num = _gridCellPatternSymbols[_reader.Name];
					switch (_reader.NodeType)
					{
					case XmlNodeType.Element:
						switch (num)
						{
						case 2:

		private void LoadGridPattern()
		{
			string attribute = GetAttribute("Id", (string)null);
			GridPattern gridPattern = new GridPattern();
			PropertyCollection properties = new PropertyCollection();
			LoadBorders("Borders", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Borders", (string)null)));
			LoadBorders("Borders", "Borders", properties);
			LoadMargins("Margins", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Margins", (string)null)));
			LoadMargins("Margins", "Margins", properties);
			LoadPaddings("Paddings", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Paddings", (string)null)));
			LoadPaddings("Paddings", "Paddings", properties);
			LoadBackground("Background", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Background", (string)null)));
			LoadBackground("Background", "Background", properties);
			if (!_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				while (flag)
				{
					if (!Next())
					{
						return;
					}
					if (!_gridPatternSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
					{
						continue;
					}
					short num = _gridPatternSymbols[_reader.Name];
					switch (_reader.NodeType)
					{
					case XmlNodeType.Element:
						switch (num)
						{
						case 2:
							LoadGridHeaderPattern(gridPattern.Header);
							break;
						case 3:
							LoadGridFooterPattern(gridPattern.Footer);
							break;
						case 4:
							LoadGridDividerPattern(gridPattern.Divider);
							break;
						case 5:
							LoadBorders("Borders", "", properties);
							break;
						case 6:
							LoadMargins("Margins", "", properties);
							break;
						case 7:
							LoadPaddings("Paddings", "", properties);
							break;
						case 8:
							LoadBackground("Background", "", properties);
							break;
						case 9:
							LoadGridColumnPattern(gridPattern.Column);
							break;
						case 10:
							LoadGridRowPattern(gridPattern.Row);
							break;
						}
						break;
					case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
						if (num == 1)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			Borders borders = GetBorders("Borders", properties);
			Margins margins = GetMargins("Margins", properties);
			Paddings paddings = GetPaddings("Paddings", properties);
			Background background = GetBackground("Background", properties);
			if (borders != null)
			{
				gridPattern.Borders = borders;
			}
			if (margins != null)
			{
				gridPattern.Margins = margins;
			}
			if (paddings != null)
			{
				gridPattern.Paddings = paddings;
			}
			if (background != null)
			{
				gridPattern.Background = background;
			}
			_gridPatterns.Add(attribute, gridPattern);
		}

		private void LoadGroup(IGroup group)
		{
			group.Layout = (Layout)Enum.Parse(typeof(Layout), GetAttribute("Layout", "Vertical"), ignoreCase: false);
			group.Width = LoadWidth(group.Width);
			group.Height = LoadHeight(group.Height);
			group.KeepSolid = GetAttribute("KeepSolid", group.KeepSolid);
			PropertyCollection properties = new PropertyCollection();
			LoadAlignment("Alignment", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Alignment", (string)null)));
			LoadAlignment("Alignment", "Alignment", properties);
			LoadBorders("Borders", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Borders", (string)null)));
			LoadBorders("Borders", "Borders", properties);
			LoadMargins("Margins", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Margins", (string)null)));
			LoadMargins("Margins", "Margins", properties);
			LoadPaddings("Paddings", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Paddings", (string)null)));
			LoadPaddings("Paddings", "Paddings", properties);
			LoadBackground("Background", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Background", (string)null)));
			LoadBackground("Background", "Background", properties);
			if (!_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				while (flag)
				{
					if (!Next())
					{
						return;
					}
					if (!_groupSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
					{
						continue;
					}
					short num = _groupSymbols[_reader.Name];
					switch (_reader.NodeType)
					{
					case XmlNodeType.Element:
						switch (num)
						{
						case 1:
							LoadGroup(group.AddGroup());
							break;
						case 2:
							LoadAlignment("Alignment", "", properties);
							break;
						case 3:
							LoadBorders("Borders", "", properties);
							break;
						case 4:
							LoadMargins("Margins", "", properties);
							break;
						case 5:
							LoadPaddings("Paddings", "", properties);
							break;
						case 6:
							LoadBackground("Background", "", properties);
							break;
						case 7:
							LoadQuickText(group.AddQuickText(GetAttribute("Content", (string)null)));
							break;
						case 8:
						{
							string attribute2 = GetAttribute("Source", (string)null);
							Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.ImageConverter converter2 = LoadImageConverter(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Converter", (string)null)));
							ImageCompressor compressor2 = LoadImageCompressor(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Compressor", (string)null)));
							Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image2 = GetImage(attribute2, converter2, compressor2);
							LoadQuickImage(group.AddQuickImage(image2));
							break;
						}
						case 9:
							LoadQuickList(group.AddQuickList());
							break;
						case 10:
							LoadQuickTable(group.AddQuickTable());
							break;
						case 11:
							LoadText(group.AddText());
							break;
						case 12:
						{
							string attribute = GetAttribute("Source", (string)null);
							Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.ImageConverter converter = LoadImageConverter(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Converter", (string)null)));
							ImageCompressor compressor = LoadImageCompressor(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Compressor", (string)null)));
							Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image = GetImage(attribute, converter, compressor);
							LoadImage(group.AddImage(image));
							break;
						}
						case 13:
							LoadMetafile(group.AddMetafile(GetMetafile(GetAttribute("Source", (string)null))));
							break;
						case 14:
							LoadRule(group.AddRule());
							break;
						case 15:
							LoadGap(group.AddGap());
							break;
						case 16:
							LoadChain(group.AddChain());
							break;
						case 17:
							LoadBand(group.AddBand());
							break;
						case 18:
							LoadTable(group.AddTable());
							break;
						case 19:
							LoadGrid(group.AddGrid());
							break;
						case 20:
							LoadFlow(group.AddFlow());
							break;
						case 21:
							LoadList(group.AddList());
							break;
						case 22:
							LoadTree(group.AddTree());
							break;
						case 23:
							LoadSite(group.AddSite());
							break;
						case 24:
							LoadCanvas(group.AddCanvas());
							break;
						case 25:
							LoadRotator(group.AddRotator());
							break;
						case 26:
							LoadContainer(group.AddContainer(GetAttribute("Name", (string)null)));
							break;
						case 27:
							LoadCondition(group.AddCondition(_containers[GetAttribute("Container", (string)null)], GetAttribute("Fit", defaultValue: false)));
							break;
						case 28:
							LoadStretcher(group.AddStretcher());
							break;
						case 29:
							group.AddDummy();
							break;
						case 30:
							group.AddPageBreak();
							break;
						case 31:
							LoadTOC(group.AddTOC());
							break;
						case 32:
							LoadIndex(group.AddIndex());
							break;
						}
						break;
					case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
						if (num == 1)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			ContentAlignment contentAlignment = GetContentAlignment("Alignment", properties);
			Borders borders = GetBorders("Borders", properties);
			Margins margins = GetMargins("Margins", properties);
			Paddings paddings = GetPaddings("Paddings", properties);
			Background background = GetBackground("Background", properties);
			if (contentAlignment != null)
			{
				group.Alignment = contentAlignment;
			}
			if (borders != null)
			{
				group.Borders = borders;
			}
			if (margins != null)
			{
				group.Margins = margins;
			}
			if (paddings != null)
			{
				group.Paddings = paddings;
			}
			if (background != null)
			{
				group.Background = background;
			}
		}

		private void LoadHeader(ISectionHeader header)
		{
			header.Height = GetAttribute("Height", 0f);
			header.Repeat = GetAttribute("Repeat", header.Repeat);
			if (_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (Next())
			{
				if (!_headerSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
				{
					continue;
				}
				short num = _headerSymbols[_reader.Name];
				switch (_reader.NodeType)
				{
				case XmlNodeType.Element:
					switch (num)
					{
					case 2:
						LoadText(header.AddText(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
						break;
					case 3:
					{
						string attribute = GetAttribute("Source", (string)null);
						Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.ImageConverter converter = LoadImageConverter(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Converter", (string)null)));
						ImageCompressor compressor = LoadImageCompressor(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Compressor", (string)null)));
						Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image = GetImage(attribute, converter, compressor);
						LoadImage(header.AddImage(image, GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
						break;
					}
					case 4:
						LoadMetafile(header.AddMetafile(GetMetafile(GetAttribute("Source", (string)null)), GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
						break;
					case 5:
						LoadRule(header.AddRule(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
						break;
					case 6:
						LoadGroup(header.AddGroup(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
						break;
					case 7:
						LoadBand(header.AddBand(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
						break;
					case 8:
						LoadTable(header.AddTable(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
						break;
					case 9:
						LoadGrid(header.AddGrid(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
						break;
					case 10:
						LoadFlow(header.AddFlow(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
						break;
					case 11:
						LoadList(header.AddList(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
						break;
					case 12:
						LoadTree(header.AddTree(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
						break;
					case 13:
						LoadSite(header.AddSite(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
						break;
					case 14:
						LoadLabel(header.Shapes.AddLabel());
						break;
					case 15:
						LoadLine(header.Shapes.AddLine());
						break;
					case 16:
						LoadPolyline(header.Shapes.AddPolyline());
						break;
					case 17:
						LoadPolygon(header.Shapes.AddPolygon());
						break;
					case 18:
						LoadRectangle(header.Shapes.AddRectangle());
						break;
					case 19:
						LoadEllipse(header.Shapes.AddEllipse());
						break;
					case 20:
						LoadArc(header.Shapes.AddArc());
						break;
					case 21:
						LoadPie(header.Shapes.AddPie());
						break;
					case 22:
						LoadPath(header.Shapes.AddPath());
						break;
					case 23:
						LoadCanvas(header.AddCanvas(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
						break;
					}
					break;
				case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
					if (num == 1)
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private Height LoadHeight(Height defaultValue)
		{
			string attribute = _reader.GetAttribute("Height");
			if (attribute != null)
			{
				if (attribute.Equals("Max"))
				{
					return MaxHeight.Instance;
				}
				if (attribute.Equals("Auto"))
				{
					return AutoHeight.Instance;
				}
				if (attribute.EndsWith("]"))
				{
					int length = attribute.IndexOf('%');
					int num = attribute.IndexOf('[');
					string value = attribute.Substring(0, length).Trim();
					string data = attribute.Substring(num + 1, attribute.Length - num - 2).Trim();
					string[] array = Converter.Split(data);
					return new RelativeHeight(Convert.ToSingle(value, Converter.NumberFormatInfo), Converter.ToPoints(array[0]), Converter.ToPoints(array[1]));
				}
				if (attribute.EndsWith("%"))
				{
					attribute = attribute.Substring(0, attribute.Length - 1);
					attribute = attribute.Trim();
					return new RelativeHeight(Convert.ToSingle(attribute, Converter.NumberFormatInfo));
				}
				return new FixedHeight(Converter.ToPoints(attribute));
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}

		private void LoadHorizontalBorders(string category, PropertyCollection properties, string[] values)
		{
			if (values != null && values.Length != 0)
			{
				LoadBorder(category + "Left", properties, values);
				LoadBorder(category + "Right", properties, values);
			}
		}

		private void LoadHorizontalBorders(string category, string path, PropertyCollection properties)
		{
			LoadBorder(category + "Left", path, properties);
			LoadBorder(category + "Right", path, properties);
		}

		private static void LoadHorizontalMargins(string category, PropertyCollection properties, string[] values)
		{
			if (values != null && values.Length != 0)
			{
				category += ".";
				switch (values.Length)
				{
				case 1:
					properties.SetValue(category + "Left", Converter.ToPoints(values[0]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "Right", Converter.ToPoints(values[0]));
					break;
				case 2:
					properties.SetValue(category + "Left", Converter.ToPoints(values[0]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "Right", Converter.ToPoints(values[1]));
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadHorizontalMargins(string category, string path, PropertyCollection properties)
		{
			category += ".";
			if (path.Length > 0)
			{
				path += ".";
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Left"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Left", GetAttribute(path + "Left", 0f));
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Right"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Right", GetAttribute(path + "Right", 0f));
			}
		}

		private void LoadImage(IImage image)
		{
			string attribute = GetAttribute("TransparentColor", (string)null);
			if (attribute != null)
			{
				image.SetTransparentColor(attribute);
			}
			image.Alpha = GetAttribute("Alpha", image.Alpha);
			image.KeepRatio = GetAttribute("KeepRatio", image.KeepRatio);
			image.Width = LoadWidth(image.Width);
			image.Height = LoadHeight(image.Height);
			PropertyCollection properties = new PropertyCollection();
			LoadBorders("Borders", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Borders", (string)null)));
			LoadBorders("Borders", "Borders", properties);
			LoadMargins("Margins", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Margins", (string)null)));
			LoadMargins("Margins", "Margins", properties);
			LoadPaddings("Paddings", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Paddings", (string)null)));
			LoadPaddings("Paddings", "Paddings", properties);
			LoadBackground("Background", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Background", (string)null)));
			LoadBackground("Background", "Background", properties);
			if (!_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				while (flag)
				{
					if (!Next())
					{
						return;
					}
					if (!_imageSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
					{
						continue;
					}
					short num = _imageSymbols[_reader.Name];
					switch (_reader.NodeType)
					{
					case XmlNodeType.Element:
						switch (num)
						{
						case 2:
							LoadBorders("Borders", "", properties);
							break;
						case 3:
							LoadMargins("Margins", "", properties);
							break;
						case 4:
							LoadPaddings("Paddings", "", properties);
							break;
						case 5:
							LoadBackground("Background", "", properties);
							break;
						}
						break;
					case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
						if (num == 1)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			Borders borders = GetBorders("Borders", properties);
			Margins margins = GetMargins("Margins", properties);
			Paddings paddings = GetPaddings("Paddings", properties);
			Background background = GetBackground("Background", properties);
			if (borders != null)
			{
				image.Borders = borders;
			}
			if (margins != null)
			{
				image.Margins = margins;
			}
			if (paddings != null)
			{
				image.Paddings = paddings;
			}
			if (background != null)
			{
				image.Background = background;
			}
		}

		private static ImageCompressor LoadImageCompressor(string[] values)
		{
			if (values == null || values.Length == 0)
			{
				return ImageCompressors.JPEG;
			}
			switch ((CompressorType)Enum.Parse(typeof(CompressorType), values[0], ignoreCase: false))
			{
			case CompressorType.JPEG:
				if (values.Length == 1)
				{
					return ImageCompressors.JPEG;
				}
				return new JPEGCompressor(Convert.ToInt32(values[1]));
			case CompressorType.Flate:
				return ImageCompressors.Flate;
			default:
				return ImageCompressors.JPEG;
			}
		}

		private static Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.ImageConverter LoadImageConverter(string[] values)
		{
			if (values == null || values.Length == 0)
			{
				return ImageConverters.RGB;
			}
			switch ((ConverterType)Enum.Parse(typeof(ConverterType), values[0], ignoreCase: false))
			{
			case ConverterType.RGB:
				return ImageConverters.RGB;
			case ConverterType.Grey:
				return ImageConverters.Grey;
			case ConverterType.BW:
				switch (values.Length)
				{
				case 1:
					return ImageConverters.BW;
				case 2:
					return new BWImageConverter(Convert.ToInt32(values[1]));
				case 3:
					return new BWImageConverter(Convert.ToInt32(values[1]), Convert.ToBoolean(values[2]));
				}
				break;
			}
			return ImageConverters.RGB;
		}

		private static void LoadIndents(string category, PropertyCollection properties, string[] values)
		{
			if (values != null && values.Length != 0)
			{
				category += ".";
				switch (values.Length)
				{
				case 1:
					properties.SetValue(category + "Left", Converter.ToPoints(values[0]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "Right", Converter.ToPoints(values[0]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "Top", Converter.ToPoints(values[0]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "Bottom", Converter.ToPoints(values[0]));
					break;
				case 2:
					properties.SetValue(category + "Left", Converter.ToPoints(values[0]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "Right", Converter.ToPoints(values[0]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "Top", Converter.ToPoints(values[1]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "Bottom", Converter.ToPoints(values[1]));
					break;
				case 4:
					properties.SetValue(category + "Left", Converter.ToPoints(values[0]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "Right", Converter.ToPoints(values[1]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "Top", Converter.ToPoints(values[2]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "Bottom", Converter.ToPoints(values[3]));
					break;
				case 3:
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadIndents(string category, string path, PropertyCollection properties)
		{
			category += ".";
			if (path.Length > 0)
			{
				path += ".";
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Horizontal"))
			{
				float attribute = GetAttribute(path + "Horizontal", 0f);
				properties.SetValue(category + "Left", attribute);
				properties.SetValue(category + "Right", attribute);
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Vertical"))
			{
				float attribute2 = GetAttribute(path + "Vertical", 0f);
				properties.SetValue(category + "Top", attribute2);
				properties.SetValue(category + "Bottom", attribute2);
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Left"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Left", GetAttribute(path + "Left", 0f));
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Right"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Right", GetAttribute(path + "Right", 0f));
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Top"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Top", GetAttribute(path + "Top", 0f));
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Bottom"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Bottom", GetAttribute(path + "Bottom", 0f));
			}
		}

		private void LoadIndex(IIndex index)
		{
			if (_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (Next())
			{
				if (!_indexSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
				{
					continue;
				}
				short num = _indexSymbols[_reader.Name];
				switch (_reader.NodeType)
				{
				case XmlNodeType.Element:
					switch (num)
					{
					case 2:
						LoadIndexAlphabet(index.Alphabet);
						break;
					case 3:
						LoadIndexLevel(index.AddLevel());
						break;
					}
					break;
				case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
					if (num == 1)
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadIndexAlphabet(IAlphabet alphabet)
		{
			alphabet.Style = LoadStyle(alphabet.Style);
			alphabet.Alignment = (AlphabetAlignment)Enum.Parse(typeof(AlphabetAlignment), GetAttribute("Alignment", alphabet.Alignment.ToString()), ignoreCase: false);
			PropertyCollection properties = new PropertyCollection();
			LoadIndents("Indents", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Indents", (string)null)));
			LoadIndents("Indents", "Indents", properties);
			if (!_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				while (flag)
				{
					if (!Next())
					{
						return;
					}
					if (!_indexAlphabetSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
					{
						continue;
					}
					short num = _indexAlphabetSymbols[_reader.Name];
					switch (_reader.NodeType)
					{
					case XmlNodeType.Element:
						if (num == 2)
						{
							LoadIndents("Indents", "", properties);
						}
						break;
					case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
						if (num == 1)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			Indents indents = GetIndents("Indents", properties);
			if (indents != null)
			{
				alphabet.Indents = indents;
			}
		}

		private void LoadInfo(IInfo info)
		{
			info.Title = GetAttribute("Title", info.Title);
			info.Subject = GetAttribute("Subject", info.Subject);
			info.Author = GetAttribute("Author", info.Author);
			info.Manager = GetAttribute("Manager", info.Manager);
			info.Company = GetAttribute("Company", info.Company);
			info.Creator = GetAttribute("Creator", info.Creator);
			info.Copyright = GetAttribute("Copyright", info.Copyright);
			info.Category = GetAttribute("Category", info.Category);
			info.Keywords = GetAttribute("Keywords", info.Keywords);
			info.Comments = GetAttribute("Comments", info.Comments);
			info.Created = GetAttribute("Created", info.Created);
			info.Modified = GetAttribute("Modified", info.Modified);
			if (_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (Next())
			{
				if (!_infoSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
				{
					continue;
				}
				short num = _infoSymbols[_reader.Name];
				switch (_reader.NodeType)
				{
				case XmlNodeType.Element:
					if (num == 2)
					{
						LoadInfoProperty(info);
					}
					break;
				case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
					if (num == 1)
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadItalicText(IText text, Style style, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Hyperlink hyperlink)
		{
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font font = style.Font;
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush brush = style.Brush;
			style = GetStyle(GetFont(font.Name, font.Size, font.Style | Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Italic, null), brush);
			if (_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (!_reader.EOF)
			{
				_reader.Read();
				switch (_reader.NodeType)
				{
				case XmlNodeType.Text:
				case XmlNodeType.Whitespace:
					text.AddContent(_reader.Value, style, hyperlink);
					break;
				case XmlNodeType.Element:
					if (_italicTextSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
					{
						switch (_italicTextSymbols[_reader.Name])
						{
						case 2:
							LoadBoldText(text, style, hyperlink);
							break;
						case 3:
							LoadUnderlinedText(text, style, hyperlink);
							break;
						case 4:
							LoadAllCapsText(text, style, hyperlink);
							break;
						case 5:
							LoadSmallCapsText(text, style, hyperlink);
							break;
						case 6:
							LoadTextInjector(text, style, hyperlink);
							break;
						}
					}
					break;
				case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
					if (_italicTextSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name) && _italicTextSymbols[_reader.Name] == 1)
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}
