		private void LoadList(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.List.IList list)
		{
			string attribute = GetAttribute("Pattern", (string)null);
			if (attribute != null && _listPatterns.ContainsKey(attribute))
			{
				list.ApplyPattern(_listPatterns[attribute]);
			}
			list.StartNumber = GetAttribute("StartNumber", list.StartNumber);
			list.Interval = GetAttribute("Interval", list.Interval);
			list.Width = LoadWidth(list.Width);
			list.Height = LoadHeight(list.Height);
			list.KeepSolid = GetAttribute("KeepSolid", list.KeepSolid);
			PropertyCollection properties = new PropertyCollection();
			if (ContainsAttribute("Bullets", "Default"))
			{
				list.Bullets = new Bullets();
			}
			else
			{
				LoadListBullets("Bullets", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Bullets", (string)null)));
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute("Borders", "Default"))
			{
				list.Borders = new Borders();
			}
			else
			{
				LoadBorders("Borders", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Borders", (string)null)));
			}
			if (!ContainsAttribute("Margins", "Default"))
			{
				LoadMargins("Margins", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Margins", (string)null)));
			}
			if (!ContainsAttribute("Paddings", "Default"))
			{
				LoadPaddings("Paddings", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Paddings", (string)null)));
			}
			if (!ContainsAttribute("Background", "Default"))
			{
				LoadBackground("Background", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Background", (string)null)));
			}
			LoadListBullets("Bullets", "Bullets", properties);
			LoadBorders("Borders", "Borders", properties);
			LoadMargins("Margins", "Margins", properties);
			LoadPaddings("Paddings", "Paddings", properties);
			LoadBackground("Background", "Background", properties);
			if (!_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				while (flag)
				{
					if (!Next())
					{
						return;
					}
					if (!_listSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
					{
						continue;
					}

					switch (_reader.NodeType)
					{
					case XmlNodeType.Element:
						switch (num)
						{
						case 2:
							LoadListBullets("Bullets", "", properties);
							break;
						case 3:
							LoadBorders("Borders", "", properties);
							break;
						case 4:
							LoadMargins("Margins", "", properties);
							break;
						case 5:
							LoadPaddings("Paddings", "", properties);
							break;
						case 6:
							LoadBackground("Background", "", properties);
							break;
						case 7:
							LoadListItem(list.AddItem());
							break;
						}
						break;
					case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
						if (num == 1)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			Bullets listBullets = GetListBullets("Bullets", properties);
			Borders borders = GetBorders("Borders", properties);

			Paddings paddings = GetPaddings("Paddings", properties);

			if (margins != null)
			{
				list.Margins = margins;
			}
			if (paddings != null)
			{

			}
			if (background != null)
			{
				list.Background = background;
			}
		}

		private static void LoadListBullets(string category, PropertyCollection properties, string[] values)

					properties.SetValue(category + "Style", values[1]);

				case 3:

					properties.SetValue(category + "Style", values[1]);
					properties.SetValue(category + "Indent", Converter.ToPoints(values[2]));
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadListItem(IListItem item)
		{
			item.KeepSolid = GetAttribute("KeepSolid", item.KeepSolid);
			item.KeepWithNext = GetAttribute("KeepWithNext", item.KeepWithNext);
			if (_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (Next())
			{
				if (!_listItemSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
				{
					continue;
				}
				short num = _listItemSymbols[_reader.Name];
				switch (_reader.NodeType)
				{
				case XmlNodeType.Element:
					switch (num)
					{
					case 2:
						LoadQuickText(item.AddQuickText(GetAttribute("Content", (string)null)));
						break;
					case 3:
					{
						string attribute2 = GetAttribute("Source", (string)null);
						Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.ImageConverter converter2 = LoadImageConverter(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Converter", (string)null)));
						ImageCompressor compressor2 = LoadImageCompressor(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Compressor", (string)null)));
						Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image2 = GetImage(attribute2, converter2, compressor2);
						LoadQuickImage(item.AddQuickImage(image2));
						break;
					}
					case 4:
						LoadQuickList(item.AddQuickList());
						break;
					case 5:
						LoadQuickTable(item.AddQuickTable());
						break;
					case 6:
						LoadText(item.AddText());
						break;
					case 7:
					{
						string attribute = GetAttribute("Source", (string)null);
						Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.ImageConverter converter = LoadImageConverter(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Converter", (string)null)));
						ImageCompressor compressor = LoadImageCompressor(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Compressor", (string)null)));
						Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image = GetImage(attribute, converter, compressor);
						LoadImage(item.AddImage(image));
						break;
					}
					case 8:
						LoadMetafile(item.AddMetafile(GetMetafile(GetAttribute("Source", (string)null))));
						break;
					case 9:
						LoadRule(item.AddRule());
						break;
					case 10:
						LoadGap(item.AddGap());
						break;
					case 11:
						LoadGroup(item.AddGroup());
						break;
					case 12:
						LoadChain(item.AddChain());
						break;
					case 13:
						LoadBand(item.AddBand());
						break;
					case 14:
						LoadTable(item.AddTable());
						break;
					case 15:
						LoadGrid(item.AddGrid());
						break;
					case 16:
						LoadFlow(item.AddFlow());
						break;
					case 17:
						LoadList(item.AddList());
						break;
					case 18:
						LoadTree(item.AddTree());
						break;
					case 19:
						LoadSite(item.AddSite());
						break;
					case 20:
						LoadCanvas(item.AddCanvas());
						break;
					case 21:
						LoadRotator(item.AddRotator());
						break;
					case 22:
						LoadContainer(item.AddContainer(GetAttribute("Name", (string)null)));
						break;
					case 23:
						LoadCondition(item.AddCondition(_containers[GetAttribute("Container", (string)null)], GetAttribute("Fit", defaultValue: false)));
						break;
					case 24:
						LoadStretcher(item.AddStretcher());
						break;
					case 25:
						item.AddDummy();
						break;
					case 26:
						item.AddPageBreak();
						break;
					case 27:
						LoadTOC(item.AddTOC());
						break;
					case 28:
						LoadIndex(item.AddIndex());
						break;
					}
					break;
				case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
					if (num == 1)
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

							break;

							LoadMargins("Margins", "", properties);

			Margins margins = GetMargins("Margins", properties);

		private static void LoadMatrix(string category, PropertyCollection properties, string[] values)
		{
			if (values != null && values.Length >= 6)
			{
				category += ".";
				properties.SetValue(category + "M11", Convert.ToSingle(values[0], Converter.NumberFormatInfo));
				properties.SetValue(category + "M12", Convert.ToSingle(values[1], Converter.NumberFormatInfo));
				properties.SetValue(category + "M21", Convert.ToSingle(values[2], Converter.NumberFormatInfo));
				properties.SetValue(category + "M22", Convert.ToSingle(values[3], Converter.NumberFormatInfo));
				properties.SetValue(category + "OffsetX", Converter.ToPoints(values[4]));
				properties.SetValue(category + "OffsetY", Converter.ToPoints(values[5]));
			}
		}

		private static void LoadPaddings(string category, PropertyCollection properties, string[] values)

					properties.SetValue(category + "Top", Converter.ToPoints(values[0]));

		private void LoadPaddings(string category, string path, PropertyCollection properties)
		{

				path += ".";

				float attribute = GetAttribute(path + "Horizontal", 0f);
				properties.SetValue(category + "Left", attribute);
				properties.SetValue(category + "Right", attribute);
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Vertical"))
			{
				float attribute2 = GetAttribute(path + "Vertical", 0f);
				properties.SetValue(category + "Top", attribute2);
				properties.SetValue(category + "Bottom", attribute2);
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Left"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Left", GetAttribute(path + "Left", 0f));
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Right"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Right", GetAttribute(path + "Right", 0f));
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Top"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Top", GetAttribute(path + "Top", 0f));
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Bottom"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Bottom", GetAttribute(path + "Bottom", 0f));
			}
		}

		private void LoadPage(ISectionPage page)
		{
			page.Blank = GetAttribute("Blank", defaultValue: false);
			page.Width = GetAttribute("Width", page.Width);
			page.Height = GetAttribute("Height", page.Height);
			PropertyCollection properties = new PropertyCollection();
			if (ContainsAttribute("Borders", "Default"))
			{
				page.Borders = new Borders();
			}
			else
			{
				LoadBorders("Borders", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Borders", (string)null)));
			}
			if (!ContainsAttribute("Margins", "Default"))
			{
				LoadMargins("Margins", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Margins", (string)null)));
			}
			if (!ContainsAttribute("Paddings", "Default"))
			{
				LoadPaddings("Paddings", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Paddings", (string)null)));
			}
			if (!ContainsAttribute("Background", "Default"))
			{
				LoadBackground("Background", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Background", (string)null)));
			}
			LoadBorders("Borders", "Borders", properties);
			LoadMargins("Margins", "Margins", properties);
			LoadPaddings("Paddings", "Paddings", properties);
			LoadBackground("Background", "Background", properties);
			if (!_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				while (flag)
				{
					if (!Next())
					{
						return;
					}
					if (!_pageSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
					{
						continue;
					}
					short num = _pageSymbols[_reader.Name];
					switch (_reader.NodeType)
					{
					case XmlNodeType.Element:
						switch (num)
						{
						case 2:
							LoadBorders("Borders", "", properties);
							break;
						case 3:
							LoadMargins("Margins", "", properties);
							break;
						case 4:
							LoadPaddings("Paddings", "", properties);
							break;
						case 5:
							LoadBackground("Background", "", properties);
							break;
						case 6:
							LoadText(page.AddText(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
							break;
						case 7:
						{
							string attribute = GetAttribute("Source", (string)null);

							ImageCompressor compressor = LoadImageCompressor(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Compressor", (string)null)));
							Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image = GetImage(attribute, converter, compressor);
							LoadImage(page.AddImage(image, GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
							break;
						}
						case 8:
							LoadMetafile(page.AddMetafile(GetMetafile(GetAttribute("Source", (string)null)), GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
							break;
						case 9:
							LoadRule(page.AddRule(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
							break;
						case 10:
							LoadGroup(page.AddGroup(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
							break;
						case 11:
							LoadBand(page.AddBand(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
							break;
						case 12:
							LoadTable(page.AddTable(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
							break;
						case 13:
							LoadGrid(page.AddGrid(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
							break;
						case 14:
							LoadFlow(page.AddFlow(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
							break;
						case 15:
							LoadList(page.AddList(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
							break;
						case 16:
							LoadTree(page.AddTree(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
							break;
						case 17:
							LoadSite(page.AddSite(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
							break;
						case 18:
							LoadLabel(page.Shapes.AddLabel());
							break;
						case 19:
							LoadLine(page.Shapes.AddLine());
							break;
						case 20:
							LoadPolyline(page.Shapes.AddPolyline());
							break;
						case 21:
							LoadPolygon(page.Shapes.AddPolygon());
							break;
						case 22:
							LoadRectangle(page.Shapes.AddRectangle());
							break;
						case 23:
							LoadEllipse(page.Shapes.AddEllipse());
							break;
						case 24:
							LoadArc(page.Shapes.AddArc());
							break;
						case 25:
							LoadPie(page.Shapes.AddPie());
							break;
						case 26:
							LoadPath(page.Shapes.AddPath());
							break;
						case 27:
							LoadCanvas(page.AddCanvas(GetAttribute("Left", 0f), GetAttribute("Top", 0f), GetAttribute("Angle", 0f)));
							break;
						}
						break;
					case XmlNodeType.EndElement:

			}

			}
		}

		private PageNumbering LoadPageNumbering()
		{
			PageNumbering pageNumbering = new PageNumbering();
			pageNumbering.Style = LoadStyle(pageNumbering.Style);
			pageNumbering.Template = GetAttribute("Template", pageNumbering.Template);
			pageNumbering.Format = (PageNumberFormat)Enum.Parse(typeof(PageNumberFormat), GetAttribute("Format", "Decimal"), ignoreCase: false);
			pageNumbering.First = GetAttribute("First", pageNumbering.First);
			pageNumbering.Continue = GetAttribute("Continue", pageNumbering.Continue);
			pageNumbering.SkipFirst = GetAttribute("SkipFirst", pageNumbering.SkipFirst);
			pageNumbering.OffsetX = GetAttribute("OffsetX", pageNumbering.OffsetX);
			pageNumbering.OffsetY = GetAttribute("OffsetY", pageNumbering.OffsetY);
			PropertyCollection properties = new PropertyCollection();
			LoadAlignment("Alignment", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Alignment", (string)null)));
			LoadAlignment("Alignment", "Alignment", properties);
			if (!_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				while (flag)
				{
					if (!Next())
					{
						return pageNumbering;
					}
					if (!_pageNumberingSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
					{
						continue;
					}
					short num = _pageNumberingSymbols[_reader.Name];
					switch (_reader.NodeType)
					{
					case XmlNodeType.Element:
						if (num == 2)
						{
							LoadAlignment("Alignment", "", properties);
						}
						break;
					case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
						if (num == 1)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			PageNumberAlignment pageNumberAlignment = GetPageNumberAlignment("Alignment", properties);
			if (pageNumberAlignment != null)
			{
				pageNumbering.Alignment = pageNumberAlignment;
			}
			return pageNumbering;
		}

		private static void LoadPageSize(string category, PropertyCollection properties, string[] values)
		{
			if (values == null || values.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			category += ".";
			switch (values.Length)
			{
			case 1:
			{
				PageSize pageSize = PageSizes.GetPageSize(values[0]);
				if (pageSize != null)
				{
					properties.SetValue(category + "Width", pageSize.Width);
					properties.SetValue(category + "Height", pageSize.Height);
				}
				break;
			}
			case 2:
				properties.SetValue(category + "Width", Converter.ToPoints(values[0]));
				properties.SetValue(category + "Height", Converter.ToPoints(values[1]));
				break;
			}
		}

		private void LoadPageSize(string category, string path, PropertyCollection properties)
		{
			category += ".";
			if (path.Length > 0)
			{
				path += ".";
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Width"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Width", GetAttribute(path + "Width", PageSizes.Letter.Width));
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Height"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Height", GetAttribute(path + "Height", PageSizes.Letter.Height));
			}
		}

		private void LoadPassword(IPassword password)

			password.User = GetAttribute("User", password.User);
		}

		private void LoadPath(IPath path)
		{
			PropertyCollection properties = new PropertyCollection();
			LoadPen("Pen", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Pen", (string)null)));
			LoadPen("Pen", "Pen", properties);
			LoadBrush("Brush", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Brush", (string)null)));
			LoadBrush("Brush", "Brush", properties);
			if (!_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				while (flag)
				{
					if (!Next())
					{
						return;
					}
					if (!_pathSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
					{
						continue;
					}
					short num = _pathSymbols[_reader.Name];
					switch (_reader.NodeType)
					{
					case XmlNodeType.Element:
						switch (num)
						{
						case 2:
							LoadPen("Pen", "", properties);
							break;
						case 3:
							LoadBrush("Brush", "", properties);
							break;
						case 4:
						{
							float attribute9 = GetAttribute("X", 0f);
							float attribute10 = GetAttribute("Y", 0f);
							path.MoveTo(attribute9, attribute10);
							break;
						}
						case 5:
						{
							float attribute7 = GetAttribute("X", 0f);
							float attribute8 = GetAttribute("Y", 0f);
							path.LineTo(attribute7, attribute8);
							break;
						}
						case 6:
						{
							float attribute = GetAttribute("X1", 0f);
							float attribute2 = GetAttribute("Y1", 0f);
							float attribute3 = GetAttribute("X2", 0f);
							float attribute4 = GetAttribute("Y2", 0f);
							float attribute5 = GetAttribute("X3", 0f);
							float attribute6 = GetAttribute("Y3", 0f);
							path.CurveTo(attribute, attribute2, attribute3, attribute4, attribute5, attribute6);
							break;
						}
						case 7:
							path.ClosePath();
							break;
						}
						break;
					case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
						if (num == 1)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			path.Pen = GetPen("Pen", properties);
			path.Brush = GetBrush("Brush", properties);
		}

		private void LoadPatterns()
		{
			if (_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (Next())
			{
				if (!_patternsSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))

						break;
					}
					break;

					if (num == 1)
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadPen()
		{
			string attribute = GetAttribute("Id", (string)null);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(attribute) || _linkedPens.ContainsKey(attribute))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Id");
			}
			PropertyCollection properties = new PropertyCollection();
			LoadPen("Pen", "", properties);
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen pen = GetPen("Pen", properties);
			if (pen != null)
			{
				_linkedPens.Add(attribute, pen);
			}
		}

		private void LoadPen(string category, PropertyCollection properties, string[] values)
		{
			if (values == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = values.Length;
			if (num == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			category += ".";
			string text = values[0];
			if (text[0] == '#')
			{
				string text2 = text.Substring(1);
				if (_linkedPens.ContainsKey(text2))
				{
					properties.SetValue(category + "Id", text2);
					return;
				}
			}
			properties.SetValue(category + "Color", Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color.Parse(text));
			if (num == 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			properties.SetValue(category + "Width", Converter.ToPoints(values[1]));
			if (num == 2)
			{
				return;
			}
			properties.SetValue(category + "Style", values[2]);
			if (num == 3 || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.LineCap), values[3]))
			{
				return;
			}
			properties.SetValue(category + "Cap", values[3]);
			if (num == 4)
			{
				return;
			}
			properties.SetValue(category + "Join", values[4]);
			if (num != 5)
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "MiterLimit", Convert.ToSingle(values[5], Converter.NumberFormatInfo));
				if (num != 6)
				{
					properties.SetValue(category + "Sealed", values[6]);
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadPen(string category, string path, PropertyCollection properties)
		{
			category += ".";
			if (properties.ContainsKey(category + "Id"))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (path.Length > 0)
			{
				path += ".";
			}
			string attribute = GetAttribute(path + "Reference", (string)null);
			if (attribute != null)
			{
				string text = attribute.Substring(1);
				if (_linkedPens.ContainsKey(text))
				{
					properties.SetValue(category + "Id", text);
				}
				return;
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Color"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Color", GetAttribute(path + "Color", Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Colors.Black));
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Width"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Width", GetAttribute(path + "Width", 1f));
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Style"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Style", GetAttribute(path + "Style", "Solid"));
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Cap"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Cap", GetAttribute(path + "Cap", "Flat"));
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Join"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Join", GetAttribute(path + "Join", "Miter"));
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "MiterLimit"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "MiterLimit", GetAttribute(path + "MiterLimit", 10f));
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Sealed"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Sealed", GetAttribute(path + "Sealed", defaultValue: false));
			}
		}

		private void LoadPens()
		{
			if (_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (Next())
			{
				if (!_pensSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
				{
					continue;
				}
				short num = _pensSymbols[_reader.Name];
				switch (_reader.NodeType)
				{
				case XmlNodeType.Element:
					if (num == 2)
					{
						LoadPen();
					}
					break;
				case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
					if (num == 1)
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

			LoadMargins("Margins", "Margins", properties);

					{

						break;

						{

		private void LoadQuickTable(IQuickTable table)
		{
			table.KeepSolid = GetAttribute("KeepSolid", table.KeepSolid);
			table.Stretch = GetAttribute("Stretch", table.Stretch);
			PropertyCollection properties = new PropertyCollection();
			LoadBorders("Borders", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Borders", (string)null)));
			LoadBorders("Borders", "Borders", properties);
			LoadMargins("Margins", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Margins", (string)null)));
			LoadMargins("Margins", "Margins", properties);
			LoadPaddings("Paddings", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Paddings", (string)null)));
			LoadPaddings("Paddings", "Paddings", properties);
			LoadBackground("Background", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Background", (string)null)));
			LoadBackground("Background", "Background", properties);
			if (!_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				while (flag)
				{
					if (!Next())
					{
						return;
					}
					if (!_quickTableSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
					{
						continue;
					}
					short num = _quickTableSymbols[_reader.Name];
					switch (_reader.NodeType)
					{
					case XmlNodeType.Element:
						switch (num)
						{
						case 2:
							LoadQuickTableHeader(table.Header);
							break;
						case 3:
							LoadQuickTableFooter(table.Footer);
							break;
						case 4:
							LoadQuickTableDivider(table.Divider);
							break;
						case 5:
							LoadBorders("Borders", "", properties);
							break;
						case 6:
							LoadMargins("Margins", "", properties);
							break;
						case 7:
							LoadPaddings("Paddings", "", properties);
							break;

		private void LoadReport()
		{
			if (_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (Next())
			{
				if (!_reportSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
				{
					continue;
				}
				short num = _reportSymbols[_reader.Name];
				switch (_reader.NodeType)
				{
				case XmlNodeType.Element:
					switch (num)
					{
					case 2:
						LoadInfo(_report.Info);
						break;
					case 3:
						LoadPreferences(_report.Preferences);
						break;
					case 4:
						LoadAttachments();
						break;
					case 5:
						LoadResources();
						break;
					case 6:
						LoadColors();
						break;
					case 7:
						LoadPens();
						break;
					case 8:
						LoadBrushes();
						break;
					case 9:
						LoadFonts();
						break;
					case 10:
						LoadStyles();
						break;
					case 11:
						LoadPatterns();
						break;
					case 12:
						LoadBookmarks();
						break;
					case 13:
						LoadSections();
						break;
					}
					break;
				case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
					if (num == 1)
					{

					}
					break;
				}

		private void LoadResource(ResourceType type)
		{
			if (_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			string attribute = GetAttribute("Id", (string)null);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(attribute) || _resources.ContainsKey(attribute))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Id");
			}
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			byte[] array = new byte[100000];
			string text = type.ToString();
			while (!_reader.EOF && _reader.Name == text)
			{
				int num = _reader.ReadBase64(array, 0, array.Length);
				if (num > 0)
				{
					memoryStream.Write(array, 0, num);
				}
			}
			if (type != ResourceType.Image)
			{
				memoryStream.Position = 0L;
				memoryStream = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Utils.FlateCompressor.Inflate(memoryStream);
			}
			_resources.Add(attribute, memoryStream.ToArray());
		}

		private void LoadResources()
		{
			if (_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (Next())
			{
				if (!_resourcesSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
				{
					continue;
				}
				short num = _resourcesSymbols[_reader.Name];
				switch (_reader.NodeType)
				{
				case XmlNodeType.Element:
					switch (num)
					{
					case 2:
						LoadResource(ResourceType.Font);
						break;
					case 3:
						LoadResource(ResourceType.Image);
						break;
					case 4:
						LoadResource(ResourceType.Metafile);
						break;
					}
					break;
				case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
					if (num == 1)
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadSections()
		{
			if (_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (Next())
			{
				if (!_sectionsSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
				{
					continue;
				}
				short num = _sectionsSymbols[_reader.Name];
				switch (_reader.NodeType)
				{
				case XmlNodeType.Element:
					if (num == 2)
					{
						LoadSection();
					}
					break;
				case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
					if (num == 1)
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadSmallCapsText(IText text, Style style, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Hyperlink hyperlink)
		{
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font font = style.Font;
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush brush = style.Brush;
			Style style2 = GetStyle(GetFont(font.Name, font.Size * 0.75f, font.Style, null), brush);
			if (_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (!_reader.EOF)
			{
				_reader.Read();
				switch (_reader.NodeType)
				{
				case XmlNodeType.Text:
				case XmlNodeType.Whitespace:
				{
					string value = _reader.Value;
					foreach (char c in value)
					{
						if (char.IsLower(c))
						{
							text.AddContent(char.ToUpper(c), style2, hyperlink);
						}
						else
						{
							text.AddContent(c, style, hyperlink);
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
					if (_reader.Name == "SmallCaps")
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void LoadMargins(string category, PropertyCollection properties, string[] values)
		{
			if (values != null && values.Length != 0)
			{
				category += ".";
				switch (values.Length)
				{
				case 1:
					properties.SetValue(category + "Left", Converter.ToPoints(values[0]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "Right", Converter.ToPoints(values[0]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "Top", Converter.ToPoints(values[0]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "Bottom", Converter.ToPoints(values[0]));
					break;
				case 2:
					properties.SetValue(category + "Left", Converter.ToPoints(values[0]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "Right", Converter.ToPoints(values[0]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "Top", Converter.ToPoints(values[1]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "Bottom", Converter.ToPoints(values[1]));
					break;
				case 4:
					properties.SetValue(category + "Left", Converter.ToPoints(values[0]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "Right", Converter.ToPoints(values[1]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "Top", Converter.ToPoints(values[2]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "Bottom", Converter.ToPoints(values[3]));
					break;
				case 3:
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadMargins(string category, string path, PropertyCollection properties)
		{
			category += ".";
			if (path.Length > 0)
			{
				path += ".";
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Horizontal"))
			{
				float attribute = GetAttribute(path + "Horizontal", 0f);
				properties.SetValue(category + "Left", attribute);
				properties.SetValue(category + "Right", attribute);
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Vertical"))
			{
				float attribute2 = GetAttribute(path + "Vertical", 0f);
				properties.SetValue(category + "Top", attribute2);
				properties.SetValue(category + "Bottom", attribute2);
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Left"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Left", GetAttribute(path + "Left", 0f));
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Right"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Right", GetAttribute(path + "Right", 0f));
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Top"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Top", GetAttribute(path + "Top", 0f));
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Bottom"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Bottom", GetAttribute(path + "Bottom", 0f));
			}
		}

		private void LoadStyle()
		{
			string attribute = GetAttribute("Id", (string)null);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(attribute) || _styles.ContainsKey(attribute))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Id");
			}
			PropertyCollection propertyCollection = new PropertyCollection();
			propertyCollection.SetValue("CharSpacing", GetAttribute("CharSpacing", 0f));
			propertyCollection.SetValue("WordSpacing", GetAttribute("WordSpacing", 0f));
			LoadFont("Font", propertyCollection, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Font", (string)null)));
			LoadFont("Font", "Font", propertyCollection);
			LoadBrush("Brush", propertyCollection, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Brush", (string)null)));
			LoadBrush("Brush", "Brush", propertyCollection);
			LoadBrush("Highlight", propertyCollection, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Highlight", (string)null)));
			LoadBrush("Highlight", "Highlight", propertyCollection);
			if (!_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				while (flag)
				{
					if (!Next())
					{
						return;
					}
					if (!_styleSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
					{
						continue;
					}
					short num = _styleSymbols[_reader.Name];
					switch (_reader.NodeType)
					{
					case XmlNodeType.Element:
						switch (num)
						{
						case 2:
							LoadFont("Font", "", propertyCollection);
							break;
						case 3:
							LoadBrush("Brush", "", propertyCollection);
							break;
						case 4:
							LoadBrush("Highlight", "", propertyCollection);
							break;
						}
						break;
					case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
						if (num == 1)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font font = GetFont("Font", propertyCollection);
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush brush = GetBrush("Brush", propertyCollection);
			if (brush == null)
			{
				brush = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brushes.Black;
			}
			Style style = new Style(font, brush);
			if (propertyCollection.GetValue("Font.Subscript", defaultValue: false))
			{
				style.FontVariant = FontVariant.Subscript;
			}
			if (propertyCollection.GetValue("Font.Superscript", defaultValue: false))
			{
				style.FontVariant = FontVariant.Superscript;
			}
			if (propertyCollection.GetValue("Font.AllCaps", defaultValue: false))
			{
				style.FontVariant = FontVariant.AllCaps;
			}
			if (propertyCollection.GetValue("Font.SmallCaps", defaultValue: false))
			{
				style.FontVariant = FontVariant.SmallCaps;
			}
			style.Highlight = GetBrush("Highlight", propertyCollection);
			style.CharSpacing = propertyCollection.GetValue("CharSpacing", 0f);
			style.WordSpacing = propertyCollection.GetValue("WordSpacing", 0f);
			_styles.Add(attribute, style);
		}

		private Style LoadStyle(Style defaultValue)
		{
			string attribute = _reader.GetAttribute("Style");
			if (attribute != null && _styles.ContainsKey(attribute))
			{
				return _styles[attribute];
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}

		private void LoadStyles()
		{
			if (_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (Next())
			{
				if (!_stylesSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
				{
					continue;
				}
				short num = _stylesSymbols[_reader.Name];
				switch (_reader.NodeType)
				{
				case XmlNodeType.Element:
					if (num == 2)
					{
						LoadStyle();
					}
					break;
				case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
					if (num == 1)
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadTable(ITable table)
		{
			string attribute = GetAttribute("Pattern", (string)null);
			if (attribute != null && _tablePatterns.ContainsKey(attribute))
			{
				table.ApplyPattern(_tablePatterns[attribute]);
			}
			table.Width = LoadWidth(table.Width);
			table.Height = LoadHeight(table.Height);
			table.KeepSolid = GetAttribute("KeepSolid", table.KeepSolid);
			table.Stretch = GetAttribute("Stretch", table.Stretch);
			PropertyCollection properties = new PropertyCollection();
			if (ContainsAttribute("Borders", "Default"))
			{
				table.Borders = new Borders();
			}
			else
			{
				LoadBorders("Borders", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Borders", (string)null)));
			}
			if (!ContainsAttribute("Margins", "Default"))
			{
				LoadMargins("Margins", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Margins", (string)null)));
			}
			if (!ContainsAttribute("Paddings", "Default"))
			{
				LoadPaddings("Paddings", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Paddings", (string)null)));
			}
			if (!ContainsAttribute("Background", "Default"))
			{
				LoadBackground("Background", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Background", (string)null)));
			}
			LoadBorders("Borders", "Borders", properties);
			LoadMargins("Margins", "Margins", properties);
			LoadPaddings("Paddings", "Paddings", properties);
			LoadBackground("Background", "Background", properties);

				{
					if (!Next())
					{
						return;
					}
					if (!_tableSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
					{
						continue;
					}
					short num = _tableSymbols[_reader.Name];
					switch (_reader.NodeType)
					{
					case XmlNodeType.Element:
						switch (num)
						{
						case 2:
							LoadTableHeader(table.Header);
							break;
						case 3:
							LoadTableFooter(table.Footer);
							break;

							LoadTableDivider(table.Divider);
							break;
						case 5:
							LoadBorders("Borders", "", properties);
							break;
						case 6:
							LoadMargins("Margins", "", properties);
							break;
						case 7:
							LoadPaddings("Paddings", "", properties);

						case 8:
							LoadBackground("Background", "", properties);

						break;

						break;

		private void LoadText(IText text)
		{
			string attribute = GetAttribute("Pattern", (string)null);
			if (attribute != null && _textPatterns.ContainsKey(attribute))
			{
				text.ApplyPattern(_textPatterns[attribute]);
			}
			Style style = LoadStyle(text.StyleResolved);
			PropertyCollection propertyCollection = new PropertyCollection();
			if (ContainsAttribute("Font") || ContainsAttribute("Brush"))
			{
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font font = style.Font;
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush brush = style.Brush;
				if (ContainsAttribute("Font"))
				{
					LoadFont("Font", propertyCollection, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Font", (string)null)));
					font = GetFont("Font", propertyCollection);
				}
				if (ContainsAttribute("Brush"))
				{
					LoadBrush("Brush", propertyCollection, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Brush", (string)null)));
					brush = GetBrush("Brush", propertyCollection);
				}
				style = GetStyle(font, brush);
			}
			propertyCollection.Clear();
			text.Style = style;
			text.Heading = (TextHeading)Enum.Parse(typeof(TextHeading), GetAttribute("Heading", text.Heading.ToString()), ignoreCase: false);
			text.Caption = GetAttribute("Caption", text.Caption);
			text.Interval = GetAttribute("Interval", text.Interval);
			text.Width = LoadWidth(text.Width);
			text.Height = LoadHeight(text.Height);
			text.KeepSolid = GetAttribute("KeepSolid", text.KeepSolid);
			if (!ContainsAttribute("Alignment", "Default"))
			{
				LoadAlignment("Alignment", propertyCollection, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Alignment", (string)null)));
			}
			if (!ContainsAttribute("Indents", "Default"))
			{
				LoadTextIndents("Indents", propertyCollection, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Indents", (string)null)));
			}
			if (!ContainsAttribute("Tabs", "Default"))
			{
				LoadTextTabs("Tabs", propertyCollection, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Tabs", (string)null)));
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute("Borders", "Default"))
			{
				text.Borders = new Borders();
			}
			else
			{
				LoadBorders("Borders", propertyCollection, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Borders", (string)null)));
			}
			if (!ContainsAttribute("Margins", "Default"))
			{
				LoadMargins("Margins", propertyCollection, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Margins", (string)null)));
			}
			if (!ContainsAttribute("Paddings", "Default"))
			{
				LoadPaddings("Paddings", propertyCollection, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Paddings", (string)null)));
			}
			if (!ContainsAttribute("Background", "Default"))
			{
				LoadBackground("Background", propertyCollection, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Background", (string)null)));
			}
			LoadAlignment("Alignment", "Alignment", propertyCollection);
			LoadTextIndents("Indents", "Indents", propertyCollection);
			LoadTextTabs("Tabs", "Tabs", propertyCollection);
			LoadBorders("Borders", "Borders", propertyCollection);
			LoadMargins("Margins", "Margins", propertyCollection);
			LoadPaddings("Paddings", "Paddings", propertyCollection);
			LoadBackground("Background", "Background", propertyCollection);
			if (!_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				_reader.WhitespaceHandling = WhitespaceHandling.All;
				bool flag = false;
				bool flag2 = true;
				while (flag2 && !_reader.EOF)
				{
					_reader.Read();
					switch (_reader.NodeType)
					{
					case XmlNodeType.Text:
					case XmlNodeType.Whitespace:
						if (!flag)
						{
							text.AddContent(_reader.Value, style, null);
						}
						break;
					case XmlNodeType.Element:
						if (!_textSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
						{
							break;
						}
						switch (_textSymbols[_reader.Name])
						{
						case 2:
							LoadAlignment("Alignment", "", propertyCollection);
							break;
						case 3:
							LoadTextIndents("Indents", "", propertyCollection);
							break;
						case 4:
							LoadTextTabs("Tabs", "", propertyCollection);
							break;
						case 5:
							LoadBorders("Borders", "", propertyCollection);
							break;
						case 6:
							LoadMargins("Margins", "", propertyCollection);
							break;
						case 7:
							LoadPaddings("Paddings", "", propertyCollection);
							break;
						case 8:
							LoadBackground("Background", "", propertyCollection);
							break;
						case 9:
							text.LineNumbering = LoadTextLineNumbering();
							break;
						case 10:
							text.FirstLetter = LoadTextFirstLetter();
							break;
						case 11:
							if (!flag)
							{
								flag = true;
								text.Clear();
								LoadTextBody(text);
							}
							break;
						case 12:
							if (!flag)
							{
								LoadTextLink(text, style);
							}
							break;
						case 13:
							if (!flag)
							{
								LoadTextBlock(text, style, null);
							}
							break;
						case 14:
							if (!flag)
							{
								LoadTextMergeCode(text, style, null);
							}
							break;
						case 15:
							if (!flag)
							{
								LoadTextDateTime(text, style, null);
							}
							break;
						case 16:
							if (!flag)
							{
								LoadTextPageNumber(text, style, null);
							}
							break;
						case 17:
							if (!flag)
							{
								LoadTextLeader(text, style, null);
							}
							break;
						case 18:
							if (!flag)
							{
								LoadTextTarget(text);
							}
							break;
						case 19:
							if (!flag)
							{
								LoadTextImage(text, null);
							}
							break;
						case 20:
							if (!flag)
							{
								LoadBoldText(text, style, null);
							}
							break;
						case 21:
							if (!flag)
							{
								LoadItalicText(text, style, null);
							}
							break;
						case 22:
							if (!flag)
							{
								LoadUnderlinedText(text, style, null);
							}
							break;
						case 23:
							if (!flag)
							{
								LoadAllCapsText(text, style, null);
							}
							break;
						case 24:
							if (!flag)
							{
								LoadSmallCapsText(text, style, null);
							}
							break;
						case 25:
							if (!flag)
							{
								LoadTextInjector(text, style, null);
							}
							break;
						}
						break;
					case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
						if (_textSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name) && _textSymbols[_reader.Name] == 1)
						{
							flag2 = false;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				_reader.WhitespaceHandling = WhitespaceHandling.None;
			}
			TextAlignment textAlignment = GetTextAlignment("Alignment", propertyCollection);
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Indents textIndents = GetTextIndents("Indents", propertyCollection);
			Tabs textTabs = GetTextTabs("Tabs", propertyCollection);
			Borders borders = GetBorders("Borders", propertyCollection);
			Margins margins = GetMargins("Margins", propertyCollection);
			Paddings paddings = GetPaddings("Paddings", propertyCollection);
			Background background = GetBackground("Background", propertyCollection);
			if (textAlignment != null)
			{
				text.Alignment = textAlignment;
			}
			if (textIndents != null)
			{
				text.Indents = textIndents;
			}
			if (textTabs != null)
			{
				text.Tabs = textTabs;
			}
			if (borders != null)
			{
				text.Borders = borders;
			}
			if (margins != null)
			{
				text.Margins = margins;
			}
			if (paddings != null)
			{
				text.Paddings = paddings;
			}
			if (background != null)
			{
				text.Background = background;
			}
		}

		private static void LoadTextIndents(string category, PropertyCollection properties, string[] values)
		{
			if (values != null && values.Length != 0)
			{
				category += ".";
				switch (values.Length)
				{
				case 1:
					properties.SetValue(category + "First", Converter.ToPoints(values[0]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "Left", Converter.ToPoints(values[0]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "Right", Converter.ToPoints(values[0]));
					break;
				case 2:
					properties.SetValue(category + "Left", Converter.ToPoints(values[0]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "Right", Converter.ToPoints(values[1]));
					break;
				case 3:
					properties.SetValue(category + "First", Converter.ToPoints(values[0]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "Left", Converter.ToPoints(values[1]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "Right", Converter.ToPoints(values[2]));
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadTextIndents(string category, string path, PropertyCollection properties)
		{
			category += ".";
			if (path.Length > 0)
			{
				path += ".";
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "First"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "First", GetAttribute(path + "First", 0f));
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Left"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Left", GetAttribute(path + "Left", 0f));
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Right"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Right", GetAttribute(path + "Right", 0f));
			}
		}

							LoadTextTabs("Tabs", "", properties);
							break;
						case 5:
							LoadBorders("Borders", "", properties);
							break;
						case 6:
							LoadMargins("Margins", "", properties);
							break;
						case 7:
							LoadPaddings("Paddings", "", properties);
							break;
						case 8:
							LoadBackground("Background", "", properties);
							break;
						}
						break;
					case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
						if (num == 1)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			TextAlignment textAlignment = GetTextAlignment("Alignment", properties);
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Indents textIndents = GetTextIndents("Indents", properties);
			Tabs textTabs = GetTextTabs("Tabs", properties);
			Borders borders = GetBorders("Borders", properties);
			Margins margins = GetMargins("Margins", properties);
			Paddings paddings = GetPaddings("Paddings", properties);
			Background background = GetBackground("Background", properties);
			if (textAlignment != null)
			{
				textPattern.Alignment = textAlignment;
			}
			if (textIndents != null)
			{
				textPattern.Indents = textIndents;
			}
			if (textTabs != null)
			{
				textPattern.Tabs = textTabs;
			}
			if (borders != null)
			{
				textPattern.Borders = borders;
			}
			if (margins != null)
			{
				textPattern.Margins = margins;
			}
			if (paddings != null)
			{
				textPattern.Paddings = paddings;
			}
			if (background != null)
			{
				textPattern.Background = background;
			}
			_textPatterns.Add(attribute, textPattern);
		}

		private void LoadTextTab(Tabs tabs)
		{
			float attribute = GetAttribute("Offset", 35f);
			LeaderFormat leader = (LeaderFormat)Enum.Parse(typeof(LeaderFormat), GetAttribute("Leader", "Spaces"), ignoreCase: false);
			tabs.AddTab(attribute, leader);
		}

		private static void LoadTextTabs(string category, PropertyCollection properties, string[] values)
		{
			if (values == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = values.Length;
			if (num != 0)
			{
				Tabs tabs = (Tabs)properties.GetValue(category, (object)null);
				if (tabs == null)
				{
					tabs = new Tabs();
				}
				properties.SetValue(category, tabs);
				tabs.Default.Offset = Converter.ToPoints(values[0]);
				if (num != 1)
				{
					tabs.Default.Leader = (LeaderFormat)Enum.Parse(typeof(LeaderFormat), values[1], ignoreCase: false);
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadTextTabs(string category, string path, PropertyCollection properties)
		{
			if (path.Length > 0)
			{
				path += ".";
			}
			Tabs tabs = (Tabs)properties.GetValue(category, (object)null);
			if (tabs == null)
			{
				tabs = new Tabs();
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Offset"))
			{
				tabs.Default.Offset = GetAttribute(path + "Offset", tabs.Default.Offset);
				properties.SetValue(category, tabs);
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Leader"))
			{
				tabs.Default.Leader = (LeaderFormat)Enum.Parse(typeof(LeaderFormat), GetAttribute(path + "Leader", tabs.Default.Leader.ToString()), ignoreCase: false);
				properties.SetValue(category, tabs);
			}
			if (path.Length != 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			properties.SetValue(category, tabs);
			if (_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (Next())
			{
				if (!_textTabsSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
				{
					continue;
				}
				short num = _textTabsSymbols[_reader.Name];
				switch (_reader.NodeType)
				{
				case XmlNodeType.Element:
					if (num == 2)
					{
						LoadTextTab(tabs);
					}
					break;
				case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
					if (num == 1)
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadTextTarget(IText text)
		{
			string attribute = GetAttribute("Name", (string)null);
			string attribute2 = GetAttribute("Caption", (string)null);
			text.AddTarget(attribute, attribute2);
		}

		private void LoadTOC(ITOC toc)
		{
			if (_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (Next())
			{
				if (!_tocSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
				{
					continue;
				}
				short num = _tocSymbols[_reader.Name];
				switch (_reader.NodeType)
				{
				case XmlNodeType.Element:
					if (num == 2)
					{
						LoadTOCLevel(toc.AddLevel());
					}
					break;
				case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
					if (num == 1)
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadTOCLevel(ILevel level)
		{
			level.Style = LoadStyle(level.Style);
			level.Leader = (LeaderFormat)Enum.Parse(typeof(LeaderFormat), GetAttribute("Leader", "Dots"), ignoreCase: false);
			PropertyCollection properties = new PropertyCollection();
			LoadIndents("Indents", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Indents", (string)null)));
			LoadIndents("Indents", "Indents", properties);
			if (!_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				while (flag)
				{
					if (!Next())
					{
						return;
					}
					if (!_tocLevelSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
					{
						continue;
					}
					short num = _tocLevelSymbols[_reader.Name];
					switch (_reader.NodeType)
					{
					case XmlNodeType.Element:
						if (num == 2)
						{
							LoadIndents("Indents", "", properties);
						}
						break;
					case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
						if (num == 1)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			Indents indents = GetIndents("Indents", properties);
			if (indents != null)
			{
				level.Indents = indents;
			}
		}

		private void LoadTree(ITree tree)
		{
			string attribute = GetAttribute("Pattern", (string)null);
			if (attribute != null && _treePatterns.ContainsKey(attribute))
			{
				tree.ApplyPattern(_treePatterns[attribute]);
			}
			tree.Width = LoadWidth(tree.Width);
			tree.Height = LoadHeight(tree.Height);
			tree.KeepSolid = GetAttribute("KeepSolid", tree.KeepSolid);
			PropertyCollection properties = new PropertyCollection();
			if (ContainsAttribute("Borders", "Default"))
			{
				tree.Borders = new Borders();
			}
			else
			{
				LoadBorders("Borders", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Borders", (string)null)));
			}
			if (!ContainsAttribute("Margins", "Default"))
			{
				LoadMargins("Margins", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Margins", (string)null)));
			}
			if (!ContainsAttribute("Paddings", "Default"))
			{
				LoadPaddings("Paddings", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Paddings", (string)null)));
			}
			if (!ContainsAttribute("Background", "Default"))
			{
				LoadBackground("Background", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Background", (string)null)));
			}
			LoadBorders("Borders", "Borders", properties);
			LoadMargins("Margins", "Margins", properties);
			LoadPaddings("Paddings", "Paddings", properties);
			LoadBackground("Background", "Background", properties);
			if (!_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				while (flag)
				{
					if (!Next())
					{
						return;
					}
					if (!_treeSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
					{
						continue;
					}
					short num = _treeSymbols[_reader.Name];
					switch (_reader.NodeType)
					{
					case XmlNodeType.Element:
						switch (num)
						{
						case 2:
							LoadTreeNode(tree.Root);
							break;
						case 3:
							LoadBorders("Borders", "", properties);
							break;
						case 4:
							LoadMargins("Margins", "", properties);
							break;
						case 5:
							LoadPaddings("Paddings", "", properties);
							break;
						case 6:
							LoadBackground("Background", "", properties);
							break;
						}
						break;
					case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
						if (num == 1)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			Borders borders = GetBorders("Borders", properties);
			Margins margins = GetMargins("Margins", properties);
			Paddings paddings = GetPaddings("Paddings", properties);
			Background background = GetBackground("Background", properties);
			if (borders != null)
			{
				tree.Borders = borders;
			}
			if (margins != null)
			{
				tree.Margins = margins;
			}
			if (paddings != null)
			{
				tree.Paddings = paddings;
			}
			if (background != null)
			{
				tree.Background = background;
			}
		}

			LoadBackground("Background", "Background", properties);

							Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.ImageConverter converter2 = LoadImageConverter(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Converter", (string)null)));
							ImageCompressor compressor2 = LoadImageCompressor(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Compressor", (string)null)));

							LoadQuickImage(caption.AddQuickImage(image2));
							break;
						}
						case 9:

							break;
						case 10:
							LoadQuickTable(caption.AddQuickTable());
							break;
						case 11:
							LoadText(caption.AddText());
							break;
						case 12:

							string attribute = GetAttribute("Source", (string)null);
							Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.ImageConverter converter = LoadImageConverter(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Converter", (string)null)));
							ImageCompressor compressor = LoadImageCompressor(Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Compressor", (string)null)));
							Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image = GetImage(attribute, converter, compressor);
							LoadImage(caption.AddImage(image));
							break;

							break;

							LoadRule(caption.AddRule());
							break;

							break;

							LoadGroup(caption.AddGroup());
							break;

							LoadChain(caption.AddChain());
							break;
						case 18:
							LoadBand(caption.AddBand());
							break;

							break;

							LoadGrid(caption.AddGrid());
							break;

							LoadFlow(caption.AddFlow());
							break;
						case 22:
							LoadList(caption.AddList());
							break;
						case 23:
							LoadTree(caption.AddTree());
							break;
						case 24:
							LoadSite(caption.AddSite());
							break;
						case 25:
							LoadCanvas(caption.AddCanvas());
							break;
						case 26:
							LoadRotator(caption.AddRotator());
							break;
						case 27:
							LoadContainer(caption.AddContainer(GetAttribute("Name", (string)null)));
							break;
						case 28:
							LoadCondition(caption.AddCondition(_containers[GetAttribute("Container", (string)null)], GetAttribute("Fit", defaultValue: false)));
							break;
						case 29:
							LoadStretcher(caption.AddStretcher());
							break;
						case 30:
							caption.AddDummy();
							break;
						case 31:
							caption.AddPageBreak();
							break;
						case 32:
							LoadTOC(caption.AddTOC());
							break;
						case 33:
							LoadIndex(caption.AddIndex());
							break;
						}
						break;
					case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
						if (num == 1)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			ContentAlignment contentAlignment = GetContentAlignment("Alignment", properties);
			Borders borders = GetBorders("Borders", properties);
			Margins margins = GetMargins("Margins", properties);
			Paddings paddings = GetPaddings("Paddings", properties);

			}

			{
				caption.Paddings = paddings;
			}
			if (background != null)
			{
				caption.Background = background;
			}
		}

		private void LoadTreeNode(INode node)
		{
			node.Indent = GetAttribute("Indent", node.Indent);
			node.Interval = GetAttribute("Interval", node.Interval);
			node.KeepSolid = GetAttribute("KeepSolid", node.KeepSolid);
			PropertyCollection properties = new PropertyCollection();
			if (ContainsAttribute("Lines", "Default"))
			{
				node.Lines = new Lines();
			}
			else
			{
				LoadTreeLines("Lines", properties, Converter.Split(GetAttribute("Lines", (string)null)));
			}
			LoadTreeLines("Lines", "Lines", properties);
			if (!_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				while (flag)
				{
					if (!Next())
					{
						return;
					}
					if (!_treeNodeSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
					{
						continue;
					}
					short num = _treeNodeSymbols[_reader.Name];
					switch (_reader.NodeType)
					{
					case XmlNodeType.Element:
						switch (num)
						{
						case 1:
							LoadTreeNode(node.AddNode());
							break;
						case 2:
							LoadTreeCaption(node.Caption);
							break;
						case 3:
							LoadTreeLines("Lines", "", properties);
							break;
						}
						break;
					case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
						if (num == 1)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			Lines treeLines = GetTreeLines("Lines", properties);
			if (treeLines != null)
			{
				node.Lines = treeLines;
			}
		}
