		private void LoadUnderlinedText(IText text, Style style, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Hyperlink hyperlink)
		{
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font font = style.Font;
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush brush = style.Brush;
			style = GetStyle(GetFont(font.Name, font.Size, font.Style | Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Underline, null), brush);
			if (_reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (!_reader.EOF)
			{
				_reader.Read();
				switch (_reader.NodeType)
				{
				case XmlNodeType.Text:
				case XmlNodeType.Whitespace:
					text.AddContent(_reader.Value, style, hyperlink);
					break;
				case XmlNodeType.Element:
					if (_underlinedTextSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name))
					{
						switch (_underlinedTextSymbols[_reader.Name])
						{
						case 2:
							LoadBoldText(text, style, hyperlink);
							break;
						case 3:
							LoadItalicText(text, style, hyperlink);
							break;
						case 4:
							LoadAllCapsText(text, style, hyperlink);
							break;
						case 5:
							LoadSmallCapsText(text, style, hyperlink);
							break;
						case 6:
							LoadTextInjector(text, style, hyperlink);
							break;
						}
					}
					break;
				case XmlNodeType.EndElement:
					if (_underlinedTextSymbols.ContainsKey(_reader.Name) && _underlinedTextSymbols[_reader.Name] == 1)
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadVerticalBorders(string category, PropertyCollection properties, string[] values)
		{
			if (values != null && values.Length != 0)
			{
				LoadBorder(category + "Top", properties, values);
				LoadBorder(category + "Bottom", properties, values);
			}
		}

		private void LoadVerticalBorders(string category, string path, PropertyCollection properties)
		{
			LoadBorder(category + "Top", path, properties);
			LoadBorder(category + "Bottom", path, properties);
		}

		private static void LoadVerticalMargins(string category, PropertyCollection properties, string[] values)
		{
			if (values != null && values.Length != 0)
			{
				category += ".";
				switch (values.Length)
				{
				case 1:
					properties.SetValue(category + "Top", Converter.ToPoints(values[0]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "Bottom", Converter.ToPoints(values[0]));
					break;
				case 2:
					properties.SetValue(category + "Top", Converter.ToPoints(values[0]));
					properties.SetValue(category + "Bottom", Converter.ToPoints(values[1]));
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadVerticalMargins(string category, string path, PropertyCollection properties)
		{
			category += ".";
			if (path.Length > 0)
			{
				path += ".";
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Top"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Top", GetAttribute(path + "Top", 0f));
			}
			if (ContainsAttribute(path + "Bottom"))
			{
				properties.SetValue(category + "Bottom", GetAttribute(path + "Bottom", 0f));
			}
		}

		private void LoadViewer(IViewer viewer)
		{
			viewer.HideToolbar = GetAttribute("HideToolbar", viewer.HideToolbar);
			viewer.HideMenubar = GetAttribute("HideMenubar", viewer.HideMenubar);
			viewer.HideWindowUI = GetAttribute("HideWindowUI", viewer.HideWindowUI);
			viewer.FitWindow = GetAttribute("FitWindow", viewer.FitWindow);
			viewer.CenterWindow = GetAttribute("CenterWindow", viewer.CenterWindow);
		}

		private Width LoadWidth(Width defaultValue)
		{
			string attribute = _reader.GetAttribute("Width");
			if (attribute != null)
			{
				if (attribute.Equals("Auto"))
				{
					return AutoWidth.Instance;
				}
				if (attribute.Equals("Max"))
				{
					return MaxWidth.Instance;
				}
				if (attribute.EndsWith("]"))
				{
					int length = attribute.IndexOf('%');
					int num = attribute.IndexOf('[');
					string value = attribute.Substring(0, length).Trim();
					string data = attribute.Substring(num + 1, attribute.Length - num - 2).Trim();
					string[] array = Converter.Split(data);
					return new RelativeWidth(Convert.ToSingle(value, Converter.NumberFormatInfo), Converter.ToPoints(array[0]), Converter.ToPoints(array[1]));
				}
				if (attribute.EndsWith("%"))
				{
					attribute = attribute.Substring(0, attribute.Length - 1);
					attribute = attribute.Trim();
					return new RelativeWidth(Convert.ToSingle(attribute, Converter.NumberFormatInfo));
				}
				return new FixedWidth(Converter.ToPoints(attribute));
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}

		private bool Next()
		{
			while (!_reader.EOF)
			{
				_reader.Read();
				if (_reader.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Element || _reader.NodeType == XmlNodeType.EndElement)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static void SetPoint(string category, PropertyCollection properties, float x, float y)
		{
			category += ".";
			properties.SetValue(category + "X", properties.GetValue(category + "X", x));
			properties.SetValue(category + "Y", properties.GetValue(category + "Y", y));
		}

		private void UpdateProperties(ISection section, PropertyCollection properties)
		{
			PageSize pageSize = GetPageSize("PageSize", properties);
			ContentAlignment contentAlignment = GetContentAlignment("PageAlignment", properties);
			Borders borders = GetBorders("PageBorders", properties);
			Margins margins = GetMargins("PageSpacings", properties);
			Paddings paddings = GetPaddings("PagePaddings", properties);
			Background background = GetBackground("PageBackground", properties);
			if (pageSize != null)
			{
				section.PageSize = pageSize;
			}
			if (contentAlignment != null)
			{
				section.PageAlignment = contentAlignment;
			}
			if (borders != null)
			{
				section.PageBorders = borders;
			}
			if (margins != null)
			{
				section.PageMargins = margins;
			}
			if (paddings != null)
			{
				section.PagePaddings = paddings;
			}
			if (background != null)
			{
				section.PageBackground = background;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class Writer : Visitor
	{
		private Report _report;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Section.Section _section;

		private XmlTextWriter _writer;

		private ResourceCollector _rc;

		private PenCollector _lpc;

		private BrushCollector _lbc;

		private FontCollector _lfc;

		private StyleCollector _sc;

		private PatternCollector _pc;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Utils.FlateCompressor _compressor;

		public Writer(Report report)
		{
			_report = report;
			_compressor = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Utils.FlateCompressor();
		}

		public void Write(XmlTextWriter writer)
		{
			_writer = writer;
			_writer.Formatting = Formatting.Indented;
			_writer.IndentChar = '\t';
			_writer.Indentation = 1;
			_writer.QuoteChar = '"';
			_writer.WriteStartDocument();
			_writer.WriteStartElement("Report");
			SaveReport();
			_writer.WriteEndElement();
			_writer.WriteEndDocument();
			_writer.Flush();
		}

		private static bool CheckDefault(TextAlignment alignment)
		{
			if (alignment.Horizontal == Alignment.Left && alignment.Vertical == Alignment.Top)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool CheckDefault(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Indents indents)
		{
			if (indents.First == 0f && indents.Left == 0f && indents.Right == 0f)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool CheckDefault(Tabs tabs)
		{
			if (tabs.Content.Count == 0 && tabs.Default.Offset == 35f && tabs.Default.Leader == LeaderFormat.Spaces)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool CheckDefault(Bullets bullets)
		{
			if (bullets.Type == BulletType.BlackCircle && bullets.Style == Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Text.DefaultStyle && bullets.Template == "{0})" && bullets.Glyph == 0 && bullets.Indent == 15f && bullets.OffsetX == 0f && bullets.OffsetY == 0f)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool CheckDefault(Lines lines)
		{
			if (lines.Pen == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool CheckDefault(ContentAlignment alignment)
		{
			if (alignment.Horizontal == Alignment.Left && alignment.Vertical == Alignment.Top)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool CheckDefault(Borders borders)
		{
			if (CheckDefault(borders.Corners) && (!borders.HasLeft || borders.Left.Pen == null) && (!borders.HasRight || borders.Right.Pen == null) && (!borders.HasTop || borders.Top.Pen == null) && (!borders.HasBottom || borders.Bottom.Pen == null))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool CheckDefault(Corners corners)
		{
			if ((!corners.HasTopLeft || corners.TopLeft.Pen == null) && (!corners.HasTopRight || corners.TopRight.Pen == null) && (!corners.HasBottomLeft || corners.BottomLeft.Pen == null) && (!corners.HasBottomRight || corners.BottomRight.Pen == null))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool CheckDefault(Margins margins)
		{
			if (margins.Left == 0f && margins.Right == 0f && margins.Top == 0f && margins.Bottom == 0f)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool CheckDefault(HorizontalMargins margins)
		{
			if (margins.Left == 0f && margins.Right == 0f)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool CheckDefault(VerticalMargins margins)
		{
			if (margins.Top == 0f && margins.Bottom == 0f)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool CheckDefault(Paddings paddings)
		{
			if (paddings.Left == 0f && paddings.Right == 0f && paddings.Top == 0f && paddings.Bottom == 0f)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool CheckDefault(Indents indents)
		{
			if (indents.Left == 0f && indents.Right == 0f && indents.Top == 0f && indents.Bottom == 0f)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool CheckDefault(Background background)
		{
			if (background.Brush == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static string FormatColor(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color color)
		{
			if (color == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string name = color.Name;
			if (name != null)
			{
				return name;
			}
			return color.ToHex();
		}

		private static string FormatPen(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen pen, bool optimize)
		{
			if (pen == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string text;
			if (optimize)
			{
				text = FormatColor(pen.Color);
				if (pen.Style != Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.DashStyle.Solid)
				{
					text = text + ", " + pen.Width.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo);
					text = text + ", " + pen.Style;
				}
				else if (pen.Width != 1f)
				{
					text = text + ", " + pen.Width.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				text = FormatColor(pen.Color) + ", " + pen.Width.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + ", " + pen.Style;
			}
			return text;
		}

		private string FormatStyle(Style style)
		{
			int id = _sc.GetId(style);
			if (id != -1)
			{
				return "Style" + id;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void SaveAlignmentAsAttribute(string name, ContentAlignment alignment)
		{
			if (!CheckDefault(alignment))
			{
				string value = ((alignment.Vertical == Alignment.Top) ? alignment.Horizontal.ToString() : ((alignment.Horizontal != Alignment.Left) ? (alignment.Horizontal.ToString() + ", " + alignment.Vertical) : alignment.Vertical.ToString()));
				SetAttribute(name, value);
			}
		}

		private void SaveAttachedProperties(Element element)
		{
			if (element.Panel != null)
			{
				PropertyCollection propertyCollection = element.Panel.AttachedProperties[element];
				float value = propertyCollection.GetValue("Left", 0f);
				float value2 = propertyCollection.GetValue("Top", 0f);
				float value3 = propertyCollection.GetValue("Angle", 0f);
				if (value != 0f)
				{
					SetAttribute("Left", value);
				}
				if (value2 != 0f)
				{
					SetAttribute("Top", value2);
				}
				if (value3 != 0f)
				{
					SetAttribute("Angle", value3);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SaveAttachment(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Attachments.Attachment attachment)
		{
			_writer.WriteStartElement("Attachment");
			SetAttribute("Name", attachment.Name);
			SetAttribute("MimeType", attachment.MimeType);
			SetAttribute("Description", attachment.Description);
			attachment.Content.Position = 0L;
			MemoryStream memoryStream = _compressor.Deflate(attachment.Content);
			byte[] array = memoryStream.ToArray();
			_writer.WriteBase64(array, 0, array.Length);
			_writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private void SaveAttachments()
		{
			if (_report.Attachments.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			_writer.WriteStartElement("Attachments");
			foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Attachments.Attachment attachment in _report.Attachments)
			{
				SaveAttachment(attachment);
			}
			_writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private void SaveBackground(string tag, Background background)
		{
			SaveBrush(tag, background.Brush, checkReference: true);
		}

		private bool SaveBackgroundAsAttribute(string name, Background background)
		{
			if (CheckDefault(background))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return SaveBrushAsAttribute(name, background.Brush, checkReference: true);
		}

		private void SaveBlend(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.ColorBlend blend)
		{
			_writer.WriteStartElement("Blend");
			foreach (ColorBlendEntry item in blend)
			{
				SaveBlendEntry(item);
			}
			_writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private void SaveBlendEntry(ColorBlendEntry entry)
		{
			_writer.WriteStartElement("Entry");
			SetAttribute("Color", FormatColor(entry.Color));
			SetAttribute("Offset", entry.Position);
			_writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private void SaveBookmarks()
		{
			BookmarkLevelCollection levels = ((Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Bookmarks.Bookmarks)_report.Bookmarks).Levels;
			if (levels.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			_writer.WriteStartElement("Bookmarks");
			foreach (BookmarkLevel item in levels)
			{
				SaveLevel(item);
			}
			_writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private void SaveBorder(string tag, Border border)
		{
			if (border.Pen != null)
			{
				_writer.WriteStartElement(tag);
				SavePen(border.Pen, checkReference: true);
				_writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private void SaveBorders(string tag, Borders borders)
		{
			_writer.WriteStartElement(tag);
			bool flag = SaveCornersAsAttribute("Corners", borders.Corners);
			if (borders.HasLeft)
			{
				SaveBorder("Left", borders.Left);
			}
			if (borders.HasRight)
			{
				SaveBorder("Right", borders.Right);
			}
			if (borders.HasTop)
			{
				SaveBorder("Top", borders.Top);
			}
			if (borders.HasBottom)
			{
				SaveBorder("Bottom", borders.Bottom);
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				SaveCorners("Corners", borders.Corners);
			}
			_writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private bool SaveBordersAsAttribute(string name, Borders borders)
		{
			if (CheckDefault(borders))
			{
				return true;
			}
			string text = null;
			if (borders.HasAll && borders.Left.Pen != null && borders.Left.Pen.Equals(borders.Right.Pen) && borders.Left.Pen.Equals(borders.Top.Pen) && borders.Left.Pen.Equals(borders.Bottom.Pen))
			{
				Corners corners = borders.Corners;
				if (CheckDefault(corners))
				{
					text = FormatPen(borders.Left.Pen, optimize: true);
				}
				else if (corners.HasAll && corners.TopLeft.Radius == corners.TopRight.Radius && corners.TopLeft.Radius == corners.BottomLeft.Radius && corners.TopLeft.Radius == corners.BottomRight.Radius && borders.Left.Pen.Equals(corners.TopLeft.Pen) && borders.Left.Pen.Equals(corners.TopRight.Pen) && borders.Left.Pen.Equals(corners.BottomLeft.Pen) && borders.Left.Pen.Equals(corners.BottomRight.Pen))
				{
					text = ((corners.TopLeft.Radius != 0f) ? (FormatPen(borders.Left.Pen, optimize: false) + ", " + corners.TopLeft.Radius.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo)) : FormatPen(borders.Left.Pen, optimize: true));
				}
			}
			if (text != null)
			{
				SetAttribute(name, text);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SaveBrush(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush brush, int id)
		{
			_writer.WriteStartElement("Brush");
			SetAttribute("Id", "Brush" + id);
			SaveBrush(brush, checkReference: false);
			_writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private void SaveBrush(string tag, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush brush, bool checkReference)
		{
			if (brush != null)
			{
				_writer.WriteStartElement(tag);
				SaveBrush(brush, checkReference);
				_writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private void SaveBrush(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush brush, bool checkReference)
		{
			if (brush == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (checkReference && _lbc.Brushes.ContainsKey(brush))
			{
				SetAttribute("Reference", "#Brush" + _lbc.Brushes[brush]);
				return;
			}
			SetAttribute("Type", brush.Type.ToString());
			SetAttribute("Sealed", brush.IsSealed);
			switch (brush.Type)
			{
			case BrushType.SolidColor:
			{
				SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush = (SolidColorBrush)brush;
				SetAttribute("Color", FormatColor(solidColorBrush.Color));
				break;
			}
			case BrushType.Hatch:
			{
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.HatchBrush hatchBrush = (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.HatchBrush)brush;
				SetAttribute("Style", hatchBrush.Style.ToString());
				SetAttribute("ForeColor", FormatColor(hatchBrush.ForeColor));
				SetAttribute("BackColor", FormatColor(hatchBrush.BackColor));
				break;
			}
			case BrushType.LinearGradient:
			{
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.LinearGradientBrush)brush;
				if (linearGradientBrush.Angle != 0f)
				{
					SetAttribute("Angle", linearGradientBrush.Angle.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo));
				}
				if (linearGradientBrush.Blend.Count == 2)
				{
					SetAttribute("StartColor", FormatColor(linearGradientBrush.Blend[0].Color));
					SetAttribute("EndColor", FormatColor(linearGradientBrush.Blend[1].Color));
				}
				else
				{
					SaveBlend(linearGradientBrush.Blend);
				}
				break;
			}
			case BrushType.LinearGradientDirect:
			{
				LinearGradientDirectBrush linearGradientDirectBrush = (LinearGradientDirectBrush)brush;
				SaveRectangleAsAttribute("Rectangle", linearGradientDirectBrush.Rectangle);
				SaveMatrixAsAttribute("Transform", linearGradientDirectBrush.Transform);
				SaveBlend(linearGradientDirectBrush.Blend);
				break;
			}
			case BrushType.RadialGradient:
			{
				RadialGradientBrush radialGradientBrush = (RadialGradientBrush)brush;
				SetAttribute("Circular", radialGradientBrush.Circular);
				if (radialGradientBrush.Angle != 0f)
				{
					SetAttribute("Angle", radialGradientBrush.Angle.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo));
				}
				SavePointAsAttribute("Center", radialGradientBrush.Center, 0.5f, 0.5f);
				if (radialGradientBrush.RadiusX != 0.5f)
				{
					SetAttribute("RadiusX", radialGradientBrush.RadiusX);
				}
				if (radialGradientBrush.RadiusY != 0.5f)
				{
					SetAttribute("RadiusY", radialGradientBrush.RadiusY);
				}
				SavePointAsAttribute("Focus", radialGradientBrush.Focus, 0.5f, 0.5f);
				if (radialGradientBrush.Blend.Count == 2)
				{
					SetAttribute("StartColor", FormatColor(radialGradientBrush.Blend[0].Color));
					SetAttribute("EndColor", FormatColor(radialGradientBrush.Blend[1].Color));
				}
				else
				{
					SaveBlend(radialGradientBrush.Blend);
				}
				break;
			}
			case BrushType.RadialGradientDirect:
			{
				RadialGradientDirectBrush radialGradientDirectBrush = (RadialGradientDirectBrush)brush;
				SetAttribute("Circular", radialGradientDirectBrush.Circular);
				SavePointAsAttribute("Center", radialGradientDirectBrush.Center, 0.5f, 0.5f);
				if (radialGradientDirectBrush.RadiusX != 0.5f)
				{
					SetAttribute("RadiusX", radialGradientDirectBrush.RadiusX);
				}
				if (radialGradientDirectBrush.RadiusY != 0.5f)
				{
					SetAttribute("RadiusY", radialGradientDirectBrush.RadiusY);
				}
				SavePointAsAttribute("Focus", radialGradientDirectBrush.Focus, 0.5f, 0.5f);
				SaveMatrixAsAttribute("Transform", radialGradientDirectBrush.Transform);
				SaveBlend(radialGradientDirectBrush.Blend);
				break;
			}
			case BrushType.Texture:
			{
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.TextureBrush textureBrush = (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.TextureBrush)brush;
				SaveImage(textureBrush.Image);
				if (textureBrush.Angle != 0f)
				{
					SetAttribute("Angle", textureBrush.Angle.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo));
				}
				if (textureBrush.ScaleX != 1f)
				{
					SetAttribute("ScaleX", textureBrush.ScaleX.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo));
				}
				if (textureBrush.ScaleY != 1f)
				{
					SetAttribute("ScaleY", textureBrush.ScaleY.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo));
				}
				if (textureBrush.OffsetX != 0f)
				{
					SetAttribute("OffsetX", textureBrush.OffsetX.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo));
				}
				if (textureBrush.OffsetY != 0f)
				{
					SetAttribute("OffsetY", textureBrush.OffsetY.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo));
				}
				break;
			}
			case BrushType.TextureDirect:
			{
				TextureDirectBrush textureDirectBrush = (TextureDirectBrush)brush;
				SaveImage(textureDirectBrush.Image);
				SaveMatrixAsAttribute("Transform", textureDirectBrush.Transform);
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		private bool SaveBrushAsAttribute(string name, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush brush, bool checkReference)
		{
			if (brush == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (checkReference && _lbc.Brushes.ContainsKey(brush))
			{
				SetAttribute(name, "#Brush" + _lbc.Brushes[brush]);
				return true;
			}
			string text = null;
			switch (brush.Type)
			{
			case BrushType.SolidColor:
			{
				SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush = (SolidColorBrush)brush;
				text = $"{FormatColor(solidColorBrush.Color)},{solidColorBrush.IsSealed}";
				break;
			}
			case BrushType.Hatch:
			{
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.HatchBrush hatchBrush = (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.HatchBrush)brush;
				text = $"{hatchBrush.Style.ToString()},{FormatColor(hatchBrush.ForeColor)},{FormatColor(hatchBrush.BackColor)},{hatchBrush.IsSealed}";
				break;
			}
			case BrushType.LinearGradient:
			{
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.LinearGradientBrush)brush;
				if (linearGradientBrush.Blend.Count == 2)
				{
					text = FormatColor(linearGradientBrush.Blend[0].Color) + ", " + FormatColor(linearGradientBrush.Blend[1].Color);
					if (linearGradientBrush.Angle != 0f)
					{
						text = text + ", " + linearGradientBrush.Angle.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo);
					}
					text = text + "," + linearGradientBrush.IsSealed;
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			if (text == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SetAttribute(name, text);
			return true;
		}

		private void SaveBrushes()
		{
			_lbc = new BrushCollector();
			_report.Process(_lbc);
			if (_lbc.Brushes.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			_writer.WriteStartElement("Brushes");
			foreach (KeyValuePair<Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush, int> brush in _lbc.Brushes)
			{
				SaveBrush(brush.Key, brush.Value);
			}
			_writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private void SaveCorner(string tag, Corner corner)
		{
			if (corner.Pen != null || corner.Radius != 0f)
			{
				_writer.WriteStartElement(tag);
				SavePen(corner.Pen, checkReference: true);
				if (corner.Radius != 0f)
				{
					SetAttribute("Radius", corner.Radius);
				}
				_writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private void SaveCorners(string tag, Corners corners)
		{
			_writer.WriteStartElement(tag);
			if (corners.HasTopLeft)
			{
				SaveCorner("TopLeft", corners.TopLeft);
			}
			if (corners.HasTopRight)
			{
				SaveCorner("TopRight", corners.TopRight);
			}
			if (corners.HasBottomLeft)
			{
				SaveCorner("BottomLeft", corners.BottomLeft);
			}
			if (corners.HasBottomRight)
			{
				SaveCorner("BottomRight", corners.BottomRight);
			}
			_writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private bool SaveCornersAsAttribute(string name, Corners corners)
		{
			if (CheckDefault(corners))
			{
				return true;
			}
			string text = null;
			if (corners.HasAll && corners.TopLeft.Pen != null && corners.TopLeft.Radius == corners.TopRight.Radius && corners.TopLeft.Radius == corners.BottomLeft.Radius && corners.TopLeft.Radius == corners.BottomRight.Radius && corners.TopLeft.Pen.Equals(corners.TopRight.Pen) && corners.TopLeft.Pen.Equals(corners.BottomLeft.Pen) && corners.TopLeft.Pen.Equals(corners.BottomRight.Pen))
			{
				text = ((corners.TopLeft.Radius != 0f) ? (FormatPen(corners.TopLeft.Pen, optimize: false) + ", " + corners.TopLeft.Radius.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo)) : FormatPen(corners.TopLeft.Pen, optimize: true));
			}
			if (text != null)
			{
				SetAttribute(name, text);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SaveEncryptor(IEncryptor encryptor)
		{
			if (encryptor.Password.Owner != null || encryptor.Password.User != null || ((Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Preferences.PDF.Permissions)encryptor.Permissions).Restricted())
			{
				_writer.WriteStartElement("Encryptor");
				SetAttribute("Cipher", encryptor.Cipher.ToString());
				SavePassword(encryptor.Password);
				SavePermissions(encryptor.Permissions);
				_writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		}

		private void SaveFont(string tag, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font font, FontVariant fontVariant, bool checkReference)
		{
			if (font != null)
			{
				_writer.WriteStartElement(tag);
				SaveFont(font, fontVariant, checkReference);
				_writer.WriteEndElement();
			}

		private void SaveFont(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font font, FontVariant fontVariant, bool checkReference)
		{
			if (font == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (checkReference && _lfc.Fonts.ContainsKey(font))
			{
				SetAttribute("Reference", "#Font" + _lfc.Fonts[font]);
				return;
			}
			SaveFont(font);
			SetAttribute("Name", font.Name);
			SetAttribute("Size", font.Size);
			if (font.Bold)
			{
				SetAttribute("Bold", value: true);
			}
			if (font.Italic)
			{
				SetAttribute("Italic", value: true);
			}
			if (font.Strikeout)
			{
				SetAttribute("Strikeout", value: true);
			}
			if (font.DoubleStrikeout)
			{
				SetAttribute("DoubleStrikeout", value: true);
			}
			if (font.Underline)
			{
				SetAttribute("Underline", value: true);
			}
			if (font.DoubleUnderline)
			{
				SetAttribute("DoubleUnderline", value: true);
			}
			if (fontVariant == FontVariant.Subscript)
			{
				SetAttribute("Subscript", value: true);
			}
			if (fontVariant == FontVariant.Superscript)
			{
				SetAttribute("Superscript", value: true);
			}
			if (fontVariant == FontVariant.AllCaps)
			{
				SetAttribute("AllCaps", value: true);
			}
			if (fontVariant == FontVariant.SmallCaps)
			{
				SetAttribute("SmallCaps", value: true);
			}
			if (font.Preferences.Subset)
			{
				SetAttribute("Subset", value: true);
			}
		}

		private void SaveFont(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font font)
		{
			if (font == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (font.Preferences.Embed)
			{
				Resource resource = _rc.GetResource(font);
				if (resource != null)
				{
					SetAttribute("Source", "#Font" + resource.Id);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SetAttribute("Source", font.Preferences.Location);
			}
			SetAttribute("Sealed", font.IsSealed);
		}

		private bool SaveFontAsAttribute(string name, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font font, FontVariant fontVariant, bool checkReference)
		{
			if (font == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (checkReference && _lfc.Fonts.ContainsKey(font))
			{
				SetAttribute(name, "#Font" + _lfc.Fonts[font]);
				return true;
			}
			if (font.Preferences.Embed || font.Preferences.Location != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string text = font.Name + ", ";
			text += font.Size.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo);
			if (font.Bold)
			{
				text += ", Bold";
			}
			if (font.Italic)
			{
				text += ", Italic";
			}
			if (font.Strikeout)
			{
				text += ", Strikeout";
			}
			if (font.DoubleStrikeout)
			{
				text += ", DoubleStrikeout";
			}
			if (font.Underline)
			{
				text += ", Underline";
			}
			if (font.DoubleUnderline)
			{
				text += ", DoubleUnderline";
			}
			if (fontVariant == FontVariant.Subscript)
			{
				text += ", Subscript";
			}
			if (fontVariant == FontVariant.Superscript)
			{
				text += ", Superscript";
			}
			if (fontVariant == FontVariant.AllCaps)
			{
				text += ", AllCaps";
			}
			if (fontVariant == FontVariant.SmallCaps)
			{
				text += ", SmallCaps";
			}
			if (font.IsSealed)
			{
				text += ", Sealed";
			}
			SetAttribute(name, text);
			return true;
		}

		private void SaveFonts()
		{
			_lfc = new FontCollector();
			_report.Process(_lfc);
			if (_lfc.Fonts.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			_writer.WriteStartElement("Fonts");
			foreach (KeyValuePair<Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font, int> font in _lfc.Fonts)
			{
				SaveFont(font.Key, font.Value);
			}
			_writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private void SaveHeight(Height height)
		{
			switch (height.Type)
			{
			case HeightType.Fixed:
				SetAttribute("Height", ((FixedHeight)height).Value);
				break;
			case HeightType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeHeight relativeHeight = (RelativeHeight)height;
				if (relativeHeight.Constraint != null)
				{
					SetAttribute("Height", relativeHeight.Value.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + "% [" + relativeHeight.Constraint.Min.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + ", " + relativeHeight.Constraint.Max.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + "]");
				}
				else
				{
					SetAttribute("Height", relativeHeight.Value.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + "%");
				}
				break;
			}
			case HeightType.Max:
				SetAttribute("Height", "Max");
				break;
			case HeightType.Auto:
				SetAttribute("Height", "Auto");
				break;
			}
		}

		private void SaveHorizontalMarginsAsAttribute(string name, HorizontalMargins margins)
		{
			if (!CheckDefault(margins))
			{
				string value = ((margins.Left != margins.Right) ? (margins.Left.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + ", " + margins.Right.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo)) : margins.Left.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo));
				SetAttribute(name, value);
			}
		}

		private void SaveImage(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (image.Preferences.Embed)
			{
				Resource resource = _rc.GetResource(image);
				if (resource != null)
				{
					SetAttribute("Source", "#Image" + resource.Id);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SetAttribute("Source", image.Preferences.Location);
			}
			switch (image.Preferences.Converter.Type)
			{
			case ConverterType.Grey:
				SetAttribute("Converter", "Grey");
				break;
			case ConverterType.BW:
			{
				BWImageConverter bWImageConverter = (BWImageConverter)image.Preferences.Converter;
				string value = "BW, " + bWImageConverter.Level + ", " + bWImageConverter.Invert;
				SetAttribute("Converter", value);
				break;
			}
			}
			switch (image.Preferences.Compressor.Type)
			{
			case CompressorType.JPEG:
			{
				JPEGCompressor jPEGCompressor = (JPEGCompressor)image.Preferences.Compressor;
				if (jPEGCompressor.Quality != 75)
				{
					string value2 = "JPEG, " + jPEGCompressor.Quality;
					SetAttribute("Compressor", value2);
				}
				break;
			}
			case CompressorType.Flate:
				SetAttribute("Compressor", "Flate");
				break;
			}
		}

		private void SaveIndentsAsAttribute(string name, Indents indents)
		{
			if (!CheckDefault(indents))
			{
				string value = ((indents.Left != indents.Right || indents.Top != indents.Bottom) ? (indents.Left.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + ", " + indents.Right.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + ", " + indents.Top.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + ", " + indents.Bottom.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo)) : ((indents.Left != indents.Top) ? (indents.Left.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + ", " + indents.Top.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo)) : indents.Left.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo)));
				SetAttribute(name, value);
			}
		}

		private void SaveListBullets(string tag, Bullets bullets)
		{
			_writer.WriteStartElement(tag);
			if (bullets.Type != BulletType.BlackCircle)
			{
				SetAttribute("Type", bullets.Type.ToString());
			}
			SetAttribute("Style", bullets.Style);
			if (bullets.Type == BulletType.Decimal)
			{
				if (bullets.Template != "{0}.")
				{
					SetAttribute("Template", bullets.Template);
				}
			}
			else if (bullets.Template != "{0})")
			{
				SetAttribute("Template", bullets.Template);
			}
			if (bullets.Glyph != 0)
			{
				SetAttribute("Glyph", bullets.Glyph);
			}
			if (bullets.Indent != 15f)
			{
				SetAttribute("Indent", bullets.Indent);
			}
			if (bullets.OffsetX != 0f)
			{
				SetAttribute("OffsetX", bullets.OffsetX);
			}
			if (bullets.OffsetY != 0f)
			{
				SetAttribute("OffsetY", bullets.OffsetY);
			}
			_writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private bool SaveListBulletsAsAttribute(string name, Bullets bullets)
		{
			if (CheckDefault(bullets))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (bullets.Type == BulletType.Decimal)
			{
				if (bullets.Template != "{0}.")
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			else if (bullets.Template != "{0})")
			{
				return false;
			}
			string text = null;
			if (bullets.Glyph == 0 && bullets.OffsetX == 0f && bullets.OffsetY == 0f)
			{
				text = ((bullets.Indent == 15f) ? (bullets.Type.ToString() + ", " + FormatStyle(bullets.Style)) : (bullets.Type.ToString() + ", " + FormatStyle(bullets.Style) + ", " + bullets.Indent.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo)));
			}
			if (text != null)
			{
				SetAttribute(name, text);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SaveMatrixAsAttribute(string name, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix matrix)
		{
			if (!matrix.IsIdentity)
			{
				string text = matrix.M11.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + ", ";
				text = text + matrix.M12.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + ", ";
				text = text + matrix.M21.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + ", ";
				text = text + matrix.M22.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + ", ";
				text = text + matrix.OffsetX.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + ", ";
				text += matrix.OffsetY.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo);
				SetAttribute(name, text);
			}
		}

		private void SavePattern(TextPattern pattern, int id)
		{
			_writer.WriteStartElement("Text");
			SetAttribute("Id", "Text" + id);
			SetAttribute("Style", pattern.Style);
			if (pattern.Heading != TextHeading.Normal)
			{
				SetAttribute("Heading", pattern.Heading.ToString());
			}
			if (pattern.Interval != 0f)
			{
				SetAttribute("Interval", pattern.Interval);
			}
			SaveTextAlignmentAsAttribute("Alignment", pattern.Alignment);
			SaveTextIndentsAsAttribute("Indents", pattern.Indents);
			bool flag = SaveTextTabsAsAttribute("Tabs", pattern.Tabs);
			bool flag2 = SaveBordersAsAttribute("Borders", pattern.Borders);
			SaveMarginsAsAttribute("Margins", pattern.Margins);
			SavePaddingsAsAttribute("Paddings", pattern.Paddings);
			bool flag3 = SaveBackgroundAsAttribute("Background", pattern.Background);
			if (!flag)
			{
				SaveTextTabs("Tabs", pattern.Tabs);
			}
			if (!flag2)
			{
				SaveBorders("Borders", pattern.Borders);
			}
			if (!flag3)
			{
				SaveBackground("Background", pattern.Background);
			}
			_writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private void SavePatterns()
		{
			_pc = new PatternCollector();
			_report.Process(_pc);
			if (_pc.TextPatterns.Count == 0 && _pc.TablePatterns.Count == 0 && _pc.GridPatterns.Count == 0 && _pc.FlowPatterns.Count == 0 && _pc.ListPatterns.Count == 0 && _pc.TreePatterns.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			_writer.WriteStartElement("Patterns");
			foreach (TextPattern textPattern in _pc.TextPatterns)
			{
				SavePattern(textPattern, _pc.GetId(textPattern));
			}
			foreach (TablePattern tablePattern in _pc.TablePatterns)
			{
				SavePattern(tablePattern, _pc.GetId(tablePattern));
			}
			foreach (GridPattern gridPattern in _pc.GridPatterns)
			{
				SavePattern(gridPattern, _pc.GetId(gridPattern));
			}
			foreach (FlowPattern flowPattern in _pc.FlowPatterns)
			{
				SavePattern(flowPattern, _pc.GetId(flowPattern));
			}
			foreach (ListPattern listPattern in _pc.ListPatterns)
			{
				SavePattern(listPattern, _pc.GetId(listPattern));
			}
			foreach (TreePattern treePattern in _pc.TreePatterns)
			{
				SavePattern(treePattern, _pc.GetId(treePattern));
			}
			_writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private void SavePen(string tag, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen pen, bool checkReference)
		{
			if (pen != null)
			{
				_writer.WriteStartElement(tag);
				SavePen(pen, checkReference);
				_writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private void SavePen(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen pen, bool checkReference)
		{
			if (pen == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (checkReference && _lpc.Pens.ContainsKey(pen))
			{
				SetAttribute("Reference", "#Pen" + _lpc.Pens[pen]);
				return;
			}
			SetAttribute("Color", FormatColor(pen.Color));
			if (pen.Width != 1f)
			{
				SetAttribute("Width", pen.Width.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo));
			}
			if (pen.Style != Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.DashStyle.Solid)
			{
				SetAttribute("Style", pen.Style.ToString());
			}
			if (pen.Cap != Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.LineCap.Flat)
			{
				SetAttribute("Cap", pen.Cap.ToString());
			}
			if (pen.Join != Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.LineJoin.Miter)
			{
				SetAttribute("Join", pen.Join.ToString());
			}
			if (pen.MiterLimit != 10f)
			{
				SetAttribute("MiterLimit", pen.MiterLimit.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo));
			}
			SetAttribute("Sealed", pen.IsSealed);
		}

		private void SavePenAsAttribute(string name, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen pen, bool checkReference)
		{
			if (pen == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (checkReference && _lpc.Pens.ContainsKey(pen))
			{
				SetAttribute(name, "#Pen" + _lpc.Pens[pen]);
				return;
			}
			string text = FormatColor(pen.Color);
			int num = 1;
			if (pen.Width != 1f)
			{
				num = 2;
			}
			if (pen.Style != Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.DashStyle.Solid)
			{
				num = 3;
			}
			if (pen.Cap != Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.LineCap.Flat)
			{
				num = 4;
			}
			if (pen.Join != Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.LineJoin.Miter)
			{
				num = 5;
			}
			if (pen.MiterLimit != 10f)
			{
				num = 6;
			}
			if (num > 1)
			{
				text = text + ", " + pen.Width.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo);
			}
			if (num > 2)
			{
				text = text + ", " + pen.Style;
			}
			if (num > 3)
			{
				text = text + ", " + pen.Cap;
			}
			if (num > 4)
			{
				text = text + ", " + pen.Join;
			}
			if (num > 5)
			{
				text = text + ", " + pen.MiterLimit.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo);
			}
			SetAttribute(name, text);
		}

		private void SavePens()
		{
			_lpc = new PenCollector();
			_report.Process(_lpc);
			if (_lpc.Pens.Count == 0)

			}
			_writer.WriteStartElement("Pens");
			foreach (KeyValuePair<Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen, int> pen in _lpc.Pens)
			{
				SavePen(pen.Key, pen.Value);
			}
			_writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private void SaveReport()
		{
			SaveInfo();
			SavePreferences();
			SaveAttachments();
			SaveResources();
			SavePens();
			SaveBrushes();
			SaveFonts();
			SaveStyles();
			SavePatterns();
			SaveBookmarks();
			SaveSections();
		}

		private void SaveResource(Resource resource)
		{
			_writer.WriteStartElement(resource.Type.ToString());
			SetAttribute("Id", resource.Type.ToString() + resource.Id);
			MemoryStream memoryStream = resource.Stream;
			if (resource.Type != ResourceType.Image)
			{
				memoryStream.Position = 0L;
				memoryStream = _compressor.Deflate(memoryStream);
			}
			byte[] array = memoryStream.ToArray();
			_writer.WriteBase64(array, 0, array.Length);
			_writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private void SaveResources()
		{
			_rc = new ResourceCollector();
			_report.Process(_rc);
			if (_rc.Resources.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			_writer.WriteStartElement("Resources");
			foreach (Resource resource in _rc.Resources)
			{
				if (resource.Type == ResourceType.Font)
				{
					SaveResource(resource);
				}
			}
			foreach (Resource resource2 in _rc.Resources)
			{
				if (resource2.Type == ResourceType.Image)
				{
					SaveResource(resource2);
				}
			}
			foreach (Resource resource3 in _rc.Resources)
			{
				if (resource3.Type == ResourceType.Metafile)
				{
					SaveResource(resource3);
				}
			}
			_writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private void SaveSections()
		{
			if (_report.Sections.Count != 0)
			{
				_writer.WriteStartElement("Sections");
				_report.Process(this);
				_writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private void SaveMarginsAsAttribute(string name, Margins margins)
		{
			if (!CheckDefault(margins))
			{
				string value = ((margins.Left != margins.Right || margins.Top != margins.Bottom) ? (margins.Left.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + ", " + margins.Right.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + ", " + margins.Top.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + ", " + margins.Bottom.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo)) : ((margins.Left != margins.Top) ? (margins.Left.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + ", " + margins.Top.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo)) : margins.Left.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo)));
				SetAttribute(name, value);
			}
		}

		private void SaveTextBody(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Text text)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			Style style = text.StyleResolved;
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Hyperlink hyperlink = null;
			CharBuffer charBuffer = new CharBuffer();
			_writer.Formatting = Formatting.None;
			foreach (Atom atom in text.Atoms)
			{
				bool flag3 = false;
				if (atom.Type != AtomType.Char && charBuffer.Count > 0)
				{
					_writer.WriteString(charBuffer.ToString());
					charBuffer.Clear();
				}
				if (hyperlink != atom.Hyperlink)
				{
					if (charBuffer.Count > 0)
					{
						_writer.WriteString(charBuffer.ToString());
						charBuffer.Clear();
					}
					hyperlink = atom.Hyperlink;
					if (flag2)
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							_writer.WriteEndElement();
							flag = false;
						}
						_writer.WriteEndElement();
						flag3 = true;
						flag2 = false;
					}
					if (hyperlink != null)
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							_writer.WriteEndElement();
							flag = false;
						}
						_writer.WriteStartElement("Link");
						SetAttribute("Reference", hyperlink.Reference);
						if (style != atom.Style)
						{
							style = atom.Style;
							if (style != text.StyleResolved)
							{
								SetAttribute("Style", style);
							}
							flag3 = false;
						}
						flag2 = true;
					}
				}
				bool flag4 = false;
				if (atom.Type != AtomType.Image && atom.Type != AtomType.Target && (flag3 || style != atom.Style))
				{
					if (charBuffer.Count > 0)
					{
						_writer.WriteString(charBuffer.ToString());
						charBuffer.Clear();
					}
					style = atom.Style;
					if (flag)
					{
						_writer.WriteEndElement();
						flag = false;
					}
					if (style != text.StyleResolved)
					{
						flag4 = true;
					}
				}
				switch (atom.Type)
				{
				case AtomType.Char:
				{
					if (flag4)
					{
						_writer.WriteStartElement("Block");
						SetAttribute("Style", style);
						flag = true;
					}
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Atoms.Char obj = (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Atoms.Char)atom;
					charBuffer.Add(obj.Value);
					break;
				}
				case AtomType.MergeCode:
				{
					MergeCode mergeCode = (MergeCode)atom;
					_writer.WriteStartElement("MergeCode");
					SetAttribute("Name", mergeCode.Name);
					if (flag4)
					{
						SetAttribute("Style", style);
					}
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				}
				case AtomType.DateTime:
				{
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Atoms.DateTime dateTime = (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Atoms.DateTime)atom;
					_writer.WriteStartElement("DateTime");
					SetAttribute("Format", dateTime.Format);
					if (flag4)
					{
						SetAttribute("Style", style);
					}
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				}
				case AtomType.PageNumber:
				{
					PageNumber pageNumber = (PageNumber)atom;
					_writer.WriteStartElement("PageNumber");
					if (pageNumber.Format != PageNumberFormat.Decimal)
					{
						SetAttribute("Format", pageNumber.Format.ToString());
					}
					if (flag4)
					{
						SetAttribute("Style", style);
					}
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				}
				case AtomType.Leader:
				{
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Atoms.Leader leader = (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Atoms.Leader)atom;
					_writer.WriteStartElement("Leader");
					if (leader.Format != LeaderFormat.Dots)
					{
						SetAttribute("Format", leader.Format.ToString());
					}
					if (flag4)
					{
						SetAttribute("Style", style);
					}
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				}
				case AtomType.Target:
				{
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Atoms.Target target = (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Atoms.Target)atom;
					_writer.WriteStartElement("Target");
					SetAttribute("Name", target.Value.Name);
					SetAttribute("Caption", target.Value.Caption);
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				}
				case AtomType.Image:
				{
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Atoms.Image image = (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Atoms.Image)atom;
					_writer.WriteStartElement("Image");
					SaveImage(image.Value);
					float num = Converter.PixelsToPoints(image.Value.Width);
					float num2 = Converter.PixelsToPoints(image.Value.Height);
					if (num != image.Size.Width)
					{
						SetAttribute("Width", image.Size.Width);
					}
					if (num2 != image.Size.Height)
					{
						SetAttribute("Height", image.Size.Height);
					}
					SaveIndentsAsAttribute("Indents", image.Indents);
					if (image.Alignment != ImageAlignment.Bottom)
					{
						SetAttribute("Alignment", image.Alignment.ToString());
					}
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			if (charBuffer.Count > 0)
			{
				_writer.WriteString(charBuffer.ToString());
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				_writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				_writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private void SaveTextIndentsAsAttribute(string name, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Indents indents)
		{
			if (!CheckDefault(indents))
			{
				string value = ((indents.First == indents.Left && indents.First == indents.Right) ? indents.First.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) : ((indents.First != 0f) ? (indents.First.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + ", " + indents.Left.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + ", " + indents.Right.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo)) : (indents.Left.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + ", " + indents.Right.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo))));
				SetAttribute(name, value);
			}
		}

		private void SaveTextLineNumbering(TextLineNumbering ln)
		{
			_writer.WriteStartElement("LineNumbering");
			SetAttribute("Style", ln.Style);
			if (ln.First != 1)
			{
				SetAttribute("First", ln.First);
			}
			if (ln.OffsetX != 0f)
			{
				SetAttribute("OffsetX", ln.OffsetX);
			}
			if (ln.OffsetY != 0f)
			{
				SetAttribute("OffsetY", ln.OffsetY);
			}
			_writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private void SaveTextTab(Tab tab)
		{
			_writer.WriteStartElement("Tab");
			if (tab.Offset != 35f)
			{
				SetAttribute("Offset", tab.Offset);
			}
			if (tab.Leader != LeaderFormat.Spaces)
			{
				SetAttribute("Leader", tab.Leader.ToString());
			}
			_writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private void SaveTextTabs(string tag, Tabs tabs)
		{
			_writer.WriteStartElement(tag);
			if (tabs.Default.Offset != 35f)
			{
				SetAttribute("Offset", tabs.Default.Offset);
			}
			if (tabs.Default.Leader != LeaderFormat.Spaces)
			{
				SetAttribute("Leader", tabs.Default.Leader.ToString());
			}
			foreach (Tab item in tabs.Content)
			{
				SaveTextTab(item);
			}
			_writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private bool SaveTextTabsAsAttribute(string name, Tabs tabs)
		{
			if (CheckDefault(tabs))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (tabs.Content.Count > 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string value = ((tabs.Default.Leader != LeaderFormat.Spaces) ? (tabs.Default.Offset.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + ", " + tabs.Default.Leader) : tabs.Default.Offset.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo));
			SetAttribute(name, value);
			return true;
		}

		private void SaveTreeCaptionPattern(TreeCaptionPattern caption)
		{
			_writer.WriteStartElement("Caption");
			if (caption.Layout != Layout.Vertical)
			{
				SetAttribute("Layout", caption.Layout.ToString());
			}
			SaveAlignmentAsAttribute("Alignment", caption.Alignment);
			bool flag = SaveBordersAsAttribute("Borders", caption.Borders);
			SaveMarginsAsAttribute("Margins", caption.Margins);
			SavePaddingsAsAttribute("Paddings", caption.Paddings);
			bool flag2 = SaveBackgroundAsAttribute("Background", caption.Background);
			if (!flag)
			{
				SaveBorders("Borders", caption.Borders);
			}
			if (!flag2)
			{
				SaveBackground("Background", caption.Background);
			}
			_writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private void SaveVerticalMarginsAsAttribute(string name, VerticalMargins margins)
		{
			if (!CheckDefault(margins))
			{
				string value = ((margins.Top != margins.Bottom) ? (margins.Top.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + ", " + margins.Bottom.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo)) : margins.Top.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo));

			}
		}

		private void SaveViewer(IViewer viewer)

			_writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private void SaveWidth(Width width)
		{
			switch (width.Type)
			{
			case WidthType.Fixed:
				SetAttribute("Width", ((FixedWidth)width).Value);
				break;
			case WidthType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeWidth relativeWidth = (RelativeWidth)width;
				if (relativeWidth.Constraint != null)
				{
					SetAttribute("Width", relativeWidth.Value.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + "% [" + relativeWidth.Constraint.Min.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + ", " + relativeWidth.Constraint.Max.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + "]");
				}
				else
				{
					SetAttribute("Width", relativeWidth.Value.ToString(Converter.NumberFormatInfo) + "%");
				}
				break;
			}
			case WidthType.Max:
				SetAttribute("Width", "Max");
				break;
			case WidthType.Auto:
				SetAttribute("Width", "Auto");
				break;
			}
		}

		public override void Process(SectionPage page)
		{
			_writer.WriteStartElement("Page");
			if (page.Blank)
			{
				SetAttribute("Blank", value: true);
			}
			if (page.Width != _section.PageSize.Width)
			{
				SetAttribute("Width", page.Width);
			}
			if (page.Height != _section.PageSize.Height)
			{
				SetAttribute("Height", page.Height);
			}
			bool flag = true;
			bool flag2 = true;
			if (page.Borders != _section.PageBordersResolved)
			{
				if (CheckDefault(page.Borders))
				{
					SetAttribute("Borders", "Default");
				}
				else
				{
					flag = SaveBordersAsAttribute("Borders", page.Borders);
				}
			}
			if (page.Margins != _section.PageMarginsResolved)
			{
				if (CheckDefault(page.Margins))
				{
					SetAttribute("Margins", "Default");
				}
				else
				{
					SaveMarginsAsAttribute("Margins", page.Margins);
				}
			}
			if (page.Paddings != _section.PagePaddings)
			{
				if (CheckDefault(page.Paddings))
				{
					SetAttribute("Paddings", "Default");
				}
				else
				{
					SavePaddingsAsAttribute("Paddings", page.Paddings);
				}
			}
			if (page.Background != _section.PageBackground)
			{
				if (CheckDefault(page.Background))
				{
					SetAttribute("Background", "Default");
				}
				else
				{
					flag2 = SaveBackgroundAsAttribute("Background", page.Background);
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				SaveBorders("Borders", page.Borders);
			}
			if (!flag2)
			{
				SaveBackground("Background", page.Background);
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Segment.Segment segment)
		{
			_writer.WriteStartElement("Segment");
			if (segment.Stretch)
			{
				SetAttribute("Stretch", value: true);
			}
			SaveAlignmentAsAttribute("Alignment", segment.AlignmentResolved);
			bool flag = SaveBordersAsAttribute("Borders", segment.Borders);
			SaveMarginsAsAttribute("Margins", segment.MarginsResolved);
			SavePaddingsAsAttribute("Paddings", segment.Paddings);
			bool flag2 = SaveBackgroundAsAttribute("Background", segment.Background);
			if (!flag)
			{
				SaveBorders("Borders", segment.Borders);
			}
			if (!flag2)
			{
				SaveBackground("Background", segment.Background);
			}
		}

		public override void Process(SegmentHeader header)
		{
			_writer.WriteStartElement("Header");
			if (header.Height.Type != HeightType.Auto)
			{
				SaveHeight(header.Height);
			}
			if (header.Layout != Layout.Vertical)
			{
				SetAttribute("Layout", header.Layout.ToString());
			}
			SetAttribute("Repeat", header.Repeat);
			SaveAlignmentAsAttribute("Alignment", header.AlignmentResolved);
			bool flag = SaveBordersAsAttribute("Borders", header.Borders);
			SaveMarginsAsAttribute("Margins", header.MarginsResolved);
			SavePaddingsAsAttribute("Paddings", header.Paddings);
			bool flag2 = SaveBackgroundAsAttribute("Background", header.Background);
			if (!flag)
			{
				SaveBorders("Borders", header.Borders);
			}
			if (!flag2)
			{
				SaveBackground("Background", header.Background);
			}
		}

		public override void Process(SegmentFooter footer)
		{
			_writer.WriteStartElement("Footer");
			if (footer.Height.Type != HeightType.Auto)
			{
				SaveHeight(footer.Height);
			}
			if (footer.Layout != Layout.Vertical)
			{
				SetAttribute("Layout", footer.Layout.ToString());
			}
			SetAttribute("Repeat", footer.Repeat);
			SaveAlignmentAsAttribute("Alignment", footer.AlignmentResolved);
			bool flag = SaveBordersAsAttribute("Borders", footer.Borders);
			SaveMarginsAsAttribute("Margins", footer.MarginsResolved);
			SavePaddingsAsAttribute("Paddings", footer.Paddings);
			bool flag2 = SaveBackgroundAsAttribute("Background", footer.Background);
			if (!flag)
			{
				SaveBorders("Borders", footer.Borders);

			if (!flag2)
			{
				SaveBackground("Background", footer.Background);
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.QuickText text)
		{
			_writer.WriteStartElement("QuickText");
			SetAttribute("Content", text.Content);
			if (text.Indent != 0f)
			{
				SetAttribute("Indent", text.Indent);
			}
			if (text.Interval != 0f)
			{
				SetAttribute("Interval", text.Interval);
			}
			if (text.KeepSolid)
			{
				SetAttribute("KeepSolid", value: true);
			}
			bool flag = SaveFontAsAttribute("Font", text.Font, FontVariant.Normal, checkReference: true);
			bool flag2 = SaveBrushAsAttribute("Brush", text.Brush, checkReference: true);
			SaveTextAlignmentAsAttribute("Alignment", text.Alignment);
			SaveMarginsAsAttribute("Margins", text.MarginsResolved);
			if (!flag)
			{
				SaveFont("Font", text.Font, FontVariant.Normal, checkReference: true);
			}
			if (!flag2)
			{
				SaveBrush("Brush", text.Brush, checkReference: true);
			}
		}

		public override void Process(QuickImage image)
		{
			_writer.WriteStartElement("QuickImage");
			SaveImage(image.Value);
			SetAttribute("TransparentColor", image.TransparentColor);
			if (image.Alpha != 1f)
			{
				SetAttribute("Alpha", image.Alpha);
			}
			if (image.Stretch)
			{
				SetAttribute("Stretch", value: true);
			}
			SaveMarginsAsAttribute("Margins", image.MarginsResolved);
		}

		public override void Process(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickList.QuickList list)
		{
			_writer.WriteStartElement("QuickList");
			if (list.Numbered)
			{
				SetAttribute("Numbered", list.Numbered);
			}
			if (list.Interval != 5f)
			{
				SetAttribute("Interval", list.Interval);
			}

		public override void Process(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Text text)
		{
			_writer.WriteStartElement("Text");
			bool flag = true;
			bool flag2 = true;
			bool flag3 = true;
			SaveAttachedProperties(text);
			if (text.Width.Type != WidthType.Max)
			{
				SaveWidth(text.Width);
			}
			if (text.Height.Type != HeightType.Auto)
			{
				SaveHeight(text.Height);
			}
			TextPattern pattern = text.Pattern;
			if (pattern != null)
			{
				SetAttribute("Pattern", pattern);
				if (text.StyleResolved != pattern.Style)
				{
					SetAttribute("Style", text.StyleResolved);
				}
				if (text.Heading != pattern.Heading)
				{
					SetAttribute("Heading", text.Heading.ToString());
				}
				if (text.Interval != pattern.Interval)
				{
					SetAttribute("Interval", text.Interval);
				}
				if (text.AlignmentResolved != pattern.Alignment)
				{
					if (CheckDefault(text.AlignmentResolved))
					{
						SetAttribute("Alignment", "Default");
					}
					else
					{
						SaveTextAlignmentAsAttribute("Alignment", text.AlignmentResolved);
					}
				}
				if (text.IndentsResolved != pattern.Indents)
				{
					if (CheckDefault(text.IndentsResolved))
					{
						SetAttribute("Indents", "Default");
					}
					else
					{
						SaveTextIndentsAsAttribute("Indents", text.IndentsResolved);
					}
				}
				if (text.TabsResolved != pattern.Tabs)
				{
					if (CheckDefault(text.TabsResolved))
					{
						SetAttribute("Tabs", "Default");
					}
					else
					{
						flag3 = SaveTextTabsAsAttribute("Tabs", text.TabsResolved);
					}
				}
				if (text.Borders != pattern.Borders)
				{
					if (CheckDefault(text.Borders))
					{
						SetAttribute("Borders", "Default");
					}
					else
					{
						flag = SaveBordersAsAttribute("Borders", text.Borders);
					}
				}
				if (text.MarginsResolved != pattern.Margins)
				{
					if (CheckDefault(text.MarginsResolved))
					{
						SetAttribute("Margins", "Default");
					}
					else
					{
						SaveMarginsAsAttribute("Margins", text.MarginsResolved);
					}
				}
				if (text.Paddings != pattern.Paddings)
				{
					if (CheckDefault(text.Paddings))
					{
						SetAttribute("Paddings", "Default");
					}
					else
					{
						SavePaddingsAsAttribute("Paddings", text.Paddings);
					}
				}
				if (text.Background != pattern.Background)
				{
					if (CheckDefault(text.Background))
					{
						SetAttribute("Background", "Default");
					}
					else
					{
						flag2 = SaveBackgroundAsAttribute("Background", text.Background);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SetAttribute("Style", text.StyleResolved);
				if (text.Heading != TextHeading.Normal)
				{
					SetAttribute("Heading", text.Heading.ToString());
				}
				if (text.Interval != 0f)
				{
					SetAttribute("Interval", text.Interval);
				}
				SaveTextAlignmentAsAttribute("Alignment", text.AlignmentResolved);
				SaveTextIndentsAsAttribute("Indents", text.IndentsResolved);
				flag3 = SaveTextTabsAsAttribute("Tabs", text.TabsResolved);
				flag = SaveBordersAsAttribute("Borders", text.Borders);
				SaveMarginsAsAttribute("Margins", text.MarginsResolved);
				SavePaddingsAsAttribute("Paddings", text.Paddings);
				flag2 = SaveBackgroundAsAttribute("Background", text.Background);
			}
			if (text.Caption != null)
			{
				SetAttribute("Caption", text.Caption);
			}
			if (text.KeepSolid && text.Height.Type == HeightType.Auto)
			{
				SetAttribute("KeepSolid", value: true);
			}
			bool flag4 = false;
			if (!flag3)
			{
				SaveTextTabs("Tabs", text.TabsResolved);
				flag4 = true;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				SaveBorders("Borders", text.Borders);
				flag4 = true;
			}
			if (!flag2)
			{
				SaveBackground("Background", text.Background);
				flag4 = true;
			}
			if (text.LineNumbering != null)
			{
				SaveTextLineNumbering(text.LineNumbering);
				flag4 = true;
			}
			if (text.FirstLetter != null)
			{
				SaveTextFirstLetter(text.FirstLetter);
				flag4 = true;
			}
			if (flag4)
			{
				_writer.WriteStartElement("Body");
			}
			SaveTextBody(text);
			if (flag4)
			{
				_writer.WriteEndElement();
				_writer.Formatting = Formatting.Indented;
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Tree.Tree tree)
		{
			_writer.WriteStartElement("Tree");
			bool flag = true;
			bool flag2 = true;
			SaveAttachedProperties(tree);
			if (tree.Width.Type != WidthType.Max)
			{
				SaveWidth(tree.Width);
			}
			if (tree.Height.Type != HeightType.Auto)
			{
				SaveHeight(tree.Height);
			}
			TreePattern pattern = tree.Pattern;
			if (pattern != null)
			{
				SetAttribute("Pattern", pattern);
				if (tree.Borders != pattern.Borders)
				{
					if (CheckDefault(tree.Borders))
					{
						SetAttribute("Borders", "Default");
					}
					else
					{
						flag = SaveBordersAsAttribute("Borders", tree.Borders);
					}
				}
				if (tree.MarginsResolved != pattern.Margins)
				{
					if (CheckDefault(tree.MarginsResolved))
					{
						SetAttribute("Margins", "Default");
					}
					else
					{
						SaveMarginsAsAttribute("Margins", tree.MarginsResolved);
					}
				}
				if (tree.Paddings != pattern.Paddings)
				{
					if (CheckDefault(tree.Paddings))
					{
						SetAttribute("Paddings", "Default");
					}
					else
					{
						SavePaddingsAsAttribute("Paddings", tree.Paddings);
					}
				}
				if (tree.Background != pattern.Background)
				{
					if (CheckDefault(tree.Background))
					{
						SetAttribute("Background", "Default");
					}
					else
					{
						flag2 = SaveBackgroundAsAttribute("Background", tree.Background);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				flag = SaveBordersAsAttribute("Borders", tree.Borders);
				SaveMarginsAsAttribute("Margins", tree.MarginsResolved);
				SavePaddingsAsAttribute("Paddings", tree.Paddings);
				flag2 = SaveBackgroundAsAttribute("Background", tree.Background);
			}
			if (tree.KeepSolid && tree.Height.Type == HeightType.Auto)
			{
				SetAttribute("KeepSolid", value: true);
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				SaveBorders("Borders", tree.Borders);
			}
			if (!flag2)
			{
				SaveBackground("Background", tree.Background);
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Node node)
		{
			_writer.WriteStartElement("Node");
			if (node.Tree.Pattern != null)
			{
				TreeNodePattern node2 = node.Tree.Pattern.Node;
				if (node.Lines != node2.Lines)
				{
					if (CheckDefault(node.Lines))
					{
						SetAttribute("Lines", "Default");
					}
					else
					{
						SaveTreeLinesAsAttribute("Lines", node.Lines);
					}
				}
				if (node.Indent != node2.Indent)
				{
					SetAttribute("Indent", node.Indent);
				}
				if (node.Interval != node2.Interval)
				{
					SetAttribute("Interval", node.Interval);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SaveTreeLinesAsAttribute("Lines", node.Lines);
				if (node.Indent != 10f)
				{
					SetAttribute("Indent", node.Indent);
				}
				if (node.Interval != 5f)
				{
					SetAttribute("Interval", node.Interval);
				}
			}
			if (node.KeepSolid)
			{
				SetAttribute("KeepSolid", value: true);
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Shapes.Path path)
		{
			_writer.WriteStartElement("Path");
			SavePen("Pen", path.Pen, checkReference: true);
			SaveBrush("Brush", path.Brush, checkReference: true);
			foreach (IPathCommand command in path.Data.Commands)
			{
				switch (command.Type)
				{
				case CommandType.MoveTo:
				{
					MoveToCommand moveToCommand = (MoveToCommand)command;
					_writer.WriteStartElement("MoveTo");
					SetAttribute("X", moveToCommand.X);
					SetAttribute("Y", moveToCommand.Y);
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				}
				case CommandType.LineTo:
				{
					LineToCommand lineToCommand = (LineToCommand)command;
					_writer.WriteStartElement("LineTo");
					SetAttribute("X", lineToCommand.X);
					SetAttribute("Y", lineToCommand.Y);
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				}
				case CommandType.CurveTo:
				{
					CurveToCommand curveToCommand = (CurveToCommand)command;
					_writer.WriteStartElement("CurveTo");
					SetAttribute("X1", curveToCommand.X1);
					SetAttribute("Y1", curveToCommand.Y1);
					SetAttribute("X2", curveToCommand.X2);
					SetAttribute("Y2", curveToCommand.Y2);
					SetAttribute("X3", curveToCommand.X3);
					SetAttribute("Y3", curveToCommand.Y3);
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				}
				case CommandType.ClosePath:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("ClosePath");
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Canvas canvas)
		{
			_writer.WriteStartElement("Canvas");
			SaveAttachedProperties(canvas);
			if (canvas.Width.Type != WidthType.Max)
			{
				SaveWidth(canvas.Width);
			}
			if (canvas.Height.Type != HeightType.Auto)
			{
				SaveHeight(canvas.Height);
			}
			bool flag = SaveBordersAsAttribute("Borders", canvas.Borders);
			SaveMarginsAsAttribute("Margins", canvas.MarginsResolved);
			SavePaddingsAsAttribute("Paddings", canvas.Paddings);
			bool flag2 = SaveBackgroundAsAttribute("Background", canvas.Background);
			if (!flag)
			{
				SaveBorders("Borders", canvas.Borders);
			}
			if (!flag2)
			{
				SaveBackground("Background", canvas.Background);
			}
			Canvas.Reader reader = new Canvas.Reader(canvas.Stream);
			reader.Stream.Position = 0L;
			while (true)
			{
				switch (reader.ReadByte())
				{
				case 1:
					SaveFont("Font", _report.Fonts[reader.ReadInt()], FontVariant.Normal, checkReference: true);
					break;
				case 2:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("ResetFont");
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 3:
					SaveBrush("Brush", _report.Brushes[reader.ReadInt()], checkReference: true);
					break;
				case 4:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("ResetBrush");
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 5:
					SavePen("Pen", _report.Pens[reader.ReadInt()], checkReference: true);
					break;
				case 6:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("ResetPen");
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 7:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("TextPosition");
					SetAttribute("X", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Y", reader.ReadFloat());
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 8:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("CharSpacing");
					SetAttribute("Value", reader.ReadFloat());
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 9:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("AlternateFill");
					SetAttribute("Value", reader.ReadBoolean());
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 10:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("SaveClip");
					SetAttribute("X", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Y", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Width", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Height", reader.ReadFloat());
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 11:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("RestoreClip");
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 12:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("SaveState");
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 13:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("RestoreState");
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 14:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("Transform");
					SetAttribute("M11", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("M12", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("M21", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("M22", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("OffsetX", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("OffsetY", reader.ReadFloat());
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 15:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("StartHyperlink");
					SetAttribute("Reference", reader.ReadString());
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 16:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("StartHyperlink");
					SetAttribute("PageIndex", reader.ReadInt());
					SetAttribute("X", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Y", reader.ReadFloat());
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 17:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("PauseHyperlink");
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 18:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("ResumeHyperlink");
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 19:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("EndHyperlink");
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 20:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("HyperlinkArea");
					SetAttribute("X", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Y", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Width", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Height", reader.ReadFloat());
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 21:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("String");
					SetAttribute("X", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Y", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Text", reader.ReadString());
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 22:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("Spacing");
					SetAttribute("Value", reader.ReadFloat());
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 23:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("Rectangle");
					SetAttribute("X", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Y", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Width", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Height", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Mode", ((PaintMode)reader.ReadByte()/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString());
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 24:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("RoundRect");
					SetAttribute("X", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Y", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Width", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Height", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("EW", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("EH", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Mode", ((PaintMode)reader.ReadByte()/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString());
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 25:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("Line");
					SetAttribute("X1", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Y1", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("X2", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Y2", reader.ReadFloat());
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 26:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("Lines");
					SetAttribute("Points", Converter.ToString(reader.ReadPoints()));
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 27:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("Polygon");
					SetAttribute("Points", Converter.ToString(reader.ReadPoints()));
					SetAttribute("Mode", ((PaintMode)reader.ReadByte()/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString());
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 28:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("Ellipse");
					SetAttribute("X", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Y", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Width", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Height", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Mode", ((PaintMode)reader.ReadByte()/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString());
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 29:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("Arc");
					SetAttribute("X", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Y", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Width", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Height", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("StartAngle", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("EndAngle", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Mode", ((PaintMode)reader.ReadByte()/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString());
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 30:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("Pie");
					SetAttribute("X", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Y", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Width", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Height", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("StartAngle", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("EndAngle", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Mode", ((PaintMode)reader.ReadByte()/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString());
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 31:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("Chord");
					SetAttribute("X", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Y", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Width", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Height", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("StartAngle", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("EndAngle", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Mode", ((PaintMode)reader.ReadByte()/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString());
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 32:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("Curve");
					SetAttribute("Points", Converter.ToString(reader.ReadPoints()));
					SetAttribute("Tension", reader.ReadFloat());
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 33:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("ClosedCurve");
					SetAttribute("Points", Converter.ToString(reader.ReadPoints()));
					SetAttribute("Tension", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Mode", ((PaintMode)reader.ReadByte()/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString());
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 34:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("Bezier");
					SetAttribute("X1", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Y1", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("X2", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Y2", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("X3", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Y3", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("X4", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Y4", reader.ReadFloat());
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 35:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("Beziers");
					SetAttribute("Points", Converter.ToString(reader.ReadPoints()));
					SetAttribute("Mode", ((PaintMode)reader.ReadByte()/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString());
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 36:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("StartShape");
					SetAttribute("Mode", ((PaintMode)reader.ReadByte()/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString());
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 37:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("MoveTo");
					SetAttribute("X", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Y", reader.ReadFloat());
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 38:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("LineTo");
					SetAttribute("X", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Y", reader.ReadFloat());
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 39:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("CurveTo");
					SetAttribute("X1", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Y1", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("X2", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Y2", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("X3", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Y3", reader.ReadFloat());
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 40:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("ClosePath");
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 41:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("EndShape");
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case 42:
					_writer.WriteStartElement("Image");
					SaveImage(_report.Images[reader.ReadInt()]);
					SetAttribute("X", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Y", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Width", reader.ReadFloat());
					SetAttribute("Height", reader.ReadFloat());
					if (reader.ReadBoolean())
					{
						SetAttribute("TransparentColor", reader.ReadColor());
					}
					SetAttribute("Alpha", reader.ReadFloat());
					_writer.WriteEndElement();
					break;
				case -1:
					return;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Rotator rotator)
		{
			_writer.WriteStartElement("Rotator");
			if (rotator.Width.Type != WidthType.Max)
			{
				SaveWidth(rotator.Width);
			}
			if (rotator.Height.Type != HeightType.Auto)
			{
				SaveHeight(rotator.Height);
			}
			if (rotator.Backward)
			{
