	internal class Writer : Visitor
	{
		private Report _report;

		private StreamWriter _writer;

		public Writer(Report report)
		{
			_report = report;
		}

		public void Write(System.IO.Stream stream)
		{
			_writer = new StreamWriter(stream);
			IInfo info = _report.Info;
			_writer.Write("Title : ");
			_writer.WriteLine(info.Title);
			_writer.Write("Subject : ");
			_writer.WriteLine(info.Subject);
			_writer.Write("Author : ");
			_writer.WriteLine(info.Author);
			_writer.Write("Manager : ");
			_writer.WriteLine(info.Manager);
			_writer.Write("Company : ");
			_writer.WriteLine(info.Company);
			_writer.Write("Creator : ");
			_writer.WriteLine(info.Creator);
			_writer.Write("Copyright : ");
			_writer.WriteLine(info.Copyright);
			_writer.Write("Category : ");
			_writer.WriteLine(info.Category);
			_writer.Write("Keywords : ");
			_writer.WriteLine(info.Keywords);
			_writer.Write("Comments : ");
			_writer.WriteLine(info.Comments);
			_writer.Write("Created : ");
			_writer.WriteLine(Convert.ToString(info.Created, Converter.DateTimeFormatInfo));
			_writer.Write("Modified : ");
			_writer.WriteLine(Convert.ToString(info.Modified, Converter.DateTimeFormatInfo));
			_report.Process(this);
			_writer.Close();
		}

		public override void Process(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Section.Section section)
		{
			_writer.WriteLine("==================================================");
		}

		public override void Process(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Text text)
		{
			CharBuffer charBuffer = new CharBuffer();
			foreach (Atom atom in text.Atoms)
			{
				if (atom.Type == AtomType.Char)
				{
					char value = ((Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Atoms.Char)atom).Value;
					if (value == '\n')
					{
						charBuffer.Add('\r');
					}
					charBuffer.Add(value);
				}
			}
			_writer.WriteLine(charBuffer.ToString());
		}
	}

	internal class Marker : Element
	{
		private Index _index;

		private char _letter;

		public Index Index => _index;

		public char Letter => _letter;

		public override ElementType Type => ElementType.IndexMarker;

		public Marker(Report report, Index index, char letter)
			: base(report)
		{
			_index = index;
			_letter = letter;
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			MarkerArea markerArea = null;
			graphics.Font = _index.Alphabet.Style.Font;
			float num = graphics.FontMetrics.Height + _index.Alphabet.Indents.Top + _index.Alphabet.Indents.Bottom;
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
					if (composition.ResidualHeight < num)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				case MeasureState.Create:
					markerArea = new MarkerArea(this);
					markerArea.Parent = composition;
					markerArea.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
					markerArea.Top = composition.Scene.Top + composition.ActiveHeight;
					markerArea.Width = composition.Scene.Width;
					markerArea.Height = num;
					markerArea.Paddings = new Paddings(_index.Alphabet.Indents.Left, _index.Alphabet.Indents.Right, _index.Alphabet.Indents.Top, _index.Alphabet.Indents.Bottom);
					markerArea.ResetScene();
					_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
					composition.Content.Add(markerArea);
					composition.ActiveHeight += num;
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}
	}

	internal class EntryComparer : IComparer<Entry>
	{
		public int Compare(Entry a, Entry b)
		{
			int i = 0;
			int length = a.Path.Length;
			int length2;
			for (length2 = b.Path.Length; i < length && i < length2; i++)
			{
				char c = a.Path[i];
				char c2 = b.Path[i];
				if (i == 0)
				{
					c = char.ToUpper(c);
					c2 = char.ToUpper(c2);
				}
				if (c != c2)
				{
					if (c < c2 || c == ':')
					{
						return -1;
					}
					return 1;
				}
			}
			if (length == length2)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (length < length2)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return 1;
		}
	}

	internal class Index : Element, IIndex
	{
		private Alphabet _alphabet;

		private IndexLevelCollection _levels;

		private ElementCollection _content;

		private int _marker;

		public IAlphabet Alphabet => _alphabet;

		public IndexLevelCollection Levels => _levels;

		public override ElementType Type => ElementType.Index;

		public Index(Report report)
			: base(report)
		{
			_alphabet = new Alphabet();
			_levels = new IndexLevelCollection();
			_content = new ElementCollection();
		}

		public Item AddItem(IndexLevel level, string caption, ReportTargetCollection targets)
		{
			Item item = new Item(_report, level, caption, targets);
			_content.Add(item);
			return item;
		}

		public IIndexLevel AddLevel()
		{
			IndexLevel indexLevel = new IndexLevel();
			_levels.Add(indexLevel);
			return indexLevel;
		}

		public Marker AddMarker(char letter)
		{
			Marker marker = new Marker(_report, this, letter);
			_content.Add(marker);
			return marker;
		}

		public void RemoveDuplicateTargets()
		{
			if (_content == null || _content.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Element item2 in _content)
			{
				if (!(item2 is Item { Targets: var targets }))
				{
					continue;
				}
				for (int num = targets.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					if (IsTargetDuplicate(num, targets))
					{
						targets.RemoveAt(num);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static bool IsTargetDuplicate(int index, ReportTargetCollection targets)
		{
			ReportTarget reportTarget = targets[index];
			for (int i = 0; i < index; i++)
			{
				ReportTarget reportTarget2 = targets[i];
				if (reportTarget.Caption == reportTarget2.Caption && reportTarget.Name == reportTarget2.Name && reportTarget.Destination.Page == reportTarget2.Destination.Page)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			Composition composition2 = null;
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
					if (composition.ResidualHeight < 0f)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				case MeasureState.Create:
					composition2 = new Composition();
					composition2.Fake = true;
					composition2.Parent = composition;
					composition2.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
					composition2.Top = composition.Scene.Top + composition.ActiveHeight;
					composition2.Width = composition.Scene.Width;
					composition2.Height = composition.ResidualHeight;
					composition2.ResetScene();
					if (mode == MeasureMode.Normal)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					}
					else
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Flush;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
				{
					bool flag = false;
					int num = _marker;
					int count2 = _content.Count;
					bool flag2 = _freshBreak;
					while (!flag && num < count2)
					{
						Element element2 = _content[num];
						MeasureResult measureResult = element2.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.Normal);
						if (measureResult != MeasureResult.Ok)
						{
							if (flag2 && measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
							{
								element2.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.Flush);
								num++;
								if (num < count2)
								{
									flag = true;
								}
								continue;
							}
							if (_marker == num && measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
							{
								_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
								return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
							}
							if (measureResult == MeasureResult.PageBreak)
							{
								num++;
							}
							flag = true;
						}
						else
						{
							num++;
							flag2 = false;
						}
					}
					if (composition2.Content.Count != 0)
					{
						composition.Content.Add(composition2);
						if (composition2.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							composition2.Height -= composition2.ResidualHeight;
						}
						composition.ActiveHeight += composition2.Height;
					}
					_marker = num;
					if (flag)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.ContentBreak;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Flush:
				{
					int i = _marker;
					for (int count = _content.Count; i < count; i++)
					{
						Element element = _content[i];
						element.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
					}
					composition.Content.Add(composition2);
					if (composition2.ResidualHeight > 0f)
					{
						composition2.Height -= composition2.ResidualHeight;
					}
					composition.ActiveHeight += composition2.Height;
					_marker = i;
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Process(visitor);
			}
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Reset();
			}
			_marker = 0;
			base.Reset();
		}
	}
	internal class Item : Element
	{
		private IndexLevel _level;

		private string _caption;

		private ReportTargetCollection _targets;

		internal const string INDEX_INDENTATION_STRING = "     ";

		public string Caption => _caption;

		public IndexLevel Level => _level;

		public ReportTargetCollection Targets => _targets;

		public override ElementType Type => ElementType.IndexItem;

		public Item(Report report, IndexLevel level, string caption, ReportTargetCollection targets)
			: base(report)
		{
			_level = level;
			_caption = caption;
			_targets = targets;
		}

		private int GetLinesCount(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics)
		{
			int num = 1;
			Style style = Level.Style;
			graphics.Font = style.Font;
			graphics.Brush = style.Brush;
			graphics.CharSpacing = style.CharSpacing;
			float width = composition.Scene.Width;
			float num2 = graphics.GetStringWidth(Caption) + graphics.GetStringWidth(" ");
			float num3 = num2;
			int num4 = Targets.Count - 1;
			foreach (ReportTarget target in Targets)
			{
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Projection.Destination destination = target.Destination;
				string text = destination.Page.FormattedNumber();
				if (num4 > 0)
				{
					text = $"{text}, ";
					num4--;
				}
				float stringWidth = graphics.GetStringWidth(text);
				if (num3 + stringWidth > width)
				{
					num++;
					num3 = graphics.GetStringWidth("     ") + stringWidth;
				}
				else
				{
					num3 += stringWidth;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Projection.Index.ItemArea itemArea = null;
			graphics.Font = _level.Style.Font;
			int linesCount = GetLinesCount(composition, graphics);
			float num = graphics.FontMetrics.Height * (float)linesCount + _level.Indents.Top + _level.Indents.Bottom;
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
					if (composition.ResidualHeight < num)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				case MeasureState.Create:
					itemArea = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Projection.Index.ItemArea(this);
					itemArea.Parent = composition;
					itemArea.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
					itemArea.Top = composition.Scene.Top + composition.ActiveHeight;
					itemArea.Width = composition.Scene.Width;
					itemArea.Height = num;
					itemArea.Paddings = new Paddings(_level.Indents.Left, _level.Indents.Right, _level.Indents.Top, _level.Indents.Bottom);
					itemArea.ResetScene();
					_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
					composition.Content.Add(itemArea);
					composition.ActiveHeight += num;
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}
	}
	internal class IndexLevel : IIndexLevel
	{
		private Style _style;

		private Indents _indents;

		public Indents Indents
		{
			get
			{
				return _indents;

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			foreach (FlowColumn column in _columns)

		public override void Reset()

		private static MeasureResult ComposeRows(Composition body, IGraphics graphics, ElementCollection content, ref int marker, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			float width = body.Scene.Width;
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			Composition composition = CreateRowBody(body);
			int num3 = 0;
			int num4 = marker;
			int count = content.Count;
			while (num4 < count)
			{
				Element element = content[num4];
				if (element.Type == ElementType.FlowRowBreak || element.Type == ElementType.PageBreak)
				{
					if (composition.Content.Count > 0)
					{
						composition.Height = num2;
						body.ActiveHeight += num2;
					}
					else
					{
						body.Content.RemoveAt(body.Content.Count - 1);
					}
					num4 = (marker = num4 + 1);
					if (mode == MeasureMode.Normal && element.Type == ElementType.PageBreak)
					{
						return MeasureResult.ContentBreak;
					}
					num3 = 0;
					num = 0f;
					num2 = 0f;
					composition = CreateRowBody(body);
					continue;
				}
				IBlock block = null;
				if (element is IBlock)
				{
					block = (IBlock)element;
				}
				float num5 = 0f;
				if (block != null)
				{
					num5 = block.GetBounds(body, graphics).Fit(width) - block.MarginsResolved.Left - block.MarginsResolved.Right;
				}
				num += num5;
				if (block != null)
				{
					num += block.MarginsResolved.Left + block.MarginsResolved.Right;
				}
				if (num <= width || num3 == 0)
				{
					switch (element.Measure(composition, graphics, mode))
					{
					case MeasureResult.Ok:
						if (num2 < composition.ActiveHeight)
						{
							num2 = composition.ActiveHeight;
						}
						composition.Scene.Left += num5;
						if (block != null)
						{
							composition.Scene.Left += block.MarginsResolved.Left + block.MarginsResolved.Right;
						}
						composition.ActiveHeight = 0f;
						num4++;
						num3++;
						break;
					case MeasureResult.BreakBefore:
					case MeasureResult.ContentBreak:
					{
						body.Content.RemoveAt(body.Content.Count - 1);
						for (int i = marker; i <= num4; i++)
						{
							element = content[i];
							element.Reset();
						}
						if (body.Content.Count == 0)
						{
							return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
						}
						return MeasureResult.ContentBreak;
					}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					composition.Height = num2;
					body.ActiveHeight += num2;
					marker = num4;
					num3 = 0;
					num = 0f;
					num2 = 0f;
					composition = CreateRowBody(body);
				}
			}
			if (composition.Content.Count > 0)
			{
				composition.Height = num2;
				body.ActiveHeight += num2;
			}
			else
			{
				body.Content.RemoveAt(body.Content.Count - 1);
			}
			marker = num4;
			return MeasureResult.Ok;
		}

		private static Composition CreateColumnBody(Composition composition, FlowColumn column)
		{
			Composition composition2 = new Composition();
			composition2.Left = composition.Scene.Left + column.MarginsResolved.Left;
			composition2.Top = composition.Scene.Top + composition.ActiveHeight + column.MarginsResolved.Top;
			composition2.Width = column.ActiveWidth;
			composition2.Height = composition.ResidualHeight - column.MarginsResolved.Top - column.MarginsResolved.Bottom;
			composition2.Borders = column.Borders;
			composition2.Margins = column.MarginsResolved;
			composition2.Paddings = column.Paddings;
			composition2.Background = column.Background;
			composition2.ResetScene();
			composition.Content.Add(composition2);
			composition2.Parent = composition;
			return composition2;
		}

		private static Composition CreateRowBody(Composition composition)
		{
			Composition composition2 = new Composition();
			composition2.Fake = true;
			composition2.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
			composition2.Top = composition.Scene.Top + composition.ActiveHeight;
			composition2.Width = composition.Scene.Width;
			composition2.Height = composition.ResidualHeight;
			composition2.ResetScene();
			composition.Content.Add(composition2);
			composition2.Parent = composition;
			return composition2;
		}

	public class ColumnPattern
	{
		private ContentAlignment _alignment;

		private Borders _borders;

		private Margins _margins;

		private Paddings _paddings;

		private Background _background;

		public ContentAlignment Alignment
		{
			get
			{
				return _alignment;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_alignment = value;
			}
		}

		public Background Background
		{
			get
			{
				if (_background == null)
				{
					_background = new Background();
				}
				return _background;
			}
			set
			{
				_background = value;
			}
		}

		public Borders Borders
		{
			get
			{
				return _borders;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_borders = value;
			}
		}

		public Paddings Paddings
		{
			get
			{
				if (_paddings == null)
				{
					_paddings = new Paddings();
				}
				return _paddings;
			}
			set
			{
				_paddings = value;
			}
		}

		public Margins Margins
		{
			get
			{
				if (_margins == null)
				{
					_margins = new Margins();
				}
				return _margins;
			}
			set
			{
				_margins = value;
			}
		}

		public ColumnPattern()
		{
			_alignment = new ContentAlignment();
			_borders = new Borders();
		}

		public void Apply(IFlowColumn column)
		{
			if (column == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("column");
			}
			column.Alignment = _alignment;
			column.Borders = _borders;
			column.Margins = _margins;
			column.Paddings = _paddings;
			column.Background = _background;
		}
	}
	public class FlowPattern
	{
		private ContentAlignment _alignment;

		private Borders _borders;

		private Margins _margins;

		private Paddings _paddings;

		private Background _background;

		private ColumnPattern _column;

		public ContentAlignment Alignment
		{
			get
			{
				return _alignment;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_alignment = value;
			}
		}

		public Background Background
		{
			get
			{
				if (_background == null)
				{
					_background = new Background();
				}
				return _background;
			}
			set
			{
				_background = value;
			}
		}

		public Borders Borders
		{
			get
			{
				return _borders;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_borders = value;
			}
		}

		public ColumnPattern Column => _column;

		public Paddings Paddings
		{
			get
			{
				if (_paddings == null)
				{
					_paddings = new Paddings();
				}
				return _paddings;
			}
			set
			{
				_paddings = value;
			}
		}

		public Margins Margins
		{
			get
			{
				if (_margins == null)
				{
					_margins = new Margins();
				}
				return _margins;
			}
			set
			{
				_margins = value;
			}
		}

		public FlowPattern()
		{
			_alignment = new ContentAlignment();
			_borders = new Borders();
			_column = new ColumnPattern();
		}

		public void Apply(IFlow flow)
		{
			if (flow == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("flow");
			}
			flow.Alignment = _alignment;
			flow.Borders = _borders;
			flow.Margins = _margins;
			flow.Paddings = _paddings;
			flow.Background = _background;
			foreach (FlowColumn column in ((Flow)flow).Columns)
			{
				_column.Apply(column);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class RowBreak : Element

		}
	}

	internal class Destination
	{
		private ProjectionPage _page;

		private float _x;

		private float _y;

		public ProjectionPage Page
		{
			get
			{
				return _page;
			}
			set
			{
				_page = value;
			}
		}

		public float X => _x;

		public float Y
		{
			get
			{
				return _y;
			}
			set
			{
				_y = value;
			}
		}

		public Destination()
		{
		}

		public Destination(ProjectionPage page, float x, float y)
		{
			_page = page;
			_x = x;
			_y = y;
		}
	}

		public Area()
		{
			_scene = new Scene();
			_borders = _defaultBorders;
			_paddings = _defaultPaddings;
			_background = _defaultBackground;
			_margins = _defaultMargins;
		}

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point ClientToView(float x, float y)
		{
			return new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point(x + LeftOffset + _left, y + TopOffset + _top);
		}

		public virtual void Draw(IGraphics graphics)
		{
			if (!(_width <= 0f) && !(_height <= 0f) && !_fake)
			{
				graphics.SaveState();
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point point = ClientToView(0f, 0f);
				float x = point.X;
				float y = point.Y;
				ClipBounds(graphics, x, y, _width, _height, _borders);
				DrawBackground(graphics, x, y, _width, _height, _background);
				DrawBorders(graphics, x, y, _width, _height, _borders);
				graphics.RestoreState();
			}
		}

		public virtual void ResetScene()
		{
			_scene.Left = 0f;
			_scene.Top = 0f;
			_scene.Width = _width;
			_scene.Height = _height;
			if (_borders != null)
			{
				if (_borders.HasLeft && _borders.Left.Pen != null)
				{
					_scene.Left += _borders.Left.Pen.Width / 2f;
					_scene.Width -= _borders.Left.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				if (_borders.HasTop && _borders.Top.Pen != null)
				{
					_scene.Top += _borders.Top.Pen.Width / 2f;
					_scene.Height -= _borders.Top.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				if (_borders.HasRight && _borders.Right.Pen != null)
				{
					_scene.Width -= _borders.Right.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				if (_borders.HasBottom && _borders.Bottom.Pen != null)
				{
					_scene.Height -= _borders.Bottom.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
			}
			if (_paddings != null)
			{
				_scene.Left += _paddings.Left;
				_scene.Top += _paddings.Top;
				_scene.Width -= _paddings.Left + _paddings.Right;
				_scene.Height -= _paddings.Top + _paddings.Bottom;
			}
		}

		public static void ClipBounds(IGraphics graphics, float left, float top, float width, float height, Borders borders)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			float num3 = 0f;
			float num4 = 0f;
			if (borders != null)
			{
				Corners corners = borders.Corners;
				if (corners.HasTopLeft)
				{
					num = corners.TopLeft.Radius;
				}
				if (corners.HasTopRight)
				{
					num2 = corners.TopRight.Radius;
				}
				if (corners.HasBottomRight)
				{
					num3 = corners.BottomRight.Radius;
				}
				if (corners.HasBottomLeft)
				{
					num4 = corners.BottomLeft.Radius;
				}
			}
			bool flag = num == 0f && num2 == 0f && num3 == 0f && num4 == 0f;
			graphics.StartShape(PaintMode.Clip, flag);
			if (flag)
			{
				float x = left + width;
				float y = top + height;
				graphics.MoveTo(left, top);
				graphics.LineTo(x, top);
				graphics.LineTo(x, y);
				graphics.LineTo(left, y);
				graphics.ClosePath();
			}
			else
			{
				float num5 = left + num;
				float num6 = left + width - num2;
				float x2 = left + width;
				float num7 = top + num2;
				float x3 = left + width;
				float num8 = top + height - num3;
				float num9 = left + width - num3;
				float y2 = top + height;
				float num10 = left + num4;
				float y3 = top + height;
				float num11 = top + height - num4;
				float num12 = top + num;
				float x4 = 0f;
				float y4 = 0f;
				float x5 = 0f;
				float y5 = 0f;
				float x6 = 0f;
				float y6 = 0f;
				float x7 = 0f;
				float y7 = 0f;
				float x8 = 0f;
				float y8 = 0f;
				float x9 = 0f;
				float y9 = 0f;
				float x10 = 0f;
				float y10 = 0f;
				float x11 = 0f;
				float y11 = 0f;
				if (num2 > 0f)
				{
					float num13 = 0f;
					float num14 = (float)Math.PI / 2f;
					float num15 = (float)Math.Sin(num13);
					float num16 = (float)Math.Cos(num13);
					float num17 = (float)Math.Sin(num14);
					float num18 = (float)Math.Cos(num14);
					float num19 = 4f * (float)(1.0 - Math.Cos((num14 - num13) / 2f)) / (float)Math.Sin((num14 - num13) / 2f) / 3f;
					x5 = num2 * (num18 + num19 * num17);
					y5 = (0f - num2) * (num17 - num19 * num18);
					x6 = num2 * (num16 - num19 * num15);
					y6 = (0f - num2) * (num15 + num19 * num16);
					x5 += num6;
					y5 += num7;
					x6 += num6;
					y6 += num7;
				}
				if (num3 > 0f)
				{
					float num20 = 4.712389f;
					float num21 = (float)Math.PI * 2f;
					float num22 = (float)Math.Sin(num20);
					float num23 = (float)Math.Cos(num20);
					float num24 = (float)Math.Sin(num21);
					float num25 = (float)Math.Cos(num21);
					float num26 = 4f * (float)(1.0 - Math.Cos((num21 - num20) / 2f)) / (float)Math.Sin((num21 - num20) / 2f) / 3f;
					x7 = num3 * (num25 + num26 * num24);
					y7 = (0f - num3) * (num24 - num26 * num25);
					x8 = num3 * (num23 - num26 * num22);
					y8 = (0f - num3) * (num22 + num26 * num23);
					x7 += num9;
					y7 += num8;
					x8 += num9;
					y8 += num8;
				}
				if (num4 > 0f)
				{
					float num27 = (float)Math.PI;
					float num28 = 4.712389f;
					float num29 = (float)Math.Sin(num27);
					float num30 = (float)Math.Cos(num27);
					float num31 = (float)Math.Sin(num28);
					float num32 = (float)Math.Cos(num28);
					float num33 = 4f * (float)(1.0 - Math.Cos((num28 - num27) / 2f)) / (float)Math.Sin((num28 - num27) / 2f) / 3f;
					x9 = num4 * (num32 + num33 * num31);
					y9 = (0f - num4) * (num31 - num33 * num32);
					x10 = num4 * (num30 - num33 * num29);
					y10 = (0f - num4) * (num29 + num33 * num30);
					x9 += num10;
					y9 += num11;
					x10 += num10;
					y10 += num11;
				}
				if (num > 0f)
				{
					float num34 = (float)Math.PI / 2f;
					float num35 = (float)Math.PI;
					float num36 = (float)Math.Sin(num34);
					float num37 = (float)Math.Cos(num34);
					float num38 = (float)Math.Sin(num35);
					float num39 = (float)Math.Cos(num35);
					float num40 = 4f * (float)(1.0 - Math.Cos((num35 - num34) / 2f)) / (float)Math.Sin((num35 - num34) / 2f) / 3f;
					x11 = num * (num39 + num40 * num38);
					y11 = (0f - num) * (num38 - num40 * num39);
					x4 = num * (num37 - num40 * num36);
					y4 = (0f - num) * (num36 + num40 * num37);
					x11 += num5;
					y11 += num12;
					x4 += num5;
					y4 += num12;
				}
				graphics.MoveTo(num5, top);
				graphics.LineTo(num6, top);
				if (num2 > 0f)
				{
					graphics.CurveTo(x5, y5, x6, y6, x2, num7);
				}
				graphics.LineTo(x3, num8);
				if (num3 > 0f)
				{
					graphics.CurveTo(x7, y7, x8, y8, num9, y2);
				}
				graphics.LineTo(num10, y3);
				if (num4 > 0f)
				{
					graphics.CurveTo(x9, y9, x10, y10, left, num11);
				}
				graphics.LineTo(left, num12);
				if (num > 0f)
				{
					graphics.CurveTo(x11, y11, x4, y4, num5, top);
				}
				graphics.ClosePath();
			}
			graphics.EndShape();
		}

		public static void DrawBackground(IGraphics graphics, float left, float top, float width, float height, Background background)
		{
			if (background != null)
			{
				if (background.Brush != null)
				{
					graphics.Brush = background.Brush;
					graphics.FillRectangle(left, top, width, height);
				}
				if (background.Drawing != null)
				{
					background.Drawing.OnDraw(graphics, left, top, width, height);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void DrawBorders(IGraphics graphics, float left, float top, float width, float height, Borders borders)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			float num3 = 0f;
			float num4 = 0f;
			Corners corners = null;
			if (borders != null)
			{
				corners = borders.Corners;
				if (corners.HasTopLeft)
				{
					num = corners.TopLeft.Radius;
				}
				if (corners.HasTopRight)
				{
					num2 = corners.TopRight.Radius;
				}
				if (corners.HasBottomRight)
				{
					num3 = corners.BottomRight.Radius;
				}
				if (corners.HasBottomLeft)
				{
					num4 = corners.BottomLeft.Radius;
				}
			}
			if (num == 0f && num2 == 0f && num3 == 0f && num4 == 0f && borders != null && borders.HasAll && borders.Top.Pen != null && borders.Top.Pen == borders.Right.Pen && borders.Top.Pen == borders.Bottom.Pen && borders.Top.Pen == borders.Left.Pen)
			{
				float x = left + width;
				float y = top + height;
				graphics.Pen = borders.Top.Pen;
				graphics.StartShape(PaintMode.Stroke);
				graphics.MoveTo(left, top);
				graphics.LineTo(x, top);
				graphics.LineTo(x, y);
				graphics.LineTo(left, y);
				graphics.ClosePath();
				graphics.EndShape();
				return;
			}
			float num5 = left + num;
			float num6 = left + width - num2;

			float num14 = top + num;

			float y3 = 0f;
			float x4 = 0f;
			float y4 = 0f;

			float y5 = 0f;
			float x6 = 0f;
			float y6 = 0f;
			float x7 = 0f;
			float y7 = 0f;
			float x8 = 0f;

				{
					graphics.Pen = borders.Bottom.Pen;
					graphics.StartShape(PaintMode.Stroke);
					flag = true;
					graphics.MoveTo(num10, num11);
				}
				graphics.LineTo(num12, y2);
			}
			else
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					graphics.EndShape();
					flag = false;
				}
				flag2 = true;
			}
			if (num4 > 0f && corners != null && corners.HasBottomLeft && corners.BottomLeft.Pen != null)
			{
				if (flag && (borders == null || !borders.HasBottom || borders.Bottom.Pen != corners.BottomLeft.Pen))
				{
					graphics.EndShape();
					flag = false;
					flag2 = true;
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					graphics.Pen = corners.BottomLeft.Pen;
					graphics.StartShape(PaintMode.Stroke);
					flag = true;
					graphics.MoveTo(num12, y2);
				}
				graphics.CurveTo(x8, y8, x9, y9, left, num13);
			}
			else if (flag && num4 > 0f)
			{
				graphics.EndShape();
				flag = false;
				flag2 = true;
			}
			if (borders != null && borders.HasLeft && borders.Left.Pen != null)
			{
				if (flag && ((num4 > 0f && (corners == null || !corners.HasBottomLeft || borders.Left.Pen != corners.BottomLeft.Pen)) || (num4 == 0f && (!borders.HasBottom || borders.Left.Pen != borders.Bottom.Pen))))
				{
					graphics.EndShape();
					flag = false;
					flag2 = true;
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					graphics.Pen = borders.Left.Pen;
					graphics.StartShape(PaintMode.Stroke);
					flag = true;
					graphics.MoveTo(left, num13);
				}
				graphics.LineTo(left, num14);
			}
			else
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					graphics.EndShape();
					flag = false;
				}
				flag2 = true;
			}
			if (num > 0f && corners != null && corners.HasTopLeft && corners.TopLeft.Pen != null)
			{
				if (flag && (borders == null || !borders.HasLeft || borders.Left.Pen != corners.TopLeft.Pen))
				{
					graphics.EndShape();
					flag = false;
					flag2 = true;
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					graphics.Pen = corners.TopLeft.Pen;
					graphics.StartShape(PaintMode.Stroke);
					flag = true;
					graphics.MoveTo(left, num14);
				}
				graphics.CurveTo(x10, y10, x3, y3, num5, top);
			}
			else if (flag && num > 0f)
			{
				graphics.EndShape();
				flag = false;
				flag2 = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (!flag2)
				{
					graphics.ClosePath();
				}
				graphics.EndShape();
			}
		}
	}
	internal class AreaCollection : List<Area>

	internal class Composition : Area
	{
		protected class Marker
		{
			private int _index;

			private float _activeHeight;

			public float ActiveHeight => _activeHeight;

			public int Index => _index;

			public Marker(int index, float activeHeight)
			{
				_index = index;
				_activeHeight = activeHeight;
			}
		}

		protected float _activeHeight;

		protected Stack<Scene> _scenes;

		protected AreaCollection _content;

		protected Stack<Marker> _markers;

		public float ActiveHeight
		{
			get
			{
				return _activeHeight;
			}
			set
			{
				_activeHeight = value;
			}
		}

		public AreaCollection Content => _content;

		public float ResidualHeight => _scene.Height - _activeHeight;

		public override bool Empty
		{
			get
			{
				if (_empty)
				{
					return true;
				}
				foreach (Area item in _content)
				{
					if (!item.Empty)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			set
			{
				_empty = value;
			}
		}

		public Composition()
		{
			_scenes = new Stack<Scene>();
			_content = new AreaCollection();
			_markers = new Stack<Marker>();
		}

		public override void Draw(IGraphics graphics)
		{
			if (_width <= 0f || _height <= 0f)
			{
				return;
			}
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point point = ClientToView(0f, 0f);
			float x = point.X;
			float y = point.Y;
			if (!_fake)
			{
				graphics.SaveState();
				Area.ClipBounds(graphics, x, y, _width, _height, _borders);
				Area.DrawBackground(graphics, x, y, _width, _height, _background);
			}
			foreach (Area item in _content)
			{
				if (item.RotationAngle == 0f)
				{
					item.Draw(graphics);
					continue;
				}
				graphics.SaveState();
				graphics.Rotate(x + item.Left, y + item.Top, item.RotationAngle);
				item.Draw(graphics);
				graphics.RestoreState();
			}
			if (!_fake)
			{
				Area.DrawBorders(graphics, x, y, _width, _height, _borders);
				graphics.RestoreState();
			}
		}

		public void Mark()
		{
			_markers.Push(new Marker(_content.Count, _activeHeight));
		}

		public void RestoreScene()
		{
			if (_scenes.Count > 0)
			{
				_scene = _scenes.Pop();
			}
		}

		public void Rollback()
		{
			if (_markers.Count > 0)
			{
				Marker marker = _markers.Pop();
				_content.RemoveRange(marker.Index, _content.Count - marker.Index);
				_activeHeight = marker.ActiveHeight;
			}
		}

		public void SaveScene()
		{
			_scenes.Push(_scene);
			_scene = new Scene(_scene.Left, _scene.Top, _scene.Width, _scene.Height);
		}

		public static void AlignHorizontal(Composition composition, ContentAlignment alignment, Layout layout)
		{
			int count = composition.Content.Count;
			if (count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (layout == Layout.Vertical)
			{
				float left = composition.Scene.Left;
				foreach (Area item in composition.Content)
				{
					item.Left = left + item.MarginsResolved.Left;
				}
				{
					foreach (Area item2 in composition.Content)
					{
						float num = composition.Scene.Width - item2.MarginsResolved.Left - item2.MarginsResolved.Right;
						switch (alignment.Horizontal)
						{
						case Alignment.Center:
							item2.Left += (num - item2.Width) / 2f;
							break;
						case Alignment.Right:
							item2.Left += num - item2.Width;
							break;
						}
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			float num2 = composition.Scene.Width;
			float num3 = composition.Scene.Left;
			foreach (Area item3 in composition.Content)
			{
				num3 = (item3.Left = num3 + item3.MarginsResolved.Left);
				num3 += item3.Width + item3.MarginsResolved.Right;
				num2 -= item3.Width + item3.MarginsResolved.Left + item3.MarginsResolved.Right;
			}
			if (alignment.Horizontal == Alignment.Justify && count > 1)
			{
				num2 /= (float)(count - 1);
			}
			int num5 = 0;
			foreach (Area item4 in composition.Content)
			{
				switch (alignment.Horizontal)
				{
				case Alignment.Center:
					item4.Left += num2 / 2f;
					break;
				case Alignment.Right:
					item4.Left += num2;
					break;
				case Alignment.Justify:
					item4.Left += num2 * (float)num5;
					break;
				}
				num5++;
			}
		}

		public static void AlignVertical(Composition composition, ContentAlignment alignment, Layout layout)
		{
			int count = composition.Content.Count;
			if (count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (layout == Layout.Vertical)
			{
				float num = composition.Scene.Height;
				float num2 = composition.Scene.Top;
				foreach (Area item in composition.Content)
				{
					num2 = (item.Top = num2 + item.MarginsResolved.Top);
					num2 += item.Height + item.MarginsResolved.Bottom;
					num -= item.Height + item.MarginsResolved.Top + item.MarginsResolved.Bottom;
				}
				if (alignment.Vertical == Alignment.Justify && count > 1)
				{
					num /= (float)(count - 1);
				}
				int num4 = 0;
				{
					foreach (Area item2 in composition.Content)
					{
						switch (alignment.Vertical)
						{
						case Alignment.Middle:
							item2.Top += num / 2f;
							break;
						case Alignment.Bottom:
							item2.Top += num;
							break;
						case Alignment.Justify:
							item2.Top += num * (float)num4;
							break;
						}
						num4++;
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			float top = composition.Scene.Top;
			foreach (Area item3 in composition.Content)
			{
				item3.Top = top + item3.MarginsResolved.Top;
			}
			foreach (Area item4 in composition.Content)
			{
				float num5 = composition.Scene.Height - item4.MarginsResolved.Top - item4.MarginsResolved.Bottom;
				switch (alignment.Vertical)
				{
				case Alignment.Middle:
					item4.Top += (num5 - item4.Height) / 2f;
					break;
				case Alignment.Bottom:
					item4.Top += num5 - item4.Height;
					break;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	internal class ProjectionPage : IProjectionPage
	{
		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Section.Section _section;

		private int _absoluteIndex;

		private int _relativeIndex;

		private int _number;

		private float _width;

		private float _height;

		private CompositionCollection _compositions;

		public int AbsoluteIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return _absoluteIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				_absoluteIndex = value;
			}
		}

		public CompositionCollection Compositions => _compositions;

		public float Height => _height;

		public int Number
		{
			get
			{
				return _number;
			}
			set
			{
				_number = value;
			}
		}

		public int RelativeIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return _relativeIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				_relativeIndex = value;
			}
		}

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Section.Section Section
		{
			get
			{
				return _section;
			}
			set
			{
				_section = value;
			}
		}

		public float Width => _width;

		public ProjectionPage(float width, float height)
		{
			_width = width;
			_height = height;
			_compositions = new CompositionCollection();
		}

		public Composition AddComposition()
		{
			Composition composition = new Composition();
			composition.Page = this;
			_compositions.Add(composition);
			return composition;
		}

		public void Draw(IGraphics graphics)
		{
			foreach (Composition composition in _compositions)
			{
				composition.Draw(graphics);
			}
			DrawPageNumber(graphics);
		}

		private void DrawPageNumber(IGraphics graphics)
		{
			PageNumbering pageNumbering = _section.PageNumbering;
			if (pageNumbering != null && (_relativeIndex != 0 || !pageNumbering.SkipFirst))
			{
				graphics.Font = pageNumbering.Style.Font;
				graphics.Brush = pageNumbering.Style.Brush;
				string text = FormattedNumber(advanced: true);
				float num = pageNumbering.OffsetX;
				float num2 = pageNumbering.OffsetY;
				switch (pageNumbering.Alignment.Horizontal)
				{
				case Alignment.Left:
					num = ((!_section.Flip || (_relativeIndex + 1) % 2 != 0) ? (num + 20f) : (num + (_width - 20f - graphics.GetStringWidth(text) - pageNumbering.OffsetX * 2f)));
					break;
				case Alignment.Center:
					num += (_width - graphics.GetStringWidth(text)) / 2f;
					break;
				case Alignment.Right:
					num = ((!_section.Flip || (_relativeIndex + 1) % 2 != 0) ? (num + (_width - 20f - graphics.GetStringWidth(text))) : (num + (20f - pageNumbering.OffsetX * 2f)));
					break;
				}
				Alignment vertical = pageNumbering.Alignment.Vertical;
				if (vertical != Alignment.Top && vertical == Alignment.Bottom)
				{
					num2 += _height - (graphics.FontMetrics.Ascent + graphics.FontMetrics.Descent);
				}
				graphics.DrawString(num, num2, text);
			}
		}

		public string FormattedNumber()
		{
			return FormattedNumber(advanced: false);
		}

		public string FormattedNumber(bool advanced)
		{
			PageNumbering pageNumbering = _section.PageNumbering;
			if (pageNumbering != null)
			{
				if (advanced)
				{
					return FormattedNumber(pageNumbering.Format, pageNumbering.TemplateResolved);
				}
				return FormattedNumber(pageNumbering.Format, "{0}");
			}
			return FormattedNumber(PageNumberFormat.Decimal, "{0}");
		}

		public string FormattedNumber(PageNumberFormat format, string template)
		{
			int number = _number;
			int lastPageNumber = _section.LastPageNumber;
			int lastPageNumber2 = _section.Report.Sections[_section.Report.Sections.Count - 1].LastPageNumber;
			return FormattedNumber(format, template, number, lastPageNumber, lastPageNumber2);
		}

		private static string FormattedNumber(PageNumberFormat format, string template, int v0, int v1, int v2)
		{
			string result = "";
			if (template == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			switch (format)
			{
			case PageNumberFormat.Decimal:
				result = string.Format(template, v0.ToString(), v1.ToString(), v2.ToString());
				break;
			case PageNumberFormat.SmallLetters:
				result = string.Format(template, Converter.ToLetterNumber(v0), Converter.ToLetterNumber(v1), Converter.ToLetterNumber(v2));
				break;
			case PageNumberFormat.BigLetters:
				result = string.Format(template, Converter.ToLetterNumber(v0).ToUpper(), Converter.ToLetterNumber(v1).ToUpper(), Converter.ToLetterNumber(v2).ToUpper());
				break;
			case PageNumberFormat.SmallRoman:
				result = string.Format(template, Converter.ToRomanNumber(v0), Converter.ToRomanNumber(v1), Converter.ToRomanNumber(v2));
				break;
			case PageNumberFormat.BigRoman:
				result = string.Format(template, Converter.ToRomanNumber(v0).ToUpper(), Converter.ToRomanNumber(v1).ToUpper(), Converter.ToRomanNumber(v2).ToUpper());
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

		{
			_pages = pages;
			_index = -1;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			_pages = null;
		}

		public bool MoveNext()
		{
			_index++;
			if (_index < _pages.Count)

				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		{
			_index = -1;
		}
	}

	internal class ImageArea : Area
	{
		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image _image;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color _transparentColor;

		private float _alpha;

		private bool _keepRatio;

		private float _offsetY;

		public float OffsetY
		{
			get
			{
				return _offsetY;
			}
			set
			{
				_offsetY = value;
			}
		}

		public ImageArea(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color transparentColor, float alpha, bool keepRatio)
		{
			_image = image;
			_transparentColor = transparentColor;
			_alpha = alpha;
			_keepRatio = keepRatio;
		}

		public override void Draw(IGraphics graphics)
		{
			if (_width <= 0f || _height <= 0f)
			{
				return;
			}
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point point = ClientToView(0f, 0f);
			float x = point.X;
			float y = point.Y;
			if (!_fake)
			{
				graphics.SaveState();
				Area.ClipBounds(graphics, x, y, _width, _height, _borders);
				Area.DrawBackground(graphics, x, y, _width, _height, _background);
			}
			if (_image.Width > 0 && _image.Height > 0)
			{
				float x2 = x + _scene.Left;
				float num = y + _scene.Top;
				float width = _scene.Width;
				float height = _scene.Height;
				if (_keepRatio)
				{
					height = (float)_image.Height / (float)_image.Width * width;
				}
				if (_alpha > 0f && _alpha < 1f)
				{
					graphics.DrawImage(_image, x2, num + _offsetY, width, height, _transparentColor, _alpha);
				}
				else
				{
					graphics.DrawImage(_image, x2, num + _offsetY, width, height, _transparentColor);
				}
			}
			if (!_fake)
			{
				Area.DrawBorders(graphics, x, y, _width, _height, _borders);
				graphics.RestoreState();
			}
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Projection.Text
{
	internal class TextComposition : Composition
	{
		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Text _text;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.LineCollection _lines;

		private FrameCollection _frames;

		private int _firstLineIndex;

		private float _offsetY;

		private int _linesCount;

		private ImageCollection _images;

		private IMarker _marker;

		public int FirstLineIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return _firstLineIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				_firstLineIndex = value;
			}
		}

		public FrameCollection Frames => _frames;

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.LineCollection Lines => GetLines();

		public float OffsetY
		{
			get
			{
				return _offsetY;
			}
			set
			{
				_offsetY = value;
			}
		}

		public override bool Empty
		{
			get
			{
				if (_marker == null)
				{
					_linesCount = _lines.Count;
				}
				if (_empty || (_linesCount == 0 && _frames.Count == 0))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			set
			{
				_empty = value;
			}
		}

		public TextComposition(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Text text)
		{
			_text = text;
			_lines = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.LineCollection();
			_frames = new FrameCollection();
		}

		public override void Draw(IGraphics graphics)
		{
			if (_width <= 0f || _height <= 0f)
			{
				return;
			}
			graphics.SaveState();
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point point = ClientToView(0f, 0f);
			float x = point.X;
			float y = point.Y;
			Area.ClipBounds(graphics, x, y, _width, _height, _borders);
			Area.DrawBackground(graphics, x, y, _width, _height, _background);
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Hyperlink hyperlink = null;
			Style style = null;
			float num = x + _scene.Left;
			float num2 = y + _scene.Top + _offsetY;
			foreach (Frame frame in _frames)
			{
				if (hyperlink != frame.Hyperlink)
				{
					hyperlink = frame.Hyperlink;
					if (graphics.HyperlinkStarted)
					{
						graphics.EndHyperlink();
					}
					if (hyperlink != null)
					{
						if (hyperlink.Reference[0] == '#')
						{
							string text = hyperlink.Reference.Substring(1);
							if (text.StartsWith("Page:"))
							{
								string[] array = Converter.Split(text.Substring(5));
								int num3 = 1;
								float x2 = 0f;
								float y2 = 0f;
								switch (array.Length)
								{
								case 1:
									num3 = Converter.ToInt(array[0]);
									break;
								case 2:
									num3 = Converter.ToInt(array[0]);
									y2 = Converter.ToPoints(array[1]);
									break;
								case 3:
									num3 = Converter.ToInt(array[0]);
									x2 = Converter.ToPoints(array[1]);
									y2 = Converter.ToPoints(array[2]);
									break;
								}
								graphics.StartHyperlink(num3 - 1, x2, y2);
							}
							else
							{
								List<ReportTarget> target = _text.Report.GetTarget(text);
								if (target != null)
								{
									for (int i = 0; i < target.Count; i++)
									{
										ReportTarget reportTarget = target[i];
										graphics.StartHyperlink(reportTarget.Destination.Page.AbsoluteIndex, reportTarget.Destination.X, reportTarget.Destination.Y);
									}
								}
							}
						}
						else
						{
							graphics.StartHyperlink(hyperlink.Reference);
						}
					}
				}
				if (((IFrame)frame).Type == FrameType.Char)
				{

		public void Attach(FileBuffer fb)
		{
			if (_marker != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IWriter writer = fb.GetWriter();
			_images = new ImageCollection();
			_linesCount = _lines.Count;
			writer.WriteInt(_linesCount);
			foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Line line in _lines)
			{
				SaveLine(_text.Report, line, _images, writer);
			}
			_lines = null;
			_marker = writer.Close();
		}

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.LineCollection GetLines()
		{
			if (_marker != null)
			{
				IReader reader = _marker.FileBuffer.GetReader(_marker);
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.LineCollection lineCollection = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.LineCollection();
				int num = reader.ReadInt();
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Line line = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Line();
					LoadLine(_text.Report, line, _images, reader);
					lineCollection.Add(line);
				}
				return lineCollection;
			}
			return _lines;
		}

		private static void LoadLine(Report report, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Line line, ImageCollection images, IReader reader)
		{
			line.Width = reader.ReadFloat();
			line.Height = reader.ReadFloat();
			line.Ascent = reader.ReadFloat();
			line.Indent = reader.ReadFloat();
			line.Wrapped = reader.ReadBoolean();
			line.ActiveWidth = reader.ReadFloat();
			line.ActiveCount = reader.ReadInt();
			line.LastTabIndex = reader.ReadInt();
			int num = reader.ReadInt();
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.UnitType unitType = (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.UnitType)reader.ReadInt();
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Unit unit = null;
				Style style = null;
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Hyperlink hyperlink = null;
				if (reader.ReadBoolean())
				{
					style = report.Styles[reader.ReadInt()];
				}
				if (reader.ReadBoolean())
				{
					hyperlink = report.Hyperlinks[reader.ReadInt()];
				}
				switch (unitType)
				{
				case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.UnitType.Word:
				{
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Word word = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Word(style, hyperlink);
					int num4 = reader.ReadInt();
					for (int l = 0; l < num4; l++)
					{
						word.Text.Add(reader.ReadChar());
					}
					unit = word;
					break;
				}
				case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.UnitType.MixedWord:
				{
					MixedWord mixedWord = new MixedWord(style, hyperlink);
					int num2 = reader.ReadInt();
					for (int j = 0; j < num2; j++)
					{
						style = null;
						hyperlink = null;
						if (reader.ReadBoolean())
						{
							style = report.Styles[reader.ReadInt()];
						}
						if (reader.ReadBoolean())
						{
							hyperlink = report.Hyperlinks[reader.ReadInt()];
						}
						MixedWord.Brick brick = new MixedWord.Brick(style, hyperlink);
						brick.Width = reader.ReadFloat();
						brick.Height = reader.ReadFloat();
						brick.Ascent = reader.ReadFloat();
						int num3 = reader.ReadInt();
						for (int k = 0; k < num3; k++)
						{
							char ch2 = reader.ReadChar();
							brick.Text.Add(ch2);
							mixedWord.Text.Add(ch2);
						}
						mixedWord.Bricks.Add(brick);
					}
					unit = mixedWord;
					break;
				}
				case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.UnitType.Separator:
					switch ((SeparatorType)reader.ReadInt())
					{
					case SeparatorType.Space:
						unit = new SpaceSeparator(style, hyperlink);
						break;
					case SeparatorType.Tab:
					{
						TabSeparator tabSeparator = new TabSeparator(style, hyperlink);
						tabSeparator.Leader = (LeaderFormat)reader.ReadInt();
						unit = tabSeparator;
						break;
					}
					case SeparatorType.EOL:
						unit = new EOLSeparator(style, hyperlink);
						break;
					}
					break;
				case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.UnitType.Leader:
				{
					char ch = reader.ReadChar();
					float cw = reader.ReadFloat();
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Leader leader = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Leader(style, hyperlink, ch, cw);
					leader.FixedWidth = reader.ReadFloat();
					unit = leader;
					break;
				}
				case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.UnitType.Image:
					unit = images[reader.ReadInt()];
					break;
				}
				unit.Width = reader.ReadFloat();
				unit.Height = reader.ReadFloat();
				unit.Ascent = reader.ReadFloat();
				unit.ExtraWidth = reader.ReadFloat();
				line.Units.Add(unit);
			}
		}

		private static void SaveLine(Report report, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Line line, ImageCollection images, IWriter writer)
		{
			writer.WriteFloat(line.Width);
			writer.WriteFloat(line.Height);
			writer.WriteFloat(line.Ascent);
			writer.WriteFloat(line.Indent);
			writer.WriteBoolean(line.Wrapped);
			writer.WriteFloat(line.ActiveWidth);
			writer.WriteInt(line.ActiveCount);
			writer.WriteInt(line.LastTabIndex);
			writer.WriteInt(line.Units.Count);
			foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Unit unit in line.Units)
			{
				writer.WriteInt((int)unit.Type);
				if (unit.Style != null)
				{
					writer.WriteBoolean(value: true);
					if (report.StyleIndexes.ContainsKey(unit.Style))
					{
						writer.WriteInt(report.StyleIndexes[unit.Style]);
					}
					else
					{
						int count = report.StyleIndexes.Count;
						report.StyleIndexes.Add(unit.Style, count);
						report.Styles.Add(unit.Style);
						writer.WriteInt(count);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					writer.WriteBoolean(value: false);
				}
				if (unit.Hyperlink != null)
				{
					writer.WriteBoolean(value: true);
					if (report.HyperlinkIndexes.ContainsKey(unit.Hyperlink))
					{
						writer.WriteInt(report.HyperlinkIndexes[unit.Hyperlink]);
					}
					else
					{
						int count2 = report.HyperlinkIndexes.Count;
						report.HyperlinkIndexes.Add(unit.Hyperlink, count2);
						report.Hyperlinks.Add(unit.Hyperlink);
						writer.WriteInt(count2);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					writer.WriteBoolean(value: false);
				}
				switch (unit.Type)
				{
				case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.UnitType.Word:
				{
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Word word = (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Word)unit;
					writer.WriteInt(word.Text.Count);
					foreach (char item2 in (IEnumerable<char>)word.Text)
					{
						writer.WriteChar(item2);
					}
					break;
				}
				case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.UnitType.MixedWord:
				{
					MixedWord mixedWord = (MixedWord)unit;
					writer.WriteInt(mixedWord.Bricks.Count);
					foreach (MixedWord.Brick brick in mixedWord.Bricks)
					{
						if (brick.Style != null)
						{
							writer.WriteBoolean(value: true);
							if (report.StyleIndexes.ContainsKey(brick.Style))
							{
								writer.WriteInt(report.StyleIndexes[brick.Style]);
							}
							else
							{
								int count3 = report.StyleIndexes.Count;
								report.StyleIndexes.Add(brick.Style, count3);
								report.Styles.Add(brick.Style);
								writer.WriteInt(count3);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							writer.WriteBoolean(value: false);
						}
						if (brick.Hyperlink != null)
						{
							writer.WriteBoolean(value: true);
							if (report.HyperlinkIndexes.ContainsKey(brick.Hyperlink))
							{
								writer.WriteInt(report.HyperlinkIndexes[brick.Hyperlink]);
							}
							else
							{
								int count4 = report.HyperlinkIndexes.Count;
								report.HyperlinkIndexes.Add(brick.Hyperlink, count4);
								report.Hyperlinks.Add(brick.Hyperlink);
								writer.WriteInt(count4);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							writer.WriteBoolean(value: false);
						}
						writer.WriteFloat(brick.Width);
						writer.WriteFloat(brick.Height);
						writer.WriteFloat(brick.Ascent);
						writer.WriteInt(brick.Text.Count);
						foreach (char item3 in (IEnumerable<char>)brick.Text)
						{
							writer.WriteChar(item3);
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.UnitType.Separator:
				{
					Separator separator = (Separator)unit;
					SeparatorType type = ((ISeparator)separator).Type;
					writer.WriteInt((int)type);
					if (type == SeparatorType.Tab)
					{
						TabSeparator tabSeparator = (TabSeparator)separator;
						writer.WriteInt((int)tabSeparator.Leader);
					}
					break;
				}
				case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.UnitType.Leader:
				{
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Leader leader = (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Leader)unit;
					writer.WriteChar(leader.Char);
					writer.WriteFloat(leader.CharWidth);
					writer.WriteFloat(leader.FixedWidth);
					break;
				}
				case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.UnitType.Image:
				{
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Image item = (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Image)unit;
					writer.WriteInt(images.Count);
					images.Add(item);
					break;
				}
				}
				writer.WriteFloat(unit.Width);
				writer.WriteFloat(unit.Height);
				writer.WriteFloat(unit.Ascent);
				writer.WriteFloat(unit.ExtraWidth);
			}
		}
	}
}

			float num3 = num;
			float num4 = num2;
			float num5 = num2;

				item.Draw(graphics);
				if (!(item is NodeComposition))

					continue;

				NodeComposition nodeComposition = (NodeComposition)item;
				num3 = x + nodeComposition.Left + nodeComposition.PointB.X;
				num4 = y + nodeComposition.Top + nodeComposition.PointB.Y;
				if (nodeComposition.DrawLineB)
				{
					if (_node.Lines.Pen != null)
					{
						graphics.Pen = _node.Lines.Pen;
						graphics.DrawLine(num - _node.Lines.Pen.Width / 2f, num4, num3, num4);
					}
					num5 = num4;
				}
			}
			if (_drawLineC)
			{
				num5 = y + _height;
				if (_paddings != null)
				{
					num5 -= _paddings.Bottom;
				}
			}
			if (_drawLineA && _node.Lines.Pen != null)
			{
				graphics.Pen = _node.Lines.Pen;
				graphics.DrawLine(num, num2, num, num5);
			}
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Projection.TOC
{
	internal class ItemArea : Area
	{
		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.TOC.Item _item;

		public ItemArea(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.TOC.Item item)
		{
			_item = item;
		}

		public override void Draw(IGraphics graphics)
		{
			if (_width <= 0f || _height <= 0f)
			{
				return;
			}
			Style style = _item.Level.Style;
			graphics.Font = style.Font;
			graphics.Brush = style.Brush;
			graphics.CharSpacing = style.CharSpacing;
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point point = ClientToView(0f, 0f);
			float num = point.X + _scene.Left;
			float y = point.Y + _scene.Top;
			CharBuffer charBuffer = new CharBuffer();
			float num2 = 0f;
			float stringWidth = graphics.GetStringWidth(".");
			float num3 = stringWidth * 3f;
			float num4 = _scene.Width - num3;
			if (_item.Text.Caption != null)
			{
				string caption = _item.Text.Caption;
				foreach (char ch in caption)
				{
					float charWidth = graphics.GetCharWidth(ch);
					num2 += charWidth;
					if (num2 > num4)
					{
						charBuffer.Add("...");
						num2 += num3 - charWidth;
						break;
					}
					charBuffer.Add(ch);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (Atom atom in _item.Text.Atoms)
				{
					char c = ' ';
					if (atom.Type == AtomType.Char)
					{
						c = ((Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Atoms.Char)atom).Value;
					}
					if (c == '\n' || c == '\t')
					{
						c = ' ';
					}
					float charWidth2 = graphics.GetCharWidth(c);
					num2 += charWidth2;
					if (num2 > num4)
					{
						charBuffer.Add("...");
						num2 += num3 - charWidth2;
						break;
					}
					charBuffer.Add(c);
				}
			}
			Destination destination = _item.Text.GetDestination();
			graphics.StartHyperlink(destination.Page.AbsoluteIndex, destination.X, destination.Y);
			graphics.DrawString(num, y, charBuffer.ToString());
			graphics.EndHyperlink();
			charBuffer = new CharBuffer();
			char ch2 = ' ';
			switch (_item.Level.Leader)
			{
			case LeaderFormat.Dots:
				ch2 = '.';
				break;
			case LeaderFormat.Dashes:
				ch2 = '-';
				break;
			case LeaderFormat.Lines:
				ch2 = '_';
				break;
			}
			stringWidth = graphics.GetStringWidth(ch2.ToString());
			num2 += stringWidth;
			for (num4 += num3; num2 < num4; num2 += stringWidth)
			{
				charBuffer.Add(ch2);
			}
			graphics.DrawString(charBuffer.ToString());
			num += _scene.Width;
			graphics.StartHyperlink(destination.Page.AbsoluteIndex, destination.X, destination.Y);
			graphics.DrawString(num, y, destination.Page.FormattedNumber());
			graphics.EndHyperlink();
		}
	}
}

namespace Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Projection.List
{
	internal class ItemComposition : Composition
	{
		private ListItem _item;

		private bool _showBullet;

		public bool ShowBullet
		{
			get
			{
				return _showBullet;
			}
			set
			{
				_showBullet = value;
			}
		}

		public ItemComposition(ListItem item)
		{
			_item = item;
		}

		public override void Draw(IGraphics graphics)
		{
			if (_width <= 0f || _height <= 0f)
			{
				return;
			}
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point point = ClientToView(0f, 0f);
			float x = point.X;
			float y = point.Y;
			bool flag = true;
			foreach (Area item in _content)
			{
				if (flag && _showBullet)
				{
					float x2 = x;
					float y2 = y + item.Top;
					int number = _item.Index + _item.List.StartNumber;
					DrawBullet(graphics, _item.List.Bullets, x2, y2, number);
					flag = false;
				}
				item.Draw(graphics);
			}
		}

		public override void ResetScene()
		{
			base.ResetScene();
			_scene.Left += _item.List.Bullets.Indent;
			_scene.Width -= _item.List.Bullets.Indent;
		}

		private static void DrawBullet(IGraphics graphics, Bullets bullets, float x, float y, int number)
		{
			graphics.Font = bullets.Style.Font;
			graphics.Brush = bullets.Style.Brush;
			x += bullets.OffsetX;
			y += bullets.OffsetY;
			int num = 0;
			switch (bullets.Type)
			{
			case BulletType.BlackCircle:
				num = 9679;
				break;
			case BulletType.WhiteCircle:
				num = 9675;
				break;
			case BulletType.BlackSquare:
				num = 9632;
				break;
			case BulletType.WhiteSquare:
				num = 9633;
				break;
			case BulletType.Asterisk:
				num = 42;
				break;
			case BulletType.Custom:
				num = bullets.Glyph;
				break;
			}
			if (num > 0)
			{
				graphics.DrawString(x, y, ((char)num).ToString());
				return;
			}
			string text = "";
			switch (bullets.Type)
			{
			case BulletType.Decimal:
				text = string.Format(bullets.Template, number.ToString());
				break;
			case BulletType.SmallLetters:
				text = string.Format(bullets.Template, Converter.ToLetterNumber(number));
				break;
			case BulletType.BigLetters:
				text = string.Format(bullets.Template, Converter.ToLetterNumber(number).ToUpper());
				break;
			case BulletType.SmallRoman:
				text = string.Format(bullets.Template, Converter.ToRomanNumber(number));
				break;
			case BulletType.BigRoman:
				text = string.Format(bullets.Template, Converter.ToRomanNumber(number).ToUpper());
				break;
			}
			graphics.DrawString(x, y, text);
		}
	}
}

		{
			_path = path;
		}

		public override void Draw(IGraphics graphics)
		{
			if (_width <= 0f || _height <= 0f)
			{
				return;
			}
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point point = ClientToView(0f, 0f);
			float num = point.X + _scene.Left;
			float num2 = point.Y + _scene.Top;
			graphics.Pen = _path.Pen;
			graphics.Brush = _path.Brush;
			graphics.StartShape(PaintMode.FillStroke);
			foreach (IPathCommand command in _path.Data.Commands)
			{
				switch (command.Type)
				{
				case CommandType.MoveTo:
				{
					MoveToCommand moveToCommand = (MoveToCommand)command;
					graphics.MoveTo(num + moveToCommand.X, num2 + moveToCommand.Y);
					break;
				}
				case CommandType.LineTo:
				{
					LineToCommand lineToCommand = (LineToCommand)command;
					graphics.LineTo(num + lineToCommand.X, num2 + lineToCommand.Y);
					break;
				}
				case CommandType.CurveTo:
				{
					CurveToCommand curveToCommand = (CurveToCommand)command;
					graphics.CurveTo(num + curveToCommand.X1, num2 + curveToCommand.Y1, num + curveToCommand.X2, num2 + curveToCommand.Y2, num + curveToCommand.X3, num2 + curveToCommand.Y3);
					break;
				}
				case CommandType.ClosePath:
					graphics.ClosePath();
					break;
				}
			}
			graphics.EndShape();
		}
	}

				if (_pie.Angle == 0f)

					graphics.DrawPie(num + _pie.X, num2 + _pie.Y, _pie.Width, _pie.Height, _pie.StartAngle, _pie.EndAngle, PaintMode.FillStroke);
					return;
				}
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point center = _pie.GetCenter();
				graphics.SaveState();
				graphics.Rotate(num + center.X, num2 + center.Y, _pie.Angle);
				graphics.DrawPie(num + _pie.X, num2 + _pie.Y, _pie.Width, _pie.Height, _pie.StartAngle, _pie.EndAngle, PaintMode.FillStroke);
				graphics.RestoreState();
			}
		}
	}
