namespace Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Projection.Canvas
{
	internal class CanvasArea : Area
	{
		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Canvas _canvas;

		public CanvasArea(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Canvas canvas)
		{
			_canvas = canvas;
		}

		public override void Draw(IGraphics graphics)
		{
			if (!(_width <= 0f) && !(_height <= 0f))
			{
				graphics.SaveState();
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point point = ClientToView(0f, 0f);
				float x = point.X;
				float y = point.Y;
				Area.ClipBounds(graphics, x, y, _width, _height, _borders);
				Area.DrawBackground(graphics, x, y, _width, _height, _background);
				float offsetX = x + _scene.Left;
				float offsetY = y + _scene.Top;
				graphics.SaveState();
				graphics.Translate(offsetX, offsetY);
				Playback(graphics, _canvas.Stream, _canvas.Report);
				graphics.RestoreState();
				Area.DrawBorders(graphics, x, y, _width, _height, _borders);
				graphics.RestoreState();
			}
		}

		private static void Playback(IGraphics graphics, System.IO.Stream stream, Report report)
		{
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Canvas.Reader reader = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Canvas.Reader(stream);
			reader.Stream.Position = 0L;
			while (true)
			{
				switch (reader.ReadByte())
				{
				case 1:
					graphics.Font = report.Fonts[reader.ReadInt()];
					break;
				case 2:
					graphics.Font = null;
					break;
				case 3:
					graphics.Brush = report.Brushes[reader.ReadInt()];
					break;
				case 4:
					graphics.Brush = null;
					break;
				case 5:
					graphics.Pen = report.Pens[reader.ReadInt()];
					break;
				case 6:
					graphics.Pen = null;
					break;
				case 7:
				{
					float x23 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float y23 = reader.ReadFloat();
					graphics.TextPosition = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point(x23, y23);
					break;
				}
				case 8:
					graphics.CharSpacing = reader.ReadFloat();
					break;
				case 9:
					graphics.AlternateFill = reader.ReadBoolean();
					break;
				case 10:
				{
					float x24 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float y24 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float width10 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float height9 = reader.ReadFloat();
					graphics.SaveClip(x24, y24, width10, height9);
					break;
				}
				case 11:
					graphics.RestoreClip();
					break;
				case 12:
					graphics.SaveState();
					break;
				case 13:
					graphics.RestoreState();
					break;
				case 14:
				{
					float m = reader.ReadFloat();
					float m2 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float m3 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float m4 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float offsetX = reader.ReadFloat();
					float offsetY = reader.ReadFloat();
					graphics.Transform(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix(m, m2, m3, m4, offsetX, offsetY));
					break;
				}
				case 15:
				{
					string text2 = reader.ReadString();
					if (text2[0] == '#')
					{
						text2 = text2.Substring(1);
						if (text2.StartsWith("Page:"))
						{
							string[] array = Converter.Split(text2.Substring(5));
							int num = 1;
							float x22 = 0f;
							float y22 = 0f;
							switch (array.Length)
							{
							case 1:
								num = Converter.ToInt(array[0]);
								break;
							case 2:
								num = Converter.ToInt(array[0]);
								y22 = Converter.ToPoints(array[1]);
								break;
							case 3:
								num = Converter.ToInt(array[0]);
								x22 = Converter.ToPoints(array[1]);
								y22 = Converter.ToPoints(array[2]);
								break;
							}
							graphics.StartHyperlink(num - 1, x22, y22);
							break;
						}
						List<ReportTarget> target = report.GetTarget(text2);
						if (target != null)
						{
							for (int i = 0; i < target.Count; i++)
							{
								ReportTarget reportTarget = target[i];
								graphics.StartHyperlink(reportTarget.Destination.Page.AbsoluteIndex, reportTarget.Destination.X, reportTarget.Destination.Y);
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						graphics.StartHyperlink(text2);
					}
					break;
				}
				case 16:
				{
					int pageIndex = reader.ReadInt();
					float x21 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float y21 = reader.ReadFloat();
					graphics.StartHyperlink(pageIndex, x21, y21);
					break;
				}
				case 17:
					graphics.PauseHyperlink();
					break;
				case 18:
					graphics.ResumeHyperlink();
					break;
				case 19:
					graphics.EndHyperlink();
					break;
				case 20:
				{
					float x20 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float y20 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float width9 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float height8 = reader.ReadFloat();
					graphics.AddHyperlinkArea(x20, y20, width9, height8);
					break;
				}
				case 21:
				{
					float x19 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float y19 = reader.ReadFloat();
					string text = reader.ReadString();
					graphics.DrawString(x19, y19, text);
					break;
				}
				case 22:
				{
					float width8 = reader.ReadFloat();
					graphics.DrawSpacing(width8);
					break;
				}
				case 23:
				{
					float x18 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float y18 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float width7 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float height7 = reader.ReadFloat();
					PaintMode mode9 = (PaintMode)reader.ReadByte();
					graphics.DrawRectangle(x18, y18, width7, height7, mode9);
					break;
				}
				case 24:
				{
					float x17 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float y17 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float width6 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float height6 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float ew = reader.ReadFloat();
					float eh = reader.ReadFloat();
					PaintMode mode8 = (PaintMode)reader.ReadByte();
					graphics.DrawRoundedRect(x17, y17, width6, height6, ew, eh, mode8);
					break;
				}
				case 25:
				{
					float x15 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float y15 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float x16 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float y16 = reader.ReadFloat();
					graphics.DrawLine(x15, y15, x16, y16);
					break;
				}
				case 26:
					graphics.DrawLines(reader.ReadPoints());
					break;
				case 27:
				{
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point[] points4 = reader.ReadPoints();
					PaintMode mode7 = (PaintMode)reader.ReadByte();
					graphics.DrawPolygon(points4, mode7);
					break;
				}
				case 28:
				{
					float x14 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float y14 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float width5 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float height5 = reader.ReadFloat();
					PaintMode mode6 = (PaintMode)reader.ReadByte();
					graphics.DrawEllipse(x14, y14, width5, height5, mode6);
					break;
				}
				case 29:
				{
					float x13 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float y13 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float width4 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float height4 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float startAngle3 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float endAngle3 = reader.ReadFloat();
					PaintMode mode5 = (PaintMode)reader.ReadByte();
					graphics.DrawArc(x13, y13, width4, height4, startAngle3, endAngle3, mode5);
					break;
				}
				case 30:
				{
					float x12 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float y12 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float width3 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float height3 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float startAngle2 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float endAngle2 = reader.ReadFloat();
					PaintMode mode4 = (PaintMode)reader.ReadByte();
					graphics.DrawPie(x12, y12, width3, height3, startAngle2, endAngle2, mode4);
					break;
				}
				case 31:
				{
					float x11 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float y11 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float width2 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float height2 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float startAngle = reader.ReadFloat();
					float endAngle = reader.ReadFloat();
					PaintMode mode3 = (PaintMode)reader.ReadByte();
					graphics.DrawChord(x11, y11, width2, height2, startAngle, endAngle, mode3);
					break;
				}
				case 32:
				{
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point[] points3 = reader.ReadPoints();
					float tension2 = reader.ReadFloat();
					graphics.DrawCurve(points3, tension2);
					break;
				}
				case 33:
				{
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point[] points2 = reader.ReadPoints();
					float tension = reader.ReadFloat();
					PaintMode mode2 = (PaintMode)reader.ReadByte();
					graphics.DrawClosedCurve(points2, tension, mode2);
					break;
				}
				case 34:
				{
					float x7 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float y7 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float x8 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float y8 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float x9 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float y9 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float x10 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float y10 = reader.ReadFloat();
					graphics.DrawBezier(x7, y7, x8, y8, x9, y9, x10, y10);
					break;
				}
				case 35:
				{
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point[] points = reader.ReadPoints();
					PaintMode mode = (PaintMode)reader.ReadByte();
					graphics.DrawBeziers(points, mode);
					break;
				}
				case 36:
					graphics.StartShape((PaintMode)reader.ReadByte());
					break;
				case 37:
				{
					float x6 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float y6 = reader.ReadFloat();
					graphics.MoveTo(x6, y6);
					break;
				}
				case 38:
				{
					float x5 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float y5 = reader.ReadFloat();
					graphics.LineTo(x5, y5);
					break;
				}
				case 39:
				{
					float x2 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float y2 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float x3 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float y3 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float x4 = reader.ReadFloat();
					float y4 = reader.ReadFloat();
					graphics.CurveTo(x2, y2, x3, y3, x4, y4);
					break;
				}
				case 40:
					graphics.ClosePath();
					break;
				case 41:
					graphics.EndShape();
					break;
				case 42:
				{
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image = report.Images[reader.ReadInt()];
					float x = reader.ReadFloat();
					float y = reader.ReadFloat();
					float width = reader.ReadFloat();
					float height = reader.ReadFloat();
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color transparentColor = null;
					if (reader.ReadBoolean())
					{
						transparentColor = reader.ReadColor();
					}
					float alpha = reader.ReadFloat();
					graphics.DrawImage(image, x, y, width, height, transparentColor, alpha);
					break;
				}
				case -1:
					return;
				}
			}
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Projection.QuickText
{
	internal class QuickTextComposition : Composition
	{
		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font _font;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush _brush;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.LineCollection _lines;

		private float _offsetX;

		private float _offsetY;

		private int _number;

		private bool _showBullet;

		private int _linesCount;

		private IMarker _marker;

		private bool _first;

		private bool _last;

		private float _interval;

		private float _lineHeight;

		public bool First
		{
			get
			{
				return _first;
			}
			set
			{
				_first = value;
			}
		}

		public float Interval
		{
			get
			{
				return _interval;
			}
			set
			{
				_interval = value;
			}
		}

		public bool Last
		{
			get
			{
				return _last;
			}
			set
			{
				_last = value;
			}
		}

		public float LineHeight
		{
			get
			{
				return _lineHeight;
			}
			set
			{
				_lineHeight = value;
			}
		}

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.LineCollection Lines => GetLines();

		public int Number
		{
			get
			{
				return _number;
			}
			set
			{
				_number = value;
			}
		}

		public float OffsetX
		{
			get
			{
				return _offsetX;
			}
			set
			{
				_offsetX = value;
			}
		}

		public float OffsetY
		{
			get
			{
				return _offsetY;
			}
			set
			{
				_offsetY = value;
			}
		}

		public bool ShowBullet
		{
			get
			{
				return _showBullet;
			}
			set
			{
				_showBullet = value;
			}
		}

		public override bool Empty
		{
			get
			{
				if (_marker == null)
				{
					_linesCount = _lines.Count;
				}
				if (_empty || _linesCount == 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			set
			{
				_empty = value;
			}
		}

		public QuickTextComposition(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font font, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush brush)
		{
			_number = -1;
			_font = font;
			_brush = brush;
			_lines = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.LineCollection();
		}

		public override void Draw(IGraphics graphics)
		{
			if (_width <= 0f || _height <= 0f)
			{
				return;
			}
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point point = ClientToView(0f, 0f);
			float x = point.X;
			float y = point.Y;
			if (!_fake)
			{
				graphics.SaveState();
				Area.ClipBounds(graphics, x, y, _width, _height, _borders);
				Area.DrawBackground(graphics, x, y, _width, _height, _background);
			}
			float num = x + _scene.Left;
			float num2 = y + _scene.Top + _offsetY;
			float num3 = num;
			float num4 = num2;
			graphics.Font = _font;
			graphics.Brush = _brush;
			graphics.CharSpacing = 0f;
			if (_showBullet)
			{
				float x2 = x + _lineHeight / 2f;
				float y2 = y + _scene.Top + _offsetY;
				if (_number < 0)
				{
					graphics.DrawString(x2, y2, '●'.ToString());
				}
				else
				{
					graphics.DrawString(x2, y2, $"{_number.ToString()}.");
				}
			}
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.LineCollection lines = GetLines();
			int num5 = 0;
			int num6 = lines.Count - 1;
			foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.Line item in lines)
			{
				num3 += item.Indent;
				int num7 = 0;
				foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.Unit unit in item.Units)
				{
					switch (unit.Type)
					{
					case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.UnitType.Word:
					{
						Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.Word word = (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.Word)unit;
						graphics.DrawString(num3, num4, word.Text.ToString());
						if (word.ExtraWidth > 0f)
						{
							graphics.TextPosition = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point(num3 + word.Width, num4);
							graphics.DrawSpacing(word.ExtraWidth);
						}
						break;
					}
					case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.UnitType.Space:
						if (num7 < item.ActiveCount)
						{
							graphics.TextPosition = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point(num3, num4);
							graphics.DrawSpacing(unit.Width + unit.ExtraWidth);
						}
						break;
					}
					num3 += unit.Width + unit.ExtraWidth;
					num7++;
				}
				num3 = num;
				num4 += _lineHeight;
				if (num5 < num6)
				{
					num4 += _interval;
				}
				num5++;
			}
			if (!_fake)
			{
				Area.DrawBorders(graphics, x, y, _width, _height, _borders);
				graphics.RestoreState();
			}
		}

		public override void ResetScene()
		{
			base.ResetScene();
			_scene.Left += _offsetX;
			_scene.Width -= _offsetX;
		}

		public void Attach(FileBuffer fb)
		{
			if (_marker != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IWriter writer = fb.GetWriter();
			_linesCount = _lines.Count;
			writer.WriteInt(_linesCount);
			foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.Line line in _lines)
			{
				SaveLine(line, writer);
			}
			_lines = null;
			_marker = writer.Close();
		}

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.LineCollection GetLines()
		{
			if (_marker != null)
			{
				IReader reader = _marker.FileBuffer.GetReader(_marker);
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.LineCollection lineCollection = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.LineCollection();
				int num = reader.ReadInt();
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.Line line = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.Line();
					LoadLine(line, reader);
					lineCollection.Add(line);
				}
				return lineCollection;
			}
			return _lines;
		}

		private static void LoadLine(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.Line line, IReader reader)
		{
			line.Indent = reader.ReadFloat();
			line.Wrapped = reader.ReadBoolean();
			line.ActiveWidth = reader.ReadFloat();
			line.ActiveCount = reader.ReadInt();
			int num = reader.ReadInt();
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.UnitType unitType = (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.UnitType)reader.ReadInt();
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.Unit unit = null;
				switch (unitType)
				{
				case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.UnitType.Word:
				{
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.Word word = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.Word();
					int num2 = reader.ReadInt();
					for (int j = 0; j < num2; j++)
					{
						word.Text.Add(reader.ReadChar());
					}
					unit = word;
					break;
				}
				case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.UnitType.Space:
					unit = new Space();
					break;
				case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.UnitType.EOL:
					unit = new EOL();
					break;
				}
				unit.Width = reader.ReadFloat();
				unit.ExtraWidth = reader.ReadFloat();
				line.Units.Add(unit);
			}
		}

		private static void SaveLine(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.Line line, IWriter writer)
		{
			writer.WriteFloat(line.Indent);
			writer.WriteBoolean(line.Wrapped);
			writer.WriteFloat(line.ActiveWidth);
			writer.WriteInt(line.ActiveCount);
			writer.WriteInt(line.Units.Count);
			foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.Unit unit in line.Units)
			{
				writer.WriteInt((int)unit.Type);
				if (unit.Type == Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.UnitType.Word)
				{
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.Word word = (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.Word)unit;
					writer.WriteInt(word.Text.Count);
					foreach (char item in (IEnumerable<char>)word.Text)
					{
						writer.WriteChar(item);
					}
				}
				writer.WriteFloat(unit.Width);
				writer.WriteFloat(unit.ExtraWidth);
			}
		}
	}
}

			}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			Composition composition2 = null;
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
				{
					float num = base.MarginsResolved.Top + base.MarginsResolved.Bottom;
					if (composition.Scene.Height < num)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Create:
					composition2 = new Composition();
					composition2.Parent = composition;
					composition2.Left = composition.Scene.Left + base.MarginsResolved.Left;
					composition2.Top = composition.Scene.Top + base.MarginsResolved.Top;
					composition2.Width = _activeWidth - base.MarginsResolved.Left - base.MarginsResolved.Right;
					composition2.Height = composition.Scene.Height - base.MarginsResolved.Top - base.MarginsResolved.Bottom;
					composition2.Borders = base.BordersResolved;
					composition2.Margins = base.MarginsResolved;
					composition2.Paddings = _paddings;
					composition2.Background = _background;
					composition2.ResetScene();
					if (mode == MeasureMode.Normal)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					}
					else
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Flush;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
				{
					bool flag = false;
					int num2 = _marker;
					int count2 = _content.Count;
					bool flag2 = _freshBreak;
					while (!flag && num2 < count2)
					{
						Element element2 = _content[num2];
						MeasureResult measureResult = element2.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.Normal);
						if (measureResult != MeasureResult.Ok)
						{
							if (flag2 && measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
							{
								element2.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.Flush);
								num2++;
								if (num2 < count2)
								{
									flag = true;
								}
								continue;
							}
							if (_marker == num2 && measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
							{
								_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
								return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
							}
							if (measureResult == MeasureResult.PageBreak)
							{
								num2++;
							}
							flag = true;
						}
						else
						{
							num2++;
							flag2 = false;
						}
					}
					composition.Content.Add(composition2);
					if (composition2.ResidualHeight > 0f)
					{
						composition2.Height -= composition2.ResidualHeight;
					}
					if (composition2.Content.Count == 0)
					{
						composition2.Empty = true;
					}
					_marker = num2;
					if (flag)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.ContentBreak;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Flush:
				{
					int i = _marker;
					for (int count = _content.Count; i < count; i++)
					{
						Element element = _content[i];
						element.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
					}
					composition.Content.Add(composition2);
					if (composition2.ResidualHeight > 0f)
					{
						composition2.Height -= composition2.ResidualHeight;
					}
					if (composition2.Content.Count == 0)
					{
						composition2.Empty = true;
					}
					_marker = i;
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Process(visitor);
			}
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Reset();
			}
			_marker = 0;
			base.Reset();
		}
	}
	internal abstract class QuickTableCell : Element
	{
		protected ContentAlignment _alignment;

		protected Borders _borders;

		private Margins _margins;

		protected Paddings _paddings;

		protected Background _background;

		protected int _colSpan;

		protected float _activeWidth;

		private static Margins DefaultMargins = new Margins();

		private static ContentAlignment DefaultAlignment = new ContentAlignment();

		private static Borders DefaultBorders = new Borders();

		public float ActiveWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return _activeWidth;
			}
			set
			{
				_activeWidth = value;
			}
		}

		public ContentAlignment Alignment
		{
			get
			{
				if (_alignment == null)
				{
					_alignment = new ContentAlignment();
				}
				return _alignment;
			}
			set
			{
				_alignment = value;
			}
		}

		internal ContentAlignment AlignmentResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (_alignment == null)
				{
					return DefaultAlignment;
				}
				return _alignment;
			}
		}

		public Background Background
		{
			get
			{
				if (_background == null)
				{
					_background = new Background();
				}
				return _background;
			}
			set
			{
				_background = value;
			}
		}

		public Borders Borders
		{
			get
			{
				if (_borders == null)
				{
					_borders = new Borders();
				}
				return _borders;
			}
			set
			{
				_borders = value;
			}
		}

		internal Borders BordersResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (_borders == null)
				{
					return DefaultBorders;
				}
				return _borders;
			}
		}

		public int ColSpan
		{
			get
			{
				return _colSpan;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 1)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(null, "[1, ...]");
				}
				_colSpan = value;
			}
		}

		public Paddings Paddings
		{
			get
			{
				if (_paddings == null)
				{
					_paddings = new Paddings();
				}
				return _paddings;
			}
			set
			{
				_paddings = value;
			}
		}

		public Margins Margins
		{
			get
			{
				if (_margins == null)
				{
					_margins = new Margins();
				}
				return _margins;
			}
			set
			{
				_margins = value;
			}
		}

		internal Margins MarginsResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (_margins == null)
				{
					return DefaultMargins;
				}
				return _margins;
			}
		}

		public QuickTableCell(Report report)
			: base(report)
		{
			_colSpan = 1;
		}

		public virtual void Align(Area area)
		{
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			_activeWidth = 0f;
			base.Reset();
		}
	}
	internal class ImageCell : QuickTableCell, IImageCell
	{
		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image _image;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color _transparentColor;

		private float _alpha;

		private IQuickTableRow parent;

		public float Alpha
		{
			get
			{
				return _alpha;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0f || value > 1f)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(null, "[0.0, 1.0]");
				}
				_alpha = value;
			}
		}

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image Image => _image;

		public IQuickTableRow Parent => parent;

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color TransparentColor
		{
			get
			{
				return _transparentColor;
			}
			set
			{
				_transparentColor = value;
			}
		}

		public override ElementType Type => ElementType.QuickTableImageCell;

		public ImageCell(Report report, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image)
			: base(report)
		{
			_image = image;
			_alpha = 1f;
		}

		public void InitializeParent(IQuickTableRow parent)
		{
			if (parent == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("parent");
			}
			this.parent = parent;
		}

		public void SetTransparentColor(string value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("value");
			}
			if (value == "Auto")
			{
				_transparentColor = _image.GetPixel(0, 0);
			}
			else
			{
				_transparentColor = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color.Parse(value);
			}
		}

		public override void Align(Area area)
		{
			if (area is ImageArea && _image.Width > 0 && _image.Height > 0)
			{
				switch (base.AlignmentResolved.Vertical)
				{
				case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Middle:
					((ImageArea)area).OffsetY = (area.Scene.Height - (float)_image.Height / (float)_image.Width * area.Scene.Width) / 2f;
					break;
				case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Bottom:
					((ImageArea)area).OffsetY = area.Scene.Height - (float)_image.Height / (float)_image.Width * area.Scene.Width;
					break;
				case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Top:
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			ImageArea imageArea = null;
			float num = _activeWidth - base.MarginsResolved.Left - base.MarginsResolved.Right;
			if (num < 0f)
			{
				num = 0f;
			}
			float num2 = 0f;
			if (_image.Width != 0)
			{
				float num3 = num;
				if (_paddings != null)
				{
					num3 -= _paddings.Left + _paddings.Right;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasLeft && base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen != null)
				{
					num3 -= base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasRight && base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen != null)
				{
					num3 -= base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				num2 = (float)_image.Height / (float)_image.Width * num3;
				if (_paddings != null)
				{
					num2 += _paddings.Top + _paddings.Bottom;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasTop && base.BordersResolved.Top.Pen != null)
				{
					num2 += base.BordersResolved.Top.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasBottom && base.BordersResolved.Bottom.Pen != null)
				{
					num2 += base.BordersResolved.Bottom.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num2 = Converter.PixelsToPoints(_image.Height);
			}
			if (num2 < 0f)
			{
				num2 = 0f;
			}
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
				{
					float num4 = num2 + base.MarginsResolved.Top + base.MarginsResolved.Bottom;
					if (composition.Scene.Height < num4)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Create:
					imageArea = new ImageArea(_image, _transparentColor, _alpha, keepRatio: true);
					imageArea.Parent = composition;
					imageArea.Left = composition.Scene.Left + base.MarginsResolved.Left;
					imageArea.Top = composition.Scene.Top + base.MarginsResolved.Top;
					imageArea.Width = num;
					imageArea.Height = num2;
					imageArea.Borders = _borders;
					imageArea.Margins = base.MarginsResolved;
					imageArea.Paddings = _paddings;
					imageArea.Background = _background;
					imageArea.ResetScene();
					_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
					composition.Content.Add(imageArea);
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}
	}
	public interface IImageCell
	{
		ContentAlignment Alignment { get; set; }

		Borders Borders { get; set; }

		Margins Margins { get; set; }

		Paddings Paddings { get; set; }

		Background Background { get; set; }

		int ColSpan { get; set; }

	internal class TextCell : QuickTableCell, ITextCell
	{
		private string _content;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font _font;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush _brush;

		private float _indent;

		private float _interval;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.UnitCollection _units;

		private int _marker;

		private IQuickTableRow parent;

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush Brush
		{
			get
			{
				return _brush;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_brush = value;
			}
		}

		public string Content => _content;

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font Font
		{
			get
			{
				return _font;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_font = value;

				return _indent;

				return _interval;

		public IQuickTableRow Parent => parent;

		public override ElementType Type => ElementType.QuickTableTextCell;

		public TextCell(Report report, string content)
			: base(report)

			_font = Fonts.Arial;
			_brush = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brushes.Black;
			_content = content;
		}

		public void InitializeParent(IQuickTableRow parent)
		{
			if (parent == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("parent");
			}
			this.parent = parent;
		}

		public override void Align(Area area)
		{
			if (area is QuickTextComposition)
			{
				QuickTextComposition quickTextComposition = (QuickTextComposition)area;
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.QuickText.Align(quickTextComposition, _indent, _interval, base.AlignmentResolved.Horizontal, base.AlignmentResolved.Vertical, quickTextComposition.First, quickTextComposition.Last);
				if (_report.FileBuffer != null)
				{
					quickTextComposition.Attach(_report.FileBuffer);
				}
			}
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			QuickTextComposition quickTextComposition = null;
			graphics.Font = _font;
			graphics.CharSpacing = 0f;
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					if (_units == null)
					{
						_units = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.QuickText.ComposeUnits(_content, graphics);
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
				{
					float num = base.MarginsResolved.Top + base.MarginsResolved.Bottom;
					if (composition.Scene.Height < num)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Create:
					quickTextComposition = new QuickTextComposition(_font, _brush);
					quickTextComposition.Parent = composition;
					quickTextComposition.Left = composition.Scene.Left + base.MarginsResolved.Left;
					quickTextComposition.Top = composition.Scene.Top + base.MarginsResolved.Top;
					quickTextComposition.Width = _activeWidth - base.MarginsResolved.Left - base.MarginsResolved.Right;
					quickTextComposition.Height = composition.Scene.Height - base.MarginsResolved.Top - base.MarginsResolved.Bottom;
					quickTextComposition.Borders = _borders;
					quickTextComposition.Margins = base.MarginsResolved;
					quickTextComposition.Paddings = _paddings;
					quickTextComposition.Background = _background;
					quickTextComposition.ResetScene();
					if (mode == MeasureMode.Normal)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					}
					else
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Flush;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
				{
					bool flag = false;
					int marker2 = _marker;
					MeasureResult measureResult = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.QuickText.ComposeBody(quickTextComposition, graphics, _units, _indent, _interval, ref marker2, flush: false);
					if (measureResult != MeasureResult.Ok)
					{
						if (_freshBreak && measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
						{
							quickTextComposition.Lines.Clear();
							Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.QuickText.ComposeBody(quickTextComposition, graphics, _units, _indent, _interval, ref marker2, flush: true);
						}
						else
						{
							if (measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
							{
								_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
								return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
							}
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					composition.Content.Add(quickTextComposition);
					if (quickTextComposition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
					{
						quickTextComposition.Height -= quickTextComposition.ResidualHeight;
					}
					quickTextComposition.ResetScene();
					quickTextComposition.First = _marker == 0;
					quickTextComposition.Last = marker2 == _units.Count;
					_marker = marker2;
					if (flag)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.ContentBreak;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Flush:
				{
					int marker = _marker;
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.QuickText.ComposeBody(quickTextComposition, graphics, _units, _indent, _interval, ref marker, flush: true);
					composition.Content.Add(quickTextComposition);
					if (quickTextComposition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
					{
						quickTextComposition.Height -= quickTextComposition.ResidualHeight;
					}
					quickTextComposition.ResetScene();
					quickTextComposition.First = _marker == 0;
					quickTextComposition.Last = marker == _units.Count;
					_marker = marker;
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.End:
					_units = null;
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			_units = null;
			_marker = 0;
			base.Reset();
		}
	}

	internal class QuickTable : DecoratedBlock, IQuickTable
	{
		private QuickTableHeader _header;

		private QuickTableFooter _footer;

		private QuickTableDivider _divider;

		private List<float> _columns;

		private QuickTableRowCollection _rows;

		private bool _keepSolid;

		private bool _stretch;

		private int _bodyCounter;

		private int _marker;

		private object parent;

		public List<float> Columns => _columns;

		public IQuickTableDivider Divider => _divider;

		public IQuickTableFooter Footer => _footer;

		public IQuickTableHeader Header => _header;

		public bool KeepSolid
		{
			get
			{
				return _keepSolid;
			}
			set
			{
				_keepSolid = value;
			}
		}

		public object Parent => parent;

		public bool Stretch
		{
			get

				return _stretch;
			}
			set

				_stretch = value;
			}
		}

		public override ElementType Type => ElementType.QuickTable;

		public QuickTable(Report report)
			: base(report)
		{
			_header = new QuickTableHeader(_report, this);
			_footer = new QuickTableFooter(_report, this);
			_divider = new QuickTableDivider(_report, this);
			_columns = new List<float>();
			_rows = new QuickTableRowCollection();
		}

		public void AddColumn(float width)
		{
			_columns.Add(width);
		}

			_rows.Add(quickTableRow);
			return quickTableRow;

		public void InitializeParent(object parent)
		{
			if (parent == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("parent");
			}
			this.parent = parent;
		}

		public override Bounds GetBounds(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics)
		{
			float num = ((_margins != null) ? (_margins.Left + _margins.Right) : 0f);
			if (_paddings != null)
			{
				num += _paddings.Left + _paddings.Right;
			}
			foreach (float column in _columns)
			{
				num += column;
			}
			if (base.BordersResolved.HasLeft && base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen != null)
			{
				num += base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen.Width / 2f;
			}
			if (base.BordersResolved.HasRight && base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen != null)
			{
				num += base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen.Width / 2f;
			}
			return new Bounds(num, num);
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			Composition composition2 = null;
			Composition composition3 = null;
			Composition composition4 = null;
			Composition composition5 = null;
			Composition composition6 = null;
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
				{
					float num3 = ((_margins != null) ? (_margins.Top + _margins.Bottom) : 0f);
					if (composition.ResidualHeight < num3)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Create:
					composition2 = new Composition();
					composition2.Parent = composition;
					if (_margins != null)
					{
						composition2.Left = composition.Scene.Left + _margins.Left;
						composition2.Top = composition.Scene.Top + composition.ActiveHeight + _margins.Top;
						composition2.Width = GetBounds(composition, graphics).Max - _margins.Left - _margins.Right;
						composition2.Height = composition.ResidualHeight - _margins.Top - _margins.Bottom;
					}
					else
					{
						composition2.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
						composition2.Top = composition.Scene.Top + composition.ActiveHeight;
						composition2.Width = GetBounds(composition, graphics).Max;
						composition2.Height = composition.ResidualHeight;
					}
					composition2.Borders = base.BordersResolved;
					composition2.Margins = _margins;
					composition2.Paddings = _paddings;
					composition2.Background = _background;
					composition2.ResetScene();
					composition3 = new Composition();
					composition3.Parent = composition2;
					composition3.Left = composition2.Scene.Left;
					composition3.Top = composition2.Scene.Top;
					composition3.Width = composition2.Scene.Width;
					composition3.Height = composition2.Scene.Height;
					if (mode == MeasureMode.Normal)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					}
					else
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Flush;
					}
					if (_header.Cells.Count > 0 && (_header.Repeat || _bodyCounter == 0))
					{
						composition4 = new Composition();
						composition4.Parent = composition2;
						composition4.Fake = true;
						composition4.Left = composition2.Scene.Left;
						composition4.Top = composition2.Scene.Top;
						composition4.Width = composition2.Scene.Width;
						composition4.Height = composition2.Scene.Height;
						composition4.ResetScene();
						_header.Reset();
						_header.Measure(composition4, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
						composition4.Height = _header.ActiveHeight;
						composition3.Height -= composition4.Height;
					}
					if (_footer.Cells.Count > 0 && (_footer.Repeat || _state == MeasureState.Flush))
					{
						composition5 = new Composition();
						composition5.Parent = composition2;
						composition5.Fake = true;
						composition5.Left = composition2.Scene.Left;
						composition5.Top = composition2.Scene.Top;
						composition5.Width = composition2.Scene.Width;
						composition5.Height = composition2.Scene.Height;
						composition5.ResetScene();
						_footer.Reset();
						_footer.Measure(composition5, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
						composition5.Height = _footer.ActiveHeight;
						composition3.Height -= composition5.Height;
					}
					if (_divider.Cells.Count > 0 && _state == MeasureState.Layout)
					{
						composition6 = new Composition();
						composition6.Parent = composition2;
						composition6.Fake = true;
						composition6.Left = composition2.Scene.Left;
						composition6.Top = composition2.Scene.Top;
						composition6.Width = composition2.Scene.Width;
						composition6.Height = composition2.Scene.Height;
						composition6.ResetScene();
						_divider.Reset();
						_divider.Measure(composition6, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
						composition6.Height = _divider.ActiveHeight;
						composition3.Height -= composition6.Height;
					}
					composition3.ResetScene();
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
				{
					bool flag = false;
					QuickTableRow quickTableRow2 = null;
					int num = _marker;
					int count2 = _rows.Count;
					if (_keepSolid)
					{
						while (!flag && num < count2)
						{
							QuickTableRow quickTableRow3 = _rows[num];
							if (num == count2 - 1 && _footer.Cells.Count > 0 && !_footer.Repeat)
							{
								composition5 = new Composition();
								composition5.Parent = composition2;
								composition5.Fake = true;
								composition5.Left = composition2.Scene.Left;
								composition5.Top = composition2.Scene.Top;
								composition5.Width = composition2.Scene.Width;
								composition5.Height = composition2.Scene.Height;
								composition5.ResetScene();
								_footer.Reset();
								_footer.Measure(composition5, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
								composition5.Height = _footer.ActiveHeight;
								composition3.Height -= composition5.Height;
								composition3.Scene.Height -= composition5.Height;
								if (composition3.Height < 0f)
								{
									composition3.Height = 0f;
								}
								if (composition3.Scene.Height < 0f)
								{
									composition3.Scene.Height = 0f;
								}
							}
							MeasureResult measureResult = quickTableRow3.Measure(composition3, graphics, MeasureMode.Normal);
							if (measureResult != MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
							{
								quickTableRow2 = quickTableRow3;
							}
							switch (measureResult)
							{
							case MeasureResult.BreakBefore:
							case MeasureResult.ContentBreak:
								if (!_freshBreak)
								{
									for (int j = _marker; j <= num; j++)
									{
										quickTableRow3 = _rows[j];
										quickTableRow3.Reset();
									}
									_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
									return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
								}
								if (_marker == num && measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
								{
									_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
									return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
								}
								flag = true;
								break;
							case MeasureResult.Ok:
								num++;
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						bool flag2 = _freshBreak;
						int num2 = -1;
						while (!flag && num < count2)
						{
							QuickTableRow quickTableRow4 = _rows[num];
							if (num == count2 - 1 && _footer.Cells.Count > 0 && !_footer.Repeat)
							{
								composition5 = new Composition();
								composition5.Parent = composition2;
								composition5.Fake = true;
								composition5.Left = composition2.Scene.Left;
								composition5.Top = composition2.Scene.Top;
								composition5.Width = composition2.Scene.Width;
								composition5.Height = composition2.Scene.Height;
								composition5.ResetScene();
								_footer.Reset();
								_footer.Measure(composition5, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
								composition5.Height = _footer.ActiveHeight;
								composition3.Height -= composition5.Height;
								composition3.Scene.Height -= composition5.Height;
								if (composition3.Height < 0f)
								{
									composition3.Height = 0f;
								}
								if (composition3.Scene.Height < 0f)
								{
									composition3.Scene.Height = 0f;
								}
							}
							if (!flag2 && quickTableRow4.KeepWithNext && num2 == -1)
							{

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)

				num = composition.ResidualHeight * relativeHeight.Value / 100f;

			if (num < 0f)

			while (true)

				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;

					}

					break;
				}

					composition.Scene.Height = composition.ResidualHeight;

					{

					}
					else

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			Composition composition2 = null;
			graphics.Font = _font;
			graphics.CharSpacing = 0f;
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
				{
					float num4 = ((_margins != null) ? (_margins.Top + _margins.Bottom) : 0f);
					if (composition.ResidualHeight < num4)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Create:
					composition2 = new Composition();
					composition2.Parent = composition;
					composition2.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
					composition2.Top = composition.Scene.Top + composition.ActiveHeight;
					if (_margins != null)
					{
						composition2.Left += _margins.Left;
						composition2.Top += _margins.Top;
						composition2.Width = composition.Scene.Width - _margins.Left - _margins.Right;
						composition2.Height = composition.ResidualHeight - _margins.Top - _margins.Bottom;
					}
					else
					{
						composition2.Width = composition.Scene.Width;
						composition2.Height = composition.ResidualHeight;
					}
					composition2.Margins = _margins;
					composition2.ResetScene();
					if (mode == MeasureMode.Normal)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					}
					else
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Flush;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
				{
					bool flag = false;
					int num2 = _marker;
					int count2 = _items.Count;
					if (_keepSolid)
					{
						while (!flag && num2 < count2)
						{
							QuickListItem quickListItem2 = _items[num2];
							quickListItem2.Index = num2;
							MeasureResult measureResult = quickListItem2.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.Normal);
							switch (measureResult)
							{
							case MeasureResult.BreakBefore:
							case MeasureResult.ContentBreak:
								if (!_freshBreak)
								{
									for (int i = _marker; i <= num2; i++)
									{
										quickListItem2 = _items[i];
										quickListItem2.Reset();
									}
									_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
									return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
								}
								if (_marker == num2 && measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
								{
									_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
									return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
								}
								flag = true;
								break;
							case MeasureResult.Ok:
								num2++;
								if (num2 < count2)
								{
									composition2.ActiveHeight += _interval;
								}
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						bool flag2 = _freshBreak;
						int num3 = -1;
						while (!flag && num2 < count2)
						{
							QuickListItem quickListItem3 = _items[num2];
							quickListItem3.Index = num2;
							if (!flag2 && quickListItem3.KeepWithNext && num3 == -1)
							{
								num3 = num2;
								composition2.Mark();
							}
							MeasureResult measureResult2 = quickListItem3.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.Normal);
							if (measureResult2 != MeasureResult.Ok)
							{
								if (flag2 && measureResult2 == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
								{
									quickListItem3.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.Flush);
									num3 = -1;
									num2++;
									if (num2 < count2)
									{
										composition2.ActiveHeight += _interval;
										flag = true;
									}
								}
								else
								{
									if (_marker == num2 && measureResult2 == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
									{
										_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
										return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
									}
									if (measureResult2 == MeasureResult.BreakBefore || measureResult2 == MeasureResult.ContentBreak)
									{
										if (num3 >= 0 && (quickListItem3.KeepWithNext || measureResult2 == MeasureResult.BreakBefore))
										{
											composition2.Rollback();
											for (int j = num3; j <= num2; j++)
											{
												quickListItem3 = _items[j];
												quickListItem3.Reset();
											}
											num2 = num3;
											num3 = -1;
										}
									}
									else
									{
										num3 = -1;
									}
									flag = true;
								}
							}
							else
							{
								num2++;
								if (num2 < count2)
								{
									composition2.ActiveHeight += _interval;
								}
								flag2 = false;
							}
							if (!quickListItem3.KeepWithNext)
							{
								num3 = -1;
							}
						}
					}
					if (composition2.Content.Count != 0)
					{
						composition.Content.Add(composition2);
						if (composition2.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							composition2.Height -= composition2.ResidualHeight;
						}
						composition.ActiveHeight += composition2.Height;
						if (_margins != null)
						{
							composition.ActiveHeight += _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
						}
					}
					_marker = num2;
					if (flag)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.ContentBreak;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Flush:
				{
					int num = _marker;
					int count = _items.Count;
					while (num < count)
					{
						QuickListItem quickListItem = _items[num];
						quickListItem.Index = num;
						quickListItem.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
						num++;
						if (num < count)
						{
							composition2.ActiveHeight += _interval;
						}
					}
					composition.Content.Add(composition2);
					if (composition2.ResidualHeight > 0f)
					{
						composition2.Height -= composition2.ResidualHeight;
					}
					composition.ActiveHeight += composition2.Height;
					if (_margins != null)
					{
						composition.ActiveHeight += _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
					}
					_marker = num;
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			foreach (QuickListItem item in _items)
			{
				item.Process(visitor);
			}
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			foreach (QuickListItem item in _items)
			{
				item.Reset();
			}
			_marker = 0;
			base.Reset();
		}

		public IQuickListItem AddItem(string text)
		{
			if (text == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("text");
			}
			QuickListItem quickListItem = new QuickListItem(_report, this, text);
			_items.Add(quickListItem);
			return quickListItem;
		}

		public void InitializeParent(object parent)
		{
			if (parent == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("parent");
			}
			this.parent = parent;
		}
	}
	internal class QuickListItem : Element, IQuickListItem
	{
		private QuickList _list;

		private string _content;

		private bool _keepSolid;

		private bool _keepWithNext;

		private int _index;

		private bool _showBullet;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.UnitCollection _units;

		private int _marker;

		public string Content => _content;

		public int Index
		{
			get
			{
				return _index;
			}
			set
			{
				_index = value;
			}
		}

		public bool KeepSolid
		{
			get
			{
				return _keepSolid;
			}
			set
			{
				_keepSolid = value;
			}
		}

		public bool KeepWithNext
		{
			get
			{
				return _keepWithNext;
			}
			set
			{
				_keepWithNext = value;
			}
		}

		public QuickList List => _list;

		public IQuickList Parent => List;

		public override ElementType Type => ElementType.QuickListItem;

		public QuickListItem(Report report, QuickList list, string content)
			: base(report)
		{
			_list = list;
			_content = content;
			_showBullet = true;
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			QuickTextComposition quickTextComposition = null;
			graphics.Font = _list.Font;
			graphics.CharSpacing = 0f;
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					if (_units == null)
					{
						_units = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.QuickText.ComposeUnits(_content, graphics);
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
					if (composition.ResidualHeight < 0f)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				case MeasureState.Create:
					quickTextComposition = new QuickTextComposition(_list.Font, _list.Brush);
					quickTextComposition.Fake = true;
					quickTextComposition.Parent = composition;
					quickTextComposition.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
					quickTextComposition.Top = composition.Scene.Top + composition.ActiveHeight;
					quickTextComposition.Width = composition.Scene.Width;
					quickTextComposition.Height = composition.ResidualHeight;
					if (_list.Numbered)
					{
						quickTextComposition.Number = _index + 1;
						CharBuffer charBuffer = new CharBuffer();
						for (int num = _list.Items.Count; num > 0; num /= 10)
						{
							charBuffer.Add('0');
						}
						charBuffer.Add('.');
						quickTextComposition.OffsetX = graphics.FontMetrics.Height + graphics.GetStringWidth(charBuffer.ToString());
					}
					else
					{
						quickTextComposition.OffsetX = graphics.FontMetrics.Height + graphics.GetCharWidth('●');
					}
					quickTextComposition.ResetScene();
					if (mode == MeasureMode.Normal)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					}
					else
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Flush;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
				{
					bool flag = false;
					int marker2 = _marker;
					if (_keepSolid)
					{
						switch (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.QuickText.ComposeBody(quickTextComposition, graphics, _units, 0f, 0f, ref marker2, flush: false))
						{
						case MeasureResult.BreakBefore:
							_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
							return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
						case MeasureResult.ContentBreak:
							if (!_freshBreak)
							{
								_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
								return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
							}
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						MeasureResult measureResult = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.QuickText.ComposeBody(quickTextComposition, graphics, _units, 0f, 0f, ref marker2, flush: false);
						if (measureResult != MeasureResult.Ok)
						{
							if (_freshBreak && measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
							{
								quickTextComposition.Lines.Clear();
								Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.QuickText.ComposeBody(quickTextComposition, graphics, _units, 0f, 0f, ref marker2, flush: true);
							}
							else
							{
								if (measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
								{
									_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
									return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
								}
								flag = true;
							}
						}
					}
					composition.Content.Add(quickTextComposition);
					if (_showBullet && !quickTextComposition.Empty)
					{
						quickTextComposition.ShowBullet = true;
						_showBullet = false;
					}
					if (quickTextComposition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
					{
						quickTextComposition.Height -= quickTextComposition.ResidualHeight;
					}
					quickTextComposition.ResetScene();
					composition.ActiveHeight += quickTextComposition.Height;
					if (_report.FileBuffer != null)
					{
						quickTextComposition.Attach(_report.FileBuffer);
					}
					_marker = marker2;
					if (flag)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.ContentBreak;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Flush:
				{
					int marker = _marker;
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.QuickText.ComposeBody(quickTextComposition, graphics, _units, 0f, 0f, ref marker, flush: true);
					composition.Content.Add(quickTextComposition);
					if (_showBullet && !quickTextComposition.Empty)
					{
						quickTextComposition.ShowBullet = true;
						_showBullet = false;
					}
					if (quickTextComposition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
					{
						quickTextComposition.Height -= quickTextComposition.ResidualHeight;
					}
					quickTextComposition.ResetScene();
					composition.ActiveHeight += quickTextComposition.Height;
					_marker = marker;
					if (_report.FileBuffer != null)
					{
						quickTextComposition.Attach(_report.FileBuffer);
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.End:
					_units = null;
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			_showBullet = true;
			_units = null;
			_marker = 0;
			base.Reset();
		}
	}

	internal class BoundsManager
	{
		public class Entry
		{
			private int _skipCounter;

			private GridCell _cell;

			private float _min;

			private float _max;

			public GridCell Cell
			{
				get
				{
					return _cell;
				}
				set
				{
					_cell = value;
				}
			}

			public float Max
			{
				get
				{
					return _max;
				}
				set
				{
					_max = value;
				}
			}

			public float Min
			{
				get
				{
					return _min;
				}
				set
				{
					_min = value;
				}
			}

			public int SkipCounter
			{
				get
				{
					return _skipCounter;
				}
				set
				{
					_skipCounter = value;
				}
			}
		}

		private Entry[] _buffer;

		public Entry this[int index] => _buffer[index];

		public BoundsManager(int capacity)
		{
			_buffer = new Entry[capacity];
			for (int i = 0; i < capacity; i++)
			{
				_buffer[i] = new Entry();
			}
		}

		public void Next()
		{
			Entry[] buffer = _buffer;
			foreach (Entry entry in buffer)
			{
				if (entry.SkipCounter > 0)
				{
					entry.SkipCounter--;
				}
			}
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			Entry[] buffer = _buffer;
			foreach (Entry entry in buffer)
			{
				entry.SkipCounter = 0;
				entry.Cell = null;
			}
		}
	}

		public override Bounds GetBounds(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics)
		{

				if (num < bounds.Min)
				{
					num = bounds.Min;
				}
				if (num2 < bounds.Max)

					num2 = bounds.Max;
				}
			}
			float num3 = 0f;
			if (_paddings != null)
			{
				num3 = _paddings.Left + _paddings.Right;
			}
			if (BordersResolved.HasLeft && BordersResolved.Left.Pen != null)

				num3 += BordersResolved.Left.Pen.Width / 2f;
			}
			if (BordersResolved.HasRight && BordersResolved.Right.Pen != null)
			{
				num3 += BordersResolved.Right.Pen.Width / 2f;

			return new Bounds(num + num3, num2 + num3);
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			Composition composition2 = null;
			float num = 0f;
			switch (_height.Type)
			{
			case HeightType.Fixed:
				num = ((FixedHeight)_height).Value;
				break;
			case HeightType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeHeight relativeHeight = (RelativeHeight)_height;
				num = composition.Scene.Height * relativeHeight.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeHeight.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeHeight.Constraint.Apply(num);
				}
				break;
			}
			case HeightType.Max:
			case HeightType.Auto:
				num = composition.Scene.Height;
				break;
			}
			if (num < 0f)
			{
				num = 0f;
			}
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
				{
					float num2 = 0f;
					if (_height.Type != HeightType.Auto)
					{
						num2 += num;
					}
					if (composition.Scene.Height < num2)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Create:
					composition2 = new Composition();
					composition2.Parent = composition;
					composition2.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
					composition2.Top = composition.Scene.Top;
					composition2.Width = _activeWidth;
					composition2.Height = num;
					composition2.Borders = BordersResolved;
					composition2.Paddings = _paddings;
					composition2.Background = _background;
					composition2.ResetScene();
					if (mode == MeasureMode.Normal && _height.Type == HeightType.Auto)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					}
					else
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Flush;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
				{
					bool flag = false;
					int num3 = _marker;
					int count2 = _content.Count;
					bool flag2 = _freshBreak;
					while (!flag && num3 < count2)
					{
						Element element2 = _content[num3];
						MeasureResult measureResult = element2.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.Normal);
						if (measureResult != MeasureResult.Ok)
						{
							if (flag2 && measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
							{
								element2.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.Flush);
								num3++;
								if (num3 < count2)
								{
									flag = true;
								}
								continue;
							}
							if (_marker == num3 && measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
							{
								_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
								return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
							}
							if (measureResult == MeasureResult.PageBreak)
							{
								num3++;
							}
							flag = true;
						}
						else
						{
							num3++;
							flag2 = false;
						}
					}
					composition.Content.Add(composition2);
					if (composition2.ResidualHeight > 0f)
					{
						composition2.Height -= composition2.ResidualHeight;
					}
					if (composition2.Content.Count == 0)
					{
						composition2.Empty = true;
					}
					_marker = num3;
					if (flag)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.ContentBreak;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Flush:
				{
					int i = _marker;
					for (int count = _content.Count; i < count; i++)
					{
						Element element = _content[i];
						element.Measure(composition2, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
					}
					composition.Content.Add(composition2);
					if (_height.Type == HeightType.Auto && composition2.ResidualHeight > 0f)
					{
						composition2.Height -= composition2.ResidualHeight;
					}
					if (composition2.Content.Count == 0)
					{
						composition2.Empty = true;
					}
					_marker = i;
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Process(visitor);
			}
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Reset();
			}
			_activeWidth = 0f;
			_marker = 0;
			base.Reset();
		}
	}

		private Bounds GetBounds(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, BoundsManager boundsManager)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			float num3 = ((_margins != null) ? (_margins.Left + _margins.Right) : 0f);
			switch (_width.Type)
			{
			case WidthType.Fixed:
				num = ((FixedWidth)_width).Value;
				num2 = num;
				break;
			case WidthType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeWidth relativeWidth = (RelativeWidth)_width;
				num2 = composition.Scene.Width - num3;
				num2 *= relativeWidth.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeWidth.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num);
					num2 = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num2);
				}
				break;
			}
			case WidthType.Max:
				num2 = composition.Scene.Width - num3;
				break;
			case WidthType.Auto:
			{
				AdjustBounds(composition, graphics, boundsManager);
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = _columns.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					BoundsManager.Entry entry = boundsManager[i];
					num += entry.Min;
					num2 += entry.Max;
				}
				if (_paddings != null)
				{
					num3 += _paddings.Left + _paddings.Right;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasLeft && base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen != null)
				{
					num3 += base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasRight && base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen != null)
				{
					num3 += base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			return new Bounds(num + num3, num2 + num3);
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			Composition composition2 = null;
			Composition composition3 = null;
			Composition composition4 = null;
			Composition composition5 = null;
			Composition composition6 = null;
			BoundsManager boundsManager = new BoundsManager(_columns.Count);
			float num = 0f;
			switch (_width.Type)
			{
			case WidthType.Fixed:
				num = ((FixedWidth)_width).Value;
				AdjustBounds(composition, graphics, boundsManager);
				break;
			case WidthType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeWidth relativeWidth = (RelativeWidth)_width;
				num = composition.Scene.Width;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
				num *= relativeWidth.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeWidth.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num);
				}
				AdjustBounds(composition, graphics, boundsManager);
				break;
			}
			case WidthType.Max:
				num = composition.Scene.Width;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
				AdjustBounds(composition, graphics, boundsManager);
				break;
			case WidthType.Auto:
				num = GetBounds(composition, graphics, boundsManager).Fit(composition.Scene.Width);
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (num < 0f)
			{
				num = 0f;
			}
			float num2 = 65535f;
			switch (_height.Type)
			{
			case HeightType.Fixed:
				num2 = ((FixedHeight)_height).Value;
				break;
			case HeightType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeHeight relativeHeight = (RelativeHeight)_height;
				num2 = composition.ResidualHeight;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num2 -= _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
				}
				num2 *= relativeHeight.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeHeight.Constraint != null)
				{
					num2 = relativeHeight.Constraint.Apply(num2);
				}
				break;
			}
			case HeightType.Max:
				num2 = composition.ResidualHeight;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num2 -= _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
				}
				break;
			case HeightType.Auto:
				if (mode != MeasureMode.MasterFlush)
				{
					num2 = composition.ResidualHeight;
					if (_margins != null)
					{
						num2 -= _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			if (num2 < 0f)
			{
				num2 = 0f;
			}
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
				{
					float num3 = ((_margins != null) ? (_margins.Top + _margins.Bottom) : 0f);
					if (_height.Type != HeightType.Auto)
					{
						num3 += num2;
					}
					if (composition.ResidualHeight < num3)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Create:
				{
					composition2 = new Composition();
					composition2.Parent = composition;
					composition2.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
					composition2.Top = composition.Scene.Top;
					composition2.Width = num;
					composition2.Height = num2;
					composition2.Borders = base.BordersResolved;
					composition2.Margins = _margins;
					composition2.Paddings = _paddings;
					composition2.Background = _background;
					if (_panel == null)
					{
						if (_margins != null)
						{
							composition2.Left += _margins.Left;
							composition2.Top += composition.ActiveHeight + _margins.Top;
						}
						else
						{
							composition2.Top += composition.ActiveHeight;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						PropertyCollection propertyCollection = _panel.AttachedProperties[this];
						composition2.Left += propertyCollection.GetValue("Left", 0f);
						composition2.Top += propertyCollection.GetValue("Top", 0f);
						composition2.RotationAngle = propertyCollection.GetValue("Angle", 0f);
					}
					composition2.ResetScene();
					if (_spanManager == null)
					{
						_spanManager = new SpanManager(_columns.Count);
					}
					float num12 = 0f;
					float num13 = 0f;
					int num14 = 0;
					foreach (GridColumn column in _columns)
					{
						BoundsManager.Entry entry10 = boundsManager[num14];
						switch (column.Width.Type)
						{
						case WidthType.Fixed:
							num12 += entry10.Max;
							break;
						case WidthType.Relative:
						case WidthType.Max:
						case WidthType.Auto:
							num13 += entry10.Max;
							break;
						}
						num14++;
					}
					float num15 = composition2.Scene.Width - num12;
					if (num15 < 0f)
					{
						num15 = 0f;
					}
					num14 = 0;
					foreach (GridColumn column2 in _columns)
					{
						BoundsManager.Entry entry11 = boundsManager[num14];

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			foreach (GridColumn column in _columns)
			{
				column.Process(visitor);
			}
			if (HasHeader)
			{
				_header.Process(visitor);
			}
			if (HasFooter)
			{
				_footer.Process(visitor);
			}
			if (HasDivider)
			{
				_divider.Process(visitor);
			}
			foreach (GridRow row in _rows)
			{
				row.Process(visitor);
			}
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			foreach (GridColumn column in _columns)
			{
				column.Reset();
			}
			foreach (GridRow row in _rows)
			{
				row.Reset();
			}
			_spanManager = null;
			_bodyCounter = 0;
			_marker = 0;
			base.Reset();
		}
	}
	internal class GridHeader : GridRow, IGridHeader
	{
		private bool _repeat;

		public override ElementType Type => ElementType.GridHeader;

		public bool Repeat
		{
			get
			{
				return _repeat;
			}
			set
			{
				_repeat = value;
			}
		}

		public GridHeader(Report report, Grid grid)
			: base(report, grid)
		{
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			foreach (GridCell cell in _cells)
			{
				cell.Process(visitor);
			}
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}
	}
