		Paddings Paddings { get; set; }

		Background Background { get; set; }

		bool KeepSolid { get; set; }

		bool Stretch { get; set; }

		object Parent { get; }

		IGridColumn AddColumn();

		IGridRow AddRow();

		void ApplyPattern(GridPattern pattern);

		Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Size Measure();
	}

		public MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode, SpanManager spanManager)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			switch (_height.Type)
			{
			case HeightType.Fixed:
				num = ((FixedHeight)_height).Value;
				break;
			case HeightType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeHeight relativeHeight = (RelativeHeight)_height;
				num = composition.ResidualHeight - MarginsResolved.Top - MarginsResolved.Bottom;
				num *= relativeHeight.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeHeight.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeHeight.Constraint.Apply(num);
				}
				break;
			}
			case HeightType.Max:
				num = composition.ResidualHeight - MarginsResolved.Top - MarginsResolved.Bottom;
				break;
			}
			if (num < 0f)
			{
				num = 0f;
			}
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
				{
					float num19 = MarginsResolved.Top + MarginsResolved.Bottom;
					if (_height.Type != HeightType.Auto)
					{
						num19 += num;
					}
					if (composition.ResidualHeight < num19)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Create:
					composition.SaveScene();
					composition.Scene.Top += composition.ActiveHeight + MarginsResolved.Top;
					composition.Scene.Height = composition.ResidualHeight - MarginsResolved.Top - MarginsResolved.Bottom;
					if (mode == MeasureMode.Normal && _height.Type == HeightType.Auto)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					}
					else
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Flush;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
				{
					int count6 = composition.Content.Count;
					bool flag4 = false;
					bool flag5 = false;
					bool flag6 = true;
					int num10 = 0;
					int count7 = _cells.Count;
					GridColumnCollection columns2 = _grid.Columns;
					int num11 = 0;
					int count8 = columns2.Count;
					SpanManager.Entry[] array5 = new SpanManager.Entry[count8];
					while (!flag4 && num11 < count8)
					{
						GridColumn gridColumn2 = null;
						SpanManager.Entry entry5 = null;
						GridCell gridCell2 = null;
						Area area4 = null;
						if (spanManager != null)
						{
							entry5 = spanManager[num11];
						}
						int num12 = 1;
						int num13 = 1;
						bool flag7 = false;
						if (entry5 != null && (entry5.SkipCounter > 0 || num10 >= count7))
						{
							gridCell2 = entry5.Cell;
							if (gridCell2 == null)
							{
								break;
							}
							num12 = gridCell2.ColSpan;
							num13 = entry5.SkipCounter;
							if (!gridCell2.Measured && !spanManager.FreshBreak && entry5.SkipCounter == 1)
							{
								flag5 = true;
							}
							if ((gridCell2.Measured && !spanManager.FreshBreak) || spanManager.BreakAhead)
							{
								flag7 = true;
								area4 = entry5.Area;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							if (num10 >= count7)
							{
								break;
							}
							gridCell2 = _cells[num10];
							num12 = gridCell2.ColSpan;
							num13 = gridCell2.RowSpan;
							num10++;
						}
						entry5 = null;
						float num14 = 0f;
						for (int m = 0; m < num12; m++)
						{
							if (num11 >= count8)
							{
								break;
							}
							gridColumn2 = columns2[num11];
							if (entry5 == null)
							{
								entry5 = (array5[num11] = new SpanManager.Entry(num13, gridCell2, null));
							}
							else
							{
								array5[num11] = new SpanManager.Entry(num13, gridCell2, null);
							}
							if (m == 0)
							{
								composition.Scene.Left += gridColumn2.MarginsResolved.Left;
							}
							num14 += gridColumn2.ActiveWidth;
							if (m < num12 - 1)
							{
								num14 += gridColumn2.MarginsResolved.Right;
							}
							if (m > 0)
							{
								num14 += gridColumn2.MarginsResolved.Left;
							}
							num11++;
						}
						if (!flag7)
						{
							if (!gridCell2.Measured)
							{
								gridCell2.ActiveWidth = num14;
								switch (gridCell2.Measure(composition, graphics, MeasureMode.Normal))
								{
								case MeasureResult.BreakBefore:
									flag4 = true;
									break;
								case MeasureResult.ContentBreak:
									flag5 = true;
									break;
								}
								if (!flag4)
								{
									area4 = composition.Content[composition.Content.Count - 1];
									if (!area4.Empty)
									{
										flag6 = false;
									}
								}
							}
							else
							{
								area4 = new Area();
								area4.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
								area4.Top = composition.Scene.Top;
								area4.Width = gridCell2.ActiveWidth;
								area4.Borders = gridCell2.BordersResolved;
								area4.Paddings = gridCell2.Paddings;
								area4.Background = gridCell2.Background;
								composition.Content.Add(area4);
								area4.Parent = composition;
							}
						}
						if (entry5 != null)
						{
							entry5.Area = area4;
						}
						composition.Scene.Left += gridCell2.ActiveWidth + gridColumn2.MarginsResolved.Right;
					}
					if (!_freshBreak && _keepSolid && flag5)
					{
						flag4 = true;
					}
					if (flag6 && flag5)
					{
						flag4 = true;
					}
					if (flag4)
					{
						Reset();
						composition.Content.RemoveRange(count6, composition.Content.Count - count6);
						composition.RestoreScene();
						if (!_freshBreak)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
							return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
						}
						_state = MeasureState.Flush;
						break;
					}
					if (flag6)
					{
						composition.Content.RemoveRange(count6, composition.Content.Count - count6);
					}
					else if (spanManager != null)
					{
						num11 = 0;
						SpanManager.Entry[] array6 = array5;
						foreach (SpanManager.Entry entry6 in array6)
						{
							if (entry6 != null)
							{
								spanManager[num11] = entry6;
							}
							num11++;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						float num15 = composition.Scene.Top;
						SpanManager.Entry[] array7 = array5;
						foreach (SpanManager.Entry entry7 in array7)
						{
							if (entry7 != null && entry7.Cell != null && entry7.Area != null)
							{
								Area area5 = entry7.Area;
								float num17 = area5.Top + area5.Height;
								if (num15 < num17)
								{
									num15 = num17;
								}
							}
						}
						SpanManager.Entry[] array8 = array5;
						foreach (SpanManager.Entry entry8 in array8)
						{
							if (entry8 != null && entry8.Cell != null && entry8.Area != null)
							{
								GridCell cell2 = entry8.Cell;
								Area area6 = entry8.Area;
								area6.Height = num15 - area6.Top;
								if (area6 is Composition)
								{
									area6.ResetScene();
									Composition composition2 = (Composition)area6;
									Composition.AlignHorizontal(composition2, cell2.AlignmentResolved, Layout.Vertical);
									Composition.AlignVertical(composition2, cell2.AlignmentResolved, Layout.Vertical);
								}
							}
						}
						_activeHeight = num15 - composition.Scene.Top;
					}
					composition.RestoreScene();
					if (flag5)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.ContentBreak;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Flush:
				{
					int count = composition.Content.Count;
					bool flag = true;
					float num2 = 0f;
					int num3 = 0;
					int count2 = _cells.Count;
					GridColumnCollection columns = _grid.Columns;
					int num4 = 0;
					int count3 = columns.Count;
					SpanManager.Entry[] array = new SpanManager.Entry[count3];
					while (num4 < count3)
					{
						GridColumn gridColumn = null;
						SpanManager.Entry entry = null;
						GridCell gridCell = null;
						Area area = null;
						if (spanManager != null)
						{
							entry = spanManager[num4];
						}
						int num5 = 1;
						int num6 = 1;
						bool flag2 = false;
						if (entry != null && (entry.SkipCounter > 0 || num3 >= count2))
						{
							gridCell = entry.Cell;
							if (gridCell == null)
							{
								break;
							}
							num5 = gridCell.ColSpan;
							num6 = entry.SkipCounter;
							if (mode == MeasureMode.MasterFlush || (gridCell.Measured && !spanManager.FreshBreak) || spanManager.BreakAhead)
							{
								flag2 = true;
								area = entry.Area;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							if (num3 >= count2)
							{
								break;
							}
							gridCell = _cells[num3];
							num5 = gridCell.ColSpan;
							num6 = gridCell.RowSpan;
							num3++;
						}
						entry = null;
						float num7 = 0f;
						for (int i = 0; i < num5; i++)
						{
							if (num4 >= count3)
							{
								break;
							}
							gridColumn = columns[num4];
							if (entry == null)
							{
								entry = (array[num4] = new SpanManager.Entry(num6, gridCell, null));
							}
							else
							{
								array[num4] = new SpanManager.Entry(num6, gridCell, null);
							}
							if (i == 0)
							{
								composition.Scene.Left += gridColumn.MarginsResolved.Left;
							}
							num7 += gridColumn.ActiveWidth;
							if (i < num5 - 1)
							{
								num7 += gridColumn.MarginsResolved.Right;
							}
							if (i > 0)
							{
								num7 += gridColumn.MarginsResolved.Left;
							}
							num4++;
						}
						if (!flag2)
						{
							bool flag3 = true;
							if (!gridCell.Measured)
							{
								gridCell.ActiveWidth = num7;
								int count4 = composition.Content.Count;
								if (mode == MeasureMode.MasterFlush || gridCell.RowSpan == 1)
								{
									gridCell.Measure(composition, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
								}
								else
								{
									gridCell.Measure(composition, graphics, MeasureMode.Normal);
								}
								int count5 = composition.Content.Count;
								if (count4 < count5)
								{
									area = composition.Content[composition.Content.Count - 1];
									if (!area.Empty)
									{
										if (gridCell.RowSpan == 1)
										{
											float height = area.Height;
											if (num2 < height)
											{
												num2 = height;
											}
										}
										flag = false;
									}
									flag3 = false;
								}
							}
							if (flag3)
							{
								area = new Area();
								area.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
								area.Top = composition.Scene.Top;
								area.Width = gridCell.ActiveWidth;
								area.Borders = gridCell.BordersResolved;
								area.Paddings = gridCell.Paddings;
								area.Background = gridCell.Background;
								composition.Content.Add(area);
								area.Parent = composition;
							}
						}
						if (entry != null)
						{
							entry.Area = area;
						}
						composition.Scene.Left += gridCell.ActiveWidth + gridColumn.MarginsResolved.Right;
					}
					if (mode != MeasureMode.MasterFlush && flag)
					{
						Reset();
						composition.Content.RemoveRange(count, composition.Content.Count - count);
						composition.RestoreScene();
						if (!_freshBreak)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
							return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (spanManager != null)
						{
							num4 = 0;
							SpanManager.Entry[] array2 = array;
							foreach (SpanManager.Entry entry2 in array2)
							{
								if (entry2 != null)
								{
									spanManager[num4] = entry2;
								}
								num4++;
							}
						}
						if (_height.Type != HeightType.Auto)
						{
							num2 = num;
						}
						float num8 = composition.Scene.Top + num2;
						if (mode == MeasureMode.MasterFlush)
						{
							SpanManager.Entry[] array3 = array;
							foreach (SpanManager.Entry entry3 in array3)
							{
								if (entry3 != null && entry3.Cell != null && entry3.Area != null && (_height.Type == HeightType.Auto || (_height.Type != HeightType.Auto && entry3.Cell.RowSpan > 1)) && entry3.SkipCounter == 1)
								{
									Area area2 = entry3.Area;
									float num9 = area2.Top + area2.Height;
									if (num8 < num9)
									{
										num8 = num9;
									}
								}
							}
							num2 = num8 - composition.Scene.Top;
						}
						SpanManager.Entry[] array4 = array;
						foreach (SpanManager.Entry entry4 in array4)
						{
							if (entry4 != null && entry4.Cell != null && entry4.Area != null && ((mode == MeasureMode.MasterFlush && entry4.SkipCounter == 1) || entry4.Cell.RowSpan == 1))
							{
								GridCell cell = entry4.Cell;
								Area area3 = entry4.Area;
								area3.Height = num8 - area3.Top;
								if (area3 is Composition)
								{
									area3.ResetScene();
									Composition.AlignHorizontal((Composition)area3, cell.AlignmentResolved, Layout.Vertical);
									Composition.AlignVertical((Composition)area3, cell.AlignmentResolved, Layout.Vertical);
								}
							}
						}
						if (mode == MeasureMode.MasterFlush)
						{
							composition.ActiveHeight += num2 + MarginsResolved.Top + MarginsResolved.Bottom;
						}
						_activeHeight = num2;
						composition.RestoreScene();
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.End:
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			return Measure(composition, graphics, mode, null);
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			foreach (GridCell cell in _cells)
			{
				cell.Process(visitor);
			}
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			foreach (GridCell cell in _cells)
			{
				cell.Reset();
			}
			_activeHeight = 0f;
			base.Reset();
		}

		protected virtual void ApplyPattern(IGridCell cell)
		{
			if (_grid.Pattern != null)
			{
				_grid.Pattern.Row.Cell.Apply(cell);
			}
		}
	}

	internal class SpanManager
	{
		public class Entry
		{
			private int _skipCounter;

			private GridCell _cell;

			private Area _area;

			public Area Area
			{
				get
				{
					return _area;
				}
				set
				{
					_area = value;
				}
			}

			public GridCell Cell => _cell;

			public int SkipCounter
			{
				get
				{
					return _skipCounter;
				}
				set
				{
					_skipCounter = value;
				}
			}

			public Entry()
			{
			}

			public Entry(int skipCounter, GridCell cell, Area area)
			{
				_skipCounter = skipCounter;
				_cell = cell;
				_area = area;
			}
		}

		private Entry[] _buffer;

		private Entry[] _marker;

		private bool _breakAhead;

		private bool _freshBreak;

		public bool BreakAhead
		{
			get
			{
				return _breakAhead;
			}
			set
			{
				_breakAhead = value;
			}
		}

		public bool FreshBreak
		{
			get
			{
				return _freshBreak;
			}
			set
			{
				_freshBreak = value;
			}
		}

		public Entry this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return _buffer[index];
			}
			set
			{
				_buffer[index] = value;
			}
		}

		public SpanManager(int capacity)
		{
			_buffer = new Entry[capacity];
			for (int i = 0; i < capacity; i++)
			{
				_buffer[i] = new Entry();
			}
			_marker = new Entry[capacity];
		}

		public void Mark()
		{
			int num = 0;
			Entry[] buffer = _buffer;
			foreach (Entry entry in buffer)
			{
				_marker[num] = new Entry(entry.SkipCounter, entry.Cell, entry.Area);
				num++;
			}
		}

		public void Next()
		{
			Entry[] buffer = _buffer;
			foreach (Entry entry in buffer)
			{
				if (entry.SkipCounter > 0)
				{
					entry.SkipCounter--;
				}
			}
		}

		public void Rollback()
		{
			int num = 0;
			Entry[] marker = _marker;
			foreach (Entry entry in marker)
			{
				_buffer[num] = entry;
				num++;
			}
		}
	}
}

	internal class PatternCollector : Visitor
	{
		private TextPatternCollection _textPatterns;

		private TablePatternCollection _tablePatterns;

		private GridPatternCollection _gridPatterns;

		private FlowPatternCollection _flowPatterns;

		private ListPatternCollection _listPatterns;

		private TreePatternCollection _treePatterns;

		private Dictionary<TextPattern, int> _textPatternIds;

		private Dictionary<TablePattern, int> _tablePatternIds;

		private Dictionary<GridPattern, int> _gridPatternIds;

		private Dictionary<FlowPattern, int> _flowPatternIds;

		private Dictionary<ListPattern, int> _listPatternIds;

		private Dictionary<TreePattern, int> _treePatternIds;

		public FlowPatternCollection FlowPatterns => _flowPatterns;

		public GridPatternCollection GridPatterns => _gridPatterns;

		public ListPatternCollection ListPatterns => _listPatterns;

		public TablePatternCollection TablePatterns => _tablePatterns;

		public TextPatternCollection TextPatterns => _textPatterns;

		public TreePatternCollection TreePatterns => _treePatterns;

		public PatternCollector()
		{
			_textPatterns = new TextPatternCollection();
			_tablePatterns = new TablePatternCollection();
			_gridPatterns = new GridPatternCollection();
			_flowPatterns = new FlowPatternCollection();
			_listPatterns = new ListPatternCollection();
			_treePatterns = new TreePatternCollection();
			_textPatternIds = new Dictionary<TextPattern, int>(25);
			_tablePatternIds = new Dictionary<TablePattern, int>(25);
			_gridPatternIds = new Dictionary<GridPattern, int>(25);
			_flowPatternIds = new Dictionary<FlowPattern, int>(25);
			_listPatternIds = new Dictionary<ListPattern, int>(25);
			_treePatternIds = new Dictionary<TreePattern, int>(25);
		}

		public override void Process(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Text text)
		{
			TextPattern pattern = text.Pattern;
			if (pattern != null && !_textPatternIds.ContainsKey(pattern))
			{
				_textPatterns.Add(pattern);
				_textPatternIds.Add(pattern, _textPatterns.Count);
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Table.Table table)
		{
			TablePattern pattern = table.Pattern;
			if (pattern != null && !_tablePatternIds.ContainsKey(pattern))
			{
				_tablePatterns.Add(pattern);
				_tablePatternIds.Add(pattern, _tablePatterns.Count);
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Grid.Grid grid)
		{
			GridPattern pattern = grid.Pattern;
			if (pattern != null && !_gridPatternIds.ContainsKey(pattern))
			{
				_gridPatterns.Add(pattern);
				_gridPatternIds.Add(pattern, _gridPatterns.Count);
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Flow.Flow flow)
		{
			FlowPattern pattern = flow.Pattern;
			if (pattern != null && !_flowPatternIds.ContainsKey(pattern))
			{
				_flowPatterns.Add(pattern);
				_flowPatternIds.Add(pattern, _flowPatterns.Count);
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.List.List list)
		{
			ListPattern pattern = list.Pattern;
			if (pattern != null && !_listPatternIds.ContainsKey(pattern))
			{
				_listPatterns.Add(pattern);
				_listPatternIds.Add(pattern, _listPatterns.Count);
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Tree.Tree tree)
		{
			TreePattern pattern = tree.Pattern;
			if (pattern != null && !_treePatternIds.ContainsKey(pattern))
			{
				_treePatterns.Add(pattern);
				_treePatternIds.Add(pattern, _treePatterns.Count);
			}
		}

		public int GetId(TextPattern pattern)
		{
			if (pattern == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (_textPatternIds.ContainsKey(pattern))
			{
				return _textPatternIds[pattern];
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public int GetId(TablePattern pattern)
		{
			if (pattern == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (_tablePatternIds.ContainsKey(pattern))
			{
				return _tablePatternIds[pattern];
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public int GetId(GridPattern pattern)
		{
			if (pattern == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (_gridPatternIds.ContainsKey(pattern))
			{
				return _gridPatternIds[pattern];
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public int GetId(FlowPattern pattern)
		{
			if (pattern == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (_flowPatternIds.ContainsKey(pattern))
			{
				return _flowPatternIds[pattern];
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public int GetId(ListPattern pattern)
		{

			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (_listPatternIds.ContainsKey(pattern))
			{
				return _listPatternIds[pattern];
			}
			return -1;
		}

		{
			if (pattern == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (_treePatternIds.ContainsKey(pattern))
			{
				return _treePatternIds[pattern];
			}
			return -1;
		}

	internal class StyleCollector : Visitor
	{
		private StyleCollection _styles;

		private Dictionary<StyleHashKey, int> _ids;

		public StyleCollection Styles => _styles;

		public StyleCollector()
		{
			_styles = new StyleCollection();
			_ids = new Dictionary<StyleHashKey, int>(25);
		}

		public override void Process(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Section.Section section)
		{
			if (section.PageNumbering != null)
			{
				ProcessStyle(section.PageNumbering.Style);
			}
			if (section.LineNumbering != null)
			{
				ProcessStyle(section.LineNumbering.Style);
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Text text)
		{
			Style style = text.StyleResolved;
			ProcessStyle(style);
			if (text.LineNumbering != null)
			{
				ProcessStyle(text.LineNumbering.Style);
			}
			if (text.FirstLetter != null)
			{
				ProcessStyle(text.FirstLetter.Style);
			}
			foreach (Atom atom in text.Atoms)
			{
				if (style != atom.Style)
				{
					style = atom.Style;
					ProcessStyle(style);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.List.List list)
		{
			ProcessStyle(list.Bullets.Style);
		}

		public override void Process(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.TOC.TOC toc)
		{
			foreach (Level level in toc.Levels)
			{
				ProcessStyle(level.Style);
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Index.Index index)
		{
			ProcessStyle(index.Alphabet.Style);
			foreach (IndexLevel level in index.Levels)
			{
				ProcessStyle(level.Style);
			}
		}

		private void ProcessStyle(Style style)
		{
			StyleHashKey hashKey = style.GetHashKey();
			if (!_ids.ContainsKey(hashKey))
			{
				_styles.Add(style);
				_ids.Add(hashKey, _styles.Count);
			}
		}

		public int GetId(Style style)
		{
			if (style == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			StyleHashKey hashKey = style.GetHashKey();
			if (_ids.ContainsKey(hashKey))
			{
				return _ids[hashKey];
			}
			return -1;
		}
	}
	internal class ResourceCollector : Visitor
	{
		private ResourceCollection _resources;

		private Dictionary<ShortFontHashKey, Resource> _fonts;

		private Dictionary<Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image, Resource> _images;

		private Dictionary<Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Metafile, Resource> _metafiles;

		public ResourceCollection Resources => _resources;

		public ResourceCollector()
		{
			_resources = new ResourceCollection();
			_fonts = new Dictionary<ShortFontHashKey, Resource>(25);
			_images = new Dictionary<Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image, Resource>(25);
			_metafiles = new Dictionary<Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Metafile, Resource>(25);
		}

		public override void Process(Report report)
		{
			foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font font in report.Fonts)
			{
				AddFont(font);
			}
			foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image in report.Images)
			{
				AddImage(image);
			}
			foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush brush in report.Brushes)
			{
				ProcessBrush(brush);
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Section.Section section)
		{
			if (section.PageNumbering != null)
			{
				ProcessStyle(section.PageNumbering.Style);
			}
			if (section.LineNumbering != null)
			{
				ProcessStyle(section.LineNumbering.Style);
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Text text)
		{
			Style style = text.StyleResolved;
			ProcessStyle(style);
			if (text.LineNumbering != null)
			{
				ProcessStyle(text.LineNumbering.Style);
			}
			if (text.FirstLetter != null)
			{
				ProcessStyle(text.FirstLetter.Style);
			}
			foreach (Atom atom in text.Atoms)
			{
				if (style != atom.Style)
				{
					style = atom.Style;
					ProcessStyle(style);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Image image)
		{
			AddImage(image.Value);
		}

		public override void Process(Metafile metafile)
		{
			AddMetafile(metafile.Value);
		}

		public override void Process(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.List.List list)
		{
			ProcessStyle(list.Bullets.Style);
		}

		public override void Process(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickText.QuickText text)
		{
			AddFont(text.Font);
			ProcessBrush(text.Brush);
		}

		public override void Process(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.QuickList.QuickList list)
		{
			AddFont(list.Font);
			ProcessBrush(list.Brush);
		}

		public override void Process(TextCell cell)
		{
			AddFont(cell.Font);
			ProcessBrush(cell.Brush);
		}

		public override void Process(ImageCell cell)
		{
			AddImage(cell.Image);
		}

		public override void Process(Label label)
		{
			AddFont(label.Font);
			ProcessBrush(label.Brush);
		}

		public override void Process(Polygon polygon)
		{
			ProcessBrush(polygon.Brush);
		}

		public override void Process(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Shapes.Rectangle rectangle)
		{
			ProcessBrush(rectangle.Brush);
		}

		public override void Process(Ellipse ellipse)
		{
			ProcessBrush(ellipse.Brush);
		}

		public override void Process(Pie pie)
		{
			ProcessBrush(pie.Brush);
		}

		public override void Process(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Shapes.Path path)
		{
			ProcessBrush(path.Brush);
		}

		public override void Process(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.TOC.TOC toc)
		{
			foreach (Level level in toc.Levels)
			{
				ProcessStyle(level.Style);
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Index.Index index)
		{
			ProcessStyle(index.Alphabet.Style);
			foreach (IndexLevel level in index.Levels)
			{
				ProcessStyle(level.Style);
			}
		}

		private void AddFont(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font font)
		{
			if (font.Preferences.Embed)
			{
				ShortFontHashKey key = new ShortFontHashKey(font.Name, font.Style);
				if (!_fonts.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					Resource resource = new Resource(ResourceType.Font, _fonts.Count + 1, font.ToStream());
					_resources.Add(resource);
					_fonts.Add(key, resource);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddImage(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image)
		{
			if (image.Preferences.Embed && !_images.ContainsKey(image))
			{
				Resource resource = new Resource(ResourceType.Image, _images.Count + 1, image.ToStream());
				_resources.Add(resource);
				_images.Add(image, resource);
			}
		}

		private void AddMetafile(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Metafile metafile)
		{
			if (metafile.Preferences.Embed && !_metafiles.ContainsKey(metafile))
			{
				Resource resource = new Resource(ResourceType.Metafile, _metafiles.Count + 1, metafile.ToStream());
				_resources.Add(resource);
				_metafiles.Add(metafile, resource);
			}
		}

		private void ProcessBrush(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush brush)
		{
			switch (brush.Type)
			{
			case BrushType.Texture:
				AddImage(((Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.TextureBrush)brush).Image);
				break;
			case BrushType.TextureDirect:
				AddImage(((TextureDirectBrush)brush).Image);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void ProcessStyle(Style style)
		{
			AddFont(style.Font);
			ProcessBrush(style.Brush);
		}

		public Resource GetResource(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font font)
		{
			ShortFontHashKey key = new ShortFontHashKey(font.Name, font.Style);
			if (_fonts.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				return _fonts[key];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public Resource GetResource(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image)
		{
			if (_images.ContainsKey(image))
			{
				return _images[image];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public Resource GetResource(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Metafile metafile)
		{
			if (_metafiles.ContainsKey(metafile))
			{
				return _metafiles[metafile];
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal class HeadingCollector : Visitor
	{
		private HeadingCollection _headings;

		public HeadingCollection Headings => _headings;

		public HeadingCollector()
		{
			_headings = new HeadingCollection();
		}

		public override void Process(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Text text)
		{
			switch (text.Heading)
			{
			case TextHeading.H1:
				_headings.Add(new Heading(1, text));
				break;
			case TextHeading.H2:
				_headings.Add(new Heading(2, text));
				break;
			case TextHeading.H3:
				_headings.Add(new Heading(3, text));
				break;
			case TextHeading.H4:
				_headings.Add(new Heading(4, text));
				break;
			case TextHeading.H5:
				_headings.Add(new Heading(5, text));
				break;
			case TextHeading.H6:
				_headings.Add(new Heading(6, text));
				break;
			case TextHeading.H7:
				_headings.Add(new Heading(7, text));
				break;
			case TextHeading.H8:
				_headings.Add(new Heading(8, text));
				break;
			case TextHeading.H9:
				_headings.Add(new Heading(9, text));
				break;
			case TextHeading.Normal:
				break;
			}
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Bookmarks
{
	internal class Bookmark
	{
		private Bookmark _parent;

		private BookmarkLevel _level;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Text _text;

		private BookmarkCollection _content;

		public BookmarkCollection Content => _content;

		public BookmarkLevel Level => _level;

		public Bookmark Parent => _parent;

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Text Text => _text;

		public Bookmark()
		{
			_content = new BookmarkCollection();
		}

		public Bookmark(Bookmark parent, BookmarkLevel level, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Text text)
			: this()
		{
			_parent = parent;
			_level = level;
			_text = text;
		}

		public Bookmark AddBookmark(BookmarkLevel level, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Text text)
		{
			Bookmark bookmark = new Bookmark(this, level, text);
			_content.Add(bookmark);
			return bookmark;
		}

		public string GetTitle()
		{
			if (_text.Caption != null)
			{
				return _text.Caption;
			}
			CharBuffer charBuffer = new CharBuffer();
			foreach (Atom atom in _text.Atoms)
			{
				switch (atom.Type)
				{
				case AtomType.Char:
				{
					char c = ((Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Atoms.Char)atom).Value;
					if (c == '\n' || c == '\t')
					{
						c = ' ';
					}
					charBuffer.Add(c);
					break;
				}
				default:
					charBuffer.Add(' ');
					break;
				case AtomType.Target:
					break;
				}
			}
			return charBuffer.ToString();
		}
	}
	internal class BookmarkCollection : List<Bookmark>
	{
	}

	internal class Segment : DecoratedBlock, ISegment
	{
		private ContentAlignment _alignment;

		private bool _stretch;

		private SegmentHeaderCollection _headers;

		private SegmentFooterCollection _footers;

		private ElementCollection _content;

		private SegmentHeaderCollection _bodyHeaders;

		private SegmentFooterCollection _bodyFooters;

		private int _bodyCounter;

		private int _marker;

		private object parent;

		private static ContentAlignment DefaultAlignment = new ContentAlignment();

		public ContentAlignment Alignment
		{
			get
			{
				if (_alignment == null)
				{
					_alignment = new ContentAlignment();
				}
				return _alignment;
			}
			set
			{
				_alignment = value;
			}
		}

		internal ContentAlignment AlignmentResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (_alignment == null)
				{
					return DefaultAlignment;
				}
				return _alignment;
			}
		}

		public object Parent => parent;

		public bool Stretch
		{
			get
			{
				return _stretch;
			}
			set
			{
				_stretch = value;
			}
		}

		public override ElementType Type => ElementType.Segment;

		public Segment(Report report)
			: base(report)
		{
			_headers = new SegmentHeaderCollection();
			_footers = new SegmentFooterCollection();
			_content = new ElementCollection();
			_bodyHeaders = new SegmentHeaderCollection();
			_bodyFooters = new SegmentFooterCollection();
		}

		public IBand AddBand()
		{
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Band.Band band = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Band.Band(_report);
			_content.Add(band);
			band.InitializeParent(this);
			return band;
		}

		public ICanvas AddCanvas()
		{
			Canvas canvas = new Canvas(_report);
			_content.Add(canvas);
			canvas.InitializeParent(this);
			return canvas;
		}

		public IChain AddChain()
		{
			Chain chain = new Chain(_report);
			_content.Add(chain);
			chain.InitializeParent(this);
			return chain;
		}

		public ICondition AddCondition(IContainer container, bool fit)
		{
			if (container == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("container");
			}
			Container container2 = (Container)container;
			Condition condition = new Condition(_report, container2, fit);
			container2.Conditions.Add(condition);
			_content.Add(condition);
			return condition;
		}

		public IContainer AddContainer(string name)
		{
			if (name == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("name");
			}
			Container container = new Container(_report, name);
			_content.Add(container);
			container.InitializeParent(this);
			return container;
		}

			flow.InitializeParent(this);
			return flow;

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			Composition composition2 = null;
			Composition composition3 = null;
			Composition composition4 = null;
			Composition composition5 = null;
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					foreach (SegmentHeader header in _headers)
					{
						_bodyHeaders.Add(header);
					}
					foreach (SegmentFooter footer in _footers)
					{
						_bodyFooters.Add(footer);
					}
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
				{
					float num = ((_margins != null) ? (_margins.Top + _margins.Bottom) : 0f);
					if (composition.ResidualHeight < num)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Create:
					composition2 = new Composition();
					composition2.Parent = composition;
					if (_margins != null)
					{
						composition2.Left = composition.Scene.Left + _margins.Left;
						composition2.Top = composition.Scene.Top + composition.ActiveHeight + _margins.Top;
						composition2.Width = composition.Scene.Width - _margins.Left - _margins.Right;
						composition2.Height = composition.ResidualHeight - _margins.Top - _margins.Bottom;
					}
					else
					{
						composition2.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
						composition2.Top = composition.Scene.Top + composition.ActiveHeight;
						composition2.Width = composition.Scene.Width;
						composition2.Height = composition.ResidualHeight;
					}
					composition2.Borders = base.BordersResolved;
					composition2.Margins = _margins;
					composition2.Paddings = _paddings;
					composition2.Background = _background;
					composition2.ResetScene();
					if (mode == MeasureMode.Normal)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					}
					else
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Flush;
					}
					composition3 = new Composition();
					composition3.Parent = composition2;
					composition3.Left = composition2.Scene.Left;
					composition3.Top = composition2.Scene.Top;
					composition3.Width = composition2.Scene.Width;
					composition3.Height = composition2.Scene.Height;
					if (_bodyCounter < _bodyHeaders.Count)
					{
						SegmentHeader segmentHeader = _bodyHeaders[_bodyCounter];
						if (segmentHeader.Content.Count > 0)
						{
							if (segmentHeader.Repeat)
							{
								_bodyHeaders.Add(segmentHeader);
							}
							composition4 = new Composition();
							composition4.Parent = composition2;
							composition4.Fake = true;
							composition4.Left = composition2.Scene.Left;
							composition4.Top = composition2.Scene.Top;
							composition4.Width = composition2.Scene.Width;
							composition4.Height = composition2.Scene.Height;
							composition4.ResetScene();
							segmentHeader.Reset();
							segmentHeader.Measure(composition4, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
							if (composition4.ResidualHeight > 0f)
							{
								composition4.Height -= composition4.ResidualHeight;
							}
							composition3.Height -= composition4.Height;
						}
					}
					if (_bodyCounter < _bodyFooters.Count)
					{
						SegmentFooter segmentFooter = _bodyFooters[_bodyCounter];
						if (segmentFooter.Content.Count > 0)
						{
							if (segmentFooter.Repeat)
							{
								_bodyFooters.Add(segmentFooter);
							}
							composition5 = new Composition();
							composition5.Parent = composition2;
							composition5.Fake = true;
							composition5.Left = composition2.Scene.Left;
							composition5.Top = composition2.Scene.Top;
							composition5.Width = composition2.Scene.Width;
							composition5.Height = composition2.Scene.Height;
							composition5.ResetScene();
							segmentFooter.Reset();
							segmentFooter.Measure(composition5, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
							if (composition5.ResidualHeight > 0f)
							{
								composition5.Height -= composition5.ResidualHeight;
							}
							composition3.Height -= composition5.Height;
						}
					}
					composition3.ResetScene();
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
				{
					bool flag = false;
					bool flag2 = _freshBreak;
					int num2 = _marker;
					int count2 = _content.Count;
					while (!flag && num2 < count2)
					{
						Element element2 = _content[num2];
						MeasureResult measureResult = element2.Measure(composition3, graphics, MeasureMode.Normal);
						if (measureResult != MeasureResult.Ok)
						{
							if (flag2 && measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
							{
								element2.Measure(composition3, graphics, MeasureMode.Flush);
								num2++;
								if (num2 < count2)
								{
									flag = true;
								}
								continue;
							}
							if (_marker == num2 && measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
							{
								_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
								return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
							}
							if (measureResult == MeasureResult.PageBreak)
							{
								num2++;
							}
							flag = true;
						}
						else
						{
							num2++;
							flag2 = false;
						}
					}
					if (composition3.Content.Count != 0)
					{
						composition.Content.Add(composition2);
						_bodyCounter++;
						if (composition4 != null)
						{
							composition2.Content.Add(composition4);
							composition4.Parent = composition2;
							composition4.Top = composition2.Scene.Top + composition2.ActiveHeight;
							composition2.ActiveHeight += composition4.Height;
						}
						composition2.Content.Add(composition3);
						composition3.Parent = composition2;
						if (!_stretch && composition3.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							composition3.Height -= composition3.ResidualHeight;
						}
						composition3.Top = composition2.Scene.Top + composition2.ActiveHeight;
						composition2.ActiveHeight += composition3.Height;
						composition3.ResetScene();
						Composition.AlignHorizontal(composition3, AlignmentResolved, Layout.Vertical);
						Composition.AlignVertical(composition3, AlignmentResolved, Layout.Vertical);
						if (composition5 != null)
						{
							composition2.Content.Add(composition5);
							composition5.Parent = composition2;
							composition5.Top = composition2.Scene.Top + composition2.ActiveHeight;
							composition2.ActiveHeight += composition5.Height;
						}
						if (composition2.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							composition2.Height -= composition2.ResidualHeight;
						}
						composition.ActiveHeight += composition2.Height;
						if (_margins != null)
						{
							composition.ActiveHeight += _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
						}
					}
					_marker = num2;
					if (flag)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.ContentBreak;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Flush:
				{
					int i = _marker;
					for (int count = _content.Count; i < count; i++)
					{
						Element element = _content[i];
						element.Measure(composition3, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
					}
					composition.Content.Add(composition2);
					_bodyCounter++;
					if (composition4 != null)
					{
						composition2.Content.Add(composition4);
						composition4.Parent = composition2;
						composition4.Top = composition2.Scene.Top + composition2.ActiveHeight;
						composition2.ActiveHeight += composition4.Height;
					}
					if (composition3.ResidualHeight > 0f)
					{
						composition3.Height -= composition3.ResidualHeight;
					}
					if (composition3.Height > 0f)
					{
						composition2.Content.Add(composition3);
						composition3.Parent = composition2;
						composition3.Top = composition2.Scene.Top + composition2.ActiveHeight;
						composition2.ActiveHeight += composition3.Height;
						composition3.ResetScene();
						Composition.AlignHorizontal(composition3, AlignmentResolved, Layout.Vertical);
						Composition.AlignVertical(composition3, AlignmentResolved, Layout.Vertical);
					}
					if (composition5 != null)
					{
						composition2.Content.Add(composition5);
						composition5.Parent = composition2;
						composition5.Top = composition2.Scene.Top + composition2.ActiveHeight;
						composition2.ActiveHeight += composition5.Height;
					}
					if (composition2.ResidualHeight > 0f)
					{
						composition2.Height -= composition2.ResidualHeight;
					}
					Margins marginsResolved = base.MarginsResolved;
					composition.ActiveHeight += composition2.Height + marginsResolved.Top + marginsResolved.Bottom;
					_marker = i;
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.End:
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			foreach (SegmentHeader header in _headers)
			{
				header.Process(visitor);
			}
			foreach (SegmentFooter footer in _footers)
			{
				footer.Process(visitor);
			}
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Process(visitor);
			}
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Reset();
			}
			_bodyHeaders.Clear();
			_bodyFooters.Clear();
			_bodyCounter = 0;
			_marker = 0;
			base.Reset();
		}
	}

	public class Tab
	{
		private float _offset;

		private LeaderFormat _leader;

		public LeaderFormat Leader
		{
			get
			{
				return _leader;
			}
			set
			{
				_leader = value;
			}
		}

		public float Offset
		{
			get
			{
				return _offset;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value <= 0f)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("offset", "(0.0, ...]");
				}
				_offset = value;
			}
		}

		public Tab(float offset)
			: this(offset, LeaderFormat.Spaces)
		{
		}

		public Tab(float offset, LeaderFormat leader)
		{
			if (offset <= 0f)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("offset", "(0.0, ...]");
			}
			_offset = offset;
			_leader = leader;
		}
	}
	public class Tabs
	{
		private Tab _default;

		private TabCollection _content;

		internal TabCollection Content => _content;

		public Tab Default => _default;

		public Tabs()
		{
			_default = new Tab(35f);
			_content = new TabCollection();
		}

		public Tab AddTab(float offset)
		{
			Tab tab = new Tab(offset);
			_content.Add(tab);
			return tab;
		}

		public Tab AddTab(float offset, LeaderFormat leader)
		{
			if (offset <= 0f)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("offset", "(0.0, ...]");
			}
			Tab tab = new Tab(offset, leader);
			_content.Add(tab);
			return tab;
		}

		internal Tab GetTab(float x)
		{
			foreach (Tab item in _content)
			{
				if (x < item.Offset)
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			float num;
			for (num = _default.Offset; x >= num; num += _default.Offset)
			{
			}
			return new Tab(num, _default.Leader);
		}
	}

	public class ShortStyleHashKey
	{
		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font _font;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush _brush;

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush Brush => _brush;

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font Font => _font;

		public ShortStyleHashKey(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font font, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush brush)
		{
			if (font == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("font");
			}
			if (brush == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("brush");
			}
			_font = font;
			_brush = brush;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object key)
		{
			if (key == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (key == this)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (key is ShortStyleHashKey)
			{
				ShortStyleHashKey shortStyleHashKey = (ShortStyleHashKey)key;
				if (_font == shortStyleHashKey.Font && _brush == shortStyleHashKey.Brush)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _font.GetHashCode() ^ _brush.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	public class StyleHashKey
	{
		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font _font;

		private FontVariant _fontVariant;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush _brush;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush _highlight;

		private float _charSpacing;

		private float _wordSpacing;

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush Brush => _brush;

		public float CharSpacing => _charSpacing;

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font Font => _font;

		public FontVariant FontVariant => _fontVariant;

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush Highlight => _highlight;

		public float WordSpacing => _wordSpacing;

		public StyleHashKey(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font font, FontVariant fontVariant, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush brush, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush highlight, float charSpacing, float wordSpacing)
		{
			if (font == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("font");
			}
			if (brush == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("brush");
			}
			_font = font;
			_fontVariant = fontVariant;
			_brush = brush;
			_highlight = highlight;
			_charSpacing = charSpacing;
			_wordSpacing = wordSpacing;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object key)
		{
			if (key == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (key == this)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (key is StyleHashKey)
			{
				StyleHashKey styleHashKey = (StyleHashKey)key;
				if (_font == styleHashKey.Font && _fontVariant == styleHashKey.FontVariant && _brush == styleHashKey.Brush && _highlight == styleHashKey.Highlight && _charSpacing == styleHashKey.CharSpacing && _wordSpacing == styleHashKey.WordSpacing)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (_highlight != null)
			{
				return _font.GetHashCode() ^ _fontVariant.GetHashCode() ^ _brush.GetHashCode() ^ _highlight.GetHashCode() ^ _charSpacing.GetHashCode() ^ _wordSpacing.GetHashCode();
			}
			return _font.GetHashCode() ^ _fontVariant.GetHashCode() ^ _brush.GetHashCode() ^ _charSpacing.GetHashCode() ^ _wordSpacing.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	public class Style : SealableBase
	{
		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font _font;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font _smallFont;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font _smallCapsFont;

		private FontVariant _fontVariant;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush _brush;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush _highlight;

		private float _charSpacing;

		private float _wordSpacing;

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush Brush
		{
			get
			{
				return _brush;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_brush = value;
			}
		}

		public float CharSpacing
		{
			get
			{
				return _charSpacing;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_charSpacing = value;
			}
		}

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font Font
		{
			get
			{
				return _font;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				if (_font != value)
				{
					_font = value;
					_smallFont = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public FontVariant FontVariant
		{
			get
			{
				return _fontVariant;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_fontVariant = value;
			}
		}

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush Highlight
		{
			get
			{
				return _highlight;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_highlight = value;
			}
		}

		public float WordSpacing
		{
			get
			{
				return _wordSpacing;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_wordSpacing = value;
			}
		}

		public Style(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font font, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush brush)
		{
			if (font == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("font");
			}
			if (brush == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("brush");
			}
			_font = font;
			_fontVariant = FontVariant.Normal;
			_brush = brush;
		}

		internal Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font GetFont()
		{
			switch (_fontVariant)
			{
			case FontVariant.Normal:
			case FontVariant.AllCaps:
				return _font;
			case FontVariant.Subscript:
			case FontVariant.Superscript:
				if (_smallFont == null)
				{
					_smallFont = _font.Resize(_font.Size * 0.58f);
				}
				return _smallFont;
			case FontVariant.SmallCaps:
				if (_smallCapsFont == null)
				{
					_smallCapsFont = _font.Resize(_font.Size * 0.75f);
				}
				return _smallCapsFont;
			default:
				return _font;
			}
		}

		public ShortStyleHashKey GetShortHashKey()
		{
			return new ShortStyleHashKey(_font, _brush);
		}

		public StyleHashKey GetHashKey()
		{
			return new StyleHashKey(_font, _fontVariant, _brush, _highlight, _charSpacing, _wordSpacing);
		}

		public override void Seal()
		{
			base.Seal();
			Font.Seal();
			Brush.Seal();
		}

		internal override bool VerifyMembersSealed()
		{
			if (Font.IsSealed)
			{
				return Brush.IsSealed;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public Style Clone()
		{
			return new Style(Font.Clone(), Brush.Clone());
		}
	}

	internal class HTMLReader
	{
		private static Dictionary<string, short> _symbols;

		private static int[] _fontSizes;

		private Dictionary<Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush> _brushHash;

		private Dictionary<Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontHashKey, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font> _fontHash;

		private Dictionary<ShortStyleHashKey, Style> _styleHash;

		private int _baseFontSize;

		static HTMLReader()
		{
			_fontSizes = new int[8] { 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 18, 24, 36 };
			_symbols = new Dictionary<string, short>(10);
			_symbols.Add("b", 1);
			_symbols.Add("i", 2);
			_symbols.Add("u", 3);
			_symbols.Add("font", 4);
			_symbols.Add("a", 5);
			_symbols.Add("br", 6);
			_symbols.Add("p", 7);
			_symbols.Add("img", 8);
		}

		public HTMLReader()
		{
			_brushHash = new Dictionary<Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush>(25);
			_fontHash = new Dictionary<Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontHashKey, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font>(25);
			_styleHash = new Dictionary<ShortStyleHashKey, Style>(25);
			_baseFontSize = 3;
		}

		public void Read(Text text, string content, bool normalize)
		{
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font font = text.StyleResolved.Font;
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush brush = text.StyleResolved.Brush;
			string text2 = font.Name;
			float num = font.Size;
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle fontStyle = font.Style;
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color color = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Colors.Black;
			if (brush.Type == BrushType.SolidColor)
			{
				color = ((SolidColorBrush)brush).Color;
			}
			Style style = GetStyle(GetFont(text2, num, fontStyle, font.Preferences), GetBrush(color));
			Hyperlink hyperlink = null;
			Stack<FontState> stack = new Stack<FontState>();
			StringReader stringReader = new StringReader(content);
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.HTML.Reader reader = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.HTML.Reader(stringReader);
			bool flag = true;
			while (true)
			{
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.HTML.Element element = reader.Next();
				if (element == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				switch (element.Type)
				{
				case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.HTML.ElementType.Content:
				{
					string text3 = ((Content)element).Text;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3))
					{
						text.AddContent(text3, style, hyperlink);
						flag = false;
					}
					break;
				}
				case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.HTML.ElementType.WhiteSpace:
					if (!flag)
					{
						text.AddContent(' ', style, hyperlink);
						flag = true;
					}
					break;
				case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.HTML.ElementType.StartTag:
				{
					StartTag startTag = (StartTag)element;
					string key2 = startTag.Name.ToLower();
					if (!_symbols.ContainsKey(key2))
					{
						break;
					}
					switch (_symbols[key2])
					{
					case 1:
						fontStyle |= Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Bold;
						style = GetStyle(GetFont(text2, num, fontStyle, font.Preferences), style.Brush);
						break;
					case 2:
						fontStyle |= Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Italic;
						style = GetStyle(GetFont(text2, num, fontStyle, font.Preferences), style.Brush);
						break;
					case 3:
						fontStyle |= Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Underline;
						style = GetStyle(GetFont(text2, num, fontStyle, font.Preferences), style.Brush);
						break;
					case 4:
						stack.Push(new FontState(text2, num, color));
						text2 = startTag.GetAttribute("face", text2);
						text2 = startTag.GetAttribute("name", text2);
						if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2) || text2 == "Symbol" || text2 == "System")
						{
							text2 = "Arial";
						}
						try
						{
							string attribute4 = startTag.GetAttribute("size", (string)null);
							if (attribute4 != null)
							{
								switch (attribute4[0])
								{
								case '+':
									if (attribute4.Length > 1)
									{
										attribute4 = attribute4.Substring(1, attribute4.Length - 1);
										num = ((!normalize) ? (num + (float)Convert.ToDouble(attribute4, Converter.NumberFormatInfo)) : ((float)(_baseFontSize + (int)Convert.ToDouble(attribute4, Converter.NumberFormatInfo))));
									}
									break;
								case '-':
									if (attribute4.Length > 1)
									{
										attribute4 = attribute4.Substring(1, attribute4.Length - 1);
										num = ((!normalize) ? (num - (float)Convert.ToDouble(attribute4, Converter.NumberFormatInfo)) : ((float)(_baseFontSize - (int)Convert.ToDouble(attribute4, Converter.NumberFormatInfo))));
									}
									break;
								default:
									num = (float)Convert.ToDouble(attribute4, Converter.NumberFormatInfo);
									break;
								}
								if (normalize)
								{
									if (num < 0f)
									{
										num = 0f;
									}
									if (num > 7f)
									{
										num = 7f;
									}
									num = _fontSizes[(int)num];
								}
								else if (num <= 0f)
								{
									num = 12f;
								}
							}
						}
						catch
						{
						}
						color = startTag.GetAttribute("color", color);
						style = GetStyle(GetFont(text2, num, fontStyle, font.Preferences), GetBrush(color));
						break;
					case 5:
					{
						string attribute3 = startTag.GetAttribute("href", (string)null);
						if (attribute3 != null)
						{
							hyperlink = new Hyperlink(attribute3);
						}
						break;
					}
					case 6:
						text.AddContent("\n", style, hyperlink);
						flag = true;
						break;
					case 7:
						text.AddContent("\n", style, hyperlink);
						flag = true;
						break;
					case 8:
						try
						{
							string attribute = startTag.GetAttribute("src", (string)null);
							if (attribute != null)
							{
								Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image = null;
								image = ((text.Report.PathResolver == null) ? new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image(attribute) : new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image(text.Report.PathResolver.Resolve(attribute)));
								float width = Converter.PixelsToPoints(startTag.GetAttribute("width", image.Width));
								float height = Converter.PixelsToPoints(startTag.GetAttribute("height", image.Height));
								ImageAlignment alignment = ImageAlignment.Bottom;
								string attribute2 = startTag.GetAttribute("align", "bottom");
								if (attribute2 == "top")
								{
									alignment = ImageAlignment.Top;
								}
								if (attribute2 == "middle")
								{
									alignment = ImageAlignment.Middle;
								}
								if (attribute2 == "bottom")
								{
									alignment = ImageAlignment.Bottom;
								}
								if (attribute2 == "left")
								{
									alignment = ImageAlignment.Left;
								}
								if (attribute2 == "right")
								{
									alignment = ImageAlignment.Right;
								}
								if (image.GetPhotoFactor() < 25f)
								{
									image.Preferences.Compressor = ImageCompressors.Flate;
								}
								text.AddContent(image, new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Size(width, height), alignment, hyperlink);
							}
							flag = false;
						}
						catch
						{
						}
						break;
					}
					break;
				}
				case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.HTML.ElementType.EndTag:
				{
					EndTag endTag = (EndTag)element;
					string key = endTag.Name.ToLower();
					if (!_symbols.ContainsKey(key))
					{
						break;
					}
					switch (_symbols[key])
					{
					case 1:
						fontStyle &= ~Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Bold;
						style = GetStyle(GetFont(text2, num, fontStyle, font.Preferences), style.Brush);
						break;
					case 2:
						fontStyle &= ~Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Italic;
						style = GetStyle(GetFont(text2, num, fontStyle, font.Preferences), style.Brush);
						break;
					case 3:
						fontStyle &= ~Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Underline;
						style = GetStyle(GetFont(text2, num, fontStyle, font.Preferences), style.Brush);
						break;
					case 4:
						if (stack.Count > 0)
						{
							FontState fontState = stack.Pop();
							text2 = fontState.Name;
							num = fontState.Size;
							color = fontState.Color;
							style = GetStyle(GetFont(text2, num, fontStyle, font.Preferences), GetBrush(color));
						}
						break;
					case 5:
						hyperlink = null;
						break;
					}
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			stringReader.Close();
		}

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush GetBrush(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color color)
		{
			if (_brushHash.ContainsKey(color))
			{
				return _brushHash[color];
			}
			SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush = new SolidColorBrush(color);
			_brushHash.Add(color, solidColorBrush);
			return solidColorBrush;
		}

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font GetFont(string name, float size, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle style)
		{
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontHashKey key = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontHashKey(name, size, style);
			if (_fontHash.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				return _fontHash[key];
			}
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font font = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font(name, size, style);
			_fontHash.Add(key, font);
			return font;
		}

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font GetFont(string name, float size, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle style, FontPreferences fontPreferences)
		{
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontHashKey key = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontHashKey(name, size, style);
			if (_fontHash.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				return _fontHash[key];
			}
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font font = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font(name, size, style);
			if (fontPreferences != null)
			{
				font.Preferences = fontPreferences;
			}
			_fontHash.Add(key, font);
			return font;
		}

		private Style GetStyle(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font font, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush brush)
		{
			ShortStyleHashKey key = new ShortStyleHashKey(font, brush);
			if (_styleHash.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				return _styleHash[key];
			}
			Style style = new Style(font, brush);
			_styleHash.Add(key, style);
			return style;
		}
	}

	internal class Text : DecoratedBlock, IText
	{
		private class Marker
		{
			private int _unitIndex;

			private int _lineIndex;

			public int LineIndex
			{
				get
				{
					return _lineIndex;
				}
				set
				{
					_lineIndex = value;
				}
			}

			public int UnitIndex
			{
				get
				{
					return _unitIndex;
				}
				set
				{
					_unitIndex = value;
				}
			}

			public Marker()
			{
			}

			public Marker(int unitIndex, int lineIndex)
			{
				_unitIndex = unitIndex;
				_lineIndex = lineIndex;
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				_unitIndex = 0;
				_lineIndex = 0;
			}
		}

		private static Style _defaultStyle = new Style(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font("Arial", 12f), new SolidColorBrush(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Colors.Black));

		private static HTMLReader _htmlReader = new HTMLReader();

		public void AddContent(string text, Style style, Hyperlink hyperlink)
		{
			if (text == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("text");
			}
			if (style == null)
			{
				style = StyleResolved;
			}
			text = text.Replace("\r\n", "\r");
			char[] unicodeSafeCharArray = Utilities.GetUnicodeSafeCharArray(text);
			char[] array = unicodeSafeCharArray;
			foreach (char value in array)
			{
				_atoms.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Atoms.Char(value, style, hyperlink));
			}
		}

		public void AddContent(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Size size, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Indents indents, ImageAlignment alignment, Hyperlink hyperlink)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("image");
			}
			if (size == null)
			{
				size = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Size(Converter.PixelsToPoints(image.Width), Converter.PixelsToPoints(image.Height));
			}
			if (indents == null)
			{
				indents = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Indents();
			}
			_atoms.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Atoms.Image(image, size, indents, alignment, hyperlink));
		}
