		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Projection.Destination GetDestination()
		{
			return new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Projection.Destination(_firstBody.Page, 0f, _firstBody.ClientToView(0f, 0f).Y + _firstBody.Scene.Top);
		}

		public override Bounds GetBounds(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			float num3 = ((_margins != null) ? (_margins.Left + _margins.Right) : 0f);
			switch (_width.Type)
			{
			case WidthType.Fixed:
				num = ((FixedWidth)_width).Value;
				num2 = num;
				break;
			case WidthType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeWidth relativeWidth = (RelativeWidth)_width;
				num2 = composition.Scene.Width - num3;
				num2 *= relativeWidth.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeWidth.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num);
					num2 = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num2);
				}
				break;
			}
			case WidthType.Max:
				num2 = composition.Scene.Width - num3;
				break;
			case WidthType.Auto:
			{
				if (_units == null)
				{
					_units = ComposeUnits(this, composition, graphics);
				}
				float num4 = 0f;
				float num5 = 0f;
				foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Unit unit in _units)
				{
					if (unit.Type == Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.UnitType.Separator && ((ISeparator)unit).Type == SeparatorType.EOL)
					{
						if (num < num4)
						{
							num = num4;
						}
						if (num2 < num5)
						{
							num2 = num5;
						}
						num4 = 0f;
						num5 = 0f;
					}
					else
					{
						float width = unit.Width;
						if (num4 < width)
						{
							num4 = width;
						}
						num5 += width;
					}
				}
				if (num < num4)
				{
					num = num4;
				}
				if (num2 < num5)
				{
					num2 = num5;
				}
				if (_paddings != null)
				{
					num3 += _paddings.Left + _paddings.Right;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasLeft && base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen != null)
				{
					num3 += base.BordersResolved.Left.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				if (base.BordersResolved.HasRight && base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen != null)
				{
					num3 += base.BordersResolved.Right.Pen.Width / 2f;
				}
				if (num2 > composition.Scene.Width - num3)
				{
					num2 = composition.Scene.Width - num3;
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			return new Bounds((float)Math.Ceiling(num + num3), (float)Math.Ceiling(num2 + num3));
		}

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			TextComposition textComposition = null;
			float num = 0f;
			switch (_width.Type)
			{
			case WidthType.Fixed:
				num = ((FixedWidth)_width).Value;
				break;
			case WidthType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeWidth relativeWidth = (RelativeWidth)_width;
				num = composition.Scene.Width;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
				num *= relativeWidth.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeWidth.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num);
				}
				break;
			}
			case WidthType.Max:
				num = composition.Scene.Width;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
				break;
			case WidthType.Auto:
				num = GetBounds(composition, graphics).Fit(composition.Scene.Width);
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (num < 0f)
			{
				num = 0f;
			}
			float num2 = 65535f;
			switch (_height.Type)
			{
			case HeightType.Fixed:
				num2 = ((FixedHeight)_height).Value;
				break;
			case HeightType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeHeight relativeHeight = (RelativeHeight)_height;
				num2 = composition.ResidualHeight;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num2 -= _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
				}
				num2 *= relativeHeight.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeHeight.Constraint != null)
				{
					num2 = relativeHeight.Constraint.Apply(num2);
				}
				break;
			}
			case HeightType.Max:
				num2 = composition.ResidualHeight;
				if (_margins != null)
				{
					num2 -= _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
				}
				break;
			case HeightType.Auto:
				if (mode != MeasureMode.MasterFlush)
				{
					num2 = composition.ResidualHeight;
					if (_margins != null)
					{
						num2 -= _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			if (num2 < 0f)
			{
				num2 = 0f;
			}
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					if (_state != MeasureState.End && _units == null)
					{
						_units = ComposeUnits(this, composition, graphics);
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
				{
					float num3 = ((_margins != null) ? (_margins.Top + _margins.Bottom) : 0f);
					if (_height.Type != HeightType.Auto)
					{
						num3 += num2;
					}
					if (composition.ResidualHeight < num3)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Create:
					textComposition = new TextComposition(this);
					textComposition.Parent = composition;
					textComposition.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
					textComposition.Top = composition.Scene.Top;
					textComposition.Width = num;
					textComposition.Height = num2;
					textComposition.Margins = _margins;
					textComposition.Borders = base.BordersResolved;
					textComposition.Paddings = _paddings;
					textComposition.Background = _background;
					textComposition.FirstLineIndex = _marker.LineIndex;
					if (_panel == null)
					{
						if (_margins != null)
						{
							textComposition.Left += _margins.Left;
							textComposition.Top += composition.ActiveHeight + _margins.Top;
						}
						else
						{
							textComposition.Top += composition.ActiveHeight;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						PropertyCollection propertyCollection = _panel.AttachedProperties[this];
						textComposition.Left += propertyCollection.GetValue("Left", 0f);
						textComposition.Top += propertyCollection.GetValue("Top", 0f);
						textComposition.RotationAngle = propertyCollection.GetValue("Angle", 0f);
					}
					textComposition.ResetScene();
					if (mode == MeasureMode.Normal && _height.Type == HeightType.Auto)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					}
					else
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Flush;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
				{
					bool flag = false;
					Marker marker = new Marker(_marker.UnitIndex, _marker.LineIndex);
					if (_keepSolid)
					{
						switch (ComposeBody(textComposition, graphics, _units, _frames, IndentsResolved, TabsResolved, _interval, marker, flush: false))
						{
						case MeasureResult.BreakBefore:
							_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
							return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
						case MeasureResult.ContentBreak:
							if (!_freshBreak)
							{
								_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
								return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
							}
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						MeasureResult measureResult = ComposeBody(textComposition, graphics, _units, _frames, IndentsResolved, TabsResolved, _interval, marker, flush: false);
						if (measureResult != MeasureResult.Ok)
						{
							if (_freshBreak && measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
							{
								textComposition.Lines.Clear();
								ComposeBody(textComposition, graphics, _units, _frames, IndentsResolved, TabsResolved, _interval, marker, flush: true);
							}
							else
							{
								if (measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
								{
									_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
									return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
								}
								flag = true;
							}
						}
					}
					composition.Content.Add(textComposition);
					if (_firstBody == null)
					{
						_firstBody = textComposition;
					}
					textComposition.FirstLineIndex = marker.LineIndex;
					marker.LineIndex += textComposition.Lines.Count;
					if (textComposition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
					{
						textComposition.Height -= textComposition.ResidualHeight;
					}
					textComposition.ResetScene();
					bool first = _marker.UnitIndex == 0;
					bool last = marker.UnitIndex == _units.Count;
					Align(textComposition, IndentsResolved, _interval, AlignmentResolved, first, last);
					if (_panel == null)
					{
						composition.ActiveHeight += textComposition.Height;
						if (_margins != null)
						{
							composition.ActiveHeight += _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
						}
					}
					if (_report.FileBuffer != null)
					{
						textComposition.Attach(_report.FileBuffer);
					}
					_marker = marker;
					if (flag)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.ContentBreak;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Flush:
				{
					Marker marker2 = new Marker(_marker.UnitIndex, _marker.LineIndex);
					ComposeBody(textComposition, graphics, _units, _frames, IndentsResolved, TabsResolved, _interval, marker2, flush: true);
					composition.Content.Add(textComposition);
					if (_firstBody == null)
					{
						_firstBody = textComposition;
					}
					textComposition.FirstLineIndex = marker2.LineIndex;
					marker2.LineIndex += textComposition.Lines.Count;
					if (_height.Type == HeightType.Auto && textComposition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
					{
						textComposition.Height -= textComposition.ResidualHeight;
					}
					textComposition.ResetScene();
					bool first2 = _marker.UnitIndex == 0;
					bool last2 = marker2.UnitIndex == _units.Count;
					Align(textComposition, IndentsResolved, _interval, AlignmentResolved, first2, last2);
					if (_panel == null)
					{
						composition.ActiveHeight += textComposition.Height;
						if (_margins != null)
						{
							composition.ActiveHeight += _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
						}
					}
					_marker = marker2;
					if (_report.FileBuffer != null)
					{
						textComposition.Attach(_report.FileBuffer);
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.End:
					if (_lineNumbering != null)
					{
						_firstLineNumber = _lineNumbering.First;
						_lastLineNumber = _firstLineNumber + _marker.LineIndex - 1;
					}
					_units = null;
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			_units = null;
			_frames.Clear();
			_firstBody = null;
			_marker.Reset();
			base.Reset();
		}

		private static void AdjustLine(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Line line, ImageCollection images)
		{
			if (images.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Image image in images)
			{
				if (num < image.Height)
				{
					num = image.Height;
				}
			}
			if (num < line.Ascent)
			{
				num = line.Ascent;
				num2 = line.Ascent;
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Image image2 in images)
				{
					float num3 = 0f;
					switch (image2.Alignment)
					{
					case ImageAlignment.Middle:
						num3 = (num + line.Ascent) / 2f;
						break;
					case ImageAlignment.Bottom:
						num3 = num;
						break;
					}
					if (num2 < num3)
					{
						num2 = num3;
					}
				}
			}
			float num4 = line.Height - line.Ascent;
			if (line.Ascent < num2)
			{
				line.Ascent = num2;
			}
			if (line.Height < num)
			{
				line.Height = num;
			}
			if (line.Ascent + num4 > line.Height)
			{
				line.Height = line.Ascent + num4;
			}
			foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Image image3 in images)
			{
				switch (image3.Alignment)
				{
				case ImageAlignment.Top:
					image3.Ascent = 0f;
					break;
				case ImageAlignment.Middle:
					image3.Ascent = (num - image3.Height) / 2f;
					break;
				case ImageAlignment.Bottom:
					image3.Ascent = num - image3.Height;
					break;
				}
				if (image3.Ascent < 0f)
				{
					image3.Ascent = 0f;
				}
			}
			images.Clear();
		}

		private static void Align(TextComposition body, Indents indents, float interval, TextAlignment alignment, bool first, bool last)
		{
			if (body.Frames.Count > 0 && ((IFrame)body.Frames[0]).Type == FrameType.Char)
			{
				first = false;
			}
			foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Line line in body.Lines)
			{
				foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Unit unit3 in line.Units)
				{
					unit3.ExtraWidth = 0f;
				}
			}
			float num = body.Scene.Width - indents.Left - indents.Right;
			switch (alignment.Horizontal)
			{
			case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Left:
				foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Line line2 in body.Lines)
				{
					line2.Indent = indents.Left;
					if (first)
					{
						line2.Indent += indents.First;
						first = false;
					}
				}
				break;
			case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Center:
				foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Line line3 in body.Lines)
				{
					line3.Indent = (num - line3.ActiveWidth) / 2f + indents.Left;
					if (first)
					{
						line3.Indent += indents.First;
						first = false;
					}
				}
				break;
			case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Right:
				foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Line line4 in body.Lines)
				{
					line4.Indent = num - line4.ActiveWidth + indents.Left;
					if (first)
					{
						line4.Indent += indents.First;
						first = false;
					}
				}
				break;
			case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Justify:
			{
				int num2 = body.Lines.Count;
				foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Line line5 in body.Lines)
				{
					num2--;
					if (!line5.Wrapped && (!last || num2 != 0))
					{
						Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.UnitCollection units = line5.Units;
						if (line5.LastTabIndex != -1)
						{
							int i = line5.LastTabIndex + 1;
							int num3 = line5.ActiveCount - 1;
							if (num3 - i > 0)
							{
								float extraWidth = (num - line5.ActiveWidth) / (float)(num3 - i);
								for (; i < num3; i++)
								{
									Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Unit unit = units[i];
									unit.ExtraWidth = extraWidth;
								}
							}
						}
						else
						{
							int num4 = line5.ActiveCount - 1;
							if (num4 > 0)
							{
								float extraWidth2 = (num - line5.ActiveWidth) / (float)num4;
								for (int j = 0; j < num4; j++)
								{
									Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Unit unit2 = units[j];
									unit2.ExtraWidth = extraWidth2;
								}
							}
						}
					}
					line5.Indent = indents.Left;
					if (first)
					{
						line5.Indent += indents.First;
						first = false;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			float num5 = body.ClientToView(0f, 0f).Y + body.Scene.Top;
			ProjectionPage page = body.Page;
			float num6 = 0f;
			foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Line line6 in body.Lines)
			{
				line6.Indent += GetLeftIndent(body.Frames, num6);
				foreach (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Target target in line6.Targets)
				{
					target.Destination.Page = page;
					target.Destination.Y = num5 + num6;
				}
				num6 += line6.Height + interval;
			}
			switch (alignment.Vertical)
			{
			case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Middle:
				body.OffsetY = body.ResidualHeight / 2f;
				break;
			case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Bottom:
				body.OffsetY = body.ResidualHeight;
				break;
			case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Top:
				break;
			}
		}

					frame5.Y = num5;
					body.Frames.Add(frame5);
					flag2 = false;
					num5 += frame5.Height;
					frames.RemoveAt(0);
				}
			}
			if (num8 < num4)
			{
				num8 = num4;
			}
			if (num8 < num5)
			{
				num8 = num5;
			}
			body.ActiveHeight = num8;
			return MeasureResult.Ok;
		}

		private static Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.UnitCollection ComposeUnits(Text text, Composition composition, IGraphics graphics)
		{
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.UnitCollection unitCollection = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.UnitCollection();
			char[] array = null;
			Style style = _defaultStyle;
			Hyperlink hyperlink = null;
			Style style2 = null;
			Style style3 = null;
			Style style4 = null;
			Hyperlink hyperlink2 = null;
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			float num3 = 0f;
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Word word = null;
			MixedWord mixedWord = null;
			MixedWord.Brick brick = null;
			bool flag = true;
			foreach (Atom atom in text.Atoms)
			{
				switch (atom.Type)
				{
				case AtomType.MergeCode:
				{
					MergeCode mergeCode = (MergeCode)atom;
					if (text.Report.Callback != null)
					{
						string text2 = text.Report.Callback.OnMergeCode(mergeCode.Name);
						if (text2 != null)
						{
							text2 = text2.Replace("\r\n", "\r");
							array = text2.ToCharArray();
						}
					}
					style = mergeCode.Style;
					hyperlink = mergeCode.Hyperlink;
					break;
				}
				case AtomType.DateTime:
				{
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Atoms.DateTime dateTime = (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Atoms.DateTime)atom;
					array = System.DateTime.Now.ToString(dateTime.Format).ToCharArray();
					style = dateTime.Style;
					hyperlink = dateTime.Hyperlink;
					break;
				}
				case AtomType.PageNumber:
				{
					PageNumber pageNumber = (PageNumber)atom;
					array = composition.Page.FormattedNumber(pageNumber.Format, "{0}").ToCharArray();
					style = pageNumber.Style;
					hyperlink = pageNumber.Hyperlink;
					break;
				}
				case AtomType.Leader:
				{
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Atoms.Leader leader = (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Atoms.Leader)atom;
					array = new char[1];
					switch (leader.Format)
					{
					case LeaderFormat.Dots:
						array[0] = '.';
						break;
					case LeaderFormat.Dashes:
						array[0] = '-';
						break;
					case LeaderFormat.Lines:
						array[0] = '_';
						break;
					case LeaderFormat.Spaces:
						array[0] = ' ';
						break;
					}
					style = leader.Style;
					hyperlink = leader.Hyperlink;
					break;
				}
				case AtomType.Target:
				{
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Atoms.Target target = (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Atoms.Target)atom;
					unitCollection.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Target(target.Value.Destination));
					style2 = null;
					hyperlink2 = null;
					word = null;
					break;
				}
				case AtomType.Char:
				{
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Atoms.Char obj = (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Atoms.Char)atom;
					if (flag)
					{
						FirstLetter firstLetter = text.FirstLetter;
						if (firstLetter != null)
						{
							graphics.Font = firstLetter.Style.Font;
							CharFrame charFrame = new CharFrame(firstLetter.Style, obj.Hyperlink, obj.Value, firstLetter.Indents);
							charFrame.Width = graphics.GetCharWidth(charFrame.Value) + firstLetter.Indents.Left + firstLetter.Indents.Right;
							charFrame.Height = graphics.FontMetrics.Height + firstLetter.Indents.Top + firstLetter.Indents.Bottom;
							unitCollection.Add(charFrame);
							style2 = null;
							hyperlink2 = null;
							word = null;
							break;
						}
					}
					array = new char[1] { obj.Value };
					style = obj.Style;
					hyperlink = obj.Hyperlink;
					break;
				}
				case AtomType.Image:
				{
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Atoms.Image image = (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Atoms.Image)atom;
					if (image.Alignment == ImageAlignment.Left || image.Alignment == ImageAlignment.Right)
					{
						ImageFrame imageFrame = ((image.Alignment != ImageAlignment.Left) ? new ImageFrame(image.Hyperlink, image.Value, image.Indents, FrameAlignment.Right) : new ImageFrame(image.Hyperlink, image.Value, image.Indents, FrameAlignment.Left));
						imageFrame.Width = image.Size.Width + image.Indents.Left + image.Indents.Right;
						imageFrame.Height = image.Size.Height + image.Indents.Top + image.Indents.Bottom;
						unitCollection.Add(imageFrame);
					}
					else
					{
						Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Image image2 = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Image(image.Hyperlink, image.Value, image.Indents, image.Alignment);
						image2.Width = image.Size.Width + image.Indents.Left + image.Indents.Right;
						image2.Height = image.Size.Height + image.Indents.Top + image.Indents.Bottom;
						unitCollection.Add(image2);
					}
					style2 = null;
					hyperlink2 = null;
					word = null;
					break;
				}
				}
				if (array != null)
				{
					bool flag2 = false;
					if (style2 != style)
					{
						style2 = style;
						flag2 = true;
						graphics.Font = style2.Font;
						graphics.CharSpacing = style2.CharSpacing;
						FontMetrics fontMetrics = graphics.FontMetrics;
						num = fontMetrics.Ascent;
						num2 = fontMetrics.Descent;
						num3 = fontMetrics.Height;
						if (style2.FontVariant == FontVariant.Subscript || style2.FontVariant == FontVariant.Superscript)
						{
							graphics.Font = style2.GetFont();
							if (style2.FontVariant == FontVariant.Subscript)
							{
								num = graphics.FontMetrics.Height - num2;
							}
						}
					}
					bool flag3 = false;
					if (hyperlink2 != hyperlink)
					{
						hyperlink2 = hyperlink;
						flag3 = true;
					}
					if (atom.Type == AtomType.Leader)
					{
						char ch = array[0];
						float charWidth = graphics.GetCharWidth(ch);
						Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Leader leader2 = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Leader(style2, hyperlink2, ch, charWidth);
						leader2.FixedWidth = charWidth * 3f;
						leader2.Height = num3;
						leader2.Ascent = num;
						unitCollection.Add(leader2);
						word = null;
					}
					else
					{
						bool flag4 = true;
						if (style2.FontVariant == FontVariant.SmallCaps)
						{
							style3 = new Style(style2.Font, style2.Brush);
							style3.CharSpacing = style2.CharSpacing;
							style3.WordSpacing = style2.WordSpacing;
							style4 = new Style(style2.GetFont(), style2.Brush);
							style4.CharSpacing = style2.CharSpacing;
							style4.WordSpacing = style2.WordSpacing;
							style2 = style3;
						}
						int num4 = array.Length;
						for (int i = 0; i < num4; i++)
						{
							char c = array[i];
							if (style.FontVariant == FontVariant.AllCaps)
							{
								c = char.ToUpper(c);
							}
							else if (style.FontVariant == FontVariant.SmallCaps)
							{
								if (char.IsLower(c))
								{
									c = char.ToUpper(c);
									if (flag4)
									{
										style2 = style4;
										flag2 = true;
										flag4 = false;
									}
								}
								else if (!flag4)
								{
									style2 = style3;
									flag2 = true;
									flag4 = true;
								}
								if (flag2)
								{
									graphics.Font = style2.Font;
									graphics.CharSpacing = style2.CharSpacing;
									FontMetrics fontMetrics2 = graphics.FontMetrics;
									num = fontMetrics2.Ascent;
									num2 = fontMetrics2.Descent;
									num3 = fontMetrics2.Height;
								}
							}
							float charWidth2 = graphics.GetCharWidth(c);
							Separator separator = null;
							switch (c)
							{
							case ' ':
								separator = new SpaceSeparator(style2, hyperlink2);
								if (style2.WordSpacing != 0f)
								{
									separator.Width = style2.WordSpacing;
								}
								else
								{
									separator.Width = charWidth2;
								}
								break;
							case '\t':
								separator = new TabSeparator(style2, hyperlink2);
								break;
							case '\n':
							case '\r':
								separator = new EOLSeparator(style2, hyperlink2);
								separator.Width = 10f;
								break;
							}
							if (separator != null)
							{
								separator.Height = num3;
								separator.Ascent = num;
								unitCollection.Add(separator);
								word = null;
							}
							else
							{
								if (word == null || flag2 || flag3)
								{
									if (word == null)
									{
										word = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Word(style2, hyperlink2);
										unitCollection.Add(word);
									}
									else
									{
										if (word.Type == Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.UnitType.Word)
										{
											mixedWord = new MixedWord(word.Style, word.Hyperlink, word.Text);
											mixedWord.Width = word.Width;
											mixedWord.Height = word.Height;
											mixedWord.Ascent = word.Ascent;
											brick = new MixedWord.Brick(word.Style, word.Hyperlink, word.Text.Clone());
											brick.Width = word.Width;
											brick.Height = word.Height;
											brick.Ascent = word.Ascent;
											mixedWord.Bricks.Add(brick);
											unitCollection.RemoveAt(unitCollection.Count - 1);
											unitCollection.Add(mixedWord);
										}
										else
										{
											mixedWord = (MixedWord)word;
										}
										brick = new MixedWord.Brick(style2, hyperlink2);
										brick.Height = num3;
										brick.Ascent = num;
										mixedWord.Bricks.Add(brick);
										word = mixedWord;
									}
									if (word.Ascent < num)
									{
										word.Ascent = num;
									}
									if (word.Height < num3)
									{
										word.Height = num3;
									}
								}
								word.Width += charWidth2;
								word.Text.Add(c);
								if (word.Type == Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.UnitType.MixedWord)
								{
									brick.Width += charWidth2;
									brick.Text.Add(c);
								}
							}
							flag2 = false;
							flag3 = false;
						}
					}
					array = null;
				}
				flag = false;
			}
			return unitCollection;
		}

		private static float GetLeftIndent(FrameCollection frames, float y)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			foreach (Frame frame in frames)
			{
				if (frame.Alignment == FrameAlignment.Left && y >= frame.Y && y < frame.Y + frame.Height && num < frame.Width)
				{
					num = frame.Width;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static float GetRightIndent(FrameCollection frames, float y)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			foreach (Frame frame in frames)
			{
				if (frame.Alignment == FrameAlignment.Right && y >= frame.Y && y < frame.Y + frame.Height && num < frame.Width)
				{
					num = frame.Width;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static float GetTotalIndent(FrameCollection frames, float y)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			foreach (Frame frame in frames)
			{
				if (!(y >= frame.Y) || !(y < frame.Y + frame.Height))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (frame.Alignment == FrameAlignment.Left)
				{
					if (num < frame.Width)
					{
						num = frame.Width;
					}
				}
				else if (num2 < frame.Width)
				{
					num2 = frame.Width;
				}
			}
			return num + num2;
		}

		private static void SplitWord(IGraphics graphics, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Word word, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Word wordStart, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Text.Blocks.Word wordEnd, float width, bool first)
		{
			graphics.Font = word.Style.GetFont();
			graphics.CharSpacing = word.Style.CharSpacing;
			bool flag = true;
			float num = 0f;
			foreach (char item in (IEnumerable<char>)word.Text)
			{
				float charWidth = graphics.GetCharWidth(item);
				if (flag)
				{
					num += charWidth;
					if (num <= width || first)
					{
						wordStart.Text.Add(item);
						wordStart.Width = num;
						first = false;
					}
					else
					{
						flag = false;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					wordEnd.Text.Add(item);
					wordEnd.Width += charWidth;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void SplitWord(IGraphics graphics, MixedWord word, MixedWord wordStart, MixedWord wordEnd, float width, bool first)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			float num = 0f;
			foreach (MixedWord.Brick brick3 in word.Bricks)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					if (num + brick3.Width <= width)
					{
						num += brick3.Width;
						wordStart.Bricks.Add(brick3);
						wordStart.Text.Add(brick3.Text);
						wordStart.Width = num;
						if (wordStart.Height < brick3.Height)
						{
							wordStart.Height = brick3.Height;
						}
						if (wordStart.Ascent < brick3.Ascent)
						{
							wordStart.Ascent = brick3.Ascent;
						}
						first = false;
						continue;
					}
					graphics.Font = brick3.Style.GetFont();
					graphics.CharSpacing = brick3.Style.CharSpacing;
					MixedWord.Brick brick = new MixedWord.Brick(brick3.Style, brick3.Hyperlink);
					brick.Height = brick3.Height;
					brick.Ascent = brick3.Ascent;
					wordStart.Bricks.Add(brick);
					MixedWord.Brick brick2 = new MixedWord.Brick(brick3.Style, brick3.Hyperlink);
					brick2.Height = brick3.Height;
					brick2.Ascent = brick3.Ascent;
					wordEnd.Bricks.Add(brick2);
					foreach (char item in (IEnumerable<char>)brick3.Text)
					{
						float charWidth = graphics.GetCharWidth(item);
						if (flag)
						{
							num += charWidth;
							if (num <= width || first)
							{
								wordStart.Text.Add(item);
								brick.Text.Add(item);
								wordStart.Width = num;
								brick.Width += charWidth;
								first = false;
							}
							else
							{
								flag = false;
							}
						}
						if (!flag)
						{
							wordEnd.Text.Add(item);
							brick2.Text.Add(item);
							wordEnd.Width += charWidth;
							brick2.Width += charWidth;
						}
					}
					if (wordStart.Height < brick.Height)
					{
						wordStart.Height = brick.Height;
					}
					if (wordStart.Ascent < brick.Ascent)
					{
						wordStart.Ascent = brick.Ascent;
					}
					if (wordEnd.Height < brick2.Height)
					{
						wordEnd.Height = brick2.Height;
					}
					if (wordEnd.Ascent < brick2.Ascent)
					{
						wordEnd.Ascent = brick2.Ascent;
					}
					flag = false;
				}
				else
				{
					wordEnd.Bricks.Add(brick3);
					wordEnd.Text.Add(brick3.Text);
					wordEnd.Width += brick3.Width;
					if (wordEnd.Ascent < brick3.Ascent)
					{
						wordEnd.Ascent = brick3.Ascent;
					}
					if (wordEnd.Height < brick3.Height)
					{
						wordEnd.Height = brick3.Ascent;
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	internal class QuickText : Block, IQuickText
	{
		private string _content;

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)
		{
			QuickTextComposition quickTextComposition = null;
			graphics.Font = _font;
			graphics.CharSpacing = 0f;
			while (true)
			{
				switch (_state)
				{
				case MeasureState.Start:
					_freshBreak = false;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					if (_state != MeasureState.End && _units == null)
					{
						_units = ComposeUnits(_content, graphics);
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;
					switch (mode)
					{
					case MeasureMode.Normal:
						_state = MeasureState.CheckOffset;
						break;
					case MeasureMode.Flush:
						if (composition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}
						else
						{
							_state = MeasureState.End;
						}
						break;
					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:
						_state = MeasureState.Create;
						break;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
				{
					float num = ((_margins != null) ? (_margins.Top + _margins.Bottom) : 0f);
					if (composition.ResidualHeight < num)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Create:
					quickTextComposition = new QuickTextComposition(_font, _brush);
					quickTextComposition.Fake = true;
					quickTextComposition.Parent = composition;
					if (_margins != null)
					{
						quickTextComposition.Left = composition.Scene.Left + _margins.Left;
						quickTextComposition.Top = composition.Scene.Top + composition.ActiveHeight + _margins.Top;
						quickTextComposition.Width = composition.Scene.Width - _margins.Left - _margins.Right;
						quickTextComposition.Height = composition.ResidualHeight - _margins.Top - _margins.Bottom;
					}
					else
					{
						quickTextComposition.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
						quickTextComposition.Top = composition.Scene.Top + composition.ActiveHeight;
						quickTextComposition.Width = composition.Scene.Width;
						quickTextComposition.Height = composition.ResidualHeight;
					}
					quickTextComposition.Margins = _margins;
					quickTextComposition.ResetScene();
					if (mode == MeasureMode.Normal)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Layout;
					}
					else
					{
						_state = MeasureState.Flush;
					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.Layout:
				{
					bool flag = false;
					int marker2 = _marker;
					if (_keepSolid)
					{
						switch (ComposeBody(quickTextComposition, graphics, _units, _indent, _interval, ref marker2, flush: false))
						{
						case MeasureResult.BreakBefore:
							_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
							return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
						case MeasureResult.ContentBreak:
							if (!_freshBreak)
							{
								_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
								return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
							}
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						MeasureResult measureResult = ComposeBody(quickTextComposition, graphics, _units, _indent, _interval, ref marker2, flush: false);
						if (measureResult != MeasureResult.Ok)
						{
							if (_freshBreak && measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
							{
								quickTextComposition.Lines.Clear();
								ComposeBody(quickTextComposition, graphics, _units, _indent, _interval, ref marker2, flush: true);
							}
							else
							{
								if (measureResult == MeasureResult.BreakBefore)
								{
									_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
									return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
								}
								flag = true;
							}
						}
					}
					composition.Content.Add(quickTextComposition);
					if (quickTextComposition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
					{
						quickTextComposition.Height -= quickTextComposition.ResidualHeight;
					}
					quickTextComposition.ResetScene();
					bool first2 = _marker == 0;
					bool last2 = marker2 == _units.Count;
					Align(quickTextComposition, _indent, _interval, _alignment.Horizontal, _alignment.Vertical, first2, last2);
					composition.ActiveHeight += quickTextComposition.Height;
					if (_margins != null)
					{
						composition.ActiveHeight += _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
					}
					if (_report.FileBuffer != null)
					{
						quickTextComposition.Attach(_report.FileBuffer);
					}
					_marker = marker2;
					if (flag)
					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.ContentBreak;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Flush:
				{
					int marker = _marker;
					ComposeBody(quickTextComposition, graphics, _units, _indent, _interval, ref marker, flush: true);
					composition.Content.Add(quickTextComposition);
					if (quickTextComposition.ResidualHeight > 0f)
					{
						quickTextComposition.Height -= quickTextComposition.ResidualHeight;
					}
					quickTextComposition.ResetScene();
					bool first = _marker == 0;
					bool last = marker == _units.Count;
					Align(quickTextComposition, _indent, _interval, _alignment.Horizontal, _alignment.Vertical, first, last);
					composition.ActiveHeight += quickTextComposition.Height;
					if (_margins != null)
					{
						composition.ActiveHeight += _margins.Top + _margins.Bottom;
					}
					_marker = marker;
					if (_report.FileBuffer != null)
					{
						quickTextComposition.Attach(_report.FileBuffer);
					}
					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.End:
					_units = null;
					return MeasureResult.Ok;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			_units = null;
			_marker = 0;
			base.Reset();
		}

		public static void Align(QuickTextComposition body, float indent, float interval, Alignment h, Alignment v, bool first, bool last)
		{
			foreach (Line line in body.Lines)
			{
				foreach (Unit unit2 in line.Units)
				{
					unit2.ExtraWidth = 0f;
				}
			}
			float width = body.Scene.Width;
			switch (h)
			{
			case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Left:
				foreach (Line line2 in body.Lines)
				{
					line2.Indent = 0f;
					if (first)
					{
						line2.Indent += indent;
						first = false;
					}
				}
				break;
			case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Center:
				foreach (Line line3 in body.Lines)
				{
					line3.Indent = (width - line3.ActiveWidth) / 2f;
					if (first)
					{
						line3.Indent += indent;
						first = false;
					}
				}
				break;
			case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Right:
				foreach (Line line4 in body.Lines)
				{
					line4.Indent = width - line4.ActiveWidth;
					if (first)
					{
						line4.Indent += indent;
						first = false;
					}
				}
				break;
			case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Justify:
			{
				int num = body.Lines.Count;
				foreach (Line line5 in body.Lines)
				{
					num--;
					if (!line5.Wrapped && (!last || num != 0))
					{
						UnitCollection units = line5.Units;
						int num2 = line5.ActiveCount - 1;
						if (num2 > 0)
						{
							float extraWidth = (width - line5.ActiveWidth) / (float)num2;
							for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
							{
								Unit unit = units[i];
								unit.ExtraWidth = extraWidth;
							}
						}
					}
					line5.Indent = 0f;
					if (first)
					{
						line5.Indent += indent;
						first = false;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			body.Interval = interval;
			switch (v)
			{
			case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Middle:
				body.OffsetY = body.ResidualHeight / 2f;
				break;
			case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Bottom:
				body.OffsetY = body.ResidualHeight;
				break;
			case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Justify:
			{
				int count = body.Lines.Count;
				if (count > 1)
				{
					body.Interval = (body.Scene.Height - body.LineHeight * (float)count) / (float)(count - 1);
				}
				break;
			}
			case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Report.Alignment.Top:
				break;
			}
		}

		public static MeasureResult ComposeBody(QuickTextComposition body, IGraphics graphics, UnitCollection units, float indent, float interval, ref int marker, bool flush)
		{
			float width = body.Scene.Width;
			Line line = new Line();
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = (body.LineHeight = graphics.FontMetrics.Height);
			int num3 = 0;
			int num4 = 0;
			bool flag = true;
			if (marker == 0)
			{
				num += indent;
			}
			line.ActiveWidth = num;
			int num5 = marker;
			int num6 = units.Count;
			while (num5 < num6)
			{
				Unit unit = units[num5];
				num += unit.Width;
				if (unit.Type == UnitType.Word)
				{
					if (num > width)
					{
						num -= unit.Width;
						bool flag2 = false;
						if (num3 == 0 || unit.Width > width)
						{
							Word word = (Word)unit;
							Word word2 = new Word();
							Word word3 = new Word();
							SplitWord(graphics, word, word2, word3, width - num, num3 == 0);
							if (word2.Width > 0f)
							{
								line.Units.Add(word2);
								num += word2.Width;
								line.ActiveWidth = num;
								num4 = num3;
							}
							units.RemoveAt(num5);
							units.Insert(num5, word2);
							if (word3.Width > 0f)
							{
								units.Insert(num5 + 1, word3);
								num6++;
							}
							flag2 = true;
						}
						line.ActiveCount = num4 + 1;
						if (!flush && body.ResidualHeight < num2)
						{
							if (flag2)
							{
								units.RemoveAt(num5);
								units.RemoveAt(num5);
								units.Insert(num5, unit);
							}
							if (flag)
							{
								return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
							}
							return MeasureResult.ContentBreak;
						}
						body.ActiveHeight += num2 + interval;
						body.Lines.Add(line);
						flag = false;
						line = new Line();
						num = 0f;
						num3 = 0;
						num4 = 0;
						if (flag2)
						{
							line.ActiveWidth = num;
							num5 = (marker = num5 + 1);
							continue;
						}
						if (num + unit.Width > width)
						{
							line.ActiveWidth = num;
							marker = num5 - 1;
							continue;
						}
						num = (line.ActiveWidth = num + unit.Width);
						marker = num5;
					}
					else
					{
						line.ActiveWidth = num;
						num4 = num3;
					}
				}
				line.Units.Add(unit);
				num3++;
				if (unit.Type == UnitType.EOL)
				{
					line.Wrapped = true;
					line.ActiveCount = num4 + 1;
					if (!flush && body.ResidualHeight < num2)
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
						}
						return MeasureResult.ContentBreak;
					}
					body.ActiveHeight += num2;
					if (num5 < num6 - 1)
					{
						body.ActiveHeight += interval;
					}
					body.Lines.Add(line);
					flag = false;
					line = new Line();
					num = 0f;
					marker = num5 + 1;
					num3 = 0;
					num4 = 0;
				}
				num5++;
			}
			if (line.Units.Count > 0)
			{
				line.ActiveCount = num4 + 1;
				if (!flush && body.ResidualHeight < num2)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					return MeasureResult.ContentBreak;
				}
				body.ActiveHeight += num2;
				body.Lines.Add(line);
				flag = false;
			}
			marker = num5;
			return MeasureResult.Ok;
		}

		public static UnitCollection ComposeUnits(string content, IGraphics graphics)
		{
			UnitCollection unitCollection = new UnitCollection();
			Word word = null;
			foreach (char c in content)
			{
				float charWidth = graphics.GetCharWidth(c);
				switch (c)
				{
				case '\t':
				case ' ':
				{
					Space space = new Space();
					space.Width = charWidth;
					unitCollection.Add(space);
					word = null;
					continue;
				}
				case '\n':
				case '\r':
				{
					EOL eOL = new EOL();
					eOL.Width = 10f;
					unitCollection.Add(eOL);
					word = null;
					continue;
				}
				}
				if (word == null)
				{
					word = new Word();
					unitCollection.Add(word);
				}
				word.Width += charWidth;
				word.Text.Add(c);
			}
			if (unitCollection.Count == 0)
			{
				unitCollection.Add(new Word());
				return unitCollection;
			}
			return unitCollection;
		}

		private static void SplitWord(IGraphics graphics, Word word, Word wordStart, Word wordEnd, float width, bool first)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			float num = 0f;
			foreach (char item in (IEnumerable<char>)word.Text)
			{
				float charWidth = graphics.GetCharWidth(item);
				if (flag)
				{
					num += charWidth;
					if (num <= width || first)
					{
						wordStart.Text.Add(item);
						wordStart.Width = num;
						first = false;
					}
					else
					{
						flag = false;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					wordEnd.Text.Add(item);
					wordEnd.Width += charWidth;
				}
			}
		}
	}

		public override Bounds GetBounds(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			float num3 = ((_margins != null) ? (_margins.Left + _margins.Right) : 0f);
			switch (_width.Type)
			{
			case WidthType.Fixed:
				num = ((FixedWidth)_width).Value;
				num2 = num;
				break;
			case WidthType.Relative:
			{
				RelativeWidth relativeWidth = (RelativeWidth)_width;
				num2 = composition.Scene.Width - num3;
				num2 *= relativeWidth.Value / 100f;
				if (relativeWidth.Constraint != null)
				{
					num = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num);
					num2 = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num2);
				}
				break;
			}
			case WidthType.Max:
				num2 = composition.Scene.Width - num3;
				break;
			case WidthType.Auto:
			{
				Bounds bounds = null;
				Width width = null;
				Width instance = AutoWidth.Instance;
				if (_header.Content.Count > 0)
				{
					width = _header.Width;
					_header.Width = instance;
					bounds = _header.GetBounds(composition, graphics);

		public override MeasureResult Measure(Composition composition, IGraphics graphics, MeasureMode mode)

				break;

				num = composition.Scene.Width;
				if (_margins != null)

					num -= _margins.Left + _margins.Right;
				}
				num *= relativeWidth.Value / 100f;

					num = relativeWidth.Constraint.Apply(num);

							_state = MeasureState.End;

					case MeasureMode.MasterFlush:

					}
					break;
				case MeasureState.FreshBreak:
					_freshBreak = true;

							_state = MeasureState.Create;
						}

							_state = MeasureState.End;

				case MeasureState.CheckOffset:
				{

					{
						_state = MeasureState.FreshBreak;
						return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;
					}
					_state = MeasureState.Create;
					break;
				}
				case MeasureState.Create:
					composition2 = new Composition();
					composition2.Parent = composition;
					composition2.Left = composition.Scene.Left;
					composition2.Top = composition.Scene.Top;
					composition2.Width = num;

					composition2.Paddings = _paddings;

						composition2.Left += propertyCollection.GetValue("Left", 0f);
						composition2.Top += propertyCollection.GetValue("Top", 0f);

					}
					composition2.ResetScene();
					if (mode == MeasureMode.Normal && _height.Type == HeightType.Auto)

					composition3.Parent = composition2;
					composition3.Left = composition2.Scene.Left;

					composition3.Width = composition2.Scene.Width;
					composition3.Height = composition2.Scene.Height;

						composition4 = new Composition();
						composition4.Parent = composition2;
						composition4.Fake = true;
						composition4.Left = composition2.Scene.Left;
						composition4.Top = composition2.Scene.Top;
						composition4.Width = composition2.Scene.Width;
						composition4.Height = composition2.Scene.Height;
						composition4.ResetScene();

						_header.Measure(composition4, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
						if (composition4.ResidualHeight > 0f)

							composition4.Height -= composition4.ResidualHeight;

					if (_footer.Content.Count > 0 && (_footer.Repeat || _state == MeasureState.Flush))

						composition5.Parent = composition2;

						composition5.Left = composition2.Scene.Left;
						composition5.Top = composition2.Scene.Top;
						composition5.Width = composition2.Scene.Width;
						composition5.Height = composition2.Scene.Height;
						composition5.ResetScene();
						_footer.Reset();
						_footer.Measure(composition5, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
						if (composition5.ResidualHeight > 0f)
						{
							composition5.Height -= composition5.ResidualHeight;
						}
						composition3.Height -= composition5.Height;
					}
					if (_divider.Content.Count > 0 && _state == MeasureState.Layout)

						composition6.Parent = composition2;
						composition6.Fake = true;

						composition3.Height -= composition6.Height;
					}

					bool flag = false;
					int num3 = _marker;

								composition5.Width = composition2.Scene.Width;

								composition5.ResetScene();

								_footer.Measure(composition5, graphics, MeasureMode.MasterFlush);
								if (composition5.ResidualHeight > 0f)

									composition5.Height -= composition5.ResidualHeight;
								}

								composition3.Scene.Height -= composition5.Height;
								if (composition3.Height < 0f)
								{
									composition3.Height = 0f;
								}
								if (composition3.Scene.Height < 0f)
								{
									composition3.Scene.Height = 0f;
								}
							}
							MeasureResult measureResult = element2.Measure(composition3, graphics, MeasureMode.Normal);
							switch (measureResult)
							{

									return MeasureResult.BreakBefore;

								flag = true;
								break;
							case MeasureResult.Ok:
							case MeasureResult.PageBreak:

								}

						}
					}

					_state = MeasureState.End;
					break;
				}

		public override void Process(Visitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Process(this);
			_header.Process(visitor);
			_footer.Process(visitor);
			_divider.Process(visitor);
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Process(visitor);
			}
			visitor.Exit(this);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			foreach (Element item in _content)
			{
				item.Reset();
			}
			_bodyCounter = 0;
			_marker = 0;
			base.Reset();
		}
	}

	public class Attribute
	{

		private string _value;

		public string Name
		{
			get
			{
				return _name;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_name = value;
			}
		}

		public string Value
		{
			get
			{
				return _value;
			}
			set
			{
				_value = value;
			}
		}

		public Attribute(string name)
			: this(name, null)
		{
		}

		public Attribute(string name, string value)
		{
			if (name == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("name");
			}
			_name = name;
			_value = value;
		}
	}
	public class AttributeCollection : List<Attribute>
	{
		private Dictionary<string, Attribute> _hash;

		public Attribute GetItem(string name)
		{
			if (name == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("name");
			}
			name = name.ToLower();
			if (_hash == null)
			{
				UpdateItems();
			}
			if (_hash.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				return _hash[name];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void UpdateItems()
		{
			_hash = new Dictionary<string, Attribute>(25);
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				Attribute current = enumerator.Current;
				string key = current.Name.ToLower();
				if (!_hash.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					_hash.Add(key, current);
				}
				else
				{
					_hash[key] = current;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public class NameScanner : Scanner
	{
		private string _name;

		public string Name => _name;

		public NameScanner(string name, char ch)
		{
			if (name == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("name");
			}
			_name = name;
			_ch = ch;
		}

		public override void Process(char ch)
		{
			if (!_active)
			{
				return;
			}
			_active = false;
			_accepted = false;
			char c = _name[_position];
			_position++;
			if (ch == c)
			{
				if (_position == _name.Length)
				{
					_accepted = true;
				}
				else
				{
					_active = true;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class NumberScanner : Scanner
	{
		private int _value;

		public override void Process(char ch)
		{
			if (_active)
			{
				_active = false;
				_accepted = false;
				if (_position == 0 && ch == '#')
				{
					_active = true;
				}
				if (char.IsDigit(ch))
				{
					_value *= 10;
					_value += Converter.ToDigit(ch, 10);
					_active = true;
				}
				if (_position > 1 && ch == ';')
				{
					_ch = (char)_value;
					_accepted = true;
				}
				_position++;
			}
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			_value = 0;
			base.Reset();
		}
	}
	public class Reader
	{
		private TextReader _reader;

		private ScannerCollection _escapes;

		private List<int> _buffer;

		private int _capacity;

		private int _position;

		public ScannerCollection Escapes => _escapes;

		public Reader(TextReader reader)
		{
			if (reader == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("reader");
			}
			_reader = reader;
			_escapes = new ScannerCollection();
			_escapes.Add(new NameScanner("amp;", '&'));
			_escapes.Add(new NameScanner("gt;", '>'));
			_escapes.Add(new NameScanner("lt;", '<'));
			_escapes.Add(new NameScanner("nbsp;", ' '));
			_escapes.Add(new NameScanner("tab;", '\t'));
			_escapes.Add(new NameScanner("quot;", '"'));
			_escapes.Add(new NameScanner("apos;", '\''));
			_escapes.Add(new NameScanner("cent;", '¢'));
			_escapes.Add(new NameScanner("pound;", '£'));
			_escapes.Add(new NameScanner("curren;", '¤'));
			_escapes.Add(new NameScanner("yen;", '¥'));
			_escapes.Add(new NameScanner("copy;", '©'));
			_escapes.Add(new NameScanner("acute;", '\u00b4'));
			_escapes.Add(new NameScanner("middot;", '·'));
			_escapes.Add(new NumberScanner());
			_buffer = new List<int>(25);
			_capacity = 25;
		}

		public Element Next()
		{
			switch (ReadChar())
			{
			case -1:
				return null;
			case 60:
				SkipWhiteSpaces();
				switch (ReadChar())
				{
				case -1:
					return null;
				case 47:
					return ReadEndTag();
				case 33:
					return ReadExclam();
				case 63:
					return ReadInstruction();
				default:
					UnreadChar();
					return ReadStartTag();
				}
			default:
				UnreadChar();
				return ReadContent();
			}
		}

		private static bool IsNameChar(int ch)
		{
			if ((ch >= 97 && ch <= 122) || (ch >= 65 && ch <= 90) || (ch >= 48 && ch <= 57) || ch == 95 || ch == 45 || ch == 46 || ch == 58)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsWhiteSpace(int ch)
		{
			if (ch == 32 || ch == 9 || ch == 13 || ch == 10)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private Attribute ReadAttribute()
		{
			string text = ReadName();
			if (text == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SkipWhiteSpaces();
			int num = ReadChar();
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Attribute result = null;
			if (num == 61)
			{
				SkipWhiteSpaces();
				num = ReadChar();
				if (num == -1)
				{
					return null;
				}
				string text2 = null;
				switch (num)
				{
				case 62:
					return null;
				case 34:
				case 39:
					text2 = ReadValue(num);
					break;
				default:
					UnreadChar();
					text2 = ReadValue();
					break;
				}
				if (text2 != null)
				{
					result = new Attribute(text, text2);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				UnreadChar();
				result = new Attribute(text);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private int ReadChar()
		{
			int num = -1;
			if (_position < _buffer.Count)
			{
				num = _buffer[_position];
				_position++;
			}
			else
			{
				num = _reader.Read();
				if (num != -1)
				{
					if (_position < _capacity)
					{
						_buffer.Add(num);
						_position++;
					}
					else
					{
						_buffer.RemoveAt(0);
						_buffer.Add(num);
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private Element ReadComment()
		{
			int num = ReadChar();
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CharBuffer charBuffer = new CharBuffer();
			do
			{
				if (num == 45)
				{
					switch (ReadChar())
					{
					case -1:
						return null;
					case 45:
					{
						int num2 = ReadChar();
						if (num2 == -1)
						{
							return null;
						}
						if (num2 != 62)
						{
							UnreadChar();
							goto default;
						}
						return new Comment(charBuffer.ToString());
					}
					default:
						UnreadChar();
						break;
					}
				}
				charBuffer.Add((char)num);
				num = ReadChar();
			}
			while (num != -1);
			return null;
		}

		private Element ReadContent()
		{
			int num = ReadChar();
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (IsWhiteSpace(num))
			{
				return new WhiteSpace((char)num);
			}
			CharBuffer charBuffer = new CharBuffer(15);
			while (!IsWhiteSpace(num))
			{
				switch (num)
				{
				case 38:
					charBuffer.Add(ReadEscape());
					goto IL_0042;
				default:
					charBuffer.Add((char)num);
					goto IL_0042;
				case 60:
					break;
				}
				break;
				IL_0042:
				num = ReadChar();
				if (num == -1)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			if (num != -1)
			{
				UnreadChar();
			}
			return new Content(charBuffer.ToString());
		}

		private Element ReadDeclaration()
		{
			int num = ReadChar();
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CharBuffer charBuffer = new CharBuffer();
			while (num != 62)
			{
				charBuffer.Add((char)num);
				num = ReadChar();
				if (num == -1)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			return new Declaration(charBuffer.ToString());
		}

		private char ReadEscape()
		{
			foreach (Scanner escape in _escapes)
			{
				escape.Reset();
			}
			bool flag = true;
			int num = 0;
			while (flag)
			{
				int num2 = ReadChar();
				if (num2 == -1)
				{
					break;
				}
				flag = false;
				num++;
				foreach (Scanner escape2 in _escapes)
				{
					escape2.Process(char.ToLower((char)num2));
					if (escape2.Accepted)
					{
						return escape2.Char;
					}
					if (escape2.Active)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
			}
			while (num > 0)
			{
				UnreadChar();
				num--;
			}
			return '&';
		}

		private Element ReadExclam()
		{
			switch (ReadChar())
			{
			case -1:
				return null;
			case 45:
				UnreadChar();
				return ReadComment();
			default:
				UnreadChar();
				return ReadDeclaration();
			}
		}

		private string ReadName()
		{
			int num = ReadChar();
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CharBuffer charBuffer = new CharBuffer();
			while (IsNameChar(num))
			{
				charBuffer.Add((char)num);
				num = ReadChar();
				if (num == -1)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			UnreadChar();
			if (charBuffer.Count > 0)
			{
				return charBuffer.ToString();
			}
			return null;
		}

		private Element ReadStartTag()
		{
			SkipWhiteSpaces();
			string text = ReadName();
			if (text == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			StartTag startTag = new StartTag(text);
			while (true)
			{
				SkipWhiteSpaces();
				switch (ReadChar())
				{
				case -1:
					return null;
				case 62:
					startTag.Attributes.UpdateItems();
					return startTag;
				case 47:
					startTag.Closed = true;
					continue;
				}
				UnreadChar();
				Attribute attribute = ReadAttribute();
				if (attribute != null)
				{
					startTag.Attributes.Add(attribute);
					continue;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		private Element ReadEndTag()
		{
			SkipWhiteSpaces();
			string text = ReadName();
			if (text == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SkipWhiteSpaces();
			if (ReadChar() != 62)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new EndTag(text);
		}

		private Element ReadInstruction()
		{
			int num = ReadChar();
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CharBuffer charBuffer = new CharBuffer();
			while (true)
			{
				switch (num)
				{
				case 63:
					switch (ReadChar())
					{
					case -1:
						return null;
					default:
						UnreadChar();
						goto IL_0032;
					case 62:
						break;
					}
					break;
				default:
					goto IL_0032;
				case 62:
					break;
				}
				break;
				IL_0032:
				charBuffer.Add((char)num);
				num = ReadChar();
				if (num == -1)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			return new Instruction(charBuffer.ToString());
		}

		private string ReadValue()
		{
			int num = ReadChar();
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CharBuffer charBuffer = new CharBuffer();
			while (!IsWhiteSpace(num) && num != 62)
			{
				charBuffer.Add((char)num);
				num = ReadChar();
				if (num == -1)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			UnreadChar();
			if (charBuffer.Count > 0)
			{
				return charBuffer.ToString();
			}
			return null;
		}

		private string ReadValue(int quote)
		{
			int num = ReadChar();
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CharBuffer charBuffer = new CharBuffer(15);
			while (num != quote)
			{
				if (IsWhiteSpace(num))
				{
					num = 32;
				}
				charBuffer.Add((char)num);
				num = ReadChar();
				if (num == -1)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			return charBuffer.ToString();
		}

		private void SkipWhiteSpaces()
		{
			int num = ReadChar();
			while (IsWhiteSpace(num))
			{
				num = ReadChar();
			}
			if (num != -1)
			{
				UnreadChar();
			}
		}

		private void UnreadChar()
		{
			_position--;
			if (_position < 0)
			{
				_position = 0;
			}
		}
	}

	internal class Hyperlink
	{
		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Rectangle _rectangle;

		private Action _action;

		public Action Action => _action;

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Rectangle Rectangle => _rectangle;

		public Hyperlink(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Rectangle rectangle, Action action)
		{
			if (rectangle == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("rectangle");
			}
			if (action == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("action");
			}
			_rectangle = rectangle;
			_action = action;
		}

		public bool TryMerge(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Rectangle rectangle, Action action)
		{
			if (rectangle == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("rectangle");
			}
			if (action == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("action");
			}
			if (_action == action && _rectangle.Y == rectangle.Y && _rectangle.Height == rectangle.Height)
			{
				int num = (int)((rectangle.X + rectangle.Width) * 1000f) + 1;
				int num2 = (int)(_rectangle.X * 1000f);
				int num3 = (int)(rectangle.X * 1000f);
				int num4 = (int)((_rectangle.X + _rectangle.Width) * 1000f) + 1;
				if (num >= num2 && num3 <= num4)
				{
					_rectangle = _rectangle.Union(rectangle);
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

			{
				if (page == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("page");
				}
				_page = page;
				_x = x;
				_y = y;
			}

			public override bool Equals(object key)
			{
				if (key == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (key == this)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (key is HashKey)
				{
					HashKey hashKey = (HashKey)key;
					if (_page == hashKey.Page && _x == hashKey.X && _y == hashKey.Y)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return _page.GetHashCode() ^ _x.GetHashCode() ^ _y.GetHashCode();
			}
		}

	internal class Packager
	{
		private class Checksum
		{
			private static uint Seed;

			private uint _value;

			private static uint[] Table;

			public uint Value => _value;

			static Checksum()
			{
				Seed = uint.MaxValue;
				Table = new uint[256];
				for (uint num = 0u; num < 256; num++)
				{
					uint num2 = num;
					for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
					{
						num2 = (((num2 & 1) != 1) ? (((num2 & 0xFFFFFFFEu) >> 1) & 0x7FFFFFFF) : ((((num2 & 0xFFFFFFFEu) >> 1) & 0x7FFFFFFF) ^ 0xEDB88320u));
					}
					Table[num] = num2;
				}
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				_value = 0u;
			}

			public void Update(System.IO.Stream stream)
			{
				_value ^= Seed;
				long num = stream.Position;
				for (long length = stream.Length; num < length; num++)
				{
					byte b = (byte)stream.ReadByte();
					_value = Table[(_value ^ b) & 0xFF] ^ (_value >> 8);
				}
				_value ^= Seed;
			}
		}

		private class Item
		{
			private string _name;

			private uint _size;

			private uint _compressedSize;

			private uint _checksum;

			private uint _dateTime;

			private uint _offset;

			public uint Checksum
			{
				get
				{
					return _checksum;
				}
				set
				{
					_checksum = value;
				}
			}

			public uint CompressedSize
			{
				get
				{
					return _compressedSize;
				}
				set
				{
					_compressedSize = value;
				}
			}

			public uint DateTime
			{
				get
				{
					return _dateTime;
				}
				set
				{
					_dateTime = value;
				}
			}

			public string Name
			{
				get
				{
					return _name;
				}
				set
				{
					_name = value;
				}
			}

			public uint Offset
			{
				get
				{
					return _offset;
				}
				set
				{
					_offset = value;
				}
			}

			public uint Size
			{
				get
				{
					return _size;
				}
				set
				{
					_size = value;
				}
			}
		}

		private System.IO.Stream _stream;

		private List<Item> _items;

		private Checksum _checksum;

		private uint _offset;

		public Packager(System.IO.Stream stream)
		{
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("stream");
			}
			_stream = stream;
			_items = new List<Item>();
			_checksum = new Checksum();
		}

		public void AddItem(string name, System.IO.Stream data)
		{
			if (name == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("name");
			}
			if (data == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("data");
			}
			data.Position = 0L;
			_checksum.Reset();
			_checksum.Update(data);
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			byte[] array = new byte[(int)data.Length];
			using (DeflateStream deflateStream = new DeflateStream(memoryStream, CompressionMode.Compress))
			{
				data.Position = 0L;
				data.Read(array, 0, array.Length);
				deflateStream.Write(array, 0, array.Length);
			}
			array = memoryStream.ToArray();
			memoryStream = null;
			Item item = new Item();
			item.Name = name;
			item.Size = (uint)data.Length;
			item.CompressedSize = (uint)array.Length;
			item.Checksum = _checksum.Value;
			item.DateTime = PackDateTime(System.DateTime.Now);
			item.Offset = _offset;
			_items.Add(item);
			WriteUInt(67324752u);
			WriteUShort(20);
			WriteUShort(0);
			WriteUShort(8);
			WriteUInt(item.DateTime);
			WriteUInt(item.Checksum);
			WriteUInt(item.CompressedSize);
			WriteUInt(item.Size);
			byte[] bytes = EncodingProxy.ASCII.GetBytes(item.Name);
			WriteUShort((ushort)bytes.Length);
			WriteUShort(0);
			_stream.Write(bytes, 0, bytes.Length);
			_stream.Write(array, 0, array.Length);
			_offset = (uint)_stream.Position;
		}

		public void Seal()
		{
			foreach (Item item in _items)
			{
				WriteUInt(33639248u);
				WriteUShort(20);
				WriteUShort(20);
				WriteUShort(0);
				WriteUShort(8);
				WriteUInt(item.DateTime);
				WriteUInt(item.Checksum);
				WriteUInt(item.CompressedSize);
				WriteUInt(item.Size);
				byte[] bytes = EncodingProxy.ASCII.GetBytes(item.Name);
				WriteUShort((ushort)bytes.Length);
				WriteUShort(0);
				WriteUShort(0);
				WriteUShort(0);
				WriteUShort(0);
				WriteUInt(0u);
				WriteUInt(item.Offset);
				_stream.Write(bytes, 0, bytes.Length);
			}
			uint value = (uint)(_stream.Position - _offset);
			WriteUInt(101010256u);
			WriteUShort(0);
			WriteUShort(0);
			WriteUShort((ushort)_items.Count);
			WriteUShort((ushort)_items.Count);
			WriteUInt(value);
			WriteUInt(_offset);
			WriteUShort(0);
		}

		public void WriteUShort(ushort value)
		{
			byte value2 = (byte)value;
			byte value3 = (byte)(value >> 8);
			_stream.WriteByte(value2);
			_stream.WriteByte(value3);
		}

		private static uint PackDateTime(System.DateTime value)
		{
			return (uint)((((value.Year - 1980) & 0x7F) << 25) | (value.Month << 21) | (value.Day << 16) | (value.Hour << 11) | (value.Minute << 5) | (value.Second >>> 1));
		}

		private void WriteUInt(uint value)
		{
			byte value2 = (byte)value;
			byte value3 = (byte)(value >> 8);
			byte value4 = (byte)(value >> 16);
			byte value5 = (byte)(value >> 24);
			_stream.WriteByte(value2);
			_stream.WriteByte(value3);
			_stream.WriteByte(value4);
			_stream.WriteByte(value5);
		}
	}

		private class XpsSavingProgressReporter
		{
			private readonly bool _saveFileAtTheEnd;

			private readonly int _itemsToSave;

			public XpsSavingProgressReporter(bool saveFileAtTheEnd, int itemsToSave)
			{
				_saveFileAtTheEnd = saveFileAtTheEnd;
				_itemsToSave = itemsToSave;
			}

			public PublishProgressEventArgs GetPublishProgressEventArgs(bool isSaving, int current)
			{
				if (_saveFileAtTheEnd)
				{
					if (isSaving)
					{
						return new PublishProgressEventArgs(2 + current, 10);
					}
					return new PublishProgressEventArgs(2.0 * (double)current / (double)_itemsToSave, 10);
				}
				return new PublishProgressEventArgs(current, _itemsToSave);
			}
		}
