		public void AttachFile(string fileName, string name, string mimeType)
		{
			if (fileName == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("fileName");
			}
			if (name == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("name");
			}
			FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(fileName, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.Read);
			int num = (int)fileStream.Length;
			byte[] buffer = new byte[num];
			fileStream.Read(buffer, 0, num);
			fileStream.Close();
			_attachments.Add(new Attachment(name, mimeType, new MemoryStream(buffer)));
		}

		public void AttachFile(System.IO.Stream stream, string name, string mimeType)
		{
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("stream");
			}
			if (name == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("name");
			}
			_attachments.Add(new Attachment(name, mimeType, stream));
		}

		public void AttachThumbnail(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image)
		{
			_thumbnail = image;
		}

		public MemoryStream Generate()
		{
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			Generate(memoryStream);
			return memoryStream;
		}

		public void Generate(string fileName)
		{
			if (fileName == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("fileName");
			}
			FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(fileName, FileMode.Create);
			Generate(fileStream);
			fileStream.Close();
		}

		public void Generate(System.IO.Stream stream)
		{
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("stream");
			}
			MemoryStream memoryStream = null;
			Packager packager;
			try
			{
				long position = stream.Position;
				packager = new Packager(stream);
			}
			catch
			{
				memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
				packager = new Packager(memoryStream);
			}
			int itemsToSave = _fonts.Count + _images.Count + _attachments.Count + _pages.Count;
			int num = 0;
			XpsSavingProgressReporter xpsSavingProgressReporter = new XpsSavingProgressReporter(memoryStream != null, itemsToSave);
			packager.AddItem("_rels/.rels", GetPackageRelations());
			packager.AddItem("docProps/core.xml", GetCoreProperties());
			packager.AddItem("docProps/CustomProperties.xml", GetCustomProperties());
			if (_thumbnail != null)
			{
				Image image = ImageFactory.Create(0, 0, _thumbnail, null);
				packager.AddItem("docProps/thumbnail" + image.GetExtension(), image.GetData());
			}
			foreach (Font font in _fonts)
			{
				packager.AddItem(font.ResourceName(relative: false), font.GetData());
				ReportProgress(xpsSavingProgressReporter.GetPublishProgressEventArgs(isSaving: false, num++));
			}
			foreach (Image image3 in _images)
			{
				packager.AddItem(image3.ResourceName(relative: false), image3.GetData());
				ReportProgress(xpsSavingProgressReporter.GetPublishProgressEventArgs(isSaving: false, num++));
			}
			foreach (Attachment attachment in _attachments)
			{
				packager.AddItem("Documents/1/Attachments/" + attachment.Name, attachment.Content);
				ReportProgress(xpsSavingProgressReporter.GetPublishProgressEventArgs(isSaving: false, num++));
			}
			packager.AddItem("[Content_Types].xml", GetContentTypes());
			packager.AddItem("FixedDocumentSequence.fdseq", GetFixedDocumentSequence());
			packager.AddItem("Documents/1/_rels/FixedDocument.fdoc.rels", GetDocumentRelations());
			packager.AddItem("Documents/1/FixedDocument.fdoc", GetFixedDocument());
			if (_bookmarks.Content.Count > 0)
			{
				packager.AddItem("Documents/1/Structure/DocumentStructure.struct", GetDocumentStructure());
			}
			int num2 = 1;
			foreach (XpsPage page in _pages)
			{
				if (page.Thumbnail != null)
				{
					Image image2 = ImageFactory.Create(0, 0, page.Thumbnail, null);
					packager.AddItem("Documents/1/Resources/Thumbnails/thumbnail" + num2 + image2.GetExtension(), image2.GetData());
				}
				packager.AddItem("Documents/1/Pages/_rels/" + num2 + ".fpage.rels", GetPageRelations(page, num2));
				page.Detach();
				page.FixContent();
				packager.AddItem("Documents/1/Pages/" + num2 + ".fpage", page.Stream);
				page.Cleanup();
				num2++;
				ReportProgress(xpsSavingProgressReporter.GetPublishProgressEventArgs(isSaving: false, num++));
			}
			packager.Seal();
			if (memoryStream != null)
			{
				try
				{
					byte[] buffer = memoryStream.ToArray();
					if (this.ReportPublishing != null)
					{
						int num3 = (int)memoryStream.Length / 8;
						int num4 = 0;
						int num5 = 0;
						while (num4 < memoryStream.Length)
						{
							stream.Write(buffer, num4, (int)Math.Min(num3, memoryStream.Length - num4));
							num4 += num3;
							ReportProgress(xpsSavingProgressReporter.GetPublishProgressEventArgs(isSaving: true, Math.Min(num5++, 8)));
						}
					}
					else
					{
						stream.Write(buffer, 0, (int)memoryStream.Length);
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					memoryStream.Dispose();
				}
			}
			_fonts = null;
			_images = null;
			_fontHash = null;
			_imageHash = null;
			_targetHash = null;
			_info = null;
			_thumbnail = null;
			_pages = null;
			_bookmarks = null;
			_attachments = null;
		}

		IEnumerator<IXpsPage> IEnumerable<IXpsPage>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new PageEnumerator(_pages);
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new PageEnumerator(_pages);
		}

		private MemoryStream GetContentTypes()
		{
			Writer writer = WriterFactory.CreateWriter(new MemoryStream());
			writer.StartDocument();
			writer.StartElementWithNamespace("Types", "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types");
			writer.StartElement("Default");
			writer.SetAttribute("Extension", "xml");
			writer.SetAttribute("ContentType", "application/xml");
			writer.EndElement();
			writer.StartElement("Default");
			writer.SetAttribute("Extension", "rels");
			writer.SetAttribute("ContentType", "application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml");
			writer.EndElement();
			writer.StartElement("Default");
			writer.SetAttribute("Extension", "fdseq");
			writer.SetAttribute("ContentType", "application/vnd.ms-package.xps-fixeddocumentsequence+xml");
			writer.EndElement();
			writer.StartElement("Default");
			writer.SetAttribute("Extension", "fdoc");
			writer.SetAttribute("ContentType", "application/vnd.ms-package.xps-fixeddocument+xml");
			writer.EndElement();
			writer.StartElement("Default");
			writer.SetAttribute("Extension", "fpage");
			writer.SetAttribute("ContentType", "application/vnd.ms-package.xps-fixedpage+xml");
			writer.EndElement();
			writer.StartElement("Default");
			writer.SetAttribute("Extension", "png");
			writer.SetAttribute("ContentType", "image/png");
			writer.EndElement();
			writer.StartElement("Default");
			writer.SetAttribute("Extension", "jpg");
			writer.SetAttribute("ContentType", "image/jpeg");
			writer.EndElement();
			writer.StartElement("Default");
			writer.SetAttribute("Extension", "ttf");
			writer.SetAttribute("ContentType", "application/vnd.ms-opentype");
			writer.EndElement();
			writer.StartElement("Default");
			writer.SetAttribute("Extension", "odttf");
			writer.SetAttribute("ContentType", "application/vnd.ms-package.obfuscated-opentype");
			writer.EndElement();
			writer.StartElement("Default");
			writer.SetAttribute("Extension", "struct");
			writer.SetAttribute("ContentType", "application/vnd.ms-package.xps-documentstructure+xml");
			writer.EndElement();
			writer.StartElement("Override");
			writer.SetAttribute("PartName", "/docProps/core.xml");
			writer.SetAttribute("ContentType", "application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.core-properties+xml");
			writer.EndElement();
			foreach (Attachment attachment in _attachments)
			{
				writer.StartElement("Override");
				writer.SetAttribute("PartName", "/Documents/1/Attachments/" + attachment.Name);
				writer.SetAttribute("ContentType", attachment.MimeType);
				writer.EndElement();
			}
			writer.EndElement();
			writer.EndDocument();
			writer.Flush();
			return writer.Stream;
		}

		private MemoryStream GetCoreProperties()
		{
			Writer writer = WriterFactory.CreateWriter(new MemoryStream());
			writer.StartDocument();
			writer.StartElementWithNamespace("cp:coreProperties", "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/metadata/core-properties");
			writer.SetAttribute("xmlns:cp", "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/metadata/core-properties");
			writer.SetAttribute("xmlns:dc", "http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/");
			writer.SetAttribute("xmlns:dcterms", "http://purl.org/dc/terms/");
			writer.SetAttribute("xmlns:dcmitype", "http://purl.org/dc/dcmitype/");
			writer.SetAttribute("xmlns:xsi", "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_info.Category))
			{
				writer.StartElement("cp:category");
				writer.WriteContent(_info.Category);
				writer.EndElement();
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_info.Creator))
			{
				writer.StartElement("dc:creator");
				writer.WriteContent(_info.Creator);
				writer.EndElement();
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_info.Title))
			{
				writer.StartElement("dc:title");
				writer.WriteContent(_info.Title);
				writer.EndElement();
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_info.Subject))
			{
				writer.StartElement("dc:subject");
				writer.WriteContent(_info.Subject);
				writer.EndElement();
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_info.Description))
			{
				writer.StartElement("dc:description");
				writer.WriteContent(_info.Description);
				writer.EndElement();
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_info.Keywords))
			{
				writer.StartElement("cp:keywords");
				writer.WriteContent(_info.Keywords);
				writer.EndElement();
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_info.Language))
			{
				writer.StartElement("dc:language");
				writer.WriteContent(_info.Language);
				writer.EndElement();
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_info.Status))
			{
				writer.StartElement("cp:contentStatus");
				writer.WriteContent(_info.Status);
				writer.EndElement();
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_info.Content))
			{
				writer.StartElement("cp:contentType");
				writer.WriteContent(_info.Content);
				writer.EndElement();
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_info.Version))
			{
				writer.StartElement("cp:version");
				writer.WriteContent(_info.Version);
				writer.EndElement();
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_info.Identifier))
			{
				writer.StartElement("dc:identifier");
				writer.WriteContent(_info.Identifier);
				writer.EndElement();
			}
			writer.StartElement("dcterms:created");
			writer.SetAttribute("xsi:type", "dcterms:W3CDTF");
			writer.WriteContent(_info.Created);
			writer.EndElement();
			if (_info.Modified.CompareTo(_info.Created) > 0)
			{
				writer.StartElement("dcterms:modified");
				writer.SetAttribute("xsi:type", "dcterms:W3CDTF");
				writer.WriteContent(_info.Modified);
				writer.EndElement();
			}
			writer.EndElement();
			writer.EndDocument();
			writer.Flush();
			return writer.Stream;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private MemoryStream GetCustomProperties()
		{
			Writer writer = WriterFactory.CreateWriter(new MemoryStream());
			Version version = null;
			try
			{
				new FileIOPermission(PermissionState.Unrestricted).Assert();
				AssemblyName assemblyName = new AssemblyName(Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly().FullName);
				version = assemblyName.Version;
				CodeAccessPermission.RevertAssert();
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			if (version != null)
			{
				writer.WriteComment(" Created with Infragistics Report Writer " + version.Major + "." + version.Minor + "." + version.Build + " ");
			}
			else
			{
				writer.WriteComment(" Created with Infragistics Report Writer ");
			}
			writer.StartElement("CustomProperties");
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, string> property in _info.Properties)
			{
				writer.StartElement("Property");
				writer.SetAttribute("Name", property.Key);
				writer.SetAttribute("Value", property.Value);
				writer.EndElement();
			}
			writer.EndElement();
			writer.Flush();
			return writer.Stream;
		}

		private MemoryStream GetFixedDocument()
		{
			Writer writer = WriterFactory.CreateWriter(new MemoryStream());
			writer.StartElementWithNamespace("FixedDocument", "http://schemas.microsoft.com/xps/2005/06");
			int num = 1;
			foreach (XpsPage page in _pages)
			{
				writer.StartElement("PageContent");
				writer.SetAttribute("Source", "Pages/" + num + ".fpage");
				if (page.Targets.Count > 0)
				{
					writer.StartElement("PageContent.LinkTargets");
					foreach (Target target in page.Targets)
					{
						writer.StartElement("LinkTarget");
						writer.SetAttribute("Name", target.ResourceName());
						writer.EndElement();
					}
					writer.EndElement();
				}
				writer.EndElement();
				num++;
			}
			writer.EndElement();
			writer.Flush();
			return writer.Stream;
		}

		private MemoryStream GetPageRelations(XpsPage page, int pageNo)
		{
			Writer writer = WriterFactory.CreateWriter(new MemoryStream());
			writer.StartDocument();
			writer.StartElementWithNamespace("Relationships", "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships");
			foreach (Font font in page.Fonts)
			{
				writer.StartElement("Relationship");
				writer.SetAttribute("Id", font.RelationId());
				writer.SetAttribute("Type", "http://schemas.microsoft.com/xps/2005/06/required-resource");
				writer.SetAttribute("Target", font.ResourceName(relative: true));
				writer.EndElement();
			}
			foreach (Image image in page.Images)
			{
				writer.StartElement("Relationship");
				writer.SetAttribute("Id", image.RelationId());
				writer.SetAttribute("Type", "http://schemas.microsoft.com/xps/2005/06/required-resource");
				writer.SetAttribute("Target", image.ResourceName(relative: true));
				writer.EndElement();
			}
			if (page.Thumbnail != null)
			{
				writer.StartElement("Relationship");
				writer.SetAttribute("Id", "rId" + (_indexes[0] + _indexes[1] + pageNo));
				writer.SetAttribute("Type", "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships/metadata/thumbnail");
				writer.SetAttribute("Target", "../Resources/Thumbnails/thumbnail" + pageNo + ".png");
				writer.EndElement();
			}
			writer.EndElement();
			writer.EndDocument();
			writer.Flush();
			return writer.Stream;
		}

		private void WriteBookmarks(Writer writer, BookmarkCollection bookmarks, int level)
		{
			foreach (Bookmark bookmark in bookmarks)
			{
				writer.StartElement("OutlineEntry");
				writer.SetAttribute("OutlineLevel", level);
				writer.SetAttribute("Description", bookmark.Title);
				writer.SetAttribute("OutlineTarget", "../FixedDocument.fdoc#" + bookmark.Target.ResourceName());
				writer.EndElement();
				if (bookmark.Content.Count > 0)
				{
					WriteBookmarks(writer, bookmark.Content, level + 1);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ReportProgress(PublishProgressEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			if (this.ReportPublishing != null)
			{
				this.ReportPublishing(this, eventArgs);
			}
		}

		internal Font GetFont(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font font)
		{
			ShortFontHashKey shortHashKey = font.GetShortHashKey();
			if (_fontHash.ContainsKey(shortHashKey))
			{
				return _fontHash[shortHashKey];
			}
			Font font2 = FontFactory.CreateFont(++_indexes[0], _indexes[0] + _indexes[1], font);
			string internalName = font2.InternalName;
			Font font3 = font2;
			foreach (Font font4 in _fonts)
			{
				if (internalName == font4.InternalName)
				{
					_indexes[0]--;
					font2 = font4;
					font3 = null;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (font3 != null)
			{
				_fonts.Add(font2);
			}
			_fontHash.Add(shortHashKey, font2);
			return font2;
		}

		internal Image GetImage(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color transparentColor)
		{
			Image.HashKey key = new Image.HashKey(image, transparentColor);
			if (_imageHash.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				return _imageHash[key];
			}
			Image image2 = ImageFactory.Create(++_indexes[1], _indexes[0] + _indexes[1], image, transparentColor);
			_images.Add(image2);
			_imageHash.Add(key, image2);
			return image2;
		}

		internal Target GetTarget(XpsPage page, float x, float y)
		{
			Target.HashKey key = new Target.HashKey(page, x, y);
			if (_targetHash.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				return _targetHash[key];
			}
			Target target = new Target(++_indexes[2], x, y);
			_targetHash.Add(key, target);
			return target;
		}
	}
	internal class Font
	{
		protected int _index;

		protected int _relationId;

		protected Infragistics.Documents.Reports.TTF.Font _ttFont;

		protected string _name;

		protected string _internalName;

		protected float _size;

		protected float _ascent;

		protected float _descent;

		protected float _height;

		protected Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle _style;

		protected Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle _internalStyle;

		protected byte[] _guid;

		protected string _obfuscatedName;

		public float Ascent => _ascent;

		public float Descent => _descent;

		public float Height => _height;

		public string InternalName => _internalName;

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle InternalStyle => _internalStyle;

		public string Name
		{
			get
			{
				return _name;
			}
			set
			{
				_name = value;
			}
		}

		public float Size
		{
			get
			{
				return _size;
			}
			set
			{
				_size = value;
			}
		}

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle Style
		{
			get
			{
				return _style;
			}
			set
			{
				_style = value;
			}
		}

		public Font()
		{
		}

		public Font(int index, int relationId, System.IO.Stream stream)
		{
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("stream");
			}
			_index = index;
			_relationId = relationId;
			_style = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Regular;
			_internalStyle = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Regular;
			_ttFont = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.TTF.Font(stream);
			if (_ttFont.Name != null)
			{
				_internalName = _ttFont.Name;
			}
			else
			{
				_internalName = "XPS_" + _index;
			}
			if (!_ttFont.Corrupted)
			{
				_ascent = _ttFont.Ascent;
				_descent = _ttFont.Descent;
				_height = _ttFont.Height;
				_internalStyle = _ttFont.Style;
				_guid = new byte[16];
				Random random = new Random();
				for (int i = 0; i < 14; i++)
				{
					_guid[i] = (byte)random.Next(256);
				}
				_guid[14] = (byte)(_index >> 8);
				_guid[15] = (byte)_index;
				_obfuscatedName = new CharBuffer
				{
					Converter.ToHex(_guid[3]),
					Converter.ToHex(_guid[2]),
					Converter.ToHex(_guid[1]),
					Converter.ToHex(_guid[0]),
					'-',
					Converter.ToHex(_guid[5]),
					Converter.ToHex(_guid[4]),
					'-',
					Converter.ToHex(_guid[7]),
					Converter.ToHex(_guid[6]),
					'-',
					Converter.ToHex(_guid[8]),
					Converter.ToHex(_guid[9]),
					'-',
					Converter.ToHex(_guid[10]),
					Converter.ToHex(_guid[11]),
					Converter.ToHex(_guid[12]),
					Converter.ToHex(_guid[13]),
					Converter.ToHex(_guid[14]),
					Converter.ToHex(_guid[15])
				}.ToString();
			}
		}

		public virtual System.IO.Stream GetData()
		{
			_ttFont.Subset(regular: true);
			System.IO.Stream stream = _ttFont.Stream;
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			stream.Position = 0L;
			for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
			{
				memoryStream.WriteByte((byte)(stream.ReadByte() ^ _guid[15]));
				memoryStream.WriteByte((byte)(stream.ReadByte() ^ _guid[14]));
				memoryStream.WriteByte((byte)(stream.ReadByte() ^ _guid[13]));
				memoryStream.WriteByte((byte)(stream.ReadByte() ^ _guid[12]));
				memoryStream.WriteByte((byte)(stream.ReadByte() ^ _guid[11]));
				memoryStream.WriteByte((byte)(stream.ReadByte() ^ _guid[10]));
				memoryStream.WriteByte((byte)(stream.ReadByte() ^ _guid[9]));
				memoryStream.WriteByte((byte)(stream.ReadByte() ^ _guid[8]));
				memoryStream.WriteByte((byte)(stream.ReadByte() ^ _guid[6]));
				memoryStream.WriteByte((byte)(stream.ReadByte() ^ _guid[7]));
				memoryStream.WriteByte((byte)(stream.ReadByte() ^ _guid[4]));
				memoryStream.WriteByte((byte)(stream.ReadByte() ^ _guid[5]));
				memoryStream.WriteByte((byte)(stream.ReadByte() ^ _guid[0]));
				memoryStream.WriteByte((byte)(stream.ReadByte() ^ _guid[1]));
				memoryStream.WriteByte((byte)(stream.ReadByte() ^ _guid[2]));
				memoryStream.WriteByte((byte)(stream.ReadByte() ^ _guid[3]));
			}
			int j = (int)stream.Position;
			for (int num = (int)stream.Length; j < num; j++)
			{
				memoryStream.WriteByte((byte)stream.ReadByte());
			}
			return memoryStream;
		}

		public int GlyphWidth(char ch)
		{
			_ttFont.ActiveGlyphs.Add(_ttFont.GlyphId(ch));
			return _ttFont.GlyphWidth(ch);
		}

		public class HashKey
		{
			private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image _image;

			private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color _transparentColor;

			public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image Image => _image;

			public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color TransparentColor => _transparentColor;

			public HashKey(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color transparentColor)
			{
				if (image == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("image");
				}
				_image = image;
				_transparentColor = transparentColor;
			}

			public override bool Equals(object key)
			{
				if (key == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (key == this)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (key is HashKey)
				{
					HashKey hashKey = (HashKey)key;
					if (_image == hashKey.Image)
					{
						if (_transparentColor != null)
						{
							if (_transparentColor.Equals(hashKey.TransparentColor))
							{
								return true;
							}
							return false;
						}
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				if (_transparentColor != null)
				{
					return _image.GetHashCode() ^ _transparentColor.GetHashCode();
				}
				return _image.GetHashCode();
			}
		}

		private int _index;

		private int _relationId;

		protected Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image _image;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color _transparentColor;

		public Image(int index, int relationId, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color transparentColor)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("image");
			}
			_index = index;
			_relationId = relationId;
			_image = image;
			_transparentColor = transparentColor;
		}

		public virtual MemoryStream GetData()
		{
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			Bitmap bitmap = _image.Preferences.Converter.ToNative(_image);
			bitmap.SetResolution(96f, 96f);
			if (_transparentColor != null)
			{
				bitmap.MakeTransparent(_transparentColor.ToNative());
				bitmap.Save(memoryStream, ImageFormat.Png);
			}
			else if (_image.Preferences.Compressor.Type == CompressorType.JPEG)
			{
				ImageCodecInfo encoderInfo = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image.GetEncoderInfo("image/jpeg");
				System.Drawing.Imaging.Encoder quality = System.Drawing.Imaging.Encoder.Quality;
				EncoderParameters encoderParameters = new EncoderParameters(1);
				EncoderParameter encoderParameter = new EncoderParameter(quality, ((JPEGCompressor)_image.Preferences.Compressor).Quality);
				encoderParameters.Param[0] = encoderParameter;
				bitmap.Save(memoryStream, encoderInfo, encoderParameters);
			}
			else
			{
				if (_image.AlphaChannel != null && _image.Preferences.Converter.Type == ConverterType.RGB)
				{
					bitmap = new ArgbImageConverter().ToNative(_image);
				}
				bitmap.Save(memoryStream, ImageFormat.Png);
			}
			return memoryStream;
		}

		public string GetExtension()
		{
			if (_transparentColor == null && _image.Preferences.Compressor.Type == CompressorType.JPEG)
			{
				return ".jpg";
			}
			return ".png";
		}

		public string RelationId()
		{
			return "rId" + _relationId;
		}

		public string ResourceName(bool relative)
		{

			{
				return "../Resources/Images/image" + _index + GetExtension();
			}
			return "Documents/1/Resources/Images/image" + _index + GetExtension();
		}

	internal class XpsPage : IXpsPage
	{
		private XpsDocument _document;

		private float _width;

		private float _height;

		private MemoryStream _stream;

		private Graphics _graphics;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image _thumbnail;

		private HashSet<Font> _fonts;

		private HashSet<Image> _images;

		private HashSet<Target> _targets;

		private List<Hyperlink> _hyperlinks;

		private Hyperlink _hyperlink;

		private IMarker _marker;

		public XpsDocument Document => _document;

		public List<Font> Fonts => _fonts.Items;

		public IXpsGraphics Graphics => _graphics;

		public float Height => _height;

		public List<Image> Images => _images.Items;

		public MemoryStream Stream => _stream;

		public List<Target> Targets => _targets.Items;

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image Thumbnail => _thumbnail;

		public float Width => _width;

		public XpsPage(XpsDocument document, float width, float height)
		{
			_document = document;
			_width = width;
			_height = height;
			_stream = new MemoryStream();
			_fonts = new HashSet<Font>();
			_images = new HashSet<Image>();
			_targets = new HashSet<Target>();
			_hyperlinks = new List<Hyperlink>();
			_graphics = new Graphics(this);
		}

		public void Attach()
		{
			if (_document.FileBuffer != null && _marker == null)
			{
				IWriter writer = _document.FileBuffer.GetWriter();
				byte[] array = _stream.ToArray();
				writer.WriteInt(array.Length);
				writer.WriteBlock(array);
				_stream = null;
				_marker = writer.Close();
			}
		}

		public void AttachThumbnail(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image)
		{
			_thumbnail = image;
		}

		public void AddHyperlink(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Rectangle rectangle, Action action)
		{
			if (_hyperlink == null || !_hyperlink.TryMerge(rectangle, action))
			{
				_hyperlink = new Hyperlink(rectangle, action);
				_hyperlinks.Add(_hyperlink);
			}
		}

		public void Cleanup()
		{
			_stream = null;
			_graphics = null;
			_thumbnail = null;
			_fonts = null;
			_images = null;
			_targets = null;
			_hyperlinks = null;
		}

		public void Detach()
		{
			if (_marker != null)
			{
				IReader reader = _marker.FileBuffer.GetReader(_marker);
				int size = reader.ReadInt();
				byte[] array = reader.ReadBlock(size);
				_stream = new MemoryStream();
				_stream.Write(array, 0, array.Length);
				_marker = null;
			}
		}

		public void FixContent()
		{
			if (_targets.Count == 0 && _hyperlinks.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			Writer writer = WriterFactory.CreateWriter(memoryStream);
			writer.StartElement("A");
			writer.StartElement("B");
			foreach (Target item in _targets.Items)
			{
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Path path = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Path();
				path.MoveTo(item.X, item.Y);
				path.LineTo(item.X + 1f, item.Y);
				path.LineTo(item.X + 1f, item.Y + 1f);
				path.LineTo(item.X, item.Y + 1f);
				path.ClosePath();
				writer.StartElement("Path");
				writer.SetAttribute("Name", item.ResourceName());
				writer.SetAttribute("Data", Converter.ToString(path));
				writer.SetAttribute("Stroke", "#00000000");
				writer.SetAttribute("StrokeThickness", "1");
				writer.EndElement();
			}
			foreach (Hyperlink hyperlink in _hyperlinks)
			{
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Path path2 = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Path();
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Rectangle rectangle = hyperlink.Rectangle;
				Action action = hyperlink.Action;
				path2.MoveTo(rectangle.X, rectangle.Y);
				path2.LineTo(rectangle.X + rectangle.Width, rectangle.Y);
				path2.LineTo(rectangle.X + rectangle.Width, rectangle.Y + rectangle.Height);
				path2.LineTo(rectangle.X, rectangle.Y + rectangle.Height);
				path2.ClosePath();
				writer.StartElement("Path");
				if (action.Type == ActionType.Goto)
				{
					writer.SetAttribute("FixedPage.NavigateUri", "../FixedDocument.fdoc#" + ((GotoAction)hyperlink.Action).Target.ResourceName());
				}
				else
				{
					writer.SetAttribute("FixedPage.NavigateUri", ((URIAction)hyperlink.Action).URI);
				}
				writer.SetAttribute("Data", Converter.ToString(path2));
				writer.SetAttribute("Fill", "#00000000");
				writer.EndElement();
			}
			writer.EndElement();
			writer.EndElement();
			writer.Flush();
			int num = 26;
			int num2 = (int)_stream.Length - num;
			byte[] buffer = new byte[num];
			_stream.Position = num2;
			_stream.Read(buffer, 0, num);
			_stream.Position = num2;
			_stream.Write(memoryStream.ToArray(), 12, (int)memoryStream.Length - 25);
			_stream.Write(buffer, 0, num);
		}

		public Font GetFont(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font font)
		{
			Font font2 = _document.GetFont(font);
			if (!_fonts.Contains(font2))
			{
				_fonts.Add(font2);
			}
			return font2;
		}

		public Image GetImage(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color transparentColor)
		{
			Image image2 = _document.GetImage(image, transparentColor);
			if (!_images.Contains(image2))
			{
				_images.Add(image2);
			}
			return image2;
		}

		public Target GetTarget(float x, float y)
		{
			Target target = _document.GetTarget(this, x, y);
			if (!_targets.Contains(target))
			{
				_targets.Add(target);
			}
			return target;
		}
	}

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush Brush
		{
			get
			{
				return _brush;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_brush != value)
				{
					FlushText();
					if (_underlineStarted)
					{
						EndUnderline();
						StartUnderline();
					}
					if (_strikeoutStarted)
					{
						EndStrikeout();
						StartStrikeout();
					}
					_indirectBrush = null;
					_brush = value;
					if (_brush != null && _brush is IndirectBrush)
					{
						_indirectBrush = (IndirectBrush)_brush;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public float CharSpacing
		{
			get
			{
				return _charSpacing;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_charSpacing != value)
				{
					FlushText();
					_charSpacing = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font Font
		{
			get
			{
				return _font;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_font == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				FlushText();
				if (_underlineStarted)
				{
					EndUnderline();
				}
				if (_strikeoutStarted)
				{
					EndStrikeout();
				}
				_font = value;
				if (_font != null)
				{
					_xpsFont = _page.GetFont(_font);
					_fontSize = _font.Size;
					_fontAscent = _fontSize * _xpsFont.Ascent;
					_fontDescent = _fontSize * _xpsFont.Descent;
					_fontHeight = _fontSize * _xpsFont.Height;
					_xpsFont.Name = _font.Name;
					_xpsFont.Size = _fontSize;
					_xpsFont.Style = _font.Style;
					bool flag = (_xpsFont.Style & Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Bold) == Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Bold;
					bool flag2 = (_xpsFont.InternalStyle & Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Bold) == Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Bold;
					if (flag && !flag2)
					{
						_boldFactor = 1.15f;
					}
					else
					{
						_boldFactor = 1f;
					}
					bool flag3 = (_xpsFont.Style & Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Italic) == Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Italic;
					bool flag4 = (_xpsFont.InternalStyle & Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Italic) == Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Italic;
					if (flag3 && !flag4)
					{
						_italicFactor = 0.35f;
					}
					else
					{
						_italicFactor = 0f;
					}
					if ((_font.Style & Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Underline) == Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Underline || (_font.Style & Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.DoubleUnderline) == Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.DoubleUnderline)
					{
						StartUnderline();
					}
					if ((_font.Style & Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Strikeout) == Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Strikeout || (_font.Style & Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.DoubleStrikeout) == Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.DoubleStrikeout)
					{
						StartStrikeout();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_xpsFont = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public Graphics(XpsPage page)
		{
			if (page == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("page");
			}
			_page = page;
			_textState = new TextState();
			_writer = WriterFactory.CreateWriter(_page.Stream);
			_writer.StartElementWithNamespace("FixedPage", "http://schemas.microsoft.com/xps/2005/06");
			_writer.SetAttribute("Width", Converter.PointsToPixels(_page.Width));
			_writer.SetAttribute("Height", Converter.PointsToPixels(_page.Height));
			_writer.SetAttribute("xml:lang", "en-US");
			_matrix = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix();
			_states = new Stack<State>();
			_alternateFill = true;
			Transform(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix(1.333f, 0f, 0f, 1.333f, 0f, 0f));
			_matrix.Reset();
		}

		public void AddHyperlinkArea(float x, float y, float width, float height)
		{
			FlushText();
			float x2 = x * _matrix.M11 + _matrix.OffsetX;
			float y2 = y * _matrix.M22 + _matrix.OffsetY;
			float width2 = width * _matrix.M11;
			float height2 = height * _matrix.M22;
			_page.AddHyperlink(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Rectangle(x2, y2, width2, height2), _xpsAction);
		}

		public void DrawPolygon(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point[] points, PaintMode mode)
		{
			if (points == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("points");
			}
			if (points.Length < 3)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("points", "[3, ...]");
			}
			FlushText();
			bool flag = false;
			if (_path == null)
			{
				_path = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Path();
				_paintMode = mode;
				flag = true;
			}
			_path.MoveTo(points[0].X, points[0].Y);
			int num = points.Length;
			for (int i = 1; i < num; i++)
			{
				_path.LineTo(points[i].X, points[i].Y);
			}
			_path.ClosePath();
			if (flag)
			{
				if (_alternateFill)
				{
					_path.Mode = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FillMode.Alternate;
				}
				else
				{
					_path.Mode = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FillMode.Winding;
				}
				switch (_paintMode)
				{
				case PaintMode.Fill:
					DrawPath(fill: true, stroke: false);
					break;
				case PaintMode.Stroke:
					DrawPath(fill: false, stroke: true);
					break;
				case PaintMode.FillStroke:
					DrawPath(fill: true, stroke: true);
					break;
				case PaintMode.Clip:
					ClipPath();
					break;
				}
				_path = null;
			}
		}

		public void DrawArc(float x, float y, float width, float height, float startAngle, float endAngle)
		{

		}

		public void DrawArc(float x, float y, float width, float height, float startAngle, float endAngle, PaintMode mode)
		{
			if (width <= 0f || height <= 0f)
			{
				return;
			}
			FlushText();
			while (endAngle < startAngle)
			{
				endAngle += 360f;
			}
			if (startAngle == endAngle)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (_path == null)
			{
				_path = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Path();
				_paintMode = mode;
				flag = true;
			}
			float num = width / 2f;
			float num2 = height / 2f;
			float num3 = x + num;
			float num4 = y + num2;
			if (mode != PaintMode.Stroke)
			{
				_path.MoveTo(num3, num4);
			}
			bool flag2 = true;
			while (startAngle < endAngle)
			{
				float num5;
				float num6;
				if (endAngle - startAngle < 90f)
				{
					num5 = startAngle;
					num6 = endAngle;
				}
				else
				{
					num5 = startAngle;
					num6 = num5 + 90f;
				}
				num5 = (float)((double)num5 * (Math.PI / 180.0));
				num6 = (float)((double)num6 * (Math.PI / 180.0));
				float num7 = (float)Math.Sin(num5);
				float num8 = (float)Math.Cos(num5);
				float num9 = (float)Math.Sin(num6);
				float num10 = (float)Math.Cos(num6);
				float num11 = 4f * (float)(1.0 - Math.Cos((num6 - num5) / 2f)) / (float)Math.Sin((num6 - num5) / 2f) / 3f;
				float x2 = num * num8 + num3;
				float y2 = num2 * num7 + num4;
				float x3 = num * (num8 - num11 * num7) + num3;
				float y3 = num2 * (num7 + num11 * num8) + num4;
				float x4 = num * (num10 + num11 * num9) + num3;
				float y4 = num2 * (num9 - num11 * num10) + num4;
				float x5 = num * num10 + num3;
				float y5 = num2 * num9 + num4;
				if (flag2)
				{
					flag2 = false;
					if (mode == PaintMode.Stroke)
					{
						_path.MoveTo(x2, y2);
					}
					else
					{
						_path.LineTo(x2, y2);
					}
				}
				_path.CurveTo(x3, y3, x4, y4, x5, y5);
				startAngle += 90f;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (_paintMode != PaintMode.Stroke)
				{
					_path.ClosePath();
				}
				if (_alternateFill)
				{
					_path.Mode = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FillMode.Alternate;
				}
				else
				{
					_path.Mode = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FillMode.Winding;
				}
				switch (_paintMode)
				{
				case PaintMode.Fill:
					DrawPath(fill: true, stroke: false);
					break;
				case PaintMode.Stroke:
					DrawPath(fill: false, stroke: true);
					break;
				case PaintMode.FillStroke:
					DrawPath(fill: true, stroke: true);
					break;
				case PaintMode.Clip:
					ClipPath();
					break;
				}
				_path = null;
			}
		}

		public void DrawBeziers(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point[] points, PaintMode mode)
		{
			if (points == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("points");
			}
			FlushText();
			int num = points.Length;
			if (num < 4 || (num - 1) % 3 != 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("points", "[4, ...] AND MOD 3");
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (_path == null)
			{
				_path = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Path();
				_paintMode = mode;
				flag = true;
			}
			float x = points[0].X;
			float y = points[0].Y;
			_path.MoveTo(x, y);
			num -= 2;
			for (int i = 1; i < num; i += 3)
			{
				float x2 = points[i].X;
				float y2 = points[i].Y;
				float x3 = points[i + 1].X;
				float y3 = points[i + 1].Y;
				float x4 = points[i + 2].X;
				float y4 = points[i + 2].Y;
				_path.CurveTo(x2, y2, x3, y3, x4, y4);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (_alternateFill)
				{
					_path.Mode = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FillMode.Alternate;
				}
				else
				{
					_path.Mode = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FillMode.Winding;
				}
				switch (_paintMode)
				{
				case PaintMode.Fill:
					DrawPath(fill: true, stroke: false);
					break;
				case PaintMode.Stroke:
					DrawPath(fill: false, stroke: true);
					break;
				case PaintMode.FillStroke:
					DrawPath(fill: true, stroke: true);
					break;
				case PaintMode.Clip:
					ClipPath();
					break;
				}
				_path = null;
			}
		}

		public void DrawChord(float x, float y, float width, float height, float startAngle, float endAngle, PaintMode mode)

				if (flag2)

					flag2 = false;

		public void DrawClosedCurve(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point[] points, float tension)
		{
			DrawClosedCurve(points, tension, PaintMode.Stroke);
		}

		public void DrawClosedCurve(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point[] points, float tension, PaintMode mode)
		{
			if (points == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("points");
			}
			if (points.Length < 4)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("points", "[4, ...]");
			}
			FlushText();
			bool flag = false;
			if (_path == null)
			{
				_path = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Path();
				_paintMode = mode;
				flag = true;
			}
			int num = points.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				float x;
				float y;
				if (i == 0)
				{
					x = points[num - 1].X;
					y = points[num - 1].Y;
				}
				else
				{
					x = points[i - 1].X;
					y = points[i - 1].Y;
				}
				float x2 = points[i].X;
				float y2 = points[i].Y;
				int num2 = i + 1;
				int num3 = i + 2;
				if (num3 >= num)
				{
					num3 = 0;
				}
				if (num2 >= num)
				{
					num2 = 0;
					num3 = 1;
				}
				float x3 = points[num2].X;
				float y3 = points[num2].Y;
				float x4 = points[num3].X;
				float y4 = points[num3].Y;
				float x5 = x2 + tension * ((x3 - x) / 2f);
				float y5 = y2 + tension * ((y3 - y) / 2f);
				float x6 = x3 - tension * ((x4 - x2) / 2f);
				float y6 = y3 - tension * ((y4 - y2) / 2f);
				if (i == 0)
				{
					_path.MoveTo(x2, y2);
				}
				_path.CurveTo(x5, y5, x6, y6, x3, y3);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (_alternateFill)
				{
					_path.Mode = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FillMode.Alternate;
				}
				else
				{
					_path.Mode = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FillMode.Winding;
				}
				switch (_paintMode)
				{
				case PaintMode.Fill:
					DrawPath(fill: true, stroke: false);
					break;
				case PaintMode.Stroke:
					DrawPath(fill: false, stroke: true);
					break;
				case PaintMode.FillStroke:
					DrawPath(fill: true, stroke: true);
					break;
				case PaintMode.Clip:
					ClipPath();
					break;
				}
				_path = null;
			}
		}

		public void DrawCurve(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point[] points, float tension)
		{
			if (points == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("points");
			}
			if (points.Length < 4)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("points", "[4, ...]");
			}
			FlushText();
			bool flag = false;
			if (_path == null)
			{
				_path = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Path();
				_paintMode = PaintMode.Stroke;
				flag = true;
			}
			float x = points[0].X;
			float y = points[0].Y;
			float x2 = points[1].X;
			float y2 = points[1].Y;
			float x3 = points[2].X;
			float y3 = points[2].Y;
			float x4 = x + tension * ((x2 - x) / 2f);
			float y4 = y + tension * ((y2 - y) / 2f);
			float x5 = x2 - tension * ((x3 - x) / 2f);
			float y5 = y2 - tension * ((y3 - y) / 2f);
			_path.MoveTo(x, y);
			_path.CurveTo(x4, y4, x5, y5, x2, y2);
			int num = points.Length - 2;
			float x6;
			float y6;
			for (int i = 1; i < num; i++)
			{
				x = points[i - 1].X;
				y = points[i - 1].Y;
				x2 = points[i].X;
				y2 = points[i].Y;
				x3 = points[i + 1].X;
				y3 = points[i + 1].Y;
				x6 = points[i + 2].X;
				y6 = points[i + 2].Y;
				x4 = x2 + tension * ((x3 - x) / 2f);
				y4 = y2 + tension * ((y3 - y) / 2f);
				x5 = x3 - tension * ((x6 - x2) / 2f);
				y5 = y3 - tension * ((y6 - y2) / 2f);
				_path.CurveTo(x4, y4, x5, y5, x3, y3);
			}
			num += 2;
			x2 = points[num - 3].X;
			y2 = points[num - 3].Y;
			x3 = points[num - 2].X;
			y3 = points[num - 2].Y;
			x6 = points[num - 1].X;
			y6 = points[num - 1].Y;
			x4 = x3 + tension * ((x6 - x2) / 2f);
			y4 = y3 + tension * ((y6 - y2) / 2f);
			x5 = x6 - tension * ((x6 - x3) / 2f);
			y5 = y6 - tension * ((y6 - y3) / 2f);
			_path.CurveTo(x4, y4, x5, y5, x6, y6);
			if (flag)
			{
				DrawPath(fill: false, stroke: true);
				_path = null;
			}
		}

		public void DrawEllipse(float x, float y, float width, float height, PaintMode mode)
		{
			if (width <= 0f || height <= 0f)
			{
				return;
			}
			FlushText();
			bool flag = false;
			if (_path == null)
			{
				_path = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Path();
				_paintMode = mode;
				flag = true;
			}
			float num = width / 2f;
			float num2 = height / 2f;
			float num3 = x + num;
			float num4 = y + num2;
			float num5 = 0f;
			float num6 = 360f;
			bool flag2 = true;
			for (; num5 < num6; num5 += 90f)
			{
				float num7;
				float num8;
				if (num6 - num5 < 90f)
				{
					num7 = num5;
					num8 = num6;
				}
				else
				{
					num7 = num5;
					num8 = num7 + 90f;
				}
				num7 = (float)((double)num7 * (Math.PI / 180.0));
				num8 = (float)((double)num8 * (Math.PI / 180.0));
				float num9 = (float)Math.Sin(num7);
				float num10 = (float)Math.Cos(num7);
				float num11 = (float)Math.Sin(num8);
				float num12 = (float)Math.Cos(num8);
				float num13 = 4f * (float)(1.0 - Math.Cos((num8 - num7) / 2f)) / (float)Math.Sin((num8 - num7) / 2f) / 3f;
				float x2 = num * num10 + num3;
				float y2 = num2 * num9 + num4;
				float x3 = num * (num10 - num13 * num9) + num3;
				float y3 = num2 * (num9 + num13 * num10) + num4;
				float x4 = num * (num12 + num13 * num11) + num3;
				float y4 = num2 * (num11 - num13 * num12) + num4;
				float x5 = num * num12 + num3;

		public void DrawImage(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image, float x, float y, float width, float height, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color transparentColor, float alpha)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("image");
			}
			if (alpha < 0f || alpha > 1f)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("alpha", "[0.0, 1.0]");
			}
			if (alpha != 0f)
			{
				FlushText();
				Image image2 = _page.GetImage(image, transparentColor);
				_writer.StartElement("Path");
				_freshState = false;
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Path path = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Path();
				if (width < 0.5f)
				{
					width = 0.5f;
				}
				if (height < 0.5f)
				{
					height = 0.5f;
				}
				path.MoveTo(x, y);
				path.LineTo(x + width, y);
				path.LineTo(x + width, y + height);
				path.LineTo(x, y + height);
				path.ClosePath();
				_writer.SetAttribute("Data", Converter.ToString(path));
				_writer.StartElement("Path.Fill");
				_writer.StartElement("ImageBrush");
				_writer.SetAttribute("ImageSource", image2.ResourceName(relative: true));
				_writer.SetAttribute("TileMode", "None");
				_writer.SetAttribute("Opacity", Converter.ToString(alpha, 3));
				_writer.SetAttribute("Viewbox", "0, 0, " + Converter.ToString(image.Width) + ", " + Converter.ToString(image.Height));
				_writer.SetAttribute("ViewboxUnits", "Absolute");
				_writer.SetAttribute("Viewport", "0, 0, " + Converter.ToString(image.Width) + ", " + Converter.ToString(image.Height));
				_writer.SetAttribute("ViewportUnits", "Absolute");
				_writer.SetAttribute("Transform", Converter.ToString(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix(width / (float)image.Width, 0f, 0f, height / (float)image.Height, x, y)));
				_writer.EndElement();
				_writer.EndElement();
				_writer.EndElement();
			}
		}

		public void DrawPie(float x, float y, float width, float height, float startAngle, float endAngle, PaintMode mode)
		{
			if (width <= 0f || height <= 0f)
			{
				return;
			}
			FlushText();
			while (endAngle < startAngle)
			{
				endAngle += 360f;
			}
			if (startAngle == endAngle)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (_path == null)
			{
				_path = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Path();
				_paintMode = mode;
				flag = true;
			}
			float num = width / 2f;
			float num2 = height / 2f;
			float num3 = x + num;
			float num4 = y + num2;
			_path.MoveTo(num3, num4);
			bool flag2 = true;
			while (startAngle < endAngle)
			{
				float num5;
				float num6;
				if (endAngle - startAngle < 90f)
				{
					num5 = startAngle;
					num6 = endAngle;
				}
				else
				{
					num5 = startAngle;
					num6 = num5 + 90f;
				}
				num5 = (float)((double)num5 * (Math.PI / 180.0));
				num6 = (float)((double)num6 * (Math.PI / 180.0));
				float num7 = (float)Math.Sin(num5);
				float num8 = (float)Math.Cos(num5);
				float num9 = (float)Math.Sin(num6);
				float num10 = (float)Math.Cos(num6);
				float num11 = 4f * (float)(1.0 - Math.Cos((num6 - num5) / 2f)) / (float)Math.Sin((num6 - num5) / 2f) / 3f;
				float x2 = num * num8 + num3;
				float y2 = num2 * num7 + num4;
				float x3 = num * (num8 - num11 * num7) + num3;
				float y3 = num2 * (num7 + num11 * num8) + num4;
				float x4 = num * (num10 + num11 * num9) + num3;
				float y4 = num2 * (num9 - num11 * num10) + num4;
				float x5 = num * num10 + num3;
				float y5 = num2 * num9 + num4;
				if (flag2)
				{
					flag2 = false;
					_path.LineTo(x2, y2);
				}
				_path.CurveTo(x3, y3, x4, y4, x5, y5);
				startAngle += 90f;
			}
			_path.ClosePath();
			if (flag)
			{
				if (_alternateFill)
				{
					_path.Mode = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FillMode.Alternate;
				}
				else
				{
					_path.Mode = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FillMode.Winding;
				}
				switch (_paintMode)
				{
				case PaintMode.Fill:
					DrawPath(fill: true, stroke: false);
					break;
				case PaintMode.Stroke:
					DrawPath(fill: false, stroke: true);
					break;
				case PaintMode.FillStroke:
					DrawPath(fill: true, stroke: true);
					break;
				case PaintMode.Clip:
					ClipPath();
					break;
				}
				_path = null;
			}
		}

		public void DrawRoundedRect(float x, float y, float width, float height, float ew, float eh, PaintMode mode)
		{
			if (width <= 0f || height <= 0f || ew < 0f || eh < 0f)
			{
				return;
			}
			FlushText();
			bool flag = false;
			if (_path == null)
			{
				_path = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Path();
				_paintMode = mode;
				flag = true;
			}
			float num = ew / 2f;
			float num2 = eh / 2f;
			float num3 = x + num;
			float num4 = x + width - num;
			float x2 = x + width;
			float num5 = y + num2;
			float x3 = x + width;
			float num6 = y + height - num2;
			float num7 = x + width - num;
			float y2 = y + height;
			float num8 = x + num;
			float y3 = y + height;
			float num9 = y + height - num2;
			float num10 = y + num2;
			float num11 = 0f;
			float num12 = (float)Math.PI / 2f;
			float num13 = (float)Math.Sin(num11);
			float num14 = (float)Math.Cos(num11);
			float num15 = (float)Math.Sin(num12);
			float num16 = (float)Math.Cos(num12);
			float num17 = 4f * (float)(1.0 - Math.Cos((num12 - num11) / 2f)) / (float)Math.Sin((num12 - num11) / 2f) / 3f;
			float num18 = num * (num16 + num17 * num15);
			float num19 = (0f - num2) * (num15 - num17 * num16);
			float num20 = num * (num14 - num17 * num13);
			float num21 = (0f - num2) * (num13 + num17 * num14);
			num18 += num4;
			num19 += num5;
			num20 += num4;
			num21 += num5;
			num11 = 4.712389f;
			num12 = (float)Math.PI * 2f;
			num13 = (float)Math.Sin(num11);
			num14 = (float)Math.Cos(num11);
			num15 = (float)Math.Sin(num12);
			num16 = (float)Math.Cos(num12);
			num17 = 4f * (float)(1.0 - Math.Cos((num12 - num11) / 2f)) / (float)Math.Sin((num12 - num11) / 2f) / 3f;
			float num22 = num * (num16 + num17 * num15);
			float num23 = (0f - num2) * (num15 - num17 * num16);
			float num24 = num * (num14 - num17 * num13);
			float num25 = (0f - num2) * (num13 + num17 * num14);
			num22 += num7;
			num23 += num6;
			num24 += num7;
			num25 += num6;
			num11 = (float)Math.PI;
			num12 = 4.712389f;
			num13 = (float)Math.Sin(num11);
			num14 = (float)Math.Cos(num11);
			num15 = (float)Math.Sin(num12);
			num16 = (float)Math.Cos(num12);
			num17 = 4f * (float)(1.0 - Math.Cos((num12 - num11) / 2f)) / (float)Math.Sin((num12 - num11) / 2f) / 3f;
			float num26 = num * (num16 + num17 * num15);
			float num27 = (0f - num2) * (num15 - num17 * num16);
			float num28 = num * (num14 - num17 * num13);
			float num29 = (0f - num2) * (num13 + num17 * num14);
			num26 += num8;
			num27 += num9;
			num28 += num8;
			num29 += num9;
			num11 = (float)Math.PI / 2f;
			num12 = (float)Math.PI;
			num13 = (float)Math.Sin(num11);
			num14 = (float)Math.Cos(num11);
			num15 = (float)Math.Sin(num12);
			num16 = (float)Math.Cos(num12);
			num17 = 4f * (float)(1.0 - Math.Cos((num12 - num11) / 2f)) / (float)Math.Sin((num12 - num11) / 2f) / 3f;
			float num30 = num * (num16 + num17 * num15);
			float num31 = (0f - num2) * (num15 - num17 * num16);
			float num32 = num * (num14 - num17 * num13);
			float num33 = (0f - num2) * (num13 + num17 * num14);
			num30 += num3;
			num31 += num10;
			num32 += num3;
			num33 += num10;
			_path.MoveTo(num3, y);
			_path.LineTo(num4, y);
			_path.CurveTo(num18, num19, num20, num21, x2, num5);
			_path.LineTo(x3, num6);
			_path.CurveTo(num22, num23, num24, num25, num7, y2);
			_path.LineTo(num8, y3);

			_path.LineTo(x, num10);
			_path.CurveTo(num30, num31, num32, num33, num3, y);

		public void DrawSpacing(float width)
		{
			_posX += width;
		}

		public void DrawString(string text)
		{
			DrawString(_posX, _posY, text);
		}

		public void DrawString(float x, float y, string text)
		{
			if (text == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("text");
			}
			if (_xpsFont == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_textState.Buffer.Count > 0)
			{
				int num = (int)(x * 100f);
				int num2 = (int)((_textState.X + _textState.Width + GetCharWidth(' ')) * 100f);
				int num3 = (int)(y * 100f);
				int num4 = (int)(_textState.Y * 100f);
				if (Math.Abs(num - num2) <= 1 && Math.Abs(num3 - num4) <= 1)
				{
					_textState.Buffer.Add(' ');
				}
				else
				{
					FlushText();
					_textState.X = x;
					_textState.Y = y;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				_textState.X = x;
				_textState.Y = y;
			}
			SetTextPosition(x, y);
			_posX = x + GetStringWidth(text);
			_posY = y;
			_textState.Buffer.Add(text);
			_textState.Width = _posX - _textState.X;
		}

					break;
				case PaintMode.Stroke:
					DrawPath(fill: false, stroke: true);
					break;
				case PaintMode.FillStroke:
					DrawPath(fill: true, stroke: true);
					break;
				case PaintMode.Clip:
					ClipPath();
					break;
				}
				_path = null;
			}
		}

		public void Flush()
		{
			FlushText();
			if (_underlineStarted)
			{
				EndUnderline();
			}
			if (_strikeoutStarted)
			{
				EndStrikeout();
			}
			Pen = null;
			Brush = null;
			Font = null;
			PopState();
			_writer.EndElement();
			_writer.Flush();
			_page.Attach();
		}

		public float GetCharWidth(char ch)
		{
			if (_xpsFont != null)
			{
				return _fontSize * _boldFactor * (float)_xpsFont.GlyphWidth(ch) / 1000f + _charSpacing;
			}
			return 0f;
		}

		public float GetStringWidth(string text)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			int length = text.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				char c = text[i];
				if (c < ' ')
				{
					c = ' ';
				}
				num += GetCharWidth(c);
			}
			return num;
		}

		}

		}

		public void Shear(float shearX, float shearY)
		{
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix matrix = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix();
			matrix.Shear(shearX, shearY, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.MatrixOrder.Prepend);
			Transform(matrix);
		}

		public void Skew(float skewX, float skewY)
		{
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix matrix = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix();
			matrix.Skew(skewX, skewY, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.MatrixOrder.Prepend);
			Transform(matrix);
		}

		public void StartHyperlink(string reference)
		{
			if (reference != null)
			{
				FlushText();
				_hyperlinkStarted = true;
				_xpsAction = new URIAction(reference);
			}
		}

		public void StartHyperlink(int pageIndex, float x, float y)
		{
			FlushText();
			XpsPage xpsPage = _page.Document.Pages[pageIndex];
			_hyperlinkStarted = true;
			_xpsAction = new GotoAction(xpsPage.GetTarget(x, y));
		}

		public void StartShape(PaintMode mode)
		{
			StartShape(mode, clipToBounds: false);
		}

		public void StartShape(PaintMode mode, bool clipToBounds)
		{
			if (_path == null)
			{
				FlushText();
				_path = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Path();
				_paintMode = mode;
				_clipToBounds = clipToBounds;
			}
		}

		public void Transform(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix matrix)
		{
			if (matrix == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("matrix");
			}
			FlushText();
			_matrix.Multiply(matrix, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.MatrixOrder.Prepend);
			if (_freshState)
			{
				_writer.SetAttribute("RenderTransform", matrix);
				_freshState = false;
			}
			else
			{
				_writer.StartElement("Canvas");
				_writer.SetAttribute("RenderTransform", matrix);
				_states.Push(new DummyState());
			}
		}

		public void Translate(float offsetX, float offsetY)
		{
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix matrix = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix();
			matrix.Translate(offsetX, offsetY, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.MatrixOrder.Prepend);
			Transform(matrix);
		}

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush BoundIndirectBrush(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Rectangle rectangle)
		{
			if (rectangle.Width <= 0f || rectangle.Height <= 0f)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (_underlineStarted)
			{
				EndUnderline();
				StartUnderline();
			}
			if (_strikeoutStarted)
			{
				EndStrikeout();
				StartStrikeout();
			}
			return _indirectBrush.SetBounds(rectangle.X, rectangle.Y, rectangle.Width, rectangle.Height);
		}

		private void ClipPath()
		{
			if (_freshState)
			{
				_writer.SetAttribute("Clip", Converter.ToString(_path));
				_freshState = false;
			}
			else
			{
				_writer.StartElement("Canvas");
				_writer.SetAttribute("Clip", Converter.ToString(_path));
				_states.Push(new DummyState());
			}
		}

		private void DrawPath(bool fill, bool stroke)
		{
			_writer.StartElement("Path");
			_freshState = false;
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush brush = _brush;
			bool flag = true;
			if (fill)
			{
				if (_indirectBrush != null)
				{
					brush = BoundIndirectBrush(_path.GetBounds());
				}
				flag = SaveBrush(brush);
			}
			if (stroke)
			{
				SavePen(_pen);
			}
			_writer.SetAttribute("Data", Converter.ToString(_path));
			if (!flag)
			{
				SaveBrush("Path.Fill", brush);
			}
			_writer.EndElement();
		}

		private void EndStrikeout()
		{
			if (!_strikeoutStarted)
			{
				return;
			}
			_strikeoutStarted = false;
			int num = (int)(_strikeoutX * 100f);
			int num2 = (int)(_posX * 100f);
			if (Math.Abs(num - num2) > 1)
			{
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen pen = _pen;
				float num3 = _fontSize / 10f;
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color color = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Colors.Black;
				if (_brush.Type == BrushType.SolidColor)
				{
					color = ((SolidColorBrush)_brush).Color;
				}
				if ((_font.Style & Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.DoubleStrikeout) == Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.DoubleStrikeout)
				{
					num3 /= 2f;
					Pen = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen(color, num3);
					DrawLine(_strikeoutX, _strikeoutY - num3, _posX - _charSpacing, _strikeoutY - num3);
					DrawLine(_strikeoutX, _strikeoutY + num3 * 1.5f, _posX - _charSpacing, _strikeoutY + num3 * 1.5f);
				}
				else
				{
					Pen = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen(color, num3);
					DrawLine(_strikeoutX, _strikeoutY, _posX - _charSpacing, _strikeoutY);
				}
				Pen = pen;
			}
			_strikeoutX = 0f;
			_strikeoutY = 0f;
		}

		private void EndUnderline()
		{
			if (!_underlineStarted)
			{
				return;
			}
			_underlineStarted = false;
			int num = (int)(_underlineX * 100f);
			int num2 = (int)(_posX * 100f);
			if (Math.Abs(num - num2) > 1)
			{
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen pen = _pen;
				float num3 = _fontSize / 10f;
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color color = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Colors.Black;
				if (_brush.Type == BrushType.SolidColor)
				{
					color = ((SolidColorBrush)_brush).Color;
				}
				if ((_font.Style & Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.DoubleUnderline) == Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.DoubleUnderline)
				{
					num3 /= 2f;
					Pen = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen(color, num3);
					DrawLine(_underlineX, _underlineY - num3 * 2f, _posX - _charSpacing, _underlineY - num3 * 2f);
					DrawLine(_underlineX, _underlineY + num3 / 2f, _posX - _charSpacing, _underlineY + num3 / 2f);
				}
				else
				{
					Pen = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen(color, num3);
					DrawLine(_underlineX, _underlineY, _posX - _charSpacing, _underlineY);
				}
				Pen = pen;
			}
			_underlineX = 0f;
			_underlineY = 0f;
		}

		private void FlushText()
		{
			if (_textState.Flushing || _textState.Buffer.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			_textState.Flushing = true;
			float num = _textState.X;
			float y = _textState.Y;
			float num2 = _textState.Width;
			if (_hyperlinkStarted && !_hyperlinkPaused)
			{
				if (_charSpacing < 0f)
				{
					num2 -= _charSpacing;
				}
				AddHyperlinkArea(num, y, num2, _fontHeight);
			}
			if (_brush == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush brush = _brush;
			if (_indirectBrush != null)
			{
				brush = (((_xpsFont.Style & Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Italic) != Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Italic) ? BoundIndirectBrush(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Rectangle(num, y, num2, _fontHeight)) : BoundIndirectBrush(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Rectangle(num, y, num2 + _fontHeight * 0.15f, _fontHeight)));
			}
			CharBuffer charBuffer = new CharBuffer();
			CharBuffer charBuffer2 = new CharBuffer();
			if (_textState.Buffer[0] == '{')
			{
				charBuffer.Add("{}");
			}
			if (_charSpacing == 0f)
			{
				foreach (char item in (IEnumerable<char>)_textState.Buffer)
				{
					if (item < ' ')
					{
						charBuffer.Add(' ');
					}
					else
					{
						charBuffer.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				int num3 = _textState.Buffer.Count;
				foreach (char item2 in (IEnumerable<char>)_textState.Buffer)
				{
					if (item2 < ' ')
					{
						charBuffer.Add(' ');
					}
					else
					{
						charBuffer.Add(item2);
					}
					charBuffer2.Add(',');
					charBuffer2.Add(Converter.ToString(GetCharWidth(item2) * 100f / _fontSize / _boldFactor, 3));
					num3--;
					if (num3 > 0)
					{
						charBuffer2.Add(';');
					}
				}
			}
			_writer.StartElement("Glyphs");
			_freshState = false;
			y += _fontAscent;
			if (_boldFactor != 1f || _italicFactor != 0f)
			{
				num = (num + y * _italicFactor) / _boldFactor;
				_writer.SetAttribute("RenderTransform", new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix(_boldFactor, 0f, 0f - _italicFactor, 1f, 0f, 0f));
			}
			_writer.SetAttribute("OriginX", num);
			_writer.SetAttribute("OriginY", y);
			_writer.SetAttribute("FontRenderingEmSize", _fontSize);
			_writer.SetAttribute("FontUri", _xpsFont.ResourceName(relative: true));
			_writer.SetAttribute("UnicodeString", charBuffer.ToString());
			if (charBuffer2.Count > 0)
			{
				_writer.SetAttribute("Indices", charBuffer2.ToString());
			}
			if (!SaveBrush(brush))
			{
				SaveBrush("Glyphs.Fill", brush);
			}
			_writer.EndElement();
			_textState.Reset();
		}

		private void PushState()
		{
			_writer.StartElement("Canvas");
			_freshState = true;
			RealState realState = new RealState();
			realState.Font = _font;
			realState.Brush = _brush;
			realState.Pen = _pen;
			realState.Matrix = _matrix.Clone();
			realState.CharSpacing = _charSpacing;
			realState.AlternateFill = _alternateFill;
			_states.Push(realState);
		}

		private void PopState()
		{
			while (_states.Count > 0)
			{
				State state = _states.Pop();
				_writer.EndElement();
				_freshState = false;
				if (state.Type == StateType.Real)
				{
					RealState realState = (RealState)state;
					Font = realState.Font;
					Brush = realState.Brush;
					Pen = realState.Pen;
					_matrix = realState.Matrix;
					_charSpacing = realState.CharSpacing;
					_alternateFill = realState.AlternateFill;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool SaveBrush(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush brush)
		{
			if (brush == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (brush.Type == BrushType.SolidColor)
			{
				_writer.SetAttribute("Fill", ((SolidColorBrush)brush).Color.ToHex());
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SaveBrush(string tag, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush brush)
		{
			if (brush == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_writer.StartElement(tag);
			switch (brush.Type)
			{
			case BrushType.LinearGradientDirect:
			{
				LinearGradientDirectBrush linearGradientDirectBrush = (LinearGradientDirectBrush)brush;
				_writer.StartElement("LinearGradientBrush");
				_writer.SetAttribute("MappingMode", "Absolute");
				_writer.SetAttribute("StartPoint", Converter.ToString(linearGradientDirectBrush.Rectangle.X, 3) + ", 0");
				_writer.SetAttribute("EndPoint", Converter.ToString(linearGradientDirectBrush.Rectangle.X + linearGradientDirectBrush.Rectangle.Width, 3) + ", 0");
				_writer.SetAttribute("Transform", Converter.ToString(linearGradientDirectBrush.Transform));
				_writer.StartElement("LinearGradientBrush.GradientStops");
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.ColorBlend colorBlend2 = linearGradientDirectBrush.Blend.Complete();
				foreach (ColorBlendEntry item in colorBlend2)
				{
					_writer.StartElement("GradientStop");
					_writer.SetAttribute("Color", item.Color.ToHex());
					_writer.SetAttribute("Offset", item.Position);
					_writer.EndElement();
				}
				_writer.EndElement();
				_writer.EndElement();
				break;
			}
			case BrushType.RadialGradientDirect:
			{
				RadialGradientDirectBrush radialGradientDirectBrush = (RadialGradientDirectBrush)brush;
				float num2 = Math.Max(radialGradientDirectBrush.RadiusX, radialGradientDirectBrush.RadiusY);
				float num3 = radialGradientDirectBrush.RadiusX / num2;
				float num4 = radialGradientDirectBrush.RadiusY / num2;
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point point = radialGradientDirectBrush.Focus.Clone();
				point.X = radialGradientDirectBrush.Center.X + (point.X - radialGradientDirectBrush.Center.X) / num3;
				point.Y = radialGradientDirectBrush.Center.Y + (point.Y - radialGradientDirectBrush.Center.Y) / num4;
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix matrix = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix();
				matrix.Multiply(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix(1f, 0f, 0f, 1f, 0f - radialGradientDirectBrush.Center.X, 0f - radialGradientDirectBrush.Center.Y), Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.MatrixOrder.Append);
				matrix.Multiply(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix(num3, 0f, 0f, num4, 0f, 0f), Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.MatrixOrder.Append);
				matrix.Multiply(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix(1f, 0f, 0f, 1f, radialGradientDirectBrush.Center.X, radialGradientDirectBrush.Center.Y), Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.MatrixOrder.Append);
				matrix.Multiply(radialGradientDirectBrush.Transform, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.MatrixOrder.Append);
				_writer.StartElement("RadialGradientBrush");
				_writer.SetAttribute("MappingMode", "Absolute");
				_writer.SetAttribute("Center", Converter.ToString(radialGradientDirectBrush.Center.X, 3) + ", " + Converter.ToString(radialGradientDirectBrush.Center.Y, 3));
				_writer.SetAttribute("GradientOrigin", Converter.ToString(point.X, 3) + ", " + Converter.ToString(point.Y, 3));
				_writer.SetAttribute("RadiusX", Converter.ToString(num2, 3));
				_writer.SetAttribute("RadiusY", Converter.ToString(num2, 3));
				_writer.SetAttribute("Transform", Converter.ToString(matrix));
				_writer.StartElement("RadialGradientBrush.GradientStops");
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.ColorBlend colorBlend = radialGradientDirectBrush.Blend.Complete();
				int num5 = colorBlend.Count;
				while (num5 > 0)
				{
					num5--;
					ColorBlendEntry colorBlendEntry = colorBlend[num5];
					_writer.StartElement("GradientStop");
					_writer.SetAttribute("Color", colorBlendEntry.Color.ToHex());
					_writer.SetAttribute("Offset", 1f - colorBlendEntry.Position);
					_writer.EndElement();
				}
				_writer.EndElement();
				_writer.EndElement();
				break;
			}
			case BrushType.TextureDirect:
			{
				TextureDirectBrush textureDirectBrush = (TextureDirectBrush)brush;
				Image image3 = _page.GetImage(textureDirectBrush.Image, null);
				_writer.StartElement("ImageBrush");
				_writer.SetAttribute("ImageSource", image3.ResourceName(relative: true));
				_writer.SetAttribute("TileMode", "Tile");
				_writer.SetAttribute("Viewbox", "0, 0, " + Converter.ToString(textureDirectBrush.Image.Width) + ", " + Converter.ToString(textureDirectBrush.Image.Height));
				_writer.SetAttribute("ViewboxUnits", "Absolute");
				_writer.SetAttribute("Viewport", "0, 0, " + Converter.ToString(textureDirectBrush.Image.Width) + ", " + Converter.ToString(textureDirectBrush.Image.Height));
				_writer.SetAttribute("ViewportUnits", "Absolute");
				_writer.SetAttribute("Transform", Converter.ToString(textureDirectBrush.Transform));
				_writer.EndElement();
				break;
			}
			case BrushType.Hatch:
			{
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.HatchBrush hatchBrush = (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.HatchBrush)brush;
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color backColor = hatchBrush.BackColor;
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color foreColor = hatchBrush.ForeColor;
				byte[] stylePattern = hatchBrush.GetStylePattern();
				int num = stylePattern.Length;
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image(8, num);
				image.Preferences.Compressor = ImageCompressors.Flate;
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					byte b = stylePattern[i];
					for (int j = 0; j < 8; j++)
					{
						if ((b & 0x80) == 0)
						{
							image.SetPixel(j, i, backColor);
						}
						else
						{
							image.SetPixel(j, i, foreColor);
						}
						b <<= 1;
					}
				}
				Image image2 = _page.GetImage(image, null);
				_writer.StartElement("ImageBrush");
				_writer.SetAttribute("ImageSource", image2.ResourceName(relative: true));
				_writer.SetAttribute("TileMode", "Tile");
				_writer.SetAttribute("Viewbox", "0, 0, " + Converter.ToString(image.Width) + ", " + Converter.ToString(image.Height));
				_writer.SetAttribute("ViewboxUnits", "Absolute");
				_writer.SetAttribute("Viewport", "0, 0, " + Converter.ToString(image.Width) + ", " + Converter.ToString(image.Height));
				_writer.SetAttribute("ViewportUnits", "Absolute");
				_writer.EndElement();
				break;
			}
			}
			_writer.EndElement();
		}

		private void SavePen(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen pen)
		{
			if (pen == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_writer.SetAttribute("Stroke", _pen.Color.ToHex());
			if (_pen.Width != 1f)
			{
				_writer.SetAttribute("StrokeThickness", _pen.Width);
			}
			if (_pen.Style != Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.DashStyle.Solid)
			{
				float[] stylePattern = _pen.GetStylePattern();
				CharBuffer charBuffer = new CharBuffer();
				int num = stylePattern.Length;
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					charBuffer.Add(Converter.ToString(Converter.PointsToPixels(stylePattern[i] / _pen.Width), 3));
					if (i < num - 1)
					{
						charBuffer.Add(" ");
					}
				}
				_writer.SetAttribute("StrokeDashArray", charBuffer.ToString());
			}
			if (_pen.Cap != Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.LineCap.Flat)
			{
				string value = _pen.Cap.ToString();
				_writer.SetAttribute("StrokeStartLineCap", value);
				_writer.SetAttribute("StrokeEndLineCap", value);
			}
			if (_pen.Join != Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.LineJoin.Miter)
			{
				_writer.SetAttribute("StrokeLineJoin", _pen.Join.ToString());
			}
			if (_pen.MiterLimit != 10f)
			{
				_writer.SetAttribute("StrokeMiterLimit", _pen.MiterLimit);
			}
		}

		private void SetTextPosition(float x, float y)
		{
			int num = (int)(_posX * 100f);
			int num2 = (int)(x * 100f);
			int num3 = (int)(_posY * 100f);
			int num4 = (int)(y * 100f);
			if (Math.Abs(num - num2) > 1 || Math.Abs(num3 - num4) > 1)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				bool flag2 = false;
				if (_underlineStarted)
				{
					flag = true;
					EndUnderline();
				}
				if (_strikeoutStarted)
				{
					flag2 = true;
					EndStrikeout();
				}
				_posX = x;
				_posY = y;
				if (flag)
				{
					StartUnderline();
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					StartStrikeout();
				}
			}
		}

		private void StartStrikeout()
		{
			if (!_strikeoutStarted)
			{
				_strikeoutStarted = true;
				_strikeoutX = _posX;
				_strikeoutY = _posY + _fontAscent - _fontSize / 3f;
			}
		}

		private void StartUnderline()
		{
			if (!_underlineStarted)
			{
				_underlineStarted = true;
				_underlineX = _posX;
				_underlineY = _posY + _fontAscent + _fontSize / 6f;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class Writer
	{
		protected MemoryStream _stream;

		private XmlTextWriter _writer;

		public MemoryStream Stream => _stream;

		public Writer()
		{
		}

		public Writer(MemoryStream stream)
		{
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("stream");
			}
			_stream = stream;
			_writer = new XmlTextWriter(_stream, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8);
			_writer.Formatting = Formatting.Indented;
			_writer.IndentChar = '\t';
			_writer.Indentation = 1;
			_writer.QuoteChar = '"';
		}

		public virtual void EndDocument()
		{
			_writer.WriteEndDocument();
		}

		public virtual void EndElement()
		{
			_writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		public virtual void Flush()
		{
			_writer.Flush();
		}

		public virtual void SetAttribute(string name, string value)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				_writer.WriteAttributeString(name, value);
			}
		}

		public virtual void SetAttribute(string name, int value)
		{
			_writer.WriteAttributeString(name, value.ToString());
		}

		public virtual void SetAttribute(string name, float value)
		{
			_writer.WriteAttributeString(name, Converter.ToString(value, 3));
		}

		public virtual void SetAttribute(string name, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				_writer.WriteAttributeString(name, Converter.ToString(value));
			}
		}

		public virtual void StartDocument()
		{
			_writer.WriteStartDocument();
		}

		public virtual void StartElement(string name)
		{
			_writer.WriteStartElement(name);
		}

		public virtual void StartElementWithNamespace(string name, string nmspace)
		{
			_writer.WriteStartElement(name, nmspace);
		}

		public virtual void WriteComment(string value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				_writer.WriteComment(value);
			}
		}

		public virtual void WriteContent(string value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				_writer.WriteString(value);
			}
		}

		public virtual void WriteContent(System.DateTime value)
		{
			_writer.WriteString(value.ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ"));
		}
	}

	internal class MarshalProxy
	{
		[SecurityCritical]
		internal static IntPtr AllocHGlobal(int cb)
		{
			return Marshal.AllocHGlobal(cb);
		}

		[SecurityCritical]
