	internal class FlateCompressor
	{
		private class Checksum
		{
			private static uint Base = 65521u;

			private uint _value;

			public uint Value => _value;

			public Checksum()
			{
				_value = 1u;
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				_value = 1u;
			}

			public void Update(byte[] buffer, int offset, int size)
			{
				uint num = _value & 0xFFFF;
				uint num2 = _value >> 16;
				while (size > 0)
				{
					int num3 = 3800;
					if (num3 > size)
					{
						num3 = size;
					}
					size -= num3;
					while (num3 > 0)
					{
						num += (uint)(buffer[offset++] & 0xFF);
						num2 += num;
						num3--;
					}
					num %= Base;
					num2 %= Base;
				}
				_value = (num2 << 16) | num;
			}
		}

		private Checksum _checksum;

		public FlateCompressor()
		{
			_checksum = new Checksum();
		}

		public MemoryStream Deflate(System.IO.Stream stream)
		{
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("stream");
			}
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			Deflate(stream, memoryStream);
			return memoryStream;
		}

		public void Deflate(System.IO.Stream input, System.IO.Stream output)
		{
			if (input == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("input");
			}
			if (output == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("output");
			}
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			byte[] array = new byte[(int)input.Length];
			using (DeflateStream deflateStream = new DeflateStream(memoryStream, CompressionMode.Compress))
			{
				input.Read(array, 0, array.Length);
				deflateStream.Write(array, 0, array.Length);
			}
			_checksum.Reset();
			_checksum.Update(array, 0, array.Length);
			array = memoryStream.ToArray();
			WriteShort(output, 18569);
			output.Write(array, 0, array.Length);
			WriteShort(output, (short)(_checksum.Value >> 16));
			WriteShort(output, (short)(_checksum.Value & 0xFFFF));
		}

		public static MemoryStream Inflate(System.IO.Stream stream)
		{
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("stream");
			}
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			Inflate(stream, memoryStream);
			return memoryStream;
		}

		public static void Inflate(System.IO.Stream input, System.IO.Stream output)
		{
			if (input == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("input");
			}
			if (output == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("output");
			}
			input.Position = 2L;
			byte[] array = new byte[1000];
			using DeflateStream deflateStream = new DeflateStream(input, CompressionMode.Decompress);
			while (true)
			{
				int num = deflateStream.Read(array, 0, array.Length);
				if (num == 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				output.Write(array, 0, num);
			}
		}

		private static void WriteShort(System.IO.Stream stream, short value)
		{
			byte value2 = (byte)(value >> 8);
			byte value3 = (byte)value;
			stream.WriteByte(value2);
			stream.WriteByte(value3);
		}
	}
	public class CharRange
	{
		private char _start;

		private char _end;

		public char End
		{
			get
			{
				return _end;
			}
			set
			{
				_end = value;
			}
		}

		public char Start
		{
			get
			{
				return _start;
			}
			set
			{
				_start = value;
			}
		}

		public CharRange()
			: this('\0', '\0')
		{
		}

		public CharRange(char start, char end)
		{
			_start = start;
			_end = end;
		}

		public bool Contains(char ch)
		{
			return Contains(ch, strong: true);
		}

		public bool Contains(char ch, bool strong)
		{
			if (strong)
			{
				if (ch >= _start && ch <= _end)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (ch > _start && ch < _end)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public static class Converter
	{
		private static NumberFormatInfo _nfi = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture.NumberFormat;

		private static DateTimeFormatInfo _dtfi = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture.DateTimeFormat;

		public static DateTimeFormatInfo DateTimeFormatInfo => _dtfi;

		public static NumberFormatInfo NumberFormatInfo => _nfi;

		public static float MillimetersToPoints(float mm)
		{
			return mm / 25.4f * 72f;
		}

		public static float PixelsToPoints(float pixels)
		{
			return pixels / 96f * 72f;
		}

		public static float PointsToMillimeters(float points)
		{
			return points / 72f * 25.4f;
		}

		public static float PointsToPixels(float points)
		{
			return points / 72f * 96f;
		}

		public static float PointsToTwips(float points)
		{
			return points * 20f;
		}

		public static string[] Split(string data)
		{
			if (data == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			CharBuffer charBuffer = new CharBuffer();
			foreach (char c in data)
			{
				if (c == ',')
				{
					list.Add(charBuffer.ToString().Trim());
					charBuffer.Clear();
				}
				else
				{
					charBuffer.Add(c);
				}
			}
			if (charBuffer.Count > 0)
			{
				list.Add(charBuffer.ToString().Trim());
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public static string ToBin(int value)
		{
			if (value == 0)
			{
				return "0";
			}
			int num = 32;
			char[] array = new char[num];
			int num2 = num - 1;
			uint num3 = (uint)value;
			int num4 = 1;
			while (num3 != 0)
			{
				int num5 = (int)(num3 & num4);
				array[num2] = Defs.HexDigits[num5];
				num2--;
				num3 >>= 1;
			}
			num2++;
			return new string(array, num2, num - num2);
		}

		public static int ToDigit(char ch, int radix)
		{
			int result = 0;
			switch (radix)
			{
			case 8:
				result = ch - 48;
				break;
			case 10:
				result = ch - 48;
				break;
			case 16:
				if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9')
				{
					result = ch - 48;
				}
				else if (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'f')
				{
					result = ch - 97 + 10;
				}
				else if (ch >= 'A' && ch <= 'F')
				{
					result = ch - 65 + 10;
				}
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static string ToHex(byte b)
		{
			return new string(new char[2]
			{
				Defs.HexDigits[b >> 4],
				Defs.HexDigits[b & 0xF]
			}, 0, 2);
		}

		public static string ToHex(int value)
		{
			if (value == 0)
			{
				return "0";
			}
			int num = 8;
			char[] array = new char[num];
			int num2 = num - 1;
			uint num3 = (uint)value;
			int num4 = 15;
			while (num3 != 0)
			{
				int num5 = (int)(num3 & num4);
				array[num2] = Defs.HexDigits[num5];
				num2--;
				num3 >>= 4;
			}
			num2++;
			return new string(array, num2, num - num2);
		}

		public static string ToLetterNumber(int number)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			char value = (char)(97 + (number - 1) % 26);
			stringBuilder.Append(value);
			while (number > 26)
			{
				number -= 26;
				stringBuilder.Append(value);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public static int ToInt(string s)
		{
			if (s == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("s");
			}
			int length = s.Length;
			switch (length)
			{
			case 0:
				return 0;
			case 1:
				return ToDigit(s[0], 10);
			default:
			{
				int num = 0;
				int i = 0;
				bool flag = false;
				if (s[i] == '-')
				{
					if (length == 2)
					{
						return -ToDigit(s[1], 10);
					}
					flag = true;
					i++;
				}
				int num2 = 10;
				if (s[i] == '0')
				{
					num2 = 8;
					i++;
					if (s[i] == 'x')
					{
						num2 = 16;
						i++;
					}
				}
				for (; i < length; i++)
				{
					char ch = s[i];
					num *= num2;
					num += ToDigit(ch, num2);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					num = -num;
				}
				return num;
			}
			}
		}

		public static string ToOctal(int value)
		{
			if (value == 0)
			{
				return "0";
			}
			int num = 12;
			char[] array = new char[num];
			int num2 = num - 1;
			uint num3 = (uint)value;
			int num4 = 7;
			while (num3 != 0)
			{
				int num5 = (int)(num3 & num4);
				array[num2] = Defs.HexDigits[num5];
				num2--;
				num3 >>= 3;
			}
			num2++;
			return new string(array, num2, num - num2);
		}

		public static float ToPoints(string s)
		{
			if (s == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("s");
			}
			if (s.EndsWith("pt"))
			{
				s = s.Substring(0, s.Length - 2);
				s = s.Trim();
				return Convert.ToSingle(s, _nfi);
			}
			if (s.EndsWith("px"))
			{
				s = s.Substring(0, s.Length - 2);
				s = s.Trim();
				return PixelsToPoints(Convert.ToSingle(s, _nfi));
			}
			if (s.EndsWith("tw"))
			{
				s = s.Substring(0, s.Length - 2);
				s = s.Trim();
				return TwipsToPoints(Convert.ToSingle(s, _nfi));
			}
			if (s.EndsWith("mm"))
			{
				s = s.Substring(0, s.Length - 2);
				s = s.Trim();
				return MillimetersToPoints(Convert.ToSingle(s, _nfi));
			}
			return Convert.ToSingle(s, _nfi);
		}

		public static string ToRomanNumber(int number)
		{
			string text = "";
			if (number < 1)
			{
				number = 1;
			}
			if (number > 5999)
			{
				number = 5999;
			}
			int num = (number - number % 1000) / 1000;
			number %= 1000;
			int num2 = (number - number % 100) / 100;
			number %= 100;
			int num3 = (number - number % 10) / 10;
			int num4 = number % 10;
			text += Defs.RomanThousands[num];
			text += Defs.RomanHundreds[num2];
			text += Defs.RomanTens[num3];
			return text + Defs.RomanUnits[num4];
		}

		public static string ToString(int value)
		{
			switch (value)
			{
			case int.MinValue:
				return "-2147483648";
			case int.MaxValue:
				return "2147483647";
			case 0:
				return "0";
			default:
			{
				int num = 12;
				char[] array = new char[num];
				bool flag = false;
				if (value < 0)
				{
					flag = true;
					value = -value;
				}
				int num2 = num - 1;
				while (value != 0)
				{
					int num3 = value % 10;
					array[num2--] = Defs.Digits[num3];
					value /= 10;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					array[num2] = '-';
				}
				else
				{
					num2++;
				}
				return new string(array, num2, num - num2);
			}
			}
		}

		public static string ToString(float value, int precision)
		{
			int num = precision + 2;
			char[] array = new char[num];
			array[0] = '0';
			array[1] = '.';
			for (int i = 2; i < num; i++)
			{
				array[i] = '#';
			}
			return value.ToString(new string(array), _nfi);
		}

		public static string ToString(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point[] points)

		internal static string ToString(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Path path)
		{
			if (path == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("path");
			}
			CharBuffer charBuffer = new CharBuffer();
			if (path.Mode == Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FillMode.Winding)
			{
				charBuffer.Add("F 1 ");
			}
			CommandType commandType = CommandType.MoveTo;
			int num = path.Commands.Count;
			foreach (IPathCommand command in path.Commands)
			{
				switch (command.Type)
				{
				case CommandType.MoveTo:
				{
					MoveToCommand moveToCommand = (MoveToCommand)command;
					charBuffer.Add("M ");
					charBuffer.Add(ToString(moveToCommand.X, 3));
					charBuffer.Add(", ");
					charBuffer.Add(ToString(moveToCommand.Y, 3));
					break;
				}
				case CommandType.LineTo:
				{
					LineToCommand lineToCommand = (LineToCommand)command;
					if (commandType != CommandType.LineTo)
					{
						charBuffer.Add("L ");
					}
					charBuffer.Add(ToString(lineToCommand.X, 3));
					charBuffer.Add(", ");
					charBuffer.Add(ToString(lineToCommand.Y, 3));
					break;
				}
				case CommandType.CurveTo:
				{
					CurveToCommand curveToCommand = (CurveToCommand)command;
					if (commandType != CommandType.CurveTo)
					{
						charBuffer.Add("C ");
					}
					charBuffer.Add(ToString(curveToCommand.X1, 3));
					charBuffer.Add(", ");
					charBuffer.Add(ToString(curveToCommand.Y1, 3));
					charBuffer.Add(" ");
					charBuffer.Add(ToString(curveToCommand.X2, 3));
					charBuffer.Add(", ");
					charBuffer.Add(ToString(curveToCommand.Y2, 3));
					charBuffer.Add(" ");
					charBuffer.Add(ToString(curveToCommand.X3, 3));
					charBuffer.Add(", ");
					charBuffer.Add(ToString(curveToCommand.Y3, 3));
					break;
				}
				case CommandType.ClosePath:
					charBuffer.Add("Z");
					break;
				}
				num--;
				if (num > 0)
				{
					charBuffer.Add(' ');
				}
				commandType = command.Type;
			}
			return charBuffer.ToString();
		}

		}

	internal class Reader : IReader
	{
		private MemoryStream _stream;

		public Reader(MemoryStream stream)
		{
			_stream = stream;
		}

		public void Close()
		{
			_stream = null;
		}

		public byte[] ReadBlock(int size)
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[size];
			_stream.Read(array, 0, size);
			return array;
		}

		public void ReadBlock(byte[] buffer)
		{
			ReadBlock(buffer, 0, buffer.Length);
		}

		public void ReadBlock(byte[] buffer, int size)
		{
			ReadBlock(buffer, 0, size);
		}

		public void ReadBlock(byte[] buffer, int offset, int size)
		{
			_stream.Read(buffer, offset, size);
		}

		public bool ReadBoolean()
		{
			int num = _stream.ReadByte();
			if (num == 1)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public int ReadByte()
		{
			return _stream.ReadByte();
		}

		public char ReadChar()
		{
			int num = _stream.ReadByte();
			int num2 = _stream.ReadByte();
			num <<= 8;
			return (char)(num | num2);
		}

		public float ReadFloat()
		{
			return BitConverter.ToSingle(new byte[4]
			{
				(byte)ReadByte(),
				(byte)ReadByte(),
				(byte)ReadByte(),
				(byte)ReadByte()
			}, 0);
		}

		public int ReadInt()
		{
			int num = _stream.ReadByte();
			int num2 = _stream.ReadByte();
			int num3 = _stream.ReadByte();
			int num4 = _stream.ReadByte();
			num <<= 24;
			num2 <<= 16;
			num3 <<= 8;
			return num | num2 | num3 | num4;
		}

		public short ReadShort()
		{
			int num = _stream.ReadByte();
			int num2 = _stream.ReadByte();
			num <<= 8;
			return (short)(num | num2);
		}
	}
	internal class Writer : IWriter
	{
		private FileBuffer _fb;

		private MemoryStream _stream;

		public Writer(FileBuffer fb)
		{
			_fb = fb;
			_stream = new MemoryStream();
		}

		public IMarker Close()
		{
			IMarker result = _fb.Write(_stream);
			_stream = null;
			return result;
		}

		public void WriteBlock(byte[] buffer)
		{
			_stream.Write(buffer, 0, buffer.Length);
		}

		public void WriteBlock(byte[] buffer, int size)
		{
			_stream.Write(buffer, 0, size);
		}

		public void WriteBlock(byte[] buffer, int offset, int size)
		{
			_stream.Write(buffer, offset, size);
		}

		public void WriteBoolean(bool value)
		{
			if (value)
			{
				_stream.WriteByte(1);
			}
			else
			{
				_stream.WriteByte(0);
			}
		}

		public void WriteByte(byte b)
		{
			_stream.WriteByte(b);
		}

		public void WriteChar(char value)
		{
			byte value2 = (byte)((int)value >> 8);
			byte value3 = (byte)value;

	public class FileBuffer
	{
		private static object _syncObject = new object();

		private string _fileName;

		private FileStream _stream;

		private FlateCompressor _compressor;

		public FileBuffer(string fileName)
		{
			if (fileName == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("fileName");
			}
			_fileName = fileName;
			_stream = new FileStream(_fileName, FileMode.Create, FileAccess.ReadWrite, FileShare.None);
			_compressor = new FlateCompressor();
		}

		public FileBuffer(FileStream fs)
		{
			_stream = fs;
			_compressor = new FlateCompressor();
		}

		internal MemoryStream Read(IMarker marker)
		{
			Marker marker2 = (Marker)marker;
			byte[] array = new byte[marker2.Size];
			lock (_syncObject)
			{
				_stream.Position = marker2.Position;
				_stream.Read(array, 0, array.Length);
			}
			MemoryStream stream = new MemoryStream(array);
			stream = FlateCompressor.Inflate(stream);
			stream.Position = 0L;
			return stream;
		}

		internal IMarker Write(MemoryStream stream)
		{
			Marker marker = null;
			lock (_syncObject)
			{
				stream.Position = 0L;
				stream = _compressor.Deflate(stream);
				_stream.Position = _stream.Length;
				marker = new Marker(this, _stream.Position, stream.Length);
				_stream.Write(stream.ToArray(), 0, (int)stream.Length);
				return marker;
			}
		}

		public void Close()
		{
			if (_stream != null)
			{
				_stream.Close();
			}
			File.Delete(_fileName);
			_stream = null;
			_compressor = null;
		}

		public IReader GetReader(IMarker marker)
		{
			if (marker == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("marker");
			}
			return new Reader(Read(marker));
		}

		public IWriter GetWriter()
		{
			return new Writer(this);
		}

	public class HashSet<T>
	{
		public class HashSetEntry
		{
			private T _item;

			private HashSetEntry _next;

			public T Item
			{
				get
				{
					return _item;
				}
				set
				{
					_item = value;
				}
			}

			public HashSetEntry Next
			{
				get
				{
					return _next;
				}
				set
				{
					_next = value;
				}
			}

			public HashSetEntry()
				: this(default(T))
			{
			}

			public HashSetEntry(T item)
			{
				_item = item;
			}
		}

		private int _capacity;

		private HashSetEntry[] _buffer;

		private int _count;

		private IEqualityComparer<T> _comparer;

		public IEqualityComparer<T> Comparer => _comparer;

		public int Count => _count;

		public List<T> Items
		{
			get
			{
				List<T> list = new List<T>(_count);
				for (int i = 0; i < _capacity; i++)
				{
					HashSetEntry hashSetEntry = _buffer[i];
					if (hashSetEntry != null)
					{
						list.Add(hashSetEntry.Item);
						for (hashSetEntry = hashSetEntry.Next; hashSetEntry != null; hashSetEntry = hashSetEntry.Next)
						{
							list.Add(hashSetEntry.Item);
						}
					}
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		public HashSet()
			: this(10, (IEqualityComparer<T>)null)
		{
		}

		public HashSet(IEqualityComparer<T> comparer)
			: this(10, comparer)
		{
		}

		public HashSet(int capacity)
			: this(capacity, (IEqualityComparer<T>)null)
		{
		}

		public HashSet(int capacity, IEqualityComparer<T> comparer)
		{
			if (capacity < 1)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("capacity", "[1, ...]");
			}
			_capacity = capacity;
			_buffer = new HashSetEntry[_capacity];
			if (comparer != null)
			{
				_comparer = comparer;
			}
			else
			{
				_comparer = EqualityComparer<T>.Default;
			}
		}

		public void Add(T item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("item");
			}
			int num = (int)((uint)_comparer.GetHashCode(item) % _capacity);
			HashSetEntry hashSetEntry = _buffer[num];
			if (hashSetEntry == null)
			{
				_buffer[num] = new HashSetEntry(item);
				_count++;
				return;
			}
			HashSetEntry hashSetEntry2 = null;
			while (hashSetEntry != null)
			{
				if (_comparer.Equals(item, hashSetEntry.Item))
				{
					return;
				}
				hashSetEntry2 = hashSetEntry;
				hashSetEntry = hashSetEntry.Next;
			}
			hashSetEntry2.Next = new HashSetEntry(item);
			_count++;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			if (_count > 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < _capacity; i++)
				{
					_buffer[i] = null;
				}
				_count = 0;
			}
		}

		public bool Contains(T item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("item");
			}
			int num = (int)((uint)_comparer.GetHashCode(item) % _capacity);
			for (HashSetEntry hashSetEntry = _buffer[num]; hashSetEntry != null; hashSetEntry = hashSetEntry.Next)
			{
				if (_comparer.Equals(item, hashSetEntry.Item))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Remove(T item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("item");
			}
			int num = (int)((uint)_comparer.GetHashCode(item) % _capacity);
			HashSetEntry hashSetEntry = _buffer[num];
			if (hashSetEntry == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			HashSetEntry hashSetEntry2 = null;
			for (HashSetEntry hashSetEntry3 = hashSetEntry; hashSetEntry3 != null; hashSetEntry3 = hashSetEntry3.Next)
			{
				if (_comparer.Equals(item, hashSetEntry3.Item))
				{
					if (hashSetEntry3 != hashSetEntry)
					{
						hashSetEntry2.Next = hashSetEntry3.Next;
					}
					else
					{
						_buffer[num] = hashSetEntry.Next;
					}
					_count--;
					break;
				}
				hashSetEntry2 = hashSetEntry3;
			}
		}

	internal static class Utilities
	{
		private enum BidiDirection
		{
			None,
			LeftToRight,
			RightToLeft
		}

		private static bool failedToGetreflectionPermissions;

		private static BindingFlags getBidiCategoryBindingFlags = BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.InvokeMethod;

		private static Type typeCharUnicodeInfo;

		private static MethodInfo getBidiCategoryMethodInfo;

		private static bool canInvokeGetBidiCategoryMethod = true;

		private static Type TypeCharUnicodeInfo
		{
			get
			{
				if (typeCharUnicodeInfo == null)
				{
					typeCharUnicodeInfo = typeof(CharUnicodeInfo);
				}
				return typeCharUnicodeInfo;
			}
		}

		private static MethodInfo GetBidiCategoryMethodInfo
		{
			get
			{
				if (getBidiCategoryMethodInfo == null)
				{
					getBidiCategoryMethodInfo = TypeCharUnicodeInfo.GetMethod("GetBidiCategory", getBidiCategoryBindingFlags);
				}
				return getBidiCategoryMethodInfo;
			}
		}

		internal static object GetWeakReferenceTarget(WeakReference weakRef)
		{
			try
			{
				if (weakRef == null || !weakRef.IsAlive)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return weakRef.Target;
			}
			catch (InvalidOperationException)
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		internal static char[] GetUnicodeSafeCharArray(string text)
		{
			if (failedToGetreflectionPermissions)
			{
				return text.ToCharArray();
			}
			ReflectionPermission reflectionPermission = new ReflectionPermission(ReflectionPermissionFlag.MemberAccess);
			List<char> list;
			try
			{
				reflectionPermission.Assert();
				BidiDirection bidiDirection = BidiDirection.LeftToRight;
				int index = 0;
				list = new List<char>(text.Length);
				char[] array = text.ToCharArray();
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					char item = array[i];
					BidiDirection bidiCategoryDirection = GetBidiCategoryDirection(text, i);
					if (bidiCategoryDirection != BidiDirection.None && bidiCategoryDirection != bidiDirection)
					{
						bidiDirection = bidiCategoryDirection;
						index = i;
					}
					switch (bidiDirection)
					{
					case BidiDirection.LeftToRight:
						list.Add(item);
						break;
					case BidiDirection.RightToLeft:
						list.Insert(index, item);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				failedToGetreflectionPermissions = true;
				return text.ToCharArray();
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private static BidiDirection GetBidiCategoryDirection(string text, int charIndex)
		{
			object[] parameters = new object[2] { text, charIndex };
			int num = 0;
			if (canInvokeGetBidiCategoryMethod)
			{
				try
				{
					if (GetBidiCategoryMethodInfo != null)
					{
						object obj = GetBidiCategoryMethodInfo.Invoke(TypeCharUnicodeInfo, getBidiCategoryBindingFlags, null, parameters, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
						num = (int)obj;
					}
					else
					{
						canInvokeGetBidiCategoryMethod = false;
						DebugProxy.Fail("Failed to get GetBidiCategoryMethodInfo");
					}
				}
				catch (MemberAccessException)
				{
					canInvokeGetBidiCategoryMethod = false;
					DebugProxy.Fail("Failed to invoke GetBidiCategoryMethod");
				}
			}
			switch (num)
			{
			case 0:
			case 1:
			case 2:
				return BidiDirection.LeftToRight;
			case 3:
			case 4:
			case 5:
			case 6:
				return BidiDirection.RightToLeft;
			case 7:
			case 8:
			case 9:
			case 10:
			case 11:
			case 12:
			case 13:
			case 14:
			case 15:
			case 16:
			case 17:
			case 18:
				return BidiDirection.None;
			default:
				DebugProxy.Fail("Unknown Bidi Category");
				return BidiDirection.LeftToRight;
			}
		}
	}

	internal class CMap
	{
		private ushort _numEncTabs;

		private CMapFormat0 _mac;

		private CMapFormat4 _win;

		public CMapFormat0 Mac => _mac;

		public CMapFormat4 Win => _win;

		public void Load(Reader reader)
		{
			long position = reader.Stream.Position;
			reader.ReadUShort();
			_numEncTabs = reader.ReadUShort();
			for (int i = 0; i < _numEncTabs; i++)
			{
				ushort num = reader.ReadUShort();
				ushort encodingId = reader.ReadUShort();
				uint num2 = reader.ReadUInt();
				long position2 = reader.Stream.Position;
				reader.Stream.Position = position + num2;
				switch (num)
				{
				case 1:
					if (_mac == null)
					{
						_mac = new CMapFormat0();
						_mac.Load(reader);
					}
					break;
				case 3:
					if (_win == null)
					{
						_win = new CMapFormat4();
						_win.EncodingId = encodingId;
						_win.Load(reader);
					}
					break;
				}
				reader.Stream.Position = position2;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class CMapFormat0
	{
		private byte[] _glyphIdArray;

		public byte[] GlyphIdArray => _glyphIdArray;

		public void Load(Reader reader)
		{
			reader.ReadUShort();
			reader.ReadUShort();
			reader.ReadUShort();
			_glyphIdArray = reader.ReadBlock(256);
		}
	}
	internal class CMapFormat4
	{
		private ushort _encodingId;

		private ushort _length;

		private ushort _segCountX2;

		private ushort[] _endCount;

		private ushort[] _startCount;

		private short[] _idDelta;

		private ushort[] _idRangeOffs;

		private ushort[] _glyphIdArray;

		public ushort EncodingId
		{
			get
			{
				return _encodingId;
			}
			set
			{
				_encodingId = value;
			}
		}

		public ushort[] EndCount => _endCount;

		public ushort[] GlyphIdArray => _glyphIdArray;

		public short[] IdDelta => _idDelta;

		public ushort[] IdRangeOffs => _idRangeOffs;

		public ushort Length => _length;

		public ushort SegCountX2 => _segCountX2;

		public ushort[] StartCount => _startCount;

		public void Load(Reader reader)
		{
			reader.ReadUShort();
			_length = reader.ReadUShort();
			reader.ReadUShort();
			_segCountX2 = reader.ReadUShort();
			reader.ReadUShort();
			reader.ReadUShort();
			reader.ReadUShort();
			int num = _segCountX2 / 2;
			int num2 = (_length - (16 + 8 * num)) / 2;
			_endCount = new ushort[num];
			_startCount = new ushort[num];
			_idDelta = new short[num];
			_idRangeOffs = new ushort[num];
			if (num2 > 0)
			{
				_glyphIdArray = new ushort[num2];
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				_endCount[i] = reader.ReadUShort();
			}
			reader.Stream.Position += 2L;
			for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
			{
				_startCount[j] = reader.ReadUShort();
			}
			for (int k = 0; k < num; k++)
			{
				_idDelta[k] = reader.ReadShort();
			}
			for (int l = 0; l < num; l++)
			{
				_idRangeOffs[l] = reader.ReadUShort();
			}
			for (int m = 0; m < num2; m++)
			{
				_glyphIdArray[m] = reader.ReadUShort();
			}
		}
	}

	internal class Descriptor
	{
		private string _fontName;

		private int _fontAscent;

		private int _fontDescent;

		private int _fontCapHeight;

		private ulong _fontFlags;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Rectangle _fontBBox;

		private float _fontItalicAngle;

		private int _fontStemVertical;

		private int _fontStemHorizontal;

		public int FontAscent
		{
			get
			{
				return _fontAscent;
			}
			set
			{
				_fontAscent = value;
			}
		}

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Rectangle FontBBox
		{
			get
			{
				return _fontBBox;
			}
			set
			{
				_fontBBox = value;
			}
		}

		public int FontCapHeight
		{
			get
			{
				return _fontCapHeight;

	internal class Directory

		}

	internal class FontHashKey
	{
		private string _name;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle _style;

		public string Name => _name;

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle Style => _style;

		public FontHashKey(string name, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle style)
		{
			if (name == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("name");
			}
			_name = name;
			_style = style;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object key)
		{
			if (key == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (key == this)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (key is FontHashKey)
			{
				FontHashKey fontHashKey = (FontHashKey)key;
				if (_name == fontHashKey.Name && _style == fontHashKey.Style)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _name.GetHashCode() ^ _style.GetHashCode();
		}
	}

		public int EmToMP(int value, bool round)

		public virtual void Subset(bool regular)
		{
			if (_corrupted)
			{
				return;
			}
			uint offset = _directories[Defs.TagGlyf].Offset;
			List<ushort> items = _activeGlyphs.Items;
			ushort item = 0;
			if (!_activeGlyphs.Contains(item))
			{
				_activeGlyphs.Add(item);
				items.Add(item);
			}
			Reader reader = new Reader(_stream);
			_stream.Position = offset;
			int i = 0;
			uint num;
			for (int count = items.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				item = items[i];
				num = _tableLoca.Offsets[item];
				if (num == _tableLoca.Offsets[item + 1])
				{
					continue;
				}
				_stream.Position = offset + num;
				int num2 = reader.ReadShort();
				if (num2 >= 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				_stream.Position += 8L;
				bool flag = true;
				while (flag)
				{
					uint num3 = reader.ReadUShort();
					ushort item2 = reader.ReadUShort();
					if (!_activeGlyphs.Contains(item2))
					{
						_activeGlyphs.Add(item2);
						items.Add(item2);
					}
					if ((num3 & 1) != 0)
					{
						_stream.Position += 4L;
					}
					else
					{
						_stream.Position += 2L;
					}
					if ((num3 & 8) != 0)
					{
						_stream.Position += 2L;
					}
					else if ((num3 & 0x40) != 0)
					{
						_stream.Position += 4L;
					}
					else if ((num3 & 0x80) != 0)
					{
						_stream.Position += 8L;
					}
					if ((num3 & 0x20) == 0)
					{
						flag = false;
					}
				}
			}
			items.Sort();
			uint num4 = 0u;
			i = 0;
			for (int count = items.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				item = items[i];
				num4 += _tableLoca.Offsets[item + 1] - _tableLoca.Offsets[item];
			}
			uint num5 = num4;
			num4 = (uint)((num4 + 3) & -4);
			byte[] buffer = new byte[num4];
			uint[] array = new uint[_tableLoca.Length];
			num = 0u;

					{

			}

			Writer writer = new Writer(stream);

				if (_tableLoca.Short)
				{
					writer.WriteUShort((ushort)(array[i] / 2));
				}
				else
				{
					writer.WriteUInt(array[i]);
				}
			}
			List<uint> list = new List<uint>(25);
			if (regular)
			{
				list.Add(Defs.TagName);
			}
			list.Add(Defs.TagCMap);
			list.Add(Defs.TagCVT);
			list.Add(Defs.TagFPGM);
			list.Add(Defs.TagGlyf);
			list.Add(Defs.TagHead);

			list.Add(Defs.TagHMtx);

			list.Add(Defs.TagOS2);

				}

				if (directory != null)

					}
					else if (num13 == Defs.TagLoca)
					{
						writer.WriteUInt(Checksum(buffer2));
						num4 = num10;
					}
					else
					{
						writer.WriteUInt(directory.Checksum);
						num4 = directory.Length;
					}
					writer.WriteUInt(num);
					writer.WriteUInt(num4);
					num4 = (uint)((num4 + 3) & -4);
					num += num4;
				}
			}
			i = 0;
			for (int count = list.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				uint num14 = list[i];
				if (!_directories.ContainsKey(num14))
				{

				}

				if (directory2 != null)
				{
					if (num14 == Defs.TagGlyf)
					{

						buffer = null;
						continue;
					}
					if (num14 == Defs.TagLoca)
					{
						writer.WriteBlock(buffer2);
						buffer2 = null;
						continue;
					}
					num4 = directory2.Length;
					num4 = (uint)((num4 + 3) & -4);
					byte[] buffer3 = new byte[num4];
					_stream.Position = directory2.Offset;
					reader.ReadBlock(buffer3, (int)directory2.Length);
					writer.WriteBlock(buffer3);
				}
			}
			_stream = stream;
		}

		public static uint Checksum(byte[] buffer)
		{
			if (buffer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("buffer");
			}
			uint num = 0u;
			uint num2 = 0u;
			uint num3 = 0u;
			uint num4 = 0u;
			uint num5 = 0u;
			int i = 0;
			for (int num6 = buffer.Length / 4; i < num6; i++)
			{
				num4 += (uint)(buffer[num5++] & 0xFF);
				num3 += (uint)(buffer[num5++] & 0xFF);
				num2 += (uint)(buffer[num5++] & 0xFF);
				num += (uint)(buffer[num5++] & 0xFF);
			}
			return num + (num2 << 8) + (num3 << 16) + (num4 << 24);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static MemoryStream GetData(System.Drawing.Font font)
		{
			try
			{
				SecurityPermission securityPermission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode);
				securityPermission.Assert();
				return GetDataUnsafe(font);
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				return GetDataSafe(font);
			}
		}

		private static MemoryStream GetDataSafe(System.Drawing.Font font)
		{
			string name = ((!font.Bold) ? "Verdana.bin" : "Verdana_Bold.bin");
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(Font);
			System.IO.Stream manifestResourceStream = typeFromHandle.Module.Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(typeFromHandle, name);
			if (manifestResourceStream != null)
			{
				MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
				int num;
				while ((num = manifestResourceStream.ReadByte()) >= 0)
				{
					memoryStream.WriteByte((byte)num);
				}
				return memoryStream;
			}
			DebugProxy.Fail("Could not retrieve safe font fallback");
			return null;
		}

		[SecurityCritical]
		private static MemoryStream GetDataUnsafe(System.Drawing.Font font)
		{
			MemoryStream memoryStream = null;
			IntPtr zero = IntPtr.Zero;
			IntPtr dCApi = NativeWindowMethods.GetDCApi(zero);
			IntPtr hGDIObj = font.ToHfont();
			IntPtr hGDIObj2 = NativeWindowMethods.SelectObjectApi(dCApi, hGDIObj);
			int fontDataApi = (int)NativeWindowMethods.GetFontDataApi(dCApi, (uint)Defs.TagTTC, 0u, null, 0u);
			if (fontDataApi > 0)
			{
				byte[] buffer = new byte[fontDataApi];
				NativeWindowMethods.GetFontDataApi(dCApi, (uint)Defs.TagTTC, 0u, buffer, (uint)fontDataApi);
				Reader reader = new Reader(new MemoryStream(buffer));
				reader.Stream.Position = 8L;
				uint num = reader.ReadUInt();
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					uint num2 = reader.ReadUInt();
					long position = reader.Stream.Position;
					reader.Stream.Position = num2;
					reader.Stream.Position += 4L;
					ushort num3 = reader.ReadUShort();
					DirectoryCollection directoryCollection = new DirectoryCollection();
					reader.Stream.Position += 6L;
					for (int j = 0; j < num3; j++)
					{
						Directory directory = new Directory();
						directory.Load(reader);
						if (!directoryCollection.ContainsKey(directory.Tag))
						{
							directoryCollection.Add(directory.Tag, directory);
						}
					}
					if (directoryCollection.ContainsKey(Defs.TagName))
					{
						reader.Stream.Position = directoryCollection[Defs.TagName].Offset;
						Name name = new Name();
						name.Load(reader);
						bool flag = name.Names[6].Length > 0 && name.Names[6] == font.Name;
						if (!flag)
						{
							try
							{
								FontFamily fontFamily = new FontFamily(name.Names[1]);
								flag = fontFamily.GetName(0) == font.FontFamily.GetName(0);
							}
							catch
							{
							}
						}
						if (flag)
						{
							memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
							Writer writer = new Writer(memoryStream);
							writer.WriteUInt(65536u);
							writer.WriteUShort(num3);
							int num4 = Defs.EntrySelector[num3];
							writer.WriteUShort((ushort)((1 << num4) * 16));
							writer.WriteUShort((ushort)num4);
							writer.WriteUShort((ushort)((num3 - (1 << num4)) * 16));
							uint num5 = (uint)(16 * num3 + 12);
							Dictionary<uint, Directory>.ValueCollection values = directoryCollection.Values;
							foreach (Directory item in values)
							{
								writer.WriteUInt(item.Tag);
								writer.WriteUInt(item.Checksum);
								uint length = item.Length;
								writer.WriteUInt(num5);
								writer.WriteUInt(length);
								length = (uint)((length + 3) & -4);
								num5 += length;
							}
							foreach (Directory item2 in values)
							{
								uint length2 = item2.Length;
								length2 = (uint)((length2 + 3) & -4);
								byte[] buffer2 = new byte[length2];
								reader.Stream.Position = item2.Offset;
								reader.ReadBlock(buffer2, (int)item2.Length);
								writer.WriteBlock(buffer2);
							}
							break;
						}
					}
					reader.Stream.Position = position;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				fontDataApi = (int)NativeWindowMethods.GetFontDataApi(dCApi, 0u, 0u, null, 0u);
				if (fontDataApi > 0)
				{
					byte[] buffer3 = new byte[fontDataApi];
					NativeWindowMethods.GetFontDataApi(dCApi, 0u, 0u, buffer3, (uint)fontDataApi);
					memoryStream = new MemoryStream(buffer3);
				}
			}
			NativeWindowMethods.SelectObjectApi(dCApi, hGDIObj2);
			NativeWindowMethods.DeleteObjectApi(hGDIObj);
			NativeWindowMethods.ReleaseDCApi(zero, dCApi);
			return memoryStream;
		}

	internal class Name
	{
		private ushort _numNameRecords;

		private ushort _offsetStrings;

		private string[] _names;

		public string[] Names => _names;

		public Name()
		{
			_names = new string[7];
		}

		public void Load(Reader reader)
		{
			long position = reader.Stream.Position;
			NameReference[] array = new NameReference[7];
			for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++)
			{
				array[i] = new NameReference();
			}
			reader.ReadUShort();
			_numNameRecords = reader.ReadUShort();
			_offsetStrings = reader.ReadUShort();
			for (int j = 0; j < _numNameRecords; j++)
			{
				ushort num = reader.ReadUShort();
				reader.ReadUShort();
				ushort num2 = reader.ReadUShort();
				ushort num3 = reader.ReadUShort();
				ushort length = reader.ReadUShort();
				ushort offset = reader.ReadUShort();
				if (num3 >= 7 || array[num3].Length != 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				switch (num)
				{
				case 3:
					if (num2 == 1033)
					{
						array[num3].Platform = num;
						array[num3].Length = length;
						array[num3].Offset = offset;
					}
					break;
				case 1:
					array[num3].Platform = num;
					array[num3].Length = length;
					array[num3].Offset = offset;
					break;
				}
			}
			long num4 = position + _offsetStrings;
			for (int k = 0; k < 7; k++)
			{
				if (array[k].Length <= 0)
				{
					_names[k] = "";
					continue;
				}
				reader.Stream.Position = num4 + array[k].Offset;
				byte[] array2 = reader.ReadBlock(array[k].Length);
				if (array[k].Platform == 3)
				{
					int num5 = array[k].Length / 2;
					byte[] array3 = new byte[num5];
					for (int l = 0; l < num5; l++)
					{
						array3[l] = array2[2 * l + 1];
					}
					array2 = array3;
				}
				CharBuffer charBuffer = new CharBuffer(array2);
				_names[k] = charBuffer.ToString();
			}
		}

	internal class Reader
	{
		private System.IO.Stream _stream;

		public System.IO.Stream Stream => _stream;

		public Reader(System.IO.Stream stream)
		{
			_stream = stream;
		}

		public byte[] ReadBlock(int size)
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[size];
			_stream.Read(array, 0, size);
			return array;
		}

		public void ReadBlock(byte[] buffer, int size)
		{
			ReadBlock(buffer, 0, size);
		}

		public void ReadBlock(byte[] buffer, int offset, int size)
		{
			_stream.Read(buffer, offset, size);
		}

		public int ReadInt()
		{
			int num = _stream.ReadByte();
			int num2 = _stream.ReadByte();
			int num3 = _stream.ReadByte();
			int num4 = _stream.ReadByte();
			num <<= 24;
			num2 <<= 16;
			num3 <<= 8;
			return num | num2 | num3 | num4;
		}

		public short ReadShort()
		{
			int num = _stream.ReadByte();
			int num2 = _stream.ReadByte();
			num <<= 8;
			return (short)(num | num2);
		}

		public uint ReadUInt()
		{
			int num = _stream.ReadByte();
			int num2 = _stream.ReadByte();
			int num3 = _stream.ReadByte();
			int num4 = _stream.ReadByte();
			num <<= 24;
			num2 <<= 16;
			num3 <<= 8;
			return (uint)(num | num2 | num3 | num4);
		}

		public ushort ReadUShort()
		{
			int num = _stream.ReadByte();
			int num2 = _stream.ReadByte();
			num <<= 8;
			return (ushort)(num | num2);
		}
	}
	internal class Writer
	{
		private System.IO.Stream _stream;

		public Writer(System.IO.Stream stream)
		{
			_stream = stream;
		}

		public void WriteBlock(byte[] buffer)
		{
			_stream.Write(buffer, 0, buffer.Length);
		}

		public void WriteUInt(uint value)
		{
			byte value2 = (byte)(value >> 24);
			byte value3 = (byte)(value >> 16);
			byte value4 = (byte)(value >> 8);
			byte value5 = (byte)value;
			_stream.WriteByte(value2);
			_stream.WriteByte(value3);
			_stream.WriteByte(value4);
			_stream.WriteByte(value5);
		}

		public void WriteUShort(ushort value)
		{
			byte value2 = (byte)(value >> 8);
			byte value3 = (byte)value;
			_stream.WriteByte(value2);
			_stream.WriteByte(value3);
		}
	}

		public static void Encrypt(MemoryStream input, MemoryStream output, byte[] key, CipherType type)
		{
			if (input == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("input");
			}
			if (output == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("output");
			}
			if (key == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("key");
			}
			switch (type)
			{
			case CipherType.Default:
			{
				int num3 = key.Length;
				byte[] array2 = (byte[])KeyBlobPattern.Clone();
				for (int j = 0; j < num3; j++)
				{
					array2[j + 12] = key[num3 - j - 1];
				}
				byte[] array3 = input.ToArray();
				int pdwDataLen = array3.Length;
				IntPtr hProv = IntPtr.Zero;
				IntPtr phKey = IntPtr.Zero;
				IntPtr phKey2 = IntPtr.Zero;
				bool flag = NativeWindowMethods.CryptAcquireContextApi(ref hProv, null, "Microsoft Enhanced Cryptographic Provider v1.0", 1u, 0u);
				if (!flag)
				{
					flag = NativeWindowMethods.CryptAcquireContextApi(ref hProv, "InfragisticsCryptoContainer", "Microsoft Enhanced Cryptographic Provider v1.0", 1u, 0u);
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					flag = NativeWindowMethods.CryptAcquireContextApi(ref hProv, "InfragisticsCryptoContainer", "Microsoft Enhanced Cryptographic Provider v1.0", 1u, 8u);
				}
				NativeWindowMethods.CryptImportKeyApi(hProv, PrivateExponentOneKey, (uint)PrivateExponentOneKey.Length, IntPtr.Zero, 0u, ref phKey);
				NativeWindowMethods.CryptImportKeyApi(hProv, array2, (uint)array2.Length, phKey, 0u, ref phKey2);
				NativeWindowMethods.CryptEncryptApi(phKey2, IntPtr.Zero, 1, 0u, array3, ref pdwDataLen, pdwDataLen);
				NativeWindowMethods.CryptReleaseContextApi(hProv, 0u);
				output.Write(array3, 0, pdwDataLen);
				break;
			}
			case CipherType.AES:
			{
				Rijndael rijndael = Rijndael.Create();
				rijndael.Mode = CipherMode.CBC;
				rijndael.Padding = PaddingMode.None;
				rijndael.KeySize = 128;
				rijndael.Key = key;
				rijndael.GenerateIV();
				output.Write(rijndael.IV, 0, rijndael.IV.Length);
				int num = (int)input.Length;
				int num2 = 16 - num % 16;
				byte[] array = new byte[num + num2];
				input.Read(array, 0, array.Length);
				for (int i = num; i < num + num2; i++)
				{
					array[i] = (byte)num2;
				}
				MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
				using (CryptoStream cryptoStream = new CryptoStream(memoryStream, rijndael.CreateEncryptor(), CryptoStreamMode.Write))
				{
					cryptoStream.Write(array, 0, array.Length);
				}
				array = memoryStream.ToArray();
				output.Write(array, 0, array.Length);
				break;
			}
			}
		}

	internal class Signature : Object
	{
		private X509Certificate2 _certificate;

		private string _reason;

		private string _location;

		private string _contactInfo;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Marker _contents;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Marker _byteRange;

		public Signature(X509Certificate2 certificate, string reason, string location, string contactInfo)
		{
			_certificate = certificate;
			_location = location;
			_contactInfo = contactInfo;
			_reason = reason;
		}

		public override void Write(Writer writer)
		{
			writer.Write(_id);
			writer.Write(" 0 obj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			Dictionary dictionary = new Dictionary();
			dictionary.WrapBound = 1;
			ContentInfo contentInfo = new ContentInfo(new byte[1]);
			SignedCms signedCms = new SignedCms(contentInfo, detached: true);
			CmsSigner signer = new CmsSigner(_certificate);
			signedCms.ComputeSignature(signer);
			_contents = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Marker(new Padding(' ', signedCms.Encode().Length * 2 + 2));
			_byteRange = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Marker(new Padding(' ', 50));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Type"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Sig"));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Filter"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Adobe.PPKLite", encode: false));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("SubFilter"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("adbe.pkcs7.detached", encode: false));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Contents"), _contents);
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("ByteRange"), _byteRange);
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("M"), new Date(System.DateTime.Now));
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_reason))
			{
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Reason"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.String(_reason));
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_location))
			{
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Location"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.String(_location));
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_contactInfo))
			{
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("ContactInfo"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.String(_contactInfo));
			}
			dictionary.Write(writer);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("endobj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
		}

		public void Apply(Writer writer)
		{
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Array array = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Array();
			array.Add(new Integer(0));
			array.Add(new Integer(_contents.Start));
			array.Add(new Integer(_contents.End));
			array.Add(new Integer((int)writer.Stream.Length - _contents.End));
			writer.Stream.Position = _byteRange.Start;
			array.Write(writer);
			byte[] array2 = new byte[(int)writer.Stream.Length - _contents.End + _contents.Start];
			writer.Stream.Position = 0L;
			writer.Stream.Read(array2, 0, _contents.Start);
			writer.Stream.Position = _contents.End;
			writer.Stream.Read(array2, _contents.Start, (int)writer.Stream.Length - _contents.End);
			ContentInfo contentInfo = new ContentInfo(array2);
			SignedCms signedCms = new SignedCms(contentInfo, detached: true);
			CmsSigner signer = new CmsSigner(_certificate);
			signedCms.ComputeSignature(signer);
			Literal literal = new Literal(signedCms.Encode());
			writer.Stream.Position = _contents.Start;
			literal.Write(writer);
		}
	}

	internal class FileSpecification : Object
	{
		private Attachment _attachment;

		public FileSpecification(Attachment attachment)
		{
			if (attachment == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("attachment");
			}
			_attachment = attachment;
		}

		public override void Write(Writer writer)
		{
			writer.Write(_id);
			writer.Write(" 0 obj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			Dictionary dictionary = new Dictionary();
			dictionary.WrapBound = 1;
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Type"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Filespec"));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("F"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.String(_attachment.Name));
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_attachment.Description))
			{
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Desc"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.String(_attachment.Description));
			}
			Dictionary dictionary2 = new Dictionary();
			dictionary2.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("F"), new Reference(_attachment));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("EF"), dictionary2);
			dictionary.Write(writer);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("endobj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
		}
	}
	internal class EmbeddedFiles : Object
	{

		public EmbeddedFiles(AttachmentCollection attachments)

			_attachments = attachments;

		public override void AddNotify()

			}
		}

		public override void Write(Writer writer)
		{
			writer.Write(_id);
			writer.Write(" 0 obj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			Dictionary dictionary = new Dictionary();
			dictionary.WrapBound = 1;
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Array array = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Array();
			array.WrapBound = 16;
			foreach (Attachment attachment in _attachments)
			{
				array.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.String(attachment.ResourceName));
				array.Add(new Reference(attachment.FileSpecification));
			}
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Names"), array);
			dictionary.Write(writer);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("endobj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
		}
	}

	internal class RadialShading : Shading
	{
		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point _center;

		private float _radius;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point _focus;

		private GradientFunction _function;

		public RadialShading(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point center, float radius, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point focus, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.ColorBlend blend)
		{
			if (center == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("center");
			}
			if (focus == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("focus");
			}
			_center = center;
			_radius = radius;
			_focus = focus;
			_function = new GradientFunction(blend);
		}

		public override void AddNotify()
		{
			_document.Add(_function);
		}

		public override void Write(Writer writer)
		{
			writer.Write(_id);
			writer.Write(" 0 obj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			Dictionary dictionary = new Dictionary();
			dictionary.WrapBound = 1;
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("ShadingType"), new Integer(3));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("ColorSpace"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("DeviceRGB"));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("AntiAlias"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Boolean(value: false));
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Array array = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Array();
			array.Add(new Real(_center.X));
			array.Add(new Real(_center.Y));
			array.Add(new Real(_radius));
			array.Add(new Real(_focus.X));
			array.Add(new Real(_focus.Y));
			array.Add(new Real(0f));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Coords"), array);
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Function"), new Reference(_function));
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Array array2 = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Array();
			array2.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Boolean(value: true));
			array2.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Boolean(value: true));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Extend"), array2);
			dictionary.Write(writer);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("endobj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
		}
	}

			{
				_pages = pages;
				_index = -1;
			}

			{
				_pages = null;
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				_index = -1;
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				_index++;
				if (_index < _pages.Count)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		{
			_displayMode = DisplayMode.Default;
			_permissions = new Permissions();
			_content = new ObjectCollection();
			_indexes = new int[5];
			_fonts = new List<Font>(25);
			_fontHash = new Dictionary<ShortFontHashKey, Font>(100);
			_imageHash = new Dictionary<Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image, Image>(100);
			_egStateHash = new Dictionary<ExtGState.HashKey, ExtGState>(100);
			_patternHash = new Dictionary<Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush, Pattern>(100);
			_uriHash = new Dictionary<string, URIAction>(100);
			_cipher = CipherType.Default;
			_info = new PdfInfo();
			_pages = new PdfPageCollection();
			_bookmarks = new Bookmark();
			_attachments = new AttachmentCollection();
			_vp = new ViewerPreferences();
			_catalog = new Catalog(_pages, _bookmarks, _vp);
			Add(_catalog);
			Add(_info);
			Add(_pages);
			Add(_bookmarks);
			Add(_vp);
		}

		public void AttachFile(string fileName, string name, string mimeType, string description)
		{
			if (fileName == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("fileName");
			}
			if (name == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("name");
			}
			FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(fileName, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.Read);
			int num = (int)fileStream.Length;
			byte[] buffer = new byte[num];
			fileStream.Read(buffer, 0, num);
			fileStream.Close();
			_attachments.Add(new Attachment(++_indexes[4], name, mimeType, description, new MemoryStream(buffer)));
		}

		public void AttachFile(System.IO.Stream stream, string name, string mimeType, string description)
		{
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("stream");
			}
			if (name == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("name");
			}
			_attachments.Add(new Attachment(++_indexes[4], name, mimeType, description, stream));
		}

		public MemoryStream Generate()
		{
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			Generate(memoryStream);
			return memoryStream;
		}

		public void Generate(string fileName)
		{
			if (fileName == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("fileName");
			}
			VerifyEncryptionRights();
			FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(fileName, FileMode.Create);
			Generate(fileStream);
			fileStream.Close();
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public void Generate(System.IO.Stream stream)
		{
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("stream");
			}
			VerifyEncryptionRights();
			string text = "1.4";
			foreach (Font font in _fonts)
			{
				if (font.Embed)
				{
					font.EmbedData();
				}
			}
			if (_attachments.Count > 0)
			{
				EmbeddedFiles embeddedFiles = new EmbeddedFiles(_attachments);
				Add(embeddedFiles);
				_catalog.EmbeddedFiles = embeddedFiles;
				text = "1.6";
			}
			Writer writer;
			if (_signature != null)
			{
				AcroForm acroForm = new AcroForm(_signature);
				Add(acroForm);
				_catalog.AcroForm = acroForm;
				writer = new Writer(new MemoryStream());
				text = "1.6";
			}
			else
			{
				writer = new Writer(stream);
			}
			Encrypt encrypt = null;
			Encryptor encryptor = null;
			if (_owner != null || _user != null || _permissions.IsRestricted)
			{
				encrypt = new Encrypt(_owner, _user);
				encryptor = new Encryptor(this);
				Add(encrypt);
				encrypt.CreateKeys(encryptor);
				writer.Encryptor = encryptor;
				if (_cipher == CipherType.AES)
				{
					text = "1.6";
				}
			}
			List<XRef> list = new List<XRef>();
			writer.Write("%PDF-" + text);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("%");
			writer.Write((byte)226);
			writer.Write((byte)227);
			writer.Write((byte)207);
			writer.Write((byte)211);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			Version version = null;
			try
			{
				new FileIOPermission(PermissionState.Unrestricted).Assert();
				AssemblyName assemblyName = new AssemblyName(Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly().FullName);
				version = assemblyName.Version;
				CodeAccessPermission.RevertAssert();
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			writer.Write("%--------------------------------------------");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("%");
			writer.Write(" Created with Infragistics Report Writer ");
			if (version != null)
			{
				writer.Write(version.Major);
				writer.Write(".");
				writer.Write(version.Minor);
				writer.Write(".");
				writer.Write(version.Build);
			}
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("%--------------------------------------------");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			int counter = writer.Counter;
			list.Add(new XRef(0, 65535));
			int num = 0;
			foreach (IObject item in _content)
			{
				encryptor?.UpdateKey(item.Id);
				list.Add(new XRef(counter, 0));
				item.Write(writer);
				counter = writer.Counter;
				num++;
				if (this.ReportPublishing != null)
				{
					this.ReportPublishing(this, new PublishProgressEventArgs(num, _content.Count));
				}
			}
			writer.Write("xref");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("0 ");
			writer.Write(list.Count);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			foreach (XRef item2 in list)
			{
				writer.Write(item2.ResourceName());
				writer.Write((byte)10);
			}
			writer.Write("trailer");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("<<");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("/Size ");
			writer.Write(list.Count);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("/Root ");
			Reference reference = new Reference(_catalog);
			reference.Write(writer);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("/Info ");
			reference = new Reference(_info);
			reference.Write(writer);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			if (encrypt != null)
			{
				writer.Write("/Encrypt ");
				reference = new Reference(encrypt);
				reference.Write(writer);
				writer.Write((byte)10);
			}
			writer.Write(">>");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("startxref");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write(counter);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("%%EOF");
			if (_signature != null)
			{
				_signature.Apply(writer);
				byte[] array = ((MemoryStream)writer.Stream).ToArray();
				stream.Write(array, 0, array.Length);
			}
			_content = null;
			_fonts = null;
			_fontHash = null;
			_imageHash = null;
			_egStateHash = null;
			_patternHash = null;
			_uriHash = null;
			_catalog = null;
			_info = null;
			_pages = null;
			_bookmarks = null;
			_attachments = null;
			_vp = null;
			_compressor = null;
			_signature = null;
		}

		public void Sign(X509Certificate2 certificate, string reason, string location, string contactInfo)
		{
			if (certificate == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("certificate");
			}
			if (_signature == null)
			{
				_signature = new Signature(certificate, reason, location, contactInfo);
			}
		}

		internal void Add(IObject obj)
		{
			obj.Id = _content.Count + 1;
			obj.Document = this;
			_content.Add(obj);
			obj.AddNotify();
		}

		internal ExtGState GetExtGState(float strokeOpacity, float fillOpacity)
		{
			ExtGState.HashKey key = new ExtGState.HashKey(strokeOpacity, fillOpacity);
			if (_egStateHash.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				return _egStateHash[key];
			}
			ExtGState extGState = new ExtGState(++_indexes[2], strokeOpacity, fillOpacity);
			_egStateHash.Add(key, extGState);
			Add(extGState);
			return extGState;
		}

		internal Font GetFont(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font font, bool embed, bool subset, bool enableCIDFontRendering)
		{
			ShortFontHashKey shortHashKey = font.GetShortHashKey();
			if (_fontHash.ContainsKey(shortHashKey))
			{
				Font font2 = _fontHash[shortHashKey];
				InitializeFont(font2, embed, subset, enableCIDFontRendering);
				return font2;
			}
			Font font3 = FontFactory.CreateFont(++_indexes[0], font);
			font3.Document = this;
			string internalName = font3.InternalName;
			Font font4 = font3;
			foreach (Font font5 in _fonts)
			{
				if (internalName == font5.InternalName)
				{
					font4 = null;
					font3 = font5;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (font4 != null)
			{
				_fonts.Add(font4);
			}
			InitializeFont(font4, embed, subset, enableCIDFontRendering);
			_fontHash.Add(shortHashKey, font3);
			return font3;
		}

		private static void InitializeFont(Font font, bool embed, bool subset, bool enableCID)
		{
			if (font != null)
			{
				if (embed)
				{
					font.Embed = true;
				}
				if (subset)
				{
					font.Subset = true;
				}
				font.EnableCIDFontRendering = enableCID;
			}
		}

		internal Image GetImage(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image)
		{
			if (_imageHash.ContainsKey(image))
			{
				return _imageHash[image];
			}
			Image image2 = new Image(++_indexes[1], image);
			_imageHash.Add(image, image2);
			Add(image2);
			if (image.AlphaChannel != null)
			{
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image softMask = image.GetSoftMask();
				Image image3 = new Image(++_indexes[1], softMask);
				image3.IsSoftMask = true;
				_imageHash.Add(softMask, image3);
				Add(image3);
				image2.SoftMaskReference = image3;
			}
			return image2;
		}

		internal Pattern GetPattern(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush brush, PdfPage page)
		{
			if (_patternHash.ContainsKey(brush))
			{
				return _patternHash[brush];
			}
			Pattern pattern = null;
			switch (brush.Type)
			{
			case BrushType.LinearGradientDirect:
			{
				LinearGradientDirectBrush linearGradientDirectBrush = (LinearGradientDirectBrush)brush;
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Rectangle rectangle = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Rectangle(linearGradientDirectBrush.Rectangle.X, 0f, linearGradientDirectBrush.Rectangle.Width, 0f);
				AxialShading shading2 = new AxialShading(rectangle, linearGradientDirectBrush.Blend.Complete());
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix matrix2 = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix();
				matrix2.Multiply(linearGradientDirectBrush.Transform, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.MatrixOrder.Append);
				matrix2.Multiply(page.Graphics.Transformation, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.MatrixOrder.Append);
				pattern = new ShadingPattern(++_indexes[3], shading2);
				pattern.Matrix = matrix2;
				break;
			}
			case BrushType.RadialGradientDirect:
			{
				RadialGradientDirectBrush radialGradientDirectBrush = (RadialGradientDirectBrush)brush;
				float num2 = Math.Max(radialGradientDirectBrush.RadiusX, radialGradientDirectBrush.RadiusY);
				float num3 = radialGradientDirectBrush.RadiusX / num2;
				float num4 = radialGradientDirectBrush.RadiusY / num2;
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point point = radialGradientDirectBrush.Focus.Clone();
				point.X = radialGradientDirectBrush.Center.X + (point.X - radialGradientDirectBrush.Center.X) / num3;
				point.Y = radialGradientDirectBrush.Center.Y + (point.Y - radialGradientDirectBrush.Center.Y) / num4;
				RadialShading shading = new RadialShading(radialGradientDirectBrush.Center, num2, point, radialGradientDirectBrush.Blend.Complete());
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix matrix = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix();
				matrix.Multiply(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix(1f, 0f, 0f, 1f, 0f - radialGradientDirectBrush.Center.X, 0f - radialGradientDirectBrush.Center.Y), Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.MatrixOrder.Append);
				matrix.Multiply(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix(num3, 0f, 0f, num4, 0f, 0f), Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.MatrixOrder.Append);
				matrix.Multiply(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix(1f, 0f, 0f, 1f, radialGradientDirectBrush.Center.X, radialGradientDirectBrush.Center.Y), Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.MatrixOrder.Append);
				matrix.Multiply(radialGradientDirectBrush.Transform, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.MatrixOrder.Append);
				matrix.Multiply(page.Graphics.Transformation, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.MatrixOrder.Append);
				pattern = new ShadingPattern(++_indexes[3], shading);
				pattern.Matrix = matrix;
				break;
			}
			case BrushType.TextureDirect:
			{
				TextureDirectBrush textureDirectBrush = (TextureDirectBrush)brush;
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix matrix3 = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix();
				matrix3.Multiply(textureDirectBrush.Transform, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.MatrixOrder.Append);
				matrix3.Multiply(page.Graphics.Transformation, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.MatrixOrder.Append);
				pattern = new TilingPattern(++_indexes[3], textureDirectBrush.Image);
				pattern.Matrix = matrix3;
				break;
			}
			case BrushType.Hatch:
			{
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.HatchBrush hatchBrush = (Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.HatchBrush)brush;
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color backColor = hatchBrush.BackColor;
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color foreColor = hatchBrush.ForeColor;
				byte[] stylePattern = hatchBrush.GetStylePattern();
				int num = stylePattern.Length;
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image(8, num);
				image.Preferences.Compressor = ImageCompressors.Flate;
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					byte b = stylePattern[i];
					for (int j = 0; j < 8; j++)
					{
						if ((b & 0x80) == 0)
						{
							image.SetPixel(j, i, backColor);
						}
						else
						{
							image.SetPixel(j, i, foreColor);
						}
						b <<= 1;
					}
				}
				pattern = new TilingPattern(++_indexes[3], image);
				break;
			}
			}
			_patternHash.Add(brush, pattern);
			Add(pattern);
			return pattern;
		}

		internal URIAction GetURI(string reference)
		{
			if (_uriHash.ContainsKey(reference))
			{
				return _uriHash[reference];
			}
			URIAction uRIAction = new URIAction(reference);
			_uriHash.Add(reference, uRIAction);
			Add(uRIAction);
			return uRIAction;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private void VerifyEncryptionRights()
		{
			if (_permissions.IsRestricted)
			{
				SecurityPermission securityPermission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode);
				securityPermission.Assert();
				VerifyEncryptionRightsHelper(securityPermission);
			}
		}

		[SecurityCritical]
		private static void VerifyEncryptionRightsHelper(SecurityPermission perm)
		{
			perm.Demand();
		}
	}

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush Brush
		{
			get
			{
				return _brush;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_brush == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				FlushText();
				if (_underlineStarted)
				{
					EndUnderline();
					StartUnderline();
				}
				if (_strikeoutStarted)
				{
					EndStrikeout();
					StartStrikeout();
				}
				_brushColor = null;
				_brushPattern = null;
				_brushOpacity = 1f;
				_indirectBrush = null;
				_brush = value;
				if (_brush != null)
				{
					if (_brush is IndirectBrush)
					{
						_indirectBrush = (IndirectBrush)_brush;
					}
					else if (_brush.Type == BrushType.SolidColor)
					{
						_brushColor = ((SolidColorBrush)_brush).Color;
						_brushOpacity = (float)(int)_brushColor.A / 255f;
						_applyFillPattern = true;
					}
					else
					{
						_brushPattern = _page.GetPattern(_brush);
						_applyFillColor = true;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public float CharSpacing
		{
			get
			{
				return _charSpacing;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_charSpacing != value)

					FlushText();
					_charSpacing = value;
					_applyCharSpacing = true;
				}
			}
		}

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font Font
		{
			get
			{
				return _font;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_font == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				FlushText();
				if (_underlineStarted)
				{
					EndUnderline();
				}
				if (_strikeoutStarted)
				{
					EndStrikeout();
				}
				_font = value;
				if (_font != null)
				{
					_pdfFont = _page.GetFont(_font, _font.Preferences.Embed, _font.Preferences.Subset, _font.Preferences.EnableCIDFontRendering);
					_fontSize = _font.Size;
					_fontAscent = _fontSize * _pdfFont.Ascent;
					_fontDescent = _fontSize * _pdfFont.Descent;
					_fontHeight = _fontSize * _pdfFont.Height;
					_pdfFont.Name = _font.Name;
					_pdfFont.Size = _fontSize;
					_pdfFont.Style = _font.Style;
					_semaphore.Select(_textOperator);
					_textOperator.SetFont(_pdfFont);
					if ((_font.Style & Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Underline) == Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Underline || (_font.Style & Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.DoubleUnderline) == Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.DoubleUnderline)
					{
						StartUnderline();
					}
					if ((_font.Style & Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Strikeout) == Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Strikeout || (_font.Style & Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.DoubleStrikeout) == Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.DoubleStrikeout)
					{
						StartStrikeout();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_pdfFont = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen Pen
		{
			get
			{
				return _pen;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_pen == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				FlushText();
				_penColor = null;
				_penOpacity = 1f;
				_penWidth = 0f;
				_penCap = 0;
				_penMiterLimit = 10f;
				_penJoin = 0;
				_penPattern = DashStylePattern.Solid;
				_pen = value;
				if (_pen != null)
				{
					_penColor = _pen.Color;
					_penOpacity = (float)(int)_penColor.A / 255f;
					_penWidth = _pen.Width;
					switch (_pen.Cap)
					{
					case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.LineCap.Flat:
						_penCap = 0;
						break;
					case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.LineCap.Round:
						_penCap = 1;
						break;
					case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.LineCap.Square:
						_penCap = 2;
						break;
					}
					_penMiterLimit = _pen.MiterLimit;
					switch (_pen.Join)
					{
					case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.LineJoin.Miter:
						_penJoin = 0;
						break;
					case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.LineJoin.Round:
						_penJoin = 1;
						break;
					case Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.LineJoin.Bevel:
						_penJoin = 2;
						break;
					}
					_penPattern = _pen.GetStylePattern();
				}
			}
		}

			}
