				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				SetTextPosition(value.X, value.Y);
			}
		}

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix Transformation => _matrix.Clone();

		public PdfGraphics(PdfPage page)
		{
			if (page == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("page");
			}
			_page = page;
			_matrix = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix();
			_states = new Stack<State>();
			_semaphore = new Semaphore(_page.Stream);
			_textOperator = new TextOperator();
			_pathOperator = new PathOperator();
			_imageOperator = new ImageOperator();
			_stateOperator = new StateOperator();
			_textOperator.ForceApplyFont();
			_textOperator.ForceApplyMatrix();
			_textState = new TextState();
			_brushOpacity = 1f;
			_fillOpacity = 1f;
			_applyFillColor = true;
			_applyFillPattern = true;
			_penOpacity = 1f;
			_penMiterLimit = 10f;
			_penPattern = DashStylePattern.Solid;
			_strokeOpacity = 1f;
			_strokeMiterLimit = 10f;
			_strokePattern = DashStylePattern.Solid;
			_applyStrokeColor = true;
			_applyStrokeWidth = true;
			_applyStrokeCap = true;
			_applyStrokeMiterLimit = true;
			_applyStrokeJoin = true;
			_applyStrokePattern = true;
			_alternateFill = true;
			_shapePaintMode = PaintMode.Stroke;
			Transform(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix(1f, 0f, 0f, -1f, 0f, _page.Height));
		}

		private void BoundIndirectBrush(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Rectangle rectangle)
		{
			if (!(rectangle.Width <= 0f) && !(rectangle.Height <= 0f))
			{
				if (_underlineStarted)
				{
					EndUnderline();
					StartUnderline();
				}
				if (_strikeoutStarted)
				{
					EndStrikeout();
					StartStrikeout();
				}
				_brushColor = null;
				_brushPattern = null;
				_brushOpacity = 1f;
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush brush = _indirectBrush.SetBounds(rectangle.X, rectangle.Y, rectangle.Width, rectangle.Height);
				if (brush.Type == BrushType.SolidColor)
				{
					_brushColor = ((SolidColorBrush)brush).Color;
					_brushOpacity = (float)(int)_brushColor.A / 255f;
					_applyFillPattern = true;
				}
				else
				{
					_brushPattern = _page.GetPattern(brush);
					_applyFillColor = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void EndStrikeout()
		{
			if (!_strikeoutStarted)
			{
				return;
			}
			_strikeoutStarted = false;
			int num = (int)(_strikeoutX * 100f);
			int num2 = (int)(_posX * 100f);
			if (Math.Abs(num - num2) > 1)
			{
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen pen = _pen;
				float num3 = _fontSize * _textOperator.Matrix.M11 / 10f;
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color color = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Colors.Black;
				if (_brushColor != null)
				{
					color = _brushColor;
				}
				if ((_font.Style & Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.DoubleStrikeout) == Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.DoubleStrikeout)
				{
					num3 /= 2f;
					Pen = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen(color, num3);
					DrawLine(_strikeoutX, _strikeoutY - num3, _posX - _charSpacing, _strikeoutY - num3);
					DrawLine(_strikeoutX, _strikeoutY + num3 * 1.5f, _posX - _charSpacing, _strikeoutY + num3 * 1.5f);
				}
				else
				{
					Pen = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen(color, num3);
					DrawLine(_strikeoutX, _strikeoutY, _posX - _charSpacing, _strikeoutY);
				}
				Pen = pen;
			}
			_strikeoutX = 0f;
			_strikeoutY = 0f;
		}

		private void EndUnderline()
		{
			if (!_underlineStarted)
			{
				return;
			}
			_underlineStarted = false;
			int num = (int)(_underlineX * 100f);
			int num2 = (int)(_posX * 100f);
			if (Math.Abs(num - num2) > 1)
			{
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen pen = _pen;
				float num3 = _fontSize * _textOperator.Matrix.M11 / 10f;
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color color = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Colors.Black;
				if (_brushColor != null)
				{
					color = _brushColor;
				}
				if ((_font.Style & Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.DoubleUnderline) == Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.DoubleUnderline)
				{
					num3 /= 2f;
					Pen = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen(color, num3);
					DrawLine(_underlineX, _underlineY - num3 * 2f, _posX - _charSpacing, _underlineY - num3 * 2f);
					DrawLine(_underlineX, _underlineY + num3 / 2f, _posX - _charSpacing, _underlineY + num3 / 2f);
				}
				else
				{
					Pen = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Pen(color, num3);
					DrawLine(_underlineX, _underlineY, _posX - _charSpacing, _underlineY);
				}
				Pen = pen;
			}
			_underlineX = 0f;
			_underlineY = 0f;
		}

		private void FlushText()
		{
			if (_textState.Flushing || _textState.Buffer.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			_textState.Flushing = true;
			float x = _textState.X;
			float y = _textState.Y;
			float num = _textState.Width;
			if (_hyperlinkStarted && !_hyperlinkPaused)
			{
				if (_charSpacing < 0f)
				{
					num -= _charSpacing;
				}
				AddHyperlinkArea(x, y, num, _fontHeight);
			}
			if (_indirectBrush != null)
			{
				if ((_pdfFont.Style & Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Italic) == Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Italic)
				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Rectangle(x, y, num + _fontHeight * 0.15f, _fontHeight));
				}
				else
				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Rectangle(x, y, num, _fontHeight));
				}
			}
			if (_brushColor != null || _brushPattern != null)
			{
				UpdateOpacity();
				_semaphore.Select(_textOperator);
				_textOperator.SetPosition(x, y + _fontAscent);
				UpdateFill(Target.Text);
				if (_applyCharSpacing)
				{
					_textOperator.SetCharSpacing(_charSpacing);
					_applyCharSpacing = false;
				}
				_textOperator.OutText(_textState.Buffer.ToString());
				_textState.Reset();
			}
		}

		private void PushState()
		{
			State state = new State();
			state.Font = _font;
			state.Brush = _brush;
			state.Pen = _pen;
			state.Matrix = _matrix.Clone();
			state.CharSpacing = _charSpacing;
			state.FillOpacity = _fillOpacity;
			state.StrokeOpacity = _strokeOpacity;
			state.AlternateFill = _alternateFill;
			_states.Push(state);
		}

		private void SetTextPosition(float x, float y)
		{
			int num = (int)(_posX * 100f);
			int num2 = (int)(x * 100f);
			int num3 = (int)(_posY * 100f);
			int num4 = (int)(y * 100f);
			if (Math.Abs(num - num2) > 1 || Math.Abs(num3 - num4) > 1)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				bool flag2 = false;
				if (_underlineStarted)
				{
					flag = true;
					EndUnderline();
				}
				if (_strikeoutStarted)
				{
					flag2 = true;
					EndStrikeout();
				}
				_posX = x;
				_posY = y;
				if (flag)
				{
					StartUnderline();
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					StartStrikeout();
				}
			}
		}

		private void StartStrikeout()
		{
			if (!_strikeoutStarted)
			{
				_strikeoutStarted = true;
				_strikeoutX = _posX;
				_strikeoutY = _posY + _fontAscent - _fontSize * _textOperator.Matrix.M11 / 3f;
			}
		}

		private void StartUnderline()
		{
			if (!_underlineStarted)
			{
				_underlineStarted = true;
				_underlineX = _posX;
				_underlineY = _posY + _fontAscent + _fontSize * _textOperator.Matrix.M11 / 6f;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateFill(Target target)
		{
			if (_brushPattern != null)
			{
				if (_applyFillPattern || _fillPattern != _brushPattern)
				{
					switch (target)
					{
					case Target.Text:
						_textOperator.SetFillPattern(_brushPattern);
						break;
					case Target.Path:
						_pathOperator.SetFillPattern(_brushPattern);
						break;
					}
					_fillPattern = _brushPattern;
					_applyFillPattern = false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (_brushColor == null)
				{
					_fillColor = null;
					_applyFillColor = false;
					return;
				}
				if (_applyFillColor || _fillColor != _brushColor)
				{
					float r = (float)(int)_brushColor.R / 255f;
					float g = (float)(int)_brushColor.G / 255f;
					float b = (float)(int)_brushColor.B / 255f;
					switch (target)
					{
					case Target.Text:
						_textOperator.SetFillColor(r, g, b);
						break;
					case Target.Path:
						_pathOperator.SetFillColor(r, g, b);
						break;
					}
					_fillColor = _brushColor;
					_applyFillColor = false;
				}
			}
			if (_alternateFill)
			{
				_pathOperator.Alternate = true;
			}
			else
			{
				_pathOperator.Alternate = false;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateOpacity()
		{
			if (_strokeOpacity != _penOpacity || _fillOpacity != _brushOpacity)
			{
				_strokeOpacity = _penOpacity;
				_fillOpacity = _brushOpacity;
				ExtGState extGState = _page.GetExtGState(_strokeOpacity, _fillOpacity);
				if (extGState != null)
				{
					_semaphore.Select(_stateOperator);
					_stateOperator.Apply(extGState);
					_semaphore.Select(null);
					_textOperator.ForceApplyFont();
					_textOperator.ForceApplyMatrix();
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateStroke()
		{
			if (_penColor == null)
			{
				_strokeColor = null;
				_applyStrokeColor = false;
				return;
			}
			if (_applyStrokeColor || _strokeColor != _penColor)
			{
				float r = (float)(int)_penColor.R / 255f;
				float g = (float)(int)_penColor.G / 255f;
				float b = (float)(int)_penColor.B / 255f;
				_pathOperator.SetStrokeColor(r, g, b);
				_strokeColor = _penColor;
				_applyStrokeColor = false;
			}
			if (_applyStrokeWidth || _strokeWidth != _penWidth)
			{
				_pathOperator.SetLineWidth(_penWidth);
				_strokeWidth = _penWidth;
				_applyStrokeWidth = false;
			}
			if (_applyStrokeCap || _strokeCap != _penCap)
			{
				_pathOperator.SetLineCap(_penCap);
				_strokeCap = _penCap;
				_applyStrokeCap = false;
			}
			if (_applyStrokeMiterLimit || _strokeMiterLimit != _penMiterLimit)
			{
				_pathOperator.SetLineMiterLimit(_penMiterLimit);
				_strokeMiterLimit = _penMiterLimit;
				_applyStrokeMiterLimit = false;
			}
			if (_applyStrokeJoin || _strokeJoin != _penJoin)
			{
				_pathOperator.SetLineJoin(_penJoin);
				_strokeJoin = _penJoin;
				_applyStrokeJoin = false;
			}
			if (_applyStrokePattern || _strokePattern != _penPattern)
			{
				_pathOperator.SetLinePattern(_penPattern);
				_strokePattern = _penPattern;
				_applyStrokePattern = false;
			}
		}

		public void AddHyperlinkArea(float x, float y, float width, float height)
		{
			FlushText();
			float x2 = x * _matrix.M11 + _matrix.OffsetX;
			float y2 = y * _matrix.M22 + _matrix.OffsetY;
			float width2 = width * _matrix.M11;
			float height2 = height * _matrix.M22;
			_page.AddAnnot(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Rectangle(x2, y2, width2, height2), _pdfAction);
		}

		public void CurveTo(float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2, float x3, float y3)

		public void DrawArc(float x, float y, float width, float height, float startAngle, float endAngle)
		{
			DrawArc(x, y, width, height, startAngle, endAngle, PaintMode.Stroke);
		}

		public void DrawArc(float x, float y, float width, float height, float startAngle, float endAngle, PaintMode mode)
		{
			if (width <= 0f || height <= 0f)
			{
				return;
			}
			FlushText();
			while (endAngle < startAngle)
			{
				endAngle += 360f;
			}
			if (startAngle == endAngle)
			{
				return;
			}
			float num = width / 2f;
			float num2 = height / 2f;
			float num3 = x + num;
			float num4 = y + num2;
			if (mode != PaintMode.Stroke)
			{
				_pathOperator.MoveTo(num3, num4);
			}
			bool flag = true;
			while (startAngle < endAngle)
			{
				float num5;
				float num6;
				if (endAngle - startAngle < 90f)
				{
					num5 = startAngle;
					num6 = endAngle;
				}
				else
				{
					num5 = startAngle;
					num6 = num5 + 90f;
				}
				num5 = (float)((double)num5 * (Math.PI / 180.0));
				num6 = (float)((double)num6 * (Math.PI / 180.0));
				float num7 = (float)Math.Sin(num5);
				float num8 = (float)Math.Cos(num5);
				float num9 = (float)Math.Sin(num6);
				float num10 = (float)Math.Cos(num6);
				float num11 = 4f * (float)(1.0 - Math.Cos((num6 - num5) / 2f)) / (float)Math.Sin((num6 - num5) / 2f) / 3f;
				float x2 = num * num8 + num3;
				float y2 = num2 * num7 + num4;
				float x3 = num * (num8 - num11 * num7) + num3;
				float y3 = num2 * (num7 + num11 * num8) + num4;
				float x4 = num * (num10 + num11 * num9) + num3;
				float y4 = num2 * (num9 - num11 * num10) + num4;
				float x5 = num * num10 + num3;
				float y5 = num2 * num9 + num4;
				if (flag)
				{
					flag = false;
					if (mode == PaintMode.Stroke)
					{
						_pathOperator.MoveTo(x2, y2);
					}
					else
					{
						_pathOperator.LineTo(x2, y2);
					}
				}
				_pathOperator.CurveTo(x3, y3, x4, y4, x5, y5);
				startAngle += 90f;
			}
			if (_shapeStarted)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (mode)
			{
			case PaintMode.Fill:
				if (_indirectBrush != null)
				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(_pathOperator.Path.GetBounds());
				}
				UpdateOpacity();
				_semaphore.Select(_pathOperator);
				UpdateFill(Target.Path);
				_pathOperator.ClosePath();
				if (_fillColor != null || _fillPattern != null)
				{
					_pathOperator.Fill = true;
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.Stroke:
				UpdateOpacity();
				_semaphore.Select(_pathOperator);
				UpdateStroke();
				if (_strokeColor != null)
				{
					_pathOperator.Stroke = true;
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.FillStroke:
				if (_indirectBrush != null)
				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(_pathOperator.Path.GetBounds());
				}
				UpdateOpacity();
				_semaphore.Select(_pathOperator);
				UpdateFill(Target.Path);
				UpdateStroke();
				_pathOperator.ClosePath();
				if (_fillColor != null || _fillPattern != null)
				{
					_pathOperator.Fill = true;
				}
				if (_strokeColor != null)
				{
					_pathOperator.Stroke = true;
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.Clip:
				_semaphore.Select(_pathOperator);
				_pathOperator.ClosePath();
				_pathOperator.Clip = true;
				break;
			}
			_pathOperator.OutPath();
			_semaphore.Select(null);
			_textOperator.ForceApplyMatrix();
		}

		public void DrawBezier(float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2, float x3, float y3, float x4, float y4)
		{
			FlushText();
			_pathOperator.MoveTo(x1, y1);
			_pathOperator.CurveTo(x2, y2, x3, y3, x4, y4);
			if (!_shapeStarted)
			{
				UpdateOpacity();
				_semaphore.Select(_pathOperator);
				UpdateStroke();
				if (_strokeColor != null)
				{
					_pathOperator.Stroke = true;
				}
				_pathOperator.OutPath();
				_semaphore.Select(null);
				_textOperator.ForceApplyMatrix();
			}
		}

		public void DrawBeziers(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point[] points)
		{
			DrawBeziers(points, PaintMode.Stroke);
		}

		public void DrawBeziers(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point[] points, PaintMode mode)
		{
			if (points == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("points");
			}
			FlushText();
			int num = points.Length;
			if (num < 4 || (num - 1) % 3 != 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("points", "[4, ...] AND MOD 3");
			}
			float x = points[0].X;
			float y = points[0].Y;
			_pathOperator.MoveTo(x, y);
			num -= 2;
			for (int i = 1; i < num; i += 3)
			{
				float x2 = points[i].X;
				float y2 = points[i].Y;
				float x3 = points[i + 1].X;
				float y3 = points[i + 1].Y;
				float x4 = points[i + 2].X;
				float y4 = points[i + 2].Y;
				_pathOperator.CurveTo(x2, y2, x3, y3, x4, y4);
			}
			if (_shapeStarted)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_indirectBrush != null)
			{
				BoundIndirectBrush(_pathOperator.Path.GetBounds());
			}
			switch (mode)
			{
			case PaintMode.Fill:
				if (_indirectBrush != null)
				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(_pathOperator.Path.GetBounds());
				}
				UpdateOpacity();
				_semaphore.Select(_pathOperator);
				UpdateFill(Target.Path);
				if (_fillColor != null || _fillPattern != null)
				{
					_pathOperator.Fill = true;
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.Stroke:
				UpdateOpacity();
				_semaphore.Select(_pathOperator);
				UpdateStroke();
				if (_strokeColor != null)
				{
					_pathOperator.Stroke = true;
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.FillStroke:
				if (_indirectBrush != null)
				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(_pathOperator.Path.GetBounds());
				}
				UpdateOpacity();
				_semaphore.Select(_pathOperator);
				UpdateFill(Target.Path);
				UpdateStroke();
				if (_fillColor != null || _fillPattern != null)
				{
					_pathOperator.Fill = true;
				}
				if (_strokeColor != null)
				{
					_pathOperator.Stroke = true;
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.Clip:
				_semaphore.Select(_pathOperator);
				_pathOperator.Clip = true;
				break;
			}
			_pathOperator.OutPath();
			_semaphore.Select(null);
			_textOperator.ForceApplyMatrix();
		}

		public void DrawClosedCurve(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point[] points, float tension)
		{
			DrawClosedCurve(points, tension, PaintMode.Stroke);
		}

		public void DrawClosedCurve(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point[] points, float tension, PaintMode mode)
		{
			if (points == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("points");
			}
			if (points.Length < 4)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("points", "[4, ...]");
			}
			FlushText();
			int num = points.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				float x;
				float y;
				if (i == 0)
				{
					x = points[num - 1].X;
					y = points[num - 1].Y;
				}
				else
				{
					x = points[i - 1].X;
					y = points[i - 1].Y;
				}
				float x2 = points[i].X;
				float y2 = points[i].Y;
				int num2 = i + 1;
				int num3 = i + 2;
				if (num3 >= num)
				{
					num3 = 0;
				}
				if (num2 >= num)
				{
					num2 = 0;
					num3 = 1;
				}
				float x3 = points[num2].X;
				float y3 = points[num2].Y;
				float x4 = points[num3].X;
				float y4 = points[num3].Y;
				float x5 = x2 + tension * ((x3 - x) / 2f);
				float y5 = y2 + tension * ((y3 - y) / 2f);
				float x6 = x3 - tension * ((x4 - x2) / 2f);
				float y6 = y3 - tension * ((y4 - y2) / 2f);
				if (i == 0)
				{
					_pathOperator.MoveTo(x2, y2);
				}
				_pathOperator.CurveTo(x5, y5, x6, y6, x3, y3);
			}
			if (_shapeStarted)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (mode)
			{
			case PaintMode.Fill:
				if (_indirectBrush != null)
				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(_pathOperator.Path.GetBounds());
				}
				UpdateOpacity();
				_semaphore.Select(_pathOperator);
				UpdateFill(Target.Path);
				if (_fillColor != null || _fillPattern != null)
				{
					_pathOperator.Fill = true;
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.Stroke:
				UpdateOpacity();
				_semaphore.Select(_pathOperator);
				UpdateStroke();
				if (_strokeColor != null)
				{
					_pathOperator.Stroke = true;
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.FillStroke:
				if (_indirectBrush != null)
				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(_pathOperator.Path.GetBounds());
				}
				UpdateOpacity();
				_semaphore.Select(_pathOperator);
				UpdateFill(Target.Path);
				UpdateStroke();
				if (_fillColor != null || _fillPattern != null)
				{
					_pathOperator.Fill = true;
				}
				if (_strokeColor != null)
				{
					_pathOperator.Stroke = true;
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.Clip:
				_semaphore.Select(_pathOperator);
				_pathOperator.Clip = true;
				break;
			}
			_pathOperator.OutPath();
			_semaphore.Select(null);
			_textOperator.ForceApplyMatrix();
		}

		public void DrawCurve(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Point[] points, float tension)
		{
			if (points == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("points");
			}
			if (points.Length < 4)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("points", "[4, ...]");
			}
			FlushText();
			float x = points[0].X;
			float y = points[0].Y;
			float x2 = points[1].X;
			float y2 = points[1].Y;
			float x3 = points[2].X;
			float y3 = points[2].Y;
			float x4 = x + tension * ((x2 - x) / 2f);
			float y4 = y + tension * ((y2 - y) / 2f);
			float x5 = x2 - tension * ((x3 - x) / 2f);
			float y5 = y2 - tension * ((y3 - y) / 2f);
			_pathOperator.MoveTo(x, y);
			_pathOperator.CurveTo(x4, y4, x5, y5, x2, y2);
			int num = points.Length - 2;
			float x6;
			float y6;
			for (int i = 1; i < num; i++)
			{
				x = points[i - 1].X;
				y = points[i - 1].Y;
				x2 = points[i].X;
				y2 = points[i].Y;
				x3 = points[i + 1].X;
				y3 = points[i + 1].Y;
				x6 = points[i + 2].X;
				y6 = points[i + 2].Y;
				x4 = x2 + tension * ((x3 - x) / 2f);
				y4 = y2 + tension * ((y3 - y) / 2f);
				x5 = x3 - tension * ((x6 - x2) / 2f);
				y5 = y3 - tension * ((y6 - y2) / 2f);
				_pathOperator.CurveTo(x4, y4, x5, y5, x3, y3);
			}
			num += 2;
			x2 = points[num - 3].X;
			y2 = points[num - 3].Y;
			x3 = points[num - 2].X;
			y3 = points[num - 2].Y;
			x6 = points[num - 1].X;
			y6 = points[num - 1].Y;
			x4 = x3 + tension * ((x6 - x2) / 2f);
			y4 = y3 + tension * ((y6 - y2) / 2f);
			x5 = x6 - tension * ((x6 - x3) / 2f);
			y5 = y6 - tension * ((y6 - y3) / 2f);
			_pathOperator.CurveTo(x4, y4, x5, y5, x6, y6);
			if (!_shapeStarted)
			{
				UpdateOpacity();
				_semaphore.Select(_pathOperator);
				UpdateStroke();
				if (_strokeColor != null)
				{
					_pathOperator.Stroke = true;
				}
				_pathOperator.OutPath();
				_semaphore.Select(null);
				_textOperator.ForceApplyMatrix();
			}
		}

		public void DrawEllipse(float x, float y, float width, float height)
		{
			DrawEllipse(x, y, width, height, PaintMode.Stroke);
		}

		public void DrawEllipse(float x, float y, float width, float height, PaintMode mode)
		{
			if (width <= 0f || height <= 0f)
			{
				return;
			}
			FlushText();
			float num = width / 2f;
			float num2 = height / 2f;
			float num3 = x + num;
			float num4 = y + num2;
			float num5 = 0f;
			float num6 = 360f;
			bool flag = true;
			for (; num5 < num6; num5 += 90f)
			{
				float num7;
				float num8;
				if (num6 - num5 < 90f)
				{

		public void DrawPie(float x, float y, float width, float height, float startAngle, float endAngle, PaintMode mode)
		{
			if (width <= 0f || height <= 0f)
			{
				return;
			}
			FlushText();
			while (endAngle < startAngle)
			{
				endAngle += 360f;
			}
			if (startAngle == endAngle)
			{
				return;
			}
			float num = width / 2f;
			float num2 = height / 2f;
			float num3 = x + num;
			float num4 = y + num2;
			_pathOperator.MoveTo(num3, num4);
			bool flag = true;

			{
				float num5;
				float num6;
				if (endAngle - startAngle < 90f)
				{
					num5 = startAngle;
					num6 = endAngle;
				}
				else
				{
					num5 = startAngle;
					num6 = num5 + 90f;
				}
				num5 = (float)((double)num5 * (Math.PI / 180.0));
				num6 = (float)((double)num6 * (Math.PI / 180.0));
				float num7 = (float)Math.Sin(num5);

				float num10 = (float)Math.Cos(num6);
				float num11 = 4f * (float)(1.0 - Math.Cos((num6 - num5) / 2f)) / (float)Math.Sin((num6 - num5) / 2f) / 3f;
				float x2 = num * num8 + num3;
				float y2 = num2 * num7 + num4;
				float x3 = num * (num8 - num11 * num7) + num3;
				float y3 = num2 * (num7 + num11 * num8) + num4;
				float x4 = num * (num10 + num11 * num9) + num3;
				float y4 = num2 * (num9 - num11 * num10) + num4;
				float x5 = num * num10 + num3;
				float y5 = num2 * num9 + num4;
				if (flag)
				{
					flag = false;
					_pathOperator.LineTo(x2, y2);
				}
				_pathOperator.CurveTo(x3, y3, x4, y4, x5, y5);
				startAngle += 90f;
			}
			_pathOperator.ClosePath();
			if (_shapeStarted)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (mode)
			{
			case PaintMode.Fill:

					_pathOperator.Fill = true;
				}
				break;

				UpdateOpacity();
				_semaphore.Select(_pathOperator);
				UpdateStroke();
				if (_strokeColor != null)
				{
					_pathOperator.Stroke = true;
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.FillStroke:
				if (_indirectBrush != null)
				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(_pathOperator.Path.GetBounds());
				}
				UpdateOpacity();
				_semaphore.Select(_pathOperator);
				UpdateFill(Target.Path);
				UpdateStroke();
				if (_fillColor != null || _fillPattern != null)
				{
					_pathOperator.Fill = true;
				}
				if (_strokeColor != null)
				{
					_pathOperator.Stroke = true;
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.Clip:
				_semaphore.Select(_pathOperator);

		public void DrawSpacing(float width)
		{

		}

		public void DrawString(string text)
		{
			DrawString(_posX, _posY, text);
		}

		public void DrawString(float x, float y, string text)
		{
			if (text == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("text");
			}
			if (_pdfFont == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_textState.Buffer.Count > 0)
			{
				int num = (int)(x * 100f);
				int num2 = (int)((_textState.X + _textState.Width + GetCharWidth(' ')) * 100f);
				int num3 = (int)(y * 100f);
				int num4 = (int)(_textState.Y * 100f);
				if (Math.Abs(num - num2) <= 1 && Math.Abs(num3 - num4) <= 1)
				{
					_textState.Buffer.Add(' ');
				}
				else
				{
					FlushText();
					_textState.X = x;
					_textState.Y = y;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				_textState.X = x;
				_textState.Y = y;
			}
			SetTextPosition(x, y);
			_posX = x + GetStringWidth(text);
			_posY = y;
			_textState.Buffer.Add(text);
			_textState.Width = _posX - _textState.X;
		}

		public void EndHyperlink()
		{

			_hyperlinkStarted = false;
			_pdfAction = null;
		}

		public void EndShape()
		{
			if (!_shapeStarted)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (_shapePaintMode)
			{
			case PaintMode.Fill:
				if (_indirectBrush != null)
				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(_pathOperator.Path.GetBounds());
				}
				UpdateOpacity();
				_semaphore.Select(_pathOperator);
				UpdateFill(Target.Path);
				if (_fillColor != null || _fillPattern != null)
				{
					_pathOperator.Fill = true;
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.Stroke:
				UpdateOpacity();
				_semaphore.Select(_pathOperator);
				UpdateStroke();
				if (_strokeColor != null)
				{
					_pathOperator.Stroke = true;
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.FillStroke:
				if (_indirectBrush != null)
				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(_pathOperator.Path.GetBounds());
				}
				UpdateOpacity();
				_semaphore.Select(_pathOperator);
				UpdateFill(Target.Path);
				UpdateStroke();
				if (_fillColor != null || _fillPattern != null)
				{
					_pathOperator.Fill = true;
				}
				if (_strokeColor != null)
				{
					_pathOperator.Stroke = true;
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.Clip:
				_semaphore.Select(_pathOperator);
				_pathOperator.Clip = true;
				break;
			}
			_pathOperator.OutPath();
			_semaphore.Select(null);
			_textOperator.ForceApplyMatrix();
			_shapeStarted = false;
		}

		public void Flush()
		{
			FlushText();
			if (_underlineStarted)
			{
				EndUnderline();
			}
			if (_strikeoutStarted)
			{
				EndStrikeout();
			}
			Pen = null;
			Brush = null;
			Font = null;
			_semaphore.Select(null);
			_page.Stream.Attach(_page.Document.FileBuffer);
		}

		public float GetCharWidth(char ch)
		{
			if (_pdfFont != null)
			{
				return _fontSize * _textOperator.Matrix.M11 * (float)_pdfFont.GlyphWidth(ch) / 1000f + _charSpacing;
			}
			return 0f;
		}

		public float GetStringWidth(string text)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			int length = text.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				char c = text[i];
				if (c < ' ')
				{
					c = ' ';
				}
				num += GetCharWidth(c);
			}
			return num;
		}

		private void PopState()
		{
			State state = _states.Pop();
			Font = state.Font;
			Brush = state.Brush;
			Pen = state.Pen;
			CharSpacing = state.CharSpacing;
			_matrix = state.Matrix;
			_fillOpacity = state.FillOpacity;
			_strokeOpacity = state.StrokeOpacity;
			_alternateFill = state.AlternateFill;
			_applyFillColor = true;
			_applyFillPattern = true;
			_applyStrokeColor = true;
			_applyStrokeWidth = true;
			_applyStrokeCap = true;
			_applyStrokeMiterLimit = true;
			_applyStrokeJoin = true;
			_applyStrokePattern = true;
			_textOperator.ForceApplyFont();
			_textOperator.ForceApplyMatrix();
		}

		public void RestoreClip()
		{
			if (_states.Count > 0)
			{
				FlushText();
				if (_underlineStarted)
				{
					EndUnderline();
				}
				if (_strikeoutStarted)
				{
					EndStrikeout();
				}
				_semaphore.Select(_stateOperator);
				_stateOperator.Restore();
				_semaphore.Select(null);
				PopState();
			}
		}

		public void RestoreState()
		{
			if (_states.Count > 0)

				FlushText();

					EndUnderline();
				}
				if (_strikeoutStarted)
				{
					EndStrikeout();
				}
				_semaphore.Select(_stateOperator);

		}

		public void SaveClip(float x, float y, float width, float height)
		{
			FlushText();
			PushState();
			_semaphore.Select(_stateOperator);
			_stateOperator.Save();
			float x2 = x + width;
			float y2 = y + height;
			_semaphore.Select(_pathOperator);
			_pathOperator.MoveTo(x, y);
			_pathOperator.LineTo(x2, y);
			_pathOperator.LineTo(x2, y2);
			_pathOperator.LineTo(x, y2);
			_pathOperator.ClosePath();
			_pathOperator.Clip = true;
			_pathOperator.Alternate = _alternateFill;
			_pathOperator.OutPath();
			_semaphore.Select(null);
			_applyFillColor = true;
			_applyFillPattern = true;
			_applyStrokeColor = true;
			_applyStrokeWidth = true;
			_applyStrokeCap = true;
			_applyStrokeMiterLimit = true;
			_applyStrokeJoin = true;
			_applyStrokePattern = true;
			_textOperator.ForceApplyFont();
			_textOperator.ForceApplyMatrix();
		}

		{
			get
			{
				return _id;
			}
			set
			{
				_id = value;
			}
		}

		public Object()
		{
		}

		public Object(IAtom value)
		{
			_value = value;
		}

		public virtual void AddNotify()
		{
		}

		public virtual void Write(Writer writer)
		{
			writer.Write(_id);
			writer.Write(" 0 obj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			if (_value != null)

				_value.Write(writer);
			}
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("endobj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
		}
	}
	internal class Encoding : Object
	{
		private List<string> _content;

		private Dictionary<char, int> _hash;

		private int _firstIndex;

		private int _lastIndex;

		public int FirstIndex => _firstIndex;

		public bool IsFull
		{
			get
			{
				if (_content.Count >= 52)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public int LastIndex => _lastIndex;

		public Encoding()
		{
			_content = new List<string>(52);
			_hash = new Dictionary<char, int>(100);
			_firstIndex = 65;
			_lastIndex = _firstIndex - 1;
		}

		public int Add(char ch, string name)
		{
			if (name == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("name");
			}
			if (!_hash.ContainsKey(ch))
			{
				_lastIndex++;
				if (_lastIndex == 91)
				{
					_lastIndex += 6;
				}
				_content.Add(name);
				_hash.Add(ch, _lastIndex);
			}
			return _lastIndex;
		}

		public int GetCharCode(char ch)
		{
			if (_hash.ContainsKey(ch))
			{
				return _hash[ch];
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public override void Write(Writer writer)
		{
			writer.Write(_id);
			writer.Write(" 0 obj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			Dictionary dictionary = new Dictionary();
			dictionary.WrapBound = 1;
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Type"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Encoding"));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("BaseEncoding"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("WinAnsiEncoding"));
			int count = _content.Count;
			if (count > 0)
			{
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Array array = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Array();
				array.WrapBound = 16;
				array.Add(new Integer(_firstIndex));
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (i == 26)
					{
						array.Add(new Integer(97));
					}
					array.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name(_content[i]));
				}
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Differences"), array);
			}
			dictionary.Write(writer);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("endobj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
		}
	}
	internal class Encrypt : Object
	{
		private static byte[] Padding = new byte[32]
		{
			40, 191, 78, 94, 78, 117, 138, 65, 100, 0,
			78, 86, 255, 250, 1, 8, 46, 46, 0, 182,
			208, 104, 62, 128, 47, 12, 169, 254, 100, 83,
			105, 122
		};

		private string _owner;

		private string _user;

		public Encrypt(string owner, string user)
		{
			_owner = owner;
			_user = user;
		}

		public void CreateKeys(Encryptor encryptor)
		{
			if (encryptor == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("encryptor");
			}
			System.Text.Encoding aSCII = System.Text.Encoding.ASCII;
			byte[] array = new byte[32];
			int num = ((_user != null) ? _user.Length : 0);
			if (num > 0)
			{
				System.Array.Copy(aSCII.GetBytes(_user), 0, array, 0, Math.Min(num, 32));
				if (num < 32)
				{
					System.Array.Copy(Padding, 0, array, num, 32 - num);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				System.Array.Copy(Padding, 0, array, 0, 32);
			}
			byte[] array2 = new byte[32];
			num = ((_owner != null) ? _owner.Length : 0);
			if (num > 0)
			{
				System.Array.Copy(aSCII.GetBytes(_owner), 0, array2, 0, Math.Min(num, 32));
				if (num < 32)
				{
					System.Array.Copy(Padding, 0, array2, num, 32 - num);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				System.Array.Copy(Padding, 0, array2, 0, 32);
			}
			MD5CryptoServiceProvider mD = encryptor.MD5;
			byte[] array3 = mD.ComputeHash(array2);
			for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++)
			{
				array3 = mD.ComputeHash(array3);
			}
			MemoryStream memoryStream = Cipher.Encrypt(array, array3, CipherType.Default);
			for (int j = 1; j < 20; j++)
			{
				byte[] array4 = new byte[16];
				for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++)
				{
					array4[k] = (byte)(array3[k] ^ j);
				}
				memoryStream.Position = 0L;
				memoryStream = Cipher.Encrypt(memoryStream, array4, CipherType.Default);
			}
			encryptor.OwnerKey = memoryStream.ToArray();
			uint num2 = 4294963392u;
			if (_document.Permissions.Print)
			{
				num2 |= 4;
				num2 |= 0x800;
			}
			if (_document.Permissions.Modify)
			{
				num2 |= 8;
				num2 |= 0x20;
				num2 |= 0x100;
				num2 |= 0x400;
			}
			if (_document.Permissions.Copy)
			{
				num2 |= 0x10;
				num2 |= 0x200;
			}
			if (_document.Permissions.Add)
			{
				num2 |= 0x20;
			}
			memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			Writer writer = new Writer(memoryStream);
			writer.Write(array);
			writer.Write(encryptor.OwnerKey);
			writer.Write((byte)num2);
			writer.Write((byte)(num2 >> 8));
			writer.Write((byte)(num2 >> 16));
			writer.Write((byte)(num2 >> 24));
			memoryStream.Position = 0L;
			byte[] array5 = mD.ComputeHash(memoryStream);
			for (int l = 0; l < 50; l++)
			{
				array5 = mD.ComputeHash(array5);
			}
			encryptor.MasterKey = array5;
			array3 = mD.ComputeHash(Padding);
			memoryStream = Cipher.Encrypt(array3, array5, CipherType.Default);
			for (int m = 1; m < 20; m++)
			{
				byte[] array6 = new byte[16];
				for (int n = 0; n < 16; n++)
				{
					array6[n] = (byte)(array5[n] ^ m);
				}
				memoryStream.Position = 0L;
				memoryStream = Cipher.Encrypt(memoryStream, array6, CipherType.Default);
			}
			Random random = new Random();
			for (int num3 = 0; num3 < 16; num3++)
			{
				memoryStream.WriteByte((byte)random.Next(256));
			}
			encryptor.UserKey = memoryStream.ToArray();
		}

		public override void Write(Writer writer)
		{
			writer.Write(_id);
			writer.Write(" 0 obj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			Dictionary dictionary = new Dictionary();
			dictionary.WrapBound = 1;
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Filter"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Standard"));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Length"), new Integer(128));
			if (_document.Cipher == CipherType.Default)
			{
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("R"), new Integer(3));
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("V"), new Integer(2));
			}
			else
			{
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("R"), new Integer(4));
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("V"), new Integer(4));
				Dictionary dictionary2 = new Dictionary();
				dictionary2.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Type"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("CryptFilter"));
				dictionary2.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("AuthEvent"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("DocOpen"));
				dictionary2.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("CFM"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("AESV2"));
				dictionary2.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Length"), new Integer(16));
				Dictionary dictionary3 = new Dictionary();
				dictionary3.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("StdCF"), dictionary2);
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("CF"), dictionary3);
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("StrF"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("StdCF"));
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("StmF"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("StdCF"));
			}
			uint num = 4294963392u;
			if (_document.Permissions.Print)
			{
				num |= 4;
				num |= 0x800;
			}
			if (_document.Permissions.Modify)
			{
				num |= 8;
				num |= 0x20;
				num |= 0x100;
				num |= 0x400;
			}
			if (_document.Permissions.Copy)
			{
				num |= 0x10;
				num |= 0x200;
			}
			if (_document.Permissions.Add)
			{
				num |= 0x20;
			}
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("P"), new Integer((int)num));
			Encryptor encryptor = writer.Encryptor;
			if (encryptor != null)
			{
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("O"), new Literal(encryptor.OwnerKey));
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("U"), new Literal(encryptor.UserKey));
			}
			dictionary.Write(writer);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("endobj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
		}
	}
	internal class Encryptor
	{
		private MD5CryptoServiceProvider _md5;

		private byte[] _ownerKey;

		private byte[] _userKey;

		private byte[] _masterKey;

		private byte[] _key;

		private PdfDocument _document;

		public PdfDocument Document => _document;

		public byte[] Key => _key;

		public byte[] MasterKey
		{
			get
			{
				return _masterKey;
			}
			set
			{
				_masterKey = value;
			}
		}

		public MD5CryptoServiceProvider MD5 => _md5;

		public byte[] OwnerKey
		{
			get
			{
				return _ownerKey;
			}
			set
			{
				_ownerKey = value;
			}
		}

		public byte[] UserKey
		{
			get
			{
				return _userKey;
			}
			set
			{
				_userKey = value;
			}
		}

		public Encryptor(PdfDocument document)
		{
			if (document == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("document");
			}
			_document = document;
			_md5 = new MD5CryptoServiceProvider();
		}

		public void UpdateKey(int id)
		{
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			Writer writer = new Writer(memoryStream);
			writer.Write(_masterKey);
			writer.Write((byte)id);
			writer.Write((byte)(id >> 8));
			writer.Write((byte)(id >> 16));
			writer.Write((byte)0);
			writer.Write((byte)0);
			if (_document.Cipher == CipherType.AES)
			{
				writer.Write((byte)115);
				writer.Write((byte)65);
				writer.Write((byte)108);
				writer.Write((byte)84);
			}
			memoryStream.Position = 0L;
			_key = _md5.ComputeHash(memoryStream);
		}
	}
	internal class ExtGState : Object
	{
		public class HashKey
		{
			private float _strokeOpacity;

			private float _fillOpacity;

			public float FillOpacity => _fillOpacity;

			public float StrokeOpacity => _strokeOpacity;

			public HashKey(float strokeOpacity, float fillOpacity)
			{
				_strokeOpacity = strokeOpacity;
				_fillOpacity = fillOpacity;
			}

			public override bool Equals(object key)
			{
				if (key == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (key == this)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (key is HashKey)
				{
					HashKey hashKey = (HashKey)key;
					if (_strokeOpacity == hashKey.StrokeOpacity && _fillOpacity == hashKey.FillOpacity)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return _strokeOpacity.GetHashCode() ^ (_fillOpacity.GetHashCode() >> 3);
			}
		}

		private int _index;

		private float _strokeOpacity;

		private float _fillOpacity;

		public string ResourceName => "GS" + _index;

		public ExtGState(int index, float strokeOpacity, float fillOpacity)
		{
			_index = index;
			_strokeOpacity = strokeOpacity;
			_fillOpacity = fillOpacity;
		}

		public override void Write(Writer writer)
		{
			writer.Write(_id);
			writer.Write(" 0 obj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			Dictionary dictionary = new Dictionary();
			dictionary.WrapBound = 1;
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Type"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("ExtGState"));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("CA"), new Real(_strokeOpacity));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("ca"), new Real(_fillOpacity));
			dictionary.Write(writer);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("endobj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
		}
	}
	internal class Font : Object
	{
		protected Infragistics.Documents.Reports.TTF.Font _ttFont;

		protected FontDescriptor _fontDescriptor;

		protected string _name;

		protected string _internalName;

		protected float _size;

		protected float _ascent;

		protected float _descent;

		protected float _height;

		protected Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle _style;

		protected Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle _internalStyle;

		protected int _index;

		protected FontReferenceCollection _references;

		protected int _referenceIndex;

		protected bool _symbolic;

		protected bool _embed;

		protected bool _subset;

		private bool _enableCIDFontRendering = true;

		public float Ascent => _ascent;

		public float Descent => _descent;

		public bool Embed
		{
			get
			{
				return _embed;
			}
			set
			{
				_embed = value;
			}
		}

		public bool EnableCIDFontRendering
		{
			get
			{
				return _enableCIDFontRendering;
			}
			set
			{
				_enableCIDFontRendering = value;
			}
		}

		public float Height => _height;

		public string InternalName => _internalName;

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle InternalStyle => _internalStyle;

		public string Name
		{
			get
			{
				return _name;
			}
			set
			{
				_name = value;
			}
		}

		public int ReferenceIndex => _referenceIndex;

		public FontReferenceCollection References => _references;

		public float Size
		{
			get
			{
				return _size;
			}
			set
			{
				_size = value;
			}
		}

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle Style
		{
			get
			{
				return _style;
			}
			set
			{
				_style = value;
			}
		}

		public bool Subset
		{
			get
			{
				return _subset;
			}
			set
			{
				_subset = value;
			}
		}

		public bool Symbolic => _symbolic;

		public Font(int index, System.IO.Stream stream)
		{
			_index = index;
			_style = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Regular;
			_internalStyle = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Regular;
			_references = new FontReferenceCollection();
			_referenceIndex = -1;
			_ttFont = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.TTF.Font(stream);
			if (_ttFont.Name != null)
			{
				_internalName = _ttFont.Name;
			}
			else
			{
				_internalName = "PDF_" + _index;
			}
			if (!_ttFont.Corrupted)
			{
				_ascent = _ttFont.Ascent;
				_descent = _ttFont.Descent;
				_height = _ttFont.Height;
				_symbolic = _ttFont.Symbolic;
				_internalStyle = _ttFont.Style;
				_fontDescriptor = new FontDescriptor();
				_fontDescriptor.FontName = _internalName;
				_fontDescriptor.FontAscent = _ttFont.Descriptor.FontAscent;
				_fontDescriptor.FontDescent = _ttFont.Descriptor.FontDescent;
				_fontDescriptor.FontCapHeight = _ttFont.Descriptor.FontCapHeight;
				_fontDescriptor.FontStemVertical = _ttFont.Descriptor.FontStemVertical;
				_fontDescriptor.FontBBox = _ttFont.Descriptor.FontBBox;
				_fontDescriptor.FontItalicAngle = _ttFont.Descriptor.FontItalicAngle;
				_fontDescriptor.FontFlags = _ttFont.Descriptor.FontFlags;
			}
		}

		public int CharCode(char ch)
		{
			if (_ttFont.Corrupted)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			_ttFont.ActiveGlyphs.Add(_ttFont.GlyphId(ch));
			int count = _references.Count;
			FontReference fontReference;
			Widths widths;
			UnicodeMap unicodeMap;
			if (_symbolic)
			{
				if (count == 0)
				{
					fontReference = new FontReference(_referenceIndex + 1);
					fontReference.Font = this;
					fontReference.FontDescriptor = _fontDescriptor;
					widths = new Widths(solid: true);
					for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++)
					{
						widths.Add(GlyphWidth((char)i));
					}
					fontReference.Widths = widths;
					unicodeMap = new UnicodeMap(fontReference);
					for (int j = 0; j < 256; j++)
					{
						unicodeMap.Add((char)j, j);
					}
					fontReference.UnicodeMap = unicodeMap;
					_references.Add(fontReference);
					_document.Add(_fontDescriptor);
					_document.Add(fontReference);
					_document.Add(widths);
					_document.Add(unicodeMap);
				}
				return ch;
			}
			Encoding encoding;
			int charCode;
			for (int k = 0; k < count; k++)
			{
				fontReference = _references[k];
				encoding = fontReference.Encoding;
				charCode = encoding.GetCharCode(ch);
				if (charCode >= 0)
				{
					_referenceIndex = k;
					return charCode;
				}
			}
			if (count > 0)
			{
				fontReference = _references[count - 1];
				encoding = fontReference.Encoding;
				if (!encoding.IsFull)
				{
					charCode = encoding.Add(ch, _ttFont.AGLName(ch));
					fontReference.UnicodeMap.Add(ch, charCode);
					if (fontReference.Widths == null)
					{
						fontReference.Widths = new Widths(solid: false);
					}
					fontReference.Widths.Add(GlyphWidth(ch));
					_referenceIndex = count - 1;
					return charCode;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				_document.Add(_fontDescriptor);
			}
			_referenceIndex = count;
			fontReference = new FontReference(_referenceIndex + 1);
			fontReference.Font = this;
			fontReference.FontDescriptor = _fontDescriptor;
			encoding = new Encoding();
			charCode = encoding.Add(ch, _ttFont.AGLName(ch));
			fontReference.Encoding = encoding;
			widths = new Widths(solid: false);
			widths.Add(GlyphWidth(ch));
			fontReference.Widths = widths;
			unicodeMap = new UnicodeMap(fontReference);
			unicodeMap.Add(ch, charCode);
			fontReference.UnicodeMap = unicodeMap;
			_references.Add(fontReference);
			_document.Add(fontReference);
			_document.Add(encoding);
			_document.Add(widths);
			_document.Add(unicodeMap);
			return charCode;
		}

		public virtual void EmbedData()
		{
			if (!_ttFont.Corrupted)
			{
				if (_subset)
				{
					_ttFont.Subset(regular: false);
				}
				Stream stream = new Stream();
				_fontDescriptor.FontFile2 = stream;
				Writer writer = new Writer(stream.Content);
				_ttFont.Stream.Position = 0L;
				if (_ttFont.Stream is MemoryStream)
				{
					writer.WriteUnchecked(((MemoryStream)_ttFont.Stream).ToArray());
				}
				else
				{
					writer.WriteUnchecked(_ttFont.Stream);
				}
				Object obj = new Object(new Integer((int)_ttFont.Stream.Length));
				_document.Add(obj);
				stream.Dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Length1"), new Reference(obj));
				_document.Add(stream);
			}
		}

		public ushort GlyphId(char ch)
		{
			if (_ttFont.Corrupted)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return _ttFont.GlyphId(ch);
		}

		public int GlyphWidth(char ch)
		{
			return _ttFont.GlyphWidth(ch);
		}

		public string ResourceName()
		{
			return ResourceName(_referenceIndex);
		}

		public string ResourceName(int index)
		{
			if (index > 0)
			{
				return "F" + _index + _references[index].ResourceName();
			}
			return "F" + _index;
		}

		internal void WriteOutCIDFontRenderingInformation(char ch)
		{
			if (_ttFont.Corrupted)
			{
				return;
			}
			_ttFont.ActiveGlyphs.Add(_ttFont.GlyphId(ch));
			int count = _references.Count;
			FontReference fontReference;
			Encoding encoding;
			if (count == 0)
			{
				fontReference = new FontReference(_referenceIndex + 1);
				fontReference.Font = this;
				fontReference.FontDescriptor = _fontDescriptor;
				CIDWidthArray cIDWidthArray = new CIDWidthArray();
				cIDWidthArray.Add(0, GlyphWidth('\0'));
				cIDWidthArray.Add(GlyphId(ch), GlyphWidth(ch));
				fontReference.CIDWidths = cIDWidthArray;
				UnicodeMap unicodeMap = new UnicodeMap(fontReference);
				unicodeMap.Add(ch, GlyphId(ch));
				fontReference.UnicodeMap = unicodeMap;
				_references.Add(fontReference);
			}
			else
			{
				if (_references.Count > 0)
				{
					fontReference = _references[count - 1];
					encoding = fontReference.Encoding;
					if (fontReference.CIDWidths == null)
					{
						fontReference.CIDWidths = new CIDWidthArray();
					}
					fontReference.CIDWidths.Add(GlyphId(ch), GlyphWidth(ch));
					encoding.Add(ch, _ttFont.AGLName(ch));
					fontReference.UnicodeMap.Add(ch, GlyphId(ch));
					return;
				}
				fontReference = new FontReference(_referenceIndex + 1);
				CIDWidthArray cIDWidthArray = new CIDWidthArray();
				cIDWidthArray.Add(0, GlyphWidth('\0'));
				cIDWidthArray.Add(GlyphId(ch), GlyphWidth(ch));
				fontReference.CIDWidths = cIDWidthArray;
				UnicodeMap unicodeMap = new UnicodeMap(fontReference);
				unicodeMap.Add(ch, GlyphId(ch));
				fontReference.UnicodeMap = unicodeMap;
				_references.Add(fontReference);
			}
			encoding = new Encoding();
			encoding.Add(ch, _ttFont.AGLName(ch));
			fontReference.Encoding = encoding;
			fontReference.DescendantFonts = new DescendantFonts();
			fontReference.DescendantFonts.DescendantFont = new DescendantFont();
			fontReference.DescendantFonts.DescendantFont.Font = this;
			fontReference.DescendantFonts.DescendantFont.CIDSystemInfo = new CIDSystemInfo();
			fontReference.DescendantFonts.DescendantFont.CIDWidthArray = fontReference.CIDWidths;
			fontReference.DescendantFonts.DescendantFont.FontDescriptor = fontReference.FontDescriptor;
			_document.Add(fontReference);
			_document.Add(fontReference.FontDescriptor);
			_document.Add(fontReference.DescendantFonts);
			_document.Add(fontReference.DescendantFonts.DescendantFont);
			_document.Add(fontReference.DescendantFonts.DescendantFont.CIDSystemInfo);
			_document.Add(fontReference.CIDWidths);
			_document.Add(fontReference.UnicodeMap);
		}
	}

		public FontDescriptor()
		{
			_fontAscent = 800;
			_fontDescent = -200;
			_fontCapHeight = 700;
			_fontFlags = 40uL;
			_fontBBox = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Rectangle(-50f, -200f, 1050f, 1200f);
		}

		public override void Write(Writer writer)
		{
			writer.Write(_id);
			writer.Write(" 0 obj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			Dictionary dictionary = new Dictionary();
			dictionary.WrapBound = 1;
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Type"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("FontDescriptor"));
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_fontName))
			{
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("FontName"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name(_fontName));
			}
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Ascent"), new Integer(_fontAscent));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Descent"), new Integer(_fontDescent));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("CapHeight"), new Integer(_fontCapHeight));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Flags"), new Flags(_fontFlags));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("ItalicAngle"), new Real(_fontItalicAngle));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("StemV"), new Integer(_fontStemVertical));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("StemH"), new Integer(0));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("FontBBox"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Rectangle(_fontBBox));
			if (_fontFile2 != null)
			{
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("FontFile2"), new Reference(_fontFile2));
			}
			dictionary.Write(writer);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("endobj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
		}
	}
	internal class FontReference : Object
	{
		private int _index;

		private Font _font;

		private FontDescriptor _fontDescriptor;

		private Encoding _encoding;

		private Widths _widths;

		private UnicodeMap _unicodeMap;

		private DescendantFonts _descendantFonts;

		private CIDWidthArray _cidWidthArray;

		public DescendantFonts DescendantFonts
		{
			get
			{
				return _descendantFonts;
			}
			set
			{
				_descendantFonts = value;
			}
		}

		public Encoding Encoding
		{
			get
			{
				return _encoding;
			}
			set
			{
				_encoding = value;
			}
		}

		public Font Font
		{
			get
			{
				return _font;
			}
			set
			{
				_font = value;
			}
		}

		public FontDescriptor FontDescriptor
		{
			get
			{
				return _fontDescriptor;
			}
			set
			{
				_fontDescriptor = value;
			}
		}

		public UnicodeMap UnicodeMap
		{
			get
			{
				return _unicodeMap;
			}
			set
			{
				_unicodeMap = value;
			}
		}

		public Widths Widths
		{
			get
			{
				return _widths;
			}
			set
			{
				_widths = value;
			}
		}

		public CIDWidthArray CIDWidths
		{
			get
			{
				return _cidWidthArray;
			}
			set
			{
				_cidWidthArray = value;
			}
		}

		public FontReference(int index)
		{
			_index = index;
		}

		public string ResourceName()
		{
			return "R" + _index;
		}

		public override void Write(Writer writer)
		{
			writer.Write(_id);
			writer.Write(" 0 obj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			Dictionary dictionary = new Dictionary();
			dictionary.WrapBound = 1;
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Type"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Font"));
			if (_font != null && _font.EnableCIDFontRendering)
			{
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Subtype"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Type0"));
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("BaseFont"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name(_font.InternalName));
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Encoding"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Identity-H", encode: false));
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("DescendantFonts"), new Reference(_descendantFonts));
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("ToUnicode"), new Reference(_unicodeMap));
			}
			else
			{
				if (_font != null)
				{
					dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Subtype"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("TrueType"));
					dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("BaseFont"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name(_font.InternalName));
					if (!_font.Symbolic && _encoding != null)
					{
						dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("FirstChar"), new Integer(_encoding.FirstIndex));
						dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("LastChar"), new Integer(_encoding.LastIndex));
						dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Encoding"), new Reference(_encoding));
					}
					else
					{
						dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("FirstChar"), new Integer(0));
						dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("LastChar"), new Integer(255));
					}
				}
				if (_widths != null)
				{
					dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Widths"), new Reference(_widths));
				}
				if (_fontDescriptor != null)
				{
					dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("FontDescriptor"), new Reference(_fontDescriptor));
				}
				if (_unicodeMap != null)
				{
					dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("ToUnicode"), new Reference(_unicodeMap));
				}
			}
			dictionary.Write(writer);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("endobj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
		}
	}

	internal class Image : Object
	{
		private int _index;

		private Object _softMaskReference;

		private bool _isSoftMask;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image _image;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color _transparentColor;

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color TransparentColor
		{
			set
			{
				_transparentColor = value;
			}
		}

		public Object SoftMaskReference
		{
			set
			{
				_softMaskReference = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsSoftMask
		{
			set
			{
				_isSoftMask = value;
			}
		}

		public Image(int index, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("image");
			}
			_index = index;
			_image = image;
		}

		public string ResourceName()
		{
			return "I" + _index;
		}

		public override void Write(Writer writer)
		{
			writer.Write(_id);
			writer.Write(" 0 obj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			Dictionary dictionary = new Dictionary();
			dictionary.WrapBound = 1;
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Name"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name(ResourceName()));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Type"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("XObject"));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Subtype"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Image"));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Width"), new Integer(_image.Width));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Height"), new Integer(_image.Height));
			if (_softMaskReference != null)
			{
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("SMask"), new Reference(_softMaskReference));
			}
			else if (_isSoftMask)
			{
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Array array = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Array();
				array.Add(new Integer(0));
				array.Add(new Integer(0));
				array.Add(new Integer(0));
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Matte"), array);
			}
			MemoryStream memoryStream = _image.Preferences.Compressor.Compress(_image, _image.Preferences.Converter);
			Encryptor encryptor = writer.Encryptor;
			if (encryptor != null)
			{
				memoryStream.Position = 0L;
				memoryStream = Cipher.Encrypt(memoryStream, encryptor.Key, encryptor.Document.Cipher);
			}
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Length"), new Long(memoryStream.Length));
			switch (_image.Preferences.Compressor.Type)
			{
			case CompressorType.JPEG:
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Filter"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("DCTDecode"));
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("ColorSpace"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("DeviceRGB"));
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("BitsPerComponent"), new Integer(8));
				break;
			case CompressorType.Flate:
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Filter"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("FlateDecode"));
				switch (_image.Preferences.Converter.Type)
				{
				case ConverterType.RGB:
					dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("ColorSpace"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("DeviceRGB"));
					dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("BitsPerComponent"), new Integer(8));
					break;
				case ConverterType.Grey:
					dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("ColorSpace"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("DeviceGray"));
					dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("BitsPerComponent"), new Integer(8));
					break;
				case ConverterType.BW:
					dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("ColorSpace"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("DeviceGray"));
					dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("BitsPerComponent"), new Integer(1));
					break;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (_transparentColor != null && !_isSoftMask && _softMaskReference == null)
			{
				byte r = _transparentColor.R;
				byte g = _transparentColor.G;
				byte b = _transparentColor.B;
				int value = (r * 3 + g * 6 + b) / 10;
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Array array2 = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Array();
				if (_image.Preferences.Compressor.Type == CompressorType.JPEG)
				{
					array2.Add(new Integer(r));
					array2.Add(new Integer(r));
					array2.Add(new Integer(g));
					array2.Add(new Integer(g));
					array2.Add(new Integer(b));
					array2.Add(new Integer(b));
				}
				else
				{
					switch (_image.Preferences.Converter.Type)
					{
					case ConverterType.RGB:
						array2.Add(new Integer(r));
						array2.Add(new Integer(r));
						array2.Add(new Integer(g));
						array2.Add(new Integer(g));
						array2.Add(new Integer(b));
						array2.Add(new Integer(b));
						break;
					case ConverterType.Grey:
						array2.Add(new Integer(value));
						array2.Add(new Integer(value));
						break;
					case ConverterType.BW:
						array2.Add(new Integer(value));
						array2.Add(new Integer(value));
						break;
					}
				}
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Mask"), array2);
			}
			dictionary.Write(writer);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("stream");
			writer.Write((byte)13);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.WriteUnchecked(memoryStream.ToArray());
			writer.Write((byte)13);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("endstream");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("endobj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
		}
	}

		{

			writer.Write(" 0 obj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			Dictionary dictionary = new Dictionary();
			dictionary.WrapBound = 1;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_author))
			{
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Author"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.String(_author));

			{
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Producer"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.String(_producer));
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_title))
			{
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Title"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.String(_title));
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_subject))
			{
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Subject"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.String(_subject));
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_keywords))
			{
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Keywords"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.String(_keywords));
			}
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("CreationDate"), new Date(_created));
			if (_modified.CompareTo(_created) > 0)
			{
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("ModDate"), new Date(_modified));
			}
			foreach (Dictionary.Entry item in _dictionary)
			{
				dictionary.Add(item);
			}
			dictionary.Write(writer);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("endobj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
		}
	}

	internal class GradientFunction : Object
	{
		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.ColorBlend _blend;

		public GradientFunction(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.ColorBlend blend)
		{
			if (blend == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("blend");
			}
			_blend = blend;
		}

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color[] CreateGradient(int length)
		{
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color[] array = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color[length];
			int i = 0;
			int num = 0;
			int count = _blend.Count;
			while (i < length)
			{
				if (num < count - 1)
				{
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color color = _blend[num].Color;
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color color2 = _blend[num + 1].Color;
					int num2 = (int)(_blend[num + 1].Position * (float)length);
					float num3 = num2 - i;
					if (num3 == 0f)
					{
						num3 = 1f;
					}
					float num4 = (float)(color2.R - color.R) / num3;
					float num5 = (float)(color2.G - color.G) / num3;
					float num6 = (float)(color2.B - color.B) / num3;
					float num7 = (int)color.R;
					float num8 = (int)color.G;
					float num9 = (int)color.B;
					for (; i < num2; i++)
					{
						array[i] = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color((byte)num7, (byte)num8, (byte)num9);
						num7 += num4;
						num8 += num5;
						num9 += num6;
					}
					num++;
				}
				else
				{
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color color3 = _blend[num].Color;
					for (; i < length; i++)
					{
						array[i] = color3;
					}
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		public override void Write(Writer writer)
		{
			writer.Write(_id);
			writer.Write(" 0 obj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			Dictionary dictionary = new Dictionary();
			dictionary.WrapBound = 1;
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("FunctionType"), new Integer(0));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("BitsPerSample"), new Integer(8));
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Array array = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Array();
			array.Add(new Integer(0));
			array.Add(new Integer(1));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Domain"), array);
			int num = 35;
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color[] array2 = CreateGradient(num);
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Array array3 = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Array();
			array3.Add(new Integer(num));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Size"), array3);
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Array array4 = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Array();
			array4.Add(new Integer(0));
			array4.Add(new Integer(num - 1));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Encode"), array4);
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Array array5 = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Array();
			array5.Add(new Integer(0));
			array5.Add(new Integer(1));
			array5.Add(new Integer(0));
			array5.Add(new Integer(1));
			array5.Add(new Integer(0));
			array5.Add(new Integer(1));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Range"), array5);
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Color color = array2[i];
				memoryStream.WriteByte(color.R);
				memoryStream.WriteByte(color.G);
				memoryStream.WriteByte(color.B);
			}
			memoryStream.Position = 0L;
			memoryStream = _document.Compressor.Deflate(memoryStream);
			Encryptor encryptor = writer.Encryptor;
			if (encryptor != null)
			{
				memoryStream.Position = 0L;
				memoryStream = Cipher.Encrypt(memoryStream, encryptor.Key, encryptor.Document.Cipher);
			}
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Length"), new Long(memoryStream.Length));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Filter"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("FlateDecode"));
			dictionary.Write(writer);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("stream");
			writer.Write((byte)13);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.WriteUnchecked(memoryStream.ToArray());
			writer.Write((byte)13);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("endstream");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("endobj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
		}
	}

	internal class Bookmark : Object, IBookmark
	{
		private Bookmark _parent;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Destination _destination;

		private string _title;

		private bool _opened;

		private BookmarkCollection _content;

		private BookmarkCollection Content => _content;

		private int Count
		{
			get
			{
				int num = 0;
				int count = _content.Count;
				int num2;
				for (num2 = 0; num2 < count; num2++)
				{
					Bookmark bookmark = _content[num2];
					num = ((bookmark.Opened && bookmark.Content.Count != 0) ? (num + bookmark.Count) : (num + 1));
					num2++;
				}
				if (!_opened)
				{
					num = -num;
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		private bool Opened => _opened;

		public Bookmark()
		{
			_content = new BookmarkCollection();
		}

		public Bookmark(Bookmark parent, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Destination destination, string title, bool opened)
			: this()
		{
			_parent = parent;
			_destination = destination;
			_title = title;
			_opened = opened;
		}

		public IBookmark AddBookmark(int pageIndex, float x, float y, string title, bool opened)
		{
			if (title == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("title");
			}
			PdfPage pdfPage = _document.Pages[pageIndex];
			Bookmark bookmark = new Bookmark(this, new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Destination(pdfPage, x, pdfPage.Height - y), title, opened);
			_content.Add(bookmark);
			_document.Add(bookmark);
			return bookmark;
		}

		public override void Write(Writer writer)
		{
			writer.Write(_id);
			writer.Write(" 0 obj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			Dictionary dictionary = new Dictionary();
			dictionary.WrapBound = 1;
			if (_parent == null)
			{
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Type"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Outlines"));
			}
			else
			{
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Parent"), new Reference(_parent));
				if (_title != null)
				{
					dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Title"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.String(_title));
				}
				if (_destination != null)
				{
					dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Dest"), _destination);
				}
			}
			int count = _content.Count;
			if (count > 0)
			{
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("First"), new Reference(_content[0]));
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Last"), new Reference(_content[count - 1]));
			}
			int num = Count;
			if (_parent != null)
			{
				count = _parent.Content.Count;
				int num2 = _parent.Content.IndexOf(this);
				if (num2 != -1)
				{
					if (num2 > 0)
					{
						dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Prev"), new Reference(_parent.Content[num2 - 1]));
					}
					if (num2 < count - 1)
					{
						dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Next"), new Reference(_parent.Content[num2 + 1]));
					}
				}
				if (num != 0)
				{
					dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Count"), new Integer(num));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (num < 0)
				{
					num = -num;
				}
				if (num != 0)
				{
					dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Count"), new Integer(num));
				}
			}
			dictionary.Write(writer);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("endobj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
		}
	}
