	internal class PdfPage : Object, IPdfPage
	{
		private struct Procset
		{
			public bool Text;

			public bool ImageB;

			public bool ImageC;
		}

		private PdfPageCollection _parent;

		private float _width;

		private float _height;

		private Stream _stream;

		private Procset _procset;

		private Thumbnail _thumbnail;

		private AnnotCollection _annots;

		private PdfGraphics _graphics;

		private HashSet<Font> _fonts;

		private HashSet<Image> _images;

		private HashSet<ExtGState> _egStates;

		private HashSet<Pattern> _patterns;

		private Annot _annot;

		public IPdfGraphics Graphics => _graphics;

		public float Height => _height;

		public Stream Stream => _stream;

		public float Width => _width;

		public PdfPage(PdfPageCollection parent, float width, float height)
		{
			if (parent == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("parent");
			}
			_parent = parent;
			_width = width;
			_height = height;
			_stream = new Stream();
			_procset = default(Procset);
			_annots = new AnnotCollection();
			_fonts = new HashSet<Font>();
			_images = new HashSet<Image>();
			_egStates = new HashSet<ExtGState>();
			_patterns = new HashSet<Pattern>();
			_graphics = new PdfGraphics(this);
		}

		public void AddAnnot(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Rectangle rectangle, Action action)
		{
			if (_annot == null || !_annot.TryMerge(rectangle, action))
			{
				_annot = new Annot(rectangle, action);
				_annots.Add(_annot);
				_document.Add(_annot);
			}
		}

		public void AttachThumbnail(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image)
		{
			_thumbnail = new Thumbnail(image);
			_document.Add(_thumbnail);
		}

		public ExtGState GetExtGState(float strokeOpacity, float fillOpacity)
		{
			ExtGState extGState = _document.GetExtGState(strokeOpacity, fillOpacity);
			if (!_egStates.Contains(extGState))
			{
				_egStates.Add(extGState);
			}
			return extGState;
		}

		public Font GetFont(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font font, bool embed, bool subset)
		{
			return GetFont(font, embed, subset, enableCIDFontRendering: false);
		}

		public Font GetFont(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Font font, bool embed, bool subset, bool enableCIDFontRendering)
		{
			Font font2 = _document.GetFont(font, embed, subset, enableCIDFontRendering);
			if (!_fonts.Contains(font2))
			{
				_fonts.Add(font2);
				_procset.Text = true;
			}
			return font2;
		}

		public Image GetImage(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image)
		{
			switch (image.Preferences.Converter.Type)
			{
			case ConverterType.RGB:
				_procset.ImageC = true;
				break;
			case ConverterType.Grey:
			case ConverterType.BW:
				_procset.ImageB = true;
				break;
			}
			Image image2 = _document.GetImage(image);
			if (!_images.Contains(image2))
			{
				_images.Add(image2);
			}
			return image2;
		}

		public Pattern GetPattern(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Brush brush)
		{
			Pattern pattern = _document.GetPattern(brush, this);
			if (!_patterns.Contains(pattern))
			{
				_patterns.Add(pattern);
			}
			return pattern;
		}

		public override void AddNotify()
		{
			_document.Add(_stream);
		}

		public override void Write(Writer writer)
		{
			writer.Write(_id);
			writer.Write(" 0 obj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			Dictionary dictionary = new Dictionary();
			dictionary.WrapBound = 1;
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Type"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Page"));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Parent"), new Reference(_parent));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("MediaBox"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Rectangle(0f, 0f, _width, _height));
			if (_fonts.Count > 0 || _images.Count > 0 || _egStates.Count > 0 || _patterns.Count > 0)
			{
				Dictionary dictionary2 = new Dictionary();
				dictionary2.WrapBound = 1;
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Array array = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Array();
				if (_procset.Text)
				{
					array.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Text"));
				}
				if (_procset.ImageB)
				{
					array.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("ImageB"));
				}
				if (_procset.ImageC)
				{
					array.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("ImageC"));
				}
				dictionary2.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("ProcSet"), array);
				if (_fonts.Count > 0)
				{
					Dictionary dictionary3 = new Dictionary();
					dictionary3.WrapBound = 16;
					foreach (Font item in _fonts.Items)
					{
						int num = 0;
						foreach (FontReference reference in item.References)
						{
							dictionary3.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name(item.ResourceName(num)), new Reference(reference));
							num++;
						}
					}
					dictionary2.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Font"), dictionary3);
				}
				if (_images.Count > 0)
				{
					Dictionary dictionary4 = new Dictionary();
					dictionary4.WrapBound = 16;
					foreach (Image item2 in _images.Items)
					{
						dictionary4.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name(item2.ResourceName()), new Reference(item2));
					}
					dictionary2.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("XObject"), dictionary4);
				}
				if (_egStates.Count > 0)
				{
					Dictionary dictionary5 = new Dictionary();
					dictionary5.WrapBound = 16;
					foreach (ExtGState item3 in _egStates.Items)
					{
						dictionary5.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name(item3.ResourceName), new Reference(item3));
					}
					dictionary2.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("ExtGState"), dictionary5);
				}
				if (_patterns.Count > 0)
				{
					Dictionary dictionary6 = new Dictionary();
					dictionary6.WrapBound = 16;
					foreach (Pattern item4 in _patterns.Items)
					{
						dictionary6.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name(item4.ResourceName()), new Reference(item4));
					}
					dictionary2.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Pattern"), dictionary6);
				}
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Resources"), dictionary2);
			}
			_stream.Detach();
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Contents"), new Reference(_stream));
			_stream = null;
			if (_thumbnail != null)
			{
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Thumb"), new Reference(_thumbnail));
			}
			if (_annots.Count > 0)
			{
				Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Array array2 = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Array();
				foreach (Annot annot in _annots)
				{
					array2.Add(new Reference(annot));
				}
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Annots"), array2);
			}
			dictionary.Write(writer);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("endobj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
		}
	}

	internal class Stream : Object
	{
		private MemoryStream _content;

		private Dictionary _dictionary;

		private IMarker _marker;

		public MemoryStream Content => _content;

		public Dictionary Dictionary => _dictionary;

		public Stream()
		{
			_content = new MemoryStream();
			_dictionary = new Dictionary();
		}

		public void Attach(FileBuffer fb)
		{
			if (fb != null && _marker == null)
			{
				IWriter writer = fb.GetWriter();
				byte[] array = _content.ToArray();
				writer.WriteInt(array.Length);
				writer.WriteBlock(array);
				_content = null;
				_marker = writer.Close();
			}
		}

		public void Detach()
		{
			if (_marker != null)
			{
				IReader reader = _marker.FileBuffer.GetReader(_marker);
				int size = reader.ReadInt();
				byte[] buffer = reader.ReadBlock(size);
				_content = new MemoryStream(buffer);
				_marker = null;
			}
		}

		public void Write(Writer writer, Dictionary dictionary)
		{
			foreach (Dictionary.Entry item in _dictionary)
			{
				dictionary.Add(item);
			}
			_content.Position = 0L;
			_content = _document.Compressor.Deflate(_content);
			Encryptor encryptor = writer.Encryptor;
			if (encryptor != null)
			{
				_content.Position = 0L;
				_content = Cipher.Encrypt(_content, encryptor.Key, encryptor.Document.Cipher);
			}
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Length"), new Long(_content.Length));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Filter"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("FlateDecode"));
			dictionary.Write(writer);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("stream");
			writer.Write((byte)13);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.WriteUnchecked(_content.ToArray());
			writer.Write((byte)13);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("endstream");
			_content = null;
		}

		public override void Write(Writer writer)
		{
			writer.Write(_id);
			writer.Write(" 0 obj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			Dictionary dictionary = new Dictionary();
			dictionary.WrapBound = 1;
			Write(writer, dictionary);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("endobj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
		}
	}
	internal class Thumbnail : Object
	{
		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image _image;

		public Thumbnail(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("image");
			}
			_image = image;
		}

		public override void Write(Writer writer)
		{
			writer.Write(_id);
			writer.Write(" 0 obj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			Dictionary dictionary = new Dictionary();
			dictionary.WrapBound = 1;
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Width"), new Integer(_image.Width));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Height"), new Integer(_image.Height));
			MemoryStream memoryStream = _image.Preferences.Compressor.Compress(_image, _image.Preferences.Converter);
			Encryptor encryptor = writer.Encryptor;
			if (encryptor != null)
			{
				memoryStream.Position = 0L;
				memoryStream = Cipher.Encrypt(memoryStream, encryptor.Key, encryptor.Document.Cipher);
			}
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Length"), new Long(memoryStream.Length));
			switch (_image.Preferences.Compressor.Type)
			{
			case CompressorType.JPEG:
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Filter"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("DCTDecode"));
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("ColorSpace"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("DeviceRGB"));
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("BitsPerComponent"), new Integer(8));
				break;
			case CompressorType.Flate:
				dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Filter"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("FlateDecode"));
				switch (_image.Preferences.Converter.Type)
				{
				case ConverterType.RGB:
					dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("ColorSpace"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("DeviceRGB"));
					dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("BitsPerComponent"), new Integer(8));
					break;
				case ConverterType.Grey:
					dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("ColorSpace"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("DeviceGray"));
					dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("BitsPerComponent"), new Integer(8));
					break;
				case ConverterType.BW:
					dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("ColorSpace"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("DeviceGray"));
					dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("BitsPerComponent"), new Integer(1));
					break;
				}
				break;
			}
			dictionary.Write(writer);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("stream");
			writer.Write((byte)13);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.WriteUnchecked(memoryStream.ToArray());
			writer.Write((byte)13);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("endstream");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("endobj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
		}
	}
	internal class TilingPattern : Pattern
	{
		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image _internalImage;

		private Image _image;

		public TilingPattern(int index, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Image image)
			: base(index)

		}

		public override void AddNotify()
		{
			_image = _document.GetImage(_internalImage);
		}

		public override void Write(Writer writer)
		{
			writer.Write(_id);
			writer.Write(" 0 obj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			Dictionary dictionary = new Dictionary();
			dictionary.WrapBound = 1;
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Type"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Pattern"));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("PatternType"), new Integer(1));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("PaintType"), new Integer(1));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("TilingType"), new Integer(1));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("BBox"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Rectangle(0f, 0f, _internalImage.Width, _internalImage.Height));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("XStep"), new Real(_internalImage.Width));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("YStep"), new Real(_internalImage.Height));

			array.Add(new Real(_matrix.M11));
			array.Add(new Real(_matrix.M12));
			array.Add(new Real(_matrix.M21));
			array.Add(new Real(_matrix.M22));
			array.Add(new Real(_matrix.OffsetX));
			array.Add(new Real(_matrix.OffsetY));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Matrix"), array);
			Dictionary dictionary2 = new Dictionary();
			dictionary2.WrapBound = 1;
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Array array2 = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Array();
			array2.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("PDF"));
			array2.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("ImageC"));
			dictionary2.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("ProcSet"), array2);
			Dictionary dictionary3 = new Dictionary();
			dictionary3.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name(_image.ResourceName()), new Reference(_image));
			dictionary2.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("XObject"), dictionary3);
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Resources"), dictionary2);
			Stream stream = new Stream();
			stream.Document = _document;
			StateOperator stateOperator = new StateOperator();
			ImageOperator imageOperator = new ImageOperator();
			Semaphore semaphore = new Semaphore(stream);
			semaphore.Select(stateOperator);
			stateOperator.Save();
			semaphore.Select(imageOperator);
			imageOperator.SetPosition(0f, 0f);
			imageOperator.SetSize(_internalImage.Width, _internalImage.Height);
			imageOperator.OutImage(_image);
			semaphore.Select(stateOperator);
			stateOperator.Restore();
			semaphore.Select(null);
			stream.Write(writer, dictionary);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("endobj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
		}

	internal class UnicodeMap : Object
	{
		private IDictionary<char, int> _unicodeItems;

		private FontReference _fontReference;

		public UnicodeMap(FontReference fontReference)
		{
			_unicodeItems = new Dictionary<char, int>(256);
			_fontReference = fontReference;
		}

		public void Add(char ch, int code)
		{
			_unicodeItems[ch] = code;
		}

		public override void Write(Writer writer)
		{
			writer.Write(_id);
			writer.Write(" 0 obj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			Writer writer2 = new Writer(memoryStream);
			writer2.Write("/CIDInit /ProcSet findresource begin");
			writer2.Write((byte)10);
			writer2.Write("12 dict begin");
			writer2.Write((byte)10);
			writer2.Write("begincmap");
			writer2.Write((byte)10);
			bool enableCIDFontRendering = _fontReference.Font.EnableCIDFontRendering;
			if (enableCIDFontRendering)
			{
				writer2.Write("/CIDSystemInfo << /Registry (Adobe) /Ordering (UCS) /Supplement 0 >> def");
			}
			else
			{
				writer2.Write("/CIDSystemInfo <</Registry (" + _fontReference.Font.ResourceName() + "+0) /Supplement 0 >> def");
			}
			writer2.Write((byte)10);
			if (enableCIDFontRendering)
			{
				writer2.Write("/CMapName /Adobe-Identity-UCS def");
			}
			else
			{
				writer2.Write("/CMapName /" + _fontReference.Font.ResourceName() + "+0 def");
			}
			writer2.Write((byte)10);
			writer2.Write("/CMapType 2 def");
			writer2.Write((byte)10);
			Encoding encoding = _fontReference.Encoding;
			if (enableCIDFontRendering)
			{
				writer2.Write("1 begincodespacerange <0000> <FFFF> endcodespacerange");
			}
			else if (encoding != null)
			{
				writer2.Write("1 begincodespacerange <" + Converter.ToHex((byte)encoding.FirstIndex) + "><" + Converter.ToHex((byte)encoding.LastIndex) + "> endcodespacerange");
			}
			else
			{
				writer2.Write("1 begincodespacerange <" + Converter.ToHex((byte)0) + "><" + Converter.ToHex(byte.MaxValue) + "> endcodespacerange");
			}
			writer2.Write((byte)10);
			int count = _unicodeItems.Count;
			writer2.Write(count + " beginbfchar");
			writer2.Write((byte)10);
			IEnumerator<KeyValuePair<char, int>> enumerator = _unicodeItems.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				KeyValuePair<char, int> current = enumerator.Current;
				byte b = (byte)((int)current.Key >> 8);
				byte b2 = (byte)current.Key;
				if (enableCIDFontRendering)
				{
					writer2.Write("<" + Converter.ToHex(current.Value).PadLeft(4, '0') + "><" + Converter.ToHex(b) + Converter.ToHex(b2) + ">");
				}
				else
				{
					writer2.Write("<" + Converter.ToHex(current.Value) + "><" + Converter.ToHex(b) + Converter.ToHex(b2) + ">");
				}
				writer2.Write((byte)10);
			}
			writer2.Write("endbfchar");
			writer2.Write((byte)10);
			writer2.Write("endcmap");
			writer2.Write((byte)10);
			writer2.Write("CMapName currentdict /CMap defineresource pop");
			writer2.Write((byte)10);
			writer2.Write("end");
			writer2.Write((byte)10);
			writer2.Write("end");
			Dictionary dictionary = new Dictionary();
			dictionary.WrapBound = 1;
			memoryStream.Position = 0L;
			memoryStream = _document.Compressor.Deflate(memoryStream);
			Encryptor encryptor = writer.Encryptor;
			if (encryptor != null)
			{
				memoryStream.Position = 0L;
				memoryStream = Cipher.Encrypt(memoryStream, encryptor.Key, encryptor.Document.Cipher);
			}
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Length"), new Long(memoryStream.Length));
			dictionary.Add(new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("Filter"), new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Name("FlateDecode"));
			dictionary.Write(writer);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("stream");
			writer.Write((byte)13);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.WriteUnchecked(memoryStream.ToArray());
			writer.Write((byte)13);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("endstream");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("endobj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
		}
	}

		private bool _solid;

		public Widths(bool solid)
		{
			_content = new List<int>(256);
			_solid = solid;
		}

		public void Add(int value)
		{
			_content.Add(value);
		}

		public override void Write(Writer writer)
		{
			writer.Write(_id);
			writer.Write(" 0 obj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Array array = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.PDF.Atoms.Array();
			array.WrapBound = 16;
			int count = _content.Count;
			if (_solid)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					array.Add(new Integer(_content[i]));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
				{
					if (j == 26)
					{
						for (int k = 0; k < 6; k++)
						{
							array.Add(new Integer(500));
						}
					}
					array.Add(new Integer(_content[j]));
				}
			}
			array.Write(writer);
			writer.Write((byte)10);
			writer.Write("endobj");
			writer.Write((byte)10);
		}
	}
	internal class Writer
	{
		private System.IO.Stream _stream;

		private int _counter;

		private Encryptor _encryptor;

		private StreamFormat _format;

		private bool _unicode;

		public int Counter => _counter;

		public Encryptor Encryptor
		{
			get
			{
				return _encryptor;
			}
			set
			{
				_encryptor = value;
			}
		}

		public StreamFormat Format
		{
			get
			{
				return _format;
			}
			set
			{
				_format = value;
			}
		}

		public System.IO.Stream Stream => _stream;

		public bool Unicode
		{
			get
			{
				return _unicode;
			}
			set
			{
				_unicode = value;
			}
		}

		public Writer(System.IO.Stream stream)
		{
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("stream");
			}
			_stream = stream;
			_format = StreamFormat.Default;
		}

		public void Write(byte b)
		{
			switch (_format)
			{
			case StreamFormat.Hex:
			{
				byte value = (byte)Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Utils.Defs.HexDigits[b >> 4];
				byte value2 = (byte)Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Utils.Defs.HexDigits[b & 0xF];
				_stream.WriteByte(value);
				_counter++;
				_stream.WriteByte(value2);
				_counter++;
				break;
			}
			case StreamFormat.Escape:
				if (b == 40 || b == 41 || b == 92)
				{
					_stream.WriteByte(92);
					_counter++;
				}
				_stream.WriteByte(b);
				_counter++;
				break;
			default:
				_stream.WriteByte(b);
				_counter++;
				break;
			}
		}

		public void Write(byte[] buffer)
		{
			foreach (byte b in buffer)
			{
				Write(b);
			}
		}

		public void Write(System.IO.Stream stream)
		{
			while (true)
			{
				int num = stream.ReadByte();
				if (num != -1)
				{
					Write((byte)num);
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		public void Write(char ch)
		{
			if (_unicode)
			{
				byte b = (byte)((int)ch >> 8);
				byte b2 = (byte)ch;
				Write(b);
				Write(b2);
			}
			else
			{
				Write((byte)ch);
			}
		}

		public void Write(string text)
		{
			if (_unicode)
			{
				foreach (char c in text)
				{
					byte b = (byte)((int)c >> 8);
					byte b2 = (byte)c;
					Write(b);
					Write(b2);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (char c2 in text)
				{
					Write((byte)c2);
				}
			}
		}

		public void Write(int value)
		{
			Write(value.ToString());
		}

		public void Write(long value)
		{
			Write(value.ToString());
		}

		public void Write(ulong value)
		{
			Write(value.ToString());
		}

		public void Write(float value)
		{
			Write(Converter.ToString(value, 3));
		}

		public void Write(bool value)
		{
			if (value)
			{
				Write("true");
			}
			else
			{
				Write("false");
			}
		}

		public void WriteUnchecked(byte[] buffer)
		{
			if (buffer.Length != 0)
			{
				_stream.Write(buffer, 0, buffer.Length);
				_counter += buffer.Length;
			}
		}

		public void WriteUnchecked(System.IO.Stream stream)
		{
			for (int num = stream.ReadByte(); num != -1; num = stream.ReadByte())
			{
				_stream.WriteByte((byte)num);
				_counter++;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class XRef
	{
		private int _offset;

		private int _generationId;

		public XRef(int offset, int generationId)
		{
			_offset = offset;
			_generationId = generationId;
		}

		public string ResourceName()
		{
			string text = _offset.ToString();
			string text2 = _generationId.ToString();
			string text3 = new string('0', 10 - text.Length) + text + " " + new string('0', 5 - text2.Length) + text2;
			if (_generationId == 65535)
			{
				return text3 + " f ";
			}
			return text3 + " n ";
		}
	}
}

	internal class ImageOperator : Operator
	{
		private float _xPos;

		private float _yPos;

		private float _width;

		private float _height;

		public void OutImage(Image image)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("image");
			}
			if (_active)
			{
				_writer.Write(_width);
				_writer.Write(" ");
				_writer.Write("0 0 ");
				_writer.Write(0f - _height);
				_writer.Write(" ");
				_writer.Write(_xPos);
				_writer.Write(" ");
				_writer.Write(_yPos + _height);
				_writer.Write(" ");
				_writer.Write("cm ");
				_writer.Write("/");
				_writer.Write(image.ResourceName());
				_writer.Write(" Do");
				_writer.Write((byte)10);
				_empty = false;
			}
		}

		public void SetPosition(float x, float y)
		{
			_xPos = x;
			_yPos = y;
		}

		public void SetSize(float width, float height)
		{
			_width = width;
			_height = height;
		}
	}
	internal class Operator
	{
		protected MemoryStream _stream;

		protected Writer _writer;

		protected bool _active;

		protected bool _empty;

		public bool Active => _active;

		public Operator()
		{
			_stream = new MemoryStream();
			_writer = new Writer(_stream);
			_empty = true;
		}

		public virtual void Close()
		{
			_active = false;
		}

		public virtual void Open()
		{
			_active = true;
		}

		public void FlushWrite(Writer writer)
		{
			if (!_empty)
			{
				writer.WriteUnchecked(_stream.ToArray());
				_stream = new MemoryStream();
				_writer = new Writer(_stream);
				_empty = true;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class PathOperator : Operator
	{
		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Path _path;

		private bool _fill;

		private bool _stroke;

		private bool _clip;

		private bool _alternate;

		public bool Alternate
		{
			get
			{
				return _alternate;
			}
			set
			{
				_alternate = value;
			}
		}

		public bool Clip
		{
			get
			{
				return _clip;
			}
			set
			{
				_clip = value;
			}
		}

		public bool Fill
		{
			get
			{
				return _fill;
			}
			set
			{
				_fill = value;
			}
		}

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Path Path => _path;

		public bool Stroke
		{
			get
			{
				return _stroke;
			}
			set
			{
				_stroke = value;
			}
		}

		public PathOperator()
		{
			_path = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Path();
		}

		public void ClosePath()
		{
			_path.ClosePath();
		}

		public void CurveTo(float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2, float x3, float y3)
		{
			_path.CurveTo(x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3);
		}

		public void LineTo(float x, float y)
		{
			_path.LineTo(x, y);
		}

		public void MoveTo(float x, float y)
		{
			_path.MoveTo(x, y);
		}

		public void OutPath()
		{
			if (!_active)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (IPathCommand command in _path.Commands)
			{
				switch (command.Type)
				{
				case CommandType.MoveTo:
				{
					MoveToCommand moveToCommand = (MoveToCommand)command;
					_writer.Write(moveToCommand.X);
					_writer.Write(" ");
					_writer.Write(moveToCommand.Y);
					_writer.Write(" m ");
					break;
				}
				case CommandType.LineTo:
				{
					LineToCommand lineToCommand = (LineToCommand)command;
					_writer.Write(lineToCommand.X);
					_writer.Write(" ");
					_writer.Write(lineToCommand.Y);
					_writer.Write(" l ");
					break;
				}
				case CommandType.CurveTo:
				{
					CurveToCommand curveToCommand = (CurveToCommand)command;
					_writer.Write(curveToCommand.X1);
					_writer.Write(" ");
					_writer.Write(curveToCommand.Y1);
					_writer.Write(" ");
					_writer.Write(curveToCommand.X2);
					_writer.Write(" ");
					_writer.Write(curveToCommand.Y2);
					_writer.Write(" ");
					_writer.Write(curveToCommand.X3);
					_writer.Write(" ");
					_writer.Write(curveToCommand.Y3);
					_writer.Write(" c ");
					break;
				}
				case CommandType.ClosePath:
					_writer.Write("h ");
					break;
				}
			}
			_path.Commands.Clear();
			if (_alternate)
			{
				if (_clip)
				{
					_writer.Write("W* ");
				}
				if (_fill && _stroke)
				{
					_writer.Write("B* ");
				}
				if (!_fill && !_stroke)
				{
					_writer.Write("n ");
				}
				if (_fill && !_stroke)
				{
					_writer.Write("f* ");
				}
				if (!_fill && _stroke)
				{
					_writer.Write("S ");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (_clip)
				{
					_writer.Write("W ");
				}
				if (_fill && _stroke)
				{
					_writer.Write("B ");
				}
				if (!_fill && !_stroke)
				{
					_writer.Write("n ");
				}
				if (_fill && !_stroke)
				{
					_writer.Write("f ");
				}
				if (!_fill && _stroke)
				{
					_writer.Write("S ");
				}
			}
			_writer.Write((byte)10);
			_fill = false;
			_stroke = false;
			_clip = false;
			_alternate = false;
			_empty = false;
		}

		public void SetFillPattern(Pattern pattern)
		{
			if (pattern == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("pattern");
			}
			if (_active)
			{
				_writer.Write("/Pattern cs ");
				_writer.Write("/");
				_writer.Write(pattern.ResourceName());
				_writer.Write(" scn ");
				_writer.Write((byte)10);
				_empty = false;
			}
		}

		public void SetFillColor(float r, float g, float b)
		{
			if (_active)
			{
				_writer.Write(r);
				_writer.Write(" ");
				_writer.Write(g);
				_writer.Write(" ");
				_writer.Write(b);
				_writer.Write(" rg ");
				_empty = false;
			}
		}

		public void SetLineCap(int value)
		{
			if (_active)
			{
				_writer.Write(value);
				_writer.Write(" J ");
				_empty = false;
			}
		}

		public void SetLineJoin(int value)
		{
			if (_active)
			{
				_writer.Write(value);
				_writer.Write(" j ");
				_empty = false;
			}
		}

		public void SetLineMiterLimit(float value)
		{
			if (_active)
			{
				_writer.Write(value);
				_writer.Write(" M ");
				_empty = false;
			}
		}

		public void SetLinePattern(float[] pattern)
		{
			if (pattern == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("pattern");
			}
			if (!_active)
			{
				return;
			}
			_writer.Write("[");
			int num = pattern.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				_writer.Write(pattern[i]);
				if (i < num - 1)
				{
					_writer.Write(" ");
				}
			}
			_writer.Write("] ");
			_writer.Write("0 d ");
			_empty = false;
		}

		public void SetLineWidth(float value)
		{
			if (_active)
			{
				_writer.Write(value);
				_writer.Write(" w ");
				_empty = false;
			}
		}

		public void SetStrokeColor(float r, float g, float b)
		{
			if (_active)
			{
				_writer.Write(r);
				_writer.Write(" ");
				_writer.Write(g);
				_writer.Write(" ");
				_writer.Write(b);
				_writer.Write(" RG ");
				_empty = false;
			}
		}

	internal class Semaphore
	{
		private Stream _stream;

		private Operator _operator;

		public Semaphore(Stream stream)
		{
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("stream");
			}
			_stream = stream;
		}

		public void Select(Operator op)
		{
			if (_operator == op)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_operator != null && _operator.Active)
			{
				_operator.Close();
				if (_stream != null)
				{
					_operator.FlushWrite(new Writer(_stream.Content));
				}
			}
			if (op != null && !op.Active)
			{
				op.Open();
			}
			_operator = op;
		}
	}

	internal class TextOperator : Operator
	{
		private Font _font;

		private string _fontName;

		private float _fontSize;

		private bool _bold;

		private bool _italic;

		private int _referenceIndex;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix _matrix;

		private float _posX;

		private float _posY;

		private float _fillR;

		private float _fillG;

		private float _fillB;

		private Pattern _fillPattern;

		private float _charSpacing;

		private bool _applyFont;

		private bool _applyMatrix;

		private bool _applyFillColor;

		private bool _applyFillPattern;

		private bool _applyCharSpacing;

		public Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix Matrix => _matrix;

		public TextOperator()
		{
			_referenceIndex = -1;
			_matrix = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.Matrix(1f, 0f, 0f, -1f, 0f, 0f);
		}

		public void ForceApplyFont()
		{
			_applyFont = true;
		}

		public void ForceApplyMatrix()
		{
			_applyMatrix = true;
		}

		public void OutText(string text)
		{
			if (text == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("text");
			}
			if (!_active || _font == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int length = text.Length;
			switch (length)
			{
			case 1:
				if (text[0] <= ' ')
				{
					return;
				}
				break;
			case 0:
				return;
			}
			if (_applyFillPattern)
			{
				_writer.Write("/Pattern cs ");
				_writer.Write("/");
				_writer.Write(_fillPattern.ResourceName());
				_writer.Write(" scn ");
				_applyFillPattern = false;
			}
			if (_applyFillColor)
			{
				_writer.Write(_fillR);
				_writer.Write(" ");
				_writer.Write(_fillG);
				_writer.Write(" ");
				_writer.Write(_fillB);
				_writer.Write(" rg ");
				_applyFillColor = false;
			}
			if (_applyCharSpacing)
			{
				_writer.Write(_charSpacing / _matrix.M11);
				_writer.Write(" Tc ");
				_applyCharSpacing = false;
			}
			if (_applyMatrix)
			{
				_writer.Write(_matrix.M11);
				_writer.Write(" ");
				_writer.Write(_matrix.M12);
				_writer.Write(" ");
				_writer.Write(_matrix.M21);
				_writer.Write(" ");
				_writer.Write(_matrix.M22);
				_writer.Write(" ");
				_writer.Write(_matrix.OffsetX);
				_writer.Write(" ");
				_writer.Write(_matrix.OffsetY);
				_writer.Write(" Tm ");
				_applyMatrix = false;
			}
			else
			{
				float num = _matrix.OffsetX - _posX;
				float num2 = _matrix.OffsetY - _posY;
				num /= _matrix.M11;
				num2 /= _matrix.M22;
				num -= num2 * _matrix.M21;
				num = (float)Convert.ToInt32(num * 1000f) / 1000f;
				num2 = (float)Convert.ToInt32(num2 * 1000f) / 1000f;
				_writer.Write(num);
				_writer.Write(" ");
				_writer.Write(num2);
				_writer.Write(" Td ");
			}
			_posX = _matrix.OffsetX;
			_posY = _matrix.OffsetY;
			bool flag = false;
			bool enableCIDFontRendering = _font.EnableCIDFontRendering;
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				char c = text[i];
				if (enableCIDFontRendering || c > 'ÿ')
				{
					_font.Embed = true;
					_font.Subset = true;
				}
				int num3 = 0;
				if (!enableCIDFontRendering)
				{
					num3 = _font.CharCode(c);
				}
				if (_applyFont || _referenceIndex != _font.ReferenceIndex)
				{
					_applyFont = false;
					_referenceIndex = _font.ReferenceIndex;
					if (flag)
					{
						_writer.Write(enableCIDFontRendering ? "> Tj " : ") Tj ");
						flag = false;
					}
					_writer.Write("/");
					_writer.Write(_font.ResourceName());
					_writer.Write(" ");
					_writer.Write(_fontSize);
					_writer.Write(" Tf ");
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					_writer.Write(enableCIDFontRendering ? "<" : "(");
					flag = true;
				}
				if (enableCIDFontRendering)
				{
					_writer.Write(Converter.ToHex(_font.GlyphId(c)).PadLeft(4, '0'));
					_font.WriteOutCIDFontRenderingInformation(c);
				}
				else if (_font.Symbolic)
				{
					_writer.Write("\\" + Converter.ToOctal(_font.CharCode(c)));
				}
				else
				{
					_writer.Write((char)num3);
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				_writer.Write(enableCIDFontRendering ? "> Tj " : ") Tj ");
				flag = false;
			}
			_empty = false;
		}

		public void SetCharSpacing(float value)
		{
			_charSpacing = value;
			_applyCharSpacing = true;
		}

		public void SetFillColor(float r, float g, float b)
		{
			_fillR = r;
			_fillG = g;
			_fillB = b;
			_applyFillColor = true;
			_applyFillPattern = false;
		}

		public void SetFillPattern(Pattern pattern)
		{
			if (pattern == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("pattern");
			}
			_fillPattern = pattern;
			_applyFillPattern = true;
			_applyFillColor = false;
		}

		public void SetFont(Font font)
		{
			if (font == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("font");
			}
			if (_fontName == null || _fontName != font.Name)
			{
				_fontName = font.Name;
				_applyFont = true;
			}
			if (_fontSize != font.Size)
			{
				_fontSize = font.Size;
				_applyFont = true;
			}
			if (_referenceIndex != font.ReferenceIndex)
			{
				_referenceIndex = font.ReferenceIndex;
				_applyFont = true;
			}
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle style = font.Style;
			bool flag = (style & Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Bold) == Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Bold;
			bool flag2 = (style & Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Italic) == Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Italic;
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle internalStyle = font.InternalStyle;
			bool flag3 = (internalStyle & Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Bold) == Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Bold;
			bool flag4 = (internalStyle & Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Italic) == Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Graphics.FontStyle.Italic;
			if (_bold != flag)
			{
				_bold = flag;
				_applyFont = true;
			}
			if (_bold && !flag3 && _matrix.M11 == 1f)
			{
				_matrix.M11 = 1.15f;
				_applyMatrix = true;
			}
			if (_bold && flag3 && _matrix.M11 != 1f)
			{
				_matrix.M11 = 1f;
				_applyMatrix = true;
			}
			if (!_bold && _matrix.M11 != 1f)
			{
				_matrix.M11 = 1f;
				_applyMatrix = true;
			}
			if (_italic != flag2)
			{
				_italic = flag2;
				_applyFont = true;
			}
			if (_italic && !flag4 && _matrix.M21 == 0f)
			{
				_matrix.M21 = 0.35f;
				_applyMatrix = true;
			}
			if (_italic && flag4 && _matrix.M21 != 0f)
			{
				_matrix.M21 = 0f;
				_applyMatrix = true;
			}
			if (!_italic && _matrix.M21 != 0f)
			{
				_matrix.M21 = 0f;
				_applyMatrix = true;
			}
			_font = font;
		}

		public void SetPosition(float x, float y)
		{
			_matrix.OffsetX = (float)Convert.ToInt32(x * 1000f) / 1000f;
			_matrix.OffsetY = (float)Convert.ToInt32(y * 1000f) / 1000f;
		}

		public override void Close()
		{
			if (_active)
			{
				_writer.Write((byte)10);
				_writer.Write("ET");
				_writer.Write((byte)10);
				_active = false;
			}
		}

		public override void Open()
		{
			if (!_active)
			{
				_writer.Write((byte)10);
				_writer.Write("BT");
				_writer.Write((byte)10);
				_active = true;
			}
		}
	}
}

	internal class Array : List<IAtom>, IAtom
	{
		private int _wrapBound;

		public int WrapBound
		{
			get
			{
				return _wrapBound;
			}
			set
			{
				_wrapBound = value;
			}
		}

		public void Write(Writer writer)
		{
			int count = base.Count;
			if (_wrapBound == 1)
			{
				writer.Write("[");
				writer.Write((byte)10);
			}
			else
			{
				writer.Write("[ ");
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				IAtom atom = base[i];
				atom.Write(writer);
				if (_wrapBound > 0)
				{
					if (i < count - 1)
					{
						if ((i + 1) % _wrapBound == 0)
						{
							writer.Write((byte)10);
						}
						else
						{
							writer.Write(" ");
						}
					}
				}
				else if (i < count - 1)
				{
					writer.Write(" ");
				}
			}
			if (_wrapBound == 1)
			{
				writer.Write("]");
			}
			else
			{
				writer.Write(" ]");
			}
		}
	}

	internal class Date : IAtom
	{
		private System.DateTime _value;

		public Date(System.DateTime value)
		{
			_value = value;
		}

		public void Write(Writer writer)
		{
			Encryptor encryptor = writer.Encryptor;
			if (encryptor != null)
			{
				writer.Write("<");
				writer.Format = StreamFormat.Hex;
				MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
				Writer writer2 = new Writer(memoryStream);
				writer2.Write("D:");
				string text = _value.Year.ToString("0000");
				writer2.Write(text);
				text = _value.Month.ToString("00");
				writer2.Write(text);
				text = _value.Day.ToString("00");
				writer2.Write(text);
				text = _value.Hour.ToString("00");
				writer2.Write(text);
				text = _value.Minute.ToString("00");
				writer2.Write(text);
				text = _value.Second.ToString("00");
				writer2.Write(text);
				TimeSpan timeSpan = System.DateTime.Now.Subtract(System.DateTime.UtcNow);
				if (timeSpan.Hours == 0 && timeSpan.Minutes == 0)
				{
					writer2.Write("Z");
				}
				else
				{
					if (timeSpan.Hours > 0 || (timeSpan.Hours == 0 && timeSpan.Minutes > 0))
					{
						writer2.Write("+");
					}
					else
					{
						writer2.Write("-");
					}
					writer2.Write(Math.Abs(timeSpan.Hours).ToString("00"));
					writer2.Write("'");
					writer2.Write(Math.Abs(timeSpan.Minutes).ToString("00"));
					writer2.Write("'");
				}
				memoryStream.Position = 0L;
				memoryStream = Cipher.Encrypt(memoryStream, encryptor.Key, encryptor.Document.Cipher);
				memoryStream.Position = 0L;
				writer.Write(memoryStream);
				writer.Format = StreamFormat.Default;
				writer.Write(">");
				return;
			}
			writer.Write("(D:");
			string text2 = _value.Year.ToString("0000");
			writer.Write(text2);
			text2 = _value.Month.ToString("00");
			writer.Write(text2);
			text2 = _value.Day.ToString("00");
			writer.Write(text2);
			text2 = _value.Hour.ToString("00");
			writer.Write(text2);
			text2 = _value.Minute.ToString("00");
			writer.Write(text2);
			text2 = _value.Second.ToString("00");
			writer.Write(text2);
			TimeSpan timeSpan2 = System.DateTime.Now.Subtract(System.DateTime.UtcNow);
			if (timeSpan2.Hours == 0 && timeSpan2.Minutes == 0)
			{
				writer.Write("Z");
			}
			else
			{
				if (timeSpan2.Hours > 0 || (timeSpan2.Hours == 0 && timeSpan2.Minutes > 0))
				{
					writer.Write("+");
				}
				else
				{
					writer.Write("-");
				}
				writer.Write(Math.Abs(timeSpan2.Hours).ToString("00"));
				writer.Write("'");
				writer.Write(Math.Abs(timeSpan2.Minutes).ToString("00"));
				writer.Write("'");
			}
			writer.Write(")");
		}
	}

	internal class Dictionary : List<Dictionary.Entry>, IAtom
	{
		internal class Entry : IAtom
		{
			private Name _key;

			private IAtom _value;

			public Entry(Name key, IAtom value)
			{
				if (key == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("key");
				}
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("value");
				}
				_key = key;
				_value = value;
			}

			public void Write(Writer writer)
			{
				_key.Write(writer);
				writer.Write(" ");
				_value.Write(writer);
			}
		}

		private int _wrapBound;

		public int WrapBound
		{
			get
			{
				return _wrapBound;
			}
			set
			{
				_wrapBound = value;
			}
		}

		public void Add(Name key, IAtom value)
		{
			Add(new Entry(key, value));
		}

		public void Write(Writer writer)
		{
			if (_wrapBound == 1)
			{
				writer.Write("<<");
				writer.Write((byte)10);
			}
			else
			{
				writer.Write("<< ");
			}
			int count = base.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				Entry entry = base[i];
				entry.Write(writer);
				if (_wrapBound > 0)
				{
					if ((i + 1) % _wrapBound == 0)
					{
						writer.Write((byte)10);
					}
					else if (i < count - 1)
					{
						writer.Write(" ");
					}
				}
				else if (i < count - 1)
				{
					writer.Write(" ");
				}
			}
			if (_wrapBound == 1)
			{
				writer.Write(">>");
			}
			else
			{
				writer.Write(" >>");
			}
		}
	}

	internal class Name : IAtom
	{
		private string _value;

		private bool _encode;

		public Name(string value)
			: this(value, encode: true)
		{
		}

		public Name(string value, bool encode)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("value");
			}
			_value = value;
			_encode = encode;
		}

		public void Write(Writer writer)
		{
			if (_encode)
			{
				CharBuffer charBuffer = new CharBuffer(25);
				string value = _value;
				foreach (char c in value)
				{
					if (char.IsLetterOrDigit(c) || c == '_')
					{
						charBuffer.Add(c);
						continue;
					}
					byte b = (byte)c;
					charBuffer.Add('#');
					charBuffer.Add(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Utils.Defs.HexDigits[b >> 4]);
					charBuffer.Add(Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Utils.Defs.HexDigits[b & 0xF]);
				}
				writer.Write("/");
				if (charBuffer.Count > 0)
				{
					writer.Write(charBuffer.ToString());
				}
				else
				{
					writer.Write("NoName");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				writer.Write("/");
				writer.Write(_value);
			}
		}
	}

	internal class String : IAtom
	{
		private string _value;

		public String(string value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("value");
			}
			_value = value;
		}

		public void Write(Writer writer)
		{
			Encryptor encryptor = writer.Encryptor;
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			bool flag = false;
			string value = _value;
			foreach (char c in value)
			{
				if (c > 'ÿ')
				{
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
				memoryStream.WriteByte((byte)c);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
				memoryStream.WriteByte(254);
				memoryStream.WriteByte(byte.MaxValue);
				string value2 = _value;
				foreach (char c2 in value2)
				{
					byte value3 = (byte)((int)c2 >> 8);
					byte value4 = (byte)c2;
					memoryStream.WriteByte(value3);
					memoryStream.WriteByte(value4);
				}
			}
			if (encryptor != null)
			{
				memoryStream.Position = 0L;
				memoryStream = Cipher.Encrypt(memoryStream, encryptor.Key, encryptor.Document.Cipher);
				writer.Write("<");
				writer.Format = StreamFormat.Hex;
				writer.Unicode = flag;
				memoryStream.Position = 0L;
				writer.Write(memoryStream);
				writer.Unicode = false;
				writer.Format = StreamFormat.Default;
				writer.Write(">");
			}
			else
			{
				writer.Write("(");
				writer.Format = StreamFormat.Escape;
				writer.Unicode = flag;
				memoryStream.Position = 0L;
				writer.Write(memoryStream);
				writer.Unicode = false;
				writer.Format = StreamFormat.Default;
				writer.Write(")");
			}
		}
	}

	public class ColorBlendEntry : SealableBase
	{
		private Color _color;

		private float _position;

		public Color Color
		{
			get
			{
				return _color;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_color = value;
			}
		}

		public float Position
		{
			get
			{
				return _position;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_position = value;
			}
		}

		public ColorBlendEntry(Color color, float position)
		{
			if (color == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("color");
			}
			_color = color;
			_position = position;
		}

		public ColorBlendEntry Clone()
		{
			return new ColorBlendEntry(_color, _position);
		}

		public bool Equals(ColorBlendEntry entry)
		{
			if (entry == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (entry == this)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (_color.Equals(entry.Color) && _position == entry.Position)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class ColorBlend : List<ColorBlendEntry>, ISealable
	{
		private bool _sealed;

		public bool IsSealed => _sealed;

		public ColorBlend()
		{
		}

		public ColorBlend(System.Drawing.Drawing2D.ColorBlend blend)
		{
			if (blend == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("blend");
			}
			int num = blend.Colors.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				Color color = new Color(blend.Colors[i]);
				float position = blend.Positions[i];
				Add(color, position);
			}
		}

		public void Add(Color color, float position)
		{
			SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
			Add(new ColorBlendEntry(color, position));
		}

		public ColorBlend Clone()
		{
			ColorBlend colorBlend = new ColorBlend();
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				ColorBlendEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				colorBlend.Add(current.Clone());
			}
			return colorBlend;
		}

		public ColorBlend Complete()
		{
			ColorBlend colorBlend = new ColorBlend();
			if (base[0].Position != 0f)
			{
				colorBlend.Add(base[0].Color, 0f);
			}
			using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					ColorBlendEntry current = enumerator.Current;
					colorBlend.Add(current.Clone());
				}
			}
			if (base[base.Count - 1].Position != 1f)
			{
				colorBlend.Add(base[base.Count - 1].Color, 1f);
			}
			return colorBlend;
		}

		public void Insert(int index, Color color, float position)
		{
			SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
			Insert(index, new ColorBlendEntry(color, position));
		}

		public bool Equals(ColorBlend blend)
		{
			if (blend == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (blend == this)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (blend.Count != base.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = 0;
			using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					ColorBlendEntry current = enumerator.Current;
					if (!current.Equals(blend[num]))
					{
						return false;
					}
					num++;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Seal()
		{
			_sealed = true;
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				ColorBlendEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				current.Seal();
			}
		}

		internal System.Drawing.Drawing2D.ColorBlend ToNative()
		{
			int count = base.Count;
			System.Drawing.Drawing2D.ColorBlend colorBlend = new System.Drawing.Drawing2D.ColorBlend(count);
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				ColorBlendEntry colorBlendEntry = base[i];
				colorBlend.Colors[i] = colorBlendEntry.Color.ToNative();
				colorBlend.Positions[i] = colorBlendEntry.Position;
			}
			return colorBlend;
		}
	}

		public static SolidColorBrush GetBrush(string name)

	[SecurityCritical]
	internal class GraphicsProxy : RealProxy, IDisposable
	{
		private class RegionData
		{
			private static class Defs
			{
				public const int Rectangle = 268435456;

				public const int Path = 268435457;

				public const int ShortFormat = 16384;
			}

			private byte[] _data;

			private int _size;

			private int _position;

			public RegionData(byte[] data)
			{
				if (data == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("data");
				}
				_data = data;
				_size = _data.Length;
			}

			public int Playback(IGraphics graphics)
			{
				int num = 0;
				_position = 12;
				while (_position < _size)
				{
					switch (ReadInt())
					{
					case 268435456:
					{
						float x2 = ReadFloat();
						float y2 = ReadFloat();
						float width = ReadFloat();
						float height = ReadFloat();
						graphics.SaveState();
						num++;
						graphics.ClipRectangle(x2, y2, width, height);
						break;
					}
					case 268435457:
					{
						int num2 = ReadInt();
						int position = _position + num2;
						_position += 4;
						int num3 = ReadInt();
						int num4 = ReadInt();
						Point[] array = new Point[num3];
						if (num4 == 16384)
						{
							for (int i = 0; i < num3; i++)
							{
								short num5 = ReadShort();
								short num6 = ReadShort();
								array[i] = new Point(num5, num6);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							for (int j = 0; j < num3; j++)
							{
								float x = ReadFloat();
								float y = ReadFloat();
								array[j] = new Point(x, y);
							}
						}
						byte[] array2 = new byte[num3];
						for (int k = 0; k < num3; k++)
						{
							array2[k] = (byte)ReadByte();
						}
						_position = position;
						graphics.SaveState();
						num++;
						graphics.StartShape(PaintMode.Clip);
						int num7 = 0;
						while (num7 < num3)
						{
							byte b = array2[num7];
							switch (b & -129)
							{
							case 0:
							{
								Point point5 = array[num7++];
								graphics.MoveTo(point5.X, point5.Y);
								break;
							}
							case 1:
							{
								Point point4 = array[num7++];
								graphics.LineTo(point4.X, point4.Y);
								break;
							}
							case 3:
							{
								Point point = array[num7++];
								Point point2 = array[num7++];
								Point point3 = array[num7++];
								graphics.CurveTo(point.X, point.Y, point2.X, point2.Y, point3.X, point3.Y);
								break;
							}
							}
							if ((b & 0x80) == 128)
							{
								graphics.ClosePath();
							}
						}
						graphics.EndShape();
						break;
					}
					}
				}
				return num;
			}

			private int ReadByte()
			{
				int result = -1;
				if (_position < _size)
				{
					result = _data[_position++];
				}
				return result;
			}

			private float ReadFloat()
			{
				return BitConverter.ToSingle(new byte[4]
				{
					(byte)ReadByte(),
					(byte)ReadByte(),
					(byte)ReadByte(),
					(byte)ReadByte()
				}, 0);
			}

			private int ReadInt()
			{
				int num = ReadByte();
				int num2 = ReadByte();
				int num3 = ReadByte();
				int num4 = ReadByte();
				num4 <<= 24;
				num3 <<= 16;
				num2 <<= 8;
				return num4 | num3 | num2 | num;
			}

			private short ReadShort()
			{
				int num = ReadByte();
				int num2 = ReadByte();
				num2 <<= 8;
				return (short)(num2 | num);
			}
		}

		private class TextLine
		{

		}

		private static HashSet<string> _stateMethods;

		protected IGraphics _graphics;

		private Bitmap _memoryBitmap;

		private System.Drawing.Graphics _memoryGraphics;

		private Dictionary<System.Drawing.Font, Font> _fonts;

		private Dictionary<System.Drawing.Image, Image> _images;

		private int _stateLevel;

		static GraphicsProxy()
		{
			_stateMethods = new HashSet<string>(15);
			_stateMethods.Add("set_Clip");
			_stateMethods.Add("set_Transform");
			_stateMethods.Add("ExcludeClip");
			_stateMethods.Add("IntersectClip");
			_stateMethods.Add("MultiplyTransform");
			_stateMethods.Add("ResetClip");
			_stateMethods.Add("ResetTransform");
			_stateMethods.Add("Restore");
			_stateMethods.Add("RotateTransform");
			_stateMethods.Add("ScaleTransform");
			_stateMethods.Add("SetClip");
			_stateMethods.Add("TranslateTransform");
		}

		protected GraphicsProxy(IGraphics graphics)
			: base(typeof(System.Drawing.Graphics))
		{
			_graphics = graphics;
			_memoryBitmap = new Bitmap(1, 1, PixelFormat.Format24bppRgb);
			_memoryGraphics = System.Drawing.Graphics.FromImage(_memoryBitmap);
			_memoryGraphics.PageUnit = GraphicsUnit.Point;
			_fonts = new Dictionary<System.Drawing.Font, Font>(25);
			_images = new Dictionary<System.Drawing.Image, Image>(25);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				_memoryGraphics.Dispose();
				_memoryBitmap.Dispose();
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		~GraphicsProxy()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: false);
		}

		[SecurityCritical]
		public override IMessage Invoke(IMessage msg)
		{
			IMethodCallMessage methodCallMessage = (IMethodCallMessage)msg;
			MethodInfo method = GetType().GetMethod(methodCallMessage.MethodName, (Type[])methodCallMessage.MethodSignature);
			if (method != null)
			{
				method.Invoke(this, methodCallMessage.Args);
			}
			IMethodReturnMessage result = RemotingServices.ExecuteMessage(_memoryGraphics, methodCallMessage);
			if (_stateMethods.Contains(methodCallMessage.MethodName))
			{
				UpdateState();
			}
			return result;
		}

		private string BuildMultiLineString(string originalString, System.Drawing.Font font, RectangleF rect, StringFormat format)
		{
			if ((format.FormatFlags & StringFormatFlags.NoWrap) != 0)
			{
				return originalString;
			}
			float stringWidth = _graphics.GetStringWidth(originalString);
			if (stringWidth <= rect.Width)
			{
				return originalString;
			}
			List<string> list = BuildWordList(originalString);
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			float num = 0f;
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				string text = list[i];
				float stringWidth2 = _graphics.GetStringWidth(text);
				if (stringWidth2 > rect.Width)
				{
					if (text.Trim().Length == 0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (num > 0f)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append("\n");
						num = 0f;
					}
					string text2 = ((i < list.Count - 1) ? list[i + 1] : null);
					if (text2 != null && text2.Trim().Length == 0)
					{
						list[i + 1] = "\n";
						text2 = string.Empty;
					}
					StringBuilder stringBuilder2 = new StringBuilder();
					do
					{
						char c = text[text.Length - 1];
						stringBuilder2.Insert(0, new char[1] { c });
						text = text.Remove(text.Length - 1);
						stringWidth2 = _graphics.GetStringWidth(text);
					}
					while (stringWidth2 > rect.Width);
					if (stringBuilder2.Length > 0)
					{
						list.Insert(i + 1, stringBuilder2.ToString());
					}
				}
				if (stringWidth2 + num > rect.Width)
				{
					if (text.Trim().Length == 0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					stringBuilder.Append("\n");
					num = 0f;
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(text);
				num += stringWidth2;
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private static List<string> BuildWordList(string s)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			char c = s[0];
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			foreach (char c2 in s)
			{
				if ((c2 == ' ' && c == ' ') || (c2 != ' ' && c != ' '))
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(c2);
					continue;
				}
				if (stringBuilder.Length > 0)
				{
					list.Add(stringBuilder.ToString());
					stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(c2);
				c = c2;
			}
			if (stringBuilder.Length > 0)
			{
				list.Add(stringBuilder.ToString());
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static Brush GetBrush(System.Drawing.Brush brush)
		{
			Brush result = Brushes.Black;
			if (brush is SolidBrush)
			{
				result = new SolidColorBrush((SolidBrush)brush);
			}
			else if (brush is System.Drawing.Drawing2D.LinearGradientBrush)
			{
				result = new LinearGradientDirectBrush((System.Drawing.Drawing2D.LinearGradientBrush)brush);
			}
			else if (brush is PathGradientBrush)
			{
				result = new RadialGradientDirectBrush((PathGradientBrush)brush);
			}
			else if (brush is System.Drawing.Drawing2D.HatchBrush)
			{
				result = new HatchBrush((System.Drawing.Drawing2D.HatchBrush)brush);
			}
			else if (brush is System.Drawing.TextureBrush)
			{
				result = new TextureDirectBrush((System.Drawing.TextureBrush)brush);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private Font GetFont(System.Drawing.Font font)
		{
			if (_fonts.ContainsKey(font))
			{
				return _fonts[font];
			}
			Font font2 = new Font(font);
			_fonts.Add(font, font2);
			return font2;
		}

		private Image GetImage(System.Drawing.Image image)
		{
			if (_images.ContainsKey(image))
			{
				return _images[image];
			}
			Image image2 = new Image(image);
			_images.Add(image, image2);
			return image2;
		}

		private static Pen GetPen(System.Drawing.Pen pen)
		{
			return new Pen(pen);
		}

		private static Point[] GetPoints(System.Drawing.Point[] points)
		{
			int num = points.Length;
			Point[] array = new Point[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				System.Drawing.Point point = points[i];
				array[i] = new Point(point.X, point.Y);
			}
			return array;
		}

		private static Point[] GetPoints(PointF[] points)
		{
			int num = points.Length;
			Point[] array = new Point[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				PointF pointF = points[i];
				array[i] = new Point(pointF.X, pointF.Y);
			}
			return array;
		}

		private void UpdateState()
		{
			while (_stateLevel > 0)
			{
				_graphics.RestoreState();
				_stateLevel--;
			}
			if (!_memoryGraphics.Transform.IsIdentity || !_memoryGraphics.Clip.IsInfinite(_memoryGraphics))
			{
				_graphics.SaveState();
				_stateLevel++;
				_graphics.Transform(new Matrix(_memoryGraphics.Transform));
				if (!_memoryGraphics.Clip.IsInfinite(_memoryGraphics))
				{
					RegionData regionData = new RegionData(_memoryGraphics.Clip.GetRegionData().Data);
					_stateLevel += regionData.Playback(_graphics);
				}
			}
		}

		public void DrawString(string s, System.Drawing.Font font, System.Drawing.Brush brush, PointF point, StringFormat format)
		{
			DrawString(s, font, brush, point.X, point.Y);
		}

		public void DrawString(string s, System.Drawing.Font font, System.Drawing.Brush brush, RectangleF rect, StringFormat format)
		{
			if (s == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("s");
			}
			if (font == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("font");
			}
			if (brush == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("brush");
			}
			_graphics.Font = GetFont(font);
			_graphics.Brush = GetBrush(brush);
			float num = 0f;
			List<TextLine> list = new List<TextLine>();
			CharBuffer charBuffer = new CharBuffer();
			s = BuildMultiLineString(s, font, rect, format);
			string text = s;
			foreach (char c in text)
			{
				switch (c)
				{
				case '\n':
				{
					string text2 = " ";
					if (charBuffer.Count > 0)
					{
						text2 = charBuffer.ToString();
						charBuffer.Clear();
					}
					SizeF sizeF = _memoryGraphics.MeasureString(text2, font);
					list.Add(new TextLine(text2, sizeF.Width, sizeF.Height));
					num += sizeF.Height;
					break;
				}
				default:
					charBuffer.Add(c);
					break;
				case '\r':
					break;
				}
			}
			if (charBuffer.Count > 0)
			{
				string text3 = charBuffer.ToString();
				charBuffer.Clear();
				SizeF sizeF2 = _memoryGraphics.MeasureString(text3, font);
				list.Add(new TextLine(text3, sizeF2.Width, sizeF2.Height));
				num += sizeF2.Height;
			}
			float x = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			switch (format.LineAlignment)
			{
			case StringAlignment.Near:
				num2 = rect.Y;
				break;
			case StringAlignment.Center:
				num2 = rect.Y + (rect.Height - num) / 2f;
				break;
			case StringAlignment.Far:
				num2 = rect.Y + rect.Height - num;
				break;
			}
			foreach (TextLine item in list)
			{
				switch (format.Alignment)
				{
				case StringAlignment.Near:
					x = rect.X;
					break;
				case StringAlignment.Center:
					x = rect.X + (rect.Width - item.Width) / 2f;
					break;
				case StringAlignment.Far:
					x = rect.X + rect.Width - item.Width;
					break;
				}
				_graphics.DrawString(x, num2, item.Text);
				num2 += item.Height;
			}
		}

		public void DrawString(string s, System.Drawing.Font font, System.Drawing.Brush brush, float x, float y)
		{
			DrawString(s, font, brush, x, y, new StringFormat());
		}

		public void DrawString(string s, System.Drawing.Font font, System.Drawing.Brush brush, float x, float y, StringFormat format)
		{
			if (s == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("s");
			}
			if (font == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("font");
			}
			if (brush == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("brush");
			}
			_graphics.Font = GetFont(font);
			_graphics.Brush = GetBrush(brush);
			float height = _memoryGraphics.MeasureString("Wj", font).Height;
			CharBuffer charBuffer = new CharBuffer();
			foreach (char c in s)
			{
				switch (c)
				{
				case '\n':
					if (charBuffer.Count > 0)
					{
						_graphics.DrawString(x, y, charBuffer.ToString());
						charBuffer.Clear();
					}
					y += height;
					break;
				default:
					charBuffer.Add(c);
					break;
				case '\r':
					break;
				}
			}
			if (charBuffer.Count > 0)
			{
				_graphics.DrawString(x, y, charBuffer.ToString());
			}
		}

		public void FillRectangle(System.Drawing.Brush brush, int x, int y, int width, int height)
		{
			FillRectangle(brush, (float)x, (float)y, (float)width, (float)height);
		}

		public void FillRectangle(System.Drawing.Brush brush, float x, float y, float width, float height)
		{
			if (brush == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("brush");
			}
			_graphics.Brush = GetBrush(brush);
			_graphics.DrawRectangle(x, y, width, height, PaintMode.Fill);
		}

		public void FillRectangles(System.Drawing.Brush brush, System.Drawing.Rectangle[] rects)
		{
			if (brush == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("brush");
			}
			if (rects == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("rects");
			}
			foreach (System.Drawing.Rectangle rect in rects)
			{
				FillRectangle(brush, rect);
			}
		}

		public void FillRectangles(System.Drawing.Brush brush, RectangleF[] rects)
		{
			if (brush == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("brush");
			}
			if (rects == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("rects");
			}
			foreach (RectangleF rect in rects)
			{
				FillRectangle(brush, rect);
			}
		}

		public void Flush()
		{
			while (_stateLevel > 0)
			{
				_graphics.RestoreState();
				_stateLevel--;
			}
			_graphics.Flush();
		}

		public static System.Drawing.Graphics CreateGraphics(IGraphics graphics)
		{
			GraphicsProxy graphicsProxy = new GraphicsProxy(graphics);
			return (System.Drawing.Graphics)graphicsProxy.GetTransparentProxy();
		}
	}

	public abstract class ImageCompressor
	{
		public abstract CompressorType Type { get; }

		public abstract bool Equals(ImageCompressor compressor);

		public abstract MemoryStream Compress(Image image, ImageConverter converter);
	}
	public class JPEGCompressor : ImageCompressor
	{
		private int _quality;

		public int Quality => _quality;

		public override CompressorType Type => CompressorType.JPEG;

		public JPEGCompressor()
			: this(75)
		{
		}

		public JPEGCompressor(int quality)
		{
			_quality = quality;
		}

		public override MemoryStream Compress(Image image, ImageConverter converter)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("image");
			}
			if (converter == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("converter");
			}
			ImageCodecInfo encoderInfo = Image.GetEncoderInfo("image/jpeg");
			System.Drawing.Imaging.Encoder quality = System.Drawing.Imaging.Encoder.Quality;
			EncoderParameters encoderParameters = new EncoderParameters(1);
			EncoderParameter encoderParameter = new EncoderParameter(quality, _quality);
			encoderParameters.Param[0] = encoderParameter;
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			Bitmap bitmap = converter.ToNative(image);
			bitmap.Save(memoryStream, encoderInfo, encoderParameters);
			return memoryStream;
		}

		public override bool Equals(ImageCompressor compressor)
		{
			if (compressor == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (compressor == this)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (compressor.Type == CompressorType.JPEG)
			{
				JPEGCompressor jPEGCompressor = (JPEGCompressor)compressor;
				if (_quality == jPEGCompressor.Quality)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return CompressorType.JPEG.GetHashCode() ^ _quality.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	public class FlateCompressor : ImageCompressor
	{
		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Utils.FlateCompressor _compressor;

		public override CompressorType Type => CompressorType.Flate;

		public FlateCompressor()
		{
			_compressor = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.Utils.FlateCompressor();
		}

		public override MemoryStream Compress(Image image, ImageConverter converter)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("image");
			}
			if (converter == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("converter");
			}
			MemoryStream memoryStream = converter.ToStream(image);
			memoryStream.Position = 0L;
			return _compressor.Deflate(memoryStream);
		}

		public override bool Equals(ImageCompressor compressor)
		{
			if (compressor == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (compressor == this)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (compressor.Type == CompressorType.Flate)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return CompressorType.Flate.GetHashCode();
		}
	}

	public class BWImageConverter : ImageConverter
	{
		private int _level;

		private bool _invert;

		public bool Invert => _invert;

		public int Level => _level;

		public override ConverterType Type => ConverterType.BW;

		public BWImageConverter()
			: this(120, invert: false)
		{
		}

		public BWImageConverter(int level)
			: this(level, invert: false)
		{
		}

		public BWImageConverter(int level, bool invert)
		{
			_level = level;
			_invert = invert;
		}

		public override bool Equals(ImageConverter converter)
		{
			if (converter == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (converter == this)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (converter.Type == ConverterType.BW)
			{
				BWImageConverter bWImageConverter = (BWImageConverter)converter;
				if (_level == bWImageConverter.Level && _invert == bWImageConverter.Invert)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return ConverterType.BW.GetHashCode() ^ _level.GetHashCode() ^ _invert.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override Image ToImage(Image image)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("image");
			}
			return ToImage(image.Width, image.Height, image.Data, _level, _invert);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		internal override Bitmap ToNative(Image image)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("image");
			}
			return ToNative(image.Width, image.Height, image.Data, _level, _invert);
		}

		internal override MemoryStream ToStream(Image image)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("image");
			}
			return ToStream(image.Width, image.Height, image.Data, _level, _invert);
		}

		private static Image ToImage(int width, int height, byte[] data, int level, bool invert)
		{
			int num = width * height * 3;
			byte[] array = new byte[num];
			int num2 = 0;
			while (num2 < num)
			{
				byte b = data[num2++];
				byte b2 = data[num2++];
				byte b3 = data[num2++];
				byte b4 = (byte)((b * 3 + b2 * 6 + b3) / 10);
				byte b5 = 0;
				if (invert)
				{
					if (b4 <= level)
					{
						b5 = byte.MaxValue;
					}
				}
				else if (b4 > level)
				{
					b5 = byte.MaxValue;
				}
				num2 -= 3;
				array[num2++] = b5;
				array[num2++] = b5;
				array[num2++] = b5;
			}
			return new Image(width, height, array);
		}

		private static MemoryStream ToStream(int width, int height, byte[] data, int level, bool invert)
		{
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			byte b = 0;
			byte b2 = 0;
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < height; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < width; j++)
				{
					byte b3 = data[num++];
					byte b4 = data[num++];
					byte b5 = data[num++];
					int num2 = (b3 * 3 + b4 * 6 + b5) / 10;
					if (invert)
					{
						if (num2 <= level)
						{
							b |= 1;
						}
					}
					else if (num2 > level)
					{
						b |= 1;
					}
					b2++;
					if (b2 == 8)
					{
						memoryStream.WriteByte(b);
						b = 0;
						b2 = 0;
					}
					else
					{
						b <<= 1;
					}
				}
				if (b2 > 0)
				{
					for (int num3 = 7; num3 > b2; num3--)
					{
						b <<= 1;
						b |= 1;
					}
					memoryStream.WriteByte(b);
					b = 0;
					b2 = 0;
				}
			}
			return memoryStream;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static Bitmap ToNative(int width, int height, byte[] data, int level, bool invert)
		{
			try
			{
				SecurityPermission securityPermission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode);
				securityPermission.Assert();
				return ToNativeInterop(width, height, data, level, invert);
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				return ToNativeSafe(width, height, data, level, invert);
			}
		}

		[SecurityCritical]
		private static Bitmap ToNativeInterop(int width, int height, byte[] data, int level, bool invert)
		{
			Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(width, height);
			System.Drawing.Rectangle rect = new System.Drawing.Rectangle(0, 0, bitmap.Width, bitmap.Height);
			BitmapData bitmapData = bitmap.LockBits(rect, ImageLockMode.WriteOnly, PixelFormat.Format24bppRgb);
			IntPtr scan = bitmapData.Scan0;
			byte[] array = new byte[height * bitmapData.Stride];
			for (int i = 0; i < height; i++)
			{
				int num = i * width * 3;
				for (int j = 0; j < bitmapData.Width; j++)
				{
					byte b = data[num++];
					byte b2 = data[num++];
					byte b3 = data[num++];
					byte b4 = (byte)((b * 3 + b2 * 6 + b3) / 10);
					byte b5 = 0;
					if (invert)
					{
						if (b4 <= level)
						{
							b5 = byte.MaxValue;
						}
					}
					else if (b4 > level)
					{
						b5 = byte.MaxValue;
					}
					int num2 = i * bitmapData.Stride + j * 3;
					for (int k = num2; k < num2 + 3; k++)
					{
						array[k] = b5;
					}
				}
			}
			Marshal.Copy(array, 0, scan, array.Length);
			bitmap.UnlockBits(bitmapData);
			return bitmap;
		}

		private static Bitmap ToNativeSafe(int width, int height, byte[] data, int level, bool invert)
		{
			Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(width, height);
			for (int i = 0; i < height; i++)
			{
				int num = i * width * 3;
				for (int j = 0; j < width; j++)
				{
					byte b = data[num++];
					byte b2 = data[num++];
					byte b3 = data[num++];
					byte b4 = (byte)((b * 3 + b2 * 6 + b3) / 10);
					byte b5 = 0;
					if (invert)
					{
						if (b4 <= level)
						{
							b5 = byte.MaxValue;
						}
					}
					else if (b4 > level)
					{
						b5 = byte.MaxValue;
					}
					bitmap.SetPixel(j, i, System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(b5, b5, b5));
				}
			}
			return bitmap;
		}
	}
	public class GreyImageConverter : ImageConverter
	{
		public override ConverterType Type => ConverterType.Grey;

		public override bool Equals(ImageConverter converter)
		{
			if (converter == null)

				return false;
			}

				return true;

			{
				return true;
			}

		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return ConverterType.Grey.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override Image ToImage(Image image)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("image");
			}
			return ToImage(image.Width, image.Height, image.Data);
		}

		internal override Bitmap ToNative(Image image)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("image");
			}
			Bitmap bitmap = image.ToBitmap();
			if (bitmap != null)

		private static Image ToImage(int width, int height, byte[] data)
		{
			int num = width * height * 3;
			byte[] array = new byte[num];
			int num2 = 0;
			while (num2 < num)
			{
				byte b = data[num2++];
				byte b2 = data[num2++];
				byte b3 = data[num2++];
				byte b4 = (byte)((b * 3 + b2 * 6 + b3) / 10);
				num2 -= 3;
				array[num2++] = b4;
				array[num2++] = b4;
				array[num2++] = b4;
			}
			return new Image(width, height, array);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static Bitmap ToNative(int width, int height, byte[] data)
		{
			try
			{
				SecurityPermission securityPermission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode);
				securityPermission.Assert();
				return ToNativeInterop(width, height, data);
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				return ToNativeSafe(width, height, data);
			}
		}

		[SecurityCritical]
		private static Bitmap ToNativeInterop(int width, int height, byte[] data)
		{
			Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(width, height);
			BitmapData bitmapData = bitmap.LockBits(new System.Drawing.Rectangle(0, 0, width, height), ImageLockMode.WriteOnly, PixelFormat.Format24bppRgb);
			IntPtr scan = bitmapData.Scan0;
			byte[] array = new byte[height * bitmapData.Stride];
			for (int i = 0; i < height; i++)
			{
				int num = i * width * 3;
				for (int j = 0; j < bitmapData.Width; j++)
				{
					byte b = data[num++];
					byte b2 = data[num++];
					byte b3 = data[num++];
					byte b4 = (byte)((b * 3 + b2 * 6 + b3) / 10);
					int num2 = i * bitmapData.Stride + j * 3;
					for (int k = num2; k < num2 + 3; k++)
					{
						array[k] = b4;
					}
				}
			}
			Marshal.Copy(array, 0, scan, array.Length);
			bitmap.UnlockBits(bitmapData);
			return bitmap;
		}

		private static Bitmap ToNativeSafe(int width, int height, byte[] data)
		{
			Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(width, height);
			for (int i = 0; i < height; i++)
			{
				int num = i * width * 3;
				for (int j = 0; j < width; j++)
				{
					byte b = data[num++];
					byte b2 = data[num++];
					byte b3 = data[num++];
					byte b4 = (byte)((b * 3 + b2 * 6 + b3) / 10);
					bitmap.SetPixel(j, i, System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(b4, b4, b4));
				}
			}
			return bitmap;
		}

		private static MemoryStream ToStream(int width, int height, byte[] data)
		{
			if (data.Length == width * height)
			{
				return new MemoryStream(data);
			}
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = width * height * 3;
			while (num < num2)
			{
				byte b = data[num++];
				byte b2 = data[num++];
				byte b3 = data[num++];
				byte value = (byte)((b * 3 + b2 * 6 + b3) / 10);
				memoryStream.WriteByte(value);
			}
			return memoryStream;
		}
	}
	internal class ArgbImageConverter : ImageConverter
	{
		public override ConverterType Type
		{
			get
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

			{
				return converter is ArgbImageConverter;
			}
			return false;
		}
