		{
			return int.MinValue;
		}

		internal override MemoryStream ToStream(Image image)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		public override Image ToImage(Image image)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		internal override Bitmap ToNative(Image image)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("image");
			}
			return ToNativeSafe(image.Width, image.Height, image.Data, image.AlphaChannel);
		}

		private static Bitmap ToNativeSafe(int width, int height, byte[] data, byte[] alphaChannel)
		{
			Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(width, height, PixelFormat.Format32bppArgb);
			bitmap.SetResolution(96f, 96f);
			for (int i = 0; i < height; i++)
			{
				int num = i * width;
				int num2 = num * 3;
				for (int j = 0; j < width; j++)
				{
					byte b = ((alphaChannel != null) ? alphaChannel[num++] : byte.MaxValue);
					byte b2 = data[num2++];
					byte b3 = data[num2++];
					byte b4 = data[num2++];
					if (alphaChannel != null && b != 0 && b != byte.MaxValue)
					{
						b2 = (byte)(b2 * 255 / b);
						b3 = (byte)(b3 * 255 / b);
						b4 = (byte)(b4 * 255 / b);
					}
					bitmap.SetPixel(j, i, System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(b, b2, b3, b4));
				}
			}
			return bitmap;
		}
	}

		private static Image ToImage(int width, int height, byte[] data)

			return new Image(width, height, array);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static Bitmap ToNative(int width, int height, byte[] data)
		{
			try
			{
				SecurityPermission securityPermission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode);
				securityPermission.Assert();
				return ToNativeInterop(width, height, data);
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				return ToNativeSafe(width, height, data);
			}
		}

		[SecurityCritical]
		private static Bitmap ToNativeInterop(int width, int height, byte[] data)
		{
			Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(width, height);
			System.Drawing.Rectangle rect = new System.Drawing.Rectangle(0, 0, bitmap.Width, bitmap.Height);
			BitmapData bitmapData = bitmap.LockBits(rect, ImageLockMode.WriteOnly, PixelFormat.Format24bppRgb);
			IntPtr scan = bitmapData.Scan0;
			byte[] array = new byte[height * bitmapData.Stride];
			for (int i = 0; i < height; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < bitmapData.Width; j++)
				{
					int num = i * width * 3 + j * 3;
					int num2 = i * bitmapData.Stride + j * 3;
					array[num2] = data[num + 2];
					array[num2 + 1] = data[num + 1];
					array[num2 + 2] = data[num];
				}
			}
			Marshal.Copy(array, 0, scan, array.Length);
			bitmap.UnlockBits(bitmapData);
			return bitmap;
		}

		private static Bitmap ToNativeSafe(int width, int height, byte[] data)
		{
			Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(width, height, PixelFormat.Format24bppRgb);
			for (int i = 0; i < height; i++)
			{
				int num = i * width * 3;
				for (int j = 0; j < width; j++)
				{
					byte red = data[num++];
					byte green = data[num++];
					byte blue = data[num++];
					bitmap.SetPixel(j, i, System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(red, green, blue));
				}
			}
			return bitmap;
		}

		private static MemoryStream ToStream(int width, int height, byte[] data)
		{
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			int count = width * height * 3;
			memoryStream.Write(data, 0, count);
			return memoryStream;
		}
	}

	internal interface IPathCommand
	{
		CommandType Type { get; }

		IPathCommand Clone();
	}
	internal class CommandCollection : List<IPathCommand>
	{
	}
	internal class ClosePathCommand : IPathCommand
	{
		public CommandType Type => CommandType.ClosePath;

		public IPathCommand Clone()
		{
			return new ClosePathCommand();
		}
	}
	internal class CurveToCommand : IPathCommand
	{
		private float _x1;

		private float _y1;

		private float _x2;

		private float _y2;

		private float _x3;

		private float _y3;

		public CommandType Type => CommandType.CurveTo;

		public float X1 => _x1;

		public float X2 => _x2;

		public float X3 => _x3;

		public float Y1 => _y1;

		public float Y2 => _y2;

		public float Y3 => _y3;

		public CurveToCommand(float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2, float x3, float y3)
		{
			_x1 = x1;
			_y1 = y1;
			_x2 = x2;
			_y2 = y2;
			_x3 = x3;
			_y3 = y3;
		}

		public IPathCommand Clone()
		{
			return new CurveToCommand(_x1, _y1, _x2, _y2, _x3, _y3);
		}
	}
	internal class LineToCommand : IPathCommand
	{
		private float _x;

		private float _y;

		public CommandType Type => CommandType.LineTo;

		public float X => _x;

		public float Y => _y;

		public LineToCommand(float x, float y)

			_y = y;

		public IPathCommand Clone()

	}
	internal class MoveToCommand : IPathCommand
	{
		private float _x;

		private float _y;

		public CommandType Type => CommandType.MoveTo;

		public float X => _x;

		public float Y => _y;

		public MoveToCommand(float x, float y)

			_x = x;
			_y = y;
		}

		public IPathCommand Clone()

			return new MoveToCommand(_x, _y);
		}
	}
	public class Path
	{
		private FillMode _mode;

		private CommandCollection _commands;

		internal CommandCollection Commands => _commands;

		public FillMode Mode
		{
			get
			{
				return _mode;
			}
			set
			{
				_mode = value;
			}
		}

		public Path()
		{
			_mode = FillMode.Alternate;
			_commands = new CommandCollection();
		}

		public Path(GraphicsPath path)
			: this()
		{
			if (path == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("path");
			}
			if (path.FillMode == System.Drawing.Drawing2D.FillMode.Alternate)
			{
				_mode = FillMode.Alternate;
			}
			else
			{
				_mode = FillMode.Winding;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int pointCount = path.PointCount;
			byte[] pathTypes = path.PathTypes;
			PointF[] pathPoints = path.PathPoints;
			while (num < pointCount)
			{
				byte b = pathTypes[num];
				switch (b & -129)
				{
				case 0:
				{
					PointF pointF = pathPoints[num++];
					MoveTo(pointF.X, pointF.Y);
					break;
				}
				case 1:
				{
					PointF pointF = pathPoints[num++];
					LineTo(pointF.X, pointF.Y);
					break;
				}
				case 3:
				{
					PointF pointF = pathPoints[num++];
					PointF pointF2 = pathPoints[num++];
					PointF pointF3 = pathPoints[num++];
					CurveTo(pointF.X, pointF.Y, pointF2.X, pointF2.Y, pointF3.X, pointF3.Y);
					break;
				}
				}
				if ((b & 0x80) == 128)
				{
					ClosePath();
				}
			}
		}

		public Path Clone()
		{
			Path path = new Path();
			foreach (IPathCommand command in _commands)
			{
				path.Commands.Add(command.Clone());
			}
			return path;
		}

		public void ClosePath()
		{
			_commands.Add(new ClosePathCommand());
		}

		public void CurveTo(float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2, float x3, float y3)
		{
			_commands.Add(new CurveToCommand(x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3));
		}

		public Rectangle GetBounds()
		{
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			float num3 = 0f;
			float num4 = 0f;
			bool flag = true;
			foreach (IPathCommand command in _commands)
			{
				switch (command.Type)
				{
				case CommandType.MoveTo:
				{
					MoveToCommand moveToCommand = (MoveToCommand)command;
					if (flag)
					{
						num = moveToCommand.X;
						num2 = moveToCommand.Y;
						num3 = num;
						num4 = num2;
						flag = false;
					}
					else
					{
						num = Math.Min(num, moveToCommand.X);
						num2 = Math.Min(num2, moveToCommand.Y);
						num3 = Math.Max(num3, moveToCommand.X);
						num4 = Math.Max(num4, moveToCommand.Y);
					}
					break;
				}
				case CommandType.LineTo:
				{
					LineToCommand lineToCommand = (LineToCommand)command;
					if (flag)
					{
						num = lineToCommand.X;
						num2 = lineToCommand.Y;
						num3 = num;
						num4 = num2;
						flag = false;
					}
					else
					{
						num = Math.Min(num, lineToCommand.X);
						num2 = Math.Min(num2, lineToCommand.Y);
						num3 = Math.Max(num3, lineToCommand.X);
						num4 = Math.Max(num4, lineToCommand.Y);
					}
					break;
				}
				case CommandType.CurveTo:
				{
					CurveToCommand curveToCommand = (CurveToCommand)command;
					if (flag)
					{
						num = curveToCommand.X1;
						num2 = curveToCommand.Y1;
						num3 = num;
						num4 = num2;
						flag = false;
						break;
					}
					num = Math.Min(num, curveToCommand.X1);
					num2 = Math.Min(num2, curveToCommand.Y1);
					num3 = Math.Max(num3, curveToCommand.X1);
					num4 = Math.Max(num4, curveToCommand.Y1);
					num = Math.Min(num, curveToCommand.X2);
					num2 = Math.Min(num2, curveToCommand.Y2);
					num3 = Math.Max(num3, curveToCommand.X2);
					num4 = Math.Max(num4, curveToCommand.Y2);
					num = Math.Min(num, curveToCommand.X3);
					num2 = Math.Min(num2, curveToCommand.Y3);
					num3 = Math.Max(num3, curveToCommand.X3);
					num4 = Math.Max(num4, curveToCommand.Y3);
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			return new Rectangle(num, num2, num3 - num, num4 - num2);
		}

		public void LineTo(float x, float y)
		{
			_commands.Add(new LineToCommand(x, y));
		}

		public void MoveTo(float x, float y)
		{
			_commands.Add(new MoveToCommand(x, y));
		}

		public void Playback(IGraphics graphics)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			float x = 0f;
			float y = 0f;
			foreach (IPathCommand command in _commands)
			{
				switch (command.Type)
				{
				case CommandType.MoveTo:
				{
					MoveToCommand moveToCommand = (MoveToCommand)command;
					if (!flag)
					{
						num = moveToCommand.X;
						num2 = moveToCommand.Y;
						flag = true;
					}
					x = moveToCommand.X;
					y = moveToCommand.Y;
					graphics.MoveTo(x, y);
					break;
				}
				case CommandType.LineTo:
				{
					LineToCommand lineToCommand = (LineToCommand)command;
					if (!flag)
					{
						graphics.MoveTo(x, y);
						flag = true;
					}
					graphics.LineTo(lineToCommand.X, lineToCommand.Y);
					x = lineToCommand.X;
					y = lineToCommand.Y;
					break;
				}
				case CommandType.CurveTo:
				{
					CurveToCommand curveToCommand = (CurveToCommand)command;
					if (!flag)
					{
						graphics.MoveTo(x, y);
						flag = true;
					}
					graphics.CurveTo(curveToCommand.X1, curveToCommand.Y1, curveToCommand.X2, curveToCommand.Y2, curveToCommand.X3, curveToCommand.Y3);
					x = curveToCommand.X3;
					y = curveToCommand.Y3;
					break;
				}
				case CommandType.ClosePath:
					if (flag)
					{
						graphics.LineTo(num, num2);
						graphics.ClosePath();
						flag = false;
					}
					x = num;
					y = num2;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public GraphicsPath ToNative()
		{
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
			bool flag = false;
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			float x = 0f;
			float y = 0f;
			foreach (IPathCommand command in _commands)
			{
				switch (command.Type)
				{
				case CommandType.MoveTo:
				{
					MoveToCommand moveToCommand = (MoveToCommand)command;
					if (!flag)
					{
						num = moveToCommand.X;
						num2 = moveToCommand.Y;
						graphicsPath.StartFigure();
						flag = true;
					}
					x = moveToCommand.X;
					y = moveToCommand.Y;
					break;
				}
				case CommandType.LineTo:
				{
					LineToCommand lineToCommand = (LineToCommand)command;
					if (!flag)
					{
						graphicsPath.StartFigure();
						flag = true;
					}
					graphicsPath.AddLine(x, y, lineToCommand.X, lineToCommand.Y);
					x = lineToCommand.X;
					y = lineToCommand.Y;
					break;
				}
				case CommandType.CurveTo:
				{
					CurveToCommand curveToCommand = (CurveToCommand)command;
					if (!flag)
					{
						graphicsPath.StartFigure();
						flag = true;
					}
					graphicsPath.AddBezier(x, y, curveToCommand.X1, curveToCommand.Y1, curveToCommand.X2, curveToCommand.Y2, curveToCommand.X3, curveToCommand.Y3);
					x = curveToCommand.X3;
					y = curveToCommand.Y3;
					break;
				}
				case CommandType.ClosePath:
					if (flag)
					{
						graphicsPath.AddLine(x, y, num, num2);
						graphicsPath.CloseFigure();
						flag = false;
					}
					x = num;
					y = num2;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (_mode == FillMode.Alternate)
			{
				graphicsPath.FillMode = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.FillMode.Alternate;
			}
			else
			{
				graphicsPath.FillMode = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.FillMode.Winding;
			}
			return graphicsPath;
		}
	}

		public static Pen GetPen(string name)
		{
			if (name == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (_pens.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				return _pens[name];
			}
			return null;
		}

	public class HatchBrush : DirectBrush
	{
		private HatchStyle _style;

		private Color _foreColor;

		private Color _backColor;

		private WeakReference _nativeBrush;

		public Color BackColor
		{
			get
			{
				return _backColor;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_backColor = value;
				_nativeBrush = null;
			}
		}

		public Color ForeColor
		{
			get
			{
				return _foreColor;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_foreColor = value;
				_nativeBrush = null;
			}
		}

		public HatchStyle Style
		{
			get
			{
				return _style;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_style = value;
				_nativeBrush = null;
			}
		}

		public override BrushType Type => BrushType.Hatch;

		public HatchBrush(HatchStyle style, Color foreColor, Color backColor)
		{
			if (foreColor == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("foreColor");
			}
			if (backColor == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("backColor");
			}
			_style = style;
			_foreColor = foreColor;
			_backColor = backColor;
		}

		public HatchBrush(System.Drawing.Drawing2D.HatchBrush brush)
		{
			if (brush == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("brush");
			}
			switch (brush.HatchStyle)
			{
			case System.Drawing.Drawing2D.HatchStyle.BackwardDiagonal:
				_style = HatchStyle.BackwardDiagonal;
				break;
			case System.Drawing.Drawing2D.HatchStyle.Cross:
				_style = HatchStyle.Cross;
				break;
			case System.Drawing.Drawing2D.HatchStyle.DiagonalBrick:
				_style = HatchStyle.DiagonalBrick;
				break;
			case System.Drawing.Drawing2D.HatchStyle.DiagonalCross:
				_style = HatchStyle.DiagonalCross;
				break;
			case System.Drawing.Drawing2D.HatchStyle.Divot:
				_style = HatchStyle.Divot;

	public class RadialGradientDirectBrush : DirectBrush
	{
		private ColorBlend _blend;

		private Point _center;

		private float _radiusX;

		private float _radiusY;

		private Point _focus;

		private Matrix _transform;

		private WeakReference _nativeBrush;

		private bool _circular;

		public override BrushType Type => BrushType.RadialGradientDirect;

		public ColorBlend Blend
		{
			get
			{
				return _blend;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_blend = value;
				_nativeBrush = null;
			}
		}

		public Point Center
		{
			get
			{
				return _center;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_center = value;
				_nativeBrush = null;
			}
		}

		public bool Circular
		{
			get
			{
				return _circular;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_circular = value;
			}
		}

		public Point Focus
		{
			get
			{
				return _focus;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_focus = value;
				_nativeBrush = null;
			}
		}

		public float RadiusX
		{
			get
			{
				return _radiusX;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_radiusX = value;
				_nativeBrush = null;
			}
		}

		public float RadiusY
		{
			get
			{
				return _radiusY;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_radiusY = value;
				_nativeBrush = null;
			}
		}

		public Matrix Transform
		{
			get
			{
				return _transform;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_transform = value;
				_nativeBrush = null;
			}
		}

		public RadialGradientDirectBrush(ColorBlend blend, Point center, float radiusX, float radiusY, Point focus, Matrix transform)
		{
			if (blend == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("blend");
			}
			if (center == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("center");
			}
			if (focus == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("focus");
			}
			if (transform == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("transform");
			}
			_blend = blend;
			_center = center;
			_radiusX = radiusX;
			_radiusY = radiusY;
			_focus = focus;
			_transform = transform;
		}

		public RadialGradientDirectBrush(PathGradientBrush brush)
		{
			if (brush == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("brush");
			}
			_blend = null;
			if (brush.InterpolationColors.Colors.Length != 1 || brush.InterpolationColors.Colors[0] != System.Drawing.Color.Empty)
			{
				try
				{
					_blend = new ColorBlend(brush.InterpolationColors);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			if (_blend == null)
			{
				_blend = new ColorBlend();
				_blend.Add(new Color(brush.CenterColor), 0f);
				_blend.Add(new Color(brush.SurroundColors[0]), 1f);
			}
			_radiusX = brush.Rectangle.Width / 2f;
			_radiusY = brush.Rectangle.Height / 2f;
			_center = new Point(brush.Rectangle.Left + _radiusX, brush.Rectangle.Top + _radiusY);
			_focus = new Point(brush.CenterPoint.X, brush.CenterPoint.Y);
			_transform = new Matrix(brush.Transform);
		}

		public override Brush Clone()
		{
			RadialGradientDirectBrush radialGradientDirectBrush = new RadialGradientDirectBrush(Blend, Center, RadiusX, RadiusY, Focus, Transform);
			radialGradientDirectBrush.Circular = Circular;
			return radialGradientDirectBrush;
		}

		public override void Seal()
		{
			base.Seal();
			if (Blend != null)
			{
				Blend.Seal();
			}
			if (Center != null)
			{
				Center.Seal();
			}
			if (Focus != null)
			{
				Focus.Seal();
			}
		}

		internal override System.Drawing.Brush ToNative()
		{
			object weakReferenceTarget = Utilities.GetWeakReferenceTarget(_nativeBrush);
			if (weakReferenceTarget != null)
			{
				return (System.Drawing.Brush)weakReferenceTarget;
			}
			switch (_blend.Count)
			{
			case 0:
				return new SolidBrush(System.Drawing.Color.Black);
			case 1:
				return new SolidBrush(_blend[0].Color.ToNative());
			default:
			{
				GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
				float num;
				float num2;
				if (Circular)
				{
					num = ((!(_radiusX > _radiusY)) ? (num2 = _radiusY) : (num2 = _radiusX));
				}
				else
				{
					num = _radiusX;
					num2 = _radiusY;
				}
				graphicsPath.AddEllipse(new RectangleF(_center.X - num, _center.Y - num2, num * 2f, num2 * 2f));
				PathGradientBrush pathGradientBrush = new PathGradientBrush(graphicsPath);
				pathGradientBrush.InterpolationColors = _blend.Complete().ToNative();
				pathGradientBrush.CenterPoint = new PointF(_focus.X, _focus.Y);
				pathGradientBrush.Transform = _transform.ToNative();
				_nativeBrush = new WeakReference(pathGradientBrush);
				return pathGradientBrush;
			}
			}
		}

		internal override bool VerifyMembersSealed()
		{
			if (Blend != null && !Blend.IsSealed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Center != null && !Center.IsSealed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Focus != null && !Focus.IsSealed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class TextureBrush : IndirectBrush
	{
		private Image _image;

		private float _angle;

		private float _scaleX;

		private float _scaleY;

		private float _offsetX;

		private float _offsetY;

		public override BrushType Type => BrushType.Texture;

		public float Angle
		{
			get
			{
				return _angle;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_angle = value;
			}
		}

		public Image Image
		{
			get
			{
				return _image;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_image = value;
			}
		}

		public float OffsetX
		{
			get
			{
				return _offsetX;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_offsetX = value;
			}
		}

		public float OffsetY
		{
			get
			{
				return _offsetY;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_offsetY = value;
			}
		}

		public float ScaleX
		{
			get
			{
				return _scaleX;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_scaleX = value;
			}
		}

		public float ScaleY
		{
			get
			{
				return _scaleY;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_scaleY = value;
			}
		}

		public TextureBrush(Image image)
			: this(image, 0f, 1f, 1f, 0f, 0f)
		{
		}

		public TextureBrush(Image image, float angle, float scaleX, float scaleY)
			: this(image, angle, scaleX, scaleY, 0f, 0f)
		{
		}

		public TextureBrush(Image image, float angle, float scaleX, float scaleY, float offsetX, float offsetY)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("image");
			}
			_image = image;
			_angle = angle;
			_scaleX = scaleX;
			_scaleY = scaleY;
			_offsetX = offsetX;
			_offsetY = offsetY;
		}

		public override Brush Clone()
		{
			return new TextureBrush(Image, Angle, ScaleX, ScaleY, OffsetX, OffsetY);
		}

		public override DirectBrush SetBounds(float x, float y, float width, float height)
		{
			Matrix matrix = new Matrix();
			double num = (double)_angle * (Math.PI / 180.0);
			float num2 = (float)Math.Cos(num);
			float num3 = (float)Math.Sin(num);
			matrix.Multiply(new Matrix(_scaleX, 0f, 0f, _scaleY, 0f, 0f), MatrixOrder.Append);
			matrix.Multiply(new Matrix(num2, num3, 0f - num3, num2, 0f, 0f), MatrixOrder.Append);
			matrix.Multiply(new Matrix(1f, 0f, 0f, 1f, x + _offsetX, y + _offsetY), MatrixOrder.Append);
			return new TextureDirectBrush(_image, matrix);
		}

		public override void Seal()
		{
			base.Seal();
			if (Image != null)
			{
				Image.Seal();
			}
		}

		internal override bool VerifyMembersSealed()
		{
			if (Image != null && !Image.IsSealed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

		public LinearGradientDirectBrush(System.Drawing.Drawing2D.LinearGradientBrush brush)
		{
			if (brush == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("brush");
			}
			try
			{
				_blend = new ColorBlend(brush.InterpolationColors);
			}
			catch
			{
				_blend = new ColorBlend();
				_blend.Add(new Color(brush.LinearColors[0]), 0f);
				_blend.Add(new Color(brush.LinearColors[1]), 1f);
			}
			_rectangle = new Rectangle(brush.Rectangle);
			_transform = new Matrix(brush.Transform);

		public override void Seal()

			}
			if (Rectangle != null)
			{
				Rectangle.Seal();
			}
			if (Transform != null)
			{
				Transform.Seal();
			}
		}

		internal override System.Drawing.Brush ToNative()
		{
			object weakReferenceTarget = Utilities.GetWeakReferenceTarget(_nativeBrush);
			if (weakReferenceTarget != null)
			{
				return (System.Drawing.Brush)weakReferenceTarget;
			}
			switch (_blend.Count)
			{
			case 0:
				return new SolidBrush(System.Drawing.Color.Black);
			case 1:
				return new SolidBrush(_blend[0].Color.ToNative());
			default:
			{
				System.Drawing.Drawing2D.LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new System.Drawing.Drawing2D.LinearGradientBrush(_rectangle.ToNative(), _blend[0].Color.ToNative(), _blend[1].Color.ToNative(), 0f);
				linearGradientBrush.InterpolationColors = _blend.Complete().ToNative();
				linearGradientBrush.Transform = _transform.ToNative();
				_nativeBrush = new WeakReference(linearGradientBrush);
				return linearGradientBrush;
			}
			}
		}

		internal override bool VerifyMembersSealed()
		{
			if (Blend != null && !Blend.IsSealed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Rectangle != null && !Rectangle.IsSealed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Transform != null && !Transform.IsSealed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class TextureDirectBrush : DirectBrush
	{
		private Image _image;

		private Matrix _transform;

		private WeakReference _nativeBrush;

		public override BrushType Type => BrushType.TextureDirect;

		public Image Image
		{
			get
			{
				return _image;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_image = value;
				_nativeBrush = null;
			}
		}

		public Matrix Transform
		{
			get
			{
				return _transform;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_transform = value;
				_nativeBrush = null;
			}
		}

		public TextureDirectBrush(Image image, Matrix transform)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("image");
			}
			if (transform == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("transform");
			}
			_image = image;
			_transform = transform;
		}

		public TextureDirectBrush(System.Drawing.TextureBrush brush)
		{
			if (brush == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("brush");
			}
			_image = new Image(brush.Image);
			_transform = new Matrix(brush.Transform);
		}

		public override Brush Clone()
		{
			return new TextureDirectBrush(Image, Transform);
		}

		public override void Seal()
		{
			base.Seal();
			if (Image != null)
			{
				Image.Seal();
			}
			if (Transform != null)
			{
				Transform.Seal();
			}
		}

		internal override System.Drawing.Brush ToNative()
		{
			object weakReferenceTarget = Utilities.GetWeakReferenceTarget(_nativeBrush);
			if (weakReferenceTarget != null)
			{
				return (System.Drawing.Brush)weakReferenceTarget;
			}
			System.Drawing.TextureBrush textureBrush = new System.Drawing.TextureBrush(_image.ToNative());
			textureBrush.Transform = _transform.ToNative();
			_nativeBrush = new WeakReference(textureBrush);
			return textureBrush;
		}

		internal override bool VerifyMembersSealed()
		{
			if (Image != null && !Image.IsSealed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Transform != null && !Transform.IsSealed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

		private float _fontAscent;

		private bool _hyperlinkPaused;

		public bool AlternateFill

		public Brush Brush
		{
			get
			{
				return _brush;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_brush == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (_underlineStarted)
				{
					EndUnderline();
					StartUnderline();
				}
				if (_strikeoutStarted)
				{
					EndStrikeout();
					StartStrikeout();
				}
				_nativeBrush = null;
				_indirectBrush = null;
				_brush = value;
				if (_brush != null)
				{
					if (_brush is IndirectBrush)
					{
						_indirectBrush = (IndirectBrush)_brush;
					}
					else
					{
						_nativeBrush = _brush.ToNative();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public float CharSpacing

			get
			{
				return _charSpacing;
			}

				_charSpacing = value;
			}

		public Font Font
		{
			get
			{
				return _font;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_font == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (_underlineStarted)
				{
					EndUnderline();
				}
				if (_strikeoutStarted)
				{
					EndStrikeout();
				}
				_font = value;
				if (_font != null)
				{
					_nativeFont = _font.ToNative();
					_fontSize = _nativeFont.SizeInPoints;
					int cellAscent = _nativeFont.FontFamily.GetCellAscent(_nativeFont.Style);
					int cellDescent = _nativeFont.FontFamily.GetCellDescent(_nativeFont.Style);
					int num = cellAscent + cellDescent;
					int emHeight = _nativeFont.FontFamily.GetEmHeight(_nativeFont.Style);
					_fontAscent = _fontSize * (float)cellAscent / (float)emHeight;
					_fontDescent = _fontSize * (float)cellDescent / (float)emHeight;
					_fontHeight = _fontSize * (float)num / (float)emHeight;
					if ((_font.Style & FontStyle.Underline) == FontStyle.Underline || (_font.Style & FontStyle.DoubleUnderline) == FontStyle.DoubleUnderline)
					{
						StartUnderline();
					}
					if ((_font.Style & FontStyle.Strikeout) == FontStyle.Strikeout || (_font.Style & FontStyle.DoubleStrikeout) == FontStyle.DoubleStrikeout)
					{
						StartStrikeout();
					}
					if (_fcw.ContainsKey(_font))
					{
						_cw = _fcw[_font];
						return;
					}
					_cw = new Dictionary<char, float>(256);
					_fcw.Add(_font, _cw);
				}
				else
				{
					_nativeFont = null;
					_cw = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public FontMetrics FontMetrics => new FontMetrics(_fontAscent, _fontDescent, _fontHeight);

		public Graphics(System.Drawing.Graphics graphics)
			: this(graphics, Quality.High)
		{
		}

		public Graphics(System.Drawing.Graphics graphics, Quality quality)
		{
			if (graphics == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("graphics");
			}
			_nativeGraphics = graphics;
			_nativeGraphics.PageUnit = GraphicsUnit.Point;
			switch (quality)
			{
			case Quality.High:
				_nativeGraphics.CompositingQuality = CompositingQuality.HighQuality;
				_nativeGraphics.SmoothingMode = SmoothingMode.HighQuality;
				_nativeGraphics.TextRenderingHint = TextRenderingHint.AntiAlias;
				break;
			case Quality.Medium:
				_nativeGraphics.CompositingQuality = CompositingQuality.AssumeLinear;
				_nativeGraphics.SmoothingMode = SmoothingMode.AntiAlias;
				_nativeGraphics.TextRenderingHint = TextRenderingHint.AntiAlias;
				break;
			case Quality.Low:
				_nativeGraphics.CompositingQuality = CompositingQuality.HighSpeed;
				_nativeGraphics.SmoothingMode = SmoothingMode.HighSpeed;
				_nativeGraphics.TextRenderingHint = TextRenderingHint.SystemDefault;
				break;
			}
			_nativeGraphics.Clear(System.Drawing.Color.White);
			_states = new Stack<State>();
			_nativeStates = new Stack<GraphicsState>();
			_fcw = new Dictionary<Font, Dictionary<char, float>>();
			_alternateFill = true;
			_sf = StringFormat.GenericTypographic;
			_sf.FormatFlags |= StringFormatFlags.NoWrap;
			_sf.FormatFlags |= StringFormatFlags.NoClip;
			_sf.FormatFlags |= StringFormatFlags.MeasureTrailingSpaces;
		}

		private void BoundIndirectBrush(Rectangle rectangle)
		{
			if (!(rectangle.Width <= 0f) && !(rectangle.Height <= 0f))
			{
				if (_underlineStarted)
				{
					EndUnderline();
					StartUnderline();
				}
				if (_strikeoutStarted)
				{
					EndStrikeout();
					StartStrikeout();
				}
				_nativeBrush = _indirectBrush.SetBounds(rectangle.X, rectangle.Y, rectangle.Width, rectangle.Height).ToNative();
			}
		}

		private void EndStrikeout()
		{
			if (!_strikeoutStarted)
			{
				return;
			}
			_strikeoutStarted = false;
			int num = (int)(_strikeoutX * 100f);
			int num2 = (int)(_posX * 100f);
			if (Math.Abs(num - num2) > 1)
			{
				Pen pen = _pen;
				float num3 = _fontSize / 10f;
				Color color = Colors.Black;
				if (_brush.Type == BrushType.SolidColor)
				{
					color = ((SolidColorBrush)_brush).Color;
				}
				if ((_font.Style & FontStyle.DoubleStrikeout) == FontStyle.DoubleStrikeout)
				{
					num3 /= 2f;
					Pen = new Pen(color, num3);
					DrawLine(_strikeoutX, _strikeoutY - num3, _posX - _charSpacing, _strikeoutY - num3);
					DrawLine(_strikeoutX, _strikeoutY + num3 * 1.5f, _posX - _charSpacing, _strikeoutY + num3 * 1.5f);
				}
				else
				{
					Pen = new Pen(color, num3);
					DrawLine(_strikeoutX, _strikeoutY, _posX - _charSpacing, _strikeoutY);
				}
				Pen = pen;
			}
			_strikeoutX = 0f;
			_strikeoutY = 0f;
		}

		private void EndUnderline()
		{
			if (!_underlineStarted)
			{
				return;
			}
			_underlineStarted = false;
			int num = (int)(_underlineX * 100f);
			int num2 = (int)(_posX * 100f);
			if (Math.Abs(num - num2) > 1)
			{
				Pen pen = _pen;
				float num3 = _fontSize / 10f;
				Color color = Colors.Black;
				if (_brush.Type == BrushType.SolidColor)
				{
					color = ((SolidColorBrush)_brush).Color;
				}
				if ((_font.Style & FontStyle.DoubleUnderline) == FontStyle.DoubleUnderline)
				{
					num3 /= 2f;
					Pen = new Pen(color, num3);
					DrawLine(_underlineX, _underlineY - num3 * 2f, _posX - _charSpacing, _underlineY - num3 * 2f);
					DrawLine(_underlineX, _underlineY + num3 / 2f, _posX - _charSpacing, _underlineY + num3 / 2f);
				}
				else
				{
					Pen = new Pen(color, num3);
					DrawLine(_underlineX, _underlineY, _posX - _charSpacing, _underlineY);
				}
				Pen = pen;
			}
			_underlineX = 0f;
			_underlineY = 0f;
		}

		private void PopState()
		{
			State state = _states.Pop();
			Font = state.Font;
			Brush = state.Brush;
			Pen = state.Pen;
			_nativeGraphics.Transform = state.Matrix.ToNative();
			_charSpacing = state.CharSpacing;
			_alternateFill = state.AlternateFill;
		}

		private void PushState()
		{
			State state = new State();
			state.Font = _font;
			state.Brush = _brush;
			state.Pen = _pen;
			state.Matrix = new Matrix(_nativeGraphics.Transform);
			state.CharSpacing = _charSpacing;
			state.AlternateFill = _alternateFill;
			_states.Push(state);
		}

		private void SetTextPosition(float x, float y)
		{
			int num = (int)(_posX * 100f);
			int num2 = (int)(x * 100f);
			int num3 = (int)(_posY * 100f);
			int num4 = (int)(y * 100f);
			if (Math.Abs(num - num2) > 1 || Math.Abs(num3 - num4) > 1)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				bool flag2 = false;
				if (_underlineStarted)
				{
					flag = true;
					EndUnderline();
				}
				if (_strikeoutStarted)
				{
					flag2 = true;
					EndStrikeout();
				}
				_posX = x;
				_posY = y;
				if (flag)
				{
					StartUnderline();
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					StartStrikeout();
				}
			}
		}

		private void StartStrikeout()
		{
			if (!_strikeoutStarted)
			{
				_strikeoutStarted = true;
				_strikeoutX = _posX;
				_strikeoutY = _posY + _fontAscent - _fontSize / 3f;
			}
		}

		private void StartUnderline()
		{
			if (!_underlineStarted)
			{
				_underlineStarted = true;
				_underlineX = _posX;
				_underlineY = _posY + _fontAscent + _fontSize / 6f;
			}
		}

		public void AddHyperlinkArea(float x, float y, float width, float height)
		{
		}

		public float GetCharWidth(char ch)
		{
			if (_nativeFont == null)
			{
				return 0f;
			}
			if (_cw.ContainsKey(ch))
			{
				return _cw[ch] + _charSpacing;
			}
			float width = _nativeGraphics.MeasureString(ch.ToString(), _nativeFont, 0, _sf).Width;
			_cw.Add(ch, width);
			return width + _charSpacing;
		}

		public void CurveTo(float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2, float x3, float y3)

			if (_path != null)

				_path.CurveTo(x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3);
			}
		}

		public void DrawArc(float x, float y, float width, float height, float startAngle, float endAngle)
		{
			DrawArc(x, y, width, height, startAngle, endAngle, PaintMode.Stroke);
		}

		public void DrawArc(float x, float y, float width, float height, float startAngle, float endAngle, PaintMode mode)
		{
			if (width <= 0f || height <= 0f)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (endAngle < startAngle)
			{
				endAngle += 360f;
			}
			if (startAngle == endAngle)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (_path == null)
			{
				_path = new Path();
				_paintMode = mode;
				flag = true;
			}
			float num = width / 2f;
			float num2 = height / 2f;
			float num3 = x + num;
			float num4 = y + num2;
			if (mode != PaintMode.Stroke)
			{
				_path.MoveTo(num3, num4);
			}
			bool flag2 = true;
			while (startAngle < endAngle)
			{
				float num5;
				float num6;
				if (endAngle - startAngle < 90f)
				{
					num5 = startAngle;
					num6 = endAngle;
				}
				else
				{
					num5 = startAngle;
					num6 = num5 + 90f;
				}
				num5 = (float)((double)num5 * (Math.PI / 180.0));
				num6 = (float)((double)num6 * (Math.PI / 180.0));
				float num7 = (float)Math.Sin(num5);
				float num8 = (float)Math.Cos(num5);
				float num9 = (float)Math.Sin(num6);
				float num10 = (float)Math.Cos(num6);
				float num11 = 4f * (float)(1.0 - Math.Cos((num6 - num5) / 2f)) / (float)Math.Sin((num6 - num5) / 2f) / 3f;
				float x2 = num * num8 + num3;
				float y2 = num2 * num7 + num4;
				float x3 = num * (num8 - num11 * num7) + num3;
				float y3 = num2 * (num7 + num11 * num8) + num4;
				float x4 = num * (num10 + num11 * num9) + num3;
				float y4 = num2 * (num9 - num11 * num10) + num4;
				float x5 = num * num10 + num3;
				float y5 = num2 * num9 + num4;
				if (flag2)
				{
					flag2 = false;
					if (mode == PaintMode.Stroke)
					{
						_path.MoveTo(x2, y2);
					}
					else
					{
						_path.LineTo(x2, y2);
					}
				}
				_path.CurveTo(x3, y3, x4, y4, x5, y5);
				startAngle += 90f;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_paintMode != PaintMode.Stroke)
			{
				_path.ClosePath();
			}
			if (_alternateFill)
			{
				_path.Mode = FillMode.Alternate;
			}
			else
			{
				_path.Mode = FillMode.Winding;
			}
			GraphicsPath path = _path.ToNative();
			switch (_paintMode)
			{
			case PaintMode.Fill:
				if (_indirectBrush != null)
				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(_path.GetBounds());
				}
				if (_nativeBrush != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.FillPath(_nativeBrush, path);
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.Stroke:
				if (_nativePen != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.DrawPath(_nativePen, path);
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.FillStroke:
				if (_indirectBrush != null)
				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(_path.GetBounds());
				}
				if (_nativeBrush != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.FillPath(_nativeBrush, path);
				}
				if (_nativePen != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.DrawPath(_nativePen, path);
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.Clip:

		public void DrawBeziers(Point[] points, PaintMode mode)
		{
			if (points == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("points");
			}
			int num = points.Length;
			if (num < 4 || (num - 1) % 3 != 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("points", "[4, ...] AND MOD 3");
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (_path == null)
			{
				_path = new Path();
				_paintMode = mode;
				flag = true;
			}
			float x = points[0].X;
			float y = points[0].Y;
			_path.MoveTo(x, y);
			num -= 2;
			for (int i = 1; i < num; i += 3)
			{
				float x2 = points[i].X;
				float y2 = points[i].Y;
				float x3 = points[i + 1].X;
				float y3 = points[i + 1].Y;
				float x4 = points[i + 2].X;
				float y4 = points[i + 2].Y;
				_path.CurveTo(x2, y2, x3, y3, x4, y4);
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_alternateFill)
			{
				_path.Mode = FillMode.Alternate;
			}
			else
			{
				_path.Mode = FillMode.Winding;
			}
			GraphicsPath path = _path.ToNative();
			switch (_paintMode)
			{
			case PaintMode.Fill:
				if (_indirectBrush != null)
				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(_path.GetBounds());
				}
				if (_nativeBrush != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.FillPath(_nativeBrush, path);
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.Stroke:
				if (_nativePen != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.DrawPath(_nativePen, path);
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.FillStroke:
				if (_indirectBrush != null)
				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(_path.GetBounds());
				}
				if (_nativeBrush != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.FillPath(_nativeBrush, path);
				}
				if (_nativePen != null)

		public void DrawChord(float x, float y, float width, float height, float startAngle, float endAngle)
		{
			DrawChord(x, y, width, height, startAngle, endAngle, PaintMode.Stroke);
		}

		public void DrawChord(float x, float y, float width, float height, float startAngle, float endAngle, PaintMode mode)
		{
			if (width <= 0f || height <= 0f)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (endAngle < startAngle)
			{
				endAngle += 360f;
			}
			if (startAngle == endAngle)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (_path == null)
			{
				_path = new Path();
				_paintMode = mode;
				flag = true;
			}
			float num = width / 2f;
			float num2 = height / 2f;
			float num3 = x + num;
			float num4 = y + num2;
			bool flag2 = true;
			while (startAngle < endAngle)
			{
				float num5;
				float num6;
				if (endAngle - startAngle < 90f)
				{
					num5 = startAngle;
					num6 = endAngle;
				}
				else
				{
					num5 = startAngle;
					num6 = num5 + 90f;
				}
				num5 = (float)((double)num5 * (Math.PI / 180.0));
				num6 = (float)((double)num6 * (Math.PI / 180.0));
				float num7 = (float)Math.Sin(num5);
				float num8 = (float)Math.Cos(num5);
				float num9 = (float)Math.Sin(num6);
				float num10 = (float)Math.Cos(num6);
				float num11 = 4f * (float)(1.0 - Math.Cos((num6 - num5) / 2f)) / (float)Math.Sin((num6 - num5) / 2f) / 3f;
				float x2 = num * num8 + num3;
				float y2 = num2 * num7 + num4;
				float x3 = num * (num8 - num11 * num7) + num3;
				float y3 = num2 * (num7 + num11 * num8) + num4;
				float x4 = num * (num10 + num11 * num9) + num3;
				float y4 = num2 * (num9 - num11 * num10) + num4;
				float x5 = num * num10 + num3;
				float y5 = num2 * num9 + num4;
				if (flag2)
				{
					flag2 = false;
					_path.MoveTo(x2, y2);
				}
				_path.CurveTo(x3, y3, x4, y4, x5, y5);
				startAngle += 90f;
			}
			_path.ClosePath();
			if (!flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_alternateFill)
			{
				_path.Mode = FillMode.Alternate;
			}
			else
			{
				_path.Mode = FillMode.Winding;
			}
			GraphicsPath path = _path.ToNative();
			switch (_paintMode)
			{
			case PaintMode.Fill:
				if (_indirectBrush != null)
				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(_path.GetBounds());
				}
				if (_nativeBrush != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.FillPath(_nativeBrush, path);
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.Stroke:
				if (_nativePen != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.DrawPath(_nativePen, path);
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.FillStroke:
				if (_indirectBrush != null)
				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(_path.GetBounds());
				}
				if (_nativeBrush != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.FillPath(_nativeBrush, path);
				}
				if (_nativePen != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.DrawPath(_nativePen, path);
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.Clip:
				_nativeGraphics.SetClip(path, CombineMode.Intersect);
				break;
			}
			_path = null;
		}

		public void DrawClosedCurve(Point[] points, float tension)
		{
			DrawClosedCurve(points, tension, PaintMode.Stroke);
		}

		public void DrawClosedCurve(Point[] points, float tension, PaintMode mode)
		{
			if (points == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("points");
			}
			if (points.Length < 4)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("points", "[4, ...]");
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (_path == null)
			{
				_path = new Path();
				_paintMode = mode;
				flag = true;
			}
			int num = points.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				float x;
				float y;
				if (i == 0)
				{
					x = points[num - 1].X;
					y = points[num - 1].Y;
				}
				else
				{
					x = points[i - 1].X;
					y = points[i - 1].Y;
				}
				float x2 = points[i].X;
				float y2 = points[i].Y;
				int num2 = i + 1;
				int num3 = i + 2;
				if (num3 >= num)
				{
					num3 = 0;
				}
				if (num2 >= num)
				{
					num2 = 0;
					num3 = 1;
				}
				float x3 = points[num2].X;
				float y3 = points[num2].Y;
				float x4 = points[num3].X;
				float y4 = points[num3].Y;
				float x5 = x2 + tension * ((x3 - x) / 2f);
				float y5 = y2 + tension * ((y3 - y) / 2f);
				float x6 = x3 - tension * ((x4 - x2) / 2f);
				float y6 = y3 - tension * ((y4 - y2) / 2f);
				if (i == 0)
				{
					_path.MoveTo(x2, y2);
				}
				_path.CurveTo(x5, y5, x6, y6, x3, y3);
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_alternateFill)
			{
				_path.Mode = FillMode.Alternate;
			}
			else
			{
				_path.Mode = FillMode.Winding;
			}
			GraphicsPath path = _path.ToNative();
			switch (_paintMode)
			{
			case PaintMode.Fill:
				if (_indirectBrush != null)
				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(_path.GetBounds());
				}
				if (_nativeBrush != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.FillPath(_nativeBrush, path);
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.Stroke:
				if (_nativePen != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.DrawPath(_nativePen, path);
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.FillStroke:
				if (_indirectBrush != null)
				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(_path.GetBounds());
				}
				if (_nativeBrush != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.FillPath(_nativeBrush, path);
				}
				if (_nativePen != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.DrawPath(_nativePen, path);
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.Clip:
				_nativeGraphics.SetClip(path, CombineMode.Intersect);
				break;
			}
			_path = null;
		}

		public void DrawCurve(Point[] points, float tension)
		{
			if (points == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("points");
			}
			if (points.Length < 4)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("points", "[4, ...]");
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (_path == null)
			{
				_path = new Path();
				_paintMode = PaintMode.Stroke;
				flag = true;
			}
			float x = points[0].X;
			float y = points[0].Y;
			float x2 = points[1].X;
			float y2 = points[1].Y;
			float x3 = points[2].X;
			float y3 = points[2].Y;
			float x4 = x + tension * ((x2 - x) / 2f);
			float y4 = y + tension * ((y2 - y) / 2f);
			float x5 = x2 - tension * ((x3 - x) / 2f);
			float y5 = y2 - tension * ((y3 - y) / 2f);
			_path.MoveTo(x, y);
			_path.CurveTo(x4, y4, x5, y5, x2, y2);
			int num = points.Length - 2;
			float x6;
			float y6;
			for (int i = 1; i < num; i++)
			{
				x = points[i - 1].X;
				y = points[i - 1].Y;
				x2 = points[i].X;
				y2 = points[i].Y;
				x3 = points[i + 1].X;
				y3 = points[i + 1].Y;
				x6 = points[i + 2].X;
				y6 = points[i + 2].Y;
				x4 = x2 + tension * ((x3 - x) / 2f);
				y4 = y2 + tension * ((y3 - y) / 2f);
				x5 = x3 - tension * ((x6 - x2) / 2f);
				y5 = y3 - tension * ((y6 - y2) / 2f);
				_path.CurveTo(x4, y4, x5, y5, x3, y3);
			}
			num += 2;
			x2 = points[num - 3].X;
			y2 = points[num - 3].Y;
			x3 = points[num - 2].X;
			y3 = points[num - 2].Y;
			x6 = points[num - 1].X;
			y6 = points[num - 1].Y;
			x4 = x3 + tension * ((x6 - x2) / 2f);
			y4 = y3 + tension * ((y6 - y2) / 2f);
			x5 = x6 - tension * ((x6 - x3) / 2f);
			y5 = y6 - tension * ((y6 - y3) / 2f);
			_path.CurveTo(x4, y4, x5, y5, x6, y6);
			if (flag)
			{
				if (_nativePen != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.DrawPath(_nativePen, _path.ToNative());
				}
				_path = null;
			}
		}

		public void DrawImage(Image image, float x, float y, float width, float height)
		{

		}

		}

		public void DrawImage(Image image, float x, float y, float width, float height, float alpha)
		{
			DrawImage(image, x, y, width, height, null, alpha);
		}

		public void DrawImage(Image image, float x, float y, float width, float height, Color transparentColor, float alpha)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("image");
			}
			if (alpha < 0f || alpha > 1f)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("alpha", "[0.0, 1.0]");
			}
			if (alpha != 0f)
			{
				System.Drawing.Image image2 = image.ToNative();
				bool flag = false;
				Bitmap bitmap;
				try
				{
					bitmap = (Bitmap)image2;
				}
				catch
				{
					bitmap = new Bitmap(image2);
					flag = true;
				}
				if (width < 0.5f)
				{
					width = 0.5f;
				}
				if (height < 0.5f)
				{
					height = 0.5f;
				}
				if (transparentColor != null)
				{
					bitmap.MakeTransparent(transparentColor.ToNative());
				}
				if (alpha < 1f)
				{
					ColorMatrix colorMatrix = new ColorMatrix();
					colorMatrix.Matrix00 = 1f;
					colorMatrix.Matrix11 = 1f;
					colorMatrix.Matrix22 = 1f;
					colorMatrix.Matrix33 = alpha;
					colorMatrix.Matrix44 = 1f;
					ImageAttributes imageAttributes = new ImageAttributes();
					imageAttributes.SetColorMatrix(colorMatrix, ColorMatrixFlag.Default, ColorAdjustType.Bitmap);
					PointF pointF = new PointF(x, y);
					PointF pointF2 = new PointF(x + width, y);
					PointF pointF3 = new PointF(x, y + height);
					PointF[] destPoints = new PointF[3] { pointF, pointF2, pointF3 };
					_nativeGraphics.DrawImage(bitmap, destPoints, new RectangleF(0f, 0f, bitmap.Width, bitmap.Height), GraphicsUnit.Pixel, imageAttributes);
				}
				else
				{
					_nativeGraphics.DrawImage(bitmap, x, y, width, height);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					bitmap.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(_path.GetBounds());
				}
				if (_nativeBrush != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.FillPath(_nativeBrush, path);
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.Stroke:
				if (_nativePen != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.DrawPath(_nativePen, path);
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.FillStroke:
				if (_indirectBrush != null)
				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(_path.GetBounds());
				}
				if (_nativeBrush != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.FillPath(_nativeBrush, path);
				}
				if (_nativePen != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.DrawPath(_nativePen, path);
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.Clip:
				_nativeGraphics.SetClip(path, CombineMode.Intersect);
				break;
			}
			_path = null;
		}

		public void DrawPolygon(Point[] points)
		{
			DrawPolygon(points, PaintMode.Stroke);
		}

		public void DrawPolygon(Point[] points, PaintMode mode)
		{
			if (points == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("points");
			}
			if (points.Length < 3)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("points", "[3, ...]");
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (_path == null)
			{
				_path = new Path();
				_paintMode = mode;
				flag = true;
			}
			_path.MoveTo(points[0].X, points[0].Y);
			int num = points.Length;
			for (int i = 1; i < num; i++)
			{
				_path.LineTo(points[i].X, points[i].Y);
			}
			_path.ClosePath();
			if (!flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_alternateFill)
			{
				_path.Mode = FillMode.Alternate;
			}
			else
			{
				_path.Mode = FillMode.Winding;
			}
			GraphicsPath path = _path.ToNative();
			switch (_paintMode)
			{
			case PaintMode.Fill:
				if (_indirectBrush != null)
				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(_path.GetBounds());
				}
				if (_nativeBrush != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.FillPath(_nativeBrush, path);
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.Stroke:
				if (_nativePen != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.DrawPath(_nativePen, path);
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.FillStroke:
				if (_indirectBrush != null)
				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(_path.GetBounds());
				}
				if (_nativeBrush != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.FillPath(_nativeBrush, path);
				}
				if (_nativePen != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.DrawPath(_nativePen, path);
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.Clip:
				_nativeGraphics.SetClip(path, CombineMode.Intersect);
				break;
			}
			_path = null;
		}

		public void DrawRectangle(float x, float y, float width, float height)
		{
			DrawRectangle(x, y, width, height, PaintMode.Stroke);
		}

		public void DrawRectangle(float x, float y, float width, float height, PaintMode mode)
		{
			if (width <= 0f || height <= 0f)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (_path == null)
			{
				_path = new Path();
				_paintMode = mode;
				flag = true;
			}
			float x2 = x + width;
			float y2 = y + height;
			_path.MoveTo(x, y);
			_path.LineTo(x2, y);
			_path.LineTo(x2, y2);
			_path.LineTo(x, y2);
			_path.ClosePath();
			if (!flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_alternateFill)
			{
				_path.Mode = FillMode.Alternate;
			}
			else
			{
				_path.Mode = FillMode.Winding;
			}
			GraphicsPath path = _path.ToNative();
			switch (_paintMode)
			{
			case PaintMode.Fill:
				if (_indirectBrush != null)
				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(_path.GetBounds());
				}
				if (_nativeBrush != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.FillPath(_nativeBrush, path);
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.Stroke:
				if (_nativePen != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.DrawPath(_nativePen, path);
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.FillStroke:
				if (_indirectBrush != null)
				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(_path.GetBounds());
				}
				if (_nativeBrush != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.FillPath(_nativeBrush, path);
				}
				if (_nativePen != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.DrawPath(_nativePen, path);
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.Clip:
				_nativeGraphics.SetClip(path, CombineMode.Intersect);
				break;
			}
			_path = null;
		}

		public void DrawRoundedRect(float x, float y, float width, float height, float ew, float eh)
		{
			DrawRoundedRect(x, y, width, height, ew, eh, PaintMode.Stroke);
		}

		public void DrawRoundedRect(float x, float y, float width, float height, float ew, float eh, PaintMode mode)
		{
			if (width <= 0f || height <= 0f || ew < 0f || eh < 0f)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (_path == null)
			{
				_path = new Path();
				_paintMode = mode;
				flag = true;
			}
			float num = ew / 2f;
			float num2 = eh / 2f;
			float num3 = x + num;
			float num4 = x + width - num;
			float x2 = x + width;
			float num5 = y + num2;
			float x3 = x + width;
			float num6 = y + height - num2;
			float num7 = x + width - num;
			float y2 = y + height;
			float num8 = x + num;
			float y3 = y + height;
			float num9 = y + height - num2;
			float num10 = y + num2;
			float num11 = 0f;
			float num12 = (float)Math.PI / 2f;
			float num13 = (float)Math.Sin(num11);
			float num14 = (float)Math.Cos(num11);
			float num15 = (float)Math.Sin(num12);
			float num16 = (float)Math.Cos(num12);
			float num17 = 4f * (float)(1.0 - Math.Cos((num12 - num11) / 2f)) / (float)Math.Sin((num12 - num11) / 2f) / 3f;
			float num18 = num * (num16 + num17 * num15);
			float num19 = (0f - num2) * (num15 - num17 * num16);
			float num20 = num * (num14 - num17 * num13);
			float num21 = (0f - num2) * (num13 + num17 * num14);
			num18 += num4;
			num19 += num5;
			num20 += num4;
			num21 += num5;
			num11 = 4.712389f;
			num12 = (float)Math.PI * 2f;
			num13 = (float)Math.Sin(num11);
			num14 = (float)Math.Cos(num11);
			num15 = (float)Math.Sin(num12);
			num16 = (float)Math.Cos(num12);
			num17 = 4f * (float)(1.0 - Math.Cos((num12 - num11) / 2f)) / (float)Math.Sin((num12 - num11) / 2f) / 3f;
			float num22 = num * (num16 + num17 * num15);
			float num23 = (0f - num2) * (num15 - num17 * num16);
			float num24 = num * (num14 - num17 * num13);
			float num25 = (0f - num2) * (num13 + num17 * num14);
			num22 += num7;
			num23 += num6;
			num24 += num7;
			num25 += num6;
			num11 = (float)Math.PI;
			num12 = 4.712389f;
			num13 = (float)Math.Sin(num11);
			num14 = (float)Math.Cos(num11);
			num15 = (float)Math.Sin(num12);
			num16 = (float)Math.Cos(num12);
			num17 = 4f * (float)(1.0 - Math.Cos((num12 - num11) / 2f)) / (float)Math.Sin((num12 - num11) / 2f) / 3f;
			float num26 = num * (num16 + num17 * num15);
			float num27 = (0f - num2) * (num15 - num17 * num16);
			float num28 = num * (num14 - num17 * num13);
			float num29 = (0f - num2) * (num13 + num17 * num14);
			num26 += num8;
			num27 += num9;
			num28 += num8;
			num29 += num9;
			num11 = (float)Math.PI / 2f;
			num12 = (float)Math.PI;
			num13 = (float)Math.Sin(num11);
			num14 = (float)Math.Cos(num11);
			num15 = (float)Math.Sin(num12);
			num16 = (float)Math.Cos(num12);
			num17 = 4f * (float)(1.0 - Math.Cos((num12 - num11) / 2f)) / (float)Math.Sin((num12 - num11) / 2f) / 3f;
			float num30 = num * (num16 + num17 * num15);
			float num31 = (0f - num2) * (num15 - num17 * num16);
			float num32 = num * (num14 - num17 * num13);
			float num33 = (0f - num2) * (num13 + num17 * num14);
			num30 += num3;
			num31 += num10;
			num32 += num3;
			num33 += num10;
			_path.MoveTo(num3, y);
			_path.LineTo(num4, y);
			_path.CurveTo(num18, num19, num20, num21, x2, num5);
			_path.LineTo(x3, num6);
			_path.CurveTo(num22, num23, num24, num25, num7, y2);
			_path.LineTo(num8, y3);
			_path.CurveTo(num26, num27, num28, num29, x, num9);
			_path.LineTo(x, num10);
			_path.CurveTo(num30, num31, num32, num33, num3, y);
			_path.ClosePath();
			if (!flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_alternateFill)
			{
				_path.Mode = FillMode.Alternate;
			}
			else
			{
				_path.Mode = FillMode.Winding;
			}
			GraphicsPath path = _path.ToNative();
			switch (_paintMode)
			{
			case PaintMode.Fill:
				if (_indirectBrush != null)
				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(_path.GetBounds());
				}
				if (_nativeBrush != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.FillPath(_nativeBrush, path);
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.Stroke:
				if (_nativePen != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.DrawPath(_nativePen, path);
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.FillStroke:
				if (_indirectBrush != null)
				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(_path.GetBounds());
				}
				if (_nativeBrush != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.FillPath(_nativeBrush, path);
				}
				if (_nativePen != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.DrawPath(_nativePen, path);
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.Clip:
				_nativeGraphics.SetClip(path, CombineMode.Intersect);
				break;
			}
			_path = null;
		}

		public void DrawSpacing(float width)
		{
			_posX += width;
		}

		public void DrawString(string text)
		{
			DrawString(_posX, _posY, text);
		}

		public void DrawString(float x, float y, string text)
		{
			if (text == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("text");
			}
			SetTextPosition(x, y);
			if (_nativeFont == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			float num = GetStringWidth(text);
			_posX = x + num;
			_posY = y;
			if (_hyperlinkStarted && !_hyperlinkPaused)
			{
				if (_charSpacing < 0f)
				{
					num -= _charSpacing;
				}
				AddHyperlinkArea(x, y, num, _fontHeight);
			}
			if (_indirectBrush != null)
			{
				if (_nativeFont.Italic)
				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(new Rectangle(x, y, num + _fontHeight * 0.15f, _fontHeight));
				}
				else
				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(new Rectangle(x, y, num, _fontHeight));
				}
			}
			if (_nativeBrush == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_charSpacing == 0f)
			{
				char[] array = text.ToCharArray();
				int num2 = array.Length;
				for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
				{
					if (array[i] < ' ')
					{
						array[i] = ' ';
					}
				}
				_nativeGraphics.DrawString(new string(array), _nativeFont, _nativeBrush, x, y, _sf);
				return;
			}
			int length = text.Length;
			for (int j = 0; j < length; j++)
			{
				char c = text[j];
				if (c < ' ')
				{
					c = ' ';
				}
				_nativeGraphics.DrawString(c.ToString(), _nativeFont, _nativeBrush, x, y, _sf);
				x += GetCharWidth(c);
			}
		}

		public void EndHyperlink()
		{
			_hyperlinkStarted = false;
		}

		public void EndShape()
		{
			if (_path == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_alternateFill)
			{
				_path.Mode = FillMode.Alternate;
			}
			else
			{
				_path.Mode = FillMode.Winding;
			}
			GraphicsPath path = _path.ToNative();
			switch (_paintMode)
			{
			case PaintMode.Fill:
				if (_indirectBrush != null)
				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(_path.GetBounds());
				}
				if (_nativeBrush != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.FillPath(_nativeBrush, path);
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.Stroke:
				if (_nativePen != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.DrawPath(_nativePen, path);
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.FillStroke:
				if (_indirectBrush != null)
				{
					BoundIndirectBrush(_path.GetBounds());
				}
				if (_nativeBrush != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.FillPath(_nativeBrush, path);
				}
				if (_nativePen != null)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.DrawPath(_nativePen, path);
				}
				break;
			case PaintMode.Clip:
				if (_clipToBounds)
				{
					_nativeGraphics.IntersectClip(_path.GetBounds().ToNative());
				}
				else
				{
					_nativeGraphics.SetClip(path, CombineMode.Intersect);
				}
				break;
			}
			_path = null;
		}

		public void FillArc(float x, float y, float width, float height, float startAngle, float endAngle)
		{
			DrawArc(x, y, width, height, startAngle, endAngle, PaintMode.Fill);
		}

			DrawBeziers(points, PaintMode.Fill);
		}

		public void FillChord(float x, float y, float width, float height, float startAngle, float endAngle)

			DrawChord(x, y, width, height, startAngle, endAngle, PaintMode.Fill);
		}

		public void FillClosedCurve(Point[] points, float tension)
		{
			DrawClosedCurve(points, tension, PaintMode.Fill);
		}

		{
			DrawEllipse(x, y, width, height, PaintMode.Fill);
		}

		{
			DrawPie(x, y, width, height, startAngle, endAngle, PaintMode.Fill);
		}

		{
			DrawPolygon(points, PaintMode.Fill);
		}

		public void FillRectangle(float x, float y, float width, float height)
		{
			DrawRectangle(x, y, width, height, PaintMode.Fill);
		}

		public void FillRoundedRect(float x, float y, float width, float height, float ew, float eh)
		{
			DrawRoundedRect(x, y, width, height, ew, eh, PaintMode.Fill);
		}

		public void Flush()
		{
			if (_underlineStarted)
			{
				EndUnderline();
			}
			if (_strikeoutStarted)
			{
				EndStrikeout();
			}
			Pen = null;
			Brush = null;
			Font = null;
			_fcw.Clear();
			_nativeGraphics.Flush();
		}

		public void LineTo(float x, float y)
		{
			if (_path != null)
			{
				_path.LineTo(x, y);
			}
		}

		public void MoveTo(float x, float y)
		{
			if (_path != null)
			{
				_path.MoveTo(x, y);
			}
		}

		public void PauseHyperlink()
		{
			_hyperlinkPaused = true;
		}

		public void RestoreClip()
		{
			if (_states.Count > 0)
			{
				PopState();
			}
			if (_nativeStates.Count > 0)
			{
				_nativeGraphics.Restore(_nativeStates.Pop());
			}
		}

		public void RestoreState()
		{
			if (_states.Count > 0)
			{
				PopState();
			}
			if (_nativeStates.Count > 0)
			{
				_nativeGraphics.Restore(_nativeStates.Pop());
			}
		}

		public void ResumeHyperlink()
		{
			_hyperlinkPaused = false;
		}

		public void Rotate(float centerX, float centerY, float angle)
		{
			Matrix matrix = new Matrix();
			matrix.RotateAt(angle, new Point(centerX, centerY), MatrixOrder.Prepend);
			Transform(matrix);
		}

		public void SaveClip(float x, float y, float width, float height)
		{
			PushState();
			_nativeStates.Push(_nativeGraphics.Save());
			_nativeGraphics.SetClip(new RectangleF(x, y, width, height), CombineMode.Intersect);
		}

		public void SaveState()
		{
			PushState();
			_nativeStates.Push(_nativeGraphics.Save());
		}

		public void Scale(float scaleX, float scaleY)
		{
			Matrix matrix = new Matrix();
			matrix.Scale(scaleX, scaleY, MatrixOrder.Prepend);
			Transform(matrix);
		}

		public void Shear(float shearX, float shearY)
		{
			Matrix matrix = new Matrix();
			matrix.Shear(shearX, shearY, MatrixOrder.Prepend);
			Transform(matrix);
		}

		public void Skew(float skewX, float skewY)
		{
			Matrix matrix = new Matrix();
			matrix.Skew(skewX, skewY, MatrixOrder.Prepend);
			Transform(matrix);
		}

		public void StartHyperlink(string reference)
		{
			if (reference != null)
			{
				_hyperlinkStarted = true;
			}
		}

		public void StartHyperlink(int pageIndex, float x, float y)
		{
			_hyperlinkStarted = true;
		}

		public void StartShape(PaintMode mode)
		{
			StartShape(mode, clipToBounds: false);
		}

		public void StartShape(PaintMode mode, bool clipToBounds)
		{
			if (_path == null)
			{
				_path = new Path();
				_paintMode = mode;
				_clipToBounds = clipToBounds;
			}
		}

		public float GetStringWidth(string text)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			int length = text.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				char c = text[i];
				if (c < ' ')
				{
					c = ' ';
				}
				num += GetCharWidth(c);
			}
			return num;
		}

		public void Transform(Matrix matrix)
		{
			if (matrix == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("matrix");
			}
			System.Drawing.Drawing2D.Matrix transform = _nativeGraphics.Transform;
			transform.Multiply(matrix.ToNative(), System.Drawing.Drawing2D.MatrixOrder.Prepend);
			_nativeGraphics.Transform = transform;
		}

		public void Translate(float offsetX, float offsetY)
		{
			Matrix matrix = new Matrix();
			matrix.Translate(offsetX, offsetY, MatrixOrder.Prepend);
			Transform(matrix);
		}
	}

	}

		{
			private string _location;

			private ImageConverter _converter;

			private ImageCompressor _compressor;

			public ImageCompressor Compressor => _compressor;

			public ImageConverter Converter => _converter;

			public string Location => _location;

			public HashKey(string location, ImageConverter converter, ImageCompressor compressor)
			{
				if (location == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("location");
				}
				if (converter == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("converter");
				}
				if (compressor == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("compressor");
				}
				_location = location;
				_converter = converter;
				_compressor = compressor;
			}

			public override bool Equals(object key)
			{
				if (key == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (key == this)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (key is HashKey)
				{
					HashKey hashKey = (HashKey)key;
					if (_location == hashKey.Location && _converter.Equals(hashKey.Converter) && _compressor.Equals(hashKey.Compressor))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return _location.GetHashCode() ^ _converter.GetHashCode() ^ _compressor.GetHashCode();
			}
		}

		[CLSCompliant(false)]

		public Image(string source)
		{

			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("source");
			}
			if (source.StartsWith("http://") || source.StartsWith("https://"))
			{
				WebClient webClient = new WebClient();
				_original = webClient.DownloadData(source);
			}
			else
			{
				FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(source, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.Read);
				int num = (int)fileStream.Length;
				_original = new byte[num];
				fileStream.Read(_original, 0, num);
				fileStream.Close();
			}
			if (_original == null)
			{
				throw new FileNotFoundException("Image could not be loaded");
			}
			System.Drawing.Image image = System.Drawing.Image.FromStream(new MemoryStream(_original));
			_nativeImage = new WeakReference(image);
			_width = image.Width;
			_height = image.Height;
			_data = GetData(image);

		}

		protected virtual byte[] GetData()
		{

		}

		private byte[] GetData(System.Drawing.Image image)
		{
			return GetData(image, null);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private byte[] GetData(System.Drawing.Image image, Color transparentMapColor)
		{
			try
			{
				SecurityPermission securityPermission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode);
				securityPermission.Assert();
				return GetDataInterop(image, transparentMapColor);
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				return GetDataSafe(image, transparentMapColor);
			}
		}

		[SecurityCritical]
		private byte[] GetDataInterop(System.Drawing.Image image, Color transparentMapColor)
		{
			Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(image);
			System.Drawing.Rectangle rect = new System.Drawing.Rectangle(0, 0, bitmap.Width, bitmap.Height);
			BitmapData bitmapData = bitmap.LockBits(rect, ImageLockMode.ReadOnly, PixelFormat.Format32bppArgb);
			IntPtr scan = bitmapData.Scan0;
			byte[] array = new byte[bitmapData.Stride * bitmapData.Height];
			Marshal.Copy(scan, array, 0, array.Length);
			byte[] array2 = new byte[bitmapData.Width * bitmapData.Height * 3];
			for (int i = 0; i < bitmap.Height; i++)
			{
				int num = bitmapData.Stride * i;
				for (int j = 0; j < bitmapData.Width; j++)
				{
					int num2 = (int)((double)num * 0.75 + (double)(j * 3));
					int num3 = j * 4 + num;
					byte b = array[num3 + 3];
					if (AlphaChannel != null)
					{
						AlphaChannel[i * bitmap.Width + j] = b;
					}
					if (b == 0)
					{
						if (transparentMapColor != null)
						{
							array2[num2] = transparentMapColor.R;
							array2[num2 + 1] = transparentMapColor.G;
							array2[num2 + 2] = transparentMapColor.B;
						}
						else
						{
							array2[num2] = byte.MaxValue;
							array2[num2 + 1] = byte.MaxValue;
							array2[num2 + 2] = byte.MaxValue;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						array2[num2 + 2] = array[num3];
						array2[num2 + 1] = array[num3 + 1];
						array2[num2] = array[num3 + 2];
					}
					if (_alphaChannel != null)
					{
						array2[num2] = (byte)(array2[num2] * b / 255);
						array2[num2 + 1] = (byte)(array2[num2 + 1] * b / 255);
						array2[num2 + 2] = (byte)(array2[num2 + 2] * b / 255);
					}
				}
			}
			bitmap.UnlockBits(bitmapData);
			bitmap.Dispose();
			return array2;
		}

		private byte[] GetDataSafe(System.Drawing.Image image, Color transparentMapColor)
		{
			Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(image);
			byte[] array = new byte[bitmap.Width * bitmap.Height * 3];
			for (int i = 0; i < bitmap.Height; i++)
			{
				int num = i * bitmap.Width * 3;
				for (int j = 0; j < bitmap.Width; j++)
				{
					System.Drawing.Color pixel = bitmap.GetPixel(j, i);
					if (AlphaChannel != null)
					{
						AlphaChannel[i * bitmap.Width + j] = pixel.A;
					}
					if (pixel.A == 0)
					{
						if (transparentMapColor != null)
						{
							array[num++] = transparentMapColor.R;
							array[num++] = transparentMapColor.G;
							array[num++] = transparentMapColor.B;
						}
						else
						{
							array[num++] = byte.MaxValue;
							array[num++] = byte.MaxValue;
							array[num++] = byte.MaxValue;
						}
					}
					else if (_alphaChannel != null)
					{
						array[num++] = (byte)(pixel.R * pixel.A / 255);
						array[num++] = (byte)(pixel.G * pixel.A / 255);
						array[num++] = (byte)(pixel.B * pixel.A / 255);
					}
					else
					{
						array[num++] = pixel.R;
						array[num++] = pixel.G;
						array[num++] = pixel.B;
					}
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal virtual Image GetSoftMask()

		internal System.Drawing.Image ToNative(bool original)
		{
			if (_marker != null)
			{
				if (!original)
				{
					return _preferences.Converter.ToNative(this);
				}
				return ImageConverters.RGB.ToNative(this);
			}
			if (!original)
			{
				if (_preferences.Converter.Type == ConverterType.RGB)
				{
					System.Drawing.Image image = Utilities.GetWeakReferenceTarget(_nativeImage) as System.Drawing.Image;
					if (image == null)
					{
						image = _preferences.Converter.ToNative(this);
						_nativeImage = new WeakReference(image);
					}
					return image;
				}
				return _preferences.Converter.ToNative(this);
			}
			System.Drawing.Image image2 = Utilities.GetWeakReferenceTarget(_nativeImage) as System.Drawing.Image;
			if (image2 == null)
			{
				image2 = ImageConverters.RGB.ToNative(this);
				_nativeImage = new WeakReference(image2);
			}
			return image2;
		}

		public void Attach(FileBuffer fb)
		{
			if (fb == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("fb");
			}
			if (_marker == null)
			{
				IWriter writer = fb.GetWriter();
				writer.WriteInt(_data.Length);
				writer.WriteBlock(_data);
				_data = null;
				_original = null;
				_nativeImage = null;
				_marker = writer.Close();
			}
		}

		public void Detach()
		{
			_data = Data;
			_marker = null;
		}

		public float GetPhotoFactor()
		{
			byte[] data = Data;
			int num = 0;
			int i = 0;
			for (int num2 = _data.Length - 3; i < num2; i += 3)
			{
				if (data[i] != data[i + 3] && data[i + 1] != data[i + 4] && data[i + 2] != data[i + 5])
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return (float)num / (float)(Width * Height) * 100f;
		}

		public virtual Color GetPixel(int x, int y)
		{
			if (_marker != null)
			{
				throw new Exception("Image is attached to a temporary file storage.");
			}
			int num = x + y * Width;
			int num2 = num * 3;
			byte a = ((AlphaChannel != null) ? AlphaChannel[num] : byte.MaxValue);
			byte r = _data[num2++];
			byte g = _data[num2++];
			byte b = _data[num2++];
			return new Color(a, r, g, b);
		}

		public virtual void SetPixel(int x, int y, Color color)
		{
			SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
			if (color == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("color");
			}
			if (_marker != null)
			{
				throw new Exception("Image is attached to a temporary file storage.");
			}
			int num = x + y * Width;
			int num2 = num * 3;
			if (AlphaChannel != null)
			{
				AlphaChannel[num] = color.A;
			}
			_data[num2++] = color.R;
			_data[num2++] = color.G;
			_data[num2++] = color.B;
			_nativeImage = null;
		}

		public static ImageCodecInfo GetEncoderInfo(string mimeType)
		{
			ImageCodecInfo[] imageEncoders = ImageCodecInfo.GetImageEncoders();
			int num = imageEncoders.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				ImageCodecInfo imageCodecInfo = imageEncoders[i];
				if (imageCodecInfo.MimeType == mimeType)
				{
					return imageCodecInfo;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void Seal()
		{
			base.Seal();
			if (Preferences != null)
			{
				Preferences.Seal();
			}
		}

		internal override bool VerifyMembersSealed()
		{
			if (Preferences != null && !Preferences.IsSealed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		}

		public bool Underline
		{
			get
			{
				if ((_style & FontStyle.Underline) == FontStyle.Underline)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				if (value)
				{
					_style |= FontStyle.Underline;
				}
				else
				{
					_style &= ~FontStyle.Underline;
				}
				_nativeFont = null;
			}
		}

		internal byte[] Data => _data;

		public Font(string name, float size)
			: this(name, size, FontStyle.Regular)
		{
		}

		public Font(string name, float size, FontStyle style)
		{
			if (name == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("name");
			}
			if (size <= 0f)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("size", "(0.0, ...]");
			}
			_name = name;
			_size = size;
			_style = style;
			_preferences = new FontPreferences();
		}

		public Font(string name, float size, string source)
			: this(name, size, FontStyle.Regular, source)
		{
		}

		public Font(string name, float size, FontStyle style, string source)
			: this(name, size, style)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("source");
			}
			if (source.StartsWith("http://") || source.StartsWith("https://"))
			{
				WebClient webClient = new WebClient();
				_data = webClient.DownloadData(source);
			}
			else
			{
				FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(source, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.Read);
				int num = (int)fileStream.Length;
				_data = new byte[num];
				fileStream.Read(_data, 0, num);
				fileStream.Close();
			}
			_preferences.Location = source;
			_preferences.Embed = true;
			_preferences.Subset = true;
			_preferences.EnableCIDFontRendering = true;
		}

		public Font(string name, float size, System.IO.Stream stream)
			: this(name, size, FontStyle.Regular, stream)
		{
		}

		public Font(string name, float size, FontStyle style, System.IO.Stream stream)
			: this(name, size, style)
		{
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("stream");
			}
			int num = (int)stream.Length;
			_data = new byte[num];
			stream.Position = 0L;
			stream.Read(_data, 0, num);
			_preferences.Embed = true;
			_preferences.Subset = true;
			_preferences.EnableCIDFontRendering = true;
		}

		public Font(string name, float size, byte[] data)
			: this(name, size, FontStyle.Regular, data)

		}

			: this(name, size, style)
