				throw new ArgumentNullException("data");
			}
			_data = data;
			_preferences.Embed = true;
			_preferences.Subset = true;
			_preferences.EnableCIDFontRendering = true;
		}

		public Font(System.Drawing.Font font)
		{
			if (font == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("font");
			}
			_name = font.Name;
			_size = font.Size;
			_style = FontStyle.Regular;
			if ((font.Style & System.Drawing.FontStyle.Bold) == System.Drawing.FontStyle.Bold)
			{
				_style |= FontStyle.Bold;
			}
			if ((font.Style & System.Drawing.FontStyle.Italic) == System.Drawing.FontStyle.Italic)
			{
				_style |= FontStyle.Italic;
			}
			if ((font.Style & System.Drawing.FontStyle.Strikeout) == System.Drawing.FontStyle.Strikeout)
			{
				_style |= FontStyle.Strikeout;
				_nativeFont = null;
			}
			if ((font.Style & System.Drawing.FontStyle.Underline) == System.Drawing.FontStyle.Underline)
			{
				_style |= FontStyle.Underline;
				_nativeFont = null;
			}
			_preferences = new FontPreferences();
		}

		public Font Clone()
		{
			return new Font(Name, Size, Style);
		}

		public FontHashKey GetHashKey()
		{
			return new FontHashKey(_name, _size, _style);
		}

		internal ShortFontHashKey GetShortHashKey()
		{
			return new ShortFontHashKey(_name, _style);
		}

		internal Font Resize(float size)
		{
			if (size <= 0f)
			{
				size = 1f;
			}
			if (_data != null)
			{
				return new Font(_name, size, _style, _data);
			}
			return new Font(_name, size, _style);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public System.Drawing.Font ToNative()
		{
			try
			{
				SecurityPermission securityPermission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode);
				securityPermission.Assert();
				return ToNativeUnsafe();
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				System.Drawing.FontStyle fontStyle = System.Drawing.FontStyle.Regular;
				if ((_style & FontStyle.Bold) == FontStyle.Bold)
				{
					fontStyle |= System.Drawing.FontStyle.Bold;
				}
				if ((_style & FontStyle.Italic) == FontStyle.Italic)
				{
					fontStyle |= System.Drawing.FontStyle.Italic;
				}
				return new System.Drawing.Font(_name, _size, fontStyle);
			}
		}

		[SecurityCritical]
		private System.Drawing.Font ToNativeUnsafe()
		{
			object weakReferenceTarget = Utilities.GetWeakReferenceTarget(_nativeFont);
			if (weakReferenceTarget != null)
			{
				return (System.Drawing.Font)weakReferenceTarget;
			}
			System.Drawing.FontStyle fontStyle = System.Drawing.FontStyle.Regular;
			if ((_style & FontStyle.Bold) == FontStyle.Bold)
			{
				fontStyle |= System.Drawing.FontStyle.Bold;
			}
			if ((_style & FontStyle.Italic) == FontStyle.Italic)
			{
				fontStyle |= System.Drawing.FontStyle.Italic;
			}
			System.Drawing.Font font;
			if (_data != null)
			{
				int num = _data.Length;
				IntPtr intPtr = MarshalProxy.AllocHGlobal(Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(byte)) * num);
				Marshal.Copy(_data, 0, intPtr, num);
				_pfc = new PrivateFontCollection();
				_pfc.AddMemoryFont(intPtr, num);
				MarshalProxy.FreeHGlobal(intPtr);
				font = new System.Drawing.Font(_pfc.Families[0], _size, fontStyle);
			}
			else
			{
				font = new System.Drawing.Font(_name, _size, fontStyle);
			}
			_nativeFont = new WeakReference(font);
			return font;
		}

		internal MemoryStream ToStream()
		{
			if (_data != null)
			{
				return new MemoryStream(_data);
			}
			return Infragistics.Documents.Reports.TTF.Font.GetData(ToNative());
		}

		public override void Seal()
		{
			base.Seal();
			if (Preferences != null)
			{
				Preferences.Seal();
			}
		}

		internal override bool VerifyMembersSealed()
		{
			if (Preferences != null && !Preferences.IsSealed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class FontHashKey
	{
		private string _name;

		private float _size;

		private FontStyle _style;

		public string Name => _name;

		public float Size => _size;

		public FontStyle Style => _style;

		public FontHashKey(string name, float size, FontStyle style)
		{
			if (name == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("name");
			}
			if (size <= 0f)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("size", "(0.0, ...]");
			}
			_name = name;
			_size = size;
			_style = style;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object key)
		{
			if (key == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (key == this)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (key is FontHashKey)
			{
				FontHashKey fontHashKey = (FontHashKey)key;
				if (_name == fontHashKey.Name && _size == fontHashKey.Size && _style == fontHashKey.Style)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _name.GetHashCode() ^ _size.GetHashCode() ^ _style.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	internal class ShortFontHashKey
	{
		private string _name;

		private FontStyle _style;

		public string Name => _name;

		public FontStyle Style => _style;

		public ShortFontHashKey(string name, FontStyle style)
		{
			if (name == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("name");
			}
			_name = name;
			_style = style;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object key)
		{
			if (key == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (key == this)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (key is ShortFontHashKey)
			{
				ShortFontHashKey shortFontHashKey = (ShortFontHashKey)key;
				if (_name == shortFontHashKey.Name && _style == shortFontHashKey.Style)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _name.GetHashCode() ^ _style.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	public class RadialGradientBrush : IndirectBrush

		private float _angle;

		private Point _center;

		private float _radiusX;

		private float _radiusY;

		private Point _focus;

		private bool _circular;

		public override BrushType Type => BrushType.RadialGradient;

		public float Angle
		{
			get
			{
				return _angle;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_angle = value;
			}
		}

		public ColorBlend Blend
		{
			get
			{
				return _blend;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);

				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_blend = value;
			}
		}

		public Point Center
		{
			get
			{
				return _center;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);

					throw new ArgumentNullException();

		{
			get
			{

		public RadialGradientBrush()
			: this(0f)
		{
		}

		public RadialGradientBrush(float angle)
		{
			_blend = new ColorBlend();
			_angle = angle;
			_center = new Point(0.5f, 0.5f);
			_radiusX = 0.5f;
			_radiusY = 0.5f;
			_focus = new Point(0.5f, 0.5f);
		}

		public RadialGradientBrush(Color startColor, Color endColor)
			: this(startColor, endColor, 0f)

		}

		public RadialGradientBrush(Color startColor, Color endColor, float angle)
			: this(angle)
		{
			if (startColor == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("startColor");
			}
			if (endColor == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("endColor");
			}
			_blend.Add(startColor, 0f);
			_blend.Add(endColor, 1f);
		}

		public RadialGradientBrush(ColorBlend blend, float angle)
		{
			if (blend == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("blend");
			}
			_blend = blend;
			_angle = angle;
			_center = new Point(0.5f, 0.5f);
			_radiusX = 0.5f;
			_radiusY = 0.5f;
			_focus = new Point(0.5f, 0.5f);
		}

		public override Brush Clone()
		{
			return new RadialGradientBrush(Blend, Angle);
		}

		public override void Seal()
		{
			base.Seal();
			if (Blend != null)
			{
				Blend.Seal();
			}
			if (Center != null)
			{
				Center.Seal();
			}
			if (Focus != null)
			{
				Focus.Seal();
			}
		}

		public override DirectBrush SetBounds(float x, float y, float width, float height)
		{
			switch (_blend.Count)
			{
			case 0:
				return new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Black);
			case 1:
				return new SolidColorBrush(_blend[0].Color);
			default:
			{
				double num = (double)_angle * (Math.PI / 180.0);
				float num2 = (float)Math.Cos(num);
				float num3 = (float)Math.Sin(num);
				float num4 = width * Math.Abs(num2) + height * Math.Abs(num3);
				float num5 = width * Math.Abs(num3) + height * Math.Abs(num2);
				x -= (num4 - width) / 2f;
				y -= (num5 - height) / 2f;
				Point point = new Point(x + num4 * _center.X, y + num5 * _center.Y);
				Point focus = new Point(x + num4 * _focus.X, y + num5 * _focus.Y);
				float num8;
				float num10;
				if (Circular)
				{
					float num6 = ((_radiusX > _radiusY) ? _radiusX : _radiusY);
					float num7 = ((num4 > num5) ? num4 : num5);
					float num9;
					num8 = (num9 = num7 * num6);
					num10 = 1f;
				}
				else
				{
					num8 = num4 * _radiusX;
					float num9 = num5 * _radiusY;
					num10 = num9 / num8;
				}
				float num11 = Math.Max(x + num4 - point.X, point.X - x);
				float num12 = Math.Max(y + num5 - point.Y, point.Y - y);
				float num13 = num12 / num10;
				float num14 = (float)Math.Sqrt(num11 * num11 + num13 * num13);
				float radiusY = num14 * num10;
				ColorBlend colorBlend = new ColorBlend();
				ColorBlend colorBlend2 = _blend.Complete();
				int num15 = colorBlend2.Count - 1;
				colorBlend.Add(colorBlend2[num15].Color, 0f);
				float num16 = num8 / num14;
				float num17 = 1f - num16;
				while (num15 >= 0)
				{
					ColorBlendEntry colorBlendEntry = colorBlend2[num15];
					colorBlend.Add(colorBlendEntry.Color, (1f - colorBlendEntry.Position) * num16 + num17);
					num15--;
				}
				Matrix matrix = new Matrix();
				matrix.Multiply(new Matrix(1f, 0f, 0f, 1f, 0f - point.X, 0f - point.Y), MatrixOrder.Append);
				matrix.Multiply(new Matrix(num2, num3, 0f - num3, num2, 0f, 0f), MatrixOrder.Append);
				matrix.Multiply(new Matrix(1f, 0f, 0f, 1f, point.X, point.Y), MatrixOrder.Append);
				RadialGradientDirectBrush radialGradientDirectBrush = new RadialGradientDirectBrush(colorBlend, point, num14, radiusY, focus, matrix);
				radialGradientDirectBrush.Circular = Circular;
				return radialGradientDirectBrush;
			}
			}
		}

		internal override bool VerifyMembersSealed()
		{
			if (Blend != null && !Blend.IsSealed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Center != null && !Center.IsSealed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Focus != null && !Focus.IsSealed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class PointCollection : List<Point>
	{
		public void Add(float x, float y)
		{
			Add(new Point(x, y));
		}

		public void Insert(int index, float x, float y)
		{
			Insert(index, new Point(x, y));
		}

		internal static PointCollection Parse(string data)
		{
			if (data == null || data.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CharBuffer charBuffer = new CharBuffer();
			List<float> list = new List<float>();
			foreach (char c in data)
			{
				if (char.IsDigit(c) || c == '.')
				{
					charBuffer.Add(c);
				}
				else if (charBuffer.Count > 0)
				{
					list.Add(Convert.ToSingle(charBuffer.ToString(), Converter.NumberFormatInfo));
					charBuffer.Clear();
				}
			}
			if (charBuffer.Count > 0)
			{
				list.Add(Convert.ToSingle(charBuffer.ToString(), Converter.NumberFormatInfo));
			}
			PointCollection pointCollection = new PointCollection();
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = list.Count / 2 * 2;
			while (num < num2)
			{
				pointCollection.Add(new Point(list[num++], list[num++]));
			}
			return pointCollection;
		}
	}
	public class LinearGradientBrush : IndirectBrush

				Blend.Seal();

		public override DirectBrush SetBounds(float x, float y, float width, float height)
		{
			switch (_blend.Count)
			{
			case 0:
				return new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Black);
			case 1:
				return new SolidColorBrush(_blend[0].Color);
			default:
			{
				float num = x + width / 2f;
				float num2 = y + height / 2f;
				double num3 = (double)_angle * (Math.PI / 180.0);
				float num4 = (float)Math.Cos(num3);
				float num5 = (float)Math.Sin(num3);
				float m = (width * Math.Abs(num4) + height * Math.Abs(num5)) / width;
				float m2 = (width * Math.Abs(num5) + height * Math.Abs(num4)) / height;
				Matrix matrix = new Matrix();
				matrix.Multiply(new Matrix(1f, 0f, 0f, 1f, 0f - num, 0f - num2), MatrixOrder.Append);
				matrix.Multiply(new Matrix(m, 0f, 0f, m2, 0f, 0f), MatrixOrder.Append);
				matrix.Multiply(new Matrix(num4, num5, 0f - num5, num4, 0f, 0f), MatrixOrder.Append);
				matrix.Multiply(new Matrix(1f, 0f, 0f, 1f, num, num2), MatrixOrder.Append);
				return new LinearGradientDirectBrush(_blend, new Rectangle(x, y, width, height), matrix);
			}
			}
		}

		internal override bool VerifyMembersSealed()
		{
			if (Blend != null && !Blend.IsSealed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static Color GetGlassColor(Color baseColor, int opacity)
		{
			if (opacity < 0)
			{
				opacity = 0;
			}
			if (opacity > 255)
			{
				opacity = 255;
			}
			float num = (float)opacity / 255f;
			float num2 = (float)(255 - opacity) / 255f;
			byte r = (byte)(num2 * (float)(int)baseColor.R + num * 255f);
			byte g = (byte)(num2 * (float)(int)baseColor.G + num * 255f);
			byte b = (byte)(num2 * (float)(int)baseColor.B + num * 255f);
			return new Color(r, g, b);
		}

		public static LinearGradientBrush CreateGlassBrush(Color backColor, Color backColor2, GlassGradientStyle gradientStyle)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			switch (gradientStyle)
			{
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassTop20:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassTop37:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassTop50:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassBottom20:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassBottom37:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassBottom50:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassLeft20:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassLeft37:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassLeft50:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassRight20:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassRight37:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassRight50:
				flag = false;
				break;
			}
			float position = 0f;
			switch (gradientStyle)
			{
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassTop20:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassBottom20:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassLeft20:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassRight20:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassTop20Bright:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassBottom20Bright:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassLeft20Bright:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassRight20Bright:
				position = 0.2f;
				break;
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassTop37:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassBottom37:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassLeft37:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassRight37:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassTop37Bright:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassBottom37Bright:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassLeft37Bright:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassRight37Bright:
				position = 0.375f;
				break;
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassTop50:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassBottom50:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassLeft50:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassRight50:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassTop50Bright:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassBottom50Bright:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassLeft50Bright:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassRight50Bright:
				position = 0.5f;
				break;
			}
			float angle;
			switch (gradientStyle)
			{
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassBottom20:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassBottom37:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassBottom50:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassBottom20Bright:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassBottom37Bright:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassBottom50Bright:
				angle = -90f;
				break;
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassLeft20:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassLeft37:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassLeft50:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassLeft20Bright:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassLeft37Bright:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassLeft50Bright:
				angle = 0f;
				break;
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassRight20:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassRight37:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassRight50:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassRight20Bright:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassRight37Bright:
			case GlassGradientStyle.GlassRight50Bright:
				angle = 180f;
				break;
			default:
				angle = 90f;
				break;
			}
			LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush();
			linearGradientBrush.Angle = angle;
			int opacity = (flag ? 50 : 20);
			int opacity2 = (flag ? 240 : 140);
			Color glassColor = GetGlassColor(backColor, opacity);
			Color glassColor2 = GetGlassColor(backColor, opacity2);
			ColorBlend blend = linearGradientBrush.Blend;
			blend.Add(glassColor2, 0f);
			blend.Add(glassColor, position);
			blend.Add(backColor, position);
			blend.Add(backColor2, 1f);
			linearGradientBrush.Seal();
			return linearGradientBrush;
		}
	}
	public class Matrix : SealableBase
	{
		private float _m11;

		private float _m12;

		private float _m21;

		private float _m22;

		private float _offsetX;

		private float _offsetY;

		public bool IsIdentity
		{
			get
			{
				if (_m11 == 1f && _m12 == 0f && _m21 == 0f && _m22 == 1f && _offsetX == 0f && _offsetY == 0f)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public float M11
		{
			get
			{
				return _m11;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_m11 = value;
			}
		}

		public float M12
		{
			get
			{
				return _m12;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_m12 = value;
			}
		}

		public float M21
		{
			get
			{
				return _m21;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_m21 = value;
			}
		}

		public float M22
		{
			get
			{
				return _m22;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_m22 = value;
			}
		}

		public float OffsetX
		{
			get
			{
				return _offsetX;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_offsetX = value;
			}
		}

		public float OffsetY
		{
			get
			{
				return _offsetY;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_offsetY = value;
			}
		}

		public static Matrix Identity => new Matrix(1f, 0f, 0f, 1f, 0f, 0f);

		public Matrix()
			: this(1f, 0f, 0f, 1f, 0f, 0f)
		{
		}

		public Matrix(float m11, float m12, float m21, float m22, float offsetX, float offsetY)
		{
			_m11 = m11;
			_m12 = m12;
			_m21 = m21;
			_m22 = m22;
			_offsetX = offsetX;
			_offsetY = offsetY;
		}

		public Matrix(System.Drawing.Drawing2D.Matrix matrix)
		{
			if (matrix == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("matrix");
			}
			_m11 = matrix.Elements[0];
			_m12 = matrix.Elements[1];
			_m21 = matrix.Elements[2];
			_m22 = matrix.Elements[3];
			_offsetX = matrix.Elements[4];
			_offsetY = matrix.Elements[5];
		}

		public System.Drawing.Drawing2D.Matrix ToNative()
		{
			return new System.Drawing.Drawing2D.Matrix(_m11, _m12, _m21, _m22, _offsetX, _offsetY);
		}

		public Matrix Clone()
		{
			return new Matrix(_m11, _m12, _m21, _m22, _offsetX, _offsetY);
		}

		public void Multiply(Matrix matrix)
		{
			Multiply(matrix, MatrixOrder.Prepend);
		}

		public void Multiply(Matrix matrix, MatrixOrder order)
		{
			SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
			if (matrix == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("matrix");
			}
			float m;
			float m2;
			float m3;
			float m4;
			float offsetX;
			float offsetY;
			float m5;
			float m6;
			float m7;
			float m8;
			float offsetX2;
			float offsetY2;
			if (order == MatrixOrder.Append)
			{
				m = _m11;
				m2 = _m12;
				m3 = _m21;
				m4 = _m22;
				offsetX = _offsetX;
				offsetY = _offsetY;
				m5 = matrix.M11;
				m6 = matrix.M12;
				m7 = matrix.M21;
				m8 = matrix.M22;
				offsetX2 = matrix.OffsetX;
				offsetY2 = matrix.OffsetY;
			}
			else
			{
				m = matrix.M11;
				m2 = matrix.M12;
				m3 = matrix.M21;
				m4 = matrix.M22;
				offsetX = matrix.OffsetX;
				offsetY = matrix.OffsetY;
				m5 = _m11;
				m6 = _m12;
				m7 = _m21;
				m8 = _m22;
				offsetX2 = _offsetX;
				offsetY2 = _offsetY;
			}
			_m11 = m * m5 + m2 * m7;
			_m12 = m * m6 + m2 * m8;
			_m21 = m3 * m5 + m4 * m7;
			_m22 = m3 * m6 + m4 * m8;
			_offsetX = offsetX * m5 + offsetY * m7 + offsetX2;
			_offsetY = offsetX * m6 + offsetY * m8 + offsetY2;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
			_m11 = 1f;
			_m12 = 0f;
			_m21 = 0f;
			_m22 = 1f;
			_offsetX = 0f;
			_offsetY = 0f;
		}

		public void Rotate(float angle)
		{
			Rotate(angle, MatrixOrder.Prepend);
		}

		public void Rotate(float angle, MatrixOrder order)
		{
			SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
			double num = (double)angle * (Math.PI / 180.0);
			float num2 = (float)Math.Cos(num);
			float num3 = (float)Math.Sin(num);
			Matrix matrix = new Matrix(num2, num3, 0f - num3, num2, 0f, 0f);
			Multiply(matrix, order);
		}

		public void RotateAt(float angle, Point center)
		{
			RotateAt(angle, center, MatrixOrder.Prepend);
		}

		public void RotateAt(float angle, Point center, MatrixOrder order)
		{
			SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
			if (center == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("center");
			}
			double num = (double)angle * (Math.PI / 180.0);
			float num2 = (float)Math.Cos(num);
			float num3 = (float)Math.Sin(num);
			Matrix matrix = new Matrix(1f, 0f, 0f, 1f, 0f - center.X, 0f - center.Y);
			Matrix matrix2 = new Matrix(num2, num3, 0f - num3, num2, 0f, 0f);
			Matrix matrix3 = new Matrix(1f, 0f, 0f, 1f, center.X, center.Y);
			matrix.Multiply(matrix2, MatrixOrder.Append);
			matrix.Multiply(matrix3, MatrixOrder.Append);
			Multiply(matrix, order);
		}

		public void Scale(float scaleX, float scaleY)
		{
			Scale(scaleX, scaleY, MatrixOrder.Prepend);
		}

		public void Scale(float scaleX, float scaleY, MatrixOrder order)
		{
			SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
			Matrix matrix = new Matrix(scaleX, 0f, 0f, scaleY, 0f, 0f);
			Multiply(matrix, order);
		}

		public void ScaleAt(float scaleX, float scaleY, Point center)
		{
			ScaleAt(scaleX, scaleY, center, MatrixOrder.Prepend);
		}

		public void ScaleAt(float scaleX, float scaleY, Point center, MatrixOrder order)
		{
			SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
			if (center == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("center");
			}
			Matrix matrix = new Matrix(1f, 0f, 0f, 1f, 0f - center.X, 0f - center.Y);
			Matrix matrix2 = new Matrix(scaleX, 0f, 0f, scaleY, 0f, 0f);
			Matrix matrix3 = new Matrix(1f, 0f, 0f, 1f, center.X, center.Y);
			matrix.Multiply(matrix2, MatrixOrder.Append);
			matrix.Multiply(matrix3, MatrixOrder.Append);
			Multiply(matrix, order);
		}

		public void Shear(float shearX, float shearY)
		{
			Shear(shearX, shearY, MatrixOrder.Prepend);
		}

		public void Shear(float shearX, float shearY, MatrixOrder order)
		{
			SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
			Matrix matrix = new Matrix(1f, shearY, shearX, 1f, 0f, 0f);
			Multiply(matrix, order);
		}

		public void ShearAt(float shearX, float shearY, Point center)
		{
			ShearAt(shearX, shearY, center, MatrixOrder.Prepend);
		}

		public void ShearAt(float shearX, float shearY, Point center, MatrixOrder order)
		{
			SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
			if (center == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("center");
			}
			Matrix matrix = new Matrix(1f, 0f, 0f, 1f, 0f - center.X, 0f - center.Y);
			Matrix matrix2 = new Matrix(1f, shearY, shearX, 1f, 0f, 0f);
			Matrix matrix3 = new Matrix(1f, 0f, 0f, 1f, center.X, center.Y);
			matrix.Multiply(matrix2, MatrixOrder.Append);
			matrix.Multiply(matrix3, MatrixOrder.Append);
			Multiply(matrix, order);
		}

		public void Skew(float skewX, float skewY)
		{
			Skew(skewX, skewY, MatrixOrder.Prepend);
		}

		public void Skew(float skewX, float skewY, MatrixOrder order)
		{
			SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
			double a = (double)skewX * (Math.PI / 180.0);
			double a2 = (double)skewY * (Math.PI / 180.0);
			float m = (float)Math.Tan(a);
			float m2 = (float)Math.Tan(a2);
			Matrix matrix = new Matrix(1f, m2, m, 1f, 0f, 0f);
			Multiply(matrix, order);
		}

		public void SkewAt(float skewX, float skewY, Point center)
		{
			SkewAt(skewX, skewY, center, MatrixOrder.Prepend);
		}

		public void SkewAt(float skewX, float skewY, Point center, MatrixOrder order)
		{
			SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
			if (center == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("center");
			}
			double a = (double)skewX * (Math.PI / 180.0);
			double a2 = (double)skewY * (Math.PI / 180.0);
			float m = (float)Math.Tan(a);
			float m2 = (float)Math.Tan(a2);
			Matrix matrix = new Matrix(1f, 0f, 0f, 1f, 0f - center.X, 0f - center.Y);
			Matrix matrix2 = new Matrix(1f, m2, m, 1f, 0f, 0f);
			Matrix matrix3 = new Matrix(1f, 0f, 0f, 1f, center.X, center.Y);
			matrix.Multiply(matrix2, MatrixOrder.Append);
			matrix.Multiply(matrix3, MatrixOrder.Append);
			Multiply(matrix, order);
		}

		public Point TransformPoint(float x, float y)
		{
			float x2 = x * _m11 + y * _m21 + _offsetX;
			float y2 = x * _m12 + y * _m22 + _offsetY;
			return new Point(x2, y2);
		}

		public Point TransformPoint(Point point)
		{
			if (point == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("point");
			}
			return TransformPoint(point.X, point.Y);
		}

		public void TransformPoints(Point[] points)
		{
			if (points == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("points");
			}
			foreach (Point point in points)
			{
				float x = point.X * _m11 + point.Y * _m21 + _offsetX;
				float y = point.X * _m12 + point.Y * _m22 + _offsetY;
				point.X = x;
				point.Y = y;
			}
		}

		public void TransformPoints(PointCollection points)
		{
			if (points == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("points");
			}
			foreach (Point point in points)
			{
				float x = point.X * _m11 + point.Y * _m21 + _offsetX;
				float y = point.X * _m12 + point.Y * _m22 + _offsetY;
				point.X = x;
				point.Y = y;
			}
		}

		public void Translate(float offsetX, float offsetY)
		{
			Translate(offsetX, offsetY, MatrixOrder.Prepend);
		}

		public void Translate(float offsetX, float offsetY, MatrixOrder order)
		{
			SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
			Matrix matrix = new Matrix(1f, 0f, 0f, 1f, offsetX, offsetY);
			Multiply(matrix, order);
		}
	}

		internal override System.Drawing.Brush ToNative()
		{
			object weakReferenceTarget = Utilities.GetWeakReferenceTarget(_nativeBrush);
			if (weakReferenceTarget != null)
			{

			}
			SolidBrush solidBrush = new SolidBrush(_color.ToNative());
			_nativeBrush = new WeakReference(solidBrush);
			return solidBrush;
		}

	internal static class DashStylePattern
	{

	public class Pen : SealableBase
	{
		internal class HashKey
		{
			private Color _color;

			private float _width;

			private DashStyle _style;

			private LineCap _cap;

			private LineJoin _join;

			private float _miterLimit;

			public LineCap Cap => _cap;

			public Color Color => _color;

			public LineJoin Join => _join;

			public float MiterLimit => _miterLimit;

			public DashStyle Style => _style;

			public float Width => _width;

			public HashKey(Color color, float width, DashStyle style, LineCap cap, LineJoin join, float miterLimit)
			{
				if (color == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("color");
				}
				if (width <= 0f)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("width", "(0.0, ...]");
				}
				_color = color;
				_width = width;
				_style = style;
				_cap = cap;
				_join = join;
				_miterLimit = miterLimit;
			}

			public override bool Equals(object key)
			{
				if (key == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (key == this)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (key is HashKey)
				{
					HashKey hashKey = (HashKey)key;
					if (_color.Equals(hashKey.Color) && _width == hashKey.Width && _style == hashKey.Style && _cap == hashKey.Cap && _join == hashKey.Join && _miterLimit == hashKey.MiterLimit)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return (int)(_color.ToARGB() ^ (uint)_width.GetHashCode() ^ (uint)_style.GetHashCode() ^ (uint)_cap.GetHashCode() ^ (uint)_join.GetHashCode()) ^ _miterLimit.GetHashCode();
			}
		}

		private Color _color;

		private float _width;

		private DashStyle _style;

		private LineCap _cap;

		private LineJoin _join;

		private float _miterLimit;

		private WeakReference _nativePen;

		public LineCap Cap
		{
			get
			{
				return _cap;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_cap = value;
				_nativePen = null;
			}
		}

		public Color Color
		{
			get
			{
				return _color;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_color = value;
				_nativePen = null;
			}
		}

		public LineJoin Join
		{
			get
			{
				return _join;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_join = value;
				_nativePen = null;
			}
		}

		public float MiterLimit
		{
			get
			{
				return _miterLimit;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_miterLimit = value;
				_nativePen = null;
			}
		}

		public DashStyle Style
		{
			get
			{
				return _style;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_style = value;
				_nativePen = null;
			}
		}

		public float Width
		{
			get
			{
				return _width;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				if (value <= 0f)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(null, "(0.0, ...]");
				}
				_width = value;
				_nativePen = null;
			}
		}

		public Pen(Color color)
			: this(color, 1f, DashStyle.Solid)
		{
		}

		public Pen(Color color, float width)
			: this(color, width, DashStyle.Solid)
		{
		}

		public Pen(Color color, DashStyle style)
			: this(color, 1f, style)
		{
		}

		public Pen(Color color, float width, DashStyle style)
		{
			if (color == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("color");
			}
			if (width <= 0f)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("width", "(0.0, ...]");
			}
			_color = color;
			_width = width;
			_style = style;
			_cap = LineCap.Flat;
			_join = LineJoin.Miter;
			_miterLimit = 10f;
		}

		public Pen(Color color, float width, DashStyle style, LineCap cap, LineJoin join, float miterLimit)
		{
			if (color == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("color");
			}
			if (width <= 0f)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("width", "(0.0, ...]");
			}
			_color = color;
			_width = width;
			_style = style;
			_cap = cap;
			_join = join;
			_miterLimit = miterLimit;
		}

		public Pen(System.Drawing.Pen pen)
		{
			if (pen == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("pen");
			}
			_color = new Color(pen.Color);
			_width = pen.Width;
			switch (pen.DashStyle)
			{
			case System.Drawing.Drawing2D.DashStyle.Solid:
				_style = DashStyle.Solid;
				break;
			case System.Drawing.Drawing2D.DashStyle.Dash:
				_style = DashStyle.Dash;
				break;
			case System.Drawing.Drawing2D.DashStyle.DashDot:
				_style = DashStyle.DashDot;
				break;
			case System.Drawing.Drawing2D.DashStyle.DashDotDot:
				_style = DashStyle.DashDotDot;
				break;
			case System.Drawing.Drawing2D.DashStyle.Dot:
				_style = DashStyle.Dot;
				break;
			}
			switch (pen.StartCap)
			{
			case System.Drawing.Drawing2D.LineCap.Flat:
				_cap = LineCap.Flat;
				break;
			case System.Drawing.Drawing2D.LineCap.Round:
				_cap = LineCap.Round;
				break;
			case System.Drawing.Drawing2D.LineCap.Square:
				_cap = LineCap.Square;
				break;
			}
			switch (pen.LineJoin)
			{
			case System.Drawing.Drawing2D.LineJoin.Miter:
				_join = LineJoin.Miter;
				break;
			case System.Drawing.Drawing2D.LineJoin.Round:
				_join = LineJoin.Round;
				break;
			case System.Drawing.Drawing2D.LineJoin.Bevel:
				_join = LineJoin.Bevel;
				break;
			}
			_miterLimit = pen.MiterLimit;
		}

		public bool Equals(Pen pen)
		{
			if (pen == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (pen == this)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (_color.Equals(pen.Color) && _width == pen.Width && _style == pen.Style && _cap == pen.Cap && _join == pen.Join && _miterLimit == pen.MiterLimit)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal float[] GetStylePattern()
		{
			return GetStylePattern(this);
		}

		internal System.Drawing.Pen ToNative()
		{
			object weakReferenceTarget = Utilities.GetWeakReferenceTarget(_nativePen);
			if (weakReferenceTarget != null)
			{
				return (System.Drawing.Pen)weakReferenceTarget;
			}
			System.Drawing.Pen pen = new System.Drawing.Pen(_color.ToNative(), _width);
			switch (_style)
			{
			case DashStyle.Solid:
				pen.DashStyle = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.DashStyle.Solid;
				break;
			case DashStyle.Dash:
				pen.DashStyle = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.DashStyle.Dash;
				break;
			case DashStyle.DashDot:
				pen.DashStyle = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.DashStyle.DashDot;
				break;
			case DashStyle.DashDotDot:
				pen.DashStyle = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.DashStyle.DashDotDot;
				break;
			case DashStyle.Dot:
				pen.DashStyle = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.DashStyle.Dot;
				break;
			}
			switch (_cap)
			{
			case LineCap.Flat:
				pen.StartCap = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.LineCap.Flat;
				pen.EndCap = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.LineCap.Flat;
				break;
			case LineCap.Round:
				pen.StartCap = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.LineCap.Round;
				pen.EndCap = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.LineCap.Round;
				break;
			case LineCap.Square:
				pen.StartCap = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.LineCap.Square;
				pen.EndCap = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.LineCap.Square;
				break;
			}
			switch (_join)
			{
			case LineJoin.Miter:
				pen.LineJoin = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.LineJoin.Miter;
				break;
			case LineJoin.Round:
				pen.LineJoin = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.LineJoin.Round;
				break;
			case LineJoin.Bevel:
				pen.LineJoin = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.LineJoin.Bevel;
				break;
			}
			pen.MiterLimit = _miterLimit;
			_nativePen = new WeakReference(pen);
			return pen;
		}

		internal static float[] GetStylePattern(Pen pen)
		{
			float[] result = DashStylePattern.Solid;
			switch (pen.Style)
			{
			case DashStyle.Solid:
				result = DashStylePattern.Solid;
				break;
			case DashStyle.Dash:
				result = DashStylePattern.Dash;
				break;
			case DashStyle.DashDot:
				result = DashStylePattern.DashDot;
				break;
			case DashStyle.DashDotDot:
				result = DashStylePattern.DashDotDot;
				break;
			case DashStyle.Dot:
				result = DashStylePattern.Dot;
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public class Rectangle : SealableBase
	{
		private float _x;

		private float _y;

		private float _width;

		private float _height;

		public float Height
		{
			get
			{
				return _height;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_height = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (_x == 0f && _y == 0f && _width == 0f && _height == 0f)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public Point Location
		{
			get
			{
				return new Point(_x, _y);
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_x = value.X;
				_y = value.Y;
			}
		}

		public Size Size
		{
			get
			{
				return new Size(_width, _height);
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				_width = value.Width;
				_height = value.Height;
			}
		}

		public float Width
		{
			get
			{
				return _width;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_width = value;
			}
		}

		public float X
		{
			get
			{
				return _x;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_x = value;
			}
		}

		public float Y
		{
			get
			{
				return _y;
			}
			set
			{
				SealableBase.VerifyNotSealed(this);
				_y = value;
			}
		}

		public Rectangle()
		{
		}

		public Rectangle(Point point, Size size)
			: this(point.X, point.Y, size.Width, size.Height)
		{
		}

		public Rectangle(float x, float y, float width, float height)
		{
			_x = x;
			_y = y;
			_width = width;
			_height = height;
		}

		public Rectangle(RectangleF rectangle)
		{
			_x = rectangle.X;
			_y = rectangle.Y;
			_width = rectangle.Width;
			_height = rectangle.Height;
		}

		internal RectangleF ToNative()
		{
			return new RectangleF(_x, _y, _width, _height);
		}

		public Rectangle Clone()
		{
			return new Rectangle(_x, _y, _width, _height);
		}

		public bool Equals(Rectangle rectangle)
		{
			if (rectangle == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (rectangle == this)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (_x == rectangle.X && _height == rectangle.Y && _width == rectangle.Width && _height == rectangle.Height)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public Rectangle Intersection(float x, float y, float width, float height)
		{
			if (Intersects(x, y, width, height))
			{
				float num = _x;
				float num2 = _y;
				float num3 = num + _width;
				float num4 = num2 + _height;
				float num5 = x + width;
				float num6 = y + height;
				if (num < x)
				{
					num = x;
				}
				if (num2 < y)
				{
					num2 = y;
				}
				if (num3 > num5)
				{
					num3 = num5;
				}
				if (num4 > num6)
				{
					num4 = num6;
				}
				return new Rectangle(num, num2, num3 - num, num4 - num2);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public Rectangle Intersection(Rectangle rectangle)
		{
			if (rectangle == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("rectangle");
			}
			return Intersection(rectangle.X, rectangle.Y, rectangle.Width, rectangle.Height);
		}

		public bool Intersects(float x, float y, float width, float height)
		{
			if (x + width <= _x || y + height <= _y || x >= _x + _width || y >= _y + _height)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool Intersects(Rectangle rectangle)
		{
			if (rectangle == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("rectangle");
			}
			return Intersects(rectangle.X, rectangle.Y, rectangle.Width, rectangle.Height);
		}

		public bool IsPointInside(float x, float y)
		{
			if (x >= _x && x - _x < _width && y >= _y && y - _y < _height)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool PointInside(Point point)
		{
			if (point == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("point");
			}
			return IsPointInside(point.X, point.Y);
		}

		public override void Seal()
		{
			base.Seal();
			if (Location != null)
			{
				Location.Seal();
			}
			if (Size != null)
			{
				Size.Seal();
			}
		}

		public Rectangle Union(float x, float y, float width, float height)
		{
			float num = Math.Min(_x, x);
			float num2 = Math.Min(_y, y);
			float num3 = Math.Max(_x + _width, x + width);
			float num4 = Math.Max(_y + _height, y + height);
			return new Rectangle(num, num2, num3 - num, num4 - num2);
		}

		public Rectangle Union(Rectangle rectangle)
		{
			if (rectangle == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("rectangle");
			}
			return Union(rectangle.X, rectangle.Y, rectangle.Width, rectangle.Height);
		}

		public Rectangle Union(float x, float y)
		{
			float num = Math.Min(_x, x);
			float num2 = Math.Min(_y, y);
			float num3 = Math.Max(_x + _width, x);
			float num4 = Math.Max(_y + _height, y);
			return new Rectangle(num, num2, num3 - num, num4 - num2);
		}

		public Rectangle Union(Point point)
		{
			if (point == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("point");
			}
			return Union(point.X, point.Y);
		}
	}

	public class Color
	{
		private byte _a;

		private byte _r;

		private byte _g;

		private byte _b;

		public byte A => _a;

		public byte R => _r;

		public byte G => _g;

		public byte B => _b;

		public string Name => Colors.GetName(this);

		public Color(byte r, byte g, byte b)
			: this(byte.MaxValue, r, g, b)
		{
		}

		public Color(byte a, byte r, byte g, byte b)
		{
			_a = a;
			_r = r;
			_g = g;
			_b = b;
		}

		[CLSCompliant(false)]
		public Color(uint value)
		{
			_a = (byte)(value >> 24);
			_r = (byte)(value >> 16);
			_g = (byte)(value >> 8);
			_b = (byte)value;
		}

		public Color(System.Drawing.Color color)
		{
			_a = color.A;
			_r = color.R;
			_g = color.G;
			_b = color.B;
		}

		public bool Equals(Color color)
		{
			if (color == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (color == this)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (_a == color.A && _r == color.R && _g == color.G && _b == color.B)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[CLSCompliant(false)]
		public uint ToARGB()
		{
			uint a = _a;
			a <<= 8;
			a |= _r;
			a <<= 8;
			a |= _g;
			a <<= 8;
			return a | _b;
		}

		public string ToHex()
		{
			CharBuffer charBuffer = new CharBuffer();
			charBuffer.Add('#');
			if (_a != byte.MaxValue)
			{
				charBuffer.Add(Converter.ToHex(_a));
			}
			charBuffer.Add(Converter.ToHex(_r));
			charBuffer.Add(Converter.ToHex(_g));
			charBuffer.Add(Converter.ToHex(_b));
			return charBuffer.ToString();
		}

		internal System.Drawing.Color ToNative()
		{
			return System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(_a, _r, _g, _b);
		}

		internal static Color Parse(string value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int length = value.Length;
			if (length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (value[0] == '#')
			{
				byte a = byte.MaxValue;
				byte r = 0;
				byte g = 0;
				byte b = 0;
				switch (length)
				{
				case 4:
					r = Convert.ToByte(value.Substring(1, 1), 16);
					r |= (byte)(r << 4);
					g = Convert.ToByte(value.Substring(2, 1), 16);
					g |= (byte)(g << 4);
					b = Convert.ToByte(value.Substring(3, 1), 16);
					b |= (byte)(b << 4);
					break;
				case 5:
					a = Convert.ToByte(value.Substring(1, 1), 16);
					a |= (byte)(a << 4);
					r = Convert.ToByte(value.Substring(2, 1), 16);
					r |= (byte)(r << 4);
					g = Convert.ToByte(value.Substring(3, 1), 16);
					g |= (byte)(g << 4);
					b = Convert.ToByte(value.Substring(4, 1), 16);
					b |= (byte)(b << 4);
					break;
				case 7:
					r = Convert.ToByte(value.Substring(1, 2), 16);
					g = Convert.ToByte(value.Substring(3, 2), 16);
					b = Convert.ToByte(value.Substring(5, 2), 16);
					break;
				case 9:
					a = Convert.ToByte(value.Substring(1, 2), 16);
					r = Convert.ToByte(value.Substring(3, 2), 16);
					g = Convert.ToByte(value.Substring(5, 2), 16);
					b = Convert.ToByte(value.Substring(7, 2), 16);
					break;
				}
				return new Color(a, r, g, b);
			}
			int num = -1;
			if (value.StartsWith("ARGB"))
			{
				num = 0;
			}
			else if (value.StartsWith("RGB"))
			{
				num = 1;
			}
			if (num != -1)
			{
				byte a2 = byte.MaxValue;
				byte r2 = 0;
				byte g2 = 0;
				byte b2 = 0;
				int num2 = 0;
				bool flag = false;
				for (int i = 4 - num; i < length; i++)
				{
					char c = value[i];
					if (char.IsNumber(c))
					{
						num2 = num2 * 10 + (byte)c - 48;
						flag = true;
					}
					else if (flag)
					{
						switch (num)
						{
						case 0:
							a2 = (byte)num2;
							break;
						case 1:
							r2 = (byte)num2;
							break;
						case 2:
							g2 = (byte)num2;
							break;
						case 3:
							b2 = (byte)num2;
							return new Color(a2, r2, g2, b2);
						}
						num++;
						num2 = 0;
						flag = false;
					}
				}
			}
			return Colors.GetColor(value);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _a.GetHashCode() ^ _b.GetHashCode() ^ _g.GetHashCode() ^ _r.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is Color color))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (A == color.A && B == color.B && G == color.G)
			{
				return R == color.R;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		public static Color GetColor(string name)
		{
			if (name == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (_colors.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				return _colors[name];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static string GetName(Color color)
		{
			if (color == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			uint key = color.ToARGB();
			if (_names.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				return _names[key];
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal class VirtualGraphics : IGraphics
	{
		private class State
		{
			private Font _font;

			private Brush _brush;

			private Pen _pen;

			private Matrix _matrix;

			private float _charSpacing;

			private bool _alternateFill;

			public bool AlternateFill
			{
				get
				{
					return _alternateFill;
				}

					_alternateFill = value;
				}
			}

			{

					_brush = value;

			}

		private Matrix _matrix;

		private Stack<State> _states;

		private Dictionary<Infragistics.Documents.Reports.TTF.FontHashKey, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.TTF.Font> _fontHash;

		private Infragistics.Documents.Reports.TTF.Font _ttFont;

		private Font _font;

		private Brush _brush;

		private Pen _pen;

		private float _fontSize;

		private float _fontAscent;

		private float _fontDescent;

		private float _fontHeight;

		private float _boldFactor;

		private bool _hyperlinkStarted;

		private bool _hyperlinkPaused;

		private float _posX;

		private float _posY;

		private float _charSpacing;

		private bool _alternateFill;

		public bool AlternateFill
		{
			get
			{
				return _alternateFill;
			}
			set
			{
				_alternateFill = value;
			}
		}

		public Brush Brush
		{
			get
			{
				return _brush;
			}
			set
			{
				_brush = value;
			}
		}

		public float CharSpacing
		{
			get
			{
				return _charSpacing;
			}
			set
			{
				_charSpacing = value;
			}
		}

		public Font Font
		{
			get
			{
				return _font;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_font == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				_font = value;
				if (_font != null)
				{
					Infragistics.Documents.Reports.TTF.FontHashKey key = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.TTF.FontHashKey(_font.Name, _font.Style);
					if (_fontHash.ContainsKey(key))
					{
						_ttFont = _fontHash[key];
					}
					else
					{
						_ttFont = Infragistics.Documents.Reports.TTF.FontFactory.CreateFont(_font);
						_fontHash.Add(key, _ttFont);
					}
					_fontSize = _font.Size;
					_fontAscent = _fontSize * _ttFont.Ascent;
					_fontDescent = _fontSize * _ttFont.Descent;
					_fontHeight = _fontSize * _ttFont.Height;
					bool flag = (_font.Style & FontStyle.Bold) == FontStyle.Bold;
					bool flag2 = (_ttFont.Style & FontStyle.Bold) == FontStyle.Bold;
					if (flag && !flag2)
					{
						_boldFactor = 1.15f;
					}
					else
					{
						_boldFactor = 1f;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_ttFont = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public FontMetrics FontMetrics => new FontMetrics(_fontAscent, _fontDescent, _fontHeight);

		public bool HyperlinkPaused => _hyperlinkPaused;

		public bool HyperlinkStarted => _hyperlinkStarted;

		public Pen Pen
		{
			get
			{
				return _pen;
			}
			set
			{
				_pen = value;
			}
		}

		public Point TextPosition
		{
			get
			{
				return new Point(_posX, _posY);
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				SetTextPosition(value.X, value.Y);
			}
		}

		public Matrix Transformation => _matrix.Clone();

		public VirtualGraphics()
			: this(new Dictionary<Infragistics.Documents.Reports.TTF.FontHashKey, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.TTF.Font>(100))
		{
		}

		public VirtualGraphics(Dictionary<Infragistics.Documents.Reports.TTF.FontHashKey, Infragistics.Documents.Reports.TTF.Font> activeFonts)
		{
			_matrix = new Matrix();
			_states = new Stack<State>();
			_fontHash = activeFonts;
			_alternateFill = true;
		}

		private void PopState()
		{
			State state = _states.Pop();
			Font = state.Font;
			Brush = state.Brush;
			Pen = state.Pen;
			_matrix = state.Matrix;
			_charSpacing = state.CharSpacing;
			_alternateFill = state.AlternateFill;
		}

		private void PushState()
		{
			State state = new State();
			state.Font = _font;
			state.Brush = _brush;
			state.Pen = _pen;
			state.Matrix = _matrix.Clone();
			state.CharSpacing = _charSpacing;
			state.AlternateFill = _alternateFill;
			_states.Push(state);
		}

		private void SetTextPosition(float x, float y)
		{
			int num = (int)(_posX * 100f);
			int num2 = (int)(x * 100f);
			int num3 = (int)(_posY * 100f);
			int num4 = (int)(y * 100f);
			if (Math.Abs(num - num2) > 1 || Math.Abs(num3 - num4) > 1)
			{
				_posX = x;
				_posY = y;
			}
		}

		public float GetCharWidth(char ch)
		{
			if (_ttFont != null)
			{
				return _fontSize * _boldFactor * (float)_ttFont.GlyphWidth(ch) / 1000f + _charSpacing;
			}
			return 0f;
		}

		public float GetStringWidth(string text)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			int length = text.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				char c = text[i];
				if (c < ' ')
				{
					c = ' ';
				}
				num += GetCharWidth(c);
			}
			return num;
		}

	public class Metafile
	{
		[CLSCompliant(false)]
		protected MemoryStream _stream;

		[CLSCompliant(false)]
		protected MetafilePreferences _preferences;

		public MetafilePreferences Preferences => _preferences;

		protected Metafile()
		{
		}

		public Metafile(string source)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("source");
			}
			byte[] buffer;
			if (source.StartsWith("http://") || source.StartsWith("https://"))
			{
				WebClient webClient = new WebClient();
				buffer = webClient.DownloadData(source);
			}
			else
			{
				FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(source, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.Read);
				int num = (int)fileStream.Length;
				buffer = new byte[num];
				fileStream.Read(buffer, 0, num);
				fileStream.Close();
			}
			_stream = new MemoryStream(buffer);
			_preferences = new MetafilePreferences();
			_preferences.Location = source;
		}

		public Metafile(System.IO.Stream stream)
		{
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("stream");
			}
			int num = (int)stream.Length;
			byte[] buffer = new byte[num];
			stream.Position = 0L;
			stream.Read(buffer, 0, num);
			_stream = new MemoryStream(buffer);
			_preferences = new MetafilePreferences();
			_preferences.Embed = true;
		}

		internal MemoryStream ToStream()
		{
			return _stream;
		}

		public Size GetSize()
		{
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.WMF.Metafile metafile = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.WMF.Metafile(_stream);
			return metafile.GetSize();
		}

		public void Playback(IGraphics graphics, float x, float y, float scale)
		{
			Playback(graphics, x, y, scale, null);
		}

		public void Playback(IGraphics graphics, float x, float y, float scale, IFontMapper fontMapper)
		{
			Infragistics.Documents.Reports.WMF.Metafile metafile = new Infragistics.Documents.Reports.WMF.Metafile(_stream);
			metafile.Playback(graphics, x, y, scale, fontMapper);
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Shared
{
	internal sealed class SR
	{
		private static SR loader;

		private ResourceManager[] resources;

		private SR()
		{
			string text = "Infragistics.Documents.Reports.strings";
			string[] array = text.Split(';');
			int num = 0;
			string[] array2 = array;
			foreach (string text2 in array2)
			{
				if (text2 != null && text2.Length > 0)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			resources = new ResourceManager[num];
			Assembly assembly = GetType().Assembly;
			int num2 = 0;
			string[] array3 = array;
			foreach (string text3 in array3)
			{
				if (text3 != null && text3.Length > 0)
				{
					resources[num2++] = new ResourceManager(text3, assembly);
				}
			}
		}

		private static SR GetLoader()
		{
			if (loader == null)
			{
				lock (typeof(SR))
				{
					if (loader == null)
					{
						loader = new SR();
					}
				}
			}
			return loader;
		}

		public static string GetString(string name)
		{
			return GetString(null, name);
		}

		public static string GetString(string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return GetString(null, name, args);
		}

		public static string GetString(CultureInfo culture, string name)
		{
			return GetString(culture, name, null);
		}

		public static string GetString(CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return GetStringHelper(allowCustomizedStrings: true, culture, name, args);
		}

		private static string GetStringHelper(bool allowCustomizedStrings, CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
		{
			string text = null;
			if (allowCustomizedStrings)
			{
				text = ResourceCustomizerLocator.Customizer.GetCustomizedString(name);
			}
			if (text == null)
			{
				SR sR = GetLoader();
				if (sR == null)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				text = sR.GetString(name, culture);
				if (text == null)
				{
					text = string.Empty;
				}
			}
			if (args != null && args.Length != 0 && text.Length > 2)
			{
				try
				{
					text = string.Format(null, text, args);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return text;
		}

		private string GetString(string name, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			ResourceManager[] array = resources;
			foreach (ResourceManager resourceManager in array)
			{
				string text = resourceManager.GetString(name, culture);
				if (text != null)
				{
					return text;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static string GetUncustomizedString(string name)
		{
			return GetUncustomizedString(null, name);
		}

		public static string GetUncustomizedString(string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return GetUncustomizedString(null, name, args);
		}

		public static string GetUncustomizedString(CultureInfo culture, string name)
		{
			return GetUncustomizedString(culture, name, null);
		}

		public static string GetUncustomizedString(CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return GetStringHelper(allowCustomizedStrings: false, culture, name, args);
		}

		public static object GetObject(string name)
		{
			return GetObject(null, name);
		}

		public static object GetObject(CultureInfo culture, string name)
		{
			return GetLoader()?.GetObject(name, culture);
		}

		private object GetObject(string name, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			ResourceManager[] array = resources;
			foreach (ResourceManager resourceManager in array)
			{
				object obj = resourceManager.GetObject(name, culture);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					return obj;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
